drop table IF EXISTS  dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_01

create table dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_01 as
select
    t1.time_now
    ,week_id
    ,month_id
    ,year_id
from
(
    select
        day_id as time_now
        ,week_id
        ,month_id
        ,year_id
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where month_id <= substr('${bizdate}',1,6) group by day_id,week_id,month_id,year_id
) t1
drop table IF EXISTS  dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_02

create table dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_02 as
select
    t1.mapping_time
    ,t1.year_id
    ,t1.month_id
    ,t2.time_now
from
(
    select
        month_id as mapping_time
        ,year_id
        ,month_id
        ,max(week_id) as max_week_id
        ,min(week_id) as min_week_id
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where month_id <= substr('${bizdate}',1,6) group by year_id,month_id
) t1
left join
    dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_01 t2
on t2.week_id <= t1.max_week_id and t2.week_id >= t1.min_week_id and t1.year_id = t2.year_id
drop table IF EXISTS  dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_03

create table dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_03 as
select
    substr(week_id,1,4) as year
    ,week_id
    --modify by shiwu ,根据业务需求，次数调整为WYYMMDD样式
    -- ,concat(min(day_id),'-',max(day_id)) as week_desc
    ,concat('W',min(substr(day_id,3,6))) as week_desc
from
    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
    --where substr(week_id,5,2) != '00'
group by week_id

insert overwrite table  ${dme_cdm}.dim_mgm_mapping_time
select
    t1.mapping_time
    ,t1.time_now
    ,t2.week_id
    -- ,concat(cast(cast(substr(min(t3.day_id),5,2) as int) as string),'.',cast(cast(substr(min(t3.day_id),8,2) as int) as string),'-',cast(cast(substr(max(t3.day_id),5,2) as int) as string),'.',cast(cast(substr(max(t3.day_id),8,2) as int) as string))
    --modify by shiwu datav需求将时间展示为YYYYMMDD形式
    ,t3.week_desc
from
    dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_02 t1
left join
    dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_01 t2
on t1.time_now = t2.time_now
left join
    dme_cdm.dim_mgm_mapping_time_03 t3
on t2.week_id = t3.week_id

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_deduction partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select  
        t2.customer_code
        ,cast(t1.deduction * t2.allocation_proportion as decimal(28,2)) as deduction
        ,t1.months
from    (
            select  months
                    ,deduction
            from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_ttl_by_month
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_ttl_by_month')
        ) t1
left join  (
              select  customer_code
                      ,allocation_proportion
                      ,months
              from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_deduction_mapping_info
              where   ds = max_pt(
                              '${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_deduction_mapping_info'
                      )
            ) t2
on      t1.months = t2.months

sum(l12_upload) as l12_upload,

sum(l13_processing_cost) as l13_processing_cost,
sum(l14_total_manufactur) as l14_total_manufactur,

sum(o2o_a2) as o2o_a2,
sum(o2o_b) as o2o_b,
sum(o2o_c) as o2o_c,
sum(o2o_d) as o2o_d,

sum(py_release_a2) as py_release_a2,
sum(py_release_b) as py_release_b,
sum(py_release_c) as py_release_c,
sum(py_release_d) as py_release_d,
sum(ttl_py_release) as ttl_py_release,
sum(po_a1) as po_a1,
sum(po_a2) as po_a2,
sum(po_b) as po_b,
sum(po_c) as po_c,
sum(po_d) as po_d,

sum(mkt_a2) as mkt_a2,
sum(mkt_b) as mkt_b,

sum(digital_a2) as digital_a2,
sum(digital_b) as digital_b,
sum(digital_c) as digital_c,
sum(digital_d) as digital_d

select  coalesce(t1.customer_code,t2.customer_code,t3.customer_code,t4.customer_code,t5.customer_code,t6.customer_code,t7.customer_code,t8.customer_code,t9.customer_code,t10.customer_code,t11.customer_code,t12.customer_code,t13.customer_code,t14.customer_code) as customer_code
        ,nvl(t1.ges,0) as ges
        ,nvl(t1.ppd,0) as ppd
        ,nvl(t1.pld,0) as pld
        ,nvl(t1.fg,0) as fg
        ,nvl(t1.ngs,0) as ngs
        ,nvl(t2.others,0) as others
        ,nvl(t2.rebate,0) as rebate
        ,nvl(t2.logistics,0) as logistics
        ,nvl(t2.ca,0) as ca

        ,nvl(t2.ttl_copa,0) as ttl_copa

        ,nvl(t6.l10_dsr,0) as l10_dsr

        ,nvl(t7.l10_surtax,0)+nvl(t6.l10_dsr,0)+nvl(t5.l10_bdp,0) as ttl_l10
        ,nvl(t8.l11_from_ke30,0) as l11_from_ke30
        ,nvl(t8.l11_upload,0) as l11_upload
        ,nvl(t8.ttl_l11,0) as ttl_l11
        ,nvl(t9.l12_material_cost,0) as l12_material_cost
        ,nvl(t9.l12_ror_return,0) as l12_ror_return
        ,nvl(t9.l12_tp_price_others,0) as l12_tp_price_others
        ,nvl(t9.l12_upload,0) as l12_upload
        ,nvl(t9.ttl_l12,0) as ttl_l12

        ,nvl(t9.l14_total_manufactur,0) as l14_total_manufactur
        ,nvl(t9.l16_additional_opera,0) as l16_additional_opera
        ,nvl(t10.o2o_a1,0) as o2o_a1
        ,nvl(t10.o2o_a2,0) as o2o_a2
        ,nvl(t10.o2o_b,0) as o2o_b
        ,nvl(t10.o2o_c,0) as o2o_c
        ,nvl(t10.o2o_d,0) as o2o_d
        ,nvl(t10.ttl_o2o,0) as ttl_o2o

        ,nvl(t11.py_release_a2,0) as py_release_a2
        ,nvl(t11.py_release_b,0) as py_release_b
        ,nvl(t11.py_release_c,0) as py_release_c
        ,nvl(t11.py_release_d,0) as py_release_d

        ,nvl(t12.po_b,0) as po_b
        ,nvl(t12.po_c,0) as po_c
        ,nvl(t12.po_d,0) as po_d

            select  customer_code

                    ,l10_dsr

            from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_l10_dsr

on      t1.customer_code = t6.customer_code

        case when channel_name_lastest='NKA' then 
                case when customer_group ='Watsons' then 'Watson\'s'
                     when customer_group ='Mannings' then 'Manning\'s'
                     when customer_group ='Sams' then 'Sam\'s' --20231009添加山姆

                     when customer_group ='CRV-SG' then 'Tesco'

,substr(ds,1,6) as months
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer
where ds like '%01'

and tt1.months=tt2.months

tt1.months

--补全月份
select t1.customer_code,
t1.month_id as months,
t1.year_id as years
 from(
select o.month_id,o.year_id,m.customer_code from (
select  month_id
        ,'1' as flag
        ,year_id
        from    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
        where month_id >='202201' and month_id < to_char(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm')
        group by  month_id,year_id
) o 
join (
     select
      customer_code,'1' as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ke24 where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ke24')
       group by customer_code
) m on o.flag=m.flag
) t1
  left join(
  select customer_code,not_require_month from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_not_require_info where ds =
  max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_not_require_info')
) t2 on t1.customer_code=t2.customer_code 
and t1.month_id=t2.not_require_month
where t2.customer_code is null

--计算每个客户的每月的YTD指标,再给当月是否有销量打标签
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ges_ytd_proportion_temp02

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ges_ytd_proportion_temp02 as 
select  
customer_code,
years,
months,
max(sales_quantity_flag) as sales_quantity_flag,
SUM(SUM(ges)) OVER (
                                partition by customer_code
                                ,years
                                ORDER BY  months ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                                AND     CURRENT ROW
        ) as ges_ytd --实现按月累加
from    (
            select  t1.customer_code
                    ,t1.months
                    ,t1.years
                    ,nvl(t2.sales_quantity_flag,0) as sales_quantity_flag
                    ,nvl(t2.ges ,0) as ges
            from    (
                        select  customer_code
                                ,months
                                ,years
                        from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ges_ytd_proportion_temp01
                    ) t1
            left join  (
                          select  customer_code
                                  ,months
                                  ,ges
                                  ,case when sales_quantity = 0 then '0'
                                  else '1' end as sales_quantity_flag
                          from   ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ke24
                          where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_customer_ke24')
                      ) t2
            on      t1.customer_code = t2.customer_code
            and     t1.months = t2.months
        ) t3
group by customer_code,
years,
months

        ,'0' as is_not_zero

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_l17_kob1 partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select customer_code,
       order_code,
       cast(sum(nvl(kob1_a1,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as kob1_a1,
       cast(sum(nvl(kob1_a2,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as kob1_a2,
       cast(sum(nvl(kob1_b,0))  as decimal(28,2)) as kob1_b,
       cast(sum(nvl(kob1_c,0))  as decimal(28,2)) as kob1_c,
       cast(sum(nvl(kob1_d,0)) as decimal(28,2))  as kob1_d,
       months
from(
select customer_code,
        order_code,
case when lower(line) ='a1'  then cost_amt end as kob1_a1,
case when lower(line) ='a2'  then cost_amt end as kob1_a2,
case when lower(line) ='b'  then cost_amt end as kob1_b,
case when lower(line) ='c'  then cost_amt end as kob1_c,
case when lower(line) ='d'  then cost_amt end as kob1_d,
months
 from(
select  customer_code
        ,order_ as order_code
        ,nvl(value_in_obj_crcy,0) as cost_amt
        ,line
        ,period as months
        -- ,row_number() over(
        --                       partition by customer_code
        --                       ,line
        --                       ,order_
        --                       ,period
        --                       order by  modify_time desc
        -- ) as rn
from    dme_ods.s_allocation_l17_kob1
where   ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_allocation_l17_kob1')
and period <>'' and period is not null and line <>'' and line is not null
) t 
) t1
-- where rn=1
group by customer_code,
        order_code,
        months

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_l17_o2o partition(ds='${bizdate}')

month as months
from(
--step1 先将列转行,获取费用类型,月份,和渠道和费用的对应关系

select 
    line,
    month,
   str_to_map(concat("wts",":",nvl(wts,0),",","walmart",":",nvl(walmart,0),",","dt",":",nvl(dt,0),",","ws",":",nvl(ws,0)),',',':') as tagmap
 from dme_cdm.dwd_allocation_l17_o2o_temp01
) t1 LATERAL view explode(tagmap) temp as channel,cost_amt
) t2 group by case when channel='ws' then 'mpd' else channel end ,
month

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_allocation_l6_accruals_cy partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
customer_code,
months,
cast(sum(nvl(ppf_ca,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as ppf_ca_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(lff_listing_fee,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as lff_listing_fee_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(pxf_nka_expense_oos,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as pxf_nka_expense_oos_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(adf_nka_expense_others,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as adf_nka_expense_others_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(abf_nka_expense_new_store,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as abf_nka_expense_new_store_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(adf_lka_contract_fee,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as adf_lka_contract_fee_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(abf_rebate_unconditional,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as abf_rebate_unconditional_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(gbf_rebate_conditional,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as gbf_rebate_conditional,
cast(sum(nvl(abf_indirect_rebate,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as abf_indirect_rebate_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(qlf_logistics,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as qlf_logistics_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(euf_int_agmt,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as euf_int_agmt_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(adf_2nd_dis_oths_w_contr,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as adf_2nd_dis_oths_w_contr_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(fff_2nd_dis_oths_wo_contr,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as fff_2nd_dis_oths_wo_contr_cy,
cast(sum(nvl(ppf_ca,0)+nvl(lff_listing_fee,0)+nvl(pxf_nka_expense_oos,0)+nvl(adf_nka_expense_others,0)+nvl(abf_nka_expense_new_store,0)+nvl(adf_lka_contract_fee,0)+nvl(abf_rebate_unconditional,0)+nvl(gbf_rebate_conditional,0)++nvl(abf_indirect_rebate,0)+nvl(qlf_logistics,0)+nvl(euf_int_agmt,0)+nvl(adf_2nd_dis_oths_w_contr,0)+nvl(fff_2nd_dis_oths_wo_contr,0)) as decimal(28,2)) as ttl_cy
from(

select customer_code,
       months,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='ppf' and lower(type) ='ca' then calculate_amount end as ppf_ca,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='lff' and lower(type) ='listing fee' then calculate_amount end  as lff_listing_fee,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='pxf' and lower(type) ='nka expense-oos' then calculate_amount end as pxf_nka_expense_oos,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='adf' and lower(type) ='nka expense-others' then calculate_amount end as adf_nka_expense_others,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='abf' and lower(type) ='nka expense-new store' then calculate_amount end as abf_nka_expense_new_store,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='adf' and lower(type) ='lka contract fee' then calculate_amount end as adf_lka_contract_fee,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='abf' and lower(type) ='rebate-unconditional' then calculate_amount end as abf_rebate_unconditional,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='gbf' and lower(type) ='rebate-conditional' then calculate_amount end as gbf_rebate_conditional,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='abf' and lower(type) ='indirect rebate' then calculate_amount end as abf_indirect_rebate,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='qlf' and lower(type) ='logistics' then calculate_amount end as qlf_logistics,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='euf' and lower(type) ='int. agmt' then  calculate_amount end as euf_int_agmt,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='adf' and lower(type) ='2nd dis+oths - w.contr' then calculate_amount end as adf_2nd_dis_oths_w_contr,
       case when lower(itas_code) ='fff' and lower(type) ='2nd dis+oths - wo.contr' then calculate_amount end as fff_2nd_dis_oths_wo_contr
 from 
(
----- DT/WS
select idh as customer_code,
case when regexp_count(budget_month, '.')=0 and length(budget_month) =6
then budget_month
else 
concat(
split_part(budget_month,'.',1),
case when length(split_part(budget_month,'.',2))=1 then concat('0',split_part(budget_month,'.',2))
 else split_part(budget_month,'.',2) end)
end as months
,itas_code
,type
,actual_usable_amt_untax as calculate_amount
-- ,
-- row_number() over(
--                                     partition by customer_code
--                                     ,itas_code
--                                     ,budget_month
--                                     ,type
--                                     order by  modify_time desc
--                     ) as rn
from
dme_ods.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_dt
where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_dt')
union all 
---------- NKA
select 
case when lower(idh) ='metro' then 'Metro'
     when lower(idh) ='homeclub' then 'HomeClub'
     when lower(idh) ='sasa' then 'SaSa'
     else idh 
end as customer_code,
case when regexp_count(budget_month, '.')=0 and length(budget_month) =6
then budget_month
else 
concat(
split_part(budget_month,'.',1),
case when length(split_part(budget_month,'.',2))=1 then concat('0',split_part(budget_month,'.',2))
 else split_part(budget_month,'.',2) end)
end as months,
itas_code,
type,
apply_amt as calculate_amount
-- ,
-- row_number() over(
--                                     partition by customer_code
--                                     ,itas_code
--                                     ,budget_month
--                                     ,type
--                                     order by  modify_time desc
--                     ) as rn
from
dme_ods.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_nka
where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_nka')
union all 
-----------Ecom
select 
customer_code,
concat(year,
case when length(replace(accrual_month,'月','')) = 2 then replace(accrual_month,'月','')
else concat('0',replace(accrual_month,'月','')) end) as months,
itas_code,
type as type,
cost_amt_untax as calculate_amount
-- ,
-- row_number() over(
--                                     partition by customer_code
--                                     ,itas_code
--                                     ,accrual_month
--                                     ,cost_type
--                                     order by  modify_time desc
--                     ) as rn
from
${dme_ods}.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_ecom
where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_allocation_l6_accruals_cy_ecom')
) t
where  customer_code is not null and months is not null and customer_code <>'' and months <>''
-- rn=1 and
) t1
group by customer_code,
months

--20241104  mass    小数精度统一提调整6位小数
--20251224  mass  调整已有门店id和名称信息，新增TP侧门店id和名称
--********************************************************************--
with
city_attack_bc_gmv_ecom_tmp_00 as(
 select
    bu      -- Beauty Care/SKP
   ,months  -- 数据月份
   ,store_id -- 店铺
   ,store_name -- 店铺名称
   ,gmv -- GMV
   ,row_number()over(partition by bu ,months,store_id,store_name order by create_time desc) as rn
 from ${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_bc_gmv_ecom
 where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_bc_gmv_ecom')
)

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_city_attack_bc_gmv_ecom partition(ds='${bizdate}')
  SELECT  
   case when upper(trim(a.bu))='BEAUTY CARE' THEN 'Consumer' 
         when upper(trim(a.bu))='SKP' THEN 'Professional' 
      end as bu_1    -- Consumer/Professional
   ,a.bu as bu_2    -- Beauty Care/SKP
   ,a.months  -- 数据月份
   ,case when nvl(b.store_code,'')<>'' then b.store_code
         when a.store_name regexp '小红书施华蔻' then '4060'
         when a.store_name regexp '小红书汉高'   then '1347'
       else a.store_id
     end as store_id -- 店铺
   ,nvl(b.store_name,a.store_name) as store_name -- 店铺名称
   ,cast(a.gmv as decimal(28,6)) as  gmv -- GMV
   ,now() as create_time       -- 创建时间        
   ,case when a.store_name regexp '小红书施华蔻' then '4060'
         when a.store_name regexp '小红书汉高'   then '1347'
       else a.store_id
     end as store_id_tp -- TP侧店铺
   ,a.store_name as store_name_tp -- TP侧店铺名称             
from city_attack_bc_gmv_ecom_tmp_00 a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
 on case when a.store_name regexp '小红书施华蔻' then '4060'
         when a.store_name regexp '小红书汉高'   then '1347'
         when a.store_id='0' then '601'
       else a.store_id
     end = b.ec_store_code_tp
 and nvl(b.ec_store_code_tp,'')<>''
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
where a.rn=1

with
city_attack_city_l17_tmp_00 as(
 select 
   bu
  ,months
  ,city_name
  ,Media_OOH_Digital_ads
  ,Flagship_salon
  ,Flagship_salon_POSM
  ,Roadshow

  ,Retail_enhancement
  ,BHT
  ,row_number()over(partition by bu,months,city_name order by create_time desc ,modify_time desc) as rn
 from ${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_city_l17_tmkt a
 where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_city_l17_tmkt')
)
,
city_attack_city_l17_tmp_01 as(
 select 
   bu
  ,months
  ,city_name
  ,Brand_MKT
  ,Media_Team
  ,Mega_Roadshow
  ,row_number()over(partition by bu,months,city_name order by create_time desc ,modify_time desc) as rn
 from ${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_city_l17_mkt a
 where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_attack_city_l17_mkt')
)

,
city_attack_city_l17_tmp_02 as(
 select 
    bu
    ,months
    ,city_name
    ,cast(Media_OOH_Digital_ads   as decimal(28,6)) as Media_OOH_Digital_ads
    ,cast(Flagship_salon          as decimal(28,6)) as Flagship_salon
    ,cast(Flagship_salon_POSM     as decimal(28,6)) as Flagship_salon_POSM
    ,cast(Roadshow                as decimal(28,6)) as Roadshow
    ,cast(O2O                     as decimal(28,6)) as O2O
    ,cast(Retail_enhancement      as decimal(28,6)) as Retail_enhancement
    ,cast(BHT                     as decimal(28,6)) as BHT
    ,null as Brand_MKT     
    ,null as Media_Team   
    ,null as Mega_Roadshow           
 from city_attack_city_l17_tmp_00 
 where rn=1
 union all
 select 
     bu
     ,months
     ,city_name
     ,null as Media_OOH_Digital_ads 
     ,null as Flagship_salon       
     ,null as Flagship_salon_POSM  
     ,null as Roadshow             
     ,null as O2O                  
     ,null as Retail_enhancement   
     ,null as BHT             
     ,cast(Brand_MKT     as decimal(28,6)) as Brand_MKT     
     ,cast(Media_Team    as decimal(28,6)) as Media_Team   
     ,cast(Mega_Roadshow as decimal(28,6)) as Mega_Roadshow
 from city_attack_city_l17_tmp_01 
 where rn=1
)

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_city_attack_city_l17 partition(ds='${bizdate}')
  SELECT  
   a.bu 
   ,a.months  -- 数据月份
   ,case when b.city_name is not null then b.city_name
      else a.city_name
     end as city_name -- 城市
   ,cast(sum(nvl(a.Media_OOH_Digital_ads,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Flagship_salon,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Flagship_salon_POSM,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Roadshow,0))
      + sum(nvl(a.O2O,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Retail_enhancement,0)) + sum(nvl(a.BHT,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Brand_MKT,0))
      + sum(nvl(a.Media_Team,0)) + sum(nvl(a.Mega_Roadshow,0))as DECIMAL(28,2)) as L17 -- GMV
   ,cast(sum(a.Brand_MKT            ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Brand_MKT     
   ,cast(sum(a.Media_Team           ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Media_Team   
   ,cast(sum(a.Mega_Roadshow        ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Mega_Roadshow
   ,cast(sum(a.Media_OOH_Digital_ads) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Media_OOH_Digital_ads
   ,cast(sum(a.Flagship_salon       ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Flagship_salon
   ,cast(sum(a.Flagship_salon_POSM  ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Flagship_salon_POSM
   ,cast(sum(a.Roadshow             ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Roadshow
   ,cast(sum(a.O2O                  ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as O2O
   ,cast(sum(a.Retail_enhancement   ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as Retail_enhancement
   ,cast(sum(a.BHT                  ) as DECIMAL(28,2)) as BHT      
   ,now() as create_time       -- 创建时间              
   ,nvl(b.province_name,'Others') as province_name --  省份名称       
from city_attack_city_l17_tmp_02 a
left join (
   select *,row_number()over(partition by district_name order by ds desc, create_time desc ) as rn
   from ${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping 
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping')
) b
 on a.city_name=b.district_name
 and b.rn=1
group by  
   a.bu 
   ,a.months  -- 数据月份
   ,case when b.city_name is not null then b.city_name
      else a.city_name
     end 
   ,nvl(b.province_name,'Others')  --  省份名称

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_city_attack_store_gmv_ecom partition(ds='${bizdate}')
  SELECT  
   case when upper(trim(a.bu))='BEAUTY CARE' THEN 'Consumer' 
         when upper(trim(a.bu))='SKP' THEN 'Professional' 
      end as bu_1    -- Consumer/Professional
    ,a.bu as bu_2    -- Beauty Care/SKP
    ,a.months  -- 数据月份
    ,case when b.city_name is not null then b.city_name
      else 'Others'
     end as city_name  --城市名称
    ,case when b.province_name is not null then b.province_name
      else 'Others'
     end as province_name  --省份名称
    ,case when nvl(c.store_code,'')<>'' then c.store_code
          when a.store_name regexp '专业京东' then '102'
          when a.store_name regexp '施华蔻京东' then '103'
          when a.store_name regexp '丝蕴京东' then '104'
       else a.store_id
      end as store_id   --门店ID
    ,case when nvl(c.store_code,'')<>'' then c.store_name
          when a.store_name regexp '专业京东' then '施华蔻专业京东官旗'
          when a.store_name regexp '施华蔻京东' then '施华蔻京东官旗'
          when a.store_name regexp '丝蕴京东' then '丝蕴京东官旗'
        else a.store_name
      end as store_name --tp侧门店名称
    ,cast(a.gmv as decimal(28,6)) as  gmv -- GMV
    ,now() as create_time       -- 创建时间
    ,case when a.store_name regexp '专业京东' then '102'
          when a.store_name regexp '施华蔻京东' then '103'
          when a.store_name regexp '丝蕴京东' then '104'
       else store_id
      end as store_id_tp   --tp侧门店ID
    ,case when a.store_name regexp '专业京东' then '施华蔻专业京东官旗'
          when a.store_name regexp '施华蔻京东' then '施华蔻京东官旗'
          when a.store_name regexp '丝蕴京东' then '丝蕴京东官旗'
        else a.store_name
      end as store_name_tp --tp侧门店名称
from city_attack_store_gmv_ecom_tmp_00 a
left join (
   select *,row_number()over(partition by district_name order by ds desc, create_time desc ) as rn
   from ${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping 
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping')
 ) b
 on a.city_name=b.district_name
 and b.rn=1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu c
 on case when a.store_name regexp '专业京东' then '102'
          when a.store_name regexp '施华蔻京东' then '103'
          when a.store_name regexp '丝蕴京东' then '104'
       else a.store_id
      end = c.ec_store_code_tp
 and nvl(c.ec_store_code_tp,'')<>''
 and c.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
where a.rn=1

   ,t1.ending_ar_balance_act_net                  AS    ending_ar_balance_act_net          
   ,t1.ending_ar_balance_diff                     AS    ending_ar_balance_diff             
   ,t1.ending_od_balance_plan                     AS    ending_od_balance_plan             
   ,t1.ending_od_balance_act                      AS    ending_od_balance_act

        ,cast(new_od_due_in_the_current_month      AS  decimal)  as  new_od_due_in_the_current_month

        ,cast(net_sell_in_act                      AS  decimal)  as  net_sell_in_act                    
        ,cast(net_sell_in_diff                     AS  decimal)  as  net_sell_in_diff                   
        ,cast(cash_collection_plan                 AS  decimal)  as  cash_collection_plan               
        ,cast(cash_collection_act                  AS  decimal)  as  cash_collection_act                
        ,cast(cash_collection_diff                 AS  decimal)  as  cash_collection_diff               
        ,cast(expense_claim_plan                   AS  decimal)  as  expense_claim_plan                 
        ,cast(expense_claim_act                    AS  decimal)  as  expense_claim_act                  
        ,cast(expense_claim_diff                   AS  decimal)  as  expense_claim_diff                 
        ,cast(zu_dr_dg_dn_act                      AS  decimal)  as  zu_dr_dg_dn_act                    
        ,cast(da_act                               AS  decimal)  as  da_act                             
        ,cast(ending_ar_balance_plan_gross         AS  decimal)  as  ending_ar_balance_plan_gross       
        ,cast(ending_ar_balance_plan_net           AS  decimal)  as  ending_ar_balance_plan_net         
        ,cast(ending_ar_balance_act_gross          AS  decimal)  as  ending_ar_balance_act_gross        
        ,cast(ending_ar_balance_act_net            AS  decimal)  as  ending_ar_balance_act_net          
        ,cast(ending_ar_balance_diff               AS  decimal)  as  ending_ar_balance_diff             
        ,cast(ending_od_balance_plan               AS  decimal)  as  ending_od_balance_plan             
        ,cast(ending_od_balance_act                AS  decimal)  as  ending_od_balance_act              
        ,cast(ending_od_balance_diff               AS  decimal)  as  ending_od_balance_diff             
        ,cast(sell_out_plan_excl_vat               AS  decimal)  as  sell_out_plan_excl_vat             
        ,cast(sell_in_target_in_ngs                AS  decimal)  as  sell_in_target_in_ngs              
        ,cast(sell_out_target_in_base_price        AS  decimal)  as  sell_out_target_in_base_price      
        ,cast(stock                                AS  decimal)  as  stock                              
        ,row_number() over(partition by customer_id,months,status,system_name order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_cnr_ar_simulation_sop       
    where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_cnr_ar_simulation_sop') 
)t1
left join     
(   --常规为DT、化妆品渠道为COS、深分为BC
    --关联DMS的销售负责人mapping，取到销售负责和省经理
    select 
         t1.dist_code
        ,decode(t1.dist_type_code,'常规','DT','深分','BC','化妆品渠道','COS')  as  customer_system
        ,t2.customer_head_of_sales
        ,t2.provincial_manager
    from dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor t1
    left join
    (
        select 
            customer_code
           ,customer_head_of_sales
           ,provincial_manager
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_sales_head_mapping_sop
        where ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_customer_sales_head_mapping_sop') 
        group by customer_code
            ,customer_head_of_sales
            ,provincial_manager
    )t2
    on t1.dist_code = t2.customer_code
    where t1.ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor') 
     -- and t1.dist_type_code in('化妆品渠道','常规','深分')
    group by  t1.dist_code
        ,decode(t1.dist_type_code,'常规','DT','深分','BC','化妆品渠道','COS')
        ,t2.customer_head_of_sales
        ,t2.provincial_manager
)t2
on t1.customer_id = t2.dist_code
left join
(
    select
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch  as  region
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch  as  province
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer a 
    left join (  --取省份的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'province'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )b
    on a.province_en = b.area_en
     left join (  --取区域的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'area'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )c
    on a.region_en = c.area_en
    where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') 
    group by
        customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch  
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch 
)t3
on t1.customer_id = t3.customer_code
where t1.rn = 1

from    (

                    ,row_number() OVER(
                                    partition by idh
                                    ,year
                                    ,month
                                    order by  ds desc
                    ) rk
            from    (
                        select  year --年
                                ,case   month
                                        when 'Jan' then concat(year ,'01')
                                        when 'Feb' then concat(year ,'02')
                                        when 'Mar' then concat(year ,'03')
                                        when 'Apr' then concat(year ,'04')
                                        when 'May' then concat(year ,'05')
                                        when 'Jun' then concat(year ,'06')
                                        when 'Jul' then concat(year ,'07')
                                        when 'Aug' then concat(year ,'08')
                                        when 'Sep' then concat(year ,'09')
                                        when 'Oct' then concat(year ,'10')
                                        when 'Nov' then concat(year ,'11')
                                        when 'Dec' then concat(year ,'12')
                                end as month
                                ,month as month_en --月
                                ,region --区域
                                ,case when upper(trim(replace(customer_type ,'-' ,'')))='WS' then 'MPD' else replace(customer_type ,'-' ,'') end as customer_type --渠道
                                ,system_name --客户分类
                                ,idh --经销商代码
                                ,customer_name --客户名称
                                ,status --合作状态
                                ,cast(
                                  case   when instr(replace(ges ,'e' ,'E') ,'E') != 0 then 0
                                          when ges = '-' or ges is null then 0

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_ka_sell_out_target_sop partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
     years
    ,quarter 
    ,z.months    
    ,province                 
    ,customer_id              
    ,customer_name            
    ,ka_code                  
    ,ka_name                  
    ,rkam                     
    ,rkae
    ,region
    ,ka_type    
    ,z.target_by_month
    ,target_ttl  
from 
(       
    select 
        years
       ,quarter                   
       ,province                 
       ,customer_id              
       ,customer_name            
       ,ka_code                  
       ,ka_name                  
       ,rkam                     
       ,rkae 
       ,region
       ,ka_type
       ,target_ttl 
       ,map( --生成月份和月目标的键值对
           concat(substr(quarter,1,4),DECODE(substr(quarter,5,2),'Q1','01','Q2','04','Q3','07','Q4','10')),first_month_target  
          ,concat(substr(quarter,1,4),DECODE(substr(quarter,5,2),'Q1','02','Q2','05','Q3','08','Q4','11')),second_month_target  
          ,concat(substr(quarter,1,4),DECODE(substr(quarter,5,2),'Q1','03','Q2','06','Q3','09','Q4','12')),third_month_target   
    
       ) as kv        
    from
    (
        select 
            substr(t1.quarter,1,4)  as  years
            ,t1.quarter                   
            ,case when t1.ka_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t4.province_cn end  as  province                 
            ,t1.customer_id              
            ,t4.customer_name            
            ,t1.ka_code                  
            ,t1.ka_name                  
            ,t5.rkam   as    rkam                 
            ,t1.rkae 
            ,case when t1.ka_name = '大润发华南' then '南区' else t4.region_cn end  as  region
            ,t3.ka_type
             --去除空格、逗号、并转换成数值  
            ,nvl(cast(regexp_replace(trim(first_month_target ), ',', '')  as  decimal),0)  as   first_month_target   
            ,nvl(cast(regexp_replace(trim(second_month_target), ',', '')  as  decimal),0)  as   second_month_target  
            ,nvl(cast(regexp_replace(trim(third_month_target ), ',', '')  as  decimal),0)  as   third_month_target   
            ,nvl(cast(regexp_replace(trim(target_ttl         ), ',', '')  as  decimal),0)  as   target_ttl         
            ,row_number() over(partition by t1.quarter,case when t1.ka_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t4.province_cn end ,t1.customer_id,t1.ka_code order by t1.qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
        from dme_ods.`s_customer_nka_sell_out_target_sop` t1
        left join ( --关联取区域和KA类型
            select 
               sfa_ka_code          
              ,sfa_ka_name 
              ,region
              ,t2.ka_type
              ,row_number() over(partition by sfa_ka_code,sfa_ka_name order by qbi_system_upload_id desc ) as rnk
            from dme_ods.s_ka_system_sfa_mapping t1
            left join 
             (
                 select 
                   distinct 
                     chain_name	 --KA NAME
                    ,store_definition  as  ka_type
                 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos
                 where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos') 
             )t2
             on t1.sfa_ka_name = t2.chain_name
            where  ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_ka_system_sfa_mapping')
        ) t3
        on t1.ka_name  = t3.sfa_ka_name
        and t3.rnk = 1
        left join
        (
            select
                 customer_code                         --用户id
                ,customer_name
                ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
                ,region_en                             --大区
                ,c.area_ch  as  region_cn
                ,province_en
                ,b.area_ch  as  province_cn
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer a 
            left join (  --取省份的中文
                select area_en,area_ch
                from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
                where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
                  and area_type = 'province'
                group by area_en,area_ch
            )b
            on a.province_en = b.area_en
             left join (  --取区域的中文
                select area_en,area_ch
                from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
                where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
                  and area_type = 'area'
                group by area_en,area_ch
            )c
            on a.region_en = c.area_en
            where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') 
            group by
                customer_code                         --用户id
                ,customer_name
                ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
                ,region_en                             --大区
                ,c.area_ch  
                ,province_en
                ,b.area_ch 
        )t4
        on t1.customer_id = t4.customer_code
        left join 
        (  
            select
                 province         
                ,ka_type           
                ,region_ka_name    
                ,rkam    
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping a 
           where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping') 
           group by province         
                ,ka_type           
                ,region_ka_name    
                ,rkam 
        )t5
         on case when t1.ka_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t4.province_cn end  = t5.province
        and t1.ka_name = t5.region_ka_name
        where t1.ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_customer_nka_sell_out_target_sop')
    )t
    where rn = 1
)t   
lateral view explode(kv) z as months,target_by_month

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
    t1.period_month           
   ,t1.sales_channel_type     
   ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others')  as  brand                  
   ,t1.product_barcode        
   ,t1.product_code           
   ,nvl(t2.product_name_en,'Others')      as    product_name_en        
   ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others')         as    product_name_cn        
   ,nvl(t4.Channel,if(upper(t1.customer_channel) = 'OTHERS','Others',t1.customer_channel))    AS    customer_channel    
   ,cast(t1.last_6month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_6month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.last_5month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_5month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.last_4month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_4month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.last_3month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_3month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.last_2month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_2month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.last_1month_sales      AS decimal(38,10))          AS    last_1month_sales      
   ,cast(t1.current_month_forecast AS decimal(38,10))          AS    current_month_forecast 
   ,cast(t1.next_1month_forecast   AS decimal(38,10))          AS    next_1month_forecast   
   ,cast(t1.next_2month_forecast   AS decimal(38,10))          AS    next_2month_forecast   
   ,cast(t1.next_3month_forecast   AS decimal(38,10))          AS    next_3month_forecast   
   ,cast(t1.next_4month_forecast   AS decimal(38,10))          AS    next_4month_forecast   
   ,cast(t1.next_5month_forecast   AS decimal(38,10))          AS    next_5month_forecast   
   ,cast(t2.product_base_price     AS decimal(38,10))          AS    product_base_price   
   ,t1.p05_umbrella_brand
   ,case when t3.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care','Laundry') then 'Consumer'
         when t3.bu_2 in ('SP','SKP') then 'Professional'
         when t1.p05_umbrella_brand is null and t1.period_month <= '202404' then 'Consumer'
         else 'Others' end                    AS  bu_1              
   ,case when t1.p05_umbrella_brand is null and t1.period_month <= '202404' then 'Beauty Care'
         else nvl(t3.bu_2,'Others')  end      AS  bu_2  
from ${dme_ods}.s_demand_demonstration_rawdata t1
left outer join(
    select
     distinct
       product_code
      ,product_name
      ,product_name_en
      ,product_base_price
      ,product_barcode   
      ,category_name     
      ,category_name_en  
      ,brand_name        
      ,brand_name_en     
      ,box_size 
      ,bu_2
      ,substr(ds,1,6) as months   
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds >='20200101'
    and (ds=TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd'))),'yyyyMMdd')
       or ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
       )
   -- where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
) t2
 on t1.product_barcode = t2.product_barcode
 and t1.period_month=t2.months
left join
(
    select 
        p05_umbrella_brand         
       ,bu_2                      
       ,dense_rank() over(partition by p05_umbrella_brand,bu_2 order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_umbrella_brand_bu_mapping
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_umbrella_brand_bu_mapping')
)t3
 on t1.p05_umbrella_brand = t3.p05_umbrella_brand
and t3.rn = 1
left join 
(
    select  distinct   
         customer_level2
        ,case when upper(trim(Channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else Channel end as Channel
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by customer_level2 order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_fca_channel_mapping 
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fca_channel_mapping')
)t4
 on t1.customer_channel = t4.customer_level2
and t4.rn = 1
where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_demand_demonstration_rawdata')

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dme_read_log_info PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.additionalEventData'),'$.WorkspaceName')) AS workspace_name
        ,GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.additionalEventData'),'$.TargetName') AS traget_name
        ,GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.userIdentity'),'$.userName') AS user_name
        ,DATEADD(
                TO_DATE(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.eventTime'),'[A-Z]',' ')),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss')
        ,8,'hh') AS event_time
FROM    (
            SELECT  TRANS_ARRAY(0,'$',val) AS val
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(val,'\},\{','\}\$\{'),'\\[|\\]','') AS val
                        FROM    dme_ods.s_dme_read_log_detail
                        WHERE   ds <> ''
                    ) a
        ) b
WHERE   GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.eventName') = "QuickbiViewLog"
AND     TRIM(GET_JSON_OBJECT(GET_JSON_OBJECT(val,'$.additionalEventData'),'$.WorkspaceName')) IN ('henkel_beautycare_pro','henkel_laundry','henkel_selfservice_analysis','henkel_beautycare_uat','henkel_selfservice_analysis_mpd')

-- 根据 经销商编码 + 单据日期 取最新全量
select * from 
(
  select
    *,
    rank() over( partition by dist_code,substr(bill_date,1,10) order by ds desc ) as rk
  from
    ${dme_ods}.s_dms_dms_data_sale_maizhi t
    where t.ds <>''
    --and NVL(t.prod_type_name,'')<>'VS'
)t

select 
  *
from
( 
  select
    t1.id                                       -- 主键标识     
    ,cast(t1.balance_month as datetime) as balance_month        -- 月结月份     
    ,t1.pnall                                   -- 组织全称     
    ,cast(t1.dist_id as decimal(38,18)) as dist_id        -- 经销商id     
    ,t1.dist_code                               -- 经销商编码   
    ,t1.dist_name                               -- 经销商名称   
    ,t1.dist_type                               -- 经销商类型   
    ,t1.client_code                             -- 客户端编码   
    ,t1.client_name                             -- 客户端名称   
    ,nvl(t2.store_code,t1.store_code) as store_code                             -- 门店编码     
    ,t4.store_name                              -- 门店名称     
    ,t4.store_definition as store_nature_name           -- 门店性质名称 
    ,t4.chain_name   as channel_name                    -- 门店渠道     
    ,t5.product_code as prod_code                       -- 产品编码     
    ,nvl(t3.prod_code,t1.prod_code) as prod_barcode             -- 产品条码     
    ,t5.product_name as prod_name                       -- 产品名称     
    ,t1.bill_code                                       -- 单据编码     
    ,substr(replace(t1.bill_date,'-',''),1,8) as bill_date    -- 单据日期     
    ,cast(t1.txn_date as datetime) as txn_date                -- 库存过期日期 
    ,t1.bill_type                             -- 单据类型     
    ,t1.stock_type                            -- 仓库类型

    ,t1.dist_prod_name                        -- 经销商产品名称
    ,t1.dist_prod_spec                        -- 经销商产品说明

    ,t1.prod_num                              -- 产品批号 
    ,t1.delivery_addr                         -- 送货地址

          else 'Others'  -- 专业线其他的都归到DT
         end
     end as store_type_level1 -- 收货方类型leve1
    -- ,case when t1.dist_type='电商' and t6.customer_code is null then 'Ecom'
    --     when t1.dist_code='2760644手工上传' then 'DT'
    --     when t5.bu_1='Professional' then
    --        case when t1.dist_name regexp '沃尔玛|山姆|新研' then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'  -- 专业线山姆数据
    --         when upper(nvl(t6.first_channel_name,t7.channel_hierarchy_1)) IN ('SELECTIVE RETAILER','NKA') then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
    --             when t8.data_type='NKA' then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'  -- OLE、BLT等一些nka门店
    --             when t8.data_type='LKA' then  'DT'  -- 商超数据
    --             else coalesce(t6.first_channel_name,t7.channel_hierarchy_1,'DT')      -- 专业线其他的都归到DT

--关联门店主数据取门店维度相关字段
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t2
on t1.store_code = t2.store_code
  and t2.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
--关联产品主数据取产品维度相关字段
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu t3
on t1.prod_code = t3.product_code and t3.ds >= '20200101'
  and to_char(t1.bill_date,'yyyymmdd') = t3.ds
left join
(
  select
    bu_2,
    customer_code,                --客户编码
    channel_hierarchy_1 as first_channel_name,  --一级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_2 as second_channel_name, --二级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_3 as third_channel_name,  --三级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_4 as fourth_channel_name, --四级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest,    --  一级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_2_lastest as second_channel_name_lastest,   --  二级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_3_lastest as third_channel_name_lastest,    --  三级渠道
    channel_hierarchy_4_lastest as fourth_channel_name_lastest,   --  四级渠道
    substr(ds,1,6) as months
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01'
) t4
on t1.dist_code = t4.customer_code
and nvl(t3.bu_2,'Beauty Care') = t4.bu_2
and to_char(t1.bill_date,'yyyymm') = t4.months
left join ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info t5
on t1.dist_code = t5.customer_code
where (t1.data_source = '手工'
 or (t1.dist_code='1787667' and to_char(t1.bill_date,'yyyymmdd') < '202401') -- 鲲驰BC数据从202401开始取迈志系统
 or (t1.data_source='DMS' AND to_char(t1.bill_date,'yyyymmdd') < '20231101') -- DMS系统除鲲驰外其他经销商只取20231101之前的数据
)
and case when t3.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') and t1.data_source = 'DMS' then nvl(UPPER(t1.store_code),'')<>'GYS' else 1=1 end

             END
       else nvl(t4.first_channel_name,'Others') end as first_channel_name_new_lastest --first_channel_name_new_lastest保持和first_channel_name_lastest一致的逻辑

   ,case when t1.dist_type='电商' and t4.customer_code is null then 'Ecom'
        when t1.data_source='手工' and t1.dist_type='NKA' and t1.bu_2='Laundry' then 'NKA' 
        when t1.dist_code like 'Small DT%' then 'DT' 
        when t1.bu_1='Professional' then
           case when upper(t4.first_channel_name_lastest) IN ('SELECTIVE RETAILER','NKA') then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'  -- OLE、BLT等一些nka门店
                when upper(t4.first_channel_name_lastest)='ECOM' then 'Ecom'  -- 专业线ECOM渠道数据
        when t1.dist_type='电商' and t4.customer_code is null then 'Ecom'  -- 专业线ECOM渠道数据
                when upper(t4.first_channel_name_lastest)='DT' then 'DT'  -- 专业线沙龙数据

             END
       else nvl(t4.first_channel_name_lastest,'Others') end as first_channel_name_lastest --所有的渠道标签取客户表属性
  ,case 
    when t1.dist_code ='Small DT_Centre' then 'Central' 
    when t1.dist_code ='Small DT_East' then 'East' 
    when t1.dist_code ='Small DT_North' then 'North' 
    when t1.dist_code ='Small DT_South' then 'South' 
    when t1.dist_code ='Small DT_West' then 'West' 
  else t4.second_channel_name_lastest end as second_channel_name_lastest
  ,case 
    when t1.dist_code like 'Small DT%' then 'Others'  
    else t4.third_channel_name_lastest 
  end as third_channel_name_lastest
  ,case 
    when t1.dist_code like 'Small DT%' then t1.dist_name
    else t4.fourth_channel_name_lastest 
  end as fourth_channel_name_lastest
  ,t2.store_category                              --汉高门店分类
  ,t2.store_category_lv1                              --汉高门店一级分类
  ,t2.store_category_lv2  
  ,nvl(t4.channel_customer_Permission,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,nvl(t4.region_customer_Permission,'Others_Others') as region_customer_Permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,t1.ds 
  from 
  (
    -- 获取DMS系统sellout数据
    select
      a.dist_store_name     -- 经销商门店名称
      ,a.dist_type          -- 经销商类型
      ,a.expire_date        -- 有效期
      ,cast(a.id as string) as id     --主键标识
      ,to_char(a.order_payment_time,'yyyymmdd') as order_payment_time -- 订单付款时间
      ,a.pk_id              -- 主键id无实际意义
      ,to_char(a.pm_updated,'yyyymmdd')         as pm_updated         -- 产品匹配更新日期
      ,a.pnall              -- 组织全称
      ,a.prod_code          -- 产品编码
      ,a.prod_num           -- 产品批号
      ,a.prod_type_name     -- 产品类型
      ,a.dist_store_code    -- 经销商门店编码
      ,a.rs                 -- 销售/退货
      ,a.stock_type         -- 仓库类型
      ,a.store_code         -- 门店编码
      ,a.tax_ind            -- 是否含税
      ,a.tax_rate           -- 税率
      ,to_char(a.transfer_time,'yyyymmdd') as transfer_time      -- 结存日期
      ,a.txn_date          -- 库存过期日期
      ,a.type_name          -- 产品品类
      ,to_char(a.update_time,'yyyymmdd')   as update_time        -- 更新日期
      ,a.delivery_addr      -- 送货地址
      ,a.base_qty           -- 基本单位数量
      ,a.base_unit          -- 基本单位
      ,a.bill_code          -- 单据编码
      ,to_char(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd')     as bill_date          -- 单据日期
      ,a.bill_type          -- 单据类型
      ,a.brand_name         -- 产品品牌
      ,a.client_code        -- 客户端编码
      ,a.client_name        -- 客户端名称
      ,a.count_qty          -- 统计单位数量
      ,a.count_unit         -- 统计单位
      ,a.created_at         -- 记录入库时间
      ,a.balance_month      -- 月结月份
      ,case when a.dist_code='1967491' then '2377625' -- 把零售广大卖的专业线数据，换到专业线广大经销商id上
        else a.dist_code
      end as dist_code          -- 经销商编码
      ,a.dist_id            -- 经销商id
      ,a.dist_name          -- 经销商名称
      ,case when a.dist_code='2032842' and a.stock_type regexp '赠仓库' then null  -- 沈阳禹石贸易有限公司，赠仓库数据不计算
          when b.bu_2 in('SKP','SP') and a.dist_prod_price in (0,1) then null -- 专业线数据，当经销商产品价格为0或者1时 经销商金额字段放0
       else a.dist_prod_amt end as dist_prod_amt     -- 经销商产品金额
      ,a.dist_prod_barcode  -- 经销商产品条码
      ,a.dist_prod_code     -- 经销商产品编码
      ,a.dist_prod_name     -- 经销商产品名称
      ,a.dist_prod_price    -- 经销商产品价格

      ,a.dist_prod_spec     -- 经销商产品说明
      ,a.dist_prod_unit     -- 经销商产品单位

      ,nvl(b.bu_1,'Others') as bu_1  -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
      ,b.bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
      ,to_char(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd') as ds
    from 
    (
      select * from ${dme_ods}.s_dms_dms_data_sale
      where ds <>''
      and to_char(bill_date,'yyyymmdd') >='20200101'  --根据单据日期抽20年之后的数据
      and 
      (
        
        coalesce(dist_code,'') NOT IN ('principleZY','Small DT_Ecom-lr')  --需剔除【汉高化妆品专业线(供DMS数据校验使用)】、skp的丽人数据
        and nvl(dist_code,'') not in ('2849715','2849714','2849713','2849712') -- 丝芙兰手工数据，需剔除
        and nvl(upper(store_code),'')<>'QITA_JH'
      ) 
      and nvl(UPPER(prod_code),'') not regexp 'QITA'
      and nvl(UPPER(store_code),'') not regexp 'QITA'
    ) a
    left join
    (
      select * from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
      where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
      --and coalesce(source_type,'')<>'professional'        -- 剔除零售主数据表里的专业线产品
    )  b
    on a.prod_code=b.product_code
    left join
    (
      select * from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu   
      where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    ) t2
    on a.store_code = t2.store_code
    inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor c

      end =c.dist_code
    and c.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor')

    where  nvl(upper(b.bu_2),'') <> 'LAUNDRY'            -- Laundry 数据走手工

    and case when nvl(upper(b.bu_2),'') in ('SKP','SP')then nvl(UPPER(a.store_code),'')<>'GYS' else 1=1 end
    -- 合并ecom渠道sellout手工数据
    union all 
    select
      NULL   as  dist_store_name                            -- 经销商门店名称       
      ,'电商'  as dist_type                                 -- 经销商类型
      ,NULL    as expire_date                               -- 有效期
      ,md5(concat('2801680','电商',a.prod_code,a.store_name,a.monthly)) as  id  -- 主键标识
      ,NULL    as order_payment_time                        -- 订单付款时间
      ,NULL    as pk_id                                     -- 主键id,无实际意义
      ,NULL    as pm_updated                                -- 产品匹配更新日期
      ,NULL    as pnall                                     -- 组织全称

      ,NULL    as  prod_num                                 -- 产品批号
      ,NULL    as  prod_type_name                           -- 产品类型
      ,NULL    as  dist_store_code                          -- 经销商门店编码
      ,NULL    as  rs                                       -- 销售/退货
      ,NULL    as  stock_type                               -- 仓库类型
      ,NULL    as  store_code                               -- 门店编码
      ,NULL    as  tax_ind                                  -- 是否含税
      ,NULL    as  tax_rate                                 -- 税率
      ,substr(replace(a.create_time,'-',''),1,8) as  transfer_time            -- 结存日期
      ,NULL    as  txn_date                                 -- 库存过期日期
      ,NULL    as  type_name                                -- 产品品类
      ,NULL    as  update_time                              -- 更新日期
      ,NULL    as  delivery_addr                            -- 送货地址
      ,a.base_qty                                 -- 基本单位数量
      ,NULL  as  base_unit                                  -- 基本单位
      ,NULL  as  bill_code                                  -- 单据编码
      ,to_char(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd') as bill_date                 -- 单据日期
      ,NULL       as bill_type                              -- 单据类型
      ,NULL       as brand_name                             -- 产品品牌
      ,NULL       as client_code                            -- 客户端编码
      ,NULL       as client_name                            -- 客户端名称

      ,NULL       as count_unit                             -- 统计单位

      ,NULL       as balance_month                          -- 月结月份

      ,NULL       as dist_id                                -- 经销商id
      ,a.dist_name                                    -- 经销商名称
      ,NULL                          as dist_prod_amt                 -- 经销商产品金额
      ,NULL                          as dist_prod_barcode             -- 经销商产品条码
      ,a.dist_prod_code              as dist_prod_code                -- 经销商产品编码
      ,cast(a.prod_name AS string  ) as dist_prod_name                -- 经销商产品名称
      ,NULL     as  dist_prod_price                           -- 经销商产品价格
      ,NULL     as  dist_prod_quantity                        -- 经销商产品数量
      ,NULL     as  dist_prod_spec                            -- 经销商产品说明
      ,NULL     as  dist_prod_unit                            -- 经销商产品单位
      ,NULL     as  remark                                    -- 说明
      ,'手工'  as  data_source
      ,a.delivery_amount_untax  -- 出库金额（未税）
      ,a.bu_1  -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
      ,a.bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
      ,a.day_id as ds
    from 
    (
      -- laundry 丽人、广大手工数据，只有月度数据，录入当月最后一天  
      select
        t2.day_id  as day_id

        ,case

          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '鲲驰' then '1787667'

          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp 'SEIF' then '2681303'

          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp 'HTDK' then '2776606'  
          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp 'EP' then '2444721'

        ,case when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '丽人|LILY' then '上海丽人丽妆化妆品有限公司'
            when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '鲲驰' then '上海鲲驰贸易发展有限公司'

            when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '沃亿' or (trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '广大' and t1.monthly>='202308') then '北京沃亿商业管理有限公司'

      ,NULL    as pk_id                                     -- 主键id,无实际意义
      ,NULL    as pm_updated                                -- 产品匹配更新日期
      ,NULL    as pnall                                     -- 组织全称
      ,a.prod_code                                        -- 产品编码
      ,NULL    as  prod_num                                 -- 产品批号
      ,NULL    as  prod_type_name                           -- 产品类型
      ,NULL    as  dist_store_code                          -- 经销商门店编码
      ,NULL    as  rs                                       -- 销售/退货
      ,NULL    as  stock_type                               -- 仓库类型
      ,NULL    as  store_code                               -- 门店编码
      ,NULL    as  tax_ind                                  -- 是否含税
      ,NULL    as  tax_rate                                 -- 税率
      ,substr(replace(a.create_time,'-',''),1,8) as  transfer_time            -- 结存日期
      ,NULL    as  txn_date                                 -- 库存过期日期
      ,NULL    as  type_name                                -- 产品品类
      ,NULL    as  update_time                              -- 更新日期
      ,NULL    as  delivery_addr                            -- 送货地址
      ,a.base_qty                                 -- 基本单位数量
      ,NULL               as  base_unit                     -- 基本单位
      ,NULL               as  bill_code                     -- 单据编码
      ,to_char(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd')  as bill_date                -- 单据日期
      ,NULL                   as bill_type                  -- 单据类型
      ,NULL                   as brand_name                 -- 产品品牌
      ,NULL                   as client_code                -- 客户端编码
      ,NULL                   as client_name                -- 客户端名称

      ,NULL                   as count_unit                 -- 统计单位

      ,NULL                   as balance_month              -- 月结月份
      ,a.dist_code                                    -- 经销商编码
      ,NULL                   as dist_id                    -- 经销商id
      ,a.dist_name                                    -- 经销商名称
      ,NULL                           as dist_prod_amt                  -- 经销商产品金额
      ,NULL                           as dist_prod_barcode              -- 经销商产品条码
      ,a.dist_prod_code               as dist_prod_code                 -- 经销商产品编码
      ,cast(a.prod_name AS string  )  as dist_prod_name                 -- 经销商产品名称
      ,NULL                 as  dist_prod_price               -- 经销商产品价格
      ,NULL                 as  dist_prod_quantity            -- 经销商产品数量
      ,NULL                 as  dist_prod_spec                -- 经销商产品说明
      ,NULL                 as  dist_prod_unit                -- 经销商产品单位
      ,NULL                 as  remark                        -- 说明
      ,'手工'               as  data_source
      ,a.delivery_amount_untax                          -- 出库金额（未税）
      ,a.bu_1                                   -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
      ,a.bu_2                                   -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
      ,a.day_id as ds
    from
    (

      select
        t2.day_id  as day_id
        ,t1.monthly
        ,nvl(t1.prod_idh_nes,t1.prod_idh_old) as prod_code                --产品编码
        ,t1.prod_name                                 -- 商品名称  
        ,t1.dist_prod_code                              -- 经销商产品编码
        ,t1.store_name                                  -- 店铺名称
        ,cast(t1.delivery_qty          AS decimal(38,18))  as base_qty              --基本单位数量
        ,cast(t1.delivery_amount_untax AS decimal(38,18))  as delivery_amount_untax --出库金额（未税）
        ,cast(concat(t2.day_short_desc,' 00:00:00') AS datetime )  as bill_date     --单据日期
        ,case 
          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '沃尔玛|WAL' then '708859'
          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '山姆|SAM' then '2509858' 
          else t1.store_name
        end as dist_code                                --经销商编码
        ,case

          when trim(upper(t1.store_name)) regexp '山姆|SAM' then '山姆士'

        ,'Consumer' as bu_1                             -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
        ,'Laundry'  as bu_2                             -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
        ,t1.create_time                               -- 创建日期
        ,t2.day_id as ds
      from ${dme_ods}.s_nka_sales_info_laundry t1
      left join 
      (
        select  
          month_id
          ,max(day_short_desc)  as   day_short_desc
          ,max(day_id)  as   day_id
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
        group by month_id
      )t2
      on t1.monthly = t2.month_id
      where t1.ds= max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_sales_info_laundry')
      and t1.monthly is not null
    )a
  ) t1
  --关联门店主数据取门店维度相关字段
  left join
  (
    select * from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu   
    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
  ) t2
  on t1.store_code=t2.store_code
  --关联产品主数据取产品维度相关字段
  left join
  (
    select
      a.product_code
      ,a.product_barcode  --产品条码
      ,a.product_name     --产品名称 
      ,a.product_base_price   -- 产品基价
      ,a.bu_2  
      ,a.ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu a
    where a.ds >='20200101'
  ) t3
  on t1.prod_code=t3.product_code
  and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
  and t1.ds=t3.ds
  left join
  (
    select distinct
      customer_code,  --客户编码  
      customer_name,  --客户名称
      channel_hierarchy_1 as first_channel_name,    --一级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_2 as second_channel_name,   --二级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_3 as third_channel_name,    --三级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_4 as fourth_channel_name,   --四级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest,    --  一级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_2_lastest as second_channel_name_lastest,   --  二级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_3_lastest as third_channel_name_lastest,    --  三级渠道
      channel_hierarchy_4_lastest as fourth_channel_name_lastest,   --  四级渠道
      substr(ds,1,6) as months,
      bu_2,
      bu_3  -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
      ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01'
  ) t4
  on t1.dist_code=t4.customer_code
  and substr(t1.ds,1,6) = t4.months
  and t1.bu_2=t4.bu_2
) a
where
(
   (a.data_source='DMS' and a.bu_2 in ('SP','SKP') AND nvl(a.dist_code,'')<>'1616258') -- 剔除丽人数据，丽人数据来自手工和maizhi
  --  or (a.data_source='DMS' and a.bu_2='SKP' AND a.dist_code in ('2530190','2377625','2256849')) -- 炜能、广大、鲲驰skp数据取dms
  --  or (a.data_source='DMS' and a.bu_2='SKP' AND upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','OTHERS','B2B&LKA')) -- DT的skp数据取dms
      or a.data_source<>'DMS' -- 非DMS系统的手工数据
) 
and if(a.dist_code in ('2949744','2948026') ,a.data_source = 'DMS' and a.bill_date <'20240101',1=1) -- 上海烁迪、创智美业24年之前专业线数据从winc出
and case when a.dist_code='2925773' and a.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then a.ds<'20200101'  -- 沃亿专业线数据取maizhi系统
         when a.bu_2 ='Laundry' and a.dist_code='2925773' then a.bill_date<'20230801'  -- 沃亿Laundry:202308开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
         when a.bu_2 ='Laundry' and a.dist_code='1787667' then a.bill_date<'20230501'  -- 鲲驰Laundry:202305开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
         when a.dist_code='2849669' and a.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then a.bill_date<'20250101' -- 利芮专业线从25年开始切换maizhi系统
     when a.dist_code='2256849' and a.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then a.bill_date<'20231101' -- 鲲驰专业线从202311开始取maizhi系统
     when a.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then a.bill_date<'20250101'  -- 专业线数据20250101开始走maizhi接口
     else 1=1 
    end
and lower(nvl(a.dist_code,'')) not like '%small dt%'  
and (nvl(a.dist_prod_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(a.base_qty,0)<>0 )  -- 剔除无效数据
union all
-- 合并beauty care 数据，迈志专业线数据
select
  t1.id                                   -- 主键标识
  ,cast(t1.balance_month as string) balance_month       -- 月结月份
  ,t1.pnall                               -- 组织全称
  ,t1.dist_id                             -- 经销商id
  ,t1.dist_code                           -- 经销商编码
  ,nvl(t4.customer_name,t1.dist_name) as dist_name  -- 经销商名称  
  ,t1.dist_type                       -- 经销商类型
  ,t1.client_code                         -- 客户端编码
  ,t1.client_name                         -- 客户端名称

  ,t1.store_name                          -- 门店名称
  ,t1.store_nature_name                   -- 门店性质名称
  ,t1.channel_name                        -- 门店渠道名称
  ,t1.prod_code                           -- 产品编码
  ,t1.prod_barcode                        -- 产品条码
  ,t1.prod_name                           -- 产品名称

  ,t1.bill_date                           -- 单据日期

  ,case

   end as prod_type_name                  --产品类型

  ,t1.dist_prod_unit                      -- 经销商产品单位

  ,t1.prod_num                            -- 产品批号

            when t2.bu_2 ='Laundry' and t1.dist_code='2925773' then t1.ds>='20230801'  -- 沃亿Laundry:202308开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
            when t2.bu_2 ='Laundry' and t1.dist_code='1787667' then t1.ds>='20230501'  -- 鲲驰Laundry:202305开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
            when t1.dist_code in ('1967491','2925773') and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='Beauty Care' then t1.ds>='20231101'  -- 广大\沃亿 BC数据----零售Ecom渠道 只有广大、鲲驰、沃亿从系统获取，其他tp手工数据
            when t1.dist_code='1787667' and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='Beauty Care' then substr(t1.ds,1,6)>='202401'   -- 鲲驰BC数据从202401开始取迈志系统
            when upper(t1.prod_type_name)='L'  and t1.dist_code='1967491' then t1.ds>='20230801' -- 广大laundry数据从23.8月及之后取数

            when upper(nvl(t1.remark,''))='WINC' then t1.ds>='20250101'  -- 迈志过来的Winc数据从25年开始取
            else 1=1
          end    
      END 
      )
  )
and lower(nvl(t1.dist_code,'')) not like '%small dt%'  
and (nvl(t1.dist_prod_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_qty,0)<>0 )  -- 剔除无效数据

from (
    select
       t1.id as id,--主键标识
       t1.pnall as pnall,--组织全称

       t1.prod_num as prod_num,--产品批号
       t1.remark as remark,--说明
       t3.brand_name as prod_brand_name,--产品品牌
       t1.prod_category as prod_category,--产品品类

-- 根据DealerCode+单据日期取最新全量
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_02

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_02 as
select
  a.*
from ${dme_ods}.s_dms_dms_data_stock_maizhi a
inner join (
  select
     ds,dist_code,stock_date
     ,row_number()over(partition by dist_code,stock_date order by ds desc) as rn
  from(
    select t.ds,t.dist_code,t.stock_date
    from ${dme_ods}.s_dms_dms_data_stock_maizhi t
    where t.ds<>''
    --and NVL(t.prod_type_name,'')<>'VS'
    group by t.ds,t.dist_code,t.stock_date
  )
) b
 on a.dist_code=b.dist_code
 and a.stock_date=b.stock_date
 and a.ds=b.ds
 and b.rn=1
where a.ds<>''
--and NVL(a.prod_type_name,'')<>'VS'
and if(upper(nvl(a.remark,''))='WINC',substr(a.stock_date,1,4)>='2025',1=1) -- winc接口数据从20250101开始切换迈志

    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_02

select
     t1.id     --主键标识
    ,t1.pnall  --组织全称
    ,t1.dist_name        --经销商名称
    ,t1.dist_code        --经销商编码
    ,t1.client_code      --客户端编码
    ,to_char(cast(t1.stock_date as datetime),'yyyymmdd') as stock_date      --库存日期
    ,t1.stock_type       --仓库类型
    ,t1.dist_prod_code--经销商产品编码
    ,t1.dist_prod_barcode--经销商产品条码
    ,t1.dist_prod_name--经销商产品名称
    ,t1.dist_prod_spec--经销商产品说明
    ,t1.dist_prod_unit--经销商产品单位
    ,t3.product_code as prod_code--产品编码
    ,t3.product_name as prod_name--产品名称
    ,cast(t1.dist_prod_quantity as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_quantity--经销商产品数量
    ,cast(t1.dist_prod_price as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_price--经销商产品价格
    ,cast(t1.dist_prod_amount as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_amount--经销商产品金额
    ,t1.update_time as update_time--更新日期
    ,t1.count_unit--统计单位
    ,t1.count_qty--统计单位数量
    ,t1.delete_time as delete_time--删除日期
    ,t1.state--状态
    ,t1.gross_sales--统计单位金额
    ,t1.prod_num--产品批号
    ,t1.remark--说明
    ,t3.brand_name as prod_brand_name--产品品牌
    ,t3.category_name as prod_category--产品品类
    ,nvl(t2.prod_code,t1.prod_code) as prod_barcode--产品条码
    ,t1.prod_type_name--产品类型
    ,t1.create_time--创建日期
    ,t1.dist_calculate_amount--经销商计算金额
    ,t1.prod_price--产品价格
    ,t1.prod_manufacturing_date--产品过期日期
    ,t1.base_unit--基本单位
    ,t1.base_qty--基本单位数量
    ,t1.delete_time as expire_date--有效期
    ,t1.dist_type--经销商类型
    ,t1.prod_line--产品线
    ,to_char(cast(t1.transfer_time as datetime),'yyyymmdd') as transfer_time --结存日期
    ,t3.product_base_price as base_price --产品基础价格
    ,'MaiZhi' as data_source   -- 数据来源
    ,nvl(b.first_channel_name,e.channel_hierarchy_1) as first_channel_name      -- 一级渠道名称
    ,nvl(b.second_channel_name,e.region_en)  as second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
    ,case when e.customer_code is not null then 'Others'
       else b.third_channel_name end as third_channel_name    -- 三级渠道名称 
    ,case when e.customer_code is not null then t1.dist_name 
       else b.fourth_channel_name end as fourth_channel_name  -- 四级渠道名称
    ,nvl(b.first_channel_name_lastest,e.channel_hierarchy_1) as first_channel_name_lastest      -- 一级渠道名称
    ,nvl(b.second_channel_name_lastest,e.region_en)  as second_channel_name_lastest -- 二级渠道名称
    ,case when e.customer_code is not null then 'Others'
       else b.third_channel_name_lastest end as third_channel_name_lastest    -- 三级渠道名称 
    ,case when e.customer_code is not null then t1.dist_name 
       else b.fourth_channel_name_lastest end as fourth_channel_name_lastest  -- 四级渠道名称 
    ,t1.warehouseCode as dist_warehouse_code   -- 经销商产仓库编码  
    ,t1.warehouseName as dist_warehouse_name   -- 经销商产仓库名称
    ,nvl(t4.warehouseSCode,t1.warehouseSCode) as warehouse_code -- 汉高标准仓库编码
    ,nvl(t4.warehouseSName,t1.warehouseSName) as warehouse_name -- 汉高标准仓库名称
    ,t1.warehouseaddress -- 库存地点
    ,to_char(cast(t1.stock_date as datetime),'yyyymmdd') as ds
from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_02  t1
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_03 t2 -- 产品维度
 on t1.dist_code=t2.dist_code
 and nvl(t1.dist_prod_code,'')=nvl(t2.dist_prod_code,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_prod_name,'')=nvl(t2.dist_prod_name,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_prod_barcode,'')=nvl(t2.dist_prod_barcode,'')
 left join(
   select *
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
   where ds>='20200101'
 --  and bu_2='Beauty Care'
  )  t3
  on nvl(t2.prod_code,t1.prod_code)=t3.product_barcode
  and to_char(cast(t1.stock_date as datetime),'yyyymmdd')=t3.ds
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu_temp_03_store t4 -- 仓库维度
  on t1.dist_code=t4.dist_code
  and nvl(t1.warehouseCode,'')=nvl(t4.warehouseCode,'')
  and nvl(t1.warehouseName,'')=nvl(t4.warehouseName,'')
 left join(
 select
	   bu_2,
       customer_code,  							   --客户编码
       channel_hierarchy_1 as first_channel_name,  --一级渠道
       channel_hierarchy_2 as second_channel_name, --二级渠道
       channel_hierarchy_3 as third_channel_name,  --三级渠道
       channel_hierarchy_4 as fourth_channel_name, --四级渠道
	   channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest, 		--	一级渠道
	   channel_hierarchy_2_lastest as second_channel_name_lastest,		--	二级渠道
	   channel_hierarchy_3_lastest as third_channel_name_lastest, 		--	三级渠道
	   channel_hierarchy_4_lastest as fourth_channel_name_lastest,		--	四级渠道
       substr(ds,1,6) as month_
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
     where ds like '%01'
  ) b
    on t1.dist_code=b.customer_code
	  and nvl(t3.bu_2,'Beauty Care') = b.bu_2
    and to_char(cast(t1.stock_date as datetime),'yyyymm') = b.month_
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info e  -- 小经销商
    on t1.dist_code=e.customer_code
where  UPPER(coalesce(t2.prod_code,t1.prod_code,'')) not regexp 'QITA'
and UPPER(coalesce(t4.warehouseSCode,t1.warehouseSCode,'')) not regexp 'QITA'

    a.dist_code as dist_code,--经销商编码

    case when a.dist_name='Ecom小经销商-鲲驰' then to_char(date_add(a.stock_date,-1),'yyyymmdd')
      else to_char(a.stock_date,'yyyymmdd')

    a.dist_prod_code as dist_prod_code,--经销商产品编码

    a.dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,--经销商产品名称
    a.dist_prod_spec as dist_prod_spec,--经销商产品说明
    a.dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit,--经销商产品单位
    a.prod_code as prod_code,--产品编码
    b.product_name as prod_name,--产品名称
    cast(a.dist_prod_quantity as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_quantity,--经销商产品数量
    cast(a.dist_prod_price as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_price,--经销商产品价格
    cast(a.dist_prod_amount as decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_amount,--经销商产品金额
    a.update_time as update_time,--更新日期
    a.count_unit as count_unit,--统计单位
    a.count_qty as count_qty,--统计单位数量
    a.delete_time as delete_time,--删除日期
    a.state as state,--状态
    a.gross_sales as gross_sales,--统计单位金额
    a.prod_num as prod_num,--产品批号
    a.remark as remark,--说明
    a.prod_brand_name as prod_brand_name,--产品品牌
    a.prod_category as prod_category,--产品品类
    a.prod_barcode as prod_barcode,--产品条码
    case when a.bu_1 ='Professional' then '专业线'
      when a.bu_1 ='Consumer' then '零售线'
     end           as prod_type_name,   --产品类型
    a.create_time as create_time,--创建日期
    a.dist_calculate_amount as dist_calculate_amount,--经销商计算金额
    a.prod_price as prod_price,--产品价格
    a.prod_manufacturing_date as prod_manufacturing_date,--产品过期日期
    a.base_unit as base_unit,--基本单位
    a.base_qty as base_qty,--基本单位数量
    a.expire_date as expire_date,--有效期
    a.dist_type as dist_type,--经销商类型
    a.prod_line as prod_line,--产品线

    cast(b.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price, --产品基础价格
    a.data_source,
    a.bu_1,
    a.bu_2,
    case when a.dist_name='Ecom小经销商-鲲驰' then to_char(date_add(a.stock_date,-1),'yyyymmdd')

          else t1.dist_code
         end as dist_code   -- 经销商编码

        ,t1.delete_time     as delete_time    --删除日期
        ,t1.state           as state          --状态
        ,t1.gross_sales     as gross_sales    --统计单位金额
        ,t1.prod_num        as prod_num       --产品批号
        ,t1.remark          as remark         --说明

        ,t1.base_unit   as base_unit     --基本单位

        ,t1.expire_date as expire_date   --有效期
        ,t1.dist_type   as dist_type     --经销商类型
        ,t1.prod_line   as prod_line     --产品线
        ,cast(t1.transfer_time as datetime) as transfer_time--结存日期
        ,cast('DMS' AS string ) as data_source

        ,b.bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
     from 
	(
		select * from ${dme_ods}.s_dms_dms_data_stock 
		where ds>='20210101'  
		and substring(stock_date,1,4)>='2021' --2020年历史库存不再进行全量计算，只跑2021年之后的全量
		and dist_code != 'principleZY'
    and nvl(UPPER(prod_code),'') not regexp 'QITA'
	)t1
	left join(
       select *
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
       where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
       -- and coalesce(source_type,'')<>'professional'  -- 剔除零售主数据表里的专业线产品
      )  b
     on t1.prod_code=b.product_code
 	 inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor c
       on case when t1.dist_code='1967491' then '2377625' -- 把零售广的专业线数据，换到专业线广大经销商id上
          else t1.dist_code end = c.dist_code

     where nvl(upper(b.bu_2),'')<>'LAUNDRY'  -- Laundry 数据走手工

    select

       ,t1.dist_prod_name    as dist_prod_name    -- 经销商产品名称
       ,cast(NULL AS string) as dist_prod_spec    -- 经销商产品说明
       ,cast(NULL AS string) as dist_prod_unit    -- 经销商产品单位

       ,cast(NULL AS  decimal(28,6)) as dist_prod_price    -- 经销商产品价格

       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as update_time        -- 更新日期
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as count_unit         -- 统计单位

       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as remark             -- 说明
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as prod_brand_name    -- 产品品牌
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as prod_category      -- 产品品类
       ,b.product_barcode            as prod_barcode       -- 产品条码

       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as prod_price         -- 产品价格
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as prod_manufacturing_date -- 产品过期日期
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as base_unit      -- 基本单位
       ,cast(t1.base_qty as decimal(28,6)) as base_qty    -- 基本单位数量
       ,cast(NULL AS  string       ) as expire_date    -- 有效期
       ,t1.dist_type                 as dist_type      -- 经销商类型
       ,cast(NULL AS  string  )      as prod_line      -- 产品线

		select
			cast(concat(t2.day_short_desc,' 00:00:00') as datetime) as stock_date -- 库存日期

		,case when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '丽人|Lily' then '1616258'
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '鲲驰' then '1787667' 
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '广大' or (trim(t1.store_name) regexp '沃亿' and t1.month<='202307') then '1967491' 
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '沃亿' or (trim(t1.store_name) regexp '广大' and t1.month>='202308') then '2925773' 
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp 'SEIF' then '2681303' 
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '恩浠' then '2895928'  
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp 'HTDK' then '2776606'  
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp 'EP' then '2444721' 
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp 'SHOPAL' then '2538240' 
			end as dist_code   --经销商编码
		,case when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '丽人|Lily' then '上海丽人丽妆化妆品有限公司'
				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '鲲驰' then '上海鲲驰贸易发展有限公司'

				when trim(t1.store_name) regexp '沃亿' or (trim(t1.store_name) regexp '广大' and t1.month>='202308') then '北京沃亿商业管理有限公司'

	or (case when t.data_source regexp '手工' then if(t.dist_code='1616258' and (nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'')='SP' or (nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'')='SKP' and t.ds >='20230201')),1<>1,1=1) end) -- 手工数据取bc和专业性数据,丽人：SP取迈志，其他数据走手工
  or(
   case when t.data_source='MaiZhi' then 
		 case when t2.bu_2='VS' then 1=1 -- 沙宣全部放出来
           when t.dist_code in ('2949744','2948026') then  t.ds>='20240101' -- 上海烁迪、创智美业24年开始专业线数据从迈志出
           when t.dist_code='2925773' and t2.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then t.ds>='20200101' -- 沃亿专业线数据取maizhi系统 
           when t.dist_code='2849669' and nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') in ('SKP','SP') then t.ds>='20250101' -- 利芮专业线从25年开始切换maizhi系统
            when t.dist_code='1616258' and nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') in('SP') then 1=1 -- 丽人SP取迈志，其他数据走手工
            when t.dist_code='1616258' and nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') in('SKP') then t.ds>='20230201'
            when t.dist_code='1616258' and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care') in('Beauty Care','Laundry') then 1<>1 -- 丽人BC、Laundry 走手工
            --when t.dist_code='1616258' and (nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') not in('SP') or (nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') in('SKP') and t.ds<='20230201') ) then 1=0
           when t.dist_code='2256849' and nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') in ('SKP','SP') then t.ds>='20231101'  -- 鲲驰专业线从202311开始切换到maizhi系统
           when t.dist_code='2801680' and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='Beauty Care' then t.ds>='20230601' -- 哆米BC 202306开始由手工切到maizhi
           when t2.bu_2 ='Laundry' and t.dist_code='2925773' then t.ds>='20240701'  -- 沃亿Laundry:202407开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
           when t2.bu_2 ='Laundry' and t.dist_code='1787667' then t.ds>='20250401'  -- 鲲驰Laundry:202504开始由手工切换到maizhi系统
           when t.dist_code in ('1967491','2925773') and nvl(UPPER(t2.bu_2),'') not in ('SKP','SP','LAUNDRY') then  t.ds>='20231101' -- 广大\沃亿 BC数据
           when t.dist_code ='1787667' and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care') ='Beauty Care' then substr(t.ds,1,6)>='202401'   -- 鲲驰BC数据从202401开始取迈志系统
           when upper(t.prod_type_name)='L'  and t.dist_code='1967491' then t.ds>='20230801' -- 广大laundry数据从23.8月及之后取数
           when upper(t.prod_type_name)='L' then t.ds>='20230101' -- 迈志mpd laundry除广大外其他数据取23.01.01日及之后的数据，广大从23.8月及之后取数
           when upper(t.prod_type_name) in('SKP','SP') then t.ds <>'' --取迈志MPD的专业线数据
           when nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care') ='Beauty Care' then t.ds>='20231101' -- 除Ecom外，其他渠道BC数据
          when upper(nvl(t.remark,''))='WINC' then t.ds>='20250101'  -- 迈志过来的Winc数据从25年开始取
          else 1=1
        end
     end  	 
	)
