    cast(a.total_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as total_price_tax, -- 商品总价/含税
    cast(a.total_price_untax as decimal(28,6)) as total_price_untax	, -- 商品总价/不含税
    a.express_company_code	, -- 快递公司代码
    a.express_company_name	, -- 快递公司名称
    a.express_num	, -- 快递单号
    a.sub_order_state	, -- 子订单状态
    a.create_time	, -- 交易创建时间
    cast(a.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as 	base_price, -- 产品基价
    cast(a.quantity*a.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as  base_sale_amt	, -- 基价销售金额
    cast(a.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax	, -- 含税零售价
    cast(a.quantity*a.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_tax_amt	, -- 零售价销售金额
    nvl(a.henkel_item_barcode,'-110') as henkel_item_barcode , -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
   nvl(a.henkel_idh_code,'-110') as henkel_idh_code , -- 汉高idh编号
    a.henkel_brand_en as henkel_brand_code	, -- 品牌代码
    a.henkel_brand	, -- 汉高品牌名称
    a.henkel_brand_en	, -- 汉高品牌英文名称
    a.henkel_category_en as henkel_category_code	, -- 汉高品类代码
    a.henkel_category	, -- 汉高品类名称
    a.henkel_category_en	, -- 汉高品类英文名称
    a.first_channel_id	, -- 一级渠道id
    a.first_channel_name	, -- 一级渠道名称
    cast(if(a.quantity=0,null,a.payment_actual/a.quantity) as decimal(28,6)) as unint_price_actual	, -- 实际商品单价
    cast(a.payment_actual as decimal(28,6)) as payment_actual	, -- 实际付款金额含税
    cast(a.untax_payment_actual as decimal(28,6)) as untax_payment_actual	, -- 实际付款金额未税
    a.shop_id	, -- 店铺id ,tp侧门店编码
    null as shop_name	, -- 店铺名称
    a.bu_1 as bu_1, --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
    a.bu_2 as bu_2, --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP)   
    nvl(f.new_henkel_region,'Others') as henkel_region_name, --汉高大区
    nvl(d.area_ch,'Others') as province_name, --标准省份名称
    nvl(e.city_name,'Others') as city_name, --城市名称
    nvl(a.Order_County_Name,'Others') as district_name	, -- 区
    a.num_iid	, -- 平台spu码
    a.tax_rate	, -- 产品税率
    cast(a.retail_price_tax/a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_untax, -- 零售价未税
    cast(a.base_price*a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_tax, -- 产品基价含税
    cast(a.quantity*a.base_price*a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as base_sale_amt_tax, -- 基价销售金额含税
    cast(a.quantity*a.retail_price_tax/a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as retail_amt_untax, -- 零售价销售金额未税
    a.sales_channel	, -- 销售渠道
    a.customer_code, -- 汉高客户编码
    nvl(b.customer_name,a.customer_name) as customer_name, -- 汉高客户名称中文
    a.ds,
    a.customer_code as ec,
    a.data_source_code,    --数据来源代码
    a.data_source_name,    --数据来源
    '常规' as data_type,
    a.henkel_store_code as store_code, -- 汉高门店编码
    a.henkel_store_category, -- 汉高门店分类
    a.henkel_store_category_lv1, -- 汉高门店一级分类
    a.henkel_store_category_lv2, -- 汉高门店二级分类

    a.third_channel_name, -- KA三级渠道名称
    a.fourth_channel_name -- KA四级渠道名称

    select 
        order_no	, -- 订单编号
        sub_order_no	, -- 子订单编号
        dist_prod_barcode as commodity_sku	, -- 商品sku
        dist_prod_name as commodity_name	, -- 商品名称
        cast(null as string) as commodity_title	, -- 商品标题
        sum(nvl(return_base_unit_qty,0)+nvl(base_unit_qty,0)) as quantity	, -- 购买数量
        dist_prod_price as unit_price	, -- 商品单价
        sum(dist_prod_price*dist_prod_qty*tax_rate) as total_price_tax	, -- 商品总价/含税
        sum(dist_prod_price*dist_prod_qty) as total_price_untax	, -- 商品总价/不含税
        cast(null as string) as express_company_code	, -- 快递公司代码
        cast(null as string) as express_company_name	, -- 快递公司名称
        cast(null as string) as express_num	, -- 快递单号
        cast(null as string) as sub_order_state	, -- 子订单状态
        cast(null as DATETIME) as create_time	, -- 交易创建时间

        henkel_prod_code as henkel_idh_code	, -- 汉高idh编号

        henkel_category_name_cn as henkel_category	, -- 汉高品类名称
        henkel_category_name_en as henkel_category_en	, -- 汉高品类英文名称
        '20' as first_channel_id	, -- 一级渠道id
        case when upper(first_channel_name)='ECOM' then 'Ecom'
            else first_channel_name end as  first_channel_name	, -- 一级渠道名称
        sum(nvl(original_amt_tax,0)+nvl(return_original_amt_tax,0)) as payment_actual	, -- 实际付款金额含税
        sum(nvl(original_amt_untax,0)+nvl(return_original_amt_untax,0)) as untax_payment_actual	, -- 实际付款金额未税
        tp_store_code as shop_id	, -- 店铺id
        bu_1	, -- bu_1
        bu_2	, -- bu_2
        order_province_name,
        order_city_name,
        Order_County_Name,
        cast(null as string) as num_iid	, -- 平台spu码
        tax_rate	, -- 产品税率
        '-' as sales_channel	, -- 销售渠道
        dealercode as  customer_code, -- 汉高客户编码
        dealername as customer_name, -- 汉高客户名称中文
        bill_date as ds,
        data_source_code, -- 数据来源代码
        data_source_name, -- 数据来源
        henkel_store_code,
        henkel_store_category,
        henkel_store_category_lv1,
        henkel_store_category_lv2,
        second_channel_name, -- KA二级渠道名称
        third_channel_name, -- KA三级渠道名称
        fourth_channel_name -- KA四级渠道名称
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid')
    and upper(first_channel_name)='ECOM' 
    group by order_no	, -- 订单编号
        sub_order_no	, -- 子订单编号
        dist_prod_barcode	, -- 商品sku
        dist_prod_name , -- 商品名称
        dist_prod_price	, -- 商品单价
        product_base_price 	, -- 产品基价
        retail_price_tax 	, -- 含税零售价
        henkel_prod_barcode 	, -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
        henkel_prod_code 	, -- 汉高idh编号
        henkel_brand_name_cn 	, -- 汉高品牌名称
        henkel_brand_name_en 	, -- 汉高品牌英文名称
        henkel_category_name_cn 	, -- 汉高品类名称
        henkel_category_name_en 	, -- 汉高品类英文名称
        case when upper(first_channel_name)='ECOM' then 'Ecom'
            else first_channel_name end 	, -- 一级渠道名称
        tp_store_code 	, -- 店铺id
        bu_1	, -- bu_1
        bu_2	, -- bu_2
        order_province_name,
        order_city_name,
        Order_County_Name,
        tax_rate	, -- 产品税率
        dealercode , -- 汉高客户编码
        dealername, -- 汉高客户名称中文
        bill_date,
        data_source_code,
        data_source_name,
        henkel_store_code,

        henkel_store_category_lv2,
        second_channel_name, -- KA二级渠道名称

select
      a.ec_code	, -- ec编码
      a.ec_name	, -- ec名称
      null	order_no	, -- 订单编号
      null as	sub_order_no	, -- 子订单编号
      a.commodity_code  as	commodity_sku	, -- 商品sku
      a.goodsname  as	commodity_name	, -- 商品名称
      d.brand_name_en  as	brand_code	, -- 品牌代码
      d.brand_name  as	brand_name	, -- 品牌名称
      null  as	commodity_title	, -- 商品标题
      a.sales_qty    as quantity	, -- 购买数量
      null  as	unit_price	, -- 商品单价
      null as total_price_tax	, -- 商品总价/含税
      null as	total_price_untax	, -- 商品总价/不含税
      null  as	express_company_code	, -- 快递公司代码
      null   as	express_company_name	, -- 快递公司名称
      null   as	express_num	, -- 快递单号
      null  as	sub_order_state	, -- 子订单状态
      null  as	create_time	, -- 交易创建时间
      cast(d.product_base_price as decimal(28,6))  as	base_price	, -- 产品基价
      cast(d.product_base_price * a.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) as base_sale_amt, -- 基价销售金额
      cast(d.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax, -- 含税零售价
      cast(d.retail_price_tax * a.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) as retail_tax_amt, -- 零售价销售金额
    bcconvert(a.product_barcode) as henkel_item_barcode, -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
    bcconvert(d.product_code) as henkel_idh_code, -- 汉高idh编号
    d.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,--汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(d.brand_name) as henkel_brand, -- 汉高品牌名称
    bcconvert(d.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_en, -- 汉高品牌英文名称
    d.category_name_en as henkel_category_code,--汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(d.category_name) as henkel_category, -- 汉高品类名称
    bcconvert(d.category_name_en) as henkel_category_en, -- 汉高品类英文名称
    '20' as first_channel_id, -- 一级渠道id
    'Ecom' as first_channel_name, -- 一级渠道名称
    if(a.sales_qty !=0,cast(a.actual_amount /a.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)),0) as unint_price_actual, -- 实际商品单价
    a.actual_amount as payment_actual, -- 实际付款金额
    cast(a.actual_amount / nvl(e.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6))  as untax_payment_actual, -- 实际付款金额未税
    a.store_code as shop_id,
    nvl(c.shop_name,a.store_name) as shop_name,
    nvl(d.bu_1,'Consumer')	bu_1	, --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
    nvl(d.bu_2,'Beauty Care')	bu_2	, --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP)
    null as henkel_region_name, -- 汉高大区名称
    null province_name, --省
    null city_name, --市
    null district_name,--区
    a.initiate_refund_quantity as initiate_refund_quantity,
    a.initiate_refund_amount as initiate_refund_amount, 
    case
      when a.pay_time is null or a.pay_time='' then '00000000'
      else a.pay_time end as ds, 
    a.ec_code as ec
from (
    select  a.store_name store_name, --店铺
            a.commodity_code commodity_code,
            a.goodsname goodsname,
            cast(a.sales_qty*nvl(b.prod_qty,1) as int) sales_qty, --商品数量(件)=组合装数量*拆分单品数量
            cast(a.actual_amount * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) actual_amount,
            a.pay_time pay_time,
            a.store_code store_code,
            a.ec_name ec_name,
            a.ec_code ec_code,
            nvl(b.product_barcode,a.commodity_code) product_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
            cast(a.initiate_refund_quantity*nvl(b.prod_qty,1) as int) initiate_refund_quantity,  -- 发起退款商品件数
            cast(a.initiate_refund_amount * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) initiate_refund_amount   -- 发起退款金额

    )  a
    left join(
             select  
                shop_id, 
                plat_prod_code as commodity_code, -- 平台产品编码
                henkel_prod_barcode as product_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
                base_price_rate, -- 基价占比

              from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
              where   ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
              and ec='e001'
    ) b 
    on a.commodity_code =b.commodity_code
    and a.store_code = b.shop_id

left join (
    -- select store_code as shop_id, -- 店铺编码
    --     stander_store_name as shop_name -- 店铺名称
    -- from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos
    -- where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')
    select  store_code,

) c on a.store_code = c.ec_store_code_tp
left join (

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_woyi_temp_00

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_woyi_temp_00 as        
select  
    a.store_name as store_name, --店铺
    a.product_name as brand_name, --商品
    a.order_num as order_num, --订单号
    a.order_state as order_status, --订单状态
    cast(sum(a.quantity*nvl(b.prod_qty,1)) as int) as  sales_qty, --商品数量(件)
    to_char(to_date(substr(a.pay_confirm_time,1,10), 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') as pay_time, --支付时间
    cast(null as string) as delivery_time, --发货时间
    cast(null as string) as confirm_receipt_time, --确认收货时间
    a.sku_id as commodity_code, --商家编码-规格维度
    cast(null as string) as after_sale_status, --售后状态
    cast(null as string) as order_time, --订单成交时间
    cast(null as string) as deliver_status, --配送状态
    max(a.order_amount) as  total_amount, --商品总价(元)
    max(a.settle_amount) as  actual_amount, --商家实收金额(元)
    cast(null as string) as province_name, --省
    cast(null as string) as city_name, --市
    cast(null as string) as district_name, --区
    nvl(b.product_barcode, regexp_extract(a.sku_id,'([0-9]+)',1)) as  product_barcode ,-- 汉高产品条码
    a.store_code as store_code,
    if(a.order_state like '%删除%','1','0') as is_refund -- 是否是退单
from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_woyi_order_info_jd a
left join (
    select
        plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
        henkel_prod_barcode as product_barcode,
        base_price_rate,
        prod_qty
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
    where  ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
    and ec ='e003'
) b 
on  a.sku_id = b.plat_prod_code
where  a.ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_woyi_order_info_jd')
group by a.store_name,
        a.product_name,
        a.order_num,
        a.order_state,
        to_char(to_date(substr(a.pay_confirm_time,1,10), 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd'),
        a.sku_id,
        nvl(b.product_barcode, regexp_extract(a.sku_id,'([0-9]+)',1)),
        a.store_code,
        if(a.order_state like '%删除%','1','0')

-----------------由于沃亿京东平台每笔订单只有总金额，分摊不到商品粒度金额，所以需要做一张订单与单品基价占比的mapping表-----------------
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_woyi_temp_01

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_woyi_temp_01 as 
select 
    order_num,
    commodity_code,
    product_barcode,
    prod_qty,
    nvl(base_price,0) as base_price, --商品基价
    product_total_base_price, -- 平台商品总基价
    case when  product_total_base_price =0 then prod_qty/product_cnt
        else nvl(cast(base_price /product_total_base_price as double),0) 
        end as base_price_rate
from (
    select 
        a.order_num as order_num,
        a.commodity_code as commodity_code,
        a.product_barcode as product_barcode,
        a.sales_qty as prod_qty,
        a.sales_qty*b.product_base_price as base_price,
        sum(a.sales_qty * nvl(b.product_base_price,0)) over(partition by order_num) as product_total_base_price, -- 订单商品总基价
        sum(a.sales_qty) over(partition by order_num) as product_cnt -- 订单商品总数量
    from (
        select 
            order_num,
            commodity_code,
            product_barcode,
            sum(sales_qty) as sales_qty
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_woyi_temp_00
        group by 
            order_num,
            commodity_code,
            product_barcode
    ) a 
    left join(
        select
            product_barcode,
            product_base_price
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
        and nvl(product_base_price,0) <>0
        ) b on a.product_barcode = b.product_barcode
) a

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_kunc_temp

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_kunc_temp as
select
    'e002' as ec_code,
    '鲲驰' as ec_name,
    t1.order_num as order_no, -- 订单id
    t1.sub_order_num as sub_order_no, -- 子订单号
    t1.commodity_sku, -- 商品sku
    t1.commodity_name, -- 商品名称
    t4.brand_name_en as brand_code, -- 品牌代码
    t4.brand_name as brand_name, -- 品牌名称
    t1.commodity_title as item_title, -- 商品标题
    cast(t1.sub_quantity*nvl(t2.prod_qty,1) as int) as quantity, -- 购买数量
    cast(t1.unit_price * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as unit_price, -- 商品单价
    cast(
        t1.sub_quantity * t1.unit_price * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as total_price_tax, -- 商品总价/含税
    t1.express_company_cd as express_company_code, -- 快递公司代码
    t1.express_company_name, -- 快递公司名称
    t1.express_num, -- 快递单号
    t1.sub_order_state as sub_order_status, -- 子订单状态
    cast(
      to_date(split_part(create_time, '.', 1),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as datetime
    ) as create_time, -- 交易创建时间
    cast(t4.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price, -- 产品基价
    cast(
      t4.product_base_price * (cast(t1.sub_quantity*nvl(t2.prod_qty,1) as int)) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as base_sale_amt, -- 基价销售金额
    cast(t4.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax, -- 含税零售价
    cast(
      t4.retail_price_tax * (cast(t1.sub_quantity*nvl(t2.prod_qty,1) as int)) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as retail_tax_amt, -- 零售价销售金额
    bcconvert(t4.product_barcode) as henkel_item_barcode, -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
    bcconvert(t4.product_code) as henkel_idh_code, -- 汉高idh编号
    t4.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,--汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(t4.brand_name) as henkel_brand, -- 汉高品牌名称
    bcconvert(t4.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_en, -- 汉高品牌英文名称
    t4.category_name_en as henkel_category_code,--汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(t4.category_name) as henkel_category, -- 汉高品类名称
    bcconvert(t4.category_name_en) as henkel_category_en, -- 汉高品类英文名称
    '20' as first_channel_id, -- 一级渠道id
    'Ecom' as first_channel_name, -- 一级渠道名称
    cast(
        t1.sub_actual_amount / t1.sub_quantity * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as unint_price_actual, -- 实际商品单价
    cast(
        t1.sub_actual_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as payment_actual, -- 实际付款金额
    t1.shop_id,
    t3.shop_name,
    cast(null as string) as num_iid, -- spu码
    province_name,
    city_name,
    country_name,
    case
      when pay_time_str is null then '00000000'
      else pay_time_str
    end as ds,
    'e002' as ec
from
(
    -- 丝蕴官方旗舰店 765276150
    select
        order_num, -- 订单id
        sub_order_num, -- 子订单号
        commodity_sku, -- 商品sku
        commodity_name, -- 商品名称
        commodity_title, -- 商品标题
        sub_quantity, -- 购买数量
        unit_price, -- 商品单价
        sub_total_price, -- 商品总价/含税
        express_company_cd, -- 快递公司代码
        express_company_name, -- 快递公司名称
        express_num, -- 快递单号
        sub_order_state, -- 子订单状态
        create_time, -- 交易创建时间
        sub_actual_amount, -- 实际付款金额
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        order_time, -- 下单时间
        to_char(
            to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
        ) as pay_time_str,
        row_number() over (
            partition by sub_order_num, commodity_sku
            order by order_time,created_at,pk_id desc
        ) rn,
        case when province_name like '%新疆%' then '新疆维吾尔自治区'
            when province_name like '%西藏%' then '西藏自治区'
            when province_name like '%内蒙%' then '内蒙古自治区'
            when province_name like '%广西%' then '广西壮族自治区'
            when province_name like '%宁夏%' then '宁夏回族自治区'
            when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=0 then concat(replace(province_name,'省',''),'省')
            when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
            else province_name
        end as province_name,--收货人的所在省份名称
        case when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
            else city_name
            end as city_name,--收货人的所在城市名称
        country_name as country_name --收货人的所在区县名称    
    from
        ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_order_merge_info
    where
        ds <> '1'
        and shop_id = '765276150'
        and trade_state in (
            'TRADE_CLOSED',
            'TRADE_FINISHED',
            'TRADE_NO_CREATE_PAY',
            'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM_GOODS',
            'WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS',
            'FINISHED_L',
            'WAIT_GOODS_RECEIVE_CONFIRM'
        )
) t1
left join
    (
    select distinct
        shop_id, -- 店铺id
        plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
        henkel_prod_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
        base_price_rate, -- 基价占比
        prod_qty,
        effective_time,
        expiration_time,ds
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc
    where ds <>''
    --    and ec ='e002'   
    ) t2 on t1.shop_id = t2.shop_id and t1.commodity_sku = t2.plat_prod_code
        and nvl(t1.pay_time_str,'${bizdate}')  = t2.ds
left join
(
    -- select
    --     store_code as shop_id, -- 店铺编码
    --     stander_store_name as shop_name -- 店铺名称
    -- from
    --     ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos
    -- where
    --     ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')

        select  store_code,
            store_name as shop_name,
            chain_name as platform,
            ec_store_code_tp 
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu where ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and ec_store_code_tp is not null 

) t3 on t1.shop_id = t3.ec_store_code_tp
left join
(
    select
        product_barcode,
        product_code,
        retail_price_tax,
        product_base_price,
        brand_name,
        brand_name_en,
        category_name,
        category_name_en,
        ds
    from
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds <> ''
) t4 on t2.henkel_prod_barcode = t4.product_barcode 
and nvl(t1.pay_time_str,'${bizdate}') = t4.ds
where t1.rn = 1

      retail_price_tax * cast(prod_qty as int) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as retail_tax_amt, -- 零售价销售金额
    bcconvert(product_barcode) as henkel_item_barcode, -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
    bcconvert(product_code) as henkel_idh_code, -- 汉高idh编号
    brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,--汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(brand_name) as henkel_brand, -- 汉高品牌名称
    bcconvert(brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_en, -- 汉高品牌英文名称
    category_name_en as henkel_category_code,--汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
    bcconvert(category_name) as henkel_category, -- 汉高品类名称
    bcconvert(category_name_en) as henkel_category_en, -- 汉高品类英文名称
    '20' as first_channel_id, -- 一级渠道id
    'Ecom' as first_channel_name, -- 一级渠道名称
    cast(
        sub_actual_amount / quantity as decimal(28,6)
    ) as unint_price_actual, -- 实际商品单价
    cast(
        sub_actual_amount as decimal(28,6)
    ) as payment_actual, -- 实际付款金额
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    cast(null as string) as num_iid, -- spu码
    province_name,
    city_name,
    country_name,
    case
      when pay_time_str is null then '00000000'
      else pay_time_str
    end as ds,
    'e002' as ec
from
(
    select
        t1.order_no, -- 订单id
        t1.sub_order_no, -- 子订单编号
        t1.commodity_sku, -- 商品sku
        t1.commodity_name, -- 商品名称
        t1.item_title, -- 商品标题
        case when t3.prod_qty is null then cast(nvl(t1.quantity,0) as int)
    else cast(nvl(t3.prod_qty*t1.quantity, 0) as int) end as prod_qty, --拆包之后的商品数量
        t1.quantity, -- 原始购买数量
        t1.unit_price, -- 商品单价
        t1.total_price_tax, -- 商品总价/含税
        t1.express_company_code, -- 快递公司代码
        t1.express_company_name, -- 快递公司名称
        t1.express_num, -- 快递单号
        t1.sub_order_status, -- 子订单状态
        t1.create_time, -- 交易创建时间
        case
            when t2.ttl_amt = 0 then (t1.sub_amt + t2.ttl_dist ) * nvl(t3.base_price_rate,1)
            else (t1.sub_amt + (t1.sub_amt/t2.ttl_amt * t2.ttl_dist))  * nvl(t3.base_price_rate,1)
        end as sub_actual_amount,
        t3.henkel_prod_barcode,
        t3.base_price_rate,
        t1.shop_id,
        t4.shop_name,
        t1.order_time,
        t1.pay_time_str,
        t1.province_name,
        t1.city_name,
        t1.country_name
    from
    (
        select
            order_num as order_no, -- 订单id
            concat(order_num,commodity_sku) as sub_order_no, -- 子订单编号
            commodity_sku, -- 商品sku
            commodity_name, -- 商品名称
            commodity_title as item_title, -- 商品标题
            sub_quantity as quantity, -- 购买数量
            unit_price, -- 商品单价
            sub_total_price as total_price_tax, -- 商品总价/含税
            express_company_cd as express_company_code, -- 快递公司代码
            express_company_name, -- 快递公司名称
            express_num, -- 快递单号
            sub_order_state as sub_order_status, -- 子订单状态
            create_time, -- 交易创建时间
            shop_id,
            shop_name,
            order_time, -- 下单时间
            to_char(
          to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
        ) as pay_time_str,
            sub_quantity * unit_price - sku_coupon_price  as sub_amt, -- 子订单付款金额
            row_number() over (
                partition by order_num,commodity_sku
                order by order_time,created_at,pk_id desc
            ) rn, -- 取最新一条数据
             case when province_name like '%新疆%' then '新疆维吾尔自治区'
                when province_name like '%西藏%' then '西藏自治区'
                when province_name like '%内蒙%' then '内蒙古自治区'
                when province_name like '%广西%' then '广西壮族自治区'
                when province_name like '%宁夏%' then '宁夏回族自治区'
                when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=0 then concat(replace(province_name,'省',''),'省')
                when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
                else province_name
            end as province_name,--收货人的所在省份名称
            case when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
                else city_name
                end as city_name,--收货人的所在城市名称
            country_name as country_name --收货人的所在区县名称
        from
            ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_order_merge_info
        where
            ds <> '1'
            and shop_id = '10231339' 
            and to_char(
                    to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
                ) < '20260101'
            -- 为了和生意参谋/商智尽量对齐，进行状态的限制
            and trade_state in (
                'TRADE_CLOSED',
                'TRADE_FINISHED',
                'TRADE_NO_CREATE_PAY',
                'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM_GOODS',
                'WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS',
                'FINISHED_L',
                'WAIT_GOODS_RECEIVE_CONFIRM'
          )
    ) t1
    left join
    (
        -- 根据实付款金额公式获取主订单下所有的子订单 +[(unitPrice * subQuantity)] - [skuCouponPrice]
        select
            order_num, -- 订单编号
            actual_amount - tax_fee - postage + shop_coupon_price as ttl_amt, -- 总金额
            tax_fee + postage - shop_coupon_price as ttl_dist -- 主订单总优惠
        from
        (
            select
                order_num, -- 订单编号
                actual_amount, -- 实付金额
                shop_coupon_price, -- 店铺优惠
                tax_fee, -- 税费
                postage, -- 邮费
                to_char(
                    to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
                ) as pay_time_str
            from
                ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_order_merge_info
            where
                ds <> '1'
                and shop_id = '10231339' 
                and to_char(
                    to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
                ) < '20260101'
                -- 为了和生意参谋/商智尽量对齐，进行状态的限制
                and trade_state in (
                    'TRADE_CLOSED',
                    'TRADE_FINISHED',
                    'TRADE_NO_CREATE_PAY',
                    'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM_GOODS',
                    'WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS',
                    'FINISHED_L',
                    'WAIT_GOODS_RECEIVE_CONFIRM'
                )
            group by
                order_num,
                actual_amount,
                shop_coupon_price,
                tax_fee,
                postage,
                to_char(
                    to_date(pay_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'
                )

        ) a1
    ) t2 on t1.order_no = t2.order_num
    left join
    (
    select distinct
        shop_id, -- 店铺id
        plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
        henkel_prod_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
        base_price_rate, -- 基价占比
        prod_qty,
        effective_time,
        expiration_time,ds
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc
    where ds <>''
    --    and ec ='e002'   
    ) t3 on t1.shop_id = t3.shop_id and t1.commodity_sku = t3.plat_prod_code
        and t1.pay_time_str = t3.ds
    left join
    (
        -- select
        --     store_code as shop_id, -- 店铺编码
        --     stander_store_name as shop_name -- 店铺名称
        -- from
        --     ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos
        -- where
        --     ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')
    select  store_code,
            store_name as shop_name,
            chain_name as platform,
            ec_store_code_tp 
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu where ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and ec_store_code_tp is not null 

    ) t4 on t1.shop_id = t4.ec_store_code_tp
    where t1.rn = 1

left join
(

    from

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_info partition (ds,ec)
select
    'e002' as ec_code,-- ec编码
    '鲲驰' as ec_name,-- ec名称
	shop_id,--店铺 ID
	shop_name,--店铺名称
	user_id,--用户id
	nickname,--用户昵称
	order_num as order_no,--订单编号
	trade_state,--交易状态
	order_state,--订单状态
	cast(to_date(split_part(delivery_time,'.',1),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as datetime) as delivery_time,--发货时间
	cast(to_date(split_part(order_time,'.',1),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as datetime) as order_time,--下单时间
	cast(to_date(split_part(pay_time,'.',1),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as datetime) as pay_time,--付款时间
	cast(total_amount as decimal(28,6)) as total_amount,--商品总价
	cast(discount_amount as decimal(28,6)) as discount_amount,--折扣金额
	cast(preferential_amount as decimal(28,6)) as preferential_amount,--优惠金额
	cast(postage as decimal(28,6)) as postage,--邮费
	cast(freight_insurance as decimal(28,6)) as freight_insurance,--运费险
	cast(gold_coin_deduction as decimal(28,6)) as gold_coin_deduction,--金币抵扣
	cast(pay_preferential as decimal(28,6)) as pay_preferential,--支付优惠
	cast(change_amount as decimal(28,6)) as change_amount,--商家改价
	cast(actual_amount as decimal(28,6)) as actual_amount,--实付金额
    cast(actual_amount/1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as untax_actual_amount,--实付金额未税
	cast(quantity as int) as quantity,--商品数量
	province_cd as province_code,--收货人的所在省份代码
	case when province_name like '%新疆%' then '新疆维吾尔自治区'
		 when province_name like '%西藏%' then '西藏自治区'
		 when province_name like '%内蒙%' then '内蒙古自治区'
		 when province_name like '%广西%' then '广西壮族自治区'
		 when province_name like '%宁夏%' then '宁夏回族自治区'
	     when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=0 then concat(replace(province_name,'省',''),'省')
	     when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
		 else province_name
	end as province_name,--收货人的所在省份名称
	city_cd as city_code,--收货人的所在城市代码
	case when regexp_count(province_name, '(上海|北京|天津|重庆)')=1 then concat(replace(province_name,'市',''),'市')
	else city_name
	end as city_name,--收货人的所在城市名称
	country_cd as country_code,--收货人的所在区县代码
	country_name as country_name,--收货人的所在区县名称
	rev_addr as rev_addr,--收货人地址 
	rev_phone as rev_phone,--收货人的手机号码
	rev_name as rev_name,--收货人姓名
	rev_email as rev_email,--邮箱
	distributor_name as distributor_name,--分销商名称
	seller_nickname as seller_nickname,--卖家昵称
	pay_mode as pay_mode,--支付方式
	remark as remark,--商品备注
	invoice_category as invoice_category,--发票种类
	invoice_title_type as invoice_title_type,--发票抬头类型
	invoice_type as invoice_type,--发票类型
	open_bank as open_bank,--开户行
	bank_account as bank_account,--账号
	invoice_phone as invoice_phone,--发票电话
	invoice_addr as invoice_addr,--发票地址
	invoice_title as invoice_title,--发票抬头
	invoice_content as invoice_content,--发票内容
	taxpayer_id as taxpayer_id,--纳税人识别号
	is_refund as is_refund,--是否退款
	refund_amount as refund_amount,--退款金额
	refund_reason as refund_reason,--退款原因
	cast(to_date(split_part(refund_time,'.',1),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss') as datetime) as refund_time,--退款时间
	refund_num as refund_no,--退款编号
	'20' as first_channel_id,-- 一级渠道id
	'Ecom' as first_channel_name,-- 一级渠道名称
	cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as adjust_fee, -- 全场优惠金额
    --如果支付时间为空 数据都存储在99999999分区
    case when pay_time_str is null then '00000000' else pay_time_str end as ds,
	'e002' as ec
from
(
    --取JD、TM店铺的数据
    select
        *,
        to_char(to_date(pay_time,'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as pay_time_str,
        row_number() over(partition by order_num order by order_time,created_at,pk_id desc) rn
    from
        ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_order_merge_info
    where
        ds <> '1'
   -- and shop_id in ('765276150','10231339') 
       and (
        -- shop_id为10231339时，只取20260101之前的数据
        (shop_id = '10231339' and to_char(to_date(pay_time,'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') < '20260101')
        -- shop_id为765276150时，取所有数据
        or shop_id = '765276150'
    )
    and trade_state in ('TRADE_CLOSED','TRADE_FINISHED','TRADE_NO_CREATE_PAY','WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM_GOODS','WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS','FINISHED_L','WAIT_GOODS_RECEIVE_CONFIRM')

    --新增小红书店铺 (注意取数状态不一样)
    union all
        select
        *,
        to_char(to_date(pay_time,'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as pay_time_str,
        row_number() over(partition by order_num order by order_time,created_at,pk_id desc) rn
    from
        ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_order_merge_info
    where
        ds <> '1'
    and shop_id in ('1347','4060')
    and trade_state='7'
) a
where
  rn = 1

    shop_id	, -- 店铺id -- tp侧门店编码
    shop_name	, -- 店铺名称
    item_code	, -- 商品编码
    item_name	, -- 商品名称

    item_num	, -- 商品数量
    item_price	, -- 商品价格

    bu_1	,

    base_price	, -- 产品基价
    base_sales_amt	, -- 产品基价金额
    tax_rate	, -- 产品税率
    base_price_tax	, -- 产品基价含税
    return_amt_untax	, -- 实际退款金额未税
    base_sales_amt_tax	, -- 基价销售金额含税
    sales_channel	, -- 销售渠道
    customer_code	, -- 汉高客户编码
    customer_name	, -- 汉高客户名称中文
    ec	, -- tp编码
    refund_time	as ds, 
    'TP POS'    as data_source_code,  --数据来源代码
    'TP POS'    as data_source_name,  --数据来源

    store_code, -- 汉高门店编码

    henkel_store_category_lv1,  -- 汉高门店一级分类
    henkel_store_category_lv2, --  汉高门店二级分类

select 
    a.order_no as return_order_id	, -- 退货单编号
    a.shop_id	, -- 店铺id
    --c.stander_store_name as shop_name	, -- 店铺名称

    a.item_code	, -- 商品编码

    a.bu_2 as bu_2, --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP) 
    nvl(e.city_name,'Others') as city_name	, -- 收货城市
    cast(a.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as 	base_price, -- 产品基价
    cast(a.item_num*a.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_sales_amt	, -- 产品基价金额
    a.tax_rate	, -- 产品税率
    cast(a.base_price*a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_tax, -- 产品基价含税
    cast(a.return_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt_untax	, -- 实际退款金额未税
    cast(a.item_num*a.base_price*a.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as base_sales_amt_tax	, -- 基价销售金额含税
    a.sales_channel	, -- 销售渠道

    a.customer_code as ec	, -- tp编码

        dist_prod_price as item_price	, -- 商品单价
        bu_1	, -- bu_1

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_woyi_temp_01

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_woyi_temp_01 as
select
     cast(null as string) as refund_id,
     a.store_code as shop_id,
    nvl(c.shop_name,a.store_name) shop_name,
    a.commodity_code barcode,
    a.brand_name goodsname,
    a.product_barcode as henkel_product_barcode,-- 汉高产品barcode
    cast(a.actual_amount as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt,
    cast(a.sales_qty as int) as item_num,-- 商品数量
    cast(a.total_amount/a.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) as item_price,-- 商品价格
    cast(a.actual_amount/a.sales_qty  as decimal(28,6)) as item_price_act,-- 实际商品价格
    nvl(d.bu_1,'Consumer')	bu_1	, --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
    nvl(d.bu_2,'Beauty Care')	bu_2	, --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP)
    a.city_name,
    cast(d.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price,
    cast(d.product_base_price*a.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) as base_sales_amt,
    case
      when a.pay_time is null then '00000000'
      else a.pay_time end as ds,
    'e003' as ec
from
(
    select a.store_name store_name,
            a.brand_name    brand_name,
            a.order_num    order_num,
            a.order_status    order_status,
            cast(if(b.base_price_rate is null,a.sales_qty,a.sales_qty*b.prod_qty) as int)    sales_qty,
            a.pay_time    pay_time,
            a.delivery_time    delivery_time,
            a.confirm_receipt_time    confirm_receipt_time,
            a.commodity_id    commodity_id,
            a.commodity_code    commodity_code,
            a.after_sale_status    after_sale_status,
            a.order_time    order_time,
            a.deliver_status    deliver_status,
            cast(a.total_amount*nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6))     total_amount,
            cast(a.actual_amount * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6))   actual_amount,
            a.province_name    province_name,
            a.city_name    city_name,
            a.district_name    district_name,
            nvl(b.product_barcode, regexp_extract(a.commodity_code,'([0-9]+)',1)) product_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
            a.store_code store_code
    from (
        select store_name,
                brand_name,
                order_num,
                order_status,
                cast(sales_qty as int) sales_qty,
                to_char(to_date(substr(pay_time,1,10), 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') pay_time,
                delivery_time,
                confirm_receipt_time,
                commodity_id,
                commodity_code,
                after_sale_status,
                order_time,
                deliver_status,
                cast(total_amount as decimal(28,6)) total_amount,
                cast(actual_amount as decimal(28,6)) actual_amount,
                province_name,
                city_name,
                district_name,
                case when store_name='妙力家清专卖店' then '801'
                 when store_name='汉高家清个护专卖店' then '802'
                 when store_name='宝莹家清专卖店' then '803'
                 when store_name='施华蔻美发官方旗舰店' then '901'
                 when store_name='施华蔻美发专卖店' then '902'
                 when store_name='汉高美发护发专卖店' then '903'
                 when store_name='施华蔻洗护专卖店' then '904'
                 when store_name='丝蕴洗护专卖店' then '905'
                 when store_name='汉高官方旗舰店' then '906'
                 when store_name='施华蔻洗护个护专卖店' then '907'
                 when store_name='丝蕴洗护造型专卖店' then '908'
                 when store_name='施华蔻洗护造型专卖店' then '909'
                 else store_name end as  store_code
        from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_woyi_commodity_return
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_woyi_commodity_return')
    ) a
    left join (
    select
        plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
        henkel_prod_barcode as product_barcode,
        base_price_rate,
        prod_qty
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
    where
        ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
        and ec ='e003'
    ) b on  a.commodity_code = b.plat_prod_code
    
) a

left join (
    -- select store_code as shop_id, -- 店铺编码
    --     stander_store_name as shop_name -- 店铺名称
    -- from dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos
    -- where ds = max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')
        select  store_code,
            store_name as shop_name,
            chain_name as platform,
            ec_store_code_tp 
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu where ds = MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and ec_store_code_tp is not null 

) c on a.store_code = c.ec_store_code_tp

left join (
    select product_barcode,
        product_code,
        retail_price_tax,
        product_base_price,
        brand_name,
        brand_name_en,
        category_name,
        category_name_en,
        bu_1,

        ds
    from dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds <> ''

and a.pay_time = d.ds

        ,b.commodity_name as goodsname
        ,nvl(c.henkel_prod_barcode,'-110') as henkel_product_barcode , -- 汉高产品barcode
        case when c.plat_prod_code is null then a.refund_fee

        end as return_amt , -- 天猫更新后申请退款金额就是实际退款金额,天猫给的金额单位是分，需要/100
        case when c.plat_prod_code is null then cast(a.num as int)
        else cast(a.num * c.prod_qty as int) 
        end as item_num , -- 商品数量
        case when c.plat_prod_code is null then a.price
             else cast(c.base_price_rate * a.price as decimal(28,6)) 
        end as item_price , -- 商品价格,天猫给的金额单位是分，需要/100
        case when c.plat_prod_code is null then if(a.num=0,0,cast(a.refund_fee/a.num as decimal(28,6)))

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_temp_01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_temp_01 as 
select 
    pk_id, -- 自增主键
    shop_id, -- 店铺id
    shop_name, -- 店铺名称
    sku_id, -- 平台编码/鲲驰编码
    bar_code, -- 条形码(69码)
    commodity_name, -- 商品名称
    sales_date, -- 销售日期
    sales_quantity, -- 实际退前数量
    actual_sales_amount, --实际含税退前金额
    actual_discount_amount, -- 实际优惠金额
    customer_num, -- 客户数
    done_order_num, -- 成交单数
    commodity_actual_price, -- 商品实际价格
    commodity_unit_price, -- 商品单价
    commodity_discount_amount, -- 商品优惠金额
    created_at, -- 入库时间
    return_after_sales_qty, -- 退后数量
    return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 退后含税金额
    sales_channel, -- 销售渠道
    data_type, -- 数据类型
    DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY shop_id,sales_date ORDER BY if(data_type='回流',1,2)) AS rn  -- by天by店铺 有回流优先取回流，没有取常规
from (
    select
        pk_id, -- 自增主键
        shop_id, -- 店铺id
        shop_name, -- 店铺名称
        sku_id, -- 平台编码/鲲驰编码
        bar_code, -- 条形码(69码)
        commodity_name, -- 商品名称
        sales_date, -- 销售日期
        sales_quantity, -- 实际退前数量
        actual_sales_amount, --实际含税退前金额
        actual_discount_amount, -- 实际优惠金额
        customer_num, -- 客户数
        done_order_num, -- 成交单数
        commodity_actual_price, -- 商品实际价格
        commodity_unit_price, -- 商品单价
        commodity_discount_amount, -- 商品优惠金额
        created_at, -- 入库时间
        return_after_sales_qty, -- 退后数量
        return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 退后含税金额
        sales_channel, -- 销售渠道
        data_type -- 数据类型
    from
    (
        select
            *,
            row_number() over(
                partition by data_type,shop_id,sku_id,bar_code,sales_date,actual_sales_amount
                order by created_at desc,pk_id,commodity_name desc --20260326 添加名称降序,使数据唯一
            ) as rn, -- 常规数据去重逻辑
            DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY data_type,sales_date,shop_id ORDER BY ds desc) AS reflow_rn -- 回流数据by天by店铺去重逻辑
        from (
            select 
                pk_id,
                shop_id,
                shop_name,
                sku_id,
                bar_code,
                commodity_name,
                replace(substr(sales_date,1,10),'-','') as sales_date,
                case when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)<'2023-01-01' then sales_quantity
                    when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)>='2023-01-01' then original_sales_quantity -- 天猫超市23年之前取退后,23年及之后取退前,其他店铺该字段放的是退前
                    when shop_id ='10231339' then original_sales_quantity
                    else sales_quantity end as sales_quantity, -- 实际退前数量
                case when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)<'2023-01-01' then actual_sales_amount
                    when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)>='2023-01-01' then original_sales_amount -- 天猫超市23年之前取退后,23年及之后取退前,,其他店铺该字段放的是退前
                    when shop_id ='10231339' then original_sales_amount
                    else actual_sales_amount end as actual_sales_amount, --实际含税退前金额
                actual_discount_amount,
                customer_num,
                done_order_num,
                commodity_actual_price,
                commodity_unit_price,
                commodity_discount_amount,
                created_at,
                case when shop_id in('101','10231339') then sales_quantity 
                    else null end as return_after_sales_qty, -- 101店铺放的退后数量
                case when shop_id in('101','10231339') then actual_sales_amount 
                    else null end   as return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 101店铺放的退后金额
                sales_channel,
                nvl(data_type,'常规') as data_type, -- 常规数据  优先级：有回流优先取回流，没有取常规
                ds
            from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_sales_daily
            where  ds <>''
            and (
                (shop_id in ('102', '103', '104','105','106','107','108','109','110'))
                or 
                (shop_id='101' and (sales_date<'2023-01-01 00:00:00' or sales_date >='2025-07-04 00:00:00'))
                or
                (shop_id='10231339' and sales_date >='2026-01-01 00:00:00')
            )
            and case when nvl(data_type,'') ='回流' then substr(sales_date,1,7)>='2025-11' -- 回流数据：2025年11月之前走手工，11月及之后走系统
            else 1=1 end 
            union all 
            select 
                pk_id,
                shop_id,
                shop_name,
                sku_id,
                bar_code,
                commodity_name,
                replace(substr(sales_date,1,10),'-','') as sales_date,
                case when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)<'2023-01-01' then sales_quantity
                    when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)>='2023-01-01' then original_sales_quantity -- 天猫超市23年之前取退后,23年及之后取退前,其他店铺该字段放的是退前
                    else sales_quantity end as sales_quantity, -- 实际退前数量
                case when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)<'2023-01-01' then actual_sales_amount
                    when shop_id ='101' and substr(sales_date,1,10)>='2023-01-01' then original_sales_amount -- 天猫超市23年之前取退后,23年及之后取退前,,其他店铺该字段放的是退前
                    else actual_sales_amount end as actual_sales_amount, --实际含税退前金额
                actual_discount_amount,
                customer_num,
                done_order_num,
                commodity_actual_price,
                commodity_unit_price,
                commodity_discount_amount,
                created_at,
                case when shop_id ='101' then sales_quantity 
                    else null end as return_after_sales_qty, -- 101店铺放的退后数量
                case when shop_id ='101' then actual_sales_amount 
                    else null end   as return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 101店铺放的退后金额
                '-' as sales_channel,
                '常规' as data_type, -- 常规数据  优先级：有回流优先取回流，没有取常规
                '20250703' as ds 
            from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_sales_daily_101_his -- 101店铺生产静态表,101店铺历史退前数据,历史数据范围:2023.1.1-2025.7.3
            union all 
            select 
                cast(null as string) as pk_id,
                shop_id,
                shop_name,
                sku_id,
                cast(null as string) as bar_code,
                commodity_name,
                replace(substr(sales_date,1,10),'-','') as sales_date,
                sales_quantity, -- 实际退前数量
                actual_sales_amount, --实际含税退前金额
                cast(null as string) as actual_discount_amount,
                customer_num,
                done_order_num,
                cast(null as string) as commodity_actual_price,
                cast(null as string) as commodity_unit_price,
                cast(null as string) as commodity_discount_amount,
                cast(null as string) as created_at,
                cast(null as string) as  return_after_sales_qty, -- 101店铺放的退后数量
                cast(null as string) as return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 101店铺放的退后金额
                sales_channel,
                data_type as data_type, -- 常规数据  优先级：有回流优先取回流，没有取常规
                '20251031' as ds
            from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_sales_daily_reflow_his -- 鲲驰京东历史回流数据（202501-202510）   
        )      
    ) t 
    where case when data_type='回流' then reflow_rn=1
        else rn=1 end 
) a

    t1.commodity_name as shop_item_name,-- 店铺商品名称
    case when t2.prod_qty is null then cast(nvl(t1.sales_quantity,0) as int )
    else cast(nvl(t2.prod_qty*t1.sales_quantity, 0) as int) end as sales_qty, -- 购买数量
    cast(
          t1.actual_sales_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as actual_sales_amt,-- 实际销售金额
    cast(
          t1.actual_sales_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) / nvl(t5.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as actual_sales_amt_untax,-- 实际销售金额未税
    cast(
        t1.actual_discount_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as actual_discount_amt,-- 实际折扣金额
    cast(t1.customer_num as bigint) as customer_qty,-- 客户数量
    cast(t1.done_order_num as bigint) as done_order_qty,-- 成交订单数量
    sales_date,-- 销售日期
    cast(
        t1.commodity_actual_price * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as actual_item_price,-- 实际商品价格
    cast(
        t1.commodity_unit_price * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as item_price,-- 商品单价
    cast(
        t1.commodity_discount_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as item_discount_amt,-- 商品优惠金额

    t3.category_name as henkel_category_name,-- 汉高品类名称
    cast(t3.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as product_base_price,-- 汉高产品基价
    cast(
      t3.product_base_price * (case when t2.prod_qty is null then cast(nvl(t1.sales_quantity,0) as int )
    else cast(nvl(t2.prod_qty*t1.sales_quantity, 0) as int) end) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as product_base_amt,-- 产品基价销售金额
    cast(t3.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as product_retail_price,-- 汉高产品含税零售价
    cast(
      t3.retail_price_tax * (case when t2.prod_qty is null then cast(nvl(t1.sales_quantity,0) as int )
    else cast(nvl(t2.prod_qty*t1.sales_quantity, 0) as int) end) as decimal(28,6)
    ) as product_retail_amt,-- 零售价销售金额
    cast(t1.return_after_sales_qty*nvl(t2.prod_qty,1) as bigint) as return_after_sales_qty, -- 退后数量
    cast(t1.return_after_act_sales_amt*nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as return_after_act_sales_amt, -- 退后含税金额
    case when t1.sales_channel='自营' then '专区'

         when t4.platform='京东自营' then '自营'

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping partition (ds = '${bizdate}',ec)
select
    shop_id, -- 店铺id
    shop_name, -- 店铺名称
    plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
    henkel_prod_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
    prod_qty, --商品数量
    nvl(base_price,0) as base_price, --套包内商品总基价
    product_total_base_price, -- 平台商品总基价
    --当平台码包含正装时,且正装基价之和是0时,则按正装产品的个数均摊占比,免费品不分摊
    --当平台码包含正装时,且正装基价之和不是0时,则按正装产品的基价均摊占比,免费票不分摊
    --当平台码包含正装时,免费品不分摊
    CASE WHEN plat_prod_type = 1 THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN product_type = 1 AND COALESCE(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0) = 0 THEN prod_qty / NULLIF(product_cnt_zhengzhuang, 0)
            WHEN product_type = 1 AND COALESCE(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0) <> 0 THEN nvl(base_price / NULLIF(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0),0)
            ELSE 0 
        END
    --当平台码不含正装时,且正装基价之和是0时,则按产品的个数均摊占比
    --当平台码不含正装时,且正装基价之和不是0时,则按产品的基价均摊占比
    WHEN plat_prod_type = 0 THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(product_total_base_price, 0) = 0 THEN prod_qty / NULLIF(product_total_cnt, 0)
            WHEN COALESCE(product_total_base_price, 0) <> 0 THEN nvl(base_price / NULLIF(product_total_base_price, 0),0)
            ELSE 0 
        END
END as base_price_rate,
    c1.product_type, --1代表正装,0代表免费品
    ec
from
(
    -- 计算组合中单品的基价,得到的结果集为拆包后的商品价格，如果商品数量*2则对应的价格也会*2,
    -- 也会存在关联不到产品主数据的情况，也会存在套包里有部分关联不到产品主数据的情况
    select
        ec,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        plat_prod_code,
        split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',1) as henkel_prod_barcode,
        prod_qty,--商品数量
        prod_qty * product_base_price as base_price,
        SUM(case when product_type =1 then prod_qty * product_base_price
        else 0 end) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code) as base_price_zhengzhuang, -- 正装产品基价
        sum(case when product_type =1 then prod_qty else 0 end) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code) as product_cnt_zhengzhuang,--正装商品数量
        sum(prod_qty * product_base_price) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code) as product_total_base_price,--套包内商品总基价
        sum(prod_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code) as product_total_cnt, --套包内商品总数量
        MAX(product_type) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code) AS plat_prod_type, --套包类型,包含正装则置正装
        product_type --套包内商品类型
    from
    (
        select
            ec,
            shop_code as shop_id,
            shop_name,
            plat_prod_code,
            henkel_prod_barcode_temp as product_barcode,
            new_henkel_prod_barcode,
            case when split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) is null 
            or split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) ='' then 1 else
            split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) end as prod_qty,
            decode(product_type,'正装',1,0) as product_type
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_temp a
            lateral view explode(split(henkel_prod_barcode_temp,'\\+')) b as new_henkel_prod_barcode
    ) t1
    left join
    (
         select
            product_barcode,
            product_base_price
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
           -- and nvl(product_base_price,0) <>0
    ) t2 on split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',1) = t2.product_barcode 

) c1

--所属主题: ECOM模块 炜能专业线
--功能描述: 数据清洗
--创建者: huoxing(huoxing@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2021-05-17 00:55:02
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--20211213  sfr     代码规范标准化
--20220930 shiwu 之前为每周四跑近一周的数据，现在调整为每日全量跑
--20240701  wpf     产品基价使用快照基价
--20240717  mass    去掉威能ods依赖：由于威能每周给一次文件
--20241029  wpf     DECIMAL精度统一调整为(28,6)
--20250728   yyq      产品税率通过门店税率表关联计算
--20251028   yyq      调度任务调整为凌晨调度
--********************************************************************--
-- 炜能专业线的商品会出现溢价的情况，导致折扣率会大于100%
-- 折扣=POS/(POS8折供价/0.8)
-- POS8折供价=经销商供价*销售数量
insert
  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_tmallsk_order_detail_info partition (ds, pro)
select
  'p001' as pro_code,-- 专业线编码
  '炜能' as pro_name,-- 专业线名称
  null as order_no,-- 订单编号
  null as sub_order_no,-- 子订单编号
  a.henkel_coe_new as commodity_sku,-- 商品编码
  a.std_pd_name as commodity_name,-- 商品名称
  null as brand_code,-- 品牌代码
  null as brand_name,-- 品牌名称
  null as commodity_title,-- 商品标题
  a.quantity,-- 购买数量
  case
    when a.quantity = 0 then 0
    when a.quantity <> 0
    and b.product_base_price = 0 then cast(un_discount_amt / a.quantity as decimal(28,6))
    else cast(
      un_discount_amt * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) / a.quantity as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as unit_price,-- 商品单价
  case
    when b.product_base_price = 0 then un_discount_amt
    else cast(
      un_discount_amt * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as total_price_tax,-- 商品总价/含税
  case
    when b.product_base_price = 0 then un_discount_amt
    else cast(
      un_discount_amt * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) / nvl(e.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as total_price_tax,-- 商品总价/不含税
  null as express_company_code,-- 快递公司代码
  null as express_company_name,-- 快递公司名称
  null as express_num,-- 快递单号
  null as sub_order_state,-- 子订单状态
  to_date(
    concat(
      split_part(a.date, '/', 1),
      case
        when length(split_part(a.date, '/', 2)) = 1 then concat('0', split_part(a.date, '/', 2))
        else split_part(a.date, '/', 2)
      end,
      case
        when length(split_part(a.date, '/', 3)) = 1 then concat('0', split_part(a.date, '/', 3))
        else split_part(a.date, '/', 3)
      end
    ),
    'yyyymmdd'
  ) as create_time,-- 交易创建时间
  cast(c.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price,-- 产品基价
  cast(
    c.product_base_price * a.quantity as decimal(28,6)
  ) as base_sale_amt,-- 基价销售金额
  cast(c.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax,-- 含税零售价
  cast(c.retail_price_tax * a.quantity as decimal(28,6)) as retail_tax_amt,-- 零售价销售金额
  bcconvert(c.product_barcode) as henkel_item_barcode,-- 汉高商品条形码barcode
  bcconvert(c.product_code) as henkel_idh_code,-- 汉高idh编号
  c.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,--汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
  bcconvert(c.brand_name) as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称
  bcconvert(c.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_en,-- 汉高品牌英文名称
  c.category_name_en as henkel_category_code,--汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
  bcconvert(c.category_name) as henkel_category,-- 汉高品类名称
  bcconvert(c.category_name_en) as henkel_category_en,-- 汉高品类英文名称
  '20' as first_channel_id,-- 一级渠道id
  'Ecom' as first_channel_name,-- 一级渠道名称
  case
    when a.quantity = 0 then 0
    when a.quantity <> 0
    and b.product_base_price = 0 then cast(a.total_price_tax / a.quantity as decimal(28,6))
    else cast(
      a.total_price_tax * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) / a.quantity as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as unint_price_actual,-- 实际商品单价
  case
    when b.product_base_price = 0 then a.total_price_tax
    else cast(
      a.total_price_tax * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as payment_actual,-- 实际付款金额
  case
    when b.product_base_price = 0 then a.total_price_tax
    else cast(
      a.total_price_tax * nvl(
        round(c.product_base_price / b.product_base_price, 6),
        1
      ) / nvl(e.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6)
    )
  end as payment_actual_untax,-- 实际付款金额未税
  a.shop_id,-- 店铺id
  '施华蔻专业官方旗舰店' as shop_name,-- 店铺名称
  a.ds,
  'p001' as pro
from
  (
    select
      *,
      split_part(sub_henkel_coe, '*', 1) as henkel_coe_new,
      case
        when split_part(henkel_coe, '*', 2) = '' then cast(regexp_replace(sales_qty, '-', '0') as int)
        else cast(regexp_replace(sales_qty, '-', '0') as int) * cast(split_part(henkel_coe, '*', 2) as int)
      end as quantity,
      nvl(cast(regexp_replace(pos, ',', '') as double), 0) as total_price_tax,
      (
        nvl(
          cast(regexp_replace(pos_dcn_price, ',', '') as double),
          0
        ) / 0.8
      ) as un_discount_amt,--折扣前总金额
      (
        nvl(
          cast(regexp_replace(dcn, '%', '') as decimal(28,6)),
          100
        ) / 100
      ) as discount_rate, -- 折扣率(小数显示)
      '0' as shop_id
    from
      ${dme_ods}.s_ec_tmallsk_order_detail_data lateral view explode(split(henkel_coe, '\\+')) adtable as sub_henkel_coe
    where
    --20220930 modify by shiwu 此数据为手工上传，有可能会有空白行，原始数据是以汉高商品编码为主键，所以在此过滤空数据
      ds >='20200101' and (henkel_coe is not null or pos is not null)
  ) a
  left join (
    select
      *
    from
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_tmallsk_product_basic_price
    where
      ds = '${bizdate}'
  ) b on a.henkel_coe = b.product_code
  left join (
    select
      *
    from
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
    where ds <> ''
  ) c on a.henkel_coe_new = c.product_code
  and a.ds = c.ds
  left join (
    select store_code,tax_rate
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_store_tax_rate_mapping
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_store_tax_rate_mapping')
) e on a.shop_id=e.store_code

--- 四个渠道的fcst数据合并
--  新加销售上传的字段20240101生效
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_1
as 
select
 --DT 
     t1.fcst_date               
    ,t1.channel  
    ,t1.months
    ,t1.years
    ,t1.customer_idh
    ,t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg            as  ges                             --NGS / 0.7225 * 0.85 + FG
    ,(t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg) - (t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg)*t2.pld - t1.fg - t1.ngs   as  ppd --计算，GES - PLD - FG - NGS
    ,(t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg)*t2.pld   as  pld                             --计算，GES * 13%   
    ,t1.fg                              
    ,(t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg) - t1.ngs as l6_a --计算 PPD + PLD + FG                             
    ,t1.ngs                             
    ,case when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' then t1.ca else t1.ngs * t2.ca end           as  ca        
    ,case when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' then t1.rebate else t1.ngs * t2.rebate end   as  rebate                   
    ,t1.listing_fee                     
    ,t1.indirect_rebate                 
    ,t1.nka_expense                     
    ,t1.lka_contract_fee                
    ,t1.int_agreement                   
    ,t1.nd_dis_dm_others                
    ,t1.logistics_fee  as logistic_fee  
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_adj                           
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_wo_ror
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_wo_ror
    ,t1.ror
    ,t1.deduction
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_w_ror
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_total
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   nes
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)      as   l10_bdp
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)      as   l10_dsr
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_sur_tax
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_royalties
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_commission
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l11_t_w
    ,(t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg)*t2.l12_goods_sold  as  l12_goods_sold  --计算，GES * 14.8%
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l12_provision_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l12_tp_price_others
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l13
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l14_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   product_contribution
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l16
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   gp1
    ,t1.l17_channel
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_mkt
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_digital
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_nka_tm_o2o
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_ba
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_adj
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_total
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   gp2
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   net_ar_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)      as   bdp_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   sales_allowance
    ,t1.collection
    ,t1.l6b_expense_claim
    ,t1.l17_expense_claim
    ,t1.deduction               as   deduction_l6b_deduction
    ,t1.ror                     as   ror_l6b_ror
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   expected_product_returns_60d
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   cnwc_ar
    ,(t1.ngs/t2.ges_ratio1*t2.ges_ratio2+t1.fg)*t2.pld + t1.ngs*t2.rebate    as   contractual_l6 --计算，PLD + Rebate
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_mark_up_ii
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   pos
    ,cast('Consumer'    as string)              AS   bu_1   
    ,cast('Beauty Care' as string)              AS   bu_2 
from 
(
    select 
        fcst_date               
       ,channel                 
       ,customer_idh            
       ,years                   
       ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
       ,nvl(cast(fg                 AS  decimal),0)  as  fg                    
       ,nvl(cast(ngs                AS  decimal),0)  as  ngs                   
       ,nvl(cast(listing_fee        AS  decimal),0)  as  listing_fee           
       ,nvl(cast(indirect_rebate    AS  decimal),0)  as  indirect_rebate       
       ,nvl(cast(nka_expense        AS  decimal),0)  as  nka_expense           
       ,nvl(cast(lka_contract_fee   AS  decimal),0)  as  lka_contract_fee      
       ,nvl(cast(int_agreement      AS  decimal),0)  as  int_agreement         
       ,nvl(cast(nd_dis_dm_others   AS  decimal),0)  as  nd_dis_dm_others      
       ,nvl(cast(logistics_fee      AS  decimal),0)  as  logistics_fee         
       ,nvl(cast(deduction          AS  decimal),0)  as  deduction             
       ,nvl(cast(ror                AS  decimal),0)  as  ror                   
       ,nvl(cast(l17_channel        AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_channel           
       ,nvl(cast(collection         AS  decimal),0)  as  collection            
       ,nvl(cast(l6b_expense_claim  AS  decimal),0)  as  l6b_expense_claim     
       ,nvl(cast(l17_expense_claim  AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_expense_claim 
       ,nvl(cast(ca  AS  decimal),0)      as  ca 
       ,nvl(cast(rebate  AS  decimal),0)  as  rebate 
      ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_fcst_dt_sales
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fcst_dt_sales')

)t1
left join 
(
  select *     
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling
  where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling')
  and bu = 'Beauty Care'
)t2
 on t1.channel = t2.channel 
and t1.years = t2.years 
and t1.months = t2.months 
and t1.fcst_date >= t2.start_fcst_date and  t1.fcst_date < t2.end_fcst_date
where t1.rn = 1
  
union all 

--NKA 
select
     t1.fcst_date          
    ,t1.channel  
    ,t1.months
    ,t1.years
    ,t1.customer_idh
    ,t1.ges                                
    ,t1.ppd          
    ,t1.pld                                
    ,t1.fg               
    ,t1.ppd+t1.fg+t1.pld             as l6_a --计算 PPD + PLD + FG                             
    ,t1.ges - (t1.ppd+t1.fg+t1.pld)  as  ngs                             
    ,t1.ca                                            
    ,t1.rebate                          
    ,t1.listing_fee                                              
    ,t1.indirect_rebate                                          
    ,t1.nka_expense                                              
    ,t1.lka_contract_fee                                         
    ,t1.int_agreement                                            
    ,t1.nd_dis_dm_others                                         
    ,t1.logistics_fee  as logistic_fee                           
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_adj                                                 
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_wo_ror                 
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_wo_ror          
    ,t1.ror                                                      
    ,t1.deduction                                                
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_w_ror                  
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_total                    
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   nes                         
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_bdp                     
    ,case when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' and t1.customer_idh = 'Sams' then (t1.ges - (t1.ppd+t1.fg+t1.pld))*nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) else cast(NULL as  decimal) end    as   l10_dsr                     
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_sur_tax
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_royalties
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_commission
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l11_t_w
    ,t1.ges*t2.l12_goods_sold   as   l12_goods_sold  --计算，GES * 14.6%
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l12_provision_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l12_tp_price_others
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l13
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l14_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   product_contribution
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l16
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   gp1
    ,t1.l17_channel
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_mkt
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_digital
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_nka_tm_o2o
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_ba
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_adj
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_total
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   gp2
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   net_ar_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)      as   bdp_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   sales_allowance
    ,t1.collection
    ,t1.l6b_expense_claim
    ,t1.l17_expense_claim
    ,t1.deduction               AS   deduction_l6b_deduction
    ,t1.ror                     AS   ror_l6b_ror
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   expected_product_returns_60d
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   cnwc_ar
    ,t1.pld + t1.rebate         as   contractual_l6  --计算，PLD + Rebate
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_mark_up_ii
    ,case when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' then t1.pos else cast(NULL as  decimal) end  as  pos
    ,t1.bu_1   
    ,t1.bu_2 
from 
(
    select 
        fcst_date                     
       ,channel                       
       ,case when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('vn','manning\'s','mannings','manning') then 'VN'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sasa') then 'SaSa'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('crv') then 'CRV'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wts','watson\'s','watsons','watson') then 'WTS'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
        else customer_idh                --客户id
        end as customer_idh                  
       ,years                         
       ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
       ,nvl(cast(ges                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ges                
       ,nvl(cast(ppd                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ppd                
       ,nvl(cast(fg                    AS  decimal),0)  as  fg                 
       ,nvl(cast(ca                    AS  decimal),0)  as  ca                 
       ,nvl(cast(listing_fee           AS  decimal),0)  as  listing_fee        
       ,nvl(cast(indirect_rebate       AS  decimal),0)  as  indirect_rebate    
       ,nvl(cast(nka_expense           AS  decimal),0)  as  nka_expense        
       ,nvl(cast(lka_contract_fee      AS  decimal),0)  as  lka_contract_fee   
       ,nvl(cast(int_agreement         AS  decimal),0)  as  int_agreement      
       ,nvl(cast(nd_dis_dm_others      AS  decimal),0)  as  nd_dis_dm_others   
       ,nvl(cast(logistics_fee         AS  decimal),0)  as  logistics_fee      
       ,nvl(cast(deduction             AS  decimal),0)  as  deduction          
       ,nvl(cast(ror                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ror                
       ,nvl(cast(l17_channel           AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_channel        
       ,nvl(cast(collection            AS  decimal),0)  as  collection         
       ,nvl(cast(l6b_expense_claim     AS  decimal),0)  as  l6b_expense_claim  
       ,nvl(cast(l17_expense_claim     AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_expense_claim  
       ,nvl(cast(pld                   AS  decimal),0)  as  pld                
       ,nvl(cast(rebate                AS  decimal),0)  as  rebate 
       ,nvl(cast(l10_service_fee                AS  decimal),0)  as  l10_service_fee 
       ,nvl(cast(pos                AS  decimal),0)  as  pos 
       ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,
       case when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('vn','manning\'s','mannings','manning') then 'VN'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sasa') then 'SaSa'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('crv') then 'CRV'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wts','watson\'s','watsons','watson') then 'WTS'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
        else customer_idh end
        ,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        ,'Consumer'                 AS   bu_1   
        ,'Beauty Care'              AS   bu_2 
    from dme_ods.s_fcst_nka_sales
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fcst_nka_sales')
    
    union all 

    select 
        fcst_date                     
       ,channel                       
       ,case when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('costco') then 'Costco'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('lirui') then 'Lirui'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('rt','rtmart') then 'RT'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
        else customer_idh                --客户id
        end as customer_idh                  
       ,years                         
       ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
       ,nvl(cast(ges                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ges                
       ,nvl(cast(ppd                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ppd                
       ,nvl(cast(fg                    AS  decimal),0)  as  fg                 
       ,nvl(cast(ca                    AS  decimal),0)  as  ca                 
       ,nvl(cast(listing_fee           AS  decimal),0)  as  listing_fee        
       ,nvl(cast(indirect_rebate       AS  decimal),0)  as  indirect_rebate    
       ,nvl(cast(nka_expense           AS  decimal),0)  as  nka_expense        
       ,nvl(cast(lka_contract_fee      AS  decimal),0)  as  lka_contract_fee   
       ,nvl(cast(int_agreement         AS  decimal),0)  as  int_agreement      
       ,nvl(cast(nd_dis_dm_others      AS  decimal),0)  as  nd_dis_dm_others   
       ,nvl(cast(logistics_fee         AS  decimal),0)  as  logistics_fee      
       ,nvl(cast(deduction             AS  decimal),0)  as  deduction          
       ,nvl(cast(ror                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ror                
       ,nvl(cast(l17_channel           AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_channel        
       ,nvl(cast(NULL                  AS  decimal),0)  as  collection         
       ,nvl(cast(NULL                  AS  decimal),0)  as  l6b_expense_claim  
       ,nvl(cast(NULL                  AS  decimal),0)  as  l17_expense_claim  
       ,nvl(cast(pld                   AS  decimal),0)  as  pld                
       ,nvl(cast(rebate                AS  decimal),0)  as  rebate 
       ,nvl(cast(NULL                  AS  decimal),0)  as  l10_service_fee 
       ,nvl(cast(pos                AS  decimal),0)  as  pos 
       ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,
       case when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('costco') then 'Costco'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('lirui') then 'Lirui'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('rt','rtmart') then 'RT'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
        else customer_idh                --客户id
        end
        ,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        ,'Consumer'                 AS   bu_1   
        ,'Laundry'                  AS   bu_2 
    from dme_ods.s_fcst_nka_sales_lhc
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fcst_nka_sales_lhc')
)t1
left join  
(   select
        distinct 
        customer_idh                         --用户id
        ,sub_channel
        ,bu_2        
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts  
    where channel = 'NKA'
)a
on t1.customer_idh  = a.customer_idh
and t1.bu_2 = a.bu_2 
left join 
(
  select *     
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling
  where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling')
)t2
 on a.sub_channel = t2.channel 
and t1.years = t2.years 
and t1.months = t2.months 
and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu 
and t1.fcst_date >= t2.start_fcst_date and  t1.fcst_date < t2.end_fcst_date
where t1.rn = 1
  
  
union all 

--WS
select
     t1.fcst_date               
    ,t1.channel  
    ,t1.months
    ,t1.years
    ,t1.customer_idh
    ,t1.ges                                
    ,t1.ges - t1.pld - t1.fg - t1.ngs   AS   ppd       --计算，GES - PLD - FG - NGS       
    ,t1.pld                                  
    ,t1.fg                                   
    ,t1.ges - t1.ngs                    AS   l6_a       --计算 PPD + PLD + FG                             
    ,t1.ngs                             AS   ngs                             
    ,t1.ca                                            
    ,case when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' then t1.rebate else t1.ngs * t2.rebate end    AS   rebate             
    ,t1.listing_fee                                              
    ,t1.indirect_rebate                                          
    ,t1.nka_expense                                              
    ,t1.lka_contract_fee                                         
    ,t1.int_agreement                                            
    ,t1.nd_dis_dm_others                                         
    ,t1.logistics_fee                                       
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l6_b_adj                                                         
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l6_b_wo_ror                 
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   trade_spend_wo_ror          
    ,t1.ror                                                              
    ,t1.deduction                                                        
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l6_b_w_ror                  
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l6_total                    
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   nes                         
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)              AS   l10_bdp                     
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l10_dsr                     
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l10_sur_tax
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l10_royalties
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l10_commission
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l11_t_w
    ,t1.ges*t2.l12_goods_sold           AS   l12_goods_sold  --计算，GES * 14.6%
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l12_provision_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l12_tp_price_others
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l13
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l14_cog
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   product_contribution
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l16
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   gp1
    ,t1.l17_channel     
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l17_mkt
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l17_digital
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l17_nka_tm_o2o
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l17_ba
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l17_adj     
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   l17_total
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   gp2
    ,t1.net_ar_balance                  AS   net_ar_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   bdp_balance
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   sales_allowance
    ,t1.collection      
    ,t1.l6b_expense_claim       
    ,t1.l17_expense_claim       
    ,t1.deduction                       AS   deduction_l6b_deduction
    ,t1.ror                             AS   ror_l6b_ror
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   expected_product_returns_60d
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   cnwc_ar
    ,t1.pld + t1.ngs * t2.rebate        AS   contractual_l6  --计算，PLD + Rebate
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)             AS   trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   l10_mark_up_ii
    ,cast(NULL as  decimal)     as   pos
    ,t1.bu_1   
    ,t1.bu_2 
from 
(
    select 
    
        fcst_date   
       ,case when upper(trim(channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else channel end as channel                 
       ,case when upper(trim(customer_idh))='V_WS' then 'v_mpd' else customer_idh end as customer_idh               
       ,years                     
       ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
       ,nvl(cast(ges                  AS  decimal),0)  as  ges               
       ,nvl(cast(pld                  AS  decimal),0)  as  pld               
       ,nvl(cast(fg                   AS  decimal),0)  as  fg                
       ,nvl(cast(ngs                  AS  decimal),0)  as  ngs               
       ,nvl(cast(ca                   AS  decimal),0)  as  ca                
       ,nvl(cast(listing_fee          AS  decimal),0)  as  listing_fee       
       ,nvl(cast(indirect_rebate      AS  decimal),0)  as  indirect_rebate   
       ,nvl(cast(nka_expense          AS  decimal),0)  as  nka_expense       
       ,nvl(cast(lka_contract_fee     AS  decimal),0)  as  lka_contract_fee  
       ,nvl(cast(int_agreement        AS  decimal),0)  as  int_agreement     
       ,nvl(cast(nd_dis_dm_others     AS  decimal),0)  as  nd_dis_dm_others
