   ,sum(nvl(t2.l6_total                      ,0))  as  l6_total                
   ,sum(nvl(t2.nes                           ,0))  as  nes                     
   ,sum(nvl(b.planned_bdp_l10                ,0))  as  l10_bdp
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_dsr                       ,0))  as   l10_dsr                             
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_sur_tax                   ,0))  as   l10_sur_tax                         
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_royalties                 ,0))  as   l10_royalties                       
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_commission                ,0))  as   l10_commission

   ,sum(nvl(t2.l12_provision_cog             ,0))  as   l12_provision_cog                   
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l12_tp_price_others           ,0))  as   l12_tp_price_others                 
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l13                           ,0))  as   l13

   ,sum(nvl(t2.gp1                           ,0))  as   gp1                         
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel                   ,0))  as   l17_channel                 
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_mkt                       ,0))  as   l17_mkt                     
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_digital                   ,0))  as   l17_digital                 
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o                ,0))  as   l17_nka_tm_o2o              
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_ba                        ,0))  as   l17_ba                      
   ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_adj                       ,0))  as   l17_adj                     
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_total                     ,0))  as   l17_total                   
   ,sum(nvl(t2.gp2                           ,0))  as   gp2                         
   ,sum(nvl(t2.net_ar_balance                ,0))  as   net_ar_balance              
   ,sum(nvl(c.planned_bdp                    ,0))  as   bdp_balance
   ,sum(nvl(t2.sales_allowance               ,0))  as   sales_allowance                
   ,sum(nvl(t2.collection                    ,0))  as   collection                     
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l6b_expense_claim             ,0))  as   l6b_expense_claim              
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_expense_claim             ,0))  as   l17_expense_claim              
   ,sum(nvl(t2.deduction_l6b_deduction       ,0))  as   deduction_l6b_deduction        
   ,sum(nvl(t2.ror_l6b_ror                   ,0))  as   ror_l6b_ror                    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.expected_product_returns_60d  ,0))  as   expected_product_returns_60d   
   ,sum(nvl(t2.cnwc_ar                       ,0))  as   cnwc_ar                        
   ,sum(nvl(t2.contractual_l6                ,0))  as   contractual_l6                 
   ,sum(nvl(t2.trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda   ,0))  as   trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa     ,0))  as   trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa  
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_mark_up_ii   ,0))               as   l10_mark_up_ii    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.pos     ,0))                        as   pos  
   ,t1.bu_1   
   ,t1.bu_2    
   ,sum(nvl(t3.l10_adj                       ,0))  as   l10_adj                     
from 
(
    select distinct t.customer_idh
        ,case when t.customer_idh = '1967491' and t1.fcst_date <= '20230814'  then 'Ecom' else t.channel end as channel
        ,t1.months
        ,t1.years
        ,t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
    from 
    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts t
    inner join( 
    select  distinct fcst_date,months,years,channel,bu_2,bu_1
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_1 
    )t1
    on t.months = substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)
    and t.bu_2 = t1.bu_2
    and case when t.customer_idh = '1967491' and t1.fcst_date <= '20230814'  then 'Ecom' else t.channel end = t1.channel
    
)t1
left join  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_1 t2
 on t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh 
and t1.months       = t2.months       
and t1.fcst_date    = t2.fcst_date        
and t1.bu_2         = t2.bu_2        
left join  -- 
(  
    select 
        to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')  as  months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,sum(cast(planned_bdp_l10 as decimal))  as   planned_bdp_l10
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata b
    inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts t1
    on b.customer_idh = case when t1.channel = 'NKA' then t1.prof_customer_name else t1.customer_idh end
    and t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care' --bdp表不区分B&L,全部数据都在B的客户上
    and to_char(to_date(b.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') = t1.months
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata') 
    group by t1.customer_idh,to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')

)b
on b.customer_idh = t1.customer_idh
and b.months = t1.months
left join  -- 
(  --取AR_BDP表每个月第一天的Planned BDP字段值作为当年度的当月及后续所有月份的fcst			

    select 
        to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')  as  months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,sum(cast(planned_bdp as decimal))  as   planned_bdp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata f
    inner join 
    (
          select 
              to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')         as  months
             ,min(to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'))  as  date
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata
          where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata')
          group by to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')
    
    )g
    on to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') = g.date
    inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts t1
    on f.customer_idh = case when t1.channel = 'NKA' then t1.prof_customer_name else t1.customer_idh end
    and t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care' --bdp表不区分B&L,全部数据都在B的客户上
    and to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') = t1.months
    where f.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata') 
    group by t1.customer_idh,to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')

)c
 on c.customer_idh = t1.customer_idh 
and c.months = substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)

left join 
(
  select                
         fcst_date  
       ,case when upper(trim(channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else channel end as channel                 
       ,case when upper(trim(customer_idh))='V_WS' then 'v_mpd' 
             when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('vn','manning\'s','mannings','manning') then 'VN'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('sasa') then 'SaSa'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('crv') then 'CRV'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('wts','watson\'s','watsons','watson') then 'WTS'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
             else customer_idh end as customer_idh  
        ,years                       
        ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                      
        ,cast(l6b_adj  as  decimal)  as l6_b_adj                    
        ,cast(l17_adj  as  decimal)  as l17_adj                    
        ,cast(l10_adj  as  decimal)  as l10_adj                    
        ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        ,'Beauty Care'              AS   bu_2 
  from dme_ods.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling
  where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling')
  
  union all 
  
  --LHC
    select                
         fcst_date 
       ,case when upper(trim(channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else channel end as channel                 
       ,case when upper(trim(customer_idh))='V_WS' then 'v_mpd' 
             when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('costco') then 'Costco'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('lirui') then 'Lirui'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('rt','rtmart') then 'RT'
             when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
             else customer_idh  end    as customer_idh          
        ,years                       
        ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                      
        ,cast(l6b_adj  as  decimal)  as l6_b_adj                    
        ,cast(l17_adj  as  decimal)  as l17_adj                    
        ,cast(l10_adj  as  decimal)  as l10_adj                    
        ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        ,'Laundry'              AS   bu_2 
  from dme_ods.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling_lhc
  where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling_lhc')
)t3
 on nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel) = t3.channel 
and t1.months       = t3.months 
and t1.fcst_date    = t3.fcst_date
and t1.customer_idh = t3.customer_idh
and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
and t3.rn = 1
where (t2.customer_idh is not null 
    or b.customer_idh is not null
    or c.customer_idh is not null
    or t3.customer_idh is not null
    or t1.customer_idh like '%v_%')
group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
   ,nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel)        
   ,t1.months                      
   ,t1.years                       
   ,t1.customer_idh 
   ,t1.bu_1   
   ,t1.bu_2

--- 如果某个渠道存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
--- 先做出每个渠道应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_title

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp_title as
select distinct
    fcst_date
   ,channel       
   ,non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
   ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
   ,rn
   ,bu_2
from(
    select 
        t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.bu_2          
        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end  as  fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.fcst_date,t1.channel,t1.non_latest,t1.bu_2 order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
    select 
    distinct
         t2.fcst_date  as  fcst_date 
        ,t2.channel       
        ,t2.bu_2       
        ,case when t1.fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
    from  
    ( 
            select 
            distinct
                b.fcst_date  as fcst_date                                                    
               ,a.channel 
               ,a.bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp0 a
            left join 
            (
            select 
                distinct fcst_date,1  as  flag 
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp0
            )b
            on case when a.customer_idh  is not null then 1 end = b.flag
            where b.fcst_date >= a.fcst_date
    )t2
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp0 t1 
        on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
        and t1.channel = t2.channel
        and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    )t1
    left join (
        select 
            distinct fcst_date,channel,bu_2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_tmp0 
    )t2
    on t1.channel = t2.channel
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    and t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
)t
where rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据

        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.start_fcst_date else t2.start_fcst_date end  as  start_fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.start_fcst_date,t1.line,t1.channel,t1.non_latest,t1.bu order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.start_fcst_date else t2.start_fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
        select 
        distinct
             t2.start_fcst_date   
            ,t2.line       
            ,t2.channel,t2.bu       
            ,case when t1.start_fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        from  
        ( 
            select distinct
                t1.start_fcst_date
               ,t2.line
               ,t2.channel,t2.bu 
            from (select start_fcst_date,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp1) t1
            left join (select line,channel,bu ,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp1) t2 
            on t1.flag = t2.flag
        )t2
        left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp1 t1 
            on t1.start_fcst_date = t2.start_fcst_date
            and t1.line     = t2.line
            and t1.channel  = t2.channel
            and t1.bu  = t2.bu
    )t1
    left join (
        select 
            distinct start_fcst_date,line,channel,bu
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp1 
    )t2
    on t1.line = t2.line
    and t1.channel = t2.channel
    and t1.bu = t2.bu
    and t1.start_fcst_date > t2.start_fcst_date
)t
where rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据

    ,max(case when  a.line = 'L11 Transport'   then  z.ratio  end)                                as  l11_transport
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'L12 Goods Sold'   then  z.ratio  end)                               as  l12_goods_sold
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'Net AR Balance(w tax）_ratio1'   then  z.ratio  end)                as  net_ar_balance_ratio1
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'Net AR Balance(w tax）_ratio2'   then  z.ratio  end)                as  net_ar_balance_ratio2
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'Sales allowance（L6b Provision Bal/wo tax)'   then  z.ratio  end)   as  sales_allowance
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'L12 Goods Sold_normal'   then  z.ratio  end)                        as  l12_goods_sold_normal
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'L12 Goods Sold_FG'   then  z.ratio  end)                            as  l12_goods_sold_fg
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'Net AR Balance(w tax）'   then  z.ratio  end)                       as  net_ar_balance
    ,a.bu
    ,max(case when  a.line = 'L10服务商费用'   then  z.ratio  end)                                as  l10_service_fee
 from
(
    select     
        t1.line                 
       ,t1.years                                 
        ,t1.remark                       
        ,t1.start_fcst_date      
        ,t1.channel
        ,case when t2.start_fcst_date is not null then t2.start_fcst_date else '99991231' end as end_fcst_date
        ,map( --生成月份和月目标的键值对
            concat(t1.years,'01'), t1.jan  
            ,concat(t1.years,'02'),t1.feb  
            ,concat(t1.years,'03'),t1.mar  
            ,concat(t1.years,'04'),t1.apr

            ,concat(t1.years,'06'),t1.jun  
            ,concat(t1.years,'07'),t1.jul  
            ,concat(t1.years,'08'),t1.aug  
            ,concat(t1.years,'09'),t1.sep  
            ,concat(t1.years,'10'),t1.octs 
            ,concat(t1.years,'11'),t1.nov   
            ,concat(t1.years,'12'),t1.decs  
        ) as kv
        ,t1.bu
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp3 t1
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling_tmp3 t2
    on t1.channel = t2.channel
    and t1.line = t2.line
    and (t1.rk+1) = t2.rk
    and t1.years = t2.years
    and t1.bu = t2.bu
)a
lateral view explode(kv) z as months,ratio 
group by a.years                                
    ,z.months
    ,a.start_fcst_date      
    ,a.end_fcst_date
    ,a.channel
    ,a.bu

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01 as
select 
     t1.id
    ,t1.rk                    
    ,t1.key_words             
    ,t1.search_popularity     
    ,t1.search_index          
    ,t1.click_popularity      
    ,t1.click_index           
    ,t1.click_rate            
    ,t1.trans_amount_index    
    ,t1.trans_number_index    
    ,t1.trans_conversion_rate 
    ,t1.whole_network_number  
    ,t1.online_products_number
    ,t1.sub_category   as     sub_category_src  
    ,t1.category       as     category_src
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.brand_matching),'%')                 then  t2.brand_marking                     end           as  tag_brand
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.category                          end           as  tag_category
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.sub_category                      end           as  tag_sub_category
    ,case when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(>)',0)  =  '>'   and lower(t1.key_words) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.key_words,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  > cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking  
          when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(<)',0)  =  '<'   and lower(t1.key_words) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.key_words,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  < cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking      
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.product_specification_matching),'%') then  t2.product_specification_marking     
          end           as  tag_specifications
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.functions  
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.functions        end           as  tag_product_function
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.subfunction 
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.subfunction      end           as  tag_sub_product_function_split
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.specific_population),'%')            then  t2.specific_population               end           as  tag_crowd
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.component),'%')                      then  t2.component                         end           as  tag_component
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.tone                              end           as  tag_colour_hue
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.color_num                         end           as  tag_colour_number
    ,t1.monthly    
    ,case when  t3.subfunction is not null then 1 end          as  multi_function_flag
from  
(    select  *  ,1 as join_type
       from dme_ods.S_JD_SEARCH_INDEX_INFO 
      where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.S_JD_SEARCH_INDEX_INFO')
)t1
left join 
(
    select 
        brand_marking                        --品牌打标值
        ,brand_matching                       --品牌匹配值
        ,category                             --品类
        ,sub_category                         --子品类
        ,product_specification_marking        --产品规格打标值
        ,product_specification_matching       --产品规格匹配值
        ,case when cnt = 1 then  functions    else NULL end  as  functions                 --功能
        ,case when cnt = 1 then  subfunction  else NULL end  as  subfunction                 --功能
        ,specific_population                  --特定人群
        ,component                            --成分
        ,tone                                 --色调
        ,color_num                            --色号    
        ,1 as join_type  
    from 
       (
           select 
               brand_marking                        --品牌打标值
               ,brand_matching                       --品牌匹配值
               ,category                             --品类
               ,sub_category                         --子品类
               ,product_specification_marking        --产品规格打标值
               ,product_specification_matching       --产品规格匹配值
               ,functions                            --功能
               ,subfunction                          --子功能
               ,specific_population                  --特定人群
               ,component                            --成分
               ,tone                                 --色调
               ,color_num                            --色号    
               ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
           from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
           where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
       )t    
)t2
 on t1.join_type = t2.join_type
left join 
(
    select 
         
         functions                            --功能
        ,subfunction                          --子功能
        ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
)t3
 on t1.category = t3.functions
and t3.cnt > 1
group by t1.id
    ,t1.rk                    
    ,t1.key_words             
    ,t1.search_popularity     
    ,t1.search_index          
    ,t1.click_popularity      
    ,t1.click_index           
    ,t1.click_rate            
    ,t1.trans_amount_index    
    ,t1.trans_number_index    
    ,t1.trans_conversion_rate 
    ,t1.whole_network_number  
    ,t1.online_products_number
    ,t1.sub_category   
    ,t1.category                                                                                      
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.brand_matching),'%')                 then  t2.brand_marking                     end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.category                          end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.sub_category                      end         
    ,case when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(>)',0)  =  '>'   and lower(t1.key_words) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.key_words,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  > cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking  
          when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(<)',0)  =  '<'   and lower(t1.key_words) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.key_words,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  < cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking      
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.product_specification_matching),'%') then  t2.product_specification_marking     
          end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.functions  
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.functions        end          
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.subfunction 
          when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.subfunction      end          
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.specific_population),'%')            then  t2.specific_population               end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.component),'%')                      then  t2.component                         end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.tone                              end         
    ,case when lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.color_num                         end         
    ,t1.monthly    
    ,case when  t3.subfunction is not null then 1 end

   ,nvl(t1.multi_function_flag,0)  as  multi_function_flag
from 
    (select  *,1 as join_type  from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01 )t1 
left join (

) t2
on  t1.join_type = t2.join_type

--子功能:主功能=1:n时，已经按照品类打标过的部分，再次看一下在集合（子功能:主功能=1:n）中是否还有可以打上的标
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_03

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_03 as
select
    id
   ,case when nvl(t1.tag_sub_product_function,'') not like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
          and nvl(t1.multi_function_flag,0) = 1 
          and lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
         then t2.functions else NULL end      as  tag_product_function
   ,case when nvl(t1.tag_sub_product_function,'') not like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  
          and nvl(t1.multi_function_flag,0) = 1 
          and lower(t1.key_words) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
         then t2.subfunction else  NULL  end  as  tag_sub_product_function_split
from 
(
    select 
        id
       ,join_type
       ,key_words
       ,concat_ws(',',collect_set(tag_product_function))            as  tag_product_function
       ,concat_ws(',',collect_set(tag_sub_product_function_split))  as  tag_sub_product_function
       ,max(nvl(multi_function_flag,0))                             as  multi_function_flag
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_02
    group by id
       ,join_type
       ,key_words
) t1
left join (
    select 
       *  
    from (
       select 
           functions                            --功能
           ,subfunction                          --子功能
           ,1 as join_type
           ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
       from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
       where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
        )t
     where cnt = 2 
       and functions  not in ('洗护','染发','造型','护理')
) t2
on  t1.join_type = t2.join_type

--关于品牌打标，与业务确认的逻辑是出现过的品牌全部打标  比如施华蔻赋芮，会分别打上施华蔻、赋芮
insert
  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
  DISTINCT
     t1.id
    ,t1.rk                    
    ,t1.key_words             
    ,cast(t1.search_popularity as bigint)                                                    AS  search_popularity  
    ,cast(t1.search_index      as bigint)                                                    AS  search_index       
    ,cast(t1.click_popularity  as bigint)                                                    AS  click_popularity   
    ,cast(t1.click_index       as bigint)                                                    AS  click_index        
    ,cast(regexp_replace(t1.click_rate, '%', '') / 100 as double)                   AS  click_rate            
    ,cast(t1.trans_amount_index as bigint)                                                    AS  trans_amount_index
    ,cast(t1.trans_number_index as bigint)                                                    AS  trans_number_index
    ,cast(regexp_replace(t1.trans_conversion_rate, '%', '') / 100 as double)        AS   trans_conversion_rate 
    ,cast(t1.whole_network_number   as bigint)                                                AS  whole_network_number  
    ,cast(t1.online_products_number as bigint)                                                AS  online_products_number
    ,t1.sub_category_src  
    ,t1.category_src                                                                                
    ,t5.tag_brand--品牌
    ,t3.tag_category--品类
    ,t3.tag_sub_category--子品类
    ,t1.tag_specifications--规格
    ,t2.tag_product_function--功能
    ,t2.tag_sub_product_function_split--子功能
    ,t1.tag_crowd--人群
    ,t1.tag_component--成分
    ,t4.tag_colour_hue--色调
    ,t4.tag_colour_number --色号
    ,t1.monthly                                                                                     
from                                                                                             
(                                                                                                
    select 
         id
        ,rk                    
        ,key_words             
        ,search_popularity     
        ,search_index          
        ,click_popularity      
        ,click_index           
        ,click_rate            
        ,trans_amount_index    
        ,trans_number_index    
        ,trans_conversion_rate 
        ,whole_network_number  
        ,online_products_number
        ,sub_category_src  
        ,category_src
        ,MAX(tag_brand         )  as  tag_brand
        ,MAX(tag_specifications)  as  tag_specifications
        ,MAX(tag_crowd         )  as  tag_crowd
        ,MAX(tag_component     )  as  tag_component
        ,MAX(tag_colour_hue    )  as  tag_colour_hue
        ,MAX(tag_colour_number )  as  tag_colour_number
        ,monthly  
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01 t 
    group by id
        ,rk                    
        ,key_words             
        ,search_popularity     
        ,search_index          
        ,click_popularity      
        ,click_index           
        ,click_rate            
        ,trans_amount_index    
        ,trans_number_index    
        ,trans_conversion_rate 
        ,whole_network_number  
        ,online_products_number
        ,sub_category_src  
        ,category_src
        ,monthly  
)t1
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_product_function
      ,tag_sub_product_function_split
    from 
    (
    
        select 
            id
           ,tag_product_function
           ,tag_sub_product_function_split
           ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_sub_product_function_split,tag_product_function),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt
        from 
        (
            select 
               id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_02
            group by   id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            
            union all
            
            select 
               id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_03
            group by   id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
        )t2

     )t
      where cnt =1 
         or (cnt > 1  and  tag_product_function is not null)
)t2
ON t1.id =t2.id
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_category
      ,tag_sub_category
    from 
    (
    
        select 
            id
           ,tag_category
           ,tag_sub_category
           ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_category,tag_sub_category),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt
        from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_sub_category is not null)
)t3
ON t1.id =t3.id
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_colour_hue
      ,tag_colour_number
    from 
    (
       select 
          id
         ,tag_colour_hue
         ,tag_colour_number
         ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_colour_hue,tag_colour_number),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt --色号打上多个标签的，都保留
      from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_colour_number is not null)
)t4
ON t1.id =t4.id
left join (
    select 
      distinct
       id
      ,tag_brand
    from 
    (
       select 
          id
         ,tag_brand
         ,count(distinct nvl(tag_brand,'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt   --品牌打上多个标签的，都保留
      from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_jd_search_index_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_brand is not null)
)t5
ON t1.id =t5.id

    t1.dist_region_name , --汉高门店所在经销商大区
    t1.first_channel_name , --一级渠道名称
    t1.second_channel_name  , --二级渠道名称
    t1.third_channel_name , --三级渠道名称
    t1.fourth_channel_name  , --四级渠道名称
    t1.bill_date  , --单据日期(yyyymmdd)
    t1.data_source_code , --数据来源代码
    t1.data_source_name , --数据来源
    t1.sales_channel  , --销售渠道
    t1.transfer_time  , --结存日期
    nvl(t1.bu_1,'Consumer')    as bu_1 , --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
    nvl(t1.bu_2,'Beauty Care') as bu_2 , --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP)
    t1.dist_store_code_orig , --原始经销商门店编码
    t1.delivery_store_code  , --汉高线下配送门店编码
    t1.delivery_store_name  , --汉高线下配送门店编码
    t1.supply_type_name, -- 直/间供类型名称
    case when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then nvl(t2.bu_3,'Others') end as bu_3, -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    t1.DealerRegion, -- 经销商大区(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.DealerType  , -- 经销商类型(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.DealerCode  , -- 经销商编码(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.DealerName  , -- 经销商名称(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.DealerStatus, -- 经销商状态(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.StoreStatus , -- 门店状态(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.StoreType   , -- 门店分类(ka系统原始数据)
    t1.product_base_price, -- 产品基价
    t1.dist_system_type_orig,
    t1.batch2code, --   二分销编码
    t1.batch2name, --   二分销名称
    t1.henkel_store_category,
    t1.henkel_store_category_lv1, --汉高门店一级分类
    t1.henkel_store_category_lv2, --汉高门店二级分类
    
    nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others') as customer_name    -- 客户中文
    ,nvl(t3.customer_name_en   ,'Others') as customer_name_en         -- 客户英文    
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region             ,'Others') end as region_cust              -- 区域(快照)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region_en          ,'Others') end as region_en_cust           -- 区域英文(快照)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province           ,'Others') end as province_cust            -- 省份(快照)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province_en        ,'Others') end as province_en_cust         -- 省份英文(快照)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region_lastest     ,'Others') end as region_cust_lastest      -- 区域(最新)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region_en_lastest  ,'Others') end as region_en_cust_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province_lastest   ,'Others') end as province_cust_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en_cust_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
    
    --- 客户快照渠道信息
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'
          when t1.data_source_name regexp '新KA系统手工|新KA系统采集|老KA系统' then '历史间供客户'
         else nvl(t3.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others')
       end as first_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度一级渠道（快照）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then if(t1.KA_Group_Name='Others','OT',t1.KA_Group_Name)
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.region,'Others')
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
         else 'Others'
       end as second_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度二级渠道（快照）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.third_channel_name
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.province,'Others')
         else null
       end as third_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度三级渠道（快照）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.fourth_channel_name
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
         else null
       end as fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度四级渠道（快照）
    --- 客户最新渠道信息
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'
          when t1.data_source_name regexp '新KA系统手工上传|新KA系统采集|老KA系统' then '历史间供客户'
         else nvl(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')
       end as first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then if(t1.KA_Group_Name='Others','OT',t1.KA_Group_Name)
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.region_lastest,'Others')
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
         else 'Others'
       end as second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.third_channel_name
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.province_lastest,'Others')
         else null
       end as third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
    ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.fourth_channel_name
          when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
         else null
       end as fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
    ,t1.dist_system_name_en -- ka英文名称
    ,nvl(t1.KA_Group_Name,'Others') as KA_Group_Name   -- KA Group名称
    ,t1.KA_Name_Cn_lv1  -- KA分组中文名称
    ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1  -- KA分组英文名称
    ,if(t1.bu_1='Professional',replace(t1.channel_ka_Permission,'NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'),t1.channel_ka_Permission) as channel_ka_Permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）   
    ,case when t1.first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then
         case when t1.dist_system_code in ('KA0008','KA0005') -- 华润万家/大润发
             then concat(t1.fourth_channel_name,nvl(t1.dist_region_name,'Others'))
            else t1.dist_system_name
          end
       else 'Others'
     end as customer_group_cn_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(中文)
    ,case when t1.first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and t1.dist_system_code not in ('KA0008','KA0005') then t1.dist_system_name_en  -- 华润万家/大润发英文取客户主数据细分名称
       else 'Others'
     end as customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
     ,t1.henkel_store_code_orig  --原始汉高门店编码
    ,t1.bill_date as ds
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_temp2  t1
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_temp3 t2
  on t1.dist_system_code=t2.dist_system_code
  left join (
     select distinct
      customer_code     -- 客户编码
      ,customer_name    -- 客户中文
      ,customer_name_en -- 客户英文
      ,channel_name
      ,region           -- 区域(快照)
      ,region_en        -- 区域英文(快照)
      ,province         -- 省份(快照)
      ,province_en      -- 省份英文(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_1 -- 一级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_2 -- 二级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_3 -- 三级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_4 -- 四级渠道(快照)
      ,region_lastest      -- 区域(最新)
      ,region_en_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
      ,province_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
      ,province_en_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest -- 一级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_2_lastest -- 二级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_3_lastest -- 三级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_4_lastest -- 四级渠道(最新)
      ,bu_1  -- 业务条线一级(Retail/Professional
      ,bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP
      ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
     where ds like '%01'
   ) t3
  on nvl(t1.DealerCode,'')=nvl(t3.customer_code,'')
  and substr(t1.bill_date,1,6)=t3.months
  and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
) a
left join (  -- 关联客户主数据取RT细分的英文名称
       select distinct
         customer_group_en_lv2
        ,customer_group_cn_lv2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
      and channel_name_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
    
) b  
on a.customer_group_cn_lv2 = b.customer_group_cn_lv2
and a.first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')

			split_part(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'-',1),

			then concat('0',split_part(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'-',2))
			else split_part(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'-',2) end
  		),1,6) >='202201'
      ) a
      left join (
        select
          dist_prod_code,
          prod_barcode
        from
          (
            select dist_prod_code,
						prod_barcode,
						 row_number() over(
                partition by dist_prod_code order by sales_date desc,prod_barcode desc ) rn

          ) bb
        where
          bb.rn = 1
      ) b on a.dist_prod_code = b.dist_prod_code
      left join (
        select
          distributor_store_code,
          distributor_region_name,
          henkel_store_code,
          henkel_store_name,
          henkel_region_name,
          store_oneid
        from
          (
            select
              distributor_store_code,
							case when distributor_region_name like '%西%' then '华西'
							else distributor_region_name end as 
              distributor_region_name,
              henkel_store_code,
              henkel_store_name,
              henkel_region_name,

                order by

                  store_oneid desc
              ) rn
            from
              ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list
            where
              ds = max_pt(
                '${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list'
              )
              and nka_system = '大润发'
            group by
              distributor_store_code,
              distributor_region_name,
              henkel_store_code,
              henkel_store_name,
              henkel_region_name,
              store_oneid
          ) cc
        where
          cc.rn = 1
      ) c on a.dist_store_code = c.distributor_store_code
      and replace(a.dist_region_name,'大润发','') = c.distributor_region_name
      --关联产品维度
      left join (
        select
	          	* ,row_number()over(partition by product_barcode,substr(ds,1,6) order by ds desc ) as rn
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
	      where ds >='20200101'
				and (ds=TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd'))),'yyyyMMdd')
           or ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')

	    ) d 
		  on b.prod_barcode = d.product_barcode
			and substr(concat(

			case when length(split_part(replace(a.sales_date,'.','-'),'-',2))=1

			else split_part(replace(a.sales_date,'.','-'),'-',2) end
  		),1,6)=substr(d.ds,1,6)
			and d.rn=1

        select

        from
          ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
        where
          ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')

   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.fourth_channel_name
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
        else null
      end as fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度四级渠道（快照）
   --- 客户最新渠道信息
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'
         when t1.data_source regexp '新KA系统手工|新KA系统采集|老KA系统|手工报表' then '历史间供客户'
        else nvl(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')
      end as first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then if(t1.KA_Group_Name='Others','OT',t1.KA_Group_Name)
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.region_lastest,'Others')
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
        else 'Others'
      end as second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.third_channel_name
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.province_lastest,'Others')
        else null
      end as third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.fourth_channel_name
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
        else null
      end as fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
   ,t1.dist_system_name_en -- ka英文名称
   ,t1.KA_Group_Name  -- KA Group名称
   ,t1.KA_Name_Cn_lv1 -- KA分组中文名称
   ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1 -- KA分组英文名称
   ,t1.channel_ka_Permission -- KA渠道（权限字段）
   ,t1.ds                        --
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_temp1 t1
 left join (
    select distinct
      customer_code     -- 客户编码
      ,customer_name    -- 客户中文
      ,customer_name_en -- 客户英文
      ,channel_name
      ,region           -- 区域(快照)
      ,region_en        -- 区域英文(快照)
      ,province         -- 省份(快照)
      ,province_en      -- 省份英文(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_1 -- 一级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_2 -- 二级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_3 -- 三级渠道(快照)
      ,channel_hierarchy_4 -- 四级渠道(快照)
      ,region_lastest      -- 区域(最新)
      ,region_en_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
      ,province_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
      ,province_en_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest -- 一级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_2_lastest -- 二级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_3_lastest -- 三级渠道(最新)
      ,channel_hierarchy_4_lastest -- 四级渠道(最新)
      ,bu_1  -- 业务条线一级(Retail/Professional
      ,bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP
      ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01'
  ) t3
  on nvl(t1.DealerCode,'')=nvl(t3.customer_code,'')
  and substr(t1.ds,1,6)=t3.months
  and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
 where nvl(t1.original_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_unit_qty,0) <> 0
) a

     ,cast(t2.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as product_base_price -- 产品基价

     ,nvl(t4.store_category_lv2,'Others') as henkel_store_category_lv2  --汉高门店二级分类
     
     ,'Others' as customer_name       -- 客户中文

     ,'Others' as region_en_cust           -- 区域英文(快照)

     ,'Others' as region_en_cust_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)

     --- 客户快照渠道信息
     ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'

     ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'
          else '历史间供客户'
        end as first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）

        ,a.bu_2 --	业务条线二级

        ,a.sales_channel --	销售渠道
        ,a.dist_store_code_orig --	原始经销商门店编码(线上O2O门店与已有经销商门店
        ,a.delivery_store_code --	汉高线下配送门店编码
        ,a.supply_type_name -- 直/间供类型名称
        ,a.DealerRegion -- 经销商大区(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,a.DealerType -- 经销商类型(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,nvl(a.DealerCode ,'Others') as DealerCode -- 经销商编码(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,a.DealerName -- 经销商名称(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,a.DealerStatus -- 经销商状态(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,a.StoreStatus -- 门店状态(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,a.StoreType -- 门店分类(ka系统原始数据) 
        ,CASE   WHEN a.bu_2 IN ('SKP','SP') THEN NVL(b.bu_3,'Others')
        END AS bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
        ,a.product_base_price -- 产品基价
        ,a.batch2code
        ,a.batch2name
        ,a.henkel_store_category --汉高门店分类
        ,a.henkel_store_category_lv1 --汉高门店一级分类
        ,a.henkel_store_category_lv2 --汉高门店二级分类
        
        ,a.customer_name       -- 客户中文
        ,a.customer_name_en    -- 客户英文
        ,a.region_cust              -- 区域(快照)
        ,a.region_en_cust           -- 区域英文(快照)
        ,a.province_cust            -- 省份(快照)
        ,a.province_en_cust         -- 省份英文(快照)
        ,a.region_cust_lastest      -- 区域(最新)
        ,a.region_en_cust_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
        ,a.province_cust_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
        ,a.province_en_cust_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
        --- 客户快照渠道信息
        ,a.first_channel_name_cust   -- 客户维度一级渠道（快照）
        ,a.second_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度二级渠道（快照）
        ,a.third_channel_name_cust   -- 客户维度三级渠道（快照）
        ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 客户维度四级渠道（快照）
        --- 客户最新渠道信息
        ,a.first_channel_name_cust_lastest   -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
        ,a.second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
        ,a.third_channel_name_cust_lastest    -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
        ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
        ,a.dist_system_name_en -- ka英文名称
        ,a.KA_Group_Name   -- KA Group名称
        ,a.KA_Name_Cn_lv1  -- KA分组中文名称
        ,a.KA_Name_En_lv1  -- KA分组英文名称
        ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,if(a.bu_1='Professional',replace(a.channel_ka_Permission,'NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'),a.channel_ka_Permission) as channel_ka_Permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）
        ,a.delivery_store_name --	汉高线下配送门店名称
        ,a.customer_group_cn_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(中文)
        ,nvl(c.customer_group_en_lv2,a.customer_group_en_lv2) as customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
        ,a.ds
FROM (
    select  
       *
       ,case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then
            case when dist_system_code in ('KA0008','KA0005') -- 华润万家/大润发
                then concat(fourth_channel_name,nvl(dist_region_name,'Others'))
               else dist_system_name
             end
          else 'Others'
        end as customer_group_cn_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(中文)
       ,case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and dist_system_code not in ('KA0008','KA0005') then dist_system_name_en  -- 华润万家/大润发英文取客户主数据细分名称
          else 'Others'
        end as customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu_temp
 ) a
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu_temp_01 b
ON      NVL(a.dist_system_code,'') = NVL(b.dist_system_code,'')
left join (  -- 关联客户主数据取RT细分的英文名称
       select distinct
         customer_group_en_lv2
        ,customer_group_cn_lv2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
      and channel_name_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
    
) c  
on a.customer_group_cn_lv2 = c.customer_group_cn_lv2
and a.first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_target_sop partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
     years                 as    years             
    ,concat(years,DECODE(substr(z.months,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))             as    quarter           
    ,z.months              as    months            
    ,present_region        as    present_region    
    ,channel               as    channel           
    ,region                as    region            
    ,province              as    province          
    ,city                  as    city              
    ,store_id              as    store_id          
    ,store_name            as    store_name        
    ,henkel_store_code     as    henkel_store_code 
    ,notes                 as    notes             
    ,is_ba                 as    is_ba             
    ,z.target_by_month     as    target_by_month   
    ,target_q1_ttl         as    target_q1_ttl     
    ,target_q2_ttl         as    target_q2_ttl     
    ,target_q3_ttl         as    target_q3_ttl     
    ,target_q4_ttl         as    target_q4_ttl     
    ,target_ytd_ttl        as    target_ytd_ttl    
    ,ka_type               as    ka_type 
    ,store_manager         AS    store_manager
    ,ba_name               AS    ba_name
    ,rkam                  AS    rkam
    ,sales_supervisor      AS    sales_supervisor
    ,ka_code               AS    ka_code
    ,ka_name               AS    ka_name 
    ,customer_code         AS    customer_code 
    ,customer_name         AS    customer_name 
    ,ka_province           AS    ka_province 
from 
(       
    select 
        t1.years                 
       ,t1.present_region        
       ,t1.channel               
       ,t2.henkel_region     as     region       
       ,t2.province_name     as     province        
       ,t2.city_name         as     city       
       ,t1.store_id              
       ,t2.store_name            
       ,t1.henkel_store_code     
       ,t1.notes                 
       ,t1.is_ba 
       ,t1.target_q1_ttl  
       ,t1.target_q2_ttl  
       ,t1.target_q3_ttl  
       ,t1.target_q4_ttl  
       ,t1.target_ytd_ttl
       ,t1.ka_type
       ,t2.store_manager
       ,t2.ba_name
       ,t5.rkam
       ,t3.sfa_ka_code  as  ka_code
       ,t2.chain_name   as  ka_name 
       ,t2.distributer_code   as  customer_code 
       ,t6.customer_name      as  customer_name 
       ,case when t4.sales_supervisor_persl_name like '%待诏%' or t4.sales_supervisor_persl_name like '%待招%' or t4.sales_supervisor_persl_name like '%经销商人员%' then '-' else t4.sales_supervisor_persl_name end  as sales_supervisor 
       ,map( --生成月份和月目标的键值对
           concat(t1.years,'01'),target_jan
          ,concat(t1.years,'02'),target_feb
          ,concat(t1.years,'03'),target_mar
          ,concat(t1.years,'04'),target_apr
          ,concat(t1.years,'05'),target_may
          ,concat(t1.years,'06'),target_jun
          ,concat(t1.years,'07'),target_jul
          ,concat(t1.years,'08'),target_aug
          ,concat(t1.years,'09'),target_sep
          ,concat(t1.years,'10'),target_oct
          ,concat(t1.years,'11'),target_nov 
          ,concat(t1.years,'12'),target_dec 
       ) as kv 
       ,case when (t1.ka_type = 'NKA' ) OR t2.chain_name like '%世纪联华%' then t2.province_name
         when t1.ka_type = 'LKA' AND t2.chain_name not like '%世纪联华%' then t6.province  
         end  AS   ka_province  
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_target_sop_tmp1 t1
    left join 
    (
        select 
          distinct 
            store_code
           ,store_name
           ,ka_code	    
           ,chain_name	 --KA NAME
           ,manager_code
           ,ba_name
           ,store_manager
           ,distributer_code
           ,distributer_name
           ,henkel_region
           ,province_name
           ,city_name
           ,distributer_province
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos') 
    )t2
    on t1.henkel_store_code = t2.store_code
    left join ( --改用SFA的KA_code
       select distinct 
          case when sfa_ka_name = '卜蜂莲花' then 'KA0002' else sfa_ka_code end  as   sfa_ka_code       
         ,sfa_ka_name          
         ,row_number() over(partition by sfa_ka_name order by qbi_system_upload_id desc ) as rnk
       from dme_ods.s_ka_system_sfa_mapping 
       where  ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_ka_system_sfa_mapping')
    ) t3
    on t2.chain_name  = t3.sfa_ka_name
   and t3.rnk = 1
    left join ( --门店主数据的负责人编码与门店主数据_组织架构表的理货员人员编码关联，取门店主数据_组织架构表的销售主管人员作为识别字段
        select 
           tallyman_persl_code          
          ,sales_supervisor_persl_name          
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_org_structure_mapping 
        where  ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_org_structure_mapping')
        group by tallyman_persl_code          
          ,sales_supervisor_persl_name 
     ) t4
    on t2.manager_code = t4.tallyman_persl_code
    left join
    (
        select
             customer_code                         --用户id
            ,customer_name
            ,province 
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer a 
        where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') 
        group by
             customer_code                         --用户id
            ,customer_name
            ,province 
    ) t6
    on t2.distributer_code = t6.customer_code
    left join 
    (  
        select
             province         
            ,ka_type           
            ,region_ka_name    
            ,rkam    
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping a 
       where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping') 
       group by province         
            ,ka_type           
            ,region_ka_name    
            ,rkam 
    )t5
     on case when (t1.ka_type = 'NKA' ) OR t2.chain_name like '%世纪联华%' then t2.province_name
         when t1.ka_type = 'LKA' AND t2.chain_name not like '%世纪联华%' then t6.province  
         end  = t5.province
    and t2.chain_name = t5.region_ka_name
    where rn = 1
)t   
lateral view explode(kv) z as months,target_by_month

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp2

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp2 as
 select 
    dist_code,
    prod_code,
    dist_prod_code,
    dist_prod_name,
    prod_brand_name,
    prod_category_name,
    ds,
    stock_date,
    dist_prod_barcode
 from (
    select
        dist_code,
        prod_code,
        dist_prod_code,
        dist_prod_name,
        prod_brand_name,
        prod_category_name,
        ds,
        stock_date,
        dist_prod_barcode,
        row_number() over(partition by dist_code,dist_prod_code,dist_prod_name,dist_prod_barcode order by ds desc,stock_date desc,prod_code desc) rn
    from(
          select
              dist_code,
              prod_code,
              dist_prod_code,              
              prod_brand_name,
              prod_category_name,
              ds,
              dist_prod_name,stock_date,dist_prod_barcode
          from (
               select dist_code,prod_code,dist_prod_code,ds,prod_brand_name,prod_category_name,dist_prod_name
                     ,stock_date,dist_prod_barcode
                     ,dense_rank()over(partition by t.stock_date,t.dist_code order by t.ds desc) as rn
                from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_data_stock_maizhi t
               where t.ds <> ''
               and to_char(to_date(stock_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') >= '20231101'
          )
          where rn=1
          GROUP BY dist_code,prod_code,dist_prod_code,ds,prod_brand_name,prod_category_name,dist_prod_name,stock_date,dist_prod_barcode
     ) a 
 ) where rn=1
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp3

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp3 as
select
  dist_code,
  store_code,
  dist_store_code,
  dist_store_name,
  ds,
  stock_date
from(
  select
     dist_code,
     store_code ,
     dist_store_code,
     dist_store_name,
     ds,
     stock_date,
     row_number() over(partition by dist_code,dist_store_code,dist_store_name order by ds desc,stock_date desc,store_code desc) rn
  from(   
    select
        dist_code,
        storecode as store_code ,
        kastorecode as dist_store_code,
        kastorename as dist_store_name,
        ds,
        stock_date
    FROM (
               select dist_code,storecode,kastorecode,kastorename,ds,stock_date
                     ,dense_rank()over(partition by t.stock_date,t.dist_code order by t.ds desc) as rn
                from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_data_stock_maizhi t
               where t.ds <> ''
               and to_char(to_date(stock_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') >= '20231101'
          )
          where rn=1
	  group by dist_code,storecode,kastorecode,kastorename,ds,stock_date
  ) 
)where rn = 1

from(
  select
   t1.ka_code                    -- ka代码

   ,nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others') as customer_name    -- 客户中文

   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region_en          ,'Others') end as region_en_cust           -- 区域英文(快照)

   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.region_en_lastest  ,'Others') end as region_en_cust_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province_lastest   ,'Others') end as province_cust_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' or upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t3.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en_cust_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
      
   --- 客户快照渠道信息
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then '直供客户'

        else nvl(t3.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others')

   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then if(nvl(t1.KA_Group_Name,'OT')='Others','OT',t1.KA_Group_Name)

   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then if(nvl(t1.KA_Group_Name,'OT')='Others','OT',t1.KA_Group_Name)

         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
        else 'Others'
      end as second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.third_channel_name
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.province_lastest,'Others')
        else null
      end as third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
   ,case when t1.supply_type_name='直供' then t1.fourth_channel_name
         when upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')
        else null
      end as fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
   ,t1.ka_name_en      -- ka英文名称
   ,t1.KA_Group_Name   -- KA Group名称
   ,t1.KA_Name_Cn_lv1  -- KA分组中文名称
   ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1  -- KA分组英文名称
   ,t1.channel_ka_Permission -- KA渠道（权限字段）
   ,t1.ds
  from(
   select 
      a.ka_code, --ka代码, 
      a.ka_name, 
      a.ka_name_en    ,   -- ka英文名称
      a.KA_Group_Name ,   -- KA Group名称
      a.KA_Name_Cn_lv1,   -- KA分组中文名称
      a.KA_Name_En_lv1,   -- KA分组英文名称
      a.channel_ka_Permission, -- KA渠道（权限字段）
      a.item_code, --KA产品编码
      a.henkel_item_barcode, --汉高商品条形码barcode
      a.henkel_idh_code, --汉高idh编号/汉高产品编号
      a.item_name , --KA商品名称
      a.stock_num,  --库存数量
      a.stock_amt,  --库存金额
      a.base_price, --产品基价
      a.base_stock_amt, --基价库存金额
      a.store_code,  --门店编号
      a.store_name ,  --门店名称, 
      a.henkel_store_code,  --汉高门店编号, 
      a.henkel_store_name,  --汉高门店名称, 
      a.henkel_region_name,  --汉高大区, 
      a.dist_region_name, --经销商大区
      a.province_name, --省份名称
      a.city_name, --城市名称
      a.brand_name ,  --品牌名称
      a.category_name ,  --品类名称
      a.channel_name ,  --渠道名称
      a.retail_name,  --零售商名称
      a.henkel_product_name , --汉高产品名称
      a.henkel_brand_code ,  --品牌代码
      a.henkel_brand ,  --汉高品牌名称
      a.henkel_brand_en , --汉高品牌英文名称
      a.henkel_category_code ,  --汉高品类代码
      a.henkel_category , --汉高品类名称
      a.henkel_category_en ,  --汉高品类英文名称
      a.stock_date ,  --库存日期
      a.first_channel_id , --一级渠道id
      a.first_channel_name ,  --一级渠道名称
      a.second_channel_name, 
      a.third_channel_name, 
      a.fourth_channel_name, 
      a.pri_store_code,  --外部唯一门店编码
      case 
        when a.data_source regexp 'Maizhi|PG' and (a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerCode='100006' or a.DealerName regexp'直供') then '直供'
        when nvl(upper(a.first_channel_name),'') not in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
        when a.data_source regexp 'Maizhi|PG' then 
             case when a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerCode='100006' or a.DealerName regexp'直供' then '直供'
               else  '间供'
             end
        --when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp 'OLE|BLT|妍丽' then '间供' --间供
        --when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp '山姆' and substr(a.stock_date,1,6)<='202309' then '间供' --山姆
        --when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp '山姆' and substr(a.stock_date,1,6)>'202309' then '直供' --山姆
        --when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp '丝芙兰' then '直供' --直供
        --when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name ='华润万家' then '间供' --间供
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp 'OLE|BLT|妍丽' then '间供' --间供
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.ka_code='KA0007' and substr(a.stock_date,1,6)<='202309' then '间供' --山姆
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.ka_code='KA0007' and substr(a.stock_date,1,6)>'202309' then '直供' --山姆
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.ka_code='KA0403' then '直供' --丝芙兰
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='SP' AND a.ka_code='KA0008' then '间供' --华润万家
      
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='Beauty Care' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp 'OLE|BLT' then '间供' --间供
        when nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')='Beauty Care' AND a.fourth_channel_name regexp '家家悦' then '间供' --间供
        
        --when a.fourth_channel_name ='华润万家' then ( case when a.dist_region_name in ('华西','华南','华北') then '直供'else '间供' end ) 
        --when a.third_channel_name ='家乐福' then ( case when a.dist_region_name in ('华东','华南') then '直供' else '间供' end)  --家乐福除家乐福东区和南区直供
        --when a.third_channel_name regexp '屈臣氏|沃尔玛|麦德龙|万宁|莎莎' then '直供' --'屈臣氏','沃尔玛','麦德龙','万宁','莎莎') 直供
        --when a.fourth_channel_name = '华润乐购' then '直供' --华润乐购直供
        --when a.fourth_channel_name = '华润苏果' then '间供' --华润苏果间供
        --when a.third_channel_name regexp '大润发' then 
        --   case when a.ds>='20240301' and (a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerName regexp'直供' or a.dist_region_name='华东') then '直供'
        --        when a.ds>='20240701' and (a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerName regexp'直供' or a.dist_region_name='华南') then '直供'
        --     else '间供' end  
        --when a.third_channel_name regexp '永辉' then '间供'
        --else 'Others'
       
        when a.ka_code='KA0008' then ( case when a.dist_region_name in ('华西','华南','华北') then '直供'else '间供' end ) -- 华润万家
        when a.ka_code='KA0001' then ( case when a.dist_region_name in ('华东','华南') then '直供' else '间供' end)  --家乐福除家乐福东区和南区直供
        when a.ka_code in('KA0011','KA0006','KA0007','KA0004','KA0010','KA0070') then '直供' --'屈臣氏','沃尔玛','山姆','麦德龙','万宁','莎莎') 直供
        when a.ka_code ='KA0009' then '直供' --华润乐购直供
        when a.ka_code ='KA0068' then '间供' --华润苏果间供
        when a.ka_code ='KA0005' then --大润发
           case when a.ds>='20240301' and (a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerName regexp'直供' or a.dist_region_name='华东') then '直供'
                when a.ds>='20240701' and (a.DealerCode='100000' or a.DealerName regexp'直供' or a.dist_region_name='华南') then '直供'
             else '间供' end  
        when a.ka_code ='KA0003' then '间供' -- 永辉
        else 'Others'
      end        as supply_type_name, -- 直/间供类型名称
      nvl(b.bu_1,'Consumer')	bu_1	, --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
      nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care')	bu_2	, --业务条线二级(BeautyCare/Laundry/SP/SKP)
      a.DealerRegion, -- 经销商大区
      a.DealerType  , -- 经销商类型
      a.DealerCode  , -- 经销商编码
      a.DealerName  , -- 经销商名称
      a.DealerStatus, -- 经销商状态
      a.StoreStatus , -- 门店状态
      a.StoreType   , -- 门店分类
      case when b.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then nvl(c.bu_3,'Others') end as bu_3, -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
  	  a.dist_type_orig,
      a.data_source, -- 数据来源
      a.henkel_store_category,
      a.henkel_store_category_lv1,
      a.henkel_store_category_lv2,
      a.ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp7 a 
    left join(
       select
          product_barcode  as henkel_prod_barcode      -- 汉高产品条码
         ,bu_1,bu_2
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
       where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
     )b 
     on a.henkel_item_barcode=b.henkel_prod_barcode
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_tmp8 c
    on a.ka_code=c.ka_code
    where nvl(c.ka_code,'')<>'KA0069' -- 过滤盒马数据
  ) t1
  left join (
     select distinct
       customer_code     -- 客户编码
       ,customer_name    -- 客户中文
       ,customer_name_en -- 客户英文
       ,channel_name
       ,region           -- 区域(快照)
       ,region_en        -- 区域英文(快照)
       ,province         -- 省份(快照)

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu_temp_1

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu_temp_1 as
   -- 合并手工数据
   select 
     t1.ka_code as ka_code    --ka代码
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Name,'Others') as ka_name  --ka名称
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Name_En,'Others') as ka_name_en    -- ka英文名称
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Group_Name ,'Others') as KA_Group_Name -- KA Group名称
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Name_Cn_lv1,'Others') as KA_Name_Cn_lv1  -- KA分组中文名称
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Name_En_lv1,'Others') as KA_Name_En_lv1  -- KA分组英文名称
     ,nvl(t5.channel_ka_Permission,'Others') as channel_ka_Permission -- KA渠道（权限字段）
     ,t1.ka_product_code as item_code --KA产品编码
     ,t1.henkel_item_barcode as henkel_item_barcode    -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
     ,t1.henkel_idh_code   as henkel_idh_code      -- 汉高idh编号/汉高产品编号
     ,t1.ka_product_name as item_name --KA商品名称
     ,cast(nvl(t1.stock_num,0) as bigint)            as stock_num   -- 库存数量
     ,cast(nvl(t1.stock_amt,0) as decimal(28,6))     as stock_amt   -- 库存金额
     ,cast(nvl(t3.product_base_price,0) as decimal(28,6)) as base_price  -- 产品基价
     ,cast(t1.stock_num * nvl(t3.product_base_price,0) as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt  -- 基价库存金额
     ,t1.dist_store_code                   as store_code         -- 门店编号
     ,t1.dist_store_name                   as store_name         -- 门店名称
     ,nvl(t1.henkel_store_code,'Others')   as henkel_store_code  -- 汉高门店编号
     ,nvl(t4.henkel_store_name,'Others')   as henkel_store_name  -- 汉高门店名称
     ,nvl(t4.henkel_region,'Others')       as henkel_region_name -- 汉高大区
     ,nvl(t4.dist_region_name,'Others')    as dist_region_name   -- 经销商大区
     ,nvl(t4.province_name,'Others')       as province_name      -- 省份名称
     ,nvl(t4.city_name,'Others')           as city_name          -- 城市名称
     ,nvl(t4.store_category,'Others') as henkel_store_category
     ,nvl(t4.store_category_lv1,'Others') as henkel_store_category_lv1
     ,nvl(t4.store_category_lv2,'Others') as henkel_store_category_lv2
     ,nvl(t1.ka_brand_name,'Others')       as brand_name         -- 品牌名称
     ,nvl(t1.ka_category_name,'Others')    as category_name      -- 品类名称
     ,nvl(t4.chain_name,'Others')          as channel_name       -- 渠道名称
     ,cast(null as string) as   retail_name --零售商名称
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_prod_name,'Others')        as henkel_product_name  --汉高产品名称
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_brand_name_en,'Others')    as henkel_brand_code    --品牌代码
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_brand_name_cn,'Others')    as henkel_brand         --汉高品牌名称
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_brand_name_en,'Others')    as henkel_brand_en      --汉高品牌英文名称
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_category_name_en,'Others') as henkel_category_code --汉高品类代码
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_category_name_cn,'Others') as henkel_category      --汉高品类名称
     ,nvl(t3.henkel_category_name_en,'Others') as henkel_category_en   --汉高品类英文名称
     ,t1.stock_date  --库存日期
     ,'10'                   as first_channel_id    --一级渠道id
     ,t1.dist_system_type    as dist_type_orig      --原始KA类型
     ,nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') as first_channel_name  --一级渠道名称
     ,case when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') = 'NKA' then nvl(t5.KA_Group_Name ,'Others')
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('LKA','OT') then nvl(t4.henkel_region,'Others')
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('NC','线上分销') then nvl(t5.KA_Name,'Others')
           else nvl(t5.KA_Name,'Others')
       end as second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
     ,case when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') = 'NKA' then nvl(t5.KA_Name_Cn_lv1 ,'Others')
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('LKA','OT') then nvl(t5.KA_Name,'Others')
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('NC','线上分销') then null
           else null
       end as third_channel_name -- 三级渠道名称
     ,case when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('LKA','OT') then null
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') in ('NC','线上分销') then null
           when t1.ka_code='KA0011' then nvl(t4.chain_name,'Others')
           when nvl(t5.KA_Type_Name,'OT') = 'NKA' then nvl(t5.KA_Name,'Others')
         else null
       end as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
     ,t1.henkel_store_code   as pri_store_code --外部唯一门店编码
     ,t1.bu_1 as bu_1
     ,t1.bu_2 as bu_2
     ,'手工数据' as data_source --数据来源
     ,t1.stock_date as ds
     ,t1.ka_code    as ka
     ,t1.supply_type_name as supply_type_name
   from (
      select
        replace(monthly,'-','') as monthly  -- 月份
        ,replace(last_day(to_date(monthly,'yyyymm')),'-','') as stock_date  --库存日期
        ,ka_product_code  -- KA产品编码
        ,product_barcode as henkel_item_barcode  -- 汉高商品条形码barcode    
        ,product_code    as henkel_idh_code      -- 汉高idh编号/汉高产品编号    
        ,product_name    as ka_product_name      --KA商品名称
        ,null            as ka_brand_name        -- ka品牌名称
        ,null            as ka_category_name     -- ka品类名称  
        ,dist_store_code  -- KA门店code
        ,dist_store_name  -- KA门店名称
        ,'Others'             as henkel_store_code -- 汉高门店code
        ,sum(store_stock)     as stock_num -- 库存数量
        ,sum(stock_amt  )     as stock_amt -- 库存金额
        ,'KA0403'            as ka_code   -- KA编码
        ,'丝芙兰'             as ka_name   -- KA名称
        ,'SELECTIVE RETAILER' as dist_system_type -- KA类型
	      ,'Professional' as bu_1
	      ,'SP' as bu_2
          ,'直供' as supply_type_name
      from ${dme_ods}.s_sephora_stock_data
      where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_sephora_stock_data')
      and monthly<='202310'  -- 后面数据取maizhi
      group by replace(monthly,'-',''),replace(last_day(to_date(monthly,'yyyymm')),'-',''),ka_product_code 
        ,product_barcode ,product_code ,product_name ,dist_store_code,dist_store_name
   ) t1
  left join(
    --产品主数据中存在产品基价不一致的情况，在此关联——pos的产品主数据，使得基价保持一致
    select
      product_code     -- 汉高产品编码
      ,product_name     as henkel_prod_name         -- KA产品名称
      ,brand_name       as henkel_brand_name_cn     -- 汉高品牌名称中文
      ,brand_name_en    as henkel_brand_name_en     -- 汉高品牌名称英文
      ,category_name    as henkel_category_name_cn  -- 汉高品类名称中文
      ,category_name_en as henkel_category_name_en  -- 汉高品类名称英文
      ,product_base_price --产品基价
      ,bu_1,bu_2,ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
    where ds >='20200101'
  )t3 
  on t1.henkel_item_barcode=t3.product_code
  and t1.bu_1=t3.bu_1
  and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
  and t1.stock_date=t3.ds
  left join(
    -- 获取门店主数据中门店的oneid
    select
      store_oneid as henkel_store_code,-- 汉高门店编码
      -- store_code as henkel_store_code, -- 汉高门店编码
      store_name as henkel_store_name, -- 汉高门店名称
      nka_customer_name,
      henkel_region,
      province_name,
      city_name,
      county_name,
      chain_name,
      distributor_region_name as dist_region_name,
      store_category,
      store_category_lv1,
      store_category_lv2,
      substr(ds,1,6) as month_link
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds like '%01'
    -- where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu') 
  ) t4 
  on nvl(t1.henkel_store_code,'Others') = t4.henkel_store_code
  and substr(t1.stock_date,1,6) = t4.month_link
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka t5 
   on t1.ka_code = t5.KA_Code
   and t5.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
  --left join(
  --   select
  --       nka_system,
  --       channel_group
  --   from ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule
  --   where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule')
  --) t5 
  --on t1.ka_name = t5.nka_system

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu_temp_4

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu_temp_4 as
 select 
   ka_code,bu_2,DealerCode
   ,substr(ds,1,6) as stock_month
   ,case when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
     end as stock_quarter
   ,substr(ds,1,4) as stock_year
   ,max(ds) as ds_m
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu_temp_3 a
 group by ka_code,bu_2,substr(ds,1,6),DealerCode
   ,case when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
         when substr(a.ds,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
     end
   ,substr(ds,1,4)

insert

select 
distinct
    case when upper(trim(channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else channel end as channel               
   ,case  when lower(customer_idh) in('c4','carrefour') then 'C4'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('me','metro') then 'ME'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('vn','manning\'s','mannings','manning') then 'VN'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sasa') then 'SaSa'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wal','walmart') then 'WAL'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('crv') then 'CRV'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('wts','watson\'s','watsons','watson') then 'WTS'
          when lower(customer_idh) in('sams','sam\'s') then 'Sams'
          when upper(trim(customer_idh))='V_WS' then 'v_mpd'
        else customer_idh   end    as    customer_idh            
   ,years                 
   ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
   ,nvl(cast(ges                      AS  decimal),0)  as  ges                     
   ,nvl(cast(ppd                      AS  decimal),0)  as  ppd                     
   ,nvl(cast(pld                      AS  decimal),0)  as  pld                     
   ,nvl(cast(fg                       AS  decimal),0)  as  fg                      
   ,nvl(cast(l6_a                     AS  decimal),0)  as  l6_a                    
   ,nvl(cast(ngs                      AS  decimal),0)  as  ngs                     
   ,nvl(cast(ca                       AS  decimal),0)  as  ca

--- 如果某个types存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
--- 先做出每个types应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp21

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp21 as
select distinct
    fcst_date
   ,types       
   ,non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
   ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
   ,rn
from(
    select 
         t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.types       
        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end  as  fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.fcst_date,t1.types,t1.non_latest order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
        select 
        distinct
             t2.fcst_date  as  fcst_date 
            ,t2.types       
            ,case when t1.fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        from  
        ( 
            select distinct
                t1.fcst_date
               ,t2.types
            from (select fcst_date,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp20) t1
            left join (select types,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp20) t2 
            on t1.flag = t2.flag
        )t2
        left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp20 t1 
            on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
            and t1.types = t2.types
    )t1
    left join (
        select 
            distinct fcst_date,types
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_digital_wide_tb_tmp20 
    )t2
    on t1.types = t2.types
    and t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
)t
where rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据

--- 如果某个brand存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
--- 先做出每个brand应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp21

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp21 as
select distinct
    fcst_date
   ,brand       
   ,non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
   ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
   ,rn
from(
    select 
         t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.brand       
        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end  as  fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.fcst_date,t1.brand,t1.non_latest order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
        select 
        distinct
             t2.fcst_date  as  fcst_date 
            ,t2.brand       
            ,case when t1.fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        from  
        ( 
            select distinct
                t1.fcst_date
               ,t2.brand
            from (select fcst_date,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp20) t1
            left join (select brand,1 as flag from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp20) t2 
            on t1.flag = t2.flag
        )t2
        left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp20 t1 
            on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
            and t1.brand = t2.brand
    )t1
    left join (
        select 
            distinct fcst_date,brand
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_l17_pure_mkt_wide_tb_tmp20 
    )t2
    on t1.brand = t2.brand
    and t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
)t
where rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据
