      ,DealerName         -- 经销商名称
      ,cast(null as string) as DealerChannelCodes       -- 经销商渠道编码集合
      ,split(replace(DealerChannelNames,'；',';'),';')[0] as DealerChannelNames
      ,CASE WHEN NVL(StartMonth,'')='' THEN '190001' ELSE StartMonth END AS StartMonth -- 开始日期
      ,CASE WHEN NVL(StartMonth,'')='' THEN '299912' ELSE EndMonth   END AS EndMonth   -- 结束日期

       ,nvl(to_char(to_date(EndDate,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm'),'999999')   as EndMonth   -- 结束日期

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_7

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_7 as
select
  t1.CountryName as cn_or_hk            -- CN or HK
  ,t1.DealerCode as customer_code       -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code
  ,case when UPPER(t1.DealerChannelNames)='ECOM' then 'Ecom'
        when UPPER(t1.DealerChannelNames) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and upper(t1.BusinessBrand) in ('SKP','SP') then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
        when upper(nvl(t1.DealerChannelNames,'Others'))='OTHERS' then 'Others'
      else upper(t1.DealerChannelNames)
    end as channel_name  -- 渠道Channel1
  ,case when UPPER(t1.DealerChannelNames) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and upper(t1.BusinessBrand) in ('SKP','SP') then 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
      else nvl(t1.DealerChannelNames2,'Others')
    end as channel_name2  -- 渠道Channel2
  ,case when t1.KANameEn='RT' then 'RT'
     else nvl(t1.KASubNameEn ,'Others')
    end as customer_group        -- 客户分类Customer Group
  ,nvl(t1.KAName      ,'Others') as customer_group_cn_lv1 -- 客户分类Customer Group1(中文)
  ,nvl(t1.KASubName   ,'Others') as customer_group_cn_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(中文)
  ,nvl(t1.KASubNameEn ,'Others') as ka_system_en          -- KA system
  ,nvl(t1.RegionName  ,'Others') as region                -- 区域Region
  ,nvl(t1.RegionNameEn,'Others') as region_en             -- 区域英文
  ,nvl(t1.ProvinceName,'Others') as province              -- 省份
  ,nvl(t1.ProvinceNameEn,'Others') as province_en         -- 省份英文
  ,nvl(t1.CityName     ,'Others') as City_Name     -- 城市
  ,nvl(t1.CityTypeName ,'Others') as City_TypeName -- 城市级别
  ,nvl(t1.DealerNameEn,'Others') as customer_name_en      -- 客户名称 Customer name EN
  ,nvl(t1.DealerName  ,'Others') as customer_name         -- 客户名称CN
  ,cast(null as string) as customer_grade        -- 客户等级（A/B/C/D)
  ,case when upper(t1.BusinessBrand) in ('SK','L')   then 'Consumer'
        when upper(t1.BusinessBrand) in ('SKP','SP') then 'Professional'
     else upper(t1.BusinessBrand)
    end as bu_1    -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional
  ,case when upper(t1.BusinessBrand)='SK' then 'Beauty Care'
        when upper(t1.BusinessBrand)='L'  then 'Laundry'
     else upper(t1.BusinessBrand)
    end as bu_2    -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
  ,cast(t1.data_source as string) as customer_belongto_brand	 -- 客户归属品牌
  ,t1.Status as is_expired_customer	 -- 是否失效客户（是/否）
  ,nvl(t1.KANameEn ,'Others')   as customer_group_en_lv1 -- 客户分类Customer Group1(英文)
  ,nvl(t1.KASubNameEn,'Others') as customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
  ,nvl(t1.MPDStatus,'Others')   as cooperation_status    -- MPD合作状态
  ,nvl(t1.KASubCode,'Others') as KASubCode             -- KA细分编码
  ,t1.data_source	             -- 数据来源
  ,t1.ds
  ,ROW_NUMBER()over(PARTITION BY t1.DealerCode,t1.BusinessBrand ORDER BY t1.ds DESC) as rn -- 防止重复取唯一
from(
   select
     a.DealerCode                -- 经销商代码
     ,a.DealerName               -- 经销商名称
     ,a.DealerNameEn             -- 经销商名称(英文)
     ,a.CountryName              -- 国家
     ,a.ProvinceName             -- 所在省份
     ,a.ProvinceNameEn           -- 省份英文
     ,a.CityName                 -- 所在城市

     ,a.ContactName              -- 经销商联系人

     ,a.ContactEmail             -- 经销商联系人邮箱
     ,a.SalesOrganization        -- 销售组织
     ,split(replace(a.DealerChannelCodes,'；',';'),';')[0] as DealerChannelCodes       -- 经销商渠道编码集合
     ,split(replace(a.DealerChannelNames,'；',';'),';')[0] as DealerChannelNames       -- 最新渠道Channel1

-- sell in专业线客户bu_3信息,nka 渠道客户基于ka汇总
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_9

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_9 as
 select distinct
   customer_group_cn_lv2,case when upper(bu_3) IN ('SKP&SP','SP&SKP') then 'SKP&SP Customer' else concat(bu_3,' Customer') end as bu_3
 from(
   select
     a.customer_group_cn_lv2,concat_ws('&',COLLECT_set(b.bu_2)) as bu_3
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_7 a
   inner join (
    select
      t1.customer_id
      ,case when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20250101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'SP'
       end as bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP/
      ,sum(cast(regexp_replace(t1.quantity_consumer_units,',','') as bigint)) as quantity_consumer_units  -- 产品销售数量
      ,sum(nvl(cast(regexp_replace(t1.gross_sales_price,',','') as decimal(20,2)),0)) as gross_sales_price -- 销售金额GES
    from dme_ods.s_sap_ke24_sale_info t1
    where t1.ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_sap_ke24_sale_info')
    and ((to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in('857010','857080','845110','845520'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20250101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120'))
     )
    group by t1.customer_id
      ,case when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_10

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_10 as
  select distinct
   a.customer_id,case when upper(a.bu_3) IN ('SKP&SP','SP&SKP') then 'SKP&SP Customer' else concat(a.bu_3,' Customer') end as bu_3
  from(
   select
    customer_id,concat_ws('&',COLLECT_set(bu_2)) as bu_3
   from(
    select
      t1.customer_id
      ,case when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20250101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'SP'
       end  as bu_2  -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP/
      ,sum(cast(regexp_replace(t1.quantity_consumer_units,',','') as bigint)) as quantity_consumer_units  -- 产品销售数量
      ,sum(nvl(cast(regexp_replace(t1.gross_sales_price,',','') as decimal(20,2)),0)) as gross_sales_price -- 销售金额GES
    from dme_ods.s_sap_ke24_sale_info t1
    where t1.ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_sap_ke24_sale_info')
    and ((to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in('857010','857080','845110','845520'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520'))
         or (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20250101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120'))
     )
     group by t1.customer_id
      ,case when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20240101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <'20240101' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8621' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') between '20240101' and '20241231' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'
         when to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>='20250101' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'SP'
       end

   group by customer_id

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu partition(ds)

  ,region           -- 区域Region
  ,region_en        -- 区域英文
  ,province         -- 省份 Province
  ,province_en      -- 省份英文
  ,customer_name_en      -- 客户名称 Customer name EN

  ,customer_grade        -- 客户等级（A/B/C/D)
  ,channel_hierarchy_1   -- 渠道层级第一级

  ,channel_hierarchy_4 --渠道层级第四级
  ,bu_1    -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional

  ,customer_belongto_brand	 -- 客户归属品牌
  ,is_expired_customer	     -- 是否失效客户（是/否）
  ,bu_3 
  --- 渠道转换, 新增最新渠道信息 ----
  ,channel_name_lastest
  ,channel_name2_lastest
  ,region_lastest                -- 区域Region
  ,region_en_lastest             -- 区域英文
  ,province_lastest             -- 省份 Province
  ,province_en_lastest          -- 省份英文
  ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest
  ,channel_hierarchy_2_lastest --渠道层级第二级
  ,channel_hierarchy_3_lastest --渠道层级第三级
  ,channel_hierarchy_4_lastest --渠道层级第四级
  ,customer_group_en_lv1 -- 客户分类Customer Group1(英文)
  ,customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
  ,cooperation_status    -- MPD客户合作状态
  ,nvl(channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道权限字段
  ,case when nvl(channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')='Others'then 'Others_Others'
    else concat(nvl(channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others'),'_',nvl(region_en_lastest,'Others'))
   end as region_customer_Permission -- 客户区域权限字段
  ,City_Name     -- 城市
  ,City_TypeName -- 城市级别
  ,ds
from(
 select
     t1.cn_or_hk               -- CN or HK
     ,t1.customer_code         -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code
     ,t1.channel_name          -- 渠道Channel1
     ,t1.channel_name2         -- 渠道Channel2
     ,t1.customer_group        -- 客户分类Customer Group
     ,decode (t1.customer_group_cn_lv1,'山姆士','山姆会员',t1.customer_group_cn_lv1) as customer_group_cn_lv1  -- 客户分类Customer Group1(中文)
     ,decode (t1.customer_group_cn_lv2,'山姆士','山姆会员',t1.customer_group_cn_lv2) as customer_group_cn_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(中文)
     ,t1.ka_system_en          -- KA system
     ,case when upper(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.region
       end as region           -- 区域Region
     ,case when upper(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.region_en
       end as region_en        -- 区域英文
     ,case when upper(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.province
       end as province         -- 省份 Province
     ,case when upper(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.province_en
       end as province_en      -- 省份英文
     ,t1.City_Name     -- 城市
     ,t1.City_TypeName -- 城市级别
     ,t1.customer_name_en      -- 客户名称 Customer name EN
     ,t1.customer_name         -- 客户名称CN
     ,t1.customer_grade        -- 客户等级（A/B/C/D)
     ,t1.channel_name as channel_hierarchy_1   -- 渠道层级第一级
     ,case when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then nvl(t1.region_en,'Others')
          when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.customer_group
          when UPPER(t1.channel_name) = 'ECOM' then t1.customer_name_en
          else null
        end as channel_hierarchy_2 --渠道层级第二级
     ,case when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then t1.province_en
          when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.customer_name_en
          when UPPER(t1.channel_name) = 'ECOM' then  null
          else null
        end as channel_hierarchy_3 --渠道层级第三级
     ,case when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then t1.customer_name_en
          when UPPER(t1.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','ECOM') then  null
          else  null
        end as channel_hierarchy_4 --渠道层级第四级
     ,t1.bu_1    -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional
     ,t1.bu_2    -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
     ,t1.customer_belongto_brand	 -- 客户归属品牌
     ,t1.is_expired_customer	     -- 是否失效客户（是/否）
     ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') and UPPER(t2.channel_name)='SELECTIVE RETAILER' then nvl(t3.bu_3,concat(t1.bu_2,' Customer'))
         when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') and UPPER(nvl(t2.channel_name,''))<>'SELECTIVE RETAILER' then nvl(t4.bu_3,concat(t1.bu_2,' Customer'))
     end as bu_3
 
     --- 渠道转换, 新增最新渠道信息 ----
     ,t2.channel_name  as channel_name_lastest
     ,t2.channel_name2 as channel_name2_lastest
     ,case when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.region
       end as region_lastest                -- 区域Region
     ,case when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.region_en
       end as region_en_lastest             -- 区域英文
     ,case when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.province
       end as province_lastest             -- 省份 Province
     ,case when upper(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then null
         else t1.province_en
       end as province_en_lastest          -- 省份英文
     ,t2.channel_name  as channel_hierarchy_1_lastest
     ,case when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then nvl(t1.region_en,'Others')
          when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.customer_group
          when UPPER(t2.channel_name) = 'ECOM' then t1.customer_name_en
          else null
        end as channel_hierarchy_2_lastest --渠道层级第二级
     ,case when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then t1.province_en
          when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.customer_name_en
          when UPPER(t2.channel_name) = 'ECOM' then  null
          else null
        end as channel_hierarchy_3_lastest --渠道层级第三级
     ,case when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in('DT','MPD') then t1.customer_name_en
          when UPPER(t2.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','ECOM') then  null
          else  null
        end as channel_hierarchy_4_lastest --渠道层级第四级
     ,t1.customer_group_en_lv1 -- 客户分类Customer Group1(英文)
     ,t1.customer_group_en_lv2 -- 客户分类Customer Group2(英文)
     ,t1.cooperation_status
     ,t1.ds
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_7 t1
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_8 t2 -- 最新渠道信息
  on t1.customer_code=t2.customer_code
  and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_9 t3
 on nvl(t1.customer_group_cn_lv2,'')=nvl(t3.customer_group_cn_lv2,'')
 and t3.bu_3='SKP&SP Customer'
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu_temp_10 t4
 on nvl(t1.customer_code,'')=nvl(t4.customer_id,'')
 and t4.bu_3='SKP&SP Customer'
)

 t1.product_code              -- 产品编码
 ,t1.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
 ,t1.product_name             -- 产品标准名称
 ,t1.product_name_new         -- 产品名称（新）
 ,t1.product_name_en          -- 英文名称
 ,t1.product_abbreviation     -- 产品简称
 ,t1.business_brand           -- 业务品牌
 ,if(nvl(t1.category_name          ,'')='','Others',t1.category_name          ) as category_name            -- 品类
 ,if(nvl(t1.category_name_en       ,'')='','Others',t1.category_name_en       ) as category_name_en         -- 品类英文
 ,if(nvl(t1.brand_name             ,'')='','Others',t1.brand_name             ) as brand_name               -- 品牌
 ,if(nvl(t1.brand_name_en          ,'')='','Others',t1.brand_name_en          ) as brand_name_en            -- 品牌英文
 ,if(nvl(t1.sub_category_name      ,'')='','Others',t1.sub_category_name      ) as sub_category_name        -- 子品类
 ,if(nvl(t1.sub_category_name_en   ,'')='','Others',t1.sub_category_name_en   ) as sub_category_name_en     -- 子品类英文
 ,if(nvl(t1.product_function       ,'')='','Others',t1.product_function       ) as product_function         -- 一级子品类
 ,if(nvl(t1.product_function_en    ,'')='','Others',t1.product_function_en    ) as product_function_en      -- 一级子品类英文
 ,if(nvl(t1.sub_product_function   ,'')='','Others',t1.sub_product_function   ) as sub_product_function     -- 二级子品类
 ,if(nvl(t1.sub_product_function_en,'')='','Others',t1.sub_product_function_en) as sub_product_function_en  -- 二级子品类英文
 ,if(nvl(t1.product_line           ,'')='','Others',t1.product_line           ) as product_line             -- 产品线
 ,if(nvl(t1.product_line_en        ,'')='','Others',t1.product_line_en        ) as product_line_en          -- 产品线英文
 ,case when upper(t1.business_brand) ='SK' then if(t3.product_line is not null,'1','0')
    end as core_product_line        -- 核心产品线
 ,t1.core_product_line as is_core_product_line -- 核心产线(MDM)
 ,t1.product_pack             -- 产品规格
 ,t1.selectable_unit          -- 可选单位
 ,t1.box_size                 -- 箱规
 ,t1.shelf_life               -- 保质期
 ,t1.colour_system            -- 色系
 ,t1.colour_chroma            -- 色度
 ,t1.main_colour_hue          -- 主色调
 ,t1.sub_colour_hue           -- 副色调
 ,t1.product_attribute        -- 产品属性
 ,t1.product_type             -- 产品种类
 ,t1.product_status           -- 产品有效性/状态
 ,t1.product_series           -- 产品系列
 ,t1.product_class            -- 产品分类
 ,t1.product_group            -- 产品组
 ,t1.free_goods_remark        -- 赠品备注
 ,t1.remark                   -- 备注
 ,concat(
    SUBSTR(t1.billing_date,1,4)  -- 年份
    ,'-',CASE WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'.',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\.')[1],2,'0')
            WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'/',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\/')[1],2,'0')
            WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'-',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\-')[1],2,'0')
            ELSE SUBSTR(t1.billing_date,5,2) END -- 月份 
    ,'-',CASE   WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'.',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\.')[2],2,'0')
            WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'/',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\/')[2],2,'0')
            WHEN INSTR(t1.billing_date,'-',1) > 0 THEN LPAD(SPLIT(t1.billing_date,'\\-')[2],2,'0')
            ELSE nvl(SUBSTR(t1.billing_date,7,2),'01') END  -- 日期
      ) as billing_date             -- 开单日期
 ,t1.npd                      -- NPD
 ,t1.relaunch                 -- relaunch
 ,t1.region                   -- 地区
 ,t1.tax_rate                 -- 税率
 ,t1.product_base_price_untax -- 产品基价（不含税）
 ,t1.product_base_price_tax   -- 产品基价（含税）
 ,t1.retail_price_untax       -- 不含税零售价
 ,t1.retail_price_tax         -- 含税零售价
 ,t1.StartDate                -- 开始时间
 ,t1.EndDate                  -- 结束时间
 ,t1.backup_field_1           -- 备用字段1
 ,t1.backup_field_2           -- 备用字段2
 ,t1.modify_time              -- 修改时间
 ,t1.create_time              -- 提交时间
 ,case when upper(t1.business_brand) ='VS' then 'VS'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) in ('L','SK') then 'Consumer'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) in ('SKP','SP') then 'Professional'
   end as bu_1
 ,case when upper(t1.business_brand) ='VS'  then 'VS'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) ='L'   then 'Laundry'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) ='SKP' then 'SKP'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) ='SP'  then 'SP'
       when upper(t1.business_brand) ='SK'  then 'Beauty Care'
   end as bu_2
 ,t0.day_id as ds
from (
   select distinct
     day_id
     ,'1' as flag
   from  dme_cdm.dim_day
   where day_id >= '20200101'
   and   day_id <= '${uddate}'
) t0
join(
    select *,'1' as flag 
        ,row_number()over(partition by product_code order by new_flag desc) as rn
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu_temp_01
) t1
on t0.flag = t1.flag
and t1.rn=1
 --按照业务给定的核心产品线划分规则，判断某个产品是否核心产品
left join  (
    select  brand_name_en
           ,product_line
    from ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_core_product_rule
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_core_product_rule')
 ) t3
 on upper(t1.brand_name_en) = upper(t3.brand_name_en)
 and upper(t1.product_line) = upper(t3.product_line)
 where t1.rn='1'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu PARTITION (ds)
SELECT  cast(null as string) as sequence -- 序列
        ,REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(bcconvert(t.product_code)),'\n|\\t|\\r','')    AS product_code    -- 产品编码
        ,REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(bcconvert(t.product_barcode)),'\n|\\t|\\r','') AS product_barcode -- 产品条码
        ,t.product_name         -- 产品名称
        ,t.product_name_en      -- 英文名称
        ,t.product_abbreviation -- 产品简称
        ,t.category_name        -- 品类
        ,t.category_name_en     -- 品类英文
        ,t.brand_name           -- 品牌
        ,t.brand_name_en        -- 品牌英文
        ,t.product_function_en as product_function  -- 一级子品类(英文)
        ,t.product_line      -- 产品线(中文)
        ,case when nvl(t.bu_2,'')='Beauty Care' then
             case when  t1.product_pack_type is not null then t.product_pack else null end 
            else t.product_pack
          end as product_pack -- 产品包装
        ,t.selectable_unit   -- 可选单位
        ,t.box_size          -- 箱规
        ,t.shelf_life        -- 保质期
        ,t.product_attribute -- 产品属性(1234)
        ,t.product_type      -- 产品种类
        ,t.product_status    -- 产品有效性/状态编码(10)
        ,t.billing_date      -- 开单日期
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.rsp_with_tax IS NOT NULL THEN t1.rsp_with_tax -- 含税零售价
                WHEN t2.retail_price_tax IS NOT NULL THEN t2.retail_price_tax
                WHEN t3.retail_price_tax IS NOT NULL THEN t3.retail_price_tax
                ELSE NULL
        END as retail_price_tax
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.base_price_without_tax IS NOT NULL THEN t1.base_price_without_tax -- 未税基价
                WHEN t2.product_base_price IS NOT NULL THEN t2.product_base_price
                WHEN t3.product_base_price IS NOT NULL THEN t3.product_base_price
                ELSE NULL
        END as product_base_price  -- 产品基价（不含税）
        ,null as dt_standard_price -- DT标准供价（不含税）
        ,null as e_commerce_price  -- 电商供价（不含税）
        ,null as whether_commerce_product -- 是否为电商价格组产品（Y/N）
        ,t.remark          -- 备注
        ,t.colour_system   -- 色系
        ,t.colour_chroma   -- 色度
        ,t.main_colour_hue -- 主色调
        ,t.sub_colour_hue  -- 副色调
        ,if(datediff(to_date(t.ds, 'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t.billing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'dd') < 180,'1','0')as new_product -- 新品
        ,null as premiumisation_product -- 高端化产品
        ,case when t.bu_2 ='Laundry' then '1'
              when t.bu_2 in('SKP','SP','VS') then null
              when (datediff(to_date(t.ds, 'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t.billing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'dd') >=180
              or datediff(to_date(t.ds, 'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t.billing_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd'),'dd') is null
              ) and t.bu_2='Beauty Care' and t.core_product_line ='1' then '1'
        else '0' end as core_product_line
        ,t.sub_product_function_en as sub_product_function -- 二级子品类(英文)
        ,t.business_brand as source_type -- 数据来源
        ,null as category_name_en_sort -- 品类排序字段
        ,null as brand_name_en_sort    -- 品牌排序字段
        ,null as product_line_sort     -- 产品线排序字段
        ,case when nvl(t.bu_2,'')='Beauty Care' then nvl(t1.product_pack_type,t.product_pack)
            else t.product_pack
          end as product_pack_type     -- 产品包装分类
        ,null as product_name_sort     -- SKU排序字段
        ,t.product_pack as product_pack_ori -- 产品包装原始值
        --,if(t.product_class='小样','1','0') as whether_ecom_sample_product -- 是否Ecom标记小样(1是0否)
        ,CASE WHEN t5.product_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS whether_ecom_sample_product
        --,if(upper(t.core_product_line) regexp'是|TRUE','1','0') as whether_ecom_core_product -- 是否Ecom标记核心品(1是0否)
        ,CASE WHEN t4.product_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END as whether_ecom_core_product -- 是否Ecom标记核心品(1是0否)
        ,null as ph5_encoding     -- PH5 编码
        ,null as morphology       -- 形态
        ,null as format           -- Format
        ,null as import_or_not    -- 是否进口
        ,null as countr_of_origin -- 原产国
        ,null as flavo_type       -- 香型
        ,null as y_status         -- Y status/(Y1-Y6)
        ,null as carton_bar_code  -- 外箱条码 barcode
        ,null as length           -- L (MM)
        ,null as width            -- W(MM)
        ,null as height           -- H(MM)
        ,null as volume           -- VOLUME (CDM)
        ,null as gross_weight     -- Gross Weight(KG)
        ,t.bu_1 -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional
        ,t.bu_2 -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP/
        ,null as whether_pro_sample_product    -- 是否专业线mini免费品(1是,0否)
        ,null as old_sp_product_code           -- 老资生堂产品编码
        ,null as sp_product_code               -- 资生堂产品编码
        ,null as original_category_name        -- 品类（原始）
        ,null as original_category_name_en     -- 品类（原始）
        ,null as original_sub_product_function -- 子品类（原始）
        ,t.product_line as product_line_cn     -- 产品线（中文）
        ,t.tax_rate                            -- 税率(计算)
        ,null as is_product_on_sale   -- 产品是否在售(Y|N)
        ,t.free_goods_remark          -- 赠品备注
        ,null as remark_3             -- 备注3
        ,null as old_category_name    -- 旧品类
        ,null as old_category_name_en -- 旧品类Eng
        ,null as mkt_remark           -- MKT 备注
        ,null as original_base_price  -- 原基价
        ,null as original_divide_current_base_price -- 原基价/现基价
        ,null as listing_status       -- 上市状态
        ,t.category_name_en AS category_name_en_orig -- 原始品类英文
        ,t.brand_name       AS brand_name_orig       -- 原始品牌
        ,t.brand_name_en    AS brand_name_en_orig    -- 原始品牌英文
        ,t.product_line_en                           -- 产品线英文
        ,if(t.product_class='小样','小样','Others') as sample_product -- 小样标签    
        ,t.product_function     as product_function_cn     -- 一级子品类中文
        ,t.sub_product_function as sub_product_function_cn -- 二级子品类中文 
        ------ 新增字段 ----
        ,t.npd                      -- NPD
        ,t.relaunch                 -- relaunch
        ,if(upper(t.is_core_product_line) regexp'是|TRUE','1','0') as is_core_product_line     -- 核心品线(MDM)
        ,t.product_class            -- 产品分类
        ,t.sub_category_name        -- 子品类
        ,t.sub_category_name_en     -- 子品类英文
        ,t.product_series           -- 产品系列
        ,t.product_group            -- 产品组
        ,t.backup_field_1           -- 备用字段1
        ,t.backup_field_2           -- 备用字段2
        ,t.ds-- 分区时间
FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu_temp_02 t
 --基于业务提供的规则，对产品包装进行归类
left join (
    select  *
    from    ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_product_pack_hierarchy_rule
    where   ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_product_pack_hierarchy_rule')
   ) t1 -- modify shiwu 20211110 需要添加 品类字段做关联键
    on  t.category_name_en = t1.category_name_en
    and t.product_function_en = t1.product_function
    and t.product_pack = t1.product_pack
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,base_price_without_tax
                        ,data_date
                        ,rsp_with_tax
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price')
            ) t1
ON      t.product_barcode = t1.product_barcode
AND     t.ds = t1.data_date
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_pos_bu_price_his t2
ON      t.product_barcode = t2.product_barcode
AND     SUBSTR(t.ds,1,6) = t2.dt_month
--针对新增月份且迈志也不提供,则用历史备份表25年3月数据
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_pos_bu_price_his t3
on      t.product_barcode = t3.product_barcode
and t3.dt_month ='202503'
LEFT JOIN   (
     SELECT  product_barcode
     FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_core_product_line
     WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_core_product_line')
     GROUP BY product_barcode
 ) t4
ON      t.product_barcode = t4.product_barcode
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu_temp_03 t5
ON t.product_barcode = t5.product_barcode

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu_temp_0001

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu_temp_0001 AS
SELECT  *
FROM    (
            SELECT  DECODE(TRIM(store_code),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,store_code) AS store_code --门店编码
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(store_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,store_name) AS store_name --门店名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(store_address),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,store_address) AS store_address --门店地址
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(province_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,province_name) AS province_name --省份名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(city_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,city_name) AS city_name --城市名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(county_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,county_name) AS county_name --县级市名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(city_level_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,city_level_name) AS city_lv --城市级别名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(channel_type_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,channel_type_name) AS channel_type --渠道类型名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(ka_code),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,ka_code) AS ka_code --KA编码
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(ka_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,ka_name) AS chain_name --KA名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(chain_login_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,chain_login_name) AS chain_login_name --发廊注册名
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(business_area_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,business_area_name) AS business_area --营业面积(㎡)名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(store_category_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,store_category_name) AS store_category --门店分类名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(first_category_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,first_category_name) AS store_category_lv1 --一级分类名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(second_category_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,second_category_name) AS store_category_lv2 --二级分类名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(store_type_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,store_type_name) AS store_type_seg --门店类型名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(wash_protect_qty),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,wash_protect_qty) AS wash_protect_qty --店内洗护货架总节数
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(colour_hair_qty),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,colour_hair_qty) AS colour_hair_qty --店内染发货架总节数
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(model_qty),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,model_qty) AS model_qty --店内造型货架总节数
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(customer_type_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,customer_type_name) AS store_definition --客户类型名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(customer_code),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,customer_code) AS customer_code --客户方代码
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(status_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,status_name) AS store_effective --状态名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(customer_level_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,customer_level_name) AS store_lv --客户等级名称
                    ,DECODE(TRIM(business_model_name),'',NULL,'-',NULL,'/',NULL,business_model_name) AS business_model_name --商业模式
                    ,CASE   WHEN NVL(close_date,'') = '' THEN NULL
                            ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTR(close_date,1,4),-- 年
                           LPAD(
                                CASE    WHEN INSTR(close_date,'/',1,2) - INSTR(close_date,'/',1,1) = 2 THEN SUBSTR(close_date,INSTR(close_date,'/',1,1) + 1,1) ELSE SUBSTR(close_date,INSTR(close_date,'/',1,1) + 1,2) END
                           ,2,'0')
                    ,  -- 月
                           LPAD(
                                TRIM(
                                     SUBSTR(close_date,INSTR(close_date,'/',1,2) + 1,INSTR(close_date,' ') - INSTR(close_date,'/',1,2) - 1)
                                )
                           ,2,'0') -- 日
                           
                    )
                    END AS close_date
                    ,is_deleted AS is_deleted
                    ,'Maizhi' AS data_source
                    ,modify_time
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                    ,store_group_code  --门店分组编码
                    ,store_group_name  --门店分组名称
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_mdm_maizhi
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_mdm_maizhi')
        ) t
WHERE   rn = 1
AND     is_deleted = '0'
AND     store_code NOT IN ('DAIQUEREN','DAIPIPEI')
AND     NVL(store_code,'') <> ''

        ,DECODE(TRIM(province), '', NULL, '-', NULL, province) AS province_name
        ,DECODE(TRIM(city), '', NULL, '-', NULL, city) AS city_name
        ,DECODE(TRIM(county), '', NULL, '-', NULL, county) AS county_name
        ,DECODE(TRIM(city_lv), '', NULL, '-', NULL, city_lv) AS city_lv
        ,DECODE(TRIM(channel_type), '', NULL, '-', NULL, channel_type) AS channel_type
        ,DECODE(TRIM(ka_code), '', NULL, '-', NULL, ka_code) AS ka_code
        ,DECODE(TRIM(ka_name), '', NULL, '-', NULL, ka_name) AS chain_name
        ,'' AS chain_login_name
        ,DECODE(TRIM(business_area), '', NULL, '-', NULL, business_area) AS business_area
        ,DECODE(TRIM(store_category), '', NULL, '-', NULL, store_category) AS store_category
        ,store_category_lv1
        ,store_category_lv2
        ,DECODE(TRIM(store_type_seg), '', NULL, '-', NULL, store_type_seg) AS store_type_seg
        ,DECODE(TRIM(wash_protect_qty), '', NULL, '-', NULL, wash_protect_qty) AS wash_protect_qty
        ,DECODE(TRIM(colour_hair_qty), '', NULL, '-', NULL, colour_hair_qty) AS colour_hair_qty
        ,DECODE(TRIM(model_qty), '', NULL, '-', NULL, model_qty) AS model_qty
        ,DECODE(TRIM(store_definition), '', NULL, '-', NULL, store_definition) AS store_definition
        ,DECODE(TRIM(customer_code), '', NULL, '-', NULL, customer_code) AS customer_code
        ,DECODE(TRIM(status_name), '', NULL, '-', NULL, status_name) AS store_effective
        ,DECODE(TRIM(store_level), '', NULL, '-', NULL, store_level) AS store_level
        ,'' as business_model_name
        ,'' as close_date
        ,'0' AS is_deleted
        ,'手工' as data_source
        , REGEXP_REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time, 1, 10), '-', '') as modify_time
        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) as rn
        ,'' as store_group_code  --门店分组编码
        ,'' as store_group_name  --门店分组名称
FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_mdm
WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_mdm')

    case when ka_code is null or trim(ka_code) = '' then 'Others' else ka_code end as ka_code,

    case when wash_protect_qty is null or trim(wash_protect_qty) = '' then 'Others' else wash_protect_qty end as wash_protect_qty,
    case when colour_hair_qty is null or trim(colour_hair_qty) = '' then 'Others' else colour_hair_qty end as colour_hair_qty,
    case when model_qty is null or trim(model_qty) = '' then 'Others' else model_qty end as model_qty,
    case when store_definition is null or trim(store_definition) = '' then 'Others' else store_definition end as store_definition,
    customer_code,
    case when store_effective is null or trim(store_effective) = '' then 'Others' else store_effective end as store_effective,

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu PARTITION (ds)
SELECT  t.store_code -- '门店编码' 
        ,case when t.store_category in ('ECOM','线上分销') and t.store_effective ='关闭'
        then concat(t.store_name,'(','已关闭',')') else t.store_name end as store_name  --门店名称
        ,t.store_address -- '门店地址'
        ,case when store_category in('批发','线上分销') then store_category
        else nvl(t1.new_henkel_region,'Others') end AS henkel_region -- '汉高区域'
        ,nvl(t.province_name,'Others') as province_name -- '省份'
        ,nvl(t.city_name,'Others')  as city_name -- '城市（标准填报样式：沈阳市，大连市等地级市及以上城市层级'
        ,nvl(t.county_name,'Others') as county_name-- '城市（县级市及以上城市层级）'
        ,nvl(t.city_lv,'Others') as city_lv-- '城市级别'
        ,NULL AS geography_name -- '地理名称---(已下线)---'
        ,t.channel_type -- '渠道类型（连锁/独立）'
        ,t.ka_code -- 'KA编码'
        ,CASE   when t.store_category in ('ECOM','线上分销') then SPLIT_PART(t.chain_name,'-',1)
                WHEN t.ka_code = 'KA0011' AND t4.store_channel IS NOT NULL THEN t4.store_channel
                WHEN t.ka_code = 'KA0011' AND t4.store_channel IS NULL THEN 'Offline'
                ELSE nvl(t5.KA_Name,t.chain_name)
        END AS chain_name -- '连锁名称,屈臣氏为渠道名称'
        ,NULL AS chain_code -- '连锁编码,合并至ka_code---(已下线)---'
        ,t.chain_login_name -- '发廊注册名'
        ,t.business_area -- '营业面积(新）(必须准确填写！！)单位：平方米'
        ,NULL AS area_mt -- '面积维护列---(已下线)---'
        ,t.store_type_seg -- '门店类型细分（Hyper/Super/Mini/CVS/COS/WS/GK/OT)'
        ,NULL AS store_type -- '门店类型,合并至门店类型细分---(已下线)---'
        ,t.wash_protect_qty -- '店内洗护货架总节数（不含端架、二次陈列）'
        ,t.colour_hair_qty -- '店内染发货架总节数（不含端架、二次陈列）'
        ,t.model_qty -- '店内造型货架总节数（不含端架、二次陈列）'
        ,t.store_definition -- '门店定义NKA/LKA/Other'
        ,NULL AS other_cft -- '其他分类---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS other_cft_code -- '其他分类编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS remark_second -- '备注（2）---(已下线)---'
        ,t.customer_code -- '客户方代码（填门店在KA系统的代码，不是汉高代码也不是经销商系统代码，没有可不填）'
        ,NULL AS store_contacts -- '门店联系人---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS store_contacts_phone -- '门店联系人电话---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS distributer_code -- '经销商编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS distributer_name -- '经销商名称---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS distributer_province -- '经销商所在省---(已下线)---'
        ,decode(t.store_effective,'正常','1','0') as store_effective -- '商店有效性'
        ,NULL AS whether_ba -- '是否有BA---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS manager_code -- '负责人编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS post_code -- '岗位编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS store_manager -- '门店负责人---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS manager_org_code -- '负责人组织编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS remark -- '备注(任何信息更新都要写备注！)---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS manager_change_remark -- '负责人变更原因说明---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS whether_distribute_henkel_product -- '是否有分销汉高产品(Y/N)---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS whether_henkel_salesman_cover -- '本月是否汉高业务员覆盖---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS whether_dms_data -- '是否有DMS数据(Y/N)---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS whether_pos_data -- '是否有POS数据（Y/N)---(已下线)---'
        ,t.store_lv -- '门店等级（A/B/C/D）'
        ,case when store_category in('批发','线上分销') then store_category
          when nvl(t2.ka_code,t3.ka_code) is not null then nvl(t2.distributor_region_name,t3.distributor_region_name)
          --当前只有家乐福|永辉|华润万家|大润发涉及KA处大区
          when t.ka_code in('KA0001','KA0003','KA0005','KA0008') and nvl(t2.distributor_region_name,t3.distributor_region_name) is null then 'Others'
          else nvl(t1.new_henkel_region,'Others') end as distributor_region_name --经销商区域
        ,NULL AS must_sales_sku_store -- '必售SKU门店---(已下线)---'
        --,case when store_definition ='NKA' and  t5.nka_system is not null then t5.nka_system 
        --      when store_definition ='NKA' then t.chain_name else null 
        --      end AS nka_customer_name -- 'NKA system'        
        ,case when t.store_definition ='NKA' then nvl(t5.KA_Name_Cn_lv1,t.chain_name)
               else null 
            end AS nka_customer_name -- 'NKA system'
        ,NULL AS sfa_store -- 'SFA门店---(已下线)---'
        --,t6.channel_group AS channel_group -- 'NKA channel group'
        ,t5.KA_Group_Name AS channel_group -- 'NKA channel group'
        ,NULL AS distributor_store_type -- '经销商门店类型---(已下线)---'
        ,t.store_code AS store_oneid -- 'DME门店唯一编码'
        ,NULL AS ba_name -- 'BA姓名---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS phone_num -- 'BA联系方式---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS active_store_id -- '活跃门店ID---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS dealer_store_code -- '经销商处门店编码---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS dealer_store_name -- '经销商处门店名称---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS disconnect_dealer_store_name -- '需要断开连接的经销商处门店名称---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS brand -- '负责品牌(SKP/IND/SP)---(已下线)---'
        ,NULL AS data_type -- '数据类型---(已下线)---'
        ,CASE   WHEN t.store_category = '沙龙' THEN '沙龙'
                ELSE '零售'
        END AS data_type_desc -- '数据类型描述'
        ,t.store_category -- '门店分类'
        ,t.store_category_lv1 -- '门店一级分类'
        ,t.store_category_lv2 -- '门店二级分类'
        --,case when store_category in ('ECOM','线上分销') then nvl(t.customer_code,t.store_code)
        --else null end as ec_store_code_tp
        ,t9.store_code_tp as ec_store_code_tp
        ,business_model_name
        ,close_date
        ,nvl(t8.ec_store_main_brand,'Others') as ec_store_main_brand -- EC店铺主营品牌
        ,store_group_code  --门店分组编码
        ,store_group_name  --门店分组名称
        ,day_id as ds
FROM    (
            SELECT  store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,store_address
                    ,province_name
                    ,city_name
                    ,county_name
                    ,city_lv
                    ,channel_type
                    ,ka_code
                    ,decode(ka_code,'KA0007','沃尔玛山姆会员',chain_name) as chain_name
                    ,chain_login_name
                    ,business_area
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,store_category_lv2
                    ,store_type_seg
                    ,wash_protect_qty
                    ,colour_hair_qty
                    ,model_qty
                    ,store_definition
                    ,customer_code
                    ,store_effective
                    ,store_lv
                    ,business_model_name
                    ,close_date
                    ,store_group_code
                    ,store_group_name
                    ,'1' as flag
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu_temp_0003
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  province_name
                        ,new_henkel_region
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_province_region_change_mapping --省份大区mapping表
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_province_region_change_mapping')

--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: 门店主数据
--功能描述: pos用门店等级
--创建者: andong
--创建日期: 2021-04-13 12:16:00
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--20211213  sfr     代码规范标准化
--20241225  mass    任务启动时间由凌晨5点调整成0点，新增依赖imp_s_master_data_store_store_grade_abnormal_list
--********************************************************************--
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_base

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_base as
select
  t1.ka_name,  --ka名称
  t1.store_code, --门店编码
  t1.months,  --月份
  sale_tax_amt --月销售金额含税
from
  (
    select
      ka_name,
      store_code,
      substr(ds, 1, 6) months,
      sum(sale_tax_amt) sale_tax_amt
    from
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_info
    where
      --当前的处理方式下，是基于alan提供的确定的20年异常销额记录清单做排除，所以写死了日期
      --如果要调整，需要手动上传异常清单，手动修改选取pos数据的日期
      ds >= '20200101'
      and ds < '20210101'
      and store_code is not null
      and store_name is not null
    group by
      ka_name,
      store_code,
      substr(ds, 1, 6)
  ) t1
  left join (
    select
      nka_name,
      store_code,
      months
    from
      ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_store_grade_abnormal_list
    where
      ds = '${bizdate}'
  ) t2 on t1.ka_name = t2.nka_name
  and t1.store_code = t2.store_code
  and t1.months = t2.months
where
  t2.nka_name is null

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--原口径要求使用异常月份前3个月的均值销额来替代
--但考虑到一二三月无法前推三个月，很多月份中间缺少月份，数据上前推三个月意义不大，所以改为排除异常后，取月均销额
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_result

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_result as
select
  ka_name, --ka名称
  store_code,  --门店编码
  months,   --月份
  year_sale_tax_amt, --年销售金额含税
  avg_sale_tax_amt, --月均销售金额含税
  store_grade, --门店等级
  lower_limit, --销额下限
  upper_limit --销额上限
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      ka_name,
      store_code,
      months,
      year_sale_tax_amt,
      avg_sale_tax_amt,
      store_grade,
      lower_limit,
      upper_limit,
      if(
        avg_sale_tax_amt >= lower_limit
        and avg_sale_tax_amt < upper_limit,
        1,
        0
      ) is_store_grade
    from
      (
        select
          1 tmp_join,
          ka_name,
          store_code,
          count(1) months,
          sum(sale_tax_amt) year_sale_tax_amt,
          sum(sale_tax_amt) / count(1) avg_sale_tax_amt
        from
          ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_base
        group by
          ka_name,
          store_code
      ) t1 full
      join (
        select
          1 tmp_join,
          store_grade,
          lower_limit,
          upper_limit
        from
          ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_store_grade_rule
        where
          ds = '${bizdate}'
      ) t2 on t1.tmp_join = t2.tmp_join
  ) t
where
  is_store_grade = 1

  store_grade, --门店等级
  lower_limit, --销售下限
  upper_limit --销售上限
from
  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_store_grade_pos_result

                    ,item_per_store
                    ,nd_sell , -- 数值铺货率
                    total_nd_point
                    ,total_wd_point
            from    dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_fact_info
            where   ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_fact_info')
            union all  --modify by shiwu 手工的这一趴数据可以直接获取
                      -- SK Total =N&E Total + Freshlight Total + Prefect Mousse + Coloe Specialist + Brillance + Men Perfect
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185409728 N&E Total
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185412478 Freshlight Total
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185410850 Prefect Mousse
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185412165 Color Specialist
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185411898 Brillance
                      --P000000000000047014200000000000185412315 SCHWARZKOPF COLORANT MEN
            select  maket_tag_code , -- 对应mkt表
                    'A0000000SKT' as product_tag_code , -- 对应产品表
                    time_tag_code , -- 数据月份
                    cast(sum(sales_units) as string) as sales_units , -- 销售量(1UNIT)
                    cast(sum(sales_volume) as string) as sales_volume , -- 销售量(1Pcs)尼尔森数据需要除以1000，单位为个，报表中的单位为1000
                    cast(sum(sales_value) as string) as sales_value , -- 销售额尼尔森数据需要除以100，单位为元，报表中的单位为1000
                    cast(max(cast(wd_sell as bigint)) as string) as wd_sell , -- 加权铺货率
                    null as price_per_pack
                    ,null as item_per_store
                    ,cast(max(cast(nd_sell as bigint)) as string) as nd_sell , -- 数值铺货率
                    null as total_nd_point
                    ,null as total_wd_point
            from    dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_fact_info
            where   ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_fact_info')
            and     product_tag_code in(
        select product_tag_code
                 from dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info
         where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info')
         and HIER_LEVEL_NUM = '3'  --取品牌层级
         and short_name IN('NATURAL & EASY','FRESHLIGHT','PERFECT MOUSSE','COLOR SPECIALIST','BRILLANCE','SCHWARZKOPF COLORANT MEN')
                    )
            group by  maket_tag_code
                      ,time_tag_code
        ) a
left join  (
              select  time_tag_code
                      ,concat(
                        split_part(long_name ,' ' ,2)
                        ,case   when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'JAN' then '01'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'FEB' then '02'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'MAR' then '03'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'APR' then '04'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'MAY' then '05'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'JUN' then '06'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'JUL' then '07'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'AUG' then '08'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'SEP' then '09'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'OCT' then '10'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'NOV' then '11'
                                when upper(substr(short_name ,1 ,3)) = 'DEC' then '12'
                        end
                      ) as data_month
              from    dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_per_info
              where   ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_per_info')
            ) b
on      a.time_tag_code = b.time_tag_code

       coalesce(b.sub_category_name,c.sub_category_name,'others') as sub_category_name,    -- 子品类
       ''                          as mid_category_name,                          -- 二级子品类 （如有则提取至该字段，没有则置空）
       a.brand_name,                                                              -- 品牌
       sub_brand_name,                                                            -- 产品线
       --20220413 Notes by shiwu 当存在一个品牌下的子品牌出现不同标签时会出现数据重复
       row_number() over(partition by a.product_tag_code,sub_brand_name) rn
     from (
         select
            product_tag_code,  -- 产品标签
            long_name,         -- 全称
            hier_level_num,    -- 层级编号
            hier_level_name,   -- 层级名称
            manufacturer_name, -- 制造商
            brand_name,        -- 品牌
            sub_brand_name     -- 子品牌
         from dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info
         where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info')
         -- 20220413 modify by shiwu 产品信息表保留
         --SK Total =N&E Total + Freshlight Total + Prefect Mousse + Coloe Specialist + Brillance + Men Perfect
         --Colorant的手动补充产品信息 
         union all
         select
            product_tag_code,  -- 产品标签
            long_name,         -- 全称
            null as hier_level_num,    -- 层级编号
            null as hier_level_name,   -- 层级名称
            null as manufacturer_name, -- 制造商
            null as brand_name,        -- 品牌
            null as sub_brand_name     -- 子品牌
         from
            dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_add_info
         where
            ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_add_info')
     ) a
         left join
     (
         select product_tag_code,
                if(sub_category_name='',null,sub_category_name) as sub_category_name
         from dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_mapping_info
         where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_mapping_info')
     ) b on a.product_tag_code = b.product_tag_code
         left join
     (-- 彩染和盖白是通过产品线划分的，产品线的父标签是brand，通过产品线把彩染和盖白划分到brand上
         select 
                if(a.sub_category_name='',null,a.sub_category_name) as sub_category_name,
                b.parent_tag_code
         from dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_mapping_info a
         join dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info b 
         on a.product_tag_code = b.product_tag_code
            and b.ds =  max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_prod_info')
         where a.ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_nielsen_colorant_mapping_info')
         group by
            a.sub_category_name,
            b.parent_tag_code
     ) c on a.product_tag_code = c.parent_tag_code
    ) tt1 where rn = 1
) t1

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nka_pos_sellin_kp_bu partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
     t.years                             as    years             
    ,t.ka                                as    ka            
    ,z.months                            as    months            
    ,'pos'                               as    kp_type          
    ,cast(z.kp_value as decimal(38,10))  as    kp_value
    ,bu
    ,'Direct'   as  supply_type
from 
(       
    select 
        years 
       ,case when  lower(ka) in ('sams','sam','sam\'s')        then 'Sams'
             when  lower(ka) in ('crv')        then 'CRV'
             when  lower(ka) in ('rt','rtmart')        then 'RT'
             when  lower(ka) in ('yh')        then 'YH'
             when  lower(ka) in ('c4','carrefour')        then 'Carrefour'

             when  lower(ka) in ('me','metro')        then 'Metro'

             when  lower(ka) in ('vn','manning\'s','mannings','manning')        then 'Mannings'
             when  lower(ka) in ('sephora')        then 'Sephora'
             when  lower(ka) in ('lirui')        then 'Lirui'
             when  lower(ka) in ('Costco')        then 'Costco'
             else  ka  end   as  ka 
       ,bu       
       ,map( --生成月份和月目标的键值对

          ,concat(years,'04'),aprs

          ,concat(years,'06'),juns

          ,concat(years,'08'),augs

          ,concat(years,'11'),novs
          ,concat(years,'12'),decs

       ,dense_rank() over(partition by years,bu order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn

    from  ${dme_ods}.`s_nka_pos_kp_bu` t1
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_pos_kp_bu')

lateral view explode(kv) z as months,kp_value

	      , t1.npd_idh  as  product_code    --产品sku
          , t2.product_name            --产品名称
          , t2.product_name_en         --英文名称
          , t2.product_abbreviation    --产品简称
          , t2.category_name           --品类
          , t2.category_name_en        --品类英文
          , t2.brand_name              --品牌
          , t2.brand_name_en           --品牌英文
          , t2.product_line            --产品线
          , t2.product_pack            --产品包装
          , t2.product_pack_type       --产品包装分类
          , t2.product_pack_ori        --产品包装原始值
          , case when (concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue)='' 
                  or concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue) is null 
                  or concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue)='.')
                 then 'Others' else concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue) 
                 end   as   colour_hue
          , case when t2.product_function is null or t2.product_function='' then 'Others' 
                 else t2.product_function end as product_function --产品功能/一级子品类
          , case when t2.sub_product_function is null or t2.sub_product_function='' then 'Others' 
                 else t2.sub_product_function end as sub_product_function--二级子品类
          , '${bizdate}'        as  ds
     from ${dme_ods}.s_npd_new_product_list t1
left join dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu t2
       on t1.npd_idh = t2.product_code
      -- and t2.bu_2='Beauty Care'
      and t2.ds = max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
    where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_npd_new_product_list')

--处理offline月份和指标
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp01 as 
select 
          np_name
	   ,product
         ,channel
	   ,replace(channel,'Greater','') as  channel_2   
	   ,case when upper(t.fact)='VALUE SALES(000\'RMB)' then 'Value_Sales_000RMB'
	         when upper(t.fact)='VALUE % SHARE' then 'Value_Share'
	         when upper(t.fact)='SALES UNITS (IN 1000UNIT)' then 'Sales_Units_in_1000UNIT'
			 when upper(t.fact)='PRICE PER KG' then 'Price_Per_kg'
			 when upper(t.fact)='MAX WD' then 'MAX_WD'
			 when upper(t.fact)='AVG ND' then 'AVG_ND'
			 when upper(t.fact)='VAL SIH(MAX WD)' then 'Val_SIH_MAX_WD'
			 when upper(t.fact)='Val SPPD(AVG WD)' then 'Val_SPPD_AVG_WD'
	         else null end   as fact
       ,concat('20',substr(month,-2,2)) as year
       ,case when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='jan' then '01'   
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='feb' then '02'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='mar' then '03'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='apr' then '04'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='may' then '05'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='jun' then '06'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='jul' then '07'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='aug' then '08'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='sep' then '09'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='oct' then '10'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='nov' then '11'  
             when lower(substr(month,1,3)) ='dec' then '12'      
             else null end       as month
	   ,cast(value as decimal(28,6))  as value
   from ${dme_ods}.s_npd_offline_info t
  where t.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_npd_offline_info')
    and t.channel not in ('CVS')

--获取指标
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp02

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp02 as
select
      t.np_name    --np名称
     ,t.product    --产品名称
     ,concat(t.year,t.month)  as monthly  --年月
     ,t.channel    --渠道
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Value_Sales_000RMB' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Value_Sales_000RMB
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Value_Share' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Value_Share
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Sales_Units_in_1000UNIT' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Sales_Units_in_1000UNIT
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Price_Per_kg' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Price_Per_kg
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='MAX_WD' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as MAX_WD
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='AVG_ND' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as AVG_ND
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Val_SIH_MAX_WD' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Val_SIH_MAX_WD
     ,cast(sum(case when t.fact ='Val_SPPD_AVG_WD' then t.value end) as decimal(28,6)) as Val_SPPD_AVG_WD
     ,coalesce(t1.area_en,'Others') as province_en   --省份英文名称	
     ,coalesce(t1.area_ch,'Others')    as province      --省份
     ,coalesce(t3.area_en,'Others')   as region_en     --区域英文名称  
     ,coalesce(t2.new_henkel_region,'Others')      as region        --区域
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp01 t 
left join (select area_en,area_ch,region_en,region_ch from dme_cdm.dim_area_trans
            where ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dim_area_trans')
              and area_type ='province' ) t1
       on lower(trim(t1.area_en)) = lower(trim(t.channel_2))
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_province_region_change_mapping t2
  on  nvl(t1.area_ch,'') = nvl(t2.province_name,'')
  and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_province_region_change_mapping')
left join dme_cdm.dim_area_trans t3
  on lower(trim(t2.new_henkel_region)) = lower(trim(t3.area_ch))
  and t3.area_type = 'area'
  and t3.ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dim_area_trans')
group by t.np_name
     ,t.product
     ,t.channel
     ,concat(t.year,t.month) 
     ,coalesce(t1.area_en,'Others') 
     ,coalesce(t1.area_ch,'Others')    
     ,coalesce(t3.area_en,'Others')    --区域英文名称  
     ,coalesce(t2.new_henkel_region,'Others')          --区域  

union all

select 
          t1.np_name     --np名称
         ,t1.product     --产品名称
         ,t1.monthly     --年月
         ,t1.channel     --渠道
         ,t1.Value_Sales_000RMB
         ,t1.Value_Share
         ,t1.Sales_Units_in_1000UNIT
         ,t1.Price_Per_KG
         ,t1.MAX_WD
         ,t1.AVG_ND
         ,t1.Val_SIH_MAX_WD
         ,t1.Val_SPPD_AVG_WD
         ,t1.province_en     --省份英文名称 
         ,t1.province        --省份
         ,t1.region_en       --区域英文名称
         ,t1.region          --区域
         ,t2.rn-1   as rn    --月份排名
         ,case when t2.rn=1 then 'M' 
               else concat('M+',t2.rn-1)
               end  as month_m  --M月
         ,t3.open_post_date  as open_post_date          --上架月份
         ,t4.tt_date         as tt_date   --上市日期
         ,'${bizdate}'       as ds  
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp02 t1
left join (
          select   a.np_name,a.product,a.monthly
             ,row_number()over(partition by a.np_name,a.product order by a.monthly asc ) as rn
            from (select np_name,product,monthly
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp02
                   group by np_name,product,monthly ) a
          ) t2
      on t1.np_name = t2.np_name
     and t1.product = t2.product
     and t1.monthly = t2.monthly
left join (
          select np_name,min(open_post_date) as open_post_date
            from ${dme_ods}.s_npd_new_product_list
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_npd_new_product_list')
            group by np_name
          ) t3
      on t1.np_name = t3.np_name
left join (select np_name,product,min(monthly) as tt_date
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_offline_info_temp02
           group by np_name,product ) t4
       on t1.np_name = t4.np_name
      and t1.product = t4.product

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_sell_in partition (ds)
select 
      t1.customer_id     --客户id
     ,nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others')  as customer_name  --客户名称
     ,nvl(t3.region,'Others') as henkel_region --汉高大区    
     ,nvl(t3.channel_name,'Others') as customer_channel  --客户渠道 
     ,nvl(t3.channel_name,'Others') as fitst_channel  --第一层级
     ,case when t3.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then t3.region
           when upper(t3.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then (case when t3.customer_group_cn_lv2 like '%大润发%' then 'non-Watsons' else t5.channel_group end ) 
           when t3.channel_name in ('Ecom') then t3.customer_name
           else '未分类' end   as second_channel  --第二层级
     ,case when t3.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then coalesce(t3.customer_name,'未分类')
           when upper(t3.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
           else null end   as third_channel 
     ,case when upper(t3.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
           else concat(t1.customer_id,'-',t3.customer_name) end as npd_customer_name --nka客户名称
     ,t1.sku_id          --产品sku
     ,cast(t1.sku_quantity_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_quantity_amt  --sellin销售数量
     ,cast(t1.sku_ngs_amt  as decimal(28,6))  as sku_ngs_amt  --sellin销售金额
     ,t1.year            --年
     ,t1.month           --年月
     ,t1.dt_date         --年月日
     ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others')    as product_name --产品名字
     ,nvl(t2.product_name_en,'Others') as product_name_en --产品英文名
     ,nvl(t2.product_barcode,'-110')   as product_barcode --产品条形码
     ,nvl(t2.category_name_en, 'Others') as category_name_en --品类代码
     ,nvl(t2.category_name, 'Others') as category_name --品类名称
     ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en, 'Others') as brand_name_en --品牌代码
     ,nvl(t2.brand_name, 'Others')  as brand_name --品牌名称
     ,nvl(t2.product_line,'Others') as product_line          --产品线
     ,nvl(t2.product_function,'Others') as product_function  --一级子品类
     ,nvl(t2.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function   --二级子品类
     ,nvl(t2.product_pack_ori,'Others')  as product_pack_ori        --产品包装原始值
     ,case when (concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue)='' 
            or concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue) is null 
            or concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue)='.')
           then 'Others' else concat(t2.colour_chroma,'.',t2.main_colour_hue) 
            end   as   colour_hue  --色调
     ,case when t4.product_code is not null then '1'
           else '0' end  as is_new_product_flag
        ,t4.np_name   
        ,t4.product_code   
        ,t4.open_post_date
        ,t4.ttm_date 
        ,case when  upper(t3.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then (case when t3.customer_group_cn_lv2 not like '%大润发%' then concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name,'直供',t5.channel_group) else concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name,'直供','non-Watsons') end)
              
              when  t3.channel_name in ('DT') then concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name,'间供') 
              else  t3.channel_name end as new_pro_first_channel
        ,case when t3.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then t3.region
              when upper(t3.channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
              when t3.channel_name in ('Ecom') then t3.customer_name
           else '未分类' end   as new_pro_second_channel
        ,nvl(t2.product_name,'未分类')  as new_pro_thrid_channel 
        
        ,nvl(t3.region_lastest,'Others') as henkel_region_lastest --汉高大区    
        ,nvl(t3.channel_name_lastest,'Others') as customer_channel_lastest  --客户渠道 
        ,nvl(t3.channel_name_lastest,'Others') as fitst_channel_lastest  --第一层级
        ,case when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('DT','MPD') then t3.region_lastest
              when upper(t3.channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then (case when t3.customer_group_cn_lv2 like '%大润发%' then 'non-Watsons' else t5.channel_group end ) 
              when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom') then t3.customer_name
              else '未分类' end   as second_channel_lastest  --第二层级
        ,case when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('DT','MPD') then coalesce(t3.customer_name,'未分类')
              when upper(t3.channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
              else null end   as third_channel_lastest 
        ,case when upper(t3.channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
              else concat(t1.customer_id,'-',t3.customer_name) end as npd_customer_name_lastest --nka客户名称
              
        ,case when  upper(t3.channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then (case when t3.customer_group_cn_lv2 not like '%大润发%' then concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name_lastest,'直供',t5.channel_group) else concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name_lastest,'直供','non-Watsons') end)
              
              when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('DT') then concat_ws('-',t3.channel_name_lastest,'间供') 
              else t3.channel_name_lastest end as new_pro_first_channel_lastest
        ,case when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('DT','MPD') then t3.region_lastest
              when upper(t3.channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_group_cn_lv2
              when t3.channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom') then t3.customer_name
              else '未分类' end                as new_pro_second_channel_lastest 
        ,'${bizdate}'                          as ds 
        
from (
    select
      customer_id,  --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
      product_id as sku_id,  --产品id用于关联dwd_master_data_product_pos
      --cast((round(nvl(gross_sales_price, 0) + nvl(product_promotion_discount, 0) + nvl(product_listing_discount, 0) + nvl(ppd_free_goods, 0),6)) as decimal(28,6)) as sku_ngs_amt, --sell-in销售金额
      cast(sku_ngs_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_ngs_amt, --sell-in销售金额
      nvl(quantity_consumer_units, 0) as sku_quantity_amt,--产品销售数量
      to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy') as year, --年
      concat(to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',quarter(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'))) as quarter,--季度
      to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as month, -- 月份
      to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') as dt_date,
      bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
    where ds >='20210101'
      and to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') <='${bizdate}'  --后期需要调整参数，当前页面只要20年数据，后面调整为进
      and customer_id is not null
      and quantity_consumer_units is not null --观察数据过滤脏数据
      and product_id is not null 
     -- and bu_2 in ('Beauty Care')         
  ) t1
 left join( select *
               from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
              where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
           ) t2
         on t1.sku_id = t2.product_code
 left join(select a.*, substr(a.ds,1,6) as monthly
              from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu a
           where a.ds like '%01' 
            -- and a.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care')         
           ) t3 
		on t1.customer_id = t3.customer_code

       and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_new_product_list t4
       on t1.sku_id = t4.product_code
      and t1.month >= t4.ttm_date
      and t4.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_npd_new_product_list')
left join (
    -- select nka_system, trim(replace(channel_group,'Group','')) as channel_group
    --          from dme_ods.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule
    --         where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule')
    SELECT  ka_name as nka_system,
                ka_group_name as channel_group
    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka
    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
    AND     ka_type_name = 'NKA'
    group by ka_name,
             ka_group_name
) t5
	 on t3.customer_group_cn_lv2 = t5.nka_system

         , case when t2.supply_type_name = '间供' then concat_ws('-',t2.customer_type,t2.supply_type_name)

         , cast(t2.distri_store_plan as bigint )		 as target_store_num   --目标店数
         , case when upper(t2.sell_in_flag)= 'Y' then '1'
                when upper(t2.sell_in_flag)= 'N' then '0'
				end		 as sell_in_flag       --方案卖进(是:1,否:0)
         , case when upper(t2.cust_ccept_flag)= 'Y' then '1'
                when upper(t2.cust_ccept_flag)= 'N' then '0'
                end   	 as cust_ccept_flag    --客户接受方案(是:1,否:0)

                end		as cust_order_flag    --客户下单(是:1,否:0)

         , replace(t2.deadline,'/','') as  deadline
         , t1.open_post_date
         , '${bizdate}'  as ds
     from (select np_name,ttm_date,open_post_date

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_platform_sale_info_temp01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_platform_sale_info_temp01 as
    select   
    t1.platform_name                   as platform_name  --平台名称
    , t1.sales_date                      as sales_date     --销售日期
    , replace(t1.retailer_name,'#N/A','')                   as retailer_name  --零售商(平台)
    , tt.upc_barcode                     as barcode        --UPC条码(平台)
    , t1.product_name                    as product_name   --产品名(平台)
    , t1.retailer_rsp                    as retailer_rsp   --零售商RSP
    , t1.page_price                      as page_price     --页面价
    , t1.sales_qty                       as sales_qty      --销量
    , t1.gmv                             as GMV            --GMV
    , case when t1.province_name like '宁夏%' then '宁夏回族自治区'  
        when t1.province_name like '内蒙古%' then '内蒙古自治区'     
        when t1.province_name like '新疆%' then '新疆维吾尔自治区'
        when t1.province_name like '广西%' then '广西壮族自治区' 
        when t1.province_name like '西藏%' then '西藏自治区'
        when t1.province_name in ('北京','上海','天津','重庆') then concat(t1.province_name,'市')
        when t1.province_name not like '%省' and t1.province_name not like '%市' then concat(t1.province_name,'省')
    else t1.province_name  end        as province_name  --省份
    , t1.city_name                       as city_name      --城市 
    , t2.product_name                   as henkel_product_name      --汉高产品名
    , t2.product_name_en                as henkel_product_name_en   --汉高产品英文名     
    , t2.category_name                  as henkel_category_name     --汉高品类
    , t2.category_name_en               as henkel_category_name_en  --汉高品类英文名称
    , t2.brand_name                     as henkel_brand_name        --汉高品牌
    , t2.brand_name_en                  as henkel_brand_name_en     --汉高品牌英文名
    , t2.sub_product_function           as henkel_sub_product_function --汉高子品类
    , t2.product_line                   as henkel_product_line         --汉高产品线
    , t2.product_pack_ori               as henkel_product_pack_ori     --汉高产品规格
    , t2.retail_price_tax               as henkel_rsp                  --汉高RSP      
    , '手工'                             as data_source                 --数据来源
    , cast(t1.sales_qty*t2.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as GMV2   --GMV(RSP*QTY)
    , t3.k1_retailer_name                as k1_retailer_name            --K1-零售商名称
    , t3.k2_store_name                   as k2_store_name               --K2-门店名称 
    ,COALESCE(t1.bu,t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care') as bu_2
from  (select 
             t1.platform_name                        as platform_name  --平台名称
           , substr(concat(
			split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
		     case when length(split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2))=1
			then concat('0',split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2))
			else split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) end,
            case when length(split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3))=1
			then concat('0',split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3))
			else split_part(replace(replace(t1.sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) end
  		),1,8)                                 as sales_date     --销售日期
           , t1.retailer_name                        as retailer_name  --零售商(平台)
           , case when trim(t1.upc_code) in ('#N/A')  then '-110'
                  else coalesce(t1.upc_code,'-110')  end as upc_code       --UPC条码(平台)
           , t1.product_name                         as product_name   --产品名(平台)
           , cast(t1.retailer_rsp as decimal(28,6))  as retailer_rsp   --零售商RSP
           , cast(t1.page_price as decimal(28,6))    as page_price     --页面价
           , sum(cast(t1.sales_qty as bigint))       as sales_qty      --销量
           , sum(cast(t1.gmv as decimal(28,6)))      as GMV            --GMV
           , t1.province_name                        as province_name  --省份
           , t1.city_name                            as city_name      --城市 
           , t1.k1_code                              as k1_code        --k1
           , t1.k2_code                              as k2_code        --k2
           ,t1.bu
        from ${dme_ods}.s_o2o_platform_sale_info t1        
         where t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_o2o_platform_sale_info') 
       group by t1.platform_name, t1.retailer_name, t1.k1_code , t1.k2_code
               ,t1.bu
               , case when trim(t1.upc_code) in ('#N/A') then '-110'
                  else coalesce(t1.upc_code,'-110')  end  
               , t1.product_name , t1.retailer_rsp, t1.city_name, t1.page_price , t1.province_name
               , substr(concat(
			split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
			case when length(split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2))=1
			then concat('0',split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2))
			else split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) end,
            case when length(split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3))=1
			then concat('0',split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3))
			else split_part(replace(replace(sales_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) end
  		),1,8)
        ) t1 lateral view explode(split(t1.upc_code,',')) tt as upc_barcode
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu t2
       on t1.upc_code = t2.product_barcode
      and t1.sales_date = t2.ds
left join ${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_k1k2_mapping t3
       on t1.k1_code = t3.k1_code
      and t1.k2_code = t3.k2_code
      and t3.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_k1k2_mapping')
    where (length(tt.upc_barcode)=13 or tt.upc_barcode = '-110')
