--合并手工、屈臣氏数据
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp01 as
select   
       t1.channel_name                    as channel_name   --渠道名称
      ,t1.sales_months                    as sales_months   --销售月份 
      ,t1.system_name                     as retailer_name  --零售商名称
      ,t1.region_name                     as region_name    --区域
      ,coalesce(t1.province_name,t2.province_name) as province_name --省份
      ,coalesce(t1.city_name,t2.city_name)    as  city_name --城市
      ,t1.store_code                      as store_code     --KA门店编码
      ,t1.store_name                      as store_name     --KA门店名称
      ,t1.platform_name                   as retailer_platform_name  --零售商平台
      ,t1.product_code                    as product_code   --KA产品编码
      ,t1.product_name                    as product_name   --KA产品名称
      ,t1.henkel_barcode                  as henkel_barcode --汉高编码
      ,t1.sales_qty                       as sales_qty      --销量     
      ,cast(t1.amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as amt_untax     --原始金额(未税)
      ,cast(t1.amt_untax*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as amt_tax  --原始金额(含税)
      ,t2.store_code                      as henkel_store_code --汉高门店编码
      ,t2.store_name                      as henkel_store_name --汉高门店名称
      ,coalesce(t4.product_barcode,t5.product_barcode)  as product_barcode   --产品条码
      ,coalesce(t4.product_name,t5.product_name)        as henkel_product_name      --汉高产品名   
      ,coalesce(t4.product_name_en,t5.product_name_en)  as henkel_product_name_en   --汉高产品英文名
      ,coalesce(t4.category_name,t5.category_name)      as henkel_category_name     --汉高品类
      ,coalesce(t4.category_name_en,t5.category_name_en)   as henkel_category_name_en  --汉高品类英文名称
      ,coalesce(t4.brand_name,t5.brand_name)       as henkel_brand_name        --汉高品牌
      ,coalesce(t4.brand_name_en,t5.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_name_en     --汉高品牌英文名
      ,coalesce(t4.sub_product_function,t5.sub_product_function) as henkel_sub_product_function --汉高子品类
      ,coalesce(t4.product_line,t5.product_line)   as henkel_product_line         --汉高产品线
      ,coalesce(t4.product_pack_ori,t5.product_pack_ori) as henkel_product_pack_ori     --汉高产品规格
      ,cast(coalesce(t4.retail_price_tax,t5.retail_price_tax) as decimal(28,6)) as henkel_RSP --汉高RSP
      ,case when t4.retail_price_tax is not null then cast(t4.retail_price_tax*t1.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) else cast(t5.retail_price_tax*t1.sales_qty as decimal(28,6)) end as GMV  --GMV  
      ,'手工数据' as data_source          --数据来源
      ,t1.dates as dates --日期
      ,null as wts_week --屈臣氏的周，前端TMKTo2o筛选屈臣氏周只展示屈臣氏的数据
      ,null as dist_system_code -- ka编码
      ,t1.system_name as dist_system_name -- ka名称
      ,t1.platform_name as sales_channel   -- 销售渠道            
      ,t1.store_code as dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
      ,t2.store_code as delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
      ,TO_CHAR(date(to_date(concat(t1.sales_months
          ,nvl(lpad(t1.dates,2,'0'),TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(t1.sales_months,'yyyyMM'))),'dd'))
         ),'yyyymmdd')),'yyyyMMdd')  as bill_date -- 交易日期
from (
    select 
              t1.channel_name                    --渠道
             ,concat(t1.year,substr(100+regexp_replace(t1.month,'[^0-9]+',''),2,2)) as  sales_months --月份 
             ,replace(t1.system_name,'#N/A','')  as system_name --系统名称
             ,t1.region_name                     --大区
             ,case when t1.province_name like '宁夏%' then '宁夏回族自治区'  
                   when t1.province_name like '内蒙古%' then '内蒙古自治区'     
                   when t1.province_name like '新疆%' then '新疆维吾尔自治区'
                   when t1.province_name like '广西%' then '广西壮族自治区' 
                   when t1.province_name like '西藏%' then '西藏自治区'
                   when t1.province_name in ('北京','上海','天津','重庆') then concat(t1.province_name,'市')
                   when t1.province_name not like '%省' and t1.province_name not like '%市' and t1.province_name in ('安徽','福建','甘肃','广东','贵州','海南','河北','河南','黑龙江','湖北','湖南'
,'吉林','江苏','江西','辽宁','青海','山东','山西','陕西','四川','云南','浙江') then concat(t1.province_name,'省')
                else t1.province_name  end  as province_name                   --省份
             ,t1.city_name                       --城市
             ,t1.store_code                      --门店编码
             ,t1.store_name                      --门店名称
             ,t1.platform_name                   --零售商平台
             ,replace(t1.product_code,'#N/A','')  as product_code --商品编码sku
             ,t1.product_name                    --客户产品名称
             ,replace(t1.henkel_barcode,'#N/A','')  as henkel_barcode--汉高编码
             ,cast(t1.sales_qty as bigint) as sales_qty   --销售数量
             ,cast(t1.amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as amt_untax --未税金额
             ,'1' as flag
             ,case when length(trim(t1.dates))=1 or length(trim(t1.dates))=2 then trim(t1.dates)
                else concat(if(substr(substr(t1.dates,9,2),1,1)='0','',substr(substr(t1.dates,9,2),1,1)),substr(substr(t1.dates,9,2),2,1)) end as dates 
       from ${dme_ods}.s_o2o_pos_sale_info t1
    where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_o2o_pos_sale_info')
) t1
left join (select * , row_number()over(partition by customer_code,chain_name order by ka_code ) as rk
             from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu 
            where customer_code is not null and chain_name is not null
              and ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')   
          )t2 
       on t1.system_name = t2.chain_name
      and t1.store_code = t2.customer_code
      and t2.rk = 1    
left join (select distinct ka_name,ka_prod_code,henkel_barcode
             from ${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_ka_prod_mapping
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_ka_prod_mapping')
            ) t3
       on t1.system_name = t3.ka_name
      and t1.product_code = t3.ka_prod_code

left join
(
   select *,substr(ds,1,6) as months from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
   where ds >='20200101'
) t4
on trim(t1.henkel_barcode) = trim(t4.product_barcode)
and nvl(concat(t1.sales_months,lpad(cast(dates as string),2,'0')),
    TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(t1.sales_months,'yyyyMM'))),'yyyyMMdd'))
  = t4.ds
left join
(
   select *,substr(ds,1,6) as months from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
   where ds >='20200101'
) t5
on trim(t3.henkel_barcode) = trim(t5.product_barcode)
and nvl(concat(t1.sales_months,lpad(cast(dates as string),2,'0')),
    TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(t1.sales_months,'yyyyMM'))),'yyyyMMdd'))
  = t5.ds
left join (
    select o2o_pos_ka_name,

else t1.sales_months<o2o_pos_start_month  end   -- 关联o2o pos直连表，没匹配到的ka还是走填报，匹配上的ka根据起始月份截取

          , t1.henkel_store_name         as henkel_store_name --汉高门店名称
          , t2.product_barcode           as product_barcode    --产品条码

          , t2.product_name_en           as henkel_product_name_en   --汉高产品英文名
          , t2.category_name             as henkel_category_name     --汉高品类
          , t2.category_name_en          as henkel_category_name_en  --汉高品类英文名称
          , t2.brand_name                as henkel_brand_name        --汉高品牌
          , t2.brand_name_en             as henkel_brand_name_en     --汉高品牌英文名

          , t2.product_line              as henkel_product_line         --汉高产品线

          , cast(t2.retail_price_tax*t1.base_unit_qty as decimal(28,6)) as GMV 
         -- , 'DME-屈臣氏'                 as data_source                 --数据来源
          , concat('DME-',t1.o2o_pos_ka_name)  as data_source          --数据来源
          ,t1.dates as dates --日期
          ,t1.wts_week as wts_week --屈臣氏的周，前端TMKTo2o筛选屈臣氏周只展示屈臣氏的数据
          ,t1.dist_system_code -- ka编码
          ,t1.dist_system_name -- ka名称
          ,t1.sales_channel   -- 销售渠道          
          ,t1.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
          ,t1.delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
          ,t1.bill_date -- 交易日期
     from (select   t1.first_channel_name       --渠道名称
                  , t1.bill_month               --销售日期
                  , t1.o2o_pos_ka_name         --平台名称
                  , t1.dist_region_name         --区域
                  , t1.province_name            --省份
                  , t1.city_name                --城市

                  , t1.dist_store_name          --KA门店名称
                  , t1.dist_prod_code           --KA产品编码
                  , t1.dist_prod_name           --KA产品名称
                  , t1.henkel_prod_barcode      --汉高门店编码
                  , cast(t1.base_unit_qty as bigint) as  base_unit_qty --销量    
                  , cast(t1.original_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as original_amt_untax --原始金额(未税)
                  , cast(t1.original_amt_tax as decimal(28,6))   as original_amt_tax --原始金额(含税)
                  , t1.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
                  , t1.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
                  ,t1.dates 
                  ,t1.wts_week
                  , t1.henkel_prod_code         --汉高sku
                  ,case when t1.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then t1.henkel_store_name
                  else t1.sales_channel end   as retailer_platform_name --销售渠道
                  ,t1.dist_system_code -- ka编码
                  ,t1.dist_system_name -- ka名称
                  ,t1.sales_channel   -- 销售渠道       
                  ,t1.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
                  ,t1.delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
                  ,t1.bill_date -- 交易日期
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_o2o_pos t1
            inner join (
                select o2o_pos_ka_name,
                case when  o2o_pos_ka_name='屈臣氏' and nvl(sales_channel,'') like '%-%' then split_part(sales_channel,'-',1) 
                else sales_channel end sales_channel,
                min(o2o_pos_start_month) as o2o_pos_start_month
                from ${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_pos_direct_connect_pos 
                where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_pos_direct_connect_pos')
                group by o2o_pos_ka_name,
                case when  o2o_pos_ka_name='屈臣氏' and nvl(sales_channel,'') like '%-%' then split_part(sales_channel,'-',1) 
                else sales_channel end
            )  t2 
            on  t1.o2o_pos_ka_name=t2.o2o_pos_ka_name 
            and t1.sales_channel_new=t2.sales_channel 
            and  t1.bill_month>=t2.o2o_pos_start_month  
            where t1.o2o_pos_ka_name is not null
            and t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_o2o_pos')
          ) t1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp02 as
select    
      t1.channel_name             --渠道名称
      , t1.sales_months             --销售日期
      , t1.retailer_name            --零售商名称
      , case when t1.retailer_name like '%华润%' then coalesce(t4.region_name,t1.region_name)
             else t1.region_name  end as region_name              --区域
      , t1.province_name             --省份
      , t1.city_name                --城市
      , case when t1.channel_name = 'NKA' then nvl(t3.ka_group_name,'Others') 
             when t1.channel_name = 'LKA' and t1.retailer_name ='红旗' then '西区'
             when t1.channel_name = 'LKA' then nvl(t1.region_name,'Others')
             else 'Others' end as channel_group --ka渠道分类
      , t1.store_code               --KA门店编码
      , t1.store_name               --KA门店名称
      , t1.retailer_platform_name   --平台名称
      , t1.product_code             --KA产品编码
      , t1.product_name             --KA产品名称
      , t1.henkel_barcode           --汉高门店编码(手工数据)
      , t1.sales_qty                --销量     
      , cast(t1.amt_untax as decimal(28,6))  as  amt_untax --原始金额(未税)
      , cast(t1.amt_tax as decimal(28,6))    as  amt_tax              --原始金额(含税)
      , t1.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
      , t1.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
      , t1.product_barcode          --产品条码
      , t1.henkel_product_name      --汉高产品名    
      , t1.henkel_product_name_en   --汉高产品英文名
      , coalesce(t1.henkel_category_name,'Others')   AS henkel_category_name  --汉高品类
      , coalesce(t1.henkel_category_name_en,'Others')AS henkel_category_name_en  --汉高品类英文名称
      , coalesce(t1.henkel_brand_name,'Others')    AS henkel_brand_name    --汉高品牌
      , coalesce(t1.henkel_brand_name_en,'Others') AS henkel_brand_name_en    --汉高品牌英文名
      , t1.henkel_sub_product_function --汉高子品类
      , t1.henkel_product_line         --汉高产品线
      , t1.henkel_product_pack_ori     --汉高产品规格
      , cast(t1.henkel_RSP as decimal(28,6))  as henkel_RSP       --汉高RSP
      , cast(t1.GMV as decimal(28,6))    as GMV                   --GMV
      , t2.standard_platform_name      --标准平台
      , t2.dashboard_data_type         --看板数据分类
      , t1.data_source                 --数据来源
      ,t1.dates --日期
      ,t1.wts_week --屈臣氏的周
      ,cast(if(t1.GMV=0,null,t1.amt_tax/t1.GMV) as decimal(28,6)) as discount_price_rate --价格折扣率
      ,t1.dist_system_code -- ka编码
      ,t1.dist_system_name -- ka名称
      ,t1.sales_channel    -- 销售渠道  
      ,t1.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
      ,t1.delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
      ,t1.bill_date -- 交易日期
      ,'${bizdate}'  as ds
      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp01 t1
 left join ${dme_ods}.s_tmkt_o2o_platform_mapping t2

--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: 交易域  O2O多点销售表
--功能描述: 数据清洗
--创建者: minqiang
--创建日期: 2021-01-20 21:22:52
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--注意：上月数据存储在当月1号分区
--20211213  sfr     代码规范标准化
--20240403  yyq     ods层表改用数据填报
--20240701  wpf     产品基价使用快照基价
--20241105 xueyang 数值类型精度调整为decimal(28,6)
--20251104  mass 将产品主数据表切换到bu表
--********************************************************************--
insert
  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_sale_info partition (ds,ot)
  --overwrite table dme_cdm_dev.dwd_o2o_sale_info partition (ds,ot)
select
  't005' as ot_code,-- o2o类型编码
  '多点' as ot_name,-- o2o类型名称
  bcconvert(substr(a.monthly,1,6)) as monthly,-- 月份(yyyymm)
  bcconvert(replace(a.sales_date,'-','')) as sales_date,-- 日期(yyyymmdd)
  bcconvert(a.brand_name) as brand_name,-- 品牌名称
  bcconvert(a.category_name) as category_name,-- 品类名称
  bcconvert(a.province_name) as province_name,-- 省份名称
  bcconvert(a.city_name) as city_name,-- 城市名称
  replace(bcconvert(a.barcode),'#N/A','') as item_barcode,-- 商品条形码
  bcconvert(a.item_name) as item_name,-- 商品名称
  cast(a.sales_qty as bigint) as sales_num,-- 销售数量
  cast(
    regexp_replace(a.act_pymt_amt, ',', '') as decimal(28,6)
  ) as sales_amt_tax,-- 销售金额含税
  cast(
    cast(
      regexp_replace(a.act_pymt_amt, ',', '') as decimal(28,6)
    ) / 1.13 as decimal(28,6)
  ) as sales_amt_untax,-- 销售金额未含税
  b.product_base_price as base_price,-- 产品基价
  cast(
    b.product_base_price * cast(a.sales_qty as bigint) as decimal(28,6)
  ) as base_sale_amt,-- 基价销售金额
  b.retail_price_tax,-- 含税零售价
  cast(
    b.retail_price_tax * cast(a.sales_qty as bigint) as decimal(28,6)
  ) as retail_tax_amt,-- 零售价销售金额
  b.product_code as henkel_idh,--汉高idh代码
  b.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,-- 汉高品牌代码
  b.brand_name as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称
  b.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_en,-- 汉高品牌英文名称
  b.category_name_en as henkel_category_code,-- 汉高品类代码
  b.category_name as henkel_category,-- 汉高品类名称
  b.category_name_en as henkel_category_en,-- 汉高品类英文名称
  '50' as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id
  'o2o' as first_channel_name,--一级渠道名称
  null as pri_key,

  to_char(
    DATETRUNC(to_date(replace(add_months(to_date(a.sales_date,'yyyymmdd') , 1),'-',''), 'yyyymmdd'), 'mm'),
    'yyyymmdd'
  ) as ds, --分区月份加一个月，显示下个月第一天

  -- to_char(
  --   DATETRUNC(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), 'mm'),
  --   'yyyymmdd'
  -- ) as ds,
  't005' as ot
from
  ${dme_ods}.s_o2o_dmall_sale_info_all a
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b 
  on a.barcode = b.product_barcode
  and to_char(
    DATETRUNC(to_date(replace(add_months(to_date(a.sales_date,'yyyymmdd') , 1),'-',''), 'yyyymmdd'), 'mm'), 'yyyymmdd'
  ) = b.ds
where
  a.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_o2o_dmall_sale_info_all')

insert

 -- overwrite table dme_cdm_dev.dwd_o2o_sale_info partition (ds, ot)
select
  't001' as ot_code,-- o2o类型编码
  '饿了么' as ot_name,-- o2o类型名称
  --modify by shiwu 20221021 取前6位为月份，手工数据很多填写的都是具体日期
  bcconvert(substr(a.monthly,1,6)) as monthly,-- 月份(yyyymm)
  null as sales_date,-- 日期(yyyymmdd)
  bcconvert(a.sub_brand_name) as brand_name,-- 品牌名称
  bcconvert(b.category_name) as category_name,-- 品类名称
  bcconvert(a.province_name) as province_name,-- 省份名称
  null as city_name,-- 城市名称
  bcconvert(a.item_code) as item_barcode,-- 商品条形码
  bcconvert(b.product_name) as item_name,-- 商品名称
  cast(a.sales_num as bigint) as sales_num,-- 销售数量
  cast(
    regexp_replace(a.item_amt_total, ',', '') as decimal(28,6)
  ) as sales_amt_tax,-- 销售金额含税
  cast(
    cast(
      regexp_replace(a.item_amt_total, ',', '') as decimal(28,6)
    ) / 1.13 as decimal(28,6)
  ) as sales_amt_untax,-- 销售金额未含税
  b.product_base_price as base_price,-- 产品基价
  cast(
    b.product_base_price * cast(a.sales_num as bigint) as decimal(28,6)
  ) as base_sale_amt,-- 基价销售金额
  b.retail_price_tax,-- 含税零售价
  cast(
    b.retail_price_tax * cast(a.sales_num as bigint) as decimal(28,6)
  ) as retail_tax_amt,-- 零售价销售金额
  b.product_code as henkel_idh,--汉高idh代码
  b.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_code,-- 汉高品牌代码
  b.brand_name as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称

  b.category_name as henkel_category,-- 汉高品类名称
  b.category_name_en as henkel_category_en,-- 汉高品类英文名称
  '50' as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id
  'o2o' as first_channel_name,--一级渠道名称
  null as pri_key,
  to_char(
    DATETRUNC(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), 'mm'),
    'yyyymmdd'

  't001' as ot

  on a.item_code = b.product_barcode

  bcconvert(a.item_name) as item_name,-- 商品名称

  d.product_base_price as base_price,-- 产品基价
  cast(

  d.retail_price_tax,-- 含税零售价
  cast(
    d.retail_price_tax * cast(a.app_txn_num as bigint) as decimal(28,6)
  ) as retail_tax_amt,-- 零售价销售金额
  bcconvert(d.product_code) as henkel_idh,--汉高idh代码
  bcconvert(d.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_code,-- 汉高品牌代码
  bcconvert(d.brand_name) as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称

  '50' as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id

--创建者: shuaishuai.ma_datacvg.com(shuaishuai.ma_datacvg.com@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2023-12-26 11:18:57
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_online_sku_detail partition(ds)
 select
    a.year           -- 年
   ,a.month          -- 月
   ,a.channel        -- 平台
   ,a.sub_channel    -- 子平台
   ,a.manufacturer as manufacturer_orig  -- 生产商(原值)
   ,upper(nvl(b.manu,a.manufacturer)) as manufacturer   -- 生产商
   ,a.branden              as brand_orig     -- 品牌英文名称(原值)
   ,upper(nvl(b.brand,a.branden)) as brand          -- 品牌英文名称
   ,a.brandencn                      -- 品牌中文名称
   ,a.variant                as sub_brand_orig -- 子品牌/产品线(原值)
   ,upper(nvl(b.variant,a.variant)) as sub_brand      -- 子品牌/产品线
   ,a.category                       -- 品类
   ,if(B.sku is not null,b.sub_category,'Wrong') as sub_segment    -- 子品类
   ,if(B.sku is not null,b.sub_function,'Wrong')as sub_function   -- 功能/功效
   ,a.sku            -- sku
   ,if(B.sku is not null,b.packsize_range,'Wrong')  as packsize_range -- 一级产品规格
   ,if(B.sku is not null,b.product_mix,'Wrong')   as product_mix    -- 产品组合形式
   ,if(B.sku is not null,b.packsize,'Wrong')       as packsize       -- 二级产品规格
   ,sum(cast(a.val_000 as decimal(38,6)))*1000 as value  -- 销额
   ,sum(cast(a.vol_000 as decimal(38,6)))*1000 as volume -- 销量
   ,'${bizdate}'as ds
 from ${dme_ods}.s_online_rawdata a
 left join (
     select
       sku           -- 产品编码
       ,category     -- 品类
       ,sub_category -- 子品类
       ,sub_function -- 功能/功效
       ,manu         -- 生产商
       ,brand        -- 品牌
       ,variant      -- 子品牌
       ,packsize     -- 二级产品规格
       ,product_mix  -- 产品组合形式
       ,packsize_range -- 一级产品规格
       ,row_number()over(partition by sku,category order by create_time desc,modify_time desc) as rn
     from ${dme_ods}.s_online_coding_mapping
     where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_online_coding_mapping')
  ) B
 on nvl(trim(a.sku),'')=nvl(trim(B.sku),'')
 and nvl(trim(a.category),'')=nvl(trim(B.category),'')
 and B.rn=1
 where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_online_rawdata')
 group by  a.year           -- 年
   ,a.month          -- 月
   ,a.channel        -- 平台
   ,a.sub_channel    -- 子平台
   ,a.manufacturer   -- 生产商(原值)
   ,upper(nvl(b.manu,a.manufacturer))    -- 生产商
   ,a.branden                  -- 品牌英文名称(原值)
   ,upper(nvl(b.brand,a.branden))          -- 品牌英文名称
   ,a.brandencn                      -- 品牌中文名称

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_cnr_data_tmp1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_cnr_data_tmp1 as
---  0382状态数为1 & Ke24没有的单子
select 
     t1.id                     as  id                       --数据填报id
    ,t0.period                 as  period                   --统计日期
    ,substr(t0.period,1,6)     as  period_month             --统计月
    ,t1.sales_organization     as  sales_organization  	    --销售组织
    ,t0.saty                   as  saty                	    --销售凭证类型
    ,cast(t0.on_date AS  datetime)  as  created_date        	    --创建日期
    ,cast(t1.bill_date    AS  datetime)  as  bill_date           	    --账单日期
    ,t0.req_dlv_date as  req_dlv_date        	    --交货日期
    ,t0.sold_to_pt          as  customer_code       	    --客户代码
    ,COALESCE(t2.customer_name,'Others')          as  customer_name      	    --客户名
    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others')    as  first_channel_name      	--一级渠道名
    ,case when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t2.channel_hierarchy_2
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('MPD','DT') then t2.region_en
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')        then  t2.channel_hierarchy_1
          else 'Others' end        as  second_channel_name     	--二级渠道名 

    ,nvl(t0.Document,t1.sales_doc)              as  sales_doc             	--销售单号
    --VA05的Status字段值若为'Not Delivered'，订单状态编码为1，否则订单状态编码为5
    ,case when t99.status = '8' then '8_2'
          else nvl(t1.status,case when upper(t0.status) = 'NOT DELIVERED' then '1' else '5' end) end as  status  --订单状态细分编码
    ,t4.partner_status         as  partner_status        	--订单状态
    ,t4.sub_status             as  sub_status            	--订单子状态
    ,cast(t5.rn AS INT)                               as  consumed_working_days 	--当月已消耗工作日
    ,cast(t3.working_days          AS INT)            as  working_days          	--当月工作日天数
    ,cast(if(upper(t0.SaTy) in ('ZXRE','ZARA'),-1*t0.Net,t0.Net) AS decimal(38,10)) as  net_value             	--净销额
    ,COALESCE(t6.bu_1,'Others') as  bu_1
    ,COALESCE(t6.bu_2,'Others') as  bu_2
    ,t0.Material  as  product_code
    ,t6.product_name   as  product_name
    ,case when  t0.su in ('SHU','BOX') then  cast(t0.order_qty as Bigint) * cast(nvl(if(trim(t6.box_size) in ('','-') ,NULL,trim(t6.box_size)),1) as  bigint) 
          else  cast(t0.order_qty as Bigint)  end    as   order_qty
    -- SU为SHU或BOX时换算为CON的逻辑为Order qty*箱规 SU为CON时换算为SHU的逻辑为Order qty/箱规

    ,cast(nvl(if(trim(t6.box_size) in ('','-') ,NULL,trim(t6.box_size)),1) as  bigint)                       as  box_size

     -- 下月订单：剔除KE24后，Next Month标签为Y的均为下月订单，剩下订单NKA走rdd逻辑，非NKA均为本月订单
    ,case when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  = 'Y' then '下月订单'

          when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.sold_to_pt,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708')))  
               and to_char(to_date(to_char(t0.req_dlv_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') =  substr(t0.period,1,6)  then '当月订单'
          when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y'  and  !(nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.sold_to_pt,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708'))) then '当月订单'
          else NULL end as  order_type

    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') as  first_channel_name_lastest --一级渠道名(最新)
    ,case when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t2.channel_hierarchy_2_lastest
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('MPD','DT') then t2.region_en_lastest
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA') then  t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest

        ,t0.ds
        ,t0.item
        ,sum(if(upper(t0.SaTy) in ('ZXRE','ZARA'),-1,1) * t0.net_value)  as  net_value_comp
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_va05_detail t0
    -- 在0382中的订单： 除了8和8_2，ZVGSPVVG0382根据period、Sales Document去重，去重后STATUS取最小值
    -- 不在0382但在VA05中的订单： VA05的Status字段值若为'Not delivered'，订单状态编码为1，否则订单状态编码为5
    left join
    (
     select *,
        row_number() over(partition by period,sales_doc order by cast(status as bigint),created_date desc) as rnn
      from(
        select *
           -- 不同的BU存在分开上传数据的场景，与BA讨论后去除去重逻辑，业务传数据要保持唯一
            ,dense_rank() over(partition by period order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info 
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info')
        --shiwu  添加此规则,避免业务上传数据的时候上传了空白行,导致代码报错
        and length(period)=8
      )t
      where rn = 1
    ) t1 
    on t0.sales_doc = t1.sales_doc
    and t1.period = t0.period
    and t1.rnn =1
    left join
    (
       select distinct  period,
              sales_doc,
              status,
              count(distinct status) over(partition by sales_doc,period)  as  status_cnt
      from(
        select *
           -- 不同的BU存在分开上传数据的场景，与BA讨论后去除去重逻辑，业务传数据要保持唯一
            ,dense_rank() over(partition by period order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info 
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info')
        --shiwu  添加此规则,避免业务上传数据的时候上传了空白行,导致代码报错
        and length(period)=8
      )t
      where rn = 1
    ) t99
    on t0.sales_doc = t99.sales_doc
    and t0.period = t99.period
    and t99.status_cnt = 1
    left join (
            SELECT
                 status_code                         
                ,partner_status
                ,sub_status
            from
                ${dme_ods}.s_cs_sell_in_order_status_mapping
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_cs_sell_in_order_status_mapping')
            group by
                 status_code                         
                ,partner_status
                ,sub_status
    )t4
    on case when t99.status = '8' and t99.status_cnt = 1 then '8_2'
            else nvl(t1.status,case when upper(t0.status_va05) = 'NOT DELIVERED' then '1' else '5' end) end = t4.status_code
     where t0.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_va05_detail')
     and t0.is_fg = 'N'
     and length(t0.period)=8
     and nvl(t0.Rj,'')=''
     and nvl(cast(t0.Order_qty as bigint),0)<>0
     and t0.status = '8'
     group by  t0.period 
        ,t0.period_month 
        ,t0.sales_organization 
        ,t0.saty 
        ,t0.created_date 
        ,t0.bill_date 
        ,t0.req_dlv_date 
        ,t0.customer_code 
        ,t0.customer_name 
        ,t0.first_channel_name 
        ,t0.second_channel_name 
        ,t0.sales_doc 
        ,case when t99.status = '8' and t99.status_cnt = 1 then '8_2'
              else nvl(t1.status,case when upper(t0.status_va05) = 'NOT DELIVERED' then '1' else '5' end) end  
        ,t4.partner_status          
        ,t4.sub_status              
        ,t0.consumed_working_days 
        ,t0.working_days 
        ,t0.bu_1 
        ,t0.bu_2 
        ,t0.product_code 
        ,t0.product_name 
        ,t0.box_size
        ,t0.remark 
        ,case when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  = 'Y' then '下月订单'
              when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and  (nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.customer_code,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708')))  
                   and to_char(to_date(to_char(t0.req_dlv_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') = to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(substr(t0.period,1,6),'yyyymm'),1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') then '下月订单'
              when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and (nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.customer_code,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708')))  
                   and to_char(to_date(to_char(t0.req_dlv_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') =  substr(t0.period,1,6)  then '当月订单'
              when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y'  and  !(nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t0.first_channel_name,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.customer_code,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708'))) then '当月订单'
              else NULL end
        ,t0.first_channel_name_lastest
        ,t0.second_channel_name_lastest
        ,t0.is_fg
        ,t0.product_base_price
        ,t0.ds
        ,t0.item
)t0
 inner join 
-- status=8_2 ：新增状态2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing，订单范围为0382的status只有8一种状态，且不在ke24中(by sales order+item)，同时报表前端新增2d状态
( 
     SELECT
           t.period_month  as    period_month1
          ,t.period        as    period1
          ,t1.product_id   as    product_id1
          ,t1.order_id     as    order_id1
          ,t1.sales_order_item     as    sales_order_item
          -- ke24的退单数量SAP已经处理成负数，需要转为正值，与va05保持一致
          ,sum(if(upper(t1.billing_type) in ('ZXRE','ZARE'),-1,1) * quantity_consumer_units)   as  order_qty1
          ,sum(cast(sku_ngs_amt  as  decimal(38,10))  )  as    net_value1 
          ,sum(ges)                                      as    ges1
          ,max(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10))             as    posting_date      
          ,sum(cast(if(upper(t1.billing_type) in ('ZXRE','ZARE'),-1,1) * t1.sku_ngs_amt  as  decimal(38,10)))  as  net_value_comp1
      from(
          SELECT
                period, substr(period,1,6) as  period_month
          from
              ${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info
          where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info')
          group by
                period, substr(period,1,6) 
      )t
      inner join (
         SELECT
             *
         from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu_mid t1
         where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu_mid')
         and replace(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'-','') >= '20240701'
      )t1
      on t.period_month = substr(replace(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'-',''),1,6)
      and t.period >= replace(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'-','')
      group by t.period_month  
          ,t.period
          ,t1.product_id
          ,t1.order_id
          ,t1.sales_order_item
)t9
 on t0.product_code=t9.product_id1
and t0.period  = t9.period1
and t0.sales_doc =t9.order_id1
and t0.item =t9.sales_order_item
---daily sales report判断ngs和va05金额大小时，正单和负单要分别比较
where  nvl(t0.net_value_comp,0) > nvl(t9.net_value_comp1,0)

select 
     t1.months  as  monthly                   -- 月份
    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,t22.channel_hierarchy_1,t3.channel_hierarchy_1,t4.channel_hierarchy_1)  as   channel                   -- 渠道
    ,t1.ngs_target
    ,case when upper(t1.bu) in ('VS') then 'VS'
          else 'Professional'  end    as   bu_1
    ,t1.bu              as   bu_2
    ,COALESCE(t2.customer_code,t22.customer_code,'未知')          as   customer_idh 
    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_2,t22.channel_hierarchy_2,t3.channel_hierarchy_2,'未知')          as   sub_channel_name
    ,t1.ges_fg
    ,t1.ges_normal

left join (
    SELECT distinct 
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_2                   --二级渠道

        ,region_en,bu_2
        ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
)t2
 on t1.customer_code = t2.customer_code
and upper(t1.bu) =  upper(t2.bu_2)
and upper(t1.channel) not in ('SR','SELECTIVE RETAILER','NKA')
left join (
    SELECT distinct 
        customer_group_en_lv1   as   customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_group_cn_lv1  as   customer_name
        ,customer_group_en_lv1  as   channel_hierarchy_2                   --二级渠道
        ,channel_hierarchy_1
        ,bu_2
        ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
)t22
 on t1.customer_code = t22.customer_code
and upper(t1.bu) =  upper(t22.bu_2)
and upper(t1.channel) in ('SR','SELECTIVE RETAILER','NKA')
left join (
    SELECT distinct
         channel_hierarchy_2                   --二级渠道
        ,channel_hierarchy_1,bu_2
        ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
     where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
     and  channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD')
)t3
 on upper(t1.customer_code) = upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_2) -- 转化为全大写进行关联，提高兼容性
and upper(t1.channel) =  upper(t3.channel_hierarchy_1)
and upper(t1.bu) =  upper(t3.bu_2)
left join (
    SELECT distinct
          channel_hierarchy_1,bu_2
         ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
)t4
 on upper(t1.customer_code) = upper(t4.channel_hierarchy_1) -- 转化为全大写进行关联，提高兼容性
and upper(t1.bu) =  upper(t4.bu_2)
and upper(t1.channel) =  upper(t4.channel_hierarchy_1)
where t1.months <= substr('${bizdate}',1,6)

   ,t1.bu_1
   ,t1.bu_2
   ,case when t3.channel in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then '未知'
          else t3.customer_idh end  as  customer_idh
   ,case when t3.channel in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_idh 
          else t3.sub_channel end   as   sub_channel_name
   ,cast(sum(case when t1.months >= '202407' then t1.fg end )       as decimal(28,6))      as   ges_fg
   ,cast(sum(case when t1.months >= '202407' then t1.ges - fg end)  as decimal(28,6))     as   ges_normal
from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3 t1
inner join 
(  --取每个月最新一次的预测值作为当月的KP值
    select     
         max(fcst_date)  as   fcst_date        
        ,months,bu_1,bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
      and substr(fcst_date,1,6) <= months --只要当月及之后的月份的预测
      and  months >= '202601'  -- 06月之后取新表
     -- and bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
    group by months,bu_1,bu_2
)t2
on t1.months    = t2.months
and t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
and t1.bu_1 = t2.bu_1
and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
left join
(
    select
        distinct 
         months            
        ,channel_lastest as channel            
        ,customer_idh_lastest as customer_idh ,bu_1,bu_2 
        ,sub_channel_lastest as sub_channel         
    from ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3 
    where channel_lastest in ('Ecom','MPD','DT','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
     -- and bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
) t3 
on t1.customer_idh_lastest = t3.customer_idh
and t1.months = t3.months
and t1.bu_1 = t3.bu_1
and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
and nvl(t3.channel,'Others') <> 'Others'
and t1.is_adj ='N'
--and t1.adj_release = 'N'
--and t1.py_release = 'N'
--and if(t1.months<'202407',t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care',t1.bu_2 in('Beauty Care','Laundry'))
group by t1.months 
       ,t3.channel ,t1.bu_1,t1.bu_2,case when t3.channel in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then '未知'
          else t3.customer_idh end  
   ,case when t3.channel in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t3.customer_idh 
          else t3.sub_channel end

insert
  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info partition (ds)
select
  case when 
    to_char(to_date(substr(posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') ='202308' 
    and customer_id in('703429','708859')
    and product_id in('2933659','2947051','2947460')
  then '2509858'
  else customer_id end as customer_id, -- 客户id
  product_id, -- 产品id
  nvl(t3.product_barcode,'Others') as product_barcode,--产品条码
  nvl(t3.brand_name_en, 'Others') as henkel_brand_code,--汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
  nvl(bcconvert(t3.brand_name), 'Others') as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称
  nvl(bcconvert(t3.brand_name_en), 'Others') as henkel_brand_en,-- 汉高品牌英文名称
  nvl(t3.category_name_en, 'Others') as henkel_category_code,--汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
  nvl(bcconvert(t3.category_name), 'Others') as henkel_category,-- 汉高品类名称
  nvl(bcconvert(t3.category_name_en), 'Others') as henkel_category_en,-- 汉高品类英文名称
  profit_center_id, -- 利润中心id
  plant_id, -- 工厂id
  to_date(substr(posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd') as posting_date, -- 过账日期
  to_date(substr(invoice_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd') as invoice_date, -- 发票日期
  order_id, -- 订单id
  reference_document_id, -- 采购订单id
  cast(
    regexp_replace(quantity_consumer_units, ',', '') as bigint
  ) as quantity_consumer_units, -- 产品销售数量
  cast(
    regexp_replace(quantity_invoiced, ',', '') as bigint
  ) as quantity_invoiced, -- 数量
  cast(
    regexp_replace(gross_sales_price, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as gross_sales_price, -- 销售金额GES
  cast(
    regexp_replace(material_costs, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as material_costs, -- 材料费
  cast(
    regexp_replace(product_promotion_discount, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as product_promotion_discount, -- 临时促销折扣费
  cast(
    regexp_replace(product_listing_discount, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as product_listing_discount, -- 固定促销折扣费
  cast(
    regexp_replace(ppd_free_goods, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as ppd_free_goods, -- 免费品
  cast(
    regexp_replace(l6a_ib_invoice, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as l6a_ib_invoice,
  cast(
    regexp_replace(l6a_ib_area, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as l6a_ib_area,
  cast(
    regexp_replace(product_hirachy_number, ',', '') as bigint
  ) as product_hirachy_number, -- 产品hirachy数
  cast(
    regexp_replace(transportation_invoice, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as transportation_invoice, -- 运输发票
  cast(
    regexp_replace(warehouse_invoice, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as warehouse_invoice, -- 出库发票
  cast(
    regexp_replace(adn_promotion_bonus, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as adn_promotion_bonus, -- 发票激励奖金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(cbn_imp_fund, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as cbn_imp_fund, -- 发票上的合作改善基金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(abf_assortment_bonus, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as abf_assortment_bonus, -- 发票上的产品组合奖金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(abn_assortment_bonus, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as abn_assortment_bonus, -- 发票上的分类奖金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(cbf_imp_fund, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as cbf_imp_fund, -- 发票外合作改善基金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(ecf_process_servic, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as ecf_process_servic, -- 处理发票外服务
  cast(
    regexp_replace(gbf_growth_bonus, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as gbf_growth_bonus, -- 发票外的增长奖金
  cast(
    regexp_replace(hqf_hq_services, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as hqf_hq_services, -- 总部服务发票外
  cast(
    regexp_replace(listing_fees, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as listing_fees, -- 发票上的永久挂牌费
  selling_effort, -- 是否批发商
  terms_payment, -- 发票付款条件
  cast(
    regexp_replace(promotion_bonus_invoice, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as promotion_bonus_invoice, -- 折扣促销发票
  cast(
    regexp_replace(logistics_invoice, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as logistics_invoice, -- 物流发票外
  cast(
    regexp_replace(euf_agreement_bonus, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6)
  ) as euf_agreement_bonus, -- 国际协议奖金折扣发票
  --20230105 modify by shiwu 新增两个字段
  cast(
    regexp_replace(dpf_deduction_provis, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ) as dpf_deduction_provis,
  cast(
    regexp_replace(rpf_returns_provisio, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ) as rpf_returns_provisio,--ROR退货预估
  nvl(cast(
    regexp_replace(ppf_prod_prom_disc, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ),0) as ppf_prod_prom_disc,--价差CA（incl. 清货费OSMI Clearance）
  nvl(cast(
    regexp_replace(lff_prod_listing_fee, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ),0) as lff_prod_listing_fee,--进场费(NKA/DT)
  nvl(cast(
    regexp_replace(fff_flexibility_fund, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ),0) as fff_flexibility_fund,--二次陈列费+海报费+其他（合同外）(NKA/DT)
  nvl(cast(
    regexp_replace(pxf_prod_except_disc, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ),0) as pxf_prod_except_disc,--缺货罚款(NKA),
  to_date(substr(create_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd')  as create_date, -- 创建日期
  created, -- 创建人
  billing_type, -- 计费类型
  case
    when t2.channel_name = 'DT' then '30'
    when t2.channel_name = 'NKA' then '10'
    when t2.channel_name = 'MPD' then '40'
    when t2.channel_name = 'Ecom' then '20'
    when t2.channel_name = 'Others' then '-110'
  end first_channel_id,--一级渠道id
  t2.channel_name as first_channel_name, --一级渠道名称
  -- to_char(DATETRUNC(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as ds
--   to_char(dateadd(DATETRUNC(to_date(case when posting_date like '%-%' then concat('20',split_part(posting_date,'-',3),split_part(posting_date,'-',2),split_part(posting_date,'-',1))
--       else posting_date end, 'yyyymmdd'), 'mm'),1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') ds 
  --  posting_date as ds
  case when a.sales_order is not null then 'Y' else 'N'  end  as  slow_moving, --是否慢流品单，Y-是，N-否
  -- 20220620 shiwu 数据从oss改为数据填报，此处调整,
  t1.Sales_Organization_Code, -- 销售机构代码
  nvl(cast(
    regexp_replace(t1.mark_up_ii, ',', '') as decimal(28, 6) 
  ),0) as mark_up_ii, -- mark_up_ii
  document_num, --20230914 添加document_num 字段
  
  -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 start 20250108 ---
  case
    when t2.channel_name_lastest = 'DT' then '30'
    when t2.channel_name_lastest = 'NKA' then '10'
    when t2.channel_name_lastest = 'MPD' then '40'
    when t2.channel_name_lastest = 'Ecom' then '20'
    when t2.channel_name_lastest = 'Others' then '-110'
  end first_channel_id_lastest,--一级渠道id
  t2.channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest, --一级渠道名称
  -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 end 20250108 ---

  -- 20220620 shiwu 数据从oss改为数据填报，此处调整,
  to_char(to_date(substr(posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') as ds
  --to_char(dateadd(DATETRUNC(to_date(substr(posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'mm'),1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as ds
   
from
  (select *-- ,dense_rank() over(partition by document_num order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn 
      from  ${dme_ods}.s_sap_ke24_sale_info t1
   where  t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_sap_ke24_sale_info')
   -- 只取Beauty care 数据
  and (( to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm')  < '202407' 
    and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8620' 
    and t1.profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110'))
  OR (to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm')  >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(regexp_replace(t1.product_hirachy_number,',',''),1,2),'-') <> '07'))
  -- 过滤创建日期小于当天，且创建日期与上传日期相等的数据
  and !(substr(t1.create_date,1,10) = substr(t1.create_time,1,10) and replace(substr(t1.create_date,1,10),'-','') < '${bizdate1}')
  and to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')  <= '${bizdate}'
  )t1
  left outer join (
  select *,substr(ds,1,6) as month_ from 
  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer 
  where ds  like '%01'
  )t2  
  on t1.customer_id = t2.customer_code
  and to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') = t2.month_
  left outer join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product t3 
  on t1.product_id = t3.product_code
  and t3.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product')
  left join
  (--关联取到慢流品订单
    select distinct months,sales_order
       ,dense_rank() over(partition by months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_profitability_slow_moving_mapping
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_profitability_slow_moving_mapping')
  ) a
  on to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') = a.months
  and cast(t1.order_id as  bigint)= cast(a.sales_order as  bigint)
  and a.rn = 1
-- where t1.rn = 1

       case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')

       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_2,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_2,   --渠道层级第二级
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_3,'Others') as   channel_hierarchy_3,   --渠道层级第三级
       coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_4,'Others') as  channel_hierarchy_4,   --渠道层级第四级	
       t1.l1,        --L1 External sales qt
       t1.l2,        --L2 TOTAL Gross Ext.
       t1.l3,        --L3 Total Net Ext.
       t1.l4,        --L4 Total sales quant
       t1.l5,        --L5 Gross total sales
       t1.l6a,       --L6a Discounts on inv
       t1.total_net, --Total Net 1 (L5-L6a)
       t1.l6b,       --L6b Discounts off in
       t1.l6,        --L6 Discounts
       t1.l9,        --L9 Net total sales
       t1.l10,       --L10 Commissions
       t1.l11,       --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
       t1.l12,       --L12 Material cost
       t1.l13,       --L13 Processing cost
       t1.l14,       --L14 Total manufactur
       t1.quantity_invoiced,  --Quantity invoiced
       t1.l15,       --L15 Product contribu
       t1.l16,       --L16 Additional opera
       cast(l17a1 as decimal(28,2))+cast(l17a2 as decimal(28,2)) as l17a,  --L17a Advertising
       t1.l17a1,     --L17a1 Non-work media 
       t1.l17a2,     --L17a2 Non-work media
       t1.l17b,      --Z0170 Total L17b
       t1.l17c,      --L17c Market Research
       t1.L17d,      --L17d Intercom charge
       t1.l17,       --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
       t1.l18a,      --L18a Gross Profit 1
       t1.l18b,      --L18b Gross Profit 2
       t1.l19,       --L19 Utilization vari
       case when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then nvl(t2.bu_3,'Others') end as bu_3,  -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
       case when t1.sku_id='未分配的'then 'Not assigned' else t1.sku_id end as sku_id,  -- 汉高产品编码
       t1.sku_name,-- 汉高产品名称
 
        -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 start 20250108 ---
        case 
            when t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')
            then null 
            else coalesce(t2.region_en_lastest,'Others') 
            end   
        as region_en_lastest,      --区域英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除
        case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA') 
            then null else coalesce(t2.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en_lastest,    --省份英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除 
        coalesce(t2.channel_name_lastest,'Others')         channel_name_lastest,    --渠道
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,   --渠道层级第一级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_2_lastest,'Others')  channel_hierarchy_2_lastest,   --渠道层级第二级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_3_lastest,'Others') as   channel_hierarchy_3_lastest,   --渠道层级第三级
        coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_4_lastest,'Others') as  channel_hierarchy_4_lastest,   --渠道层级第四级	
        -- 渠道转换需求, 新增最新渠道值 end 20250108 ---
       t1.ship_to_party_code,              -- 送达方（客户编码） 
       t1.ship_to_party_name_en,           -- 送达方（客户名称） 
       t1.ship_to_party   ,                -- 送达方（客户编码+名称） 
       t1.months   as ds  --月份  
from  (select t1.*,
            case when t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110','877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') then 'Consumer'
	             when t1.months < '202401' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','857080','845110','845520') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months>='202401' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'Professional'
	             when t1.months>='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'Professional'
               when t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506' then 'VS'
            else 'Others'    end as bu_1 ,   -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
	        
       case when t1.months < '202407' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110') and t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8620' then 'Beauty Care'
          when (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') <> '07') then 'Beauty Care'
	        when t1.months < '202407' and  (t1.Profit_center_id in ('877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8920' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110')) then 'Laundry'
	        when (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') = '07') then 'Laundry'
	        when t1.months < '202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857010','845110') then 'SKP'
	        when t1.months >='202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('845110') then 'SKP'
	      --  when t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8621' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months < '202401' and t1.Profit_center_id in ('857080','845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520') then 'SP'
          when t1.months >='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120') then 'SP'
          when t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506' then 'VS'
            else 'Others'   end  as bu_2   -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
        from ke30_temp01 t1
        where (t1.months < '202407' and (t1.Profit_center_id in ('877081','877083','878368','878388','878111','878119') 
              or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8920' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110'))
              ) -- 取laundry 数据
          or (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-') = '07') -- 取laundry 数据
          
          -- 取Professional 数据
          or (
            (t1.months < '202401' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857010','857080','845110','845520')) -- 取SKP\SP数据
	          or (t1.months>='202401' and t1.profit_center_id in('845110'))  -- 取SKP数据
	          or (t1.months between '202401' and '202412' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845520'))  -- 取SP数据
	          or (t1.months>='202501' and t1.profit_center_id in ('845120'))  -- 取SP数据
           )
           
          -- 取Beauty Care 数据
          or (
                 (t1.months < '202407' and t1.Sales_Organization_Code='8620' and t1.profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038','841110'))
	          or (t1.months >= '202407' and t1.profit_center_id in ('841110') and nvl(substr(product_code,1,2),'-')  <> '07')
           )
   
           -- 取VS的数据是2025-06-25才进入DME，所以需要限制months>='202506'
           or (t1.profit_center_id in ('841550') and t1.months >= '202506')
     
      --  or (t1.Profit_center_id in ('857034','857035','857037','857038') or (t1.Sales_Organization_Code ='8620' and t1.Profit_center_id='841110'))  -- Beauty Care 数据
       ) t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu t2
       on t1.customer_code= t2.customer_code
      and t1.bu_1 = t2.bu_1
      and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
      and t2.ds like '%01'
      and t1.months = substr(t2.ds,1,6)
      -- and t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
left join (
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,'Laundry' AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry')
       union 
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,bu AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional')
       union
        select
           a.ph5_code as ph5     --ph5编码
           ,b.category_name_en as category   --品类英文
           ,b.brand_name_en as brand         --品牌英文
           ,'Beauty Care' as bu_2
           ,row_number() over(partition by a.ph5_code order by a.priority1+b.priority2 desc) as rn
        from(
          select distinct 
            idh         --idh编码
            ,ph5_code   --ph5编码
            ,ph5_name   --ph5名称
            ,if(ph5_name is null or ph5_name ='',0,1) as priority1
          from dme_ods.s_master_data_product_idh_ph5_mapping 
          where ds = '${bizdate}'
         ) a
        left join(
           select 
            product_code    --产品编码
            ,category_name_en   --品类英文
            ,brand_name_en  --品牌英文
            ,if(category_name_en = 'Others',0,1) + if(brand_name_en = 'Others',0,1) priority2 --品类英文+品牌英文
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu 
           where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
           and bu_2='Beauty Care'
         ) b 
         on a.idh = b.product_code
     ) t3
       on t1.product_code = t3.ph5
       and upper(t1.bu_2)=upper(t3.bu_2)
       and t3.rn=1
  where t1.months >='202101' -- 只取21年及之后的数据

--获取最早粉丝数以及粉丝层级
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_social_content_info_tmp1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_social_content_info_tmp1 as
select * from(
select
    content_id
    ,user_id
    ,fans_number
    ,created_at
    ,update_time
    ,platform
    ,begin_fans
    ,end_fans
    ,kol_tier
    ,case when begin_fans is null and end_fans is not null then concat('0','-',end_fans)
         when begin_fans is not null and end_fans is null then concat(begin_fans,'以上')
         when begin_fans is not null and end_fans is not null then concat(begin_fans,'-',end_fans)
    end as kol_tier_fans,   --判断粉丝层级进行拼接
    row_number() over(partition by content_id,platform order by update_time,created_at,fans_number) rk
from
(select
    t1.content_id
    ,t1.user_id
    ,t1.fans_number
    ,t1.created_at
    ,t1.update_time
    ,t1.platform
    ,case 
    when begin_fans > 999 and begin_fans <= 999999
        then concat(
            case length(begin_fans)
                                when 4 then substr(begin_fans,1,1)
                                when 5 then substr(begin_fans,1,2)
                                when 6 then substr(begin_fans,1,3)
            end
            ,',',substr(begin_fans,length(begin_fans)-2))
    when begin_fans  > 999999 and begin_fans <= 999999999
        then concat(
            case length(begin_fans)
                                when 7 then substr(begin_fans,1,1)
                                when 8 then substr(begin_fans,1,2)
                                when 9 then substr(begin_fans,1,3)
            end
            ,','
            ,substr(begin_fans,length(begin_fans)-5,3)
            ,','
            ,substr(begin_fans,length(begin_fans)-2)
        ) 
        else begin_fans
        end as begin_fans
    ,case when end_fans > 999 and end_fans <= 999999
        then concat(
            case length(end_fans)
                                when 4 then substr(end_fans,1,1)
                                when 5 then substr(end_fans,1,2)
                                when 6 then substr(end_fans,1,3)
            end
            ,',',substr(end_fans,length(end_fans)-2))
    when end_fans  > 999999 and end_fans <= 999999999
        then concat(
            case length(end_fans)
                                when 7 then substr(end_fans,1,1)
                                when 8 then substr(end_fans,1,2)
                                when 9 then substr(end_fans,1,3)
            end
            ,','
            ,substr(end_fans,length(end_fans)-5,3)
            ,','
            ,substr(end_fans,length(end_fans)-2)
        ) 
        else end_fans
        end as end_fans   --新增千分位
    ,case
        when begin_fans is null and fans_number < end_fans then t2.tier_level
        when end_fans is null and fans_number >= begin_fans then t2.tier_level
        when t2.begin_fans is not null and t2.end_fans is not null and  fans_number < t2.end_fans and fans_number >= t2.begin_fans then t2.tier_level
        when fans_number is null and begin_fans is null then t2.tier_level
    end as kol_tier
    ,substr(replace(created_at,'-',''),1,6) as aaaa
from
(select
    content_id
    ,user_id
    ,if(fans_number is null ,0,fans_number) as fans_number
    ,created_at
    ,update_time
    ,platform
from
    ${dme_ods}.s_social_content where ds >='20230414' 
) t1
left join
(select
    platform,
    tier_level,
    cast(replace(begin_fans,',','') as int) as begin_fans,
    cast(replace(end_fans,',','') as int) as end_fans,
    if(begin_month is null,'000000',begin_month) as begin_month,
    if(end_month is null,'999999',end_month) as end_month
from
    ${dme_ods}.s_social_fans_level where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_social_fans_level')
) t2
on tolower(t1.platform) = tolower(t2.platform) and substr(replace(created_at,'-',''),1,6) >= begin_month and substr(replace(created_at,'-',''),1,6) < end_month
) z where kol_tier is not null
) t where rk= 1

insert
  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nka_stock_data_info partition (ds, ka)
select
  uuid() as pri_key,
  'KA0001' as ka_code, -- 二级分类代码
  '家乐福' as ka_name, -- 二级分类中文名称
  'p003' as first_class_code, -- 一级分类代码
  'carrefour' as first_class_name_en, -- 一级分类英文名称
  '家乐福' as first_class_name_cn, -- 一级分类中文名称
  'KA0001' as second_class_code, -- 二级分类代码
  'carrefour' as second_class_name_en, -- 二级分类英文名称
  '家乐福' as second_class_name_cn, -- 二级分类中文名称
  item_code,-- 商品编号
  henkel_item_barcode,-- 汉高商品条形码barcode
  henkel_idh_code,-- 汉高idh编号/汉高产品编号
  item_name,-- 商品名称
  total_stock_num,--库存数量
  total_stock_amt,--库存金额
  product_base_price, --产品基价
  cast(
    product_base_price * total_stock_num as decimal(28, 2)
  ) as base_stock_amt,   --基价库存金额
  distributor_store_code,   --经销商门店编号
  distributor_store_name,   --经销商门店名称
  md_store_code as henkel_store_code,-- 汉高门店编号
  md_store_name as henkel_store_name,-- 汉高门店名称
  henkel_region,    --汉高大区
  dist_region,-- 经销商大区
  province_name,    --省份名称
  city_name,    --城市名称
  brand_name,   --品牌名称
  category_name,    --品类名称
  channel_name, --渠道名称
  retail_name,  --零售商名称
  henkel_product_name,  --汉高产品名称
  henkel_brand_code,    --品牌代码
  henkel_brand, --汉高品牌名称
  henkel_brand_en,  --汉高品牌英文名称
  henkel_category_code, --汉高品类代码
  henkel_category,  --汉高品类名称
  henkel_category_en,   --汉高品类英文名称
  monthly,  --库存月份
  '10' as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id
  'NKA' as first_channel_name,-- 一级渠道名称
  store_oneid as pri_store_code, --外部唯一门店编码
  monthly as ds,
  'KA0001' as ka
FROM (
    select
      bcconvert(a.distributr_product_code) as item_code,-- 商品编号
      bcconvert(a.product_barcode) as henkel_item_barcode,-- 商品条形码
      bcconvert(a.product_code) as henkel_idh_code,-- 汉高idh编号
      bcconvert(a.product_name) as item_name,-- 商品名称
      cast(a.total_stock as bigint) as total_stock_num, --总库存数量
      cast(a.stock_amt as double) as total_stock_amt, --库存金额
      cast(d.product_base_price as double) as product_base_price, --产品基价
      bcconvert(a.distributor_store_code) as distributor_store_code,    --门店编码
      bcconvert(a.distributor_store_name) as distributor_store_name,    --门店名称
      bcconvert(c.store_oneid) as md_store_code,-- 主数据门店编号
      bcconvert(c.store_name) as md_store_name,-- 主数据门店名称
      bcconvert(c.henkel_region) as henkel_region,-- 汉高大区
      bcconvert(c.distributor_region_name) as dist_region,-- 经销商大区
      bcconvert(c.province_name) as province_name,-- 省份名称
      bcconvert(c.city_name) as city_name,-- 城市名称
      bcconvert(d.brand_name) as brand_name,-- 品牌名称
      bcconvert(d.category_name) as category_name,-- 品类名称
      bcconvert(c.chain_name) as channel_name,-- 渠道名称
      null as retail_name,-- 零售商名称
      bcconvert(d.product_name) as henkel_product_name,-- 汉高产品名称
      bcconvert(d.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_code,-- 汉高品牌代码
      bcconvert(d.brand_name) as henkel_brand,-- 汉高品牌名称
      bcconvert(d.brand_name_en) as henkel_brand_en,-- 汉高品牌英文名称
      bcconvert(d.category_name_en) as henkel_category_code,-- 汉高品类代码
      bcconvert(d.category_name) as henkel_category,-- 汉高品类名称
      bcconvert(d.category_name_en) as henkel_category_en,-- 汉高品类英文名称
      c.store_oneid,
      a.monthly as monthly
    from(
        select
          distributr_product_code,
          distributor_store_code,
          distributor_store_name,
          product_barcode,
          product_code,
          product_name,
          sum(total_stock) as total_stock,
          sum(stock_amt) as stock_amt, --经销商库存金额
          monthly
        FROM
          ${dme_ods}.s_inventory_carrefour_stock_info
        where
          ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_inventory_carrefour_stock_info')
          --20220811 modify by shiwu 
          --避免手工数据出现空白行和脏数据
          and length(monthly)=6
        group by
          distributr_product_code,
          distributor_store_code,
          distributor_store_name,
          product_barcode,
          product_code,
          product_name,
          monthly
      ) a 
      left join
    (
        select
          store_code,
          md_store_code,
          md_store_name,
          henkel_region_name,
          store_oneid
        from(
            select
              distributor_store_code as store_code,
              henkel_store_code as md_store_code,
              henkel_store_name as md_store_name,
              henkel_region_name,
              store_oneid,
              row_number() over(
                partition by distributor_store_code
                order by
                  henkel_region_name,
                  store_oneid desc
              ) rn
            from
              ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list
            where
              ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list')
              and nka_system = '家乐福'
            group by
              distributor_store_code,
              henkel_store_code,
              henkel_store_name,
              henkel_region_name,
              store_oneid
          ) bb
        where
          bb.rn = 1
      ) b on a.distributor_store_code = b.store_code
      left join (
        select
          *,substr(ds,1,6) as months
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos
        where ds like '%01'
      ) c 
      on b.store_oneid = c.store_oneid
	  and a.monthly = c.months
      left join 
	  (
	 	 select *,substr(ds,1,6) as months from dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_pos
	 	 where ds >='20200101'
	 	 and 
	 	 (
	 		 ds = TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd'))),'yyyyMMdd')
	 		 or ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos')
	 	 )
	  )
	  d on a.product_barcode = d.product_barcode
	  and a.monthly = d.months
  ) t

--总体规则，模糊匹配，能匹配上的就直接打标

--子功能的打标，存在一个子功能对应多个主功能的情况，这种情况一般出现在主功能可能有一个或多个值为品类值。做如下处理：
----a、先将码表中 子功能:主功能=1:n 的按照品类和主功能,关联打标子功能
----b、再将 子功能:主功能=1:1 的笛卡尔积关联打标子功能
----c、最后将码表中 子功能:主功能=1:n 的与打标结果集按照子功能关联，识别到子功能未打标成功的，过滤码表中主功能值包含品类值得部分，再次笛卡尔积关联打标

--产品规格得打标
--1、将search_kw中'ml'关键字前的数字提取出
--2、将码表产品规格匹配值中'ml'关键字前的数字提取出，且判断做什么比较大于还是小于
--3、双方提取的数字分别按步骤2判断结果做值比较，根据比较结果打标
--4、不包含'ml'关键字的直接做模糊匹配


--dme_ods.s_strategy_center_search_kw 物理主键：concat(nvl(t1.rn,''),nvl(t1.category,''),nvl(t1.search_kw,''),nvl(t1.search_index,''),nvl(t1.search_conversion_rate,''),nvl(t1.monthly,''))

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01 as
select 
     concat(nvl(t1.rn,''),nvl(t1.category,''),nvl(t1.search_kw,''),nvl(t1.search_index,''),nvl(t1.search_conversion_rate,''),nvl(t1.monthly,'')) as  id 
    ,t1.rn                    --排名
    ,t1.category              --品类
    ,t1.search_kw             --搜索词
    ,t1.search_index          --转换人数
    ,t1.search_conversion_rate--搜索转化率
    ,t1.monthly               --月份 
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.brand_matching),'%')                 then  t2.brand_marking                     end           as  tag_brand
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.category                          end           as  tag_category
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.sub_category                      end           as  tag_sub_category
    ,case when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(>)',0)  =  '>'   and lower(t1.search_kw) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.search_kw,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  > cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking  
          when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(<)',0)  =  '<'   and lower(t1.search_kw) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.search_kw,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  < cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking      
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.product_specification_matching),'%') then  t2.product_specification_marking     
          end           as  tag_specifications
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.functions  
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.functions        end           as  tag_product_function
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.subfunction 
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.subfunction      end           as  tag_sub_product_function_split
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.specific_population),'%')            then  t2.specific_population               end           as  tag_crowd
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.component),'%')                      then  t2.component                         end           as  tag_component
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.tone                              end           as  tag_colour_hue
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.color_num                         end           as  tag_colour_number
    ,case when  t3.subfunction is not null then 1 end          as  multi_function_flag
from  
(    select  *  ,1 as join_type
       from dme_ods.s_strategy_center_search_kw  
      where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_strategy_center_search_kw')
)t1
left join 
(
    select 
        brand_marking                        --品牌打标值
        ,brand_matching                       --品牌匹配值
        ,category                             --品类
        ,sub_category                         --子品类
        ,product_specification_marking        --产品规格打标值
        ,product_specification_matching       --产品规格匹配值
        ,case when cnt = 1 then  functions    else NULL end  as  functions                 --功能
        ,case when cnt = 1 then  subfunction  else NULL end  as  subfunction                 --功能
        ,specific_population                  --特定人群
        ,component                            --成分
        ,tone                                 --色调
        ,color_num                            --色号    
        ,1 as join_type  
    from 
       (
           select 
               brand_marking                        --品牌打标值
               ,brand_matching                       --品牌匹配值
               ,category                             --品类
               ,sub_category                         --子品类
               ,product_specification_marking        --产品规格打标值
               ,product_specification_matching       --产品规格匹配值
               ,functions                            --功能
               ,subfunction                          --子功能
               ,specific_population                  --特定人群
               ,component                            --成分
               ,tone                                 --色调
               ,color_num                            --色号    
               ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
           from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
           where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
       )t    
)t2
 on t1.join_type = t2.join_type
left join 
(
    select 
         
         functions                            --功能
        ,subfunction                          --子功能
        ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
)t3
 on t1.category = t3.functions
and t3.cnt > 1
group by t1.rn                    --排名
    ,t1.category              --品类
    ,t1.search_kw             --搜索词
    ,t1.search_index          --转换人数
    ,t1.search_conversion_rate--搜索转化率
    ,t1.monthly               --月份                                                                                     
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.brand_matching),'%')                 then  t2.brand_marking                     end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.category                          end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.sub_category),'%')                   then  t2.sub_category                      end         
    ,case when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(>)',0)  =  '>'   and lower(t1.search_kw) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.search_kw,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  > cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking  
          when regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'(<)',0)  =  '<'   and lower(t1.search_kw) like '%ml%'  and  cast(regexp_extract(t1.search_kw,'([0-9]+)',0) as int)  < cast(regexp_extract(t2.product_specification_matching,'([0-9]+)',0) as int) then t2.product_specification_marking      
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.product_specification_matching),'%') then  t2.product_specification_marking     
          end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.functions  
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.functions        end          
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t3.subfunction),'%')  then  t3.subfunction 
          when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  then  t2.subfunction      end          
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.specific_population),'%')            then  t2.specific_population               end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.component),'%')                      then  t2.component                         end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.tone                              end         
    ,case when lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.color_num),'%')                      then  t2.color_num                         end         
    ,case when  t3.subfunction is not null then 1 end

--子功能:主功能=1:n时，未按照品类打标过的部分，再次看一下在集合（子功能:主功能=1:n）中是否还有可以打上的标

       and functions  not in ('洗护','染发','造型','护理')
) t2
on  t1.join_type = t2.join_type

--子功能:主功能=1:n时，已经按照品类打标过的部分，再次看一下在集合（子功能:主功能=1:n）中是否还有可以打上的标
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_03

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_03 as
select
    t1.id
   ,case when nvl(t1.tag_sub_product_function,'') not like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
          and nvl(t1.multi_function_flag,0) = 1 
          and lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
         then t2.functions else NULL end      as  tag_product_function
   ,case when nvl(t1.tag_sub_product_function,'') not like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%')  
          and nvl(t1.multi_function_flag,0) = 1 
          and lower(t1.search_kw) like concat('%',lower(t2.subfunction),'%') 
         then t2.subfunction else  NULL  end  as  tag_sub_product_function_split
from 
(
    select 
        id
       ,join_type
       ,search_kw
       ,concat_ws(',',collect_set(tag_product_function))            as  tag_product_function
       ,concat_ws(',',collect_set(tag_sub_product_function_split))  as  tag_sub_product_function
       ,max(nvl(multi_function_flag,0))                             as  multi_function_flag
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_02
    group by id
       ,join_type
       ,search_kw
) t1
left join (
    select 
       *  
    from (
       select 
           functions                            --功能
           ,subfunction                          --子功能
           ,1 as join_type
           ,count(distinct functions) over(partition by subfunction)  as cnt
       from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info
       where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_search_kw_codeframes_info')
        )t
     where cnt = 2 
       and functions  not in ('洗护','染发','造型','护理')
) t2
on  t1.join_type = t2.join_type
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_04

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_04 as
select 
  DISTINCT
     t1.rn                    --排名
    ,t1.category              --品类
    ,t1.search_kw             --搜索词
    ,t1.search_index          --转换人数
    ,t1.search_conversion_rate--搜索转化率
    ,t1.monthly               --月份                                                                                
    ,t5.tag_brand--品牌
    ,t3.tag_category--品类
    ,t3.tag_sub_category--子品类
    ,t1.tag_specifications--规格
    ,t2.tag_product_function--功能
    ,t2.tag_sub_product_function_split--子功能
    ,t1.tag_crowd--人群
    ,t1.tag_component--成分
    ,t4.tag_colour_hue--色调
    ,t4.tag_colour_number --色号
from                                                                                             
(                                                                                                
    select
         id    
        ,rn                    --排名
        ,category              --品类
        ,search_kw             --搜索词
        ,search_index          --转换人数
        ,search_conversion_rate--搜索转化率
        ,monthly               --月份
        ,MAX(tag_brand         )  as  tag_brand
        ,MAX(tag_specifications)  as  tag_specifications
        ,MAX(tag_crowd         )  as  tag_crowd
        ,MAX(tag_component     )  as  tag_component
        ,MAX(tag_colour_number )  as  tag_colour_number
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01 t 
    group by id
        ,rn                    --排名
        ,category              --品类
        ,search_kw             --搜索词
        ,search_index          --转换人数
        ,search_conversion_rate--搜索转化率
        ,monthly               --月份
)t1
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_product_function
      ,tag_sub_product_function_split
    from 
    (
    
        select 
            id
           ,tag_product_function
           ,tag_sub_product_function_split
           ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_sub_product_function_split,tag_product_function),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt
        from 
        (
            select 
               id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_02
            group by   id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            
            union all
            
            select 
               id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
            from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_03
            group by   id
               ,tag_product_function
               ,tag_sub_product_function_split
        )t2

     )t
      where cnt =1 
         or (cnt > 1  and  tag_product_function is not null)
)t2
ON t1.id =t2.id
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_category
      ,tag_sub_category
    from 
    (
    
        select 
            id
           ,tag_category
           ,tag_sub_category
           ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_category,tag_sub_category),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt
        from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_sub_category is not null)
)t3
ON t1.id =t3.id
left join (
    select 
       id
      ,tag_colour_hue
      ,tag_colour_number
    from 
    (
       select 
          id
         ,tag_colour_hue
         ,tag_colour_number
         ,count(distinct nvl(concat(tag_colour_hue,tag_colour_number),'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt --色号打上多个标签的，都保留
      from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_colour_number is not null)
)t4
ON t1.id =t4.id
left join (
    select 
    distinct
       id
      ,tag_brand
    from 
    (
       select 
          id
         ,tag_brand
         ,count(distinct nvl(tag_brand,'')) over(partition by id)  as cnt --品牌打上多个标签的，都保留
      from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_strategy_center_search_kw_v2_01
     )t
      where cnt =1 
           or (cnt > 1  and  tag_brand is not null)
)t5
ON t1.id =t5.id

    ,a.customer_name
    ,a.prof_customer_name

    ,a.bu_2

)a

(

   from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
   where substr(day_id,1,6) >  substr('${bizdate}',1,6)

)b 
on case when a.channel is not null then 1  end = b.flag

          else customer_name end           AS    customer_name           
         ,case when customer_group_en_lv1 = 'RT' then customer_group_en_lv2 else customer_group end  as  customer_group
         ,customer_group_cn_lv2
         ,bu_2        
         ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest    AS    customer_type_lastest            
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('Ecom','NKA' ) then channel_hierarchy_1_lastest else region_en_lastest end   AS   region_en_lastest

         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then  customer_group_cn_lv2
          else customer_name end           AS    customer_name_lastest           
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu

      and ds like '%01'
