         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1 ='NKA' then (case when customer_group = 'CRV-Tesco' then 'Tesco' else customer_group end)  else  customer_code end   AS    customer_id           
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1 ='NKA' then  customer_group_cn_lv2
               else customer_name end           AS    customer_name           
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1 ='NKA' then (case when customer_group = 'CRV-Tesco' then 'Tesco' else customer_group end) else  channel_hierarchy_1_lastest end  as  system_name
         ,bu_2         
         ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest    AS    customer_type_lastest     
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('Ecom','NKA' ) then channel_hierarchy_1_lastest else region_en_lastest end   AS   region_lastest 
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest ='NKA' then (case when customer_group = 'CRV-Tesco' then 'Tesco' else customer_group end)  else  customer_code end   AS    customer_id_lastest           
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest ='NKA' then  customer_group_cn_lv2
               else customer_name end           AS    customer_name_lastest           
         ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest ='NKA' then (case when customer_group = 'CRV-Tesco' then 'Tesco' else customer_group end) else  channel_hierarchy_1_lastest end  as  system_name_lastest         
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where nvl(ds,'') <> '' 
      and bu_1 = 'Consumer' 
      and ds like '%01' 
) t2
 on case when tmp.customer_id = 'Watson\'s' then 'Watsons'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'Manning\'s' then 'Mannings'
         when tmp.customer_id in ('Tesco','CRV-Tesco') then 'Tesco'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'METRO' then 'Metro'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'Sam\'s' then 'Sams'
         else tmp.customer_id
         end =t2.customer_id 
and tmp.month = t2.months
and tmp.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
left join( 
   select
         channel
        ,sub_channel
        ,customer_idh
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_lastest
        ,sub_channel_lastest
        ,customer_idh_lastest
        ,customer_name_lastest
        ,months,bu_2
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3  
)b
on tmp.month       = b.months
and case when tmp.customer_id = 'Watson\'s' then 'Watsons'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'Manning\'s' then 'Mannings'
         when Upper(tmp.customer_id) in ('TESCO','CRV-TESCO','WANJIA','HOMECLUB','CRV-SG','CRV-W') then 'CRV'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'METRO' then 'Metro'
         when tmp.customer_id = 'Sam\'s' then 'Sams'
         else tmp.customer_id
         end = b.customer_idh
and tmp.bu_2 = b.bu_2

   ,sum(nvl(c.planned_bdp                    ,0))  as   bdp_balance
   ,sum(nvl(t2.sales_allowance               ,0))  as   sales_allowance                
   ,sum(nvl(t2.collection                    ,0))  as   collection                     
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l6b_expense_claim             ,0))  as   l6b_expense_claim              
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_expense_claim             ,0))  as   l17_expense_claim              
   ,sum(nvl(t2.deduction_l6b_deduction       ,0))  as   deduction_l6b_deduction        
   ,sum(nvl(t2.ror_l6b_ror                   ,0))  as   ror_l6b_ror                    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.expected_product_returns_60d  ,0))  as   expected_product_returns_60d   
   ,sum(nvl(t2.cnwc_ar                       ,0))  as   cnwc_ar                        
   ,sum(nvl(t2.contractual_l6                ,0))  as   contractual_l6                 
   ,sum(nvl(t2.trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda   ,0))  as   trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa     ,0))  as   trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa  
   ,sum(nvl(t2.l10_mark_up_ii   ,0))               as   l10_mark_up_ii    
   ,sum(nvl(t2.pos     ,0))                        as   pos  
   ,t1.bu_1   
   ,t1.bu_2    
   ,sum(nvl(t3.l10_adj                       ,0))  as   l10_adj                     
from 
(
    select distinct t.customer_idh
        ,case when t.customer_idh = '1967491' and t1.fcst_date <= '20230814'  then 'Ecom' else t.channel end as channel
        ,t1.months
        ,t1.years
        ,t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
    from 
    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v2 t
    inner join( 
    select  distinct fcst_date,months,years,channel,bu_2,bu_1
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp_1 
    )t1
    on t.months = substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)
    and t.bu_2 = t1.bu_2
    and case when t.customer_idh = '1967491' and t1.fcst_date <= '20230814'  then 'Ecom' else t.channel end = t1.channel
    
)t1
left join  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp_1 t2
 on t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh 
and t1.months       = t2.months       
and t1.fcst_date    = t2.fcst_date        
and t1.bu_2         = t2.bu_2        
left join  -- 
(  
    select 
        to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')  as  months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,sum(cast(planned_bdp_l10 as decimal))  as   planned_bdp_l10
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata b
    inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v2 t1
    on b.customer_idh = case when t1.channel = 'NKA' then t1.prof_customer_name else t1.customer_idh end
    and t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care' --bdp表不区分B&L,全部数据都在B的客户上
    and to_char(to_date(b.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') = t1.months
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata') 
    group by t1.customer_idh,to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')

)b
on b.customer_idh = t1.customer_idh
and b.months = t1.months
left join  -- 
(  --取AR_BDP表每个月第一天的Planned BDP字段值作为当年度的当月及后续所有月份的fcst			

    select 
        to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')  as  months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,sum(cast(planned_bdp as decimal))  as   planned_bdp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata f
    inner join 
    (
          select 
              to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')         as  months
             ,min(to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'))  as  date
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata
          where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata')
          group by to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')
    
    )g
    on to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') = g.date
    inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v2 t1
    on f.customer_idh = case when t1.channel = 'NKA' then t1.prof_customer_name else t1.customer_idh end
    and t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care' --bdp表不区分B&L,全部数据都在B的客户上
    and to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') = t1.months
    where f.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_bdp_rawdata') 
    group by t1.customer_idh,to_char(to_date(f.date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')

)c
 on c.customer_idh = t1.customer_idh 
and c.months = substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)
and t1.bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
left join 
(
  select                
         fcst_date  
       ,case when upper(trim(channel))='WS' then 'MPD' else channel end as channel                 
       ,case when upper(trim(customer_idh))='V_WS' then 'v_mpd' 
             else customer_idh end as customer_idh  
        ,years                       
        ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                      
        ,cast(l6b_adj  as  decimal)  as l6_b_adj                    
        ,cast(l17_adj  as  decimal)  as l17_adj                    
        ,cast(l10_adj  as  decimal)  as l10_adj                    
        ,row_number() over(partition by fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        ,bu              AS   bu_2 
  from ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling_v2
  where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_adj_sales_controlling_v2')   
)t3
 on nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel) = t3.channel 
and t1.months       = t3.months 
and t1.fcst_date    = t3.fcst_date
and t1.customer_idh = t3.customer_idh
and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
and t3.rn = 1
where (t2.customer_idh is not null 
    or b.customer_idh is not null
    or c.customer_idh is not null
    or t3.customer_idh is not null
    or t1.customer_idh like '%v_%')
group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
   ,nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel)        
   ,t1.months                      
   ,t1.years                       
   ,t1.customer_idh 
   ,t1.bu_1   
   ,t1.bu_2

--- 如果某个渠道存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
--- 先做出每个渠道应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp_title

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp_title as
select distinct
    fcst_date
   ,channel       
   ,non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
   ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
   ,rn
   ,bu_2
from(
    select 
        t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.bu_2          
        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end  as  fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.fcst_date,t1.channel,t1.non_latest,t1.bu_2 order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
    select 
    distinct
         t2.fcst_date  as  fcst_date 
        ,t2.channel       
        ,t2.bu_2       
        ,case when t1.fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
    from  
    ( 
            select 
            distinct
                b.fcst_date  as fcst_date                                                    
               ,a.channel 
               ,a.bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp0 a
            left join 
            (
            select 
                distinct fcst_date,1  as  flag 
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp0
            )b
            on case when a.customer_idh  is not null then 1 end = b.flag
            where b.fcst_date >= a.fcst_date
    )t2
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp0 t1 
        on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
        and t1.channel = t2.channel
        and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    )t1
    left join (
        select 
            distinct fcst_date,channel,bu_2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v2_tmp0 
    )t2
    on t1.channel = t2.channel
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    and t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
)t
where rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_store_recharge_record partition(ds)
select 
     t.id                --主键             
	,recharge_store_app_id          --充值门店的AppId
	,recharge_store_account  --充值门店的账号
	,t1.stand_store_name   AS  store_name     --店铺名                                         -- 店铺名
    ,t1.province             AS  province         --店铺省份                                       -- 店铺省份
    ,t1.city AS  city          --店铺城市
	,customer_uid                   --会员在银豹系统唯一标识
	,recharge_money --充值金额
	,gift_money --充值时赠送的金额
	,`datetime`             --充值时间        
	,pay_method                    --充值时会员所使用的支付方式
	,customer_money_after_recharge --充值后，会员剩余金额
	,t.create_time as created_at   --创建时间                 
	,t.update_time as updated_at --更新时间
	,case when t.`datetime` between t1.open_date and t1.close_date then '1'
         else '0' end as is_store_open_data
	,`datetime` as ds
from  (
    select
   	    henkel_id as id
	   ,app_id        --同recharge_store_app_id                
   	   ,recharge_store_app_id          
   	   ,recharge_store_account         
   	   ,customer_uid                   
   	   ,cast(recharge_money as  decimal(28,6) )  as    recharge_money
   	   ,cast(gift_money  as decimal(28,6)     )  as    gift_money
   	   ,to_char( to_date(substr(`datetime`,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd' )  as  `datetime`                      
   	   ,pay_method                    
   	   ,cast(customer_money_after_recharge as  decimal(28,6)  )  as    customer_money_after_recharge
   	   ,create_time                    
   	   ,update_time                   
       ,row_number() over(partition by app_id,recharge_store_account,customer_uid,`datetime` order by update_time desc) as  rn  --强行去重取唯一
   from ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_recharge_record
    where ds <> ''
)t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  app_id
                        ,stand_store_name
                        ,province
                        ,city
                        ,open_date
                        ,close_date
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_store_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_store_info')
            ) t1
ON      t.app_id = t1.app_id
where t.rn = 1

--创建者: shuaishuai.ma_datacvg.com(shuaishuai.ma_datacvg.com@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2024-03-28 09:47:28
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--20241101  wpf     从20241001号之后,取每月最新门店数据
--202505201 mass    切换数据源：由手工数据切换到maizhi系统推送
--********************************************************************--

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp1 as
select
 store_code       -- 门店编码
 ,cutoff_month    -- 数据cutoff月份
 ,dist_store_nums -- 分销门店数
from(
  select 
    store_code    -- 门店编码
    ,replace(cutoff_month,'-','') as cutoff_month   -- 数据cutoff月份
    ,cast(dist_store_nums as bigint) as dist_store_nums -- 分销门店数
    ,row_number()over(partition by store_code,cutoff_month order by ds desc) as rn
  from ${dme_ods}.s_salon_dist_store_nums_maizhi
  where ds <>''
  and nvl(store_code,'')<>''
)
where rn=1

-- 缺失cutoff月份的数据，用前一个月份数据补充
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp2

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp2 as
 select 
    month_id
    ,max(cutoff_month) as cutoff_month
 from (
    select 
      month_id
      ,'1' flag
    from dme_cdm.dim_day
    where month_id >='202301'
    and month_id <='${bizmonth}'
    group by month_id
 ) a
 left join (
    select 
      substr(cutoff_month,1,6) as cutoff_month
      ,'1' flag
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp1
    group by substr(cutoff_month,1,6)
 ) b
 on a.flag=b.flag
 and a.month_id>=b.cutoff_month
group by month_id

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums partition(ds) 
select
  t1.store_code    -- 门店编码
  ,t1.cutoff_month   -- 数据cutoff月份
  ,case when nvl(t1.dist_store_nums,0)=0 then 1
     else t1.dist_store_nums
    end as dist_store_nums -- 分销门店数
  ,t0.month_id as ds
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp2 t0
inner join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums_tmp1 t1
on t0.cutoff_month=substr(t1.cutoff_month,1,6)

            when if(a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011',a.third_channel_name,coalesce(d.o2o_pos_ka_name,e.o2o_pos_ka_name,f.o2o_pos_ka_name))='银座' and a.dist_region_name in ('东区','中区') then '东区'
                else a.dist_region_name  end as dist_region_name  --区域
            ,a.province_name            --省份
            ,a.city_name                --城市
            ,a.dist_store_code          --KA门店编码
            ,a.dist_store_name          --KA门店名称
            ,a.third_channel_name       --平台名称
            ,a.dist_prod_code           --KA产品编码
            ,a.dist_prod_name           --KA产品名称
            ,a.henkel_prod_code         --汉高sku
            ,a.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
            ,a.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
            ,a.henkel_prod_barcode      --汉高门店编码
            ,a.henkel_region_name       --汉高大区
            ,a.sales_channel            --销售渠道
            ,a.base_unit_qty --销量		 
            ,a.original_amt_untax --原始金额(未税)
            ,a.original_amt_tax --原始金额(含税)
            ,concat(if(substr(substr(a.ds,7,2),1,1)='0','',substr(substr(a.ds,7,2),1,1)),substr(substr(a.ds,7,2),2,1)) as  dates --日期
            ,a.wts_week --屈臣氏周
            ,a.bu_1
            ,a.bu_2
            ,case when a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then a.dist_store_code
                else a.sales_channel end  as sales_channel_new
            ,case when a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then a.third_channel_name
                else coalesce(d.o2o_pos_ka_name,e.o2o_pos_ka_name,f.o2o_pos_ka_name) end as o2o_pos_ka_name
            ,dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
            ,delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
            ,bill_date -- 交易日期
            ,'${bizdate}'  as ds    
    from (
        select a.first_channel_name       --渠道名称
                ,case when a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then c.mapping_time 
                    else substr(a.ds,1,6) end  as bill_month               --销售日期
                ,a.dist_system_code    
                ,a.dist_system_name         --零售商名称
                ,a.dist_region_name         --区域
                ,a.province_name            --省份
                ,a.city_name                --城市
                ,a.dist_store_code          --KA门店编码
                ,a.dist_store_name          --KA门店名称
                ,a.third_channel_name       --平台名称
                ,a.dist_prod_code           --KA产品编码
                ,a.dist_prod_name           --KA产品名称
                ,a.henkel_prod_code         --汉高sku
                ,a.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
                ,a.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
                ,a.henkel_prod_barcode      --汉高门店编码
                ,a.henkel_region_name       --汉高大区
                ,a.sales_channel            --销售渠道
                ,a.base_unit_qty --销量		 
                ,a.original_amt_untax --原始金额(未税)
                ,a.original_amt_tax --原始金额(含税)
                ,a.ds  --日期
                ,case when a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then b.mapping_time
                else null end  as wts_week --屈臣氏周
                ,a.bu_1
                ,a.bu_2
                ,a.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
                ,a.delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
                ,a.ds as bill_date -- 交易日期
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily a 
        left join (
            select time_now,mapping_time
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df 
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df')
            and time_type='D.周'
            and time_now <= concat('${bizdate}','a') 
            group by time_now,mapping_time
        ) b on a.ds=substr(b.time_now,1,8)
        left join (
            select  time_now,mapping_time
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df 
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and
            (
            time_now <= concat('${bizdate}','a') 
            or 
            (substr(time_now,1,6) = substr(concat('${bizdate}','a'),1,6) and length(time_now) = 7)
            )
            and  time_type = 'C.月'
            group by time_now,mapping_time
        )c on a.ds = substr(c.time_now,1,8)
        where a.ds <>''
        and nvl(a.dist_system_code,'') !='KA0007'   --剔除山姆会员

        union all 
        select a.first_channel_name       --渠道名称
                ,a.ds  as bill_month               --销售日期
                ,a.dist_system_code    
                ,a.dist_system_name         --零售商名称
                ,a.dist_region_name         --区域
                ,a.province_name            --省份
                ,a.city_name                --城市
                ,a.dist_store_code          --KA门店编码
                ,a.dist_store_name          --KA门店名称
                ,a.third_channel_name       --平台名称
                ,a.dist_prod_code           --KA产品编码
                ,a.dist_prod_name           --KA产品名称
                ,a.henkel_prod_code         --汉高sku
                ,a.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
                ,a.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
                ,a.henkel_prod_barcode      --汉高门店编码
                ,a.henkel_region_name       --汉高大区
                ,a.sales_channel            --销售渠道
                ,a.base_unit_qty --销量		 
                ,a.original_amt_untax --原始金额(未税)
                ,a.original_amt_tax --原始金额(含税)
                ,null as ds  --日期
                ,null as wts_week --屈臣氏周
                ,a.bu_1
                ,a.bu_2
                ,a.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(真对线上O2O门店有差异)
                ,a.delivery_store_code  -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
                ,TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymm'))),'yyyyMMdd') as bill_date -- 交易日期
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu a 
        where ds <>''
        and data_source='手工报表'
        and nvl(a.dist_system_code,'') !='KA0007' --剔除山姆会员
    ) a 
    left join (
                    select ka_code,province_name,o2o_pos_ka_name
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(province_name,'')) !=0
                    group by ka_code,province_name,o2o_pos_ka_name

             ) d
    on  concat(nvl(a.dist_system_code,''),nvl(case when a.province_name like '%广西%' then '广西'
                                                    when a.province_name='%内蒙古%' then '内蒙'
                                                    when a.province_name='%宁夏%' then '宁夏'
                                                    when a.province_name='%新疆%' then '新疆'
                                                    when a.province_name='%西藏%' then '西藏'
                                                    else  regexp_replace(replace(a.province_name,'Others',''),'省|市','') end,'')
            )=concat(nvl(d.ka_code,''),nvl(d.province_name,''))

    left join (
                    select ka_code,region_name,o2o_pos_ka_name
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(region_name,'')) !=0
                    and length(nvl(province_name,'')) =0
                    group by ka_code,region_name,o2o_pos_ka_name

             ) e
    on  concat(nvl(a.dist_system_code,''),nvl(replace(a.henkel_region_name,'Others',''),''))=concat(nvl(e.ka_code,''),nvl(e.region_name,''))


    left join (
                    select ka_code,o2o_pos_ka_name 
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(province_name,''))=0 
                    and length(nvl(region_name,''))=0
                    group by ka_code,o2o_pos_ka_name
             ) f
    on  nvl(a.dist_system_code,'')=nvl(f.ka_code,'')
    where nvl(a.bu_2,'Beauty Care') IN ('Beauty Care','VS')
    and UPPER(a.first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')

-- 活动分摊后 申请、结案和核销SKU门店信息
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm1

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm1 as
select 
	activity_id,                                    		-- 活动ID
	idh,                              		                -- IDH
	store_code,                                     		-- 门店编码
	sum(apply_amount_tax) apply_amount_tax,					-- 申请金额(含税)
	sum(apply_amount_untax) apply_amount_untax,          	-- 申请金额(未税)
	sum(concluded_amount_tax) concluded_amount_tax,			-- 结案金额(含税)
	sum(concluded_amount_untax) concluded_amount_untax,     -- 结案金额(未税)
	sum(check_amount_tax) check_amount_tax,					-- 核销金额(含税)
	sum(check_amount_untax) check_amount_untax,    			-- 核销金额(未税)		
	sum(flag_apply) flag_apply,                             -- 申请分摊
	sum(flag_concluded) flag_concluded,                     -- 结案分摊
	sum(flag_check) flag_check                              -- 核销分摊
from
(
	-- 活动门店拆分表 对应门店申请信息
	select
		activity_id,                                    -- 活动ID
		idh,                                            -- IDH
		store_code,                                     -- 门店编码
		apply_amount_tax,								-- 申请金额(含税)
		apply_amount_untax,          					-- 申请金额(未税)
		null concluded_amount_tax,						-- 结案金额(含税)
		null concluded_amount_untax,          			-- 结案金额(未税)
	    null check_amount_tax,							-- 核销金额(含税)
	    null check_amount_untax,    					-- 核销金额(未税)		
		flag_apply,
		null flag_concluded,  
		null flag_check 
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_apply_detail
	where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_apply_detail')
	union all
	-- 活动结案门店拆分表 对应门店结案信息
	select 
		activity_id,
		idh,
		store_code,
		null apply_amount_tax,							-- 申请金额(含税)
		null apply_amount_untax,          				-- 申请金额(未税)
		concluded_amount_tax,						    -- 结案金额(含税)
		concluded_amount_untax,          			    -- 结案金额(未税)
	    null check_amount_tax,							-- 核销金额(含税)
	    null check_amount_untax,    					-- 核销金额(未税)		
		null flag_apply,
		flag_concluded,  
		null flag_check 
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_conclusion_detail
	where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_conclusion_detail')
	-- 核销活动门店拆分表 对应门店核销信息
	union all
	select 
		activity_id,
		idh,
		store_code,
		null apply_amount_tax,							-- 申请金额(含税)
		null apply_amount_untax,          				-- 申请金额(未税)
		null concluded_amount_tax,						-- 结案金额(含税)
		null concluded_amount_untax,          		    -- 结案金额(未税)
	    check_amount_tax,							    -- 核销金额(含税)
	    check_amount_untax,    					        -- 核销金额(未税)		
		null flag_apply,
		null flag_concluded,  
		flag_check 		
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_check_detail
	where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_check_detail')
) t 
group by activity_id, idh, store_code

	c.activity_mechanism,												-- 活动机制 英文
	-- 活动机制PPD类型(价格变动申请单)采用活动主表,生意计划表和批复表通过活动明细表关联维表
	case
		when a.type = 'price_deviation' then nvl(a.activity_mechanism,'Others')
		when a.type = 'reply' then f.activity_mechanism_name
		else nvl(f.activity_mechanism_name,'Others') 
	end activity_mechanism_name,										-- 活动机制 名称  活动类型二级
	a.activity_code,            										-- 活动编码
	a.activity_name,            										-- 活动名称
	a.activity_status_code,                   							-- 活动状态 编码
	a.activity_status_name, 											-- 活动状态 名称
	--20250120 只有生意计划表涉及上翻o2o,其他类型置空
	case when a.type ='business_plan' then nvl(e3.display_name,'Others') 
	else null end as bp_upturn_o2o,						-- 上翻O2O
	a.bp_o2o_platform,													-- O2O平台
	a.account_group_code,												-- 活动系统编码
	d.account_group_local_name,					    					-- 活动系统名称 (活动总览 KA)
	g.activity_fee_1,													-- 费用大类   活动费用科目一级
	g.activity_fee_2,													-- 费用类别   活动费用科目二级
	g.activity_fee_3,													-- 费用科目   活动费用科目三级
	c.expense_type_code,                                    			-- 费用科目编码
	-- oneid 计算方式
	-- DT/MPD渠道：活动开始时间-活动结束时间-经销商名称-经销商编码-子系统名称-活动机制
	-- NKA渠道：活动开始时间-活动结束时间-子系统名称（直供）-活动机制
	-- 子系统名称说明：TPM系统中子系统名称若已含'（直供）'，注意不要重复，DT/MPD渠道的价格变动申请单无子系统名称，忽略该字段
	-- 活动机制说明：生意计划表取活动主表活动机制、价格变动申请单取activity_item表活动机制，批复表活动为活动名称
	case 
		when a.channel_code in ('DT','MPD') and e1.display_name = '价格变动申请单'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(j.customer_name,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.customer_code,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_mechanism,'Others'))
		when a.channel_code in ('DT','MPD') and e1.display_name = '生意计划表'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(j.customer_name,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.customer_code,'Others'),'-',nvl(k.sub_account_group_name_cn,'Others'),'-',nvl(f.activity_mechanism_name,'Others'))
		when a.channel_code in ('DT','MPD') and e1.display_name = '批复表'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(j.customer_name,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.customer_code,'Others'),'-',nvl(k.sub_account_group_name_cn,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_name,'Others'))
		when a.channel_code = 'NKA' and e1.display_name = '价格变动申请单'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(replace(k.sub_account_group_name_cn,'（直供）',''),'Others'),'（直供）','-',nvl(a.activity_mechanism,'Others'))
		when a.channel_code = 'NKA' and e1.display_name = '生意计划表'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(replace(k.sub_account_group_name_cn,'（直供）',''),'Others'),'（直供）','-',nvl(f.activity_mechanism_name,'Others'))
		when a.channel_code = 'NKA' and e1.display_name = '批复表'
			then concat(nvl(a.activity_start_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(a.activity_end_date,'Others'),'-',nvl(replace(k.sub_account_group_name_cn,'（直供）',''),'Others'),'（直供）','-',nvl(a.activity_name,'Others'))			
	end oneid,
	a.customer_code,													-- 经销商code 客户编码
	j.channel_name customer_channel,                                    -- 客户渠道
	nvl(j.customer_name,'Others') customer_name,                        -- 客户渠道一级 经销商名称
	concat(nvl(j.customer_name,'Others'),'-',a.customer_code) customer_name_code_connect,
	case 
		when j.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then nvl(j.region,'Others')
	end customer_region,                          						-- 客户区域（中文）
	case 			
		when j.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then nvl(j.province,'Others')			
	end customer_province,                      						-- 客户省份（中文）
	nvl(j.channel_name,'Others') customer_channel_name_1,   			-- 客户渠道一级
	case 			
		when j.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then j.region			
		when j.channel_name = 'NKA' then j.customer_name			
		else 'Others'			
	end customer_channel_name_2,  										-- 客户渠道二级
	case 			
		when j.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then j.province			
		when j.channel_name = 'NKA' then NULL			
		else 'Others'			
	end customer_channel_name_3,  										-- 客户渠道三级
	case 			
		when j.channel_name in ('DT','MPD') then j.customer_name			
		when j.channel_name = 'NKA' then NULL			
		else 'Others'			
	end customer_channel_name_4,  										-- 客户渠道四级
	b.idh,                                         	    				-- idh
	CONCAT(i.product_name, '-', i.product_barcode) sku,					-- 产品名称-产品条码
	i.product_barcode,                    								-- 产品条码 Barcode
	i.product_name,                                         			-- 产品名称（中文）
	i.category_name,                                        			-- 品类（中文）
	i.category_name_2,                                      			-- 一级子品类
	i.category_name_3,                                      			-- 二级子品类
	i.brand_name,                                           			-- 品牌（中文）
	i.product_line,                                         			-- 产品线（中文）
	i.packsize_1,                                           			-- 产品规格类型
	i.packsize_2                                            			-- 产品规格
    ,b.store_code       												-- 门店编码
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.store_name,'Others')
	end store_name       						                        -- 门店名称
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.ka_code,'Others')
	end ka_code     								                    -- 门店KA编码
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.ka_name,'Others')
	end ka_name        													-- 门店KA名称        							-- 门店KA名称
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.store_region,'Others')
	end store_region     						                        -- 门店区域
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.store_province,'Others')
	end store_province    					                            -- 门店省份
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.store_city,'Others')
	end store_city     							                        -- 门店城市
	,case
		when b.store_code is null then null
		else nvl(h.store_channel_name_1,'OT') 
	end store_channel_name_1											-- 门店渠道层级一级
	,case 
		when b.store_code is null then null
		when h.store_channel_name_1 = 'NKA' then h.channel_group
		when h.store_channel_name_1 in ('LKA','OT') then h.henkel_region
		else 'Others'
	end store_channel_name_2,     										-- 门店渠道层级二级
	case
		when b.store_code is null then null
        when h.store_channel_name_1 = 'NKA' then h.system_name
        when h.store_channel_name_1 in ('LKA','OT') then nvl(if(h.chain_name = '',null,h.chain_name),'Others')
        when h.store_channel_name_1 = 'NKA' then nvl(h.nka_customer_name,'Others')
		else nvl(h.chain_name,'Others')
    end as store_channel_name_3, 										-- 门店渠道层级三级
    case
		when b.store_code is null then null
        when h.store_channel_name_1 in ('LKA','OT') then null
        -- when a.account_group_code = 'KA0007' then '山姆会员'
	    else nvl(if(h.chain_name = '',null,h.chain_name),'Others')
    end as store_channel_name_4, 										-- 门店渠道层级四级
	b.flag_apply,                                           			-- 是否申请门店
	b.flag_concluded,                                           		-- 是否结案门店
	b.flag_check,                                            			-- 是否核销门店
	case 
		when e1.display_name = '价格变动申请单' then 0
		when a.activity_status_code = 'Closed' and b.flag_check is not null then 3
		when e1.display_name = '生意计划表' and b.flag_concluded is not null then 2
	end flag_status,
	b.apply_amount_tax activity_apply_amount_tax,                       -- 活动申请含税金额
	b.apply_amount_untax activity_apply_amount,                         -- 活动申请未税金额
	b.concluded_amount_tax activity_concluded_amount_tax,               -- 活动结案含税金额
	b.concluded_amount_untax activity_concluded_amount,                 -- 活动结案未税金额
	b.check_amount_tax activity_check_amount_tax,                       -- 活动核销含税金额
	b.check_amount_untax activity_check_amount,                         -- 活动核销未税金额
	case 
		when e1.display_name = '价格变动申请单' then b.apply_amount_untax
		when a.activity_status_code = 'Closed' then b.check_amount_untax
		when e1.display_name = '生意计划表' and b.flag_concluded is not null then b.concluded_amount_untax	
		else b.apply_amount_untax
	end activity_all_amount,      -- 活动整档花费金额
	case
	    when j.channel_customer_permission is null then 'Others'
		else j.channel_customer_permission
	end channel_customer_permission,
	case 
	    when j.region_customer_permission is null then 'Others_Others'
		else j.region_customer_permission
	end region_customer_permission
from 
(
-- 活动主表 
	SELECT 
		id,
		activity_code,
		sub_account_group_code,
		type,
		status activity_status_code,
		if(activity_mechanism = '',null, activity_mechanism) activity_mechanism,
		case status 
			when 'Approved' then '已审批'
			when 'Closed' then '已关闭'
			when 'Concluded' then '已结案'
			when 'Paid' then '已核销'
			when 'SapAffirm' then 'SAP已维护'
			when 'Paying' then '核销中'
			when 'Free_Execute' then '免费货 已执行'
		end activity_status_name,
		bp_upturn_o2o,
		REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(replace(bp_o2o_platform,'Meituan','美团'),'Eleme','饿了么'),'Huarun','客户自主APP'),'JD','京东到家') bp_o2o_platform,
		account_group_code,
        channel_code,
        activity_name,
		deleted,
		substr(activity_start_date,1,4) activity_start_year,
		substr(activity_end_date,1,4) activity_end_year,
		concat(substr(activity_start_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(activity_start_date)) as activity_start_quarter,
		concat(substr(activity_end_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(activity_end_date)) as activity_end_quarter,
		substr(replace(activity_start_date,'-',''),1,6) activity_start_month,
		substr(replace(activity_end_date,'-',''),1,6) activity_end_month,
		replace(activity_start_date,'-','') activity_start_date,
		replace(activity_end_date,'-','') activity_end_date,
		replace(hierarchy_code,'\'','') customer_code,
		ROW_NUMBER() over(PARTITION BY id order by ds desc,created_time desc, last_modified_time desc) rn
	FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_info
	WHERE DS <> '' 
	-- and channel_code in ('DT','NKA') -- 只取DT、NKA两个渠道
	and status in ('Approved','Closed','Concluded','Paid','SapAffirm','Paying','Free_Execute') -- 有效活动
) a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm1 b 
on a.id = b.activity_id
left join 
(
-- 活动明细行表
	SELECT *,RANK() over(PARTITION BY activity_id order by ds desc) rn
	FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_item
	WHERE DS <> ''
)c on a.id = c.activity_id and c.rn = 1
left join
(
-- KA系统主数据 取 活动系统名称
	SELECT account_group_code,
		   decode(account_group_code,'KA0007','山姆会员',account_group_local_name) as account_group_local_name
	 FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_account_group
	WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_account_group") 
	group by account_group_code,
			decode(account_group_code,'KA0007','山姆会员',account_group_local_name)
)d on a.account_group_code = d.account_group_code
left join
(
	SELECT distinct 
		sub_account_group_code,
		sub_account_group_name_cn
	FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_sub_account_group
	WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_sub_account_group") 
)k on a.sub_account_group_code = k.sub_account_group_code
left join
(
-- 字典主数据 取 活动类型
	SELECT distinct 
		display_name,          		-- 名称
		item_value            		-- 字典项值
	FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_dictionary
	WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_dictionary") 
	and code = 'report_activity_list_activity_type'
)e1 on a.type = e1.item_value
left join
(
-- 字典主数据 取 上翻O2O
	SELECT distinct 
		display_name,          		-- 名称
		item_value            		-- 字典项值
	FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_dictionary
	WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_dictionary") 
	and code = 'o2o_flip_up_type'
	and status ='ENABLED'
)e3 on a.bp_upturn_o2o = e3.item_value
left join
(
-- 活动机制主数据 取 活动机制名称
	SELECT * FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_setting_mechanism
	WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_setting_mechanism") 
)f on c.activity_mechanism = f.activity_mechanism_code
left join
(
-- 费用三级科目, 费用科目二级若是'价差'则调整为'CA'
	select t3.expense_name,
		t1.expense_name activity_fee_1,
		replace(t2.expense_name,'价差','CA') activity_fee_2,
		regexp_replace(t3.expense_name,'\\(DT\\)|（DT）|（NKA）|(DT)|（WS）|（MPD）', '')  activity_fee_3,
		t3.expense_code 
	from 
	(
		SELECT * FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type
		WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type") 
		and level = 1
	) t1 
	left join 
	(
		SELECT * FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type
		WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type") 
		and level = 2
	)t2 on t1.expense_code = t2.parent_code
	left join 
	(
		SELECT * FROM ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type
		WHERE DS = MAX_PT("${dme_ods}.s_tpm_dc_expense_type") 
		and level = 3
	)t3 on t2.expense_code = t3.parent_code 
)g on c.expense_type_code = g.expense_code
-- DME门店主数据
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm2 h 
on b.store_code = h.store_oneid
left join 
-- DME产品主数据
${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm3 i
on b.idh = i.product_code 
left join 
-- DME客户主数据
${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm4 j 
on a.customer_code = j.customer_code
and nvl(i.bu_2,'Beauty Care') = j.bu_2
where a.rn = 1

-- 活动申请、结案、核销最新状态，一个活动(id)只有一个状态。
-- 一个活动在申请、结案、核销时对应门店可能存在不同，要区分每条数据(id,idh,store 逻辑唯一)的最新活动状态
-- flag_status标记状态, 申请=1, 结案=2, 核销=3, 有申请无核销(活动状态Closed)=4, PPD(价格变动申请单)=0, NULL代表该数据非最新状态
insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail  partition(ds='${bizdate}')
SELECT  a.id
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
		,sub_account_group_code
		,sub_account_group_name_cn
        ,activity_type_code
        ,activity_type_name
        ,activity_channel
        ,activity_start_year
        ,activity_end_year
        ,activity_start_quarter
        ,activity_end_quarter
        ,activity_start_month
        ,activity_end_month
        ,activity_start_date
        ,activity_end_date
        ,activity_mechanism
        ,activity_mechanism_name
        ,activity_code
        ,activity_name
        ,activity_status_code
        ,activity_status_name
        ,oneid
        ,bp_upturn_o2o
        ,bp_o2o_platform
        ,account_group_code
        ,account_group_local_name
        ,activity_fee_1
        ,activity_fee_2
        ,activity_fee_3
        ,expense_type_code
        ,customer_channel
        ,customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,customer_name_code_connect
        ,customer_region
        ,customer_province
        ,customer_channel_name_1
        ,customer_channel_name_2
        ,customer_channel_name_3
        ,customer_channel_name_4
		,a.idh
        ,sku
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,category_name
        ,category_name_2
        ,category_name_3
        ,brand_name
        ,product_line
        ,packsize_1
        ,packsize_2
        ,a.store_code
        ,store_name
        ,ka_code
        ,ka_name
        ,store_region
        ,store_province
        ,store_city
        ,store_channel_name_1
        ,store_channel_name_2
        ,store_channel_name_3
        ,store_channel_name_4
        ,cast(activity_apply_amount_tax as decimal(28,6)) activity_apply_amount_tax
        ,cast(activity_apply_amount as decimal(28,6)) activity_apply_amount
        ,cast(activity_concluded_amount_tax as decimal(28,6)) activity_concluded_amount_tax
        ,cast(activity_concluded_amount as decimal(28,6)) activity_concluded_amount
        ,cast(activity_check_amount_tax as decimal(28,6)) activity_check_amount_tax
        ,cast(activity_check_amount as decimal(28,6)) activity_check_amount
        ,cast(activity_all_amount as decimal(28,6)) activity_all_amount
		,flag_apply                                           -- 是否申请门店
		,flag_concluded                                       -- 是否结案门店
		,flag_check                                           -- 是否核销门店
		,case 
			when a.flag_status is not null then a.flag_status
			when b.id is not null then 4
			when c.id is null then 1
		end flag_status                                       -- 非空表示活动最新状态,且为有效数据
        ,to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date,        -- 数据同步日期
		channel_customer_permission,
	    region_customer_permission
FROM
	${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm5 a
left join   
(
-- CA(生意计划表)和批复表，活动申请没有落地的情况，有申请没结案和核销
	select id from dme_cdm.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm5
    where activity_status_code = 'Closed' 
    and activity_type_name != '价格变动申请单'
    group by id HAVING sum(activity_all_amount) is null
)b
on a.id = b.id
left join 
(
-- 判定活动最新状态，筛选出非结案和核销的活动申请数据
	select
        distinct  
		id
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail_tpm5
    where flag_status is not null
) c on a.id = c.id
where a.activity_start_date >= '20240101'

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_info_vs partition(ds)
select
  B.product_code               -- 产品编码
  ,B.product_barcode            -- 产品条码
  ,B.product_name               -- 产品标准名称
  ,B.product_name_new           -- 产品名称（新）
  ,B.product_name_en            -- 英文名称
  ,B.product_abbreviation       -- 产品简称
  ,B.business_brand             -- 业务品牌
  ,B.top_category_name          -- 总品类
  ,B.top_category_name_en       -- 总品类英文
  ,B.category_name              -- 品类
  ,B.category_name_en           -- 品类英文
  ,B.brand_name                 -- 品牌
  ,B.brand_name_en              -- 品牌英文
  ,B.sub_category_name          -- 子品类
  ,B.first_product_function     -- 一级子品类
  ,B.product_function           -- 二级子品类
  ,B.product_line               -- 产品线
  ,B.product_pack               -- 产品规格
  ,B.selectable_unit            -- 可选单位
  ,B.box_size                   -- 箱规
  ,B.shelf_life                 -- 保质期
  ,B.product_attribute          -- 产品属性
  ,B.product_type               -- 产品种类
  ,B.product_status             -- 产品有效性/状态
  ,B.product_series             -- 产品系列
  ,B.product_class              -- 产品分类
  ,B.product_group              -- 产品组
  ,B.gifts_remark               -- 赠品备注
  ,B.remark                     -- 备注
  ,to_char(to_date(B.billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') as billing_date -- 开单日期
  ,C.base_price_without_tax AS product_base_price_untax   -- 产品基价（不含税）
  ,C.base_price_with_tax    AS product_base_price_tax     -- 产品基价（含税）
  ,C.rsp_without_tax        AS retail_price_untax         -- 不含税零售价
  ,C.rsp_with_tax           AS retail_price_tax           -- 含税零售价
  ,to_char(to_date(B.price_start_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') as price_start_date -- 价格开始日期
  ,to_char(to_date(B.price_end_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') as price_end_date     -- 价格结束日期
  ,B.create_time                -- 创建时间
  ,B.modify_time                -- 更新时间
  ,B.first_product_function_cn -- 一级子品类中文
  ,B.product_function_cn -- 二级子品类中文
  ,A.day_id AS ds
from (
    select
          day_id
          ,'1' as flag
    from  dme_cdm.dim_day
    where day_id >= '20220101'
    and   day_id <= '${bizdate}'
   ) A
 left join(
    select
      product_code               -- 产品编码
      ,product_barcode            -- 产品条码
      ,product_name               -- 产品标准名称
      ,product_name_new           -- 产品名称（新）
      ,product_name_en            -- 英文名称
      ,product_abbreviation       -- 产品简称
      ,business_brand             -- 业务品牌
      ,top_category_name          -- 总品类
      ,top_category_name_en       -- 总品类英文
      ,category_name              -- 品类
      ,category_name_en           -- 品类英文
      ,brand_name                 -- 品牌
      ,brand_name_en              -- 品牌英文
      ,sub_category_name          -- 子品类
      ,first_product_function     -- 一级子品类
      ,product_function           -- 二级子品类
      ,product_line               -- 产品线
      ,product_pack               -- 产品规格
      ,selectable_unit            -- 可选单位
      ,box_size                   -- 箱规
      ,shelf_life                 -- 保质期
      ,product_attribute          -- 产品属性
      ,product_type               -- 产品种类
      ,product_status             -- 产品有效性/状态
      ,product_series             -- 产品系列
      ,product_class              -- 产品分类
      ,product_group              -- 产品组
      ,gifts_remark               -- 赠品备注
      ,remark                     -- 备注
      ,billing_date               -- 开单日期
      ,product_base_price_untax   -- 产品基价（不含税）
      ,product_base_price_tax     -- 产品基价（含税）
      ,retail_price_untax         -- 不含税零售价
      ,retail_price_tax           -- 含税零售价
      ,price_start_date           -- 价格开始日期
      ,price_end_date             -- 价格结束日期
      ,create_time                -- 创建时间
      ,modify_time                -- 更新时间
      ,first_product_function_cn -- 一级子品类中文
      ,product_function_cn -- 二级子品类中文
      ,row_number()over(partition by product_barcode order by create_time desc,modify_time desc) as rn
      ,'1' as flag
    from ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_info_vs
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_info_vs')
) B
ON A.flag=B.flag
AND B.rn=1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
       product_barcode
      ,data_date
      ,base_price_with_tax    -- 含税采购基准价
      ,base_price_without_tax -- 不含税采购基准价
      ,rsp_with_tax           -- 含税建议零售价
      ,rsp_without_tax        -- 不含税建议零售价
    FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price')
    ) C
ON B.product_barcode = C.product_barcode
AND A.day_id = C.data_date

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_conclusion_detail  partition(ds='${bizdate}')
-- PPD活动分摊到SKU不到门店,CA和批复表活动可能存在不到门店的分摊数据，优先取到门店的分摊数据，若不到门店则取sku数据
select
	a.activity_id,                                  									-- 活动ID
	a.idh,                    															-- idh
    b.store_code,                                   									-- 门店编码
	nvl(b.concluded_amount_tax, a.concluded_amount_tax) concluded_amount_tax,			-- 结案金额(含税)
	nvl(b.concluded_amount_untax, a.concluded_amount_untax) concluded_amount_untax,     -- 结案金额(未税)
	case
		when b.store_code is null then 1
		else 2
	end flag_concluded,                                                                 -- 数据来源，1：sku分摊表，2: 门店分摊表
	to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date                           			-- 数据同步日期
from 
(
-- 结案SKU拆分表
	select
		activity_id,                                   	                    -- 活动ID
		idh,                    						                    -- idh
		sum(concluded_amount_tax) concluded_amount_tax,		                -- 结案金额(含税)
		sum(concluded_amount_untax) concluded_amount_untax                  -- 结案金额(未税)
	from 
	(
		select
			activity_id,                                   				    -- 活动ID
			material_code idh,                    							-- idh
			conclusion_amount concluded_amount_tax,						    -- 结案金额(含税)
			conclusion_amount_without_tax concluded_amount_untax,          	-- 结案金额(未税)
			RANK() over(PARTITION BY activity_id order by ds desc) rn
		from ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_conclusion_item_split_sku
		where ds <> ''
	) where rn = 1
	GROUP BY activity_id, idh
)a 
left join
(
-- 结案SKU门店拆分表
	select
		activity_id,                                   	                    -- 活动ID
		idh,                    						                    -- idh
		store_code,                                                         -- 门店编码
		sum(concluded_amount_tax) concluded_amount_tax,		                -- 结案金额(含税)
		sum(concluded_amount_untax) concluded_amount_untax                  -- 结案金额(未税)
	from 
	(
		select
			activity_id,                                   				    -- 活动ID
			material_code idh,                    							-- idh
			store_code,           							                -- 门店编码
			conclusion_amount concluded_amount_tax,						    -- 结案金额(含税)
			conclusion_amount_without_tax concluded_amount_untax,          	-- 结案金额(未税)
			RANK() over(PARTITION BY activity_id order by ds desc) rn
		from ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_activity_conclusion_item_split_sku_store
		where ds <> ''
	) where rn = 1
	GROUP BY activity_id, idh, store_code
) b on a.activity_id = b.activity_id and a.idh = b.idh

select
	c.id activity_id,
	a.activity_code,                                                        -- 活动编码
    a.payment_info_id,                                                      -- 核销ID
	a.idh,                    						                        -- idh
    b.store_code,                                                           -- 门店编码
	nvl(b.check_amount_tax, a.check_amount_tax) check_amount_tax,		    -- 核销金额(含税)
	nvl(b.check_amount_untax, a.check_amount_untax) check_amount_untax,     -- 核销金额(未税)
	case
		when b.store_code is null then 1
		else 2

	to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date                           -- 数据同步日期
from 
(
-- 核销SKU拆分表
	select
		activity_code,                                   				   -- 活动编码
		payment_info_id,                                   				   -- 核销ID
		idh,                    							   			   -- idh
		sum(check_amount_tax) check_amount_tax,		                       -- 核销金额(含税)
		sum(check_amount_untax) check_amount_untax                         -- 核销金额(未税)

	(
		select
			activity_code,                                   				-- 活动编码
			payment_info_id,                                   				-- 核销ID

			paid_with_tax_amount check_amount_tax,							-- 核销金额(含税)
			paid_without_tax_amount check_amount_untax,          			-- 核销金额(未税)

		from ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_payment_activity_split_sku
		where ds <> ''
	) where rn = 1
	GROUP BY activity_code, idh, payment_info_id
)a

(
-- 核销SKU门店拆分表
	select
		activity_code,                                   				   -- 活动编码
		payment_info_id,                                   				   -- 核销ID

		sum(check_amount_untax) check_amount_untax                         -- 核销金额(未税)
	from 
	(
		select
			activity_code,                                   				-- 活动编码
			payment_info_id,                                   				-- 核销ID
			material_code idh,                    							-- idh
			store_code,           							                -- 门店编码

		from ${dme_ods}.s_tpm_payment_activity_split_sku_store
		where ds <> ''

                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY update_time DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_store_info
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_store_info')
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  app_id
                        ,store_name
                        ,city_name
                        ,open_date
                        ,close_date
                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY app_id ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_standard_store_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_standard_store_info')
            ) t1
ON      t.app_id = t1.app_id
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  city_name
                        ,province_name
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping')
                AND     district_type = 'city'
            ) t2
ON      t1.city_name = t2.city_name
WHERE   t.rn = 1
AND     t1.rn = 1

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_info PARTITION (ds)
SELECT  t1.app_id
        ,t2.stand_store_name
        ,t2.province
        ,t2.city
        ,t1.cashier_uid
        ,t1.job_number
        ,t1.name
        ,t1.customer_uid
        ,t1.uid
        ,t1.sn
        ,t1.sys_create_time
        ,t1.sys_update_time
        ,if(t1.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-t1.total_amount,t1.total_amount) as total_amount 
        ,if(t1.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-t1.total_profit,t1.total_profit) as total_profit 
        ,t1.discount
        ,t1.external_order_no
        ,t1.remark
        ,t1.service_fee
        ,t1.gratuity
        ,t1.cover_charge
        ,t1.box_fee
        ,t1.coupon_fee
        ,t1.rounding
        ,t1.ticket_type
        ,t1.sell_ticket_uid
        ,t1.invalid
        ,t1.web_order_no
        ,case when t1.ds between t2.open_date and t2.close_date then '1'
         else '0' end as is_store_open_data
        ,t1.ds
FROM    (
            SELECT  app_id -- appId（用于开放平台对接）
                    ,cashier_uid --收银员唯一标识
                    ,job_number --收银员工号
                    ,name --收银员名字
                    ,customer_uid --会员唯一标识 为0表示收银时没选择会员
                    ,uid --单据唯一标识
                    ,sn --单据序列号
                    ,datetime AS sys_create_time --单据产生的时间
                    ,sys_update_time --单据更新的时间
                    ,CAST(nvl(total_amount,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS total_amount --单据实收总额
                    ,CAST(nvl(total_profit,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS total_profit --单据总利润
                    ,CAST(nvl(discount,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS discount --整单折扣
                    ,external_order_no --第三方平台支付单号
                    ,remark --备注
                    ,CAST(nvl(service_fee,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS service_fee --服务费
                    ,CAST(nvl(gratuity,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS gratuity --小费
                   ,CAST(nvl(cover_charge,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS cover_charge --餐位费，茶位费
                    ,CAST(nvl(box_fee,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS box_fee --包厢费
                    ,CAST(nvl(coupon_fee,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS coupon_fee --无
                    ,CAST(nvl(rounding,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rounding --抹零数额
                    ,ticket_type --单据类型：SELL销售单据, SELL_RETURN退货单据
                    ,sell_ticket_uid --退货单据关联的销售单据的uid
                    ,invalid --值为1时表示单据已作废(反结账)
                    ,web_order_no --网单号（直接在pos端收银，不会有值。只有通过外卖平台，小程序，或者订单推送接口 的网单才有）
                    ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(datetime,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') AS ds
                    ,row_number() over(partition by app_id,uid order by update_time desc) as  rn  --强行去重取唯一 
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_receipts_all
            WHERE   ds <> ''
        ) t1
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  app_id
                        ,stand_store_name
                        ,province
                        ,city
                        ,open_date
                        ,close_date
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_store_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_store_info')
            ) t2
ON      t1.app_id = t2.app_id
where t1.rn = 1

--@exclude_input=dme_cdm.dwd_direct_sale_order_detail_info_temp
--odps sql 
--********************************************************************--
--author:dong.c.chen
--create time:2024-12-13 11:08:40
--********************************************************************--
--先对s_yinbao_data_items进行清洗,生成临时表
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_detail_info_temp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_detail_info_temp AS
SELECT  t1.app_id --门店ID
        ,t1.uid --单据唯一标识
        ,t1.id --主键id
        ,t1.name --单据条目商品名称
        ,t1.buy_price --单据条目商品进货价
        ,t1.sell_price --据条目商品销售价
        ,t1.customer_price --单据条目商品会员价
        ,t1.quantity --单据条目销售的商品数量，如3.5箱
        ,t1.discount --单据条目所打的折扣
        ,t1.customer_discount --单据条目所打的会员折扣
        ,t1.total_amount --单据条目总价
        ,t1.total_profit --单据条目总利润
        ,t1.is_customer_discount --数据为1时表求享受了会员折扣
        ,t1.product_uid --单据条目所对应的商品唯一标识
        ,CASE   WHEN t2.prod_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN t2.prod_barcode
                WHEN t1.product_barcode IS NULL THEN '-110'
                ELSE t1.product_barcode
        END AS product_barcode --单据条目所对应的商品条形码
        ,t1.isweighing --无
        ,t5.pay_code --支付方式code
        ,t5.pay_name --支付方式名称
FROM    (
            SELECT  app_id --门店ID
                    ,uid --单据唯一标识
                    ,id --主键id
                    ,name --单据条目商品名称
                    ,buy_price --单据条目商品进货价
                    ,sell_price --据条目商品销售价
                    ,customer_price --单据条目商品会员价
                    ,quantity --单据条目销售的商品数量，如3.5箱
                    ,discount --单据条目所打的折扣
                    ,customer_discount --单据条目所打的会员折扣
                    ,total_amount --单据条目总价
                    ,total_profit --单据条目总利润
                    ,is_customer_discount --数据为1时表求享受了会员折扣
                    ,product_uid --单据条目所对应的商品唯一标识
                    ,product_barcode --单据条目所对应的商品条形码
                    ,is_weighing AS isweighing --无
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY update_time DESC ) AS rn --ID唯一,在此处去重
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_items
            WHERE   ds <> ''
        ) t1
LEFT JOIN   (
                --无码商品有的需要转换正常码,有的需要剔除
                SELECT  uid --订单ID
                        ,product_uid --订单商品ID
                        ,prod_barcode --转换后的商品条码
                        ,action_type --操作类型
                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uid,product_uid ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_nocode_product_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_nocode_product_info')
            ) t2
ON      t1.uid = t2.uid
AND     t1.product_uid = t2.product_uid
AND     t2.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN   (
                --无码商品有的需要转换正常码,有的需要剔除
                SELECT  uid --订单ID
                        ,product_uid --订单商品ID
                        ,prod_barcode --转换后的商品条码
                        ,action_type --操作类型
                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY uid,product_uid ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_nocode_product_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_nocode_product_info')
                AND     action_type = '删除'
            ) t3
ON      t1.uid = t3.uid
AND     t1.product_uid = t3.product_uid
AND     t3.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN   (
                --需要剔除手工填报的虚拟商品
                SELECT  case when length(prouct_code)=12 then concat('0',prouct_code)
                else prouct_code end as prouct_code--商品编码
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_virtual_product_info
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_virtual_product_info')
                GROUP BY prouct_code
            ) t4
ON      t1.product_barcode = t4.prouct_code
LEFT JOIN   (
                --转换付款方式
                SELECT  uid
                        ,app_id
                        ,CONCAT_WS(',',COLLECT_LIST(NVL(pay_code,'-'))) AS pay_code -- 支付方式代码,多个逗号拼接
                        ,CONCAT_WS(',',COLLECT_LIST(NVL(pay_name,'-'))) AS pay_name -- 支付方式名称,多个逗号拼接  
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  a.uid -- 单据唯一标识 
                                    ,a.app_id
                                    ,a.code AS pay_code -- 支付方式代码 
                                    ,b.payment_method_desc AS pay_name -- 支付方式名称  
                                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.uid,a.app_id,a.code ORDER BY update_time DESC ) AS rn --按照主键去重取最新
                            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_yinbao_data_payments a --支付方式维度表
                            LEFT JOIN   (
                                            SELECT  code
                                                    ,payment_method_desc
                                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_direct_pay_method_dictionary
                                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_direct_pay_method_dictionary')
                                        ) b
                            ON      a.code = b.code
                            WHERE   a.ds <> ''
                        ) t
                WHERE   rn = 1
                GROUP BY uid
                         ,app_id
            ) t5
ON      t1.uid = t5.uid
AND     t1.app_id = t5.app_id
WHERE   t1.rn = 1
AND     (
            t3.uid IS NULL
            AND     t3.product_uid IS NULL
)
AND     t4.prouct_code IS NULL

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_detail_info PARTITION (ds)
SELECT  t2.cashier_uid AS cashieruid -- 收银员唯一标识 
        ,t2.job_number AS jobnumber -- 收银员工号 
        ,t2.name AS jobname -- 收银员名字
        ,t2.stand_store_name AS store_name -- 店铺名
        ,t2.province AS province -- 店铺省份
        ,t2.city AS city
        ,t2.customer_uid -- 会员唯一标识 为0表示收银时没选择会员 
        ,t2.uid -- 主订单号 
        ,t2.sn -- 主订单流水号      
        ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t2.sys_create_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') AS order_date -- 主订单产生的时间 
        ,CAST(t2.discount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS discount -- 整单折扣 
        ,t2.external_order_no -- 第三方平台支付单号 
        ,t2.ticket_type -- 单据类型：SELL销售单据, SELL_RETURN退货单据 
        ,t2.sell_ticket_uid -- 退货单据关联的销售单据的uid 
        ,t2.invalid -- 值为1时表示单据已作废(反结账) 
        ,t2.web_order_no -- 网单号（直接在pos端收银，不会有值。只有通过外卖平台，小程序，或者订单推送接口 的网单才有）
        ,t1.id AS sub_uid -- 子订单主键id 
        ,t1.name AS sys_product_name -- 系统商品名称 
        ,CAST(t1.buy_price AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS buyprice -- 商品进货价 
        ,CAST(t1.sell_price AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS sellprice -- 商品销售价 
        ,CAST(t1.customer_price AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS customerprice -- 商品会员价 
        ,IF(t2.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-(CAST(t1.quantity AS DECIMAL(28,6))),CAST(t1.quantity AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS quantity -- 商品数量，如3.5箱 
        ,CAST(t1.discount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS subdiscount -- 子订单条目所打的折扣 
        ,CAST(t1.customer_discount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS customerdiscount -- 子订单目所打的会员折扣 
        ,IF(t2.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-(CAST(t1.total_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6))),CAST(t1.total_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS subtotalamount -- 子订单目销额 
        ,CAST((IF(t2.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-(CAST(t1.quantity AS DECIMAL(28,6))),CAST(t1.quantity AS DECIMAL(28,6)))) * NVL(t3.retail_price_tax,0) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp_subtotalamount --子单RSP销额
        ,IF(t2.ticket_type = 'SELL_RETURN',-(CAST(t1.total_profit AS DECIMAL(28,6))),CAST(t1.total_profit AS DECIMAL(28,6))) AS subtotalprofit -- 子订单目总利润 
        ,t1.is_customer_discount -- 数据为1时表求享受了会员折扣 
        ,t1.product_uid -- 银豹商品唯一标识 
        ,t1.product_barcode -- 商品条形码 
        ,t3.product_code AS henkel_product_code -- 汉高商品idh
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.product_barcode = '-110' THEN t1.name
                WHEN t4.service_name IS NOT NULL THEN t4.service_name
                WHEN t3.product_name IS NOT NULL THEN t3.product_name
                ELSE 'Others'
        END AS product_name -- 产品名称，包含无码商品，服务类产品，标准汉高商品   
        -- ,CASE   WHEN t1.product_barcode = '-110' OR t4.barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '服务收入'
        --         WHEN t5.barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '试用装销售'
        --         WHEN t3.product_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '正常品销售'
        --         ELSE 'Others'
        -- END AS product_type -- 销售产品大类，包含服务收入，试用装销售，正常品销售
        ,CASE   WHEN t5.barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '试用装销售'
                WHEN t3.product_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN '正常品销售'
                ELSE '服务收入'
        END AS product_type -- 销售产品大类，包含服务收入，试用装销售，正常品销售
        ,NVL(t3.product_name_en,'Others') AS product_name_en -- 标准汉高商品英文名称   
        ,NVL(t3.category_name,'Others') AS category_name -- 标准汉高商品品类       
        ,NVL(t3.category_name_en,'Others') AS category_name_en -- 标准汉高商品品类英文   
        ,NVL(t3.brand_name,'Others') AS brand_name -- 标准汉高商品品牌       
        ,NVL(t3.brand_name_en,'Others') AS brand_name_en -- 标准汉高商品品牌英文   
        ,NVL(t3.product_line,'Others') AS product_line -- 标准汉高商品产品线     
        ,NVL(CAST(t3.retail_price_tax AS DECIMAL(28,6)),0) AS retail_price_tax -- 标准汉高商品含税零售价 
        ,NVL(CAST(t3.product_base_price AS DECIMAL(28,6)),0) AS product_base_price -- 标准汉高商品基价（不含税） 
        ,t1.isweighing -- 无 
        ,t1.pay_code -- 支付方式代码
        ,t1.pay_name -- 支付方式名称
        ,NVL(t4.service_name,'Others') AS service_name -- 服务名称
        ,NVL(t4.service_detail,'Others') AS service_detail -- 服务类型细分
        ,t2.is_store_open_data --是否开业期间数据
        ,t2.ds
FROM    (
            SELECT  app_id --门店ID
                    ,uid --单据唯一标识
                    ,id --主键id
                    ,name --单据条目商品名称
                    ,buy_price --单据条目商品进货价
                    ,sell_price --据条目商品销售价
                    ,customer_price --单据条目商品会员价
                    ,quantity --单据条目销售的商品数量，如3.5箱
                    ,discount --单据条目所打的折扣
                    ,customer_discount --单据条目所打的会员折扣
                    ,total_amount --单据条目总价
                    ,total_profit --单据条目总利润
                    ,is_customer_discount --数据为1时表求享受了会员折扣
                    ,product_uid --单据条目所对应的商品唯一标识
                    ,product_barcode --单据条目所对应的商品条形码
                    ,isweighing --无
                    ,pay_code --支付方式code
                    ,pay_name --支付方式名称
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_detail_info_temp
        ) t1
JOIN    (
            SELECT  app_id --appId（用于开放平台对接）
                    ,stand_store_name --汉高标准门店名称
                    ,province --省份
                    ,city --城市
                    ,cashier_uid --收银员唯一标识
                    ,job_number --收银员工号
                    ,name --收银员名字
                    ,customer_uid --会员唯一标识为0表示收银时没选择会员
                    ,uid --主订单号
                    ,sn --主订单流水号
                    ,sys_create_time --订单创建时间
                    ,discount --整单折扣
                    ,external_order_no --第三方平台支付单号
                    ,ticket_type -- 单据类型：SELL销售单据, SELL_RETURN退货单据 
                    ,sell_ticket_uid --退货单据关联的销售单据的uid
                    ,invalid --值为1时表示单据已作废(反结账)
                    ,web_order_no --网单号（直接在pos端收银，不会有值。只有通过外卖平台，小程序，或者订单推送接口的网单才有）
                    ,is_store_open_data --是否开业期间数据
                    ,ds
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_direct_sale_order_info
            WHERE   ds <> '' --如果想控制开始时间的话用这个分区字段即可
        ) t2 --主订单表
ON      t1.uid = t2.uid
AND     t1.app_id = t2.app_id
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  *
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds LIKE '%01'
            ) t3
ON      t1.product_barcode = t3.product_barcode
AND     substr(t2.ds,1,6) = substr(t3.ds,1,6)
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  barcode --productBarcode 
                        ,service_name --name 
                        ,service_type --收入类型 
                        ,service_detail --收入细项 
                        ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_service_revenue_mapping --服务类收入细项表
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_service_revenue_mapping')
            ) t4
ON      t1.product_barcode = t4.barcode
AND     t4.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  barcode --条码
                        ,product_status --商品状态
                        ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_product_sample_mapping --业务商品mapping，获取试用装标识
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_product_sample_mapping')
                AND     product_status = '试用装'
            ) t5
ON      t1.product_barcode = t5.barcode
AND     t5.rn = 1

--@exclude_input=dme_ods.s_province_region_change_mapping
--MaxCompute_SQL
--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: 省份和汉高大区mapping变更表
--功能描述:
--创建者:  
--创建日期: 
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--********************************************************************-- 

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_province_region_change_mapping partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
  province_name -- 省份
  ,old_henkel_region    -- 老汉高大区
  ,new_henkel_region    -- 新汉高大区
  ,update_time          -- 渠道变更日期
  ,creator
  ,modifier
  ,creator_nickname
  ,modifier_nickname
  ,create_time
  ,modify_time
  ,qbi_system_upload_id
from (
 select *
     ,row_number()over(partition by trim(province_name) order by nvl(update_time,'19000101') desc) as rn 
 from (
   select
     trim(province_name) as province_name -- 省份
     ,old_henkel_region    -- 老汉高大区
     ,new_henkel_region    -- 新汉高大区

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_pos partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    a.prod_barcode                                    -- 产品barcode
	,a.store_code                                     -- 门店编码
	,a.customer_code                                  -- 经销商编码
	,a.bill_date                                      -- 账单日期
	,a.bill_month                                     -- 月份
	,a.bill_quarter                                   -- 季度
	,a.bill_year                                      -- 年份
	,a.channel_name                                   -- 渠道
	,cast(sum(a.original_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) original_amt_untax         -- POS销额
	,cast(sum(a.base_unit_qty) as bigint) base_unit_qty                          -- POS销量
	,a.retail_price_tax                               -- 含税建议零售价
	,a.product_base_price                             -- 未税基价
	,a.etl_date                                       -- 数据同步日期
	,a.channel_customer_permission                    -- 客户渠道权限
	,a.region_customer_permission                     --客户区域权限
from
(
    select
    	 a.prod_barcode                                   -- 产品barcode
    	,a.store_code                                     -- 门店编码
    	,a.customer_code                                  -- 经销商编码
    	,a.bill_date									  -- 账单日期
    	,substr(a.bill_date,1,6) bill_month               -- 月份
    	,concat(substr(a.bill_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(concat(substr(a.bill_date,1,4),'-',substr(a.bill_date,5,2),'-',substr(a.bill_date,7,2)))) as bill_quarter -- 季度
    	,substr(a.bill_date,1,4) bill_year                -- 年份
    	,case 
    		when a.first_channel_name = 'NKA' and a.supply_type_name = '直供' then 'NKA'
			when C.channel_name_lastest is null then 'Others'
    		else C.channel_name_lastest 
    	end as channel_name                                  -- 渠道
    	,cast(a.original_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) original_amt_untax 	-- POS销额
    	,a.base_unit_qty               -- POS销量
    	,cast(b.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) retail_price_tax			-- 含税建议零售价
    	,cast(b.product_base_price  as decimal(28,6)) product_base_price    -- 未税基价
        ,to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date    -- 数据同步日期
    	,case 
    		when a.first_channel_name = 'NKA' and a.supply_type_name = '直供' then a.channel_ka_permission
			when c.channel_customer_permission is null then 'Others'
            else c.channel_customer_permission 
    	end as channel_customer_permission    -- 客户渠道权限
        ,case 
    		when a.first_channel_name = 'NKA' and a.supply_type_name = '直供' then concat(a.channel_ka_permission,'_Others')
			when c.region_customer_permission is null then 'Others_Others'
            else c.region_customer_permission
    	end as region_customer_permission    --客户区域权限
    from 
    (
    -- 日数据
    	SELECT  bill_date
    			,henkel_store_code store_code
    			,henkel_prod_barcode prod_barcode
    			,dealercode customer_code 
    			,supply_type_name
                ,first_channel_name
    			,SUM(original_amt_untax) original_amt_untax
    			,SUM(base_unit_qty) base_unit_qty
    			,channel_ka_permission    -- 客户渠道权限
    			,region_customer_permission    --客户区域权限
    	FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily
    	WHERE   ds >='20240101'
    	AND 	bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
    	and upper(nvl(first_channel_name,'')) <>'ECOM'
    	GROUP BY bill_date
    			,henkel_store_code
    			,henkel_prod_barcode
    			,dealercode 
    			,supply_type_name
                ,first_channel_name
    			,channel_ka_permission    -- 客户渠道权限
    			,region_customer_permission    --客户区域权限
    	UNION ALL
    -- 月度手工数据
    	SELECT  replace(LAST_DAY(concat(substr(bill_month,1,4),'-',substr(bill_month,5,2),'-','01')),'-','') bill_date
    			,henkel_store_code store_code
    			,henkel_prod_barcode prod_barcode
    			,dealercode customer_code 
    			,supply_type_name
                ,first_channel_name
    			,SUM(original_amt_untax) original_amt_untax
    			,SUM(base_unit_qty) base_unit_qty
    			,channel_ka_permission    -- 客户渠道权限
    			,region_customer_permission    --客户区域权限
    	FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu
    	WHERE   ds >='202401'
    	AND     data_source = '手工报表'
    	AND 	bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
    	and upper(nvl(first_channel_name,'')) <>'ECOM'     
    	GROUP BY bill_date
    			,henkel_store_code
    			,henkel_prod_barcode
    			,dealercode 
    			,supply_type_name
                ,first_channel_name
    			,channel_ka_permission    -- 客户渠道权限
    			,region_customer_permission    --客户区域权限
    ) a 
    left join
    (
    	SELECT * FROM dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    	WHERE DS <> ''
    )b on a.bill_date = b.ds
    and a.prod_barcode = b.product_barcode
    left join
    (
    	SELECT * FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu 
    	WHERE DS <> '' 
    )c
    on a.bill_date = c.ds 
    and a.customer_code = c.customer_code
    and nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care') = c.bu_2
) a
group by 
    a.prod_barcode                
	,a.store_code                 
	,a.customer_code              
	,a.bill_date                  
	,a.bill_month                 
	,a.bill_quarter               
	,a.bill_year                  
	,a.channel_name                          
	,a.retail_price_tax           
	,a.product_base_price         
	,a.etl_date                   
	,a.channel_customer_permission
	,a.region_customer_permission

    where t.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_rtb_campaign_kunchi')
    and store_id is not null
)t
left join (
    select 
        first_channel,
        second_channel,
        third_channel,
        third_channel_text
    from (
        select 
        first_channel,
        second_channel,
        third_channel,
        third_channel_text,
        dense_rank() over(order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_campaign_channel_mapping_kunchi t -- 投放渠道mapping
        where t.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_campaign_channel_mapping_kunchi')
    ) t where rn=1
    group by 
        first_channel,
        second_channel,
        third_channel,
        third_channel_text

) t1
on t.third_channel_name=nvl(t1.third_channel_text,t1.third_channel)
and t.second_channel_name=t1.second_channel

left join(
    select 
            data_months,
            shop_code as shop_id,
            plat_prod_code,
            henkel_prod_barcode,
            base_price_rate,
            prod_qty,
            avg_prop as product_avg
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping
    where ds>0
)t2
on nvl(t.product_id_tp,'') = nvl(t2.plat_prod_code,'')
and nvl(t.store_id,'') = nvl(t2.shop_id,'')
and substr(t.data_date,1,6)=nvl(t2.data_months,'')
left join
(
    select
        product_barcode,
        product_name,
        category_name,
        product_function,  
        sub_product_function ,
        brand_name,
        product_line,
        bu_1,
        bu_2       
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')

) t3 
on nvl(t2.henkel_prod_barcode,t.product_id_tp) = t3.product_barcode
left join
(
    select ec_store_code_tp,
        store_code as shop_id,
        store_name as shop_name
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'')<>''
    group by ec_store_code_tp,
        store_code,
        store_name
) t4
 on if(t.store_id='0','601',t.store_id) = t4.ec_store_code_tp
where t.rn = 1
