--odps sql 
--********************************************************************--
--author:dong.c.chen
--create time:2025-02-28 10:55:36
--对ods数据做清洗
-- 20250718  mass  释放系统时间当天价格信息
-- 20251024  shiwu 调整bug,条码单品最开始时间置2020/1/1 0:00:00
--********************************************************************--
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price_temp_01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price_temp_01 AS
SELECT  t.code
        ,t.barcode
        ,t.region_code
        ,t.region
        ,t.tax_rate
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.start_date_min IS NOT NULL THEN t1.start_date_min
                ELSE t.start_date
        END AS start_date
        ,t.end_date
        ,t.base_price_with_tax
        ,t.base_price_without_tax
        ,t.rsp_with_tax
        ,t.rsp_without_tax
        ,t.is_delete
        ,t.create_time
        ,t.modify_time
FROM    (
            SELECT  *
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_price_maizhi
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_price_maizhi')
            AND     is_delete = 'False'
            AND     region = '中国'
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    --获取barcode粒度最早开始时间.置2020/1/1 0:00:00
                SELECT  barcode
                        ,start_date
                        ,'2020/1/1 0:00:00' AS start_date_min
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  barcode
                                    ,start_date
                                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY barcode ORDER BY start_date asc ) AS rn
                            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_price_maizhi
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_product_price_maizhi')
                            AND     is_delete = 'False'
                            AND     region = '中国'
                        ) t
                WHERE   rn = 1
            ) t1
ON      t.barcode = t1.barcode
AND     t.start_date = t1.start_date

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    code                  -- '产品唯一标识编码'
    ,product_barcode      -- '商品条码'
    ,region_code          -- '行政区域编码'
    ,region               -- '地区中文名称'
    ,tax_rate             -- '增值税率(如0.13表示13%)'
    ,start_date           -- '价格生效起始时间'
    ,end_date             --'价格失效截止时间'
    ,day_id as data_date  -- '数据日期'
    ,base_price_with_tax  -- '含税采购基准价'
    ,base_price_without_tax -- '不含税采购基准价'
    ,rsp_with_tax         -- '含税建议零售价'
    ,rsp_without_tax      -- '不含税建议零售价'
    ,create_time          -- '记录创建时间'
    ,modify_time          -- '最后修改时间'
from (
select t.*,t1.day_id,
ROW_NUMBER() over(partition by product_barcode,day_id order by rsp_with_tax desc ) as rn from (
SELECT  code
        ,barcode as product_barcode
        ,region_code
        ,region
        ,tax_rate
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(start_date,1,4),LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(start_date,'/',2),' ',1),2,'0'),
        -- 提取月并补零
        LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(start_date,'/',3),' ',1),2,'0') -- 提取日并补零
        ) AS start_date
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(end_date,1,4),LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(end_date,'/',2),' ',1),2,'0'),
        -- 提取月并补零
        LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(end_date,'/',3),' ',1),2,'0') -- 提取日并补零
        ) AS end_date
        ,base_price_with_tax
        ,base_price_without_tax
        ,rsp_with_tax
        ,rsp_without_tax
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(create_time,1,4),'-',LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(create_time,'/',2),' ',1),2,'0'),
        -- 提取月并补零
        '-',LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(create_time,'/',3),' ',1),2,'0') -- 提取日并补零
        ,' ',SPLIT_PART(create_time,' ',2)) AS create_time
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,4),'-',LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(modify_time,'/',2),' ',1),2,'0'),
        -- 提取月并补零
        '-',LPAD(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(modify_time,'/',3),' ',1),2,'0') -- 提取日并补零
        ,' ',SPLIT_PART(create_time,' ',2)) AS modify_time
        ,'1' as flag
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_master_data_product_price_temp_01
) t left join (
    select day_id,'1' as flag from dme_cdm.dim_day where day_id>='20200101' and day_id<='${uddate}'
) t1 on t.flag = t1.flag and t1.day_id >= t.start_date and t1.day_id<=t.end_date
) t2 where day_id is not null and rn=1

        cast(if(traded_amount_index_pop rlike '%',replace(traded_amount_index_pop,'%','')/100,traded_amount_index_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_amount_index_pop	, --成交金额指数环比(月)
        cast(traded_products_index as decimal(28,6)) as traded_products_index	, --成交件数指数
        cast(if(traded_products_index_pop rlike '%',replace(traded_products_index_pop,'%','')/100,traded_products_index_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_products_index_pop	, --成交件数指数环比(月)
        cast(traded_conversion_rate as decimal(28,6)) as traded_conversion_rate	, --成交转化率
        cast(if(traded_conversion_rate_pop rlike '%',replace(traded_conversion_rate_pop,'%','')/100,traded_conversion_rate_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_conversion_rate_pop	, --成交转化率环比(月)
        cast(traded_customer_unit_price as decimal(28,6)) as traded_customer_unit_price	, --成交客单价
        cast(if(traded_customer_unit_price_pop rlike '%',replace(traded_customer_unit_price_pop,'%','')/100,traded_customer_unit_price_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_customer_unit_price_pop	, --成交客单价环比(月)
        cast(brand_nums as decimal(28,6)) as brand_nums	, --品牌数
        cast(if(brand_nums_pop rlike '%',replace(brand_nums_pop,'%','')/100,brand_nums_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as brand_nums_pop	, --品牌数环比(月)
        cast(visited_brands as decimal(28,6)) as visited_brands	, --被访问品牌数
        cast(if(visited_brands_pop rlike '%',replace(visited_brands_pop,'%','')/100,visited_brands_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as visited_brands_pop	, --被访问品牌数环比(月)
        cast(dynamic_brands as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_brands	, --动销品牌数
        cast(if(dynamic_brands_pop rlike '%',replace(dynamic_brands_pop,'%','')/100,dynamic_brands_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_brands_pop	, --动销品牌数环比(月)
        cast(store_nums as decimal(28,6)) as store_nums	, --店铺数
        cast(if(store_nums_pop rlike '%',replace(store_nums_pop,'%','')/100,store_nums_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as store_nums_pop	, --店铺数环比(月)
        cast(visited_stores as decimal(28,6)) as visited_stores	, --被访问店铺数
        cast(if(visited_stores_pop rlike '%',replace(visited_stores_pop,'%','')/100,visited_stores_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as visited_stores_pop	, --被访问店铺数环比(月)
        cast(dynamic_stores as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_stores	, --动销店铺数
        cast(if(dynamic_stores_pop rlike '%',replace(dynamic_stores_pop,'%','')/100,dynamic_stores_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_stores_pop	, --动销店铺数环比(月)
        cast(visited_products as decimal(28,6)) as visited_products	, --被访问商品数
        cast(if(visited_products_pop rlike '%',replace(visited_products_pop,'%','')/100,visited_products_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as visited_products_pop	, --被访问商品数环比(月)
        cast(dynamic_products as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_products	, --动销商品数
        cast(if(dynamic_products_pop rlike '%',replace(dynamic_products_pop,'%','')/100,dynamic_products_pop) as decimal(28,6)) as dynamic_products_pop	, --动销商品数环比(月)
        third_category_tp	, --三级类目
        dense_rank() over(partition by data_date order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
    from ${dme_ods}.s_industry_index_merchantv_month_kunchi
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_industry_index_merchantv_month_kunchi')
) t
left join (
    select 
        sub_category,
        category
    from (
        select 
            sub_category,

            ROW_NUMBER() over(partition by sub_category order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_category_mapping_kunchi t -- 品类mapping表   取历史所有分区数据,按照子品类取最新上传的一条
        where t.ds>0
    ) a where rn=1
) t5
on t.third_category_tp=t5.sub_category

create table ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_00 as

        avg_prop, -- 均占比

-- 当月没数据，取不为空的上一个月的填充
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_01 as
select 
    a.month as data_months,
    nvl(a.parent_sku_code,b.parent_sku_code) as parent_sku_code,
    nvl(a.sku_code,b.sku_code) as sku_code,
    nvl(a.sku_qty,b.sku_qty) as sku_qty,
    nvl(a.avg_prop,b.avg_prop) as avg_prop,
    nvl(a.shop_code,b.shop_code) as shop_code,
    nvl(a.ec,b.ec) as ec,
    a.last_month as last_month
from (
    select 
        a.month as month,
        b.data_months as data_months,
        b.parent_sku_code as parent_sku_code,
        b.sku_code as sku_code,
        b.sku_qty as sku_qty,
        b.avg_prop as avg_prop,
        b.shop_code as shop_code,
        b.ec as ec ,
        LAST_VALUE(b.data_months,true) over(order by a.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as last_month
    from (
        select 
        month_id as month 
        from dme_cdm.dim_day
        where day_id >='20240101' and day_id<='${bizdate}'
        group by month_id
    ) a 
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_00 b
    on a.month=b.data_months
) a 
left join ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_00 b 
on case when a.data_months is not null then 1=0
else a.last_month=b.data_months end
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_02

create table ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_02 as 
select 
    data_months,
    shop_code,
    plat_prod_code,
    sku_code, --子KSU
    prod_qty,
    ec,
    henkel_prod_barcode,
    data_source,
    sum(prod_qty) over(partition by data_months,shop_code,plat_prod_code) as prod_qty_ttl,
    count(henkel_prod_barcode) over(partition by data_months,shop_code,plat_prod_code,sku_code) as prod_nums_ttl -- 子sku下产品个数，用于均占比分摊
from(
    select *,
        DENSE_RANK() over (partition by data_months,shop_code,plat_prod_code order by rk asc) as rn 
    from (
    --先获取父SKU对应的产品条码
        SELECT   
            t.data_months as data_months,
            t.shop_code as shop_code,
            t.parent_sku_code as plat_prod_code,
            t.sku_code,
            sum(nvl(t.sku_qty,t1.prod_qty)) as prod_qty,
            t.ec,
            t1.henkel_prod_barcode,
            '主子mapping表' as data_source,
            '1' as rk --排序使用,如果主SKUcode和dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping出现相同的编码,优先取主子mapping表
        FROM  ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_01 t
        left join  (
            SELECT  
                shop_id,
                plat_prod_code,
                henkel_prod_barcode,
                sum(prod_qty) as prod_qty,
                ec
            FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
            WHERE ds = MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
            AND LENGTH(henkel_prod_barcode) =13
            AND ec = 'e002'
            AND shop_id IN ('102','103','104','108','107','10231339','910','911')
            group by shop_id,
                plat_prod_code,
                henkel_prod_barcode,
                ec
        ) t1
        ON  t.sku_code = t1.plat_prod_code
        AND t.shop_code = t1.shop_id
        AND t.ec = t1.ec
        group by t.data_months,
                t.shop_code,
                t.parent_sku_code,
                t.sku_code,
                t.ec,
                t1.henkel_prod_barcode
        union all  
        SELECT 
            a.month as data_months, 
            b.shop_id as shop_code,
            b.plat_prod_code,
            b.plat_prod_code as sku_code,
            sum(b.prod_qty) as prod_qty,
            b.ec,
            b.henkel_prod_barcode,
            '鲲驰产品mapping表' as data_source,
            '2' as rk 
        FROM  (
            select 
            month_id as month ,
            '1' as flag
            from dme_cdm.dim_day
            where day_id >='20240101' and day_id<='${bizdate}'
            group by month_id
        ) a
        join  (
            select 
                shop_id,
                plat_prod_code,
                prod_qty,
                ec,
                henkel_prod_barcode,
                '1' as flag
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
            WHERE  ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
            AND ec = 'e002'
            AND shop_id IN ('102','103','104','108','107','10231339','910','911')
            AND LENGTH(henkel_prod_barcode) =13
        ) b
        on a.flag=b.flag
        group by a.month, 
            b.shop_id,
            b.plat_prod_code,
            b.ec,
            b.henkel_prod_barcode
        
    ) o 
) m where rn=1

--计算均占比
insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping partition (ds)
SELECT  
        t1.data_months,
        t1.shop_code,
        t1.plat_prod_code,
        t1.prod_qty,
        t1.henkel_prod_barcode,
        case when t1.data_source = '主子mapping表' then t2.avg_prop * (1/if(nvl(t1.prod_nums_ttl,0)=0,1,t1.prod_nums_ttl))
            when t1.data_source = '鲲驰产品mapping表' then (1/if(nvl(t1.prod_nums_ttl,0)=0,1,t1.prod_nums_ttl))
            end as avg_prop,
        t4.product_base_price as product_base_price,
        case when SUM(nvl(t4.product_base_price,0)*t1.prod_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.data_months,t1.shop_code,t1.plat_prod_code) =0  then t1.prod_qty/if(nvl(t1.prod_qty_ttl,0)=0,1,t1.prod_qty_ttl)
            when nvl(t4.product_base_price,0) = 0 then 0
            else nvl(t4.product_base_price*t1.prod_qty / SUM(nvl(t4.product_base_price,0)*t1.prod_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.data_months,t1.shop_code,t1.plat_prod_code),0)
            end  AS base_price_rate,
        t1.data_source,
        t1.ec,
        t1.data_months as ds
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_02 t1
LEFT JOIN  ${dme_cdm}.dim_ecom_product_prop_mapping_temp_01 t2
ON      t1.plat_prod_code = t2.parent_sku_code
AND     t1.shop_code = t2.shop_code
AND     t1.sku_code = t2.sku_code
AND     t1.data_months = t2.data_months
left join
(
    select
        substr(ds,1,6) as month,
        product_barcode,
        product_base_price
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds <>''
    -- and nvl(product_base_price,0) <>0
    group by substr(ds,1,6),product_barcode,product_base_price
) t4 on  t1.henkel_prod_barcode= t4.product_barcode 
and t1.data_months= t4.month

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_tm_activity_type PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  distinct
        nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id
        ,nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as  store_name
        ,t.start_date
        ,t.end_date
        ,t.activity_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  shop_id --处理时间格式,防止手工文件时间上传不规范
                    ,SUBSTR(
                           CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) END
                           ,
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) END
                           )
                    ,1,8) AS start_date --活动开始时间
                    ,SUBSTR(
                           CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) END
                           ,
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) END
                           )
                    ,1,8) AS end_date --活动结束时间
                    ,upper(activity_type) AS activity_type
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ecom_tm_activity_type_new
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ecom_tm_activity_type_new')
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu

    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1

        ,CAST(AVG(REPLACE(rsp,',','')) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp
        ,CAST(SUM(REPLACE(payment_amount,',','')) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS payment_amount

         ,idh
         ,shop_id
         ,data_month

            SELECT  product_id
                    ,NVL(idh,'-110') AS idh
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(rsp,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(payment_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS payment_amount
                    ,shop_id
                    ,tags
                    ,data_month
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id,NVL(idh,'-110'),data_month ORDER BY ds DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_product_mapping
            WHERE   ds <> ''

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_02 AS
SELECT  t.* --当销额为0,按SKU个数分摊
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.payment_amount_ttl = 0 THEN 1 / t2.idh_cnt
                ELSE t.payment_amount / t1.payment_amount_ttl
        END AS payment_amount_rate
FROM    (
            SELECT  ec
                    ,product_id
                    ,idh
                    ,payment_amount
                    ,tags
                    ,data_month
                    ,shop_id
                    ,category_name
                    ,brand_name
                    ,product_line
                    ,product_function
                    ,sub_product_function
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,product_name
                    ,retail_price_tax
                    ,key_product_line_name
                    ,sub_key_product_line_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_01
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                ----获取单个SPU的总销额
                SELECT  ec
                        ,product_id
                        ,shop_id
                        ,data_month
                        ,SUM(payment_amount) AS payment_amount_ttl
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_01
                GROUP BY ec
                         ,product_id
                         ,shop_id
                         ,data_month
            ) t1
ON      t.ec = t1.ec
AND     t.product_id = t1.product_id
AND     t.shop_id = t1.shop_id
AND     t.data_month = t1.data_month
LEFT JOIN   (
                --获取单个SPU包含SKU的个数
                SELECT  ec
                        ,product_id
                        ,shop_id
                        ,data_month
                        ,COUNT(1) AS idh_cnt
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_01
                GROUP BY ec
                         ,product_id
                         ,shop_id
                         ,data_month
            ) t2
ON      t.ec = t2.ec
AND     t.product_id = t2.product_id
AND     t.shop_id = t2.shop_id
AND     t.data_month = t2.data_month

-- --实现如当前月份没有数据,用上一个月有数据的补充
--获取连续月
WITH months AS 
(
    SELECT  month_id AS month
    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
    WHERE   day_id >= '20200101'
    AND     day_id <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY month_id
)
--获取每月是否有值
,aggregated_data AS 
(
    SELECT  data_month AS month
            ,shop_id
            ,COUNT(1) AS value
    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_02
    GROUP BY data_month
             ,shop_id
)
--连续月与有值月合并
,combined AS 
(
    SELECT  t.month
            ,t1.shop_id
            ,t2.value
    FROM    (
                SELECT  '1' AS flag
                        ,month
                FROM    months
            ) t
    JOIN    (
                SELECT  '1' AS flag
                        ,shop_id
                FROM    aggregated_data
                GROUP BY shop_id
            ) t1
    ON      t.flag = t1.flag
    LEFT JOIN aggregated_data t2
    ON      t1.shop_id = t2.shop_id
    AND     t.month = t2.month
)
--获取最近一个有值月份
,with_last_non_null AS 
(
    SELECT  month
            ,value
            ,shop_id
            ,MAX(IF(value IS NOT NULL,month,NULL)) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS last_non_null_month
    FROM    combined
) --用最近一个有值月份补充
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  m.ec
        ,m.product_id
        ,m.tags
        ,nvl(t1.store_code,m.shop_id) as shop_id
        ,m.category_name
        ,m.product_function
        ,m.sub_product_function
        ,m.brand_name
        ,m.product_line
        ,case when upper(d.main_brand) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'Consumer'
            when upper(d.main_brand) in ('SKP','SP') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'Professional'
            when upper(d.main_brand) in ('VS') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'VS'
            else m.bu_1 end as bu_1
        ,case when d.main_brand is not null and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then d.main_brand
            else m.bu_2 end as bu_2
        ,m.key_product_line_name
        ,m.sub_key_product_line_name
        ,case when m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'shopping voucher'
            else m.product_barcode end as product_barcode
        ,MAX(m.product_name) AS product_name
        ,CAST(AVG(m.retail_price_tax) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) AS retail_price_tax
        ,SUM(m.payment_amount_rate) AS payment_amount_rate
        ,CAST(SUM(m.payment_amount) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) AS payment_amount
        ,m.data_month
FROM    (
            SELECT  t1.ec
                    ,t1.product_id
                    ,t1.idh
                    ,t1.tags
                    ,t1.shop_id
                    ,t1.category_name
                    ,t1.product_function
                    ,t1.sub_product_function
                    ,t1.brand_name
                    ,t1.product_line
                    ,t1.bu_1
                    ,t1.bu_2
                    ,t1.key_product_line_name
                    ,t1.sub_key_product_line_name
                    ,t1.product_barcode
                    ,t1.product_name
                    ,t1.retail_price_tax
                    ,t1.payment_amount_rate
                    ,t1.payment_amount
                    ,t.month AS data_month
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  month
                                ,last_non_null_month
                                ,shop_id
                        FROM    with_last_non_null
                        WHERE   value IS NULL
                        AND     shop_id IS NOT NULL
                    ) t
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  *
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_02
                        ) t1
            ON      t.last_non_null_month = t1.data_month
            AND     t.shop_id = t1.shop_id
            WHERE   t1.shop_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  ec
                    ,product_id
                    ,idh
                    ,tags
                    ,shop_id
                    ,category_name
                    ,product_function
                    ,sub_product_function
                    ,brand_name
                    ,product_line
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,key_product_line_name
                    ,sub_key_product_line_name
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,product_name
                    ,retail_price_tax
                    ,payment_amount_rate
                    ,payment_amount
                    ,data_month
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping_temp_02
) m
left join (
    select store_code , -- 店铺编码
        main_brand -- 主营品牌
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_store_main_brand_mapping
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_store_main_brand_mapping')
) d on m.shop_id = d.store_code
LEFT JOIN   (

    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON m.shop_id = t1.ec_store_code_tp
GROUP BY ec
         ,product_id
         ,tags
         ,nvl(t1.store_code,m.shop_id)
         ,category_name
         ,product_function
         ,sub_product_function
         ,brand_name
         ,product_line
         ,case when upper(d.main_brand) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'Consumer'
            when upper(d.main_brand) in ('SKP','SP') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'Professional'
            when upper(d.main_brand) in ('VS') and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'VS'
            else m.bu_1 end
        ,case when d.main_brand is not null and m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then d.main_brand
            else m.bu_2 end
         ,key_product_line_name
         ,sub_key_product_line_name
         ,case when m.tags REGEXP '购物金' then 'shopping voucher'
            else m.product_barcode end
         ,data_month

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_fcst_sales_temp01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_fcst_sales_temp01 AS
SELECT  t.fcst_date
        ,t.channel
        ,CONCAT(t.years,
               DECODE(t.months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')
        ) AS months
        ,t.years
        ,t.customer_idh
        ,t.bu AS bu_2
        ,NVL(t.ges,0) AS ges
        ,NVL(t.ppd,0) AS ppd
        ,NVL(t.pld,0) AS pld
        ,NVL(t.fg,0) AS fg
        ,NVL(t.l6a_others,0) AS l6a_others
        ,NVL(t.l6b_others,0) AS l6b_others
        ,NVL(t.ppd,0) + NVL(t.pld,0) + NVL(t.fg,0) + NVL(t.l6a_others,0) AS l6a
        ,NVL(t.ca,0) AS ca
        ,NVL(t.listing_fee,0) AS listing_fee
        ,NVL(t.rebate,0) AS rebate
        ,NVL(t.logistics,0) AS logistics_fee
        ,NVL(t.int_agreement,0) AS int_agreement
        ,NVL(t.oos_penalty,0) AS oos
        ,NVL(t.promotion_activities,0) AS promotion_activities
        ,NVL(t.ka_expense,0) AS ka_expense
        ,NVL(t.ca,0) + NVL(t.rebate,0) + NVL(t.ka_expense,0) + NVL(t.listing_fee,0) + NVL(t.promotion_activities,0) + NVL(t.logistics,0) + NVL(t.oos_penalty,0) + NVL(t.int_agreement,0) + NVL(t.l6b_py_release,0) + NVL(t.deduction,0) + NVL(t.ror,0) + NVL(t.l6b_others,0) AS l6b
        ,NVL(t.l6b_py_release,0) AS l6b_py_release
        ,NVL(t.l17_py_release,0) AS l17_py_release
        ,NVL(t.l17_allocated,0) AS l17_allocated
        ,NVL(t.ror,0) AS ror
        ,NVL(t.deduction,0) AS deduction
        ,NVL(t.l10_service_fee,0) AS l10_service_fee --L10服务商费用
        ,NVL(t.o2o,0) + NVL(t.ba,0) + NVL(t.l17,0) + NVL(t.l17_py_release,0) + NVL(t.ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot,0) + NVL(t.ec_live_streaming,0) + NVL(t.ec_customer_service_fee,0) + NVL(t.ec_in_site_self_broadcast,0) + NVL(t.ec_crm_operation_service_fee,0) + NVL(t.ec_content_purchase_content_production,0) + NVL(t.ec_data_service_fee,0) + NVL(t.ec_gift_giveaway,0) + NVL(t.ec_others,0) + NVL(t.ec_not_allocated,0) AS l17_channel
        ,NVL(t.ba,0) AS l17_ba
        ,NVL(t.pos_gmv_untax,0) AS pos_gmv_pre_untax
        ,NVL(t.o2o,0) AS l17_o2o
        ,NVL(t.l17,0) AS l17_channel_specific
        ,NVL(t.ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot,0) AS l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot
        ,NVL(t.ec_live_streaming,0) AS l17_ec_live_streaming
        ,NVL(t.ec_customer_service_fee,0) AS l17_ec_customer_service_fee
        ,NVL(t.ec_in_site_self_broadcast,0) AS l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast
        ,NVL(t.ec_crm_operation_service_fee,0) AS l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee
        ,NVL(t.ec_content_purchase_content_production,0) AS l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production
        ,NVL(t.ec_data_service_fee,0) AS l17_ec_data_service_fee
        ,NVL(t.ec_gift_giveaway,0) AS l17_ec_gift_giveaway
        ,NVL(t.ec_others,0) AS l17_ec_others
        ,NVL(t.ec_not_allocated,0) AS l17_ec_not_allocated
        ,NVL(t.pos_gmv_promotional_untax,0) AS pos_gmv_promotional_untax
        ,NVL(t.pos_gmv_untax,0) - NVL(t.pos_gmv_promotional_untax,0) AS normal
        ,NVL(t.ges,0) - (
                    NVL(t.ppd,0) + NVL(t.pld,0) + NVL(t.fg,0) + NVL(t.l6a_others,0)
        ) AS ngs
        ,NVL(t.ges,0) - (
                    NVL(t.ppd,0) + NVL(t.pld,0) + NVL(t.fg,0) + NVL(t.l6a_others,0)
        ) - (
                    NVL(t.ca,0) + NVL(t.rebate,0) + NVL(t.ka_expense,0) + NVL(t.listing_fee,0) + NVL(t.promotion_activities,0) + NVL(t.logistics,0) + NVL(t.oos_penalty,0) + NVL(t.int_agreement,0) + NVL(t.l6b_py_release,0) + NVL(t.deduction,0) + NVL(t.ror,0) + NVL(t.l6b_others,0)
        ) AS nes
        ,NVL(t.ppd,0) + NVL(t.pld,0) + NVL(t.fg,0) + NVL(t.l6a_others,0) + NVL(t.ca,0) + NVL(t.rebate,0) + NVL(t.ka_expense,0) + NVL(t.listing_fee,0) + NVL(t.promotion_activities,0) + NVL(t.logistics,0) + NVL(t.oos_penalty,0) + NVL(t.int_agreement,0) + NVL(t.l6b_py_release,0) + NVL(t.deduction,0) + NVL(t.ror,0) + NVL(t.l6b_others,0) AS l6_ttl
        ,NULL AS initial_inv_value
        ,NULL AS final_inv_value
        ,NULL AS financial_swc_inv_value
        ,NVL(mini_inv,0) AS mini_inv_value
        ,t.data_source
FROM    (
            --判空前先强转一下,防止来源数据有非数字格式
            SELECT  bu
                    ,fcst_date
                    ,channel
                    ,customer_idh
                    ,years
                    ,months
                    ,CAST(ges AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ges
                    ,CAST(ppd AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ppd
                    ,CAST(pld AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pld
                    ,CAST(fg AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS fg
                    ,CAST(l6a_others AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6a_others
                    ,CAST(ngs AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ngs
                    ,CAST(ca AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ca
                    ,CAST(rebate AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rebate
                    ,CAST(ka_expense AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ka_expense
                    ,CAST(listing_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS listing_fee
                    ,CAST(promotion_activities AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS promotion_activities
                    ,CAST(logistics AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS logistics
                    ,CAST(oos_penalty AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS oos_penalty
                    ,CAST(int_agreement AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS int_agreement
                    ,CAST(deduction AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS deduction
                    ,CAST(ror AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ror
                    ,CAST(l6b_others AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6b_others
                    ,CAST(nes AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS nes
                    ,CAST(l10_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l10_service_fee
                    ,CAST(l17_channel AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_channel
                    ,CAST(o2o AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS o2o
                    ,CAST(ba AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ba
                    ,CAST(l17 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_live_streaming AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_live_streaming
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_customer_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_customer_service_fee
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_in_site_self_broadcast AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_in_site_self_broadcast
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_crm_operation_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_crm_operation_service_fee
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_content_purchase_content_production AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_content_purchase_content_production
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_data_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_data_service_fee
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_gift_giveaway AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_gift_giveaway
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_others AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_others
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = 'ec_fcst' THEN CAST(ec_not_allocated AS DECIMAL(28,6))
                            ELSE 0
                    END AS ec_not_allocated
                    ,CAST(pos_gmv_untax AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pos_gmv_untax
                    ,CAST(pos_gmv_promotional_untax AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pos_gmv_promotional_untax

                    ,CAST(l6b_py_release AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6b_py_release
                    ,CAST(l17_py_release AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_py_release
                    ,CAST(l17_allocated AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_allocated
                    ,data_source
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  *
                                ,0 AS l6b_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_allocated
                                ,'nka_fcst' AS data_source
                                ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
                        FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_nka_sales_bts
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_nka_sales_bts')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  *

                                ,0 AS l17_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_allocated
                                ,'mpd_fcst' AS data_source
                                ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
                        FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_mpd_sales_bts

                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')

                        SELECT  *

                                ,0 AS l17_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_allocated
                                ,'dt_fcst' AS data_source
                                ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
                        FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_dt_sales_bts
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_dt_sales_bts')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  *
                                ,0 AS l6b_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_py_release
                                ,0 AS l17_allocated
                                ,'ec_fcst' AS data_source
                                ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
                        FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_ecom_sales_bts
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_ecom_sales_bts')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
                        -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
                    ) o
            WHERE   rn = 1 and LENGTH(fcst_date)=8
        ) t
UNION ALL

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_gr55_temp_02 AS
-- Fcst
SELECT  a.fcst_date
        ,b.channel
        ,CONCAT(a.years,

        ,CAST(NVL(a.operating_income,0) AS DECIMAL) AS operating_income
        ,CAST(NVL(a.operating_charges,0) AS DECIMAL) AS operating_charges
        ,CAST(NVL(a.restruct_charges,0) AS DECIMAL) AS restruct_charges
        ,CAST(NVL(a.a_reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) AS DECIMAL) AS reg_mgmt_costsbu
        ,'gr55_fcst' AS data_source
FROM    (
            SELECT  'v_ttl' AS customer_idh
                    ,*
                    ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_bts

            -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
            -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
            and LENGTH(fcst_date)=8
        ) a
INNER JOIN  (
                SELECT  DISTINCT 
                        channel
                        ,customer_idh
                        ,bu_2
                        ,bu_1
                        ,channel_lastest
                        ,customer_idh_lastest
                        ,months
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
                where customer_idh ='v_ttl'
                and bu_2 = 'v_bu'
            ) b
ON      a.customer_idh = b.customer_idh
AND     a.bu = b.bu_1
AND     substr(a.fcst_date,1,6) = b.months
WHERE   a.rn = 1

union all 
   
-- ACT
SELECT 
     b.fcst_date
    ,b.channel
    ,b.months AS months
    ,substr(b.months,1,4)  as  years
    ,b.customer_idh
    ,b.channel_lastest
    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
    ,b.bu_1
    ,b.bu_2
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.blockcosts_bu,0)      AS DECIMAL))  AS blockcosts_bu
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.operating_income,0)   AS DECIMAL))  AS operating_income
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.operating_charges,0)  AS DECIMAL))  AS operating_charges
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.restruct_charges,0)   AS DECIMAL))  AS restruct_charges
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.a_reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) AS DECIMAL))  AS reg_mgmt_costsbu
    ,'gr55_actual' AS data_source
from 
(
    SELECT distinct t1.fcst_date
       ,t2.channel
       ,t2.customer_idh
       ,t2.bu_2
       ,t2.bu_1
       ,t2.channel_lastest
       ,t2.customer_idh_lastest
       ,t2.months
    from 
    (
       SELECT distinct t1.fcst_date 
       FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_fcst_sales_temp01 t1
      )t1
    left join 
    (
     SELECT  DISTINCT 
             channel
            ,customer_idh
            ,bu_2
            ,bu_1
            ,channel_lastest
            ,customer_idh_lastest
            ,months
    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
    where customer_idh ='v_ttl'
    ) t2
     on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4) = substr(t2.months,1,4)
    where t2.months < substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)
    and substr(t2.months,1,4) = substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4)
)b
left join 
(
    SELECT  'v_ttl' AS customer_idh
       ,*
       ,CONCAT(a.years,CASE a.months WHEN 'Jan' THEN '01' WHEN 'Feb' THEN '02' WHEN 'Mar' THEN '03' WHEN 'Apr' THEN '04' WHEN 'May' THEN '05' WHEN 'Jun' THEN '06' WHEN 'Jul' THEN '07' WHEN 'Aug' THEN '08' WHEN 'Sep' THEN '09' WHEN 'Oct' THEN '10' WHEN 'Nov' THEN '11' WHEN 'Dec' THEN '12' ELSE NULL END) AS month_
       ,case when profit_center_id in ('841110','841630')          then 'Consumer'
             when profit_center_id in ('845630','845110','845120') then 'Professional'
             when profit_center_id in ('841550')                   then  'VS'  end  as  bu_1
       ,case when profit_center_id in ('841110','841630','845630','841550')  then 'v_bu'
             when profit_center_id in ('845110')  then 'SKP'
             when profit_center_id in ('845120')  then 'SP' end  as  bu_2
       ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY profit_center_id,years,months ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
       ,1  as  flag
    FROM ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts a
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts')
) a
ON  a.customer_idh = b.customer_idh
AND a.bu_1 = b.bu_1
AND a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
AND a.month_  = b.months
and a.rn = 1
group by b.fcst_date
    ,b.channel
    ,b.months 
    ,substr(b.months,1,4)  
    ,b.customer_idh
    ,b.channel_lastest
    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
    ,b.bu_1
    ,b.bu_2

SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date

--- 如果某个渠道存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
--- 先做出每个渠道应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp AS
SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
        ,non_latest --是否本周期未上传
        ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
        ,data_source
FROM    (
            SELECT  t1.fcst_date
                    ,t1.data_source
                    ,t1.non_latest --是否本周期未上传
                    ,CASE   WHEN t1.non_latest = 'N' THEN t1.fcst_date
                            ELSE t2.fcst_date
                    END AS fcst_date_copy
                    ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fcst_date,t1.non_latest,t1.data_source ORDER BY CASE   WHEN t1.non_latest = 'N' THEN t1.fcst_date
                            ELSE t2.fcst_date
                    END DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  DISTINCT t2.fcst_date AS fcst_date
                                ,t2.data_source
                                ,CASE   WHEN t1.fcst_date IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                                        ELSE 'N'
                                END AS non_latest --是否本周期未上传
                        FROM    (
                                    SELECT  DISTINCT b.fcst_date AS fcst_date
                                            ,a.data_source
                                    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp05 a
                                    LEFT JOIN   (
                                                    SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                                                            ,1 AS flag
                                                            ,1 AS rn
                                                    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp05
                                                ) b
                                    ON      CASE   WHEN a.customer_idh IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                                    END = b.flag
                                    AND     b.rn = 1
                                    WHERE   b.fcst_date >= a.fcst_date
                                ) t2
                        LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp05 t1
                        ON      t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
                        AND     NVL(t1.data_source,'') = NVL(t2.data_source,'')
                    ) t1
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                                    ,data_source
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp05
                        ) t2
            ON      NVL(t1.data_source,'') = NVL(t2.data_source,'')
            AND     t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
        ) t
WHERE   rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp07

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_tmp07 AS
-- 合并所有fcst指标
SELECT  t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.non_latest
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.months
        ,t1.years
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.channel_lastest
        ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,SUM(t2.ges) AS ges
        ,SUM(t2.ppd) AS ppd
        ,SUM(t2.pld) AS pld
        ,SUM(t2.fg) AS fg
        ,SUM(t2.l6a) AS l6a
        ,SUM(t2.l6a_others) AS l6a_others
        ,SUM(t2.l6b_others) AS l6b_others
        ,SUM(t2.ngs) AS ngs
        ,SUM(t2.ca) AS ca
        ,SUM(t2.listing_fee) AS listing_fee
        ,SUM(t2.rebate) AS rebate
        ,SUM(t2.logistics_fee) AS logistics_fee
        ,SUM(t2.int_agreement) AS int_agreement
        ,SUM(t2.oos) AS oos
        ,SUM(t2.promotion_activities) AS promotion_activities
        ,SUM(t2.ka_expense) AS ka_expense
        ,SUM(t2.l6b) AS l6b
        ,SUM(t2.l6b_py_release) AS l6b_py_release
        ,SUM(t2.l17_py_release) AS l17_py_release
        ,SUM(t2.ror) AS ror
        ,SUM(t2.deduction) AS deduction
        ,SUM(t2.nes) AS nes
        ,SUM(t2.l10_service_fee) AS l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
        ,SUM(t2.l17_channel) AS l17_channel -- L17 Channel
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ba) AS l17_ba -- L17 BA
        ,SUM(t2.pos_gmv_pre_untax) AS pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
        ,SUM(t2.l17_o2o) AS l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
        ,SUM(t2.l17_channel_specific) AS l17_channel_specific -- L17 (Channel Specific)
        ,SUM(t2.pos_gmv_promotional_untax) AS pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)-Promotional
        ,sum(t2.l6_ttl) as ttl_l6
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_others) AS l17_others
        ,SUM(t2.l17_allocated) AS l17_allocated
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_customer_service_fee) AS l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_data_service_fee) AS l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_gift_giveaway) AS l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_live_streaming) AS l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
        ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_not_allocated) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,SUM(t2.initial_inv_value) AS initial_inv_value -- 期初库存
        ,SUM(t2.final_inv_value) AS final_inv_value -- 期末库存
        ,SUM(t2.financial_swc_inv_value) AS financial_swc_inv_value -- 财务SWC
        ,sum(t2.mini_inv_value) AS mini_inv_value
        ,MAX(t3.l10_ges) AS l10_ges_rate
        ,MAX(t3.l11_ges) AS l11_ges_rate
        ,MAX(t3.cog_ges) AS cog_ges_rate
        ,MAX(t3.l16_nes) AS l16_nes_rate
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) + NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) AS TTL_L17
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.GES,0) * t3.l10_ges + NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) AS L10
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.GES,0) * t3.l11_ges) AS L11
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.GES,0) * t3.cog_ges) AS COG
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) * t3.l16_nes) AS L16
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) AS GP1 -- NES - L10 - L11 - COG - L16
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0)) AS Channel_GP2 -- GP1 - L17 Channel
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) AS gp2 -- 计算GP1 - TTL L17
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) AS C1 -- 计算，NES - L10 - L11 - COG
        ,cast (null as decimal)  as DBKK
        ,cast (null as decimal)  as L30
        ,cast (null as decimal)  as L31
        -- ,SUM(t4.blockcosts_bu) AS DBKK
        -- ,SUM(t4.operating_income) AS L30
        -- ,SUM(t4.operating_charges) AS L31
        -- ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
        --             NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        -- ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0) - NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0)) AS ebit_f_ac -- 计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) as ebit_f_ac
        --,SUM(t4.restruct_charges) AS drmc
        ,cast(null as decimal) as drmc
        -- ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
        --             NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        -- ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0) - NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0) - NVL(t4.restruct_charges,0)) AS ebit_f_reg -- 计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC
         ,SUM(NVL(t2.NES,0) - NVL(t2.GES,0) * (
                    NVL(t3.l10_ges,0) + NVL(t3.l11_ges,0) + NVL(t3.cog_ges,0)
        ) - NVL(t2.NES,0) * NVL(t3.l16_nes,0) - NVL(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Channel,0) - NVL(t2.L17_Allocated,0) ) AS ebit_f_reg -- 计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC
        -- ,SUM(t4.reg_mgmt_costsbu) AS l32
        ,cast (null as decimal)  as L32
        ,SUM(t2.normal) AS normal
        ,t2.data_source
        ,'N' AS is_adj
FROM    (
    SELECT  DISTINCT a.fcst_date
                    ,a.non_latest
                    ,b.channel
                    ,b.bu_1
                    ,b.bu_2
                    ,a.data_source
                    ,a.fcst_date_copy
                    ,c.months
                    ,SUBSTR(c.months,1,4) AS years
                    ,b.customer_idh
                    ,b.channel_lastest
                    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
            from (
                        select *,'1' as flag 
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp
                        ) a
            INNER JOIN  (
                            SELECT  *
                                    ,'1' AS flag
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
                            where customer_idh <>'v_ttl'
                        ) b
            ON      SUBSTR(a.fcst_date,1,6) = substr(b.months,1,6)
            inner join (
                select distinct fcst_date,months,'1' AS flag
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_fcst_sales_temp01
            ) c 
            on a.fcst_date_copy=c.fcst_date
            and a.flag=c.flag
        ) t1
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_fcst_sales_temp01 t2
ON      t1.fcst_date_copy = t2.fcst_date --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
--AND     t1.channel = t2.channel
AND     t1.months = t2.months
AND     t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
AND     NVL(t1.data_source,'') = NVL(t2.data_source,'')
AND     NVL(t1.customer_idh,'') = NVL(t2.customer_idh,'')
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  a.fcst_date
                        ,b.*
                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.fcst_date,b.bu,b.Channel,b.Customer_IDH ORDER BY b.Start_Date DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                                    ,'1' AS flag
                                    ,fcst_date_copy
                                    ,data_source
                                    ,case when data_source='dt_fcst' then 'Salon DT'
                                         when data_source='ec_fcst' then 'Ecom'
                                         when data_source='mpd_fcst' then 'MPD'
                                         when data_source='nka_fcst' then 'NKA'
                                     end as channel
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp
                            where data_source in ('dt_fcst','ec_fcst','mpd_fcst','nka_fcst')
                        ) a
                LEFT JOIN   (
                                SELECT  bu
                                        ,Start_Date
                                        ,channel
                                        ,customer_idh
                                        ,case when channel='DT' then 'Salon DT'
                                          else channel
                                         end as channel_new
                                        ,CAST(l10_ges AS DECIMAL) AS l10_ges
                                        ,CAST(l11_ges AS DECIMAL) AS l11_ges
                                        ,CAST(cog_ges AS DECIMAL) AS cog_ges
                                        ,CAST(l16_nes AS DECIMAL) AS l16_nes
                                        ,'1' AS flag
                                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bu,Channel,Start_Date,Customer_IDH ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn1
                                FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_controller_index_bts b
                                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_controller_index_bts')
                            ) b
                ON      a.flag = b.flag
                and   a.channel=b.channel_new
                AND     a.fcst_date_copy >= b.Start_Date
                AND     b.rn1 = 1
            ) t3
ON      t1.bu_2 = t3.bu
AND     t1.fcst_date = t3.fcst_date
--and     t1.channel = t3.channel --这个需要问下zoe
AND     T1.Customer_IDH = t3.Customer_IDH
AND     t3.rn = 1
GROUP BY t1.fcst_date
         ,t1.non_latest
         ,t1.channel
         ,t1.months
         ,t1.years
         ,t1.customer_idh
         ,t1.channel_lastest
         ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
         ,t1.bu_1
         ,t1.bu_2
         ,t2.data_source
UNION ALL -- 合并adj
SELECT  t2.fcst_date -- 预测日期
        ,NULL AS on_latest -- 是否本周期未上传
        ,t2.channel -- 快照渠道
        ,t2.months -- 月份
        ,t2.years -- 年
        ,t2.customer_idh -- 客户idh
        ,t2.channel_lastest -- 最新渠道
        ,t2.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
        ,t2.bu_1 -- bu_1
        ,t2.bu_2 -- bu_2
        ,SUM(t2.ges) AS ges -- 集团外毛销售额
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ppd -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pld -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS fg -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
        ,SUM(t2.l6a) AS l6a
        ,SUM(t2.l6a_others) AS l6a_others
        ,sum(t2.l6b_others) AS l6b_others
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0)) AS ngs -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ca -- 价差
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS listing_fee -- 进场费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS rebate -- 返利
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS logistics_fee -- 物流费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS int_agreement -- Int. Agreement
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS oos -- OSS
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS promotion_activities -- Promotion Activists
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ka_expense -- KA Expense
        ,SUM(t2.l6b) AS l6b -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
        ,SUM(t2.l6b_py_release) AS l6b_py_release
        ,SUM(t2.l17_py_release) AS l17_py_release --
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ror -- 递减
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS deduction -- Returned or Refunded，退货
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0)) AS nes -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
        ,sum(t2.l17_channel) AS l17_channel -- L17 Channel
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_ba -- L17 BA
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
        ,SUM(t2.l17_channel_specific) AS l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)-Promotional
        ,SUM(l6_ttl) AS ttl_l6 -- ttl_l6
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_other -- L17其他
        ,SUM(t2.l17_allocated) AS l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS initial_inv_value -- 期初库存
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS final_inv_value -- 期末库存
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS financial_swc_inv_value -- 财务SWC
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS mini_inv_value
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_ges_rate -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l11_ges_rate -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS cog_ges_rate -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l16_nes_rate -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.l17_channel,0) + NVL(t2.l17_allocated,0)) AS TTL_L17 -- TTL_L17
        ,SUM(t2.L10) AS L10 -- L10
        ,SUM(t2.L11) AS L11 -- L11
        ,SUM(t2.COG) AS COG -- COG
        ,SUM(t2.L16) AS L16 -- L16
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0) - NVL(t2.L16,0)) AS GP1 -- GP1
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0) - NVL(t2.L16,0) - NVL(t2.l17_channel,0)) AS Channel_GP2 -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0) - NVL(t2.L16,0) - NVL(t2.l17_channel,0)- NVL(t2.l17_allocated,0)) AS gp2 -- gp2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0)) AS C1 -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG  )
        ,SUM(t2.DBKK) AS DBKK -- DBKK
        ,SUM(t2.L30) AS L30 -- L30
        ,SUM(t2.L31) AS L31 -- L31
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0) - NVL(t2.L16,0) - NVL(t2.l17_channel,0) - NVL(t2.l17_allocated,0) - NVL(t2.DBKK,0) + NVL(t2.L30,0) - NVL(t2.L31,0)) AS ebit_f_ac -- ebit_f_ac(计算GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
        ,SUM(t2.drmc) AS drmc -- drmc
        ,SUM(NVL(t2.ges,0) - NVL(t2.l6a,0) - NVL(t2.l6b,0) - NVL(t2.L10,0) - NVL(t2.L11,0) - NVL(t2.COG,0) - NVL(t2.L16,0) - NVL(t2.l17_channel,0) - NVL(t2.l17_allocated,0) - NVL(t2.DBKK,0) + NVL(t2.L30,0) - NVL(t2.L31,0) - NVL(t2.drmc,0)) AS ebit_f_reg -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC-DRMC)
        ,SUM(t2.l32) AS l32 -- l32
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS normal
        ,t2.data_source -- fcst数据来源
        ,'Y' AS is_adj -- is_adj
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_adj_tmp03 t2
GROUP BY t2.fcst_date -- 预测日期
         ,t2.channel -- 快照渠道
         ,t2.months -- 月份
         ,t2.years -- 年
         ,t2.customer_idh -- 客户idh
         ,t2.channel_lastest -- 最新渠道
         ,t2.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
         ,t2.bu_1 -- bu_1
         ,t2.bu_2 -- bu_2
         ,t2.data_source -- fcst数据来源
union all 
SELECT  t1.fcst_date
        ,t4.non_latest
        ,t1.channel
        ,t4.months
        ,t4.years
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.channel_lastest
        ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ges
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ppd
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pld
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS fg
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6a
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6a_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ngs
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ca
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS listing_fee
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS rebate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS logistics_fee
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS int_agreement
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS oos
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS promotion_activities
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ka_expense
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b_py_release
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_py_release
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ror
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS deduction
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS nes
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_channel -- L17 Channel
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_ba -- L17 BA
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_channel_specific -- L17 (Channel Specific)
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)-Promotional
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ttl_l6
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS initial_inv_value -- 期初库存
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS final_inv_value -- 期末库存
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS financial_swc_inv_value -- 财务SWC
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS mini_inv_value
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l11_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS cog_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l16_nes_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS TTL_L17
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS L10
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS L11
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS COG

        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then t5.blockcosts_bu     else  t4.blockcosts_bu     end) AS DBKK
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then t5.operating_income  else  t4.operating_income  end) AS L30
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then t5.operating_charges else  t4.operating_charges end) AS L31
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then -NVL(t5.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t5.operating_income,0) - NVL(t5.operating_charges,0)  else  -NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0) end) AS ebit_f_ac -- 计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then t5.reg_mgmt_costsbu     else  t4.reg_mgmt_costsbu     end) AS drmc 
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then -NVL(t5.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t5.operating_income,0) - NVL(t5.operating_charges,0) - NVL(t5.reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) else  -NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0) - NVL(t4.reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) end) AS ebit_f_reg -- 计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC
        ,SUM(case when t4.months>t6.gr55_act_max_months and t4.months <= substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) then t5.restruct_charges     else  t4.restruct_charges     end) AS l32

        ,'N' AS is_adj

                                     ,bu_2
                                     ,channel

                                     ,customer_idh_lastest
                        ) m

LEFT JOIN   
(    
     SELECT  a.fcst_date
             ,CASE b.data_source = 'gr55_fcst'  WHEN a.fcst_date = b.fcst_date_gr55 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END AS non_latest
             ,b.*
             ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.fcst_date,b.data_source ORDER BY b.fcst_date_gr55 DESC ) AS rn
     FROM    (
                 SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                         ,'1' AS flag
                 FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp
             ) a
     LEFT JOIN   (
                     SELECT  fcst_date AS fcst_date_gr55
                             ,channel
                             ,months
                             ,years
                             ,customer_idh
                             ,channel_lastest
                             ,customer_idh_lastest
                             ,bu_1
                             ,bu_2
                             ,blockcosts_bu
                             ,operating_income
                             ,operating_charges
                             ,restruct_charges
                             ,reg_mgmt_costsbu
                             ,data_source
                             ,'1' AS flag
                     FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_gr55_temp_02
                 ) b
      ON a.flag = b.flag
     AND a.fcst_date >= b.fcst_date_gr55
     AND ((b.data_source = 'gr55_fcst' and substr(a.fcst_date,1,6) <= b.months ) OR (b.data_source = 'gr55_actual'))

LEFT JOIN
(  -- 用拉齐后的版本，取每个月最新版本的Fcst补ACT
    select *,DENSE_RANK()over(partition by months order by fcst_date desc) as rnn
    from (
         SELECT  a.fcst_date
             ,CASE b.data_source = 'gr55_fcst'  WHEN a.fcst_date = b.fcst_date_gr55 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END AS non_latest

     FROM    (
                 SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                         ,'1' AS flag
                 FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_sales_fcst_date_temp
             ) a
     LEFT JOIN   (
                     SELECT  fcst_date AS fcst_date_gr55
                             ,channel
                             ,months
                             ,years
                             ,customer_idh
                             ,channel_lastest
                             ,customer_idh_lastest
                             ,bu_1
                             ,bu_2
                             ,blockcosts_bu
                             ,operating_income
                             ,operating_charges
                             ,restruct_charges
                             ,reg_mgmt_costsbu
                             ,data_source
                             ,'1' AS flag
                     FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3_gr55_temp_02
                 ) b
      ON a.flag = b.flag
     AND a.fcst_date >= b.fcst_date_gr55
     AND (b.data_source = 'gr55_fcst' and substr(a.fcst_date,1,6) <= b.months )
    )aa
    where data_source = 'gr55_fcst'
      and months = substr(fcst_date,1,6)
) t5
ON  t4.months = t5.months
AND t1.bu_2 = t5.bu_2
AND t1.bu_1 = t5.bu_1
AND t5.rnn = 1
LEFT JOIN
(
    select '1' AS flag
          ,max(months)     as   gr55_act_max_months  -- 数据更新至（仅ACT）
     from(
        select
           create_time
          ,CONCAT(years,CASE months WHEN 'Jan' THEN '01' WHEN 'Feb' THEN '02' WHEN 'Mar' THEN '03' WHEN 'Apr' THEN '04' WHEN 'May' THEN '05' WHEN 'Jun' THEN '06' WHEN 'Jul' THEN '07' WHEN 'Aug' THEN '08' WHEN 'Sep' THEN '09' WHEN 'Oct' THEN '10' WHEN 'Nov' THEN '11' WHEN 'Dec' THEN '12' ELSE NULL END) AS months
          ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY profit_center_id,years,months ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts')
     )
    where rn=1
) t6
ON  t1.flag = t6.flag 
-- where t4.months is not null 
GROUP BY t1.fcst_date
        ,t4.non_latest
        ,t1.channel
        ,t4.months
        ,t4.years
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.channel_lastest
        ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,t4.data_source

        ,CAST(t1.l17_gift_items AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,CAST(t1.l17_live_streaming AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,CAST(t1.l17_content_purchase_and_production AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作

        ,CAST(t1.final_inv_value AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS final_inv_value -- 期末库存
        ,CAST(t1.financial_swc_inv_value AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS financial_swc_inv_value -- 财务SWC
        ,CAST(t1.mini_inv_value AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS mini_inv_value

        ,CAST(t1.l11_ges_rate AS DECIMAL(38,16)) AS l11_ges_rate -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(t1.cog_ges_rate AS DECIMAL(38,16)) AS cog_ges_rate -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(t1.l16_nes_rate AS DECIMAL(38,16)) AS l16_nes_rate -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(t1.TTL_L17 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS TTL_L17 -- TTL_L17
        ,CAST(t1.L10 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS L10 -- L10
        ,CAST(t1.L11 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS L11 -- L11
        ,CAST(t1.COG AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS COG -- COG
        ,CAST(t1.L16 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS L16 -- L16
        ,CAST(t1.GP1 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS GP1 -- GP1
        ,CAST(t1.Channel_GP2 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS Channel_GP2 -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
        ,CAST(t1.gp2 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS gp2 -- gp2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
        ,CAST(t1.C1 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS C1 -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG  )
        ,CAST(t1.DBKK AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS DBKK -- DBKK
        ,CAST(t1.L30 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS L30 -- L30
        ,CAST(t1.L31 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS L31 -- L31
        ,CAST(t1.ebit_f_ac AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ebit_f_ac -- ebit_f_ac(计算GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
        ,CAST(t1.drmc AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS drmc -- drmc
        ,CAST(t1.ebit_f_reg AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ebit_f_reg -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC-DRMC)
        ,CAST(t1.l32 AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l32 -- l32
        ,CAST(t1.normal AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS normal -- l32

        ,nvl(t2.channel_customer_Permission,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,nvl(t2.region_customer_Permission,'Others_Others')  as region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

      SELECT  customer_idh

              ,bu_2
              ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
              ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

              ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
              ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
 ) t2

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_store_traffic_ex_tms PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.stat_date --日期
        ,nvl(t2.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id --店铺id
        ,nvl(t2.store_name,'Others') as shop_name --店铺名称
        ,t.original_first_channel_name --原始一级来源
        ,t.original_second_channel_name --原始二级来源
        ,t.original_third_channel_name --原始三级来源
        ,t1.first_channel_name --展示一级来源
        ,t1.second_channel_name --展示二级来源
        ,t.visitors --访客数
        ,t.pay_peoples --支付买家数
        ,t.pay_conversion_rate --支付转化率
        ,t.pay_amount --支付金额
        ,t.unit_price --客单价
        ,t.uv_value --UV价值
        ,t.direct_pay_peoples --直接支付买家数
        ,t.favor_pay_peoples --收藏支付买家数
        ,t.fans_pay_peoples --粉丝支付买家数
        ,t.cart_pay_peoples --加购支付买家数
        ,t.grass_pay_peoples --种草成交人数
        ,t.grass_pay_amount --种草成交金额
        ,t.ec
        ,t.shop_id as shop_id_tp -- tp侧店铺id
FROM    (
            SELECT  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(stat_date) = 8 THEN stat_date
                            WHEN LENGTH(stat_date) = 6 THEN CONCAT('20',stat_date)
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' AND LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1),
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            ,
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3) END
                            )
                            ELSE REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,' ',1),'-','')
                    END AS stat_date
                    ,shop_id
                    ,first_source AS original_first_channel_name
                    ,CASE   WHEN second_source = '汇总' THEN ''
                            ELSE second_source
                    END AS original_second_channel_name
                    ,CASE   WHEN third_source = '汇总' THEN ''
                            ELSE third_source
                    END AS original_third_channel_name
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(uv,',','') AS BIGINT) AS visitors
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(pay_conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(unit_price,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS unit_price
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(uv_value,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS uv_value
                    ,CAST(direct_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS direct_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(favor_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS favor_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(fans_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS fans_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(cart_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS cart_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(grass_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS grass_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(grass_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS grass_pay_amount
                    ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,stat_date ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id DESC ) AS rn
                    ,'e002' AS ec
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_tm_store_traffic_ex_tms
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_tm_store_traffic_ex_tms')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  CASE   WHEN stat_date LIKE '%年%' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(stat_date,1,INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1),
                                   -- 提取年
                                   LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'年') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'月') - INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')
                            ,
                            -- 提取月并补零
                            LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'月') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'日') - INSTR(stat_date,'月') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')) -- 提取日并补零
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' and length(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3))= 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )
when stat_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3) END
                            )

                            ELSE REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,' ',1),'-','')
                    END AS stat_date
                    ,shop_id
                    ,DECODE(primary_source,'-','',primary_source) AS original_first_channel_name
                    ,DECODE(secondary_source,'-','',secondary_source) AS original_second_channel_name
                    ,DECODE(tertiary_source,'-','',tertiary_source) AS original_third_channel_name
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(visitors,',','') AS BIGINT) AS visitors
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(pay_conversion_rate AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(customer_price,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS unit_price
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(uv_value,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS uv_value
                    ,CAST(direct_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS direct_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(favorite_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS favor_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(fans_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS fans_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(cart_pay_buyers AS BIGINT) AS cart_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(planted_pay_peoples AS BIGINT) AS grass_pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(planted_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS grass_pay_amount
                    ,1 AS rn
                    ,'e001' AS ec
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_traffic_data_ex_tms --一天一份文件,无需去重
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_traffic_data_ex_tms')
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  original_first_channel_name
                        ,original_second_channel_name
                        ,original_third_channel_name
                        ,first_channel_name
                        ,second_channel_name
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_traffic_channel_mapping
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_traffic_channel_mapping')
            ) t1
ON      t.original_first_channel_name = t1.original_first_channel_name
AND     t.original_second_channel_name = t1.original_second_channel_name
AND     t.original_third_channel_name = t1.original_third_channel_name
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t2
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end = t2.ec_store_code_tp
