                                   -- 提取年
                                   LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'年') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'月') - INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')
                            ,
                            -- 提取月并补零
                            LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'月') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'日') - INSTR(stat_date,'月') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')) -- 提取日并补零
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' and length(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3))= 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )

                    ,'e001' AS ec

            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_launch_tms')
                        and stat_date is not null

LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON t.shop_id = t1.ec_store_code_tp
WHERE   t.rn = 1

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_traffic_search PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.stat_date
        ,nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id
        ,nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name
        ,t.source_type
        ,t.source_name
        ,t.uv
        ,t.pay_conversion_rate
        ,t.pay_amount
        ,t.unit_price
        ,t.order_amount
        ,t.order_buyers
        ,t.order_conversion_rate
        ,t.pay_buyers
        ,t.uv_value
        ,t.follow_peoples
        ,t.favor_buyers
        ,t.cart_peoples
        ,t.new_uv
        ,t.direct_pay_buyers
        ,t.favor_pay_buyers
        ,t.fans_pay_buyers
        ,t.cart_pay_buyers
        ,t.keywords_source
        ,t.keywords_type
        ,t.data_source
FROM    (
            -- 鲲驰数据
            SELECT  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(stat_date) = 8 THEN stat_date
                            WHEN LENGTH(stat_date) = 6 THEN CONCAT('20',stat_date)
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' AND LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1),
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            ,
                                           CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3) END
                            )
                            ELSE REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,' ',1),'-','')
                    END AS stat_date
                    ,shop_id
                    ,source_type
                    ,source_name
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(uv,',','') AS BIGINT) AS uv
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_conversion_rate,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(unit_price,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS unit_price
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(order_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS order_amount
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(order_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS order_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(order_conversion_rate,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS order_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS pay_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(uv_value,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS uv_value
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(follow_peoples,',','') AS BIGINT) AS follow_peoples
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(favor_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS favor_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(cart_peoples,',','') AS BIGINT) AS cart_peoples
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(new_uv,',','') AS BIGINT) AS new_uv
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(direct_pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS direct_pay_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(favor_pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS favor_pay_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(fans_pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS fans_pay_buyers
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(cart_pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS cart_pay_buyers
                    ,CASE   WHEN source_type = '直通车' THEN '付费搜索'
                            WHEN source_type = '手淘' THEN '自然搜索'
                            ELSE NULL
                    END AS keywords_source
                    ,CASE   WHEN REGEXP_COUNT(lower(NVL(source_name,'')),'(施华蔻|schwarzkopf|丝蕴|syoss|资生堂|shiseido|妙力|bref|宝莹|persil)') = 1 OR REGEXP_COUNT(dme_cdm.chinesepinyin(NVL(source_name,'')),'(shihuakou|siyun|miaoli|zishengtang|baoying)') = 1 THEN '品牌词'
                            ELSE '品类词'
                    END AS keywords_type
                    ,'鲲驰流量数据模板_除猫超_店铺' AS data_source
                    ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBSTR(REPLACE(stat_date,'-',''),1,8),shop_id ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_tm_store_traffic_search_ex_tms
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_kunc_tm_store_traffic_search_ex_tms')
            AND     stat_date IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL -- 丽人数据
            SELECT    CASE   WHEN stat_date LIKE '%年%' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(stat_date,1,INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1),
                                   -- 提取年
                                   LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'年') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'月') - INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')
                            ,
                            -- 提取月并补零
                            LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'月') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'日') - INSTR(stat_date,'月') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')) -- 提取日并补零
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' and length(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3))= 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )
when stat_date LIKE '%/%' THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3) END
                            )

                            ELSE REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,' ',1),'-','')
                    END AS stat_date
                    ,shop_id
                    ,data_source AS source_type
                    ,source_name
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(visitors,',','') AS BIGINT) AS uv
                    ,NULL AS pay_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount
                    ,NULL AS unit_price
                    ,NULL AS order_amount
                    ,NULL AS order_buyers
                    ,NULL AS order_conversion_rate
                    ,CAST(REPLACE(pay_buyers,',','') AS BIGINT) AS pay_buyers
                    ,NULL AS uv_value
                    ,NULL AS follow_peoples
                    ,NULL AS favor_buyers
                    ,NULL AS cart_peoples
                    ,NULL AS new_uv
                    ,NULL AS direct_pay_buyers
                    ,NULL AS favor_pay_buyers
                    ,NULL AS fans_pay_buyers
                    ,NULL AS cart_pay_buyers
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = '直通车' THEN '付费搜索'
                            WHEN data_source = '手淘搜索' THEN '自然搜索'
                            ELSE NULL
                    END AS keywords_source
                    ,CASE   WHEN REGEXP_COUNT(lower(NVL(source_name,'')),'(施华蔻|schwarzkopf|丝蕴|syoss|资生堂|shiseido|妙力|bref|宝莹|persil)') = 1 OR REGEXP_COUNT(dme_cdm.chinesepinyin(NVL(source_name,'')),'(shihuakou|siyun|miaoli|zishengtang|baoying)') = 1 THEN '品牌词'
                            ELSE '品类词'
                    END AS keywords_type
                    ,'丽人搜索数据模板_流量搜索' AS data_source
                    ,1 AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_traffic_search_data
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_tm_traffic_search_data')
            AND     stat_date IS NOT NULL
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON t.shop_id = t1.ec_store_code_tp
WHERE   t.rn = 1

                                   -- 提取年
                                   LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'年') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'月') - INSTR(stat_date,'年') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')
                            ,
                            -- 提取月并补零
                            LPAD(
                                        SUBSTR(stat_date,INSTR(stat_date,'月') + 1,INSTR(stat_date,'日') - INSTR(stat_date,'月') - 1)
                                   ,2,'0')) -- 提取日并补零
                            WHEN stat_date LIKE '%/%' and length(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3))= 4 THEN CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',3),
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',1) END
                            ,
                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END
                            )

                                   CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(stat_date,'/',2) END

                            )

                            ELSE REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(stat_date,' ',1),'-','')

        ,t.cart_products

        ,t.online_cart_rate

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_store_traded partition(ds)
select 
    nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id , -- 店铺id
    nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name, -- 汉高店铺名称
    t.data_source , -- 来源
    t.stat_date as data_date, -- 日期
    t.pay_amount,
    t.refund_amount_refundtime,
    t.exposure_users,
    t.click_users,
    t.pay_users,
    t.pay_orders,
    t.per_customer_transaction,
    t.refund_amount_paytime,
    t.exposure_count,
    t.click_count,
    t.click_through_rate,
    t.click_to_pay_rate,
    t.refund_orders_refundtime,
    t.refund_rate_paytime,
    t.net_payment_amount,
    t.payment_per_thousand_exposures,
    t.qianchuan_coupon_amount,
    t.platform_subsidy_amount,
    t.net_qianchuan_coupon_amount,
    t.net_platform_subsidy_amount,
    t.actual_commission_waived,
    substr(t.stat_date,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(t.stat_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(t.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(t.stat_date,1,6) as data_month,
    t.coupon_refund_amount,
    t.shop_id as shop_id_tp,
    case when  t.stat_date is null then '00000000'
        else t.stat_date end as ds
from (
    select 
        shop_id, -- 店铺id
        data_source, -- 来源
        case when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))
            when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])=4 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[0],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(stat_date,'-',''),1,8) end as stat_date, -- 日期
        CAST(replace(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount, -- 用户支付金额
        CAST(replace(refund_amount_refundtime,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount_refundtime, -- 退款金额(退款时间)
        CAST(replace(exposure_users,',','') AS bigint) AS exposure_users, -- 商品曝光人数
        CAST(replace(click_users,',','') AS bigint) AS click_users, -- 商品点击人数
        CAST(replace(pay_users,',','') AS bigint) AS pay_users, -- 成交人数
        CAST(replace(pay_orders,',','') AS bigint) AS pay_orders, -- 成交订单数
        cast(if(replace(per_customer_transaction,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(per_customer_transaction,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(per_customer_transaction,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS per_customer_transaction, -- 客单价
        CAST(replace(refund_amount_paytime,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount_paytime, -- 退款金额(支付时间)
        CAST(replace(exposure_count,',','') AS bigint) AS exposure_count, -- 商品曝光次数
        CAST(replace(click_count,',','') AS bigint) AS click_count, -- 商品点击次数
        cast(if(replace(click_through_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_through_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_through_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_through_rate, -- 商品点击率(次数)
        cast(if(replace(click_to_pay_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_to_pay_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_to_pay_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_to_pay_rate, -- 商品点击-成交转化率(次数)
        CAST(replace(refund_orders_refundtime,',','') AS bigint) AS refund_orders_refundtime, -- 退款订单数(退款时间)
        cast(if(replace(refund_rate_paytime,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(refund_rate_paytime,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(refund_rate_paytime,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS refund_rate_paytime, -- 退款率(支付时间)
        CAST(replace(net_payment_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS net_payment_amount, -- 退款后用户支付金额(支付时间)
        CAST(replace(payment_per_thousand_exposures,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS payment_per_thousand_exposures, -- 千次曝光用户支付金额
        CAST(replace(qianchuan_coupon_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS qianchuan_coupon_amount, -- 千川智能优惠券金额
        CAST(replace(platform_subsidy_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS platform_subsidy_amount, -- 电商平台补贴金额
        CAST(replace(net_qianchuan_coupon_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS net_qianchuan_coupon_amount, -- 退款后千川智能优惠券金额(支付时间)
        CAST(replace(net_platform_subsidy_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS net_platform_subsidy_amount, -- 退款后电商平台补贴金额(支付时间)
        CAST(replace(actual_commission_waived,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS actual_commission_waived, -- 全域实际免除佣金
        CAST(replace(coupon_refund_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS coupon_refund_amount --退后金额
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_store_traded
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_store_traded')
) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end = t1.ec_store_code_tp

    t3.retail_price_tax,

        else t.stat_date end as ds

and t3.product_line = t4.product_line

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_account_traded partition(ds)
select 
    nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id, -- 店铺id
    nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name, -- 汉高店铺名称
    t.stat_date as data_date, -- 日期
    t.account_name as account_name_ori, -- 账号名称_原始
    case when t.douyin_id ='shk1898' then  concat(t1.store_name,'-主号')
        when t.douyin_id ='shkxh1898' then concat(t1.store_name,'-洗护')
        when t.douyin_id ='shkrfh' then concat(t1.store_name,'-染发')
        when t.douyin_id ='27506262696' then concat(t1.store_name,'-主号')
        when t.douyin_id ='64569804197' then concat(t1.store_name,'-主号')
        else t.account_name end as account_name, -- 账号名称
    t.account_type, -- 账号类型
    t.operation_mode, -- 自营/带货
    t.douyin_id, -- 抖音号
    t.pay_amount, -- 成交金额
    t.pay_users, -- 成交人数
    t.per_customer_transaction, -- 客单价
    t.click_to_pay_rate, -- 商品点击-成交转化率
    t.live_pay_amount, -- 直播成交金额
    t.short_video_pay_amount, -- 短视频成交金额
    t.product_card_pay_amount, -- 商品卡成交金额
    t.other_pay_amount, -- 其他成交金额
    t.refund_amount_paytime, -- 退款金额(支付时间)
    t.refund_rate_paytime, -- 退款率(支付时间)
    substr(t.stat_date,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(t.stat_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(t.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(t.stat_date,1,6) as data_month,
    case when  t.stat_date is null then '00000000'
        else t.stat_date end as ds
from (
    select 
        shop_id, -- 店铺id
        case when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))
            when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])=4 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[0],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(stat_date,'-',''),1,8) end as stat_date, -- 日期
        account_name, -- 账号名称
        account_type, -- 账号类型
        operation_mode, -- 自营/带货
        douyin_id, -- 抖音号
        CAST(replace(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount, -- 成交金额
        CAST(replace(pay_users,',','') AS BIGINT) AS pay_users, -- 成交人数
        CAST(replace(per_customer_transaction,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS per_customer_transaction, -- 客单价
        cast(if(replace(click_to_pay_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_to_pay_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_to_pay_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_to_pay_rate, -- 商品点击-成交转化率
        CAST(replace(live_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS live_pay_amount, -- 直播成交金额
        CAST(replace(short_video_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS short_video_pay_amount, -- 短视频成交金额
        CAST(replace(product_card_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS product_card_pay_amount, -- 商品卡成交金额
        CAST(replace(other_pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS other_pay_amount, -- 其他成交金额
        CAST(replace(refund_amount_paytime,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount_paytime, -- 退款金额(支付时间)
        cast(if(replace(refund_rate_paytime,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(refund_rate_paytime,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(refund_rate_paytime,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS refund_rate_paytime -- 退款率(支付时间)
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_account_traded
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_account_traded')
) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end = t1.ec_store_code_tp

-- 合并Actual和target的数据
-- Channel依次为DT、Ecom、NKA、WS，
-- 其中DT和WS的Sub Channel为 汉高大区（英文），NKA的Sub Channel为NKA-Mini和NKA-Hyper，Ecom 的Sub Channel为Ecom

--目前mapping关系较为简单，先手动插进，如存在频繁变动或者新增，可考虑改成数据填报
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3_tmp

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3_tmp as
select
      distinct
      substr(ds,1,6)         AS    months
     ,channel_hierarchy_1    AS    channel
     ,case when channel_hierarchy_1 in ('Ecom' ) then 'Ecom' else region_en end   AS   sub_channel
     ,customer_code          AS    customer_idh
     ,customer_name          AS    customer_name
     ,customer_name          AS    prof_customer_name
     ,bu_1
     ,bu_2
     ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest  as   channel_lastest
     ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('Ecom' ) then 'Ecom' else region_en_lastest end   AS   sub_channel_lastest
     ,customer_code   AS   customer_idh_lastest
     ,customer_name   AS   customer_name_lastest
     ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
     ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
where nvl(ds,'') like '%01'
  -- and bu_2 in ('Beauty Care','Laundry')
  and channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom','MPD','DT')

union all

select
   distinct
    b.months
    ,if(a.customer_idh = 'v_dt' and a.bu_1='Consumer' and b.months>='202501','MPD',a.channel) AS channel
    ,a.sub_channel
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,a.customer_name
    ,a.prof_customer_name
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,case when a.channel in ('DT','MPD' ) and a.bu_1='Consumer' and a.customer_idh like '%v_%' then 'MPD'
          else a.channel end  as  channel_lastest
    ,a.sub_channel   AS   sub_channel_lastest
    ,case when a.channel in ('DT','MPD' ) and a.bu_1='Consumer' and a.customer_idh = 'v_dt' then 'v_mpd'
          else a.customer_idh end    AS   customer_idh_lastest
    ,case when a.channel in ('DT','MPD' ) and a.bu_1='Consumer' and a.customer_idh like '%v_%' and a.customer_name like '%DT%' then replace(a.customer_name,'DT','MPD')
          else a.customer_name end    AS   customer_name_lastest
    ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
(
 
    -- 虚拟BU GR55
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Consumer'     AS   bu_1,'v_bu'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission        union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Professional' AS   bu_1,'v_bu'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission        union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'VS'           AS   bu_1,'v_bu'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission        union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Consumer'     AS   bu_1,'Beauty Care'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Consumer'     AS   bu_1,'Laundry'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission     union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Professional' AS   bu_1,'SKP'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission         union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'Professional' AS   bu_1,'SP'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission          union all
    select 'TTL'      AS  channel, 'TTL'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_ttl'        AS  customer_idh,'全渠道虚拟客户'     AS  customer_name,'全渠道虚拟客户'      AS  prof_customer_name ,'VS'           AS   bu_1,'VS'  AS   bu_2,'Others' as channel_customer_Permission ,'Others_Others' as region_customer_Permission 
   union all
    --SKP
    select 'DT'      AS  channel, 'Others'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_dt'            AS  customer_idh,'DT虚拟客户'              AS  customer_name,'DT虚拟客户'               AS  prof_customer_name ,'Professional'  AS   bu_1,'SKP'  AS   bu_2,'DT' as channel_customer_Permission ,'DT_Others' as region_customer_Permission 

   union all
    --SP
    select 'DT'      AS  channel, 'Others'      AS  sub_channel ,'v_dt'            AS  customer_idh,'DT虚拟客户'              AS  customer_name,'DT虚拟客户'               AS  prof_customer_name ,'Professional'  AS   bu_1,'SP'  AS   bu_2,'DT' as channel_customer_Permission ,'DT_Others' as region_customer_Permission 

    
    union all 
    
    select distinct 
         t2.channel                     AS  channel
        ,concat('NKA-',t4.nka_group)    AS  sub_channel 
        ,t1.customer_group_en_lv1       AS  customer_idh
        ,case when t1.customer_group_en_lv1 in ('LOTUS') then '卜蜂莲花' else t1.customer_group_cn_lv1 end  AS  customer_name
        ,case when t1.customer_group_en_lv1 in ('CRV') then t1.customer_group_en_lv2 else t1.customer_group_en_lv1 end                    AS  prof_customer_name 
        ,t2.bu_1
        ,t2.bu_2 
        ,t2.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,t2.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from 
    (
        select  distinct
           customer_group_cn_lv1
          ,customer_group_cn_lv2
          ,customer_group_en_lv1
          ,customer_group_en_lv2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
        where nvl(ds,'') like '%01'
        and (channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') or channel_hierarchy_1 in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'))
        and customer_group_en_lv1 not in ('CLH','DIA','Jiami','Lushang','NGS','Others','Parkn shop','Sanjiu') -- 过滤一些无效的KA，需要注意如果这些KA生效了需要释放
        and customer_group_en_lv2 not in ('CRV-SG')
        
        union all 
        
        select   
           '永辉'  as  customer_group_cn_lv1
          ,'永辉'  as  customer_group_cn_lv2
          ,'YH'  as  customer_group_en_lv1
          ,'YH'  as  customer_group_en_lv2
        
    )t1
    left join (
      select  distinct
          channel_hierarchy_1 as channel
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2
         ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
         ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
       where nvl(ds,'') like '%01'
        and (channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') or channel_hierarchy_1 in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'))
    
    )t2
    on case when t1.customer_group_cn_lv1 is not null then 1  end=case when t2.channel is not null then 1  end
    -- left join (
    --    select distinct ka_name,region_code,concat('NKA-',region_name)  as  region_name
    --    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka
    --    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
    --    and ka_type_name = 'NKA'
    -- )t3
    -- on case when t1.customer_group_en_lv1 in ('RT') then t1.customer_group_cn_lv1 else t1.customer_group_cn_lv2 end = t3.ka_name
    left join 
    (
       select distinct ka_name,nka_group  
       from  ${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping 
       where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping')
    )t4
    on upper(case when t1.customer_group_en_lv1 = 'RT' then t1.customer_group_en_lv1 else t1.customer_group_en_lv2 end) = upper(t4.ka_name)

)a
join(
     select  distinct
              '1' as flag
             ,substr(day_id,1,6) as months
     from    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
     where   day_id >= '20200101'
       and   substr(day_id,1,4) <= (substr('${bizdate}',1,4)+2)
)b
on case when a.channel is not null then 1  end = b.flag
-- WHERE ((b.months >= '202001' and b.months <= '202412' and !(channel = 'MPD' and customer_idh in ('v_central','v_east','v_north','v_south','v_west','v_others')) )
--   OR (b.months >= '202501' and !(if(a.customer_idh = 'v_dt' and b.months>='202501','MPD',a.channel) = 'DT')))


union all

select
   distinct
     b.months
    ,a.channel
    ,a.sub_channel
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,a.customer_name
    ,a.prof_customer_name
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest  as   channel_lastest
    ,case when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('Ecom' ) then 'Ecom' else a.region_en_lastest end   AS   sub_channel_lastest
    ,a.customer_idh   AS   customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.customer_name   AS   customer_name_lastest
    ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
(
    select
        distinct
        substr(ds,1,6)         AS    months
        ,channel_hierarchy_1    AS    channel
        ,case when channel_hierarchy_1 in ('Ecom' ) then 'Ecom' else region_en end   AS   sub_channel
        ,customer_code          AS    customer_idh
        ,customer_name          AS    customer_name
        ,customer_name          AS    prof_customer_name
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest
        ,region_en_lastest
        ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
    and channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom','MPD','DT')
     --and bu_2 in ('Beauty Care','Laundry')
)a
left join
(
   select  distinct
        '1' as flag
       ,substr(day_id,1,6) as months
   from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
   where substr(day_id,1,6) >  substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
     and substr(day_id,1,4) <= (substr('${bizdate}',1,4)+2)
)b
on case when a.channel is not null then 1  end = b.flag

insert  overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
select
      a.months
     ,a.channel
     ,a.sub_channel
     ,a.customer_idh
     ,a.customer_name
     ,a.prof_customer_name
     ,a.bu_1
     ,a.bu_2
     ,a.channel_lastest
     ,a.sub_channel_lastest
     ,a.customer_idh_lastest
     ,a.customer_name_lastest
     ,case when upper(a.channel_lastest)='TTL' then 'TTL'
           when upper(a.channel_lastest)='ECOM' then nvl(b.customer_name,'Others')
           else a.sub_channel_lastest
      end as sub_channel_lastest_dis  -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
     ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
     ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3_tmp a
left join ${dme_ods}.s_customer_mapping_info_bts b
 on a.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_customer_mapping_info_bts')
 and b.customer_type='EC_Abbreviation'
where  a.months >= '202301'
--where (months < '202401' OR (bu_2 in ('Laundry') and months >= '202401'))

--功能描述: 抖音成交数据模板_SPU
--20251224 yyq   切换门店主数据表，原门店编码和门店名称调整为标准门店信息
--********************************************************************--
insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_store_spu_traded partition(ds)
select
    nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id, -- 店铺id 
    nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name, -- 汉高店铺名称
    t.product_image, -- 商品图片 
    t.product_title, -- 商品标题 
    t.product_code as product_code_tp, -- 商品编号 
    t.stat_date as data_date, -- 日期 
    cast(t.exposure_count * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as exposure_count, -- 商品曝光次数 
    cast(t.exposure_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as exposure_users, -- 商品曝光人数 
    t.exposure_conversion_rate, -- 商品曝光-成交率(次数) 
    cast(t.exposure_gmv_per_k * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as exposure_gmv_per_k, -- 商品千次曝光成交金额 
    t.exposure_user_conversion, -- 商品曝光-成交率(人数) 
    cast(t.click_count * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as click_count, -- 商品点击次数 
    cast(t.click_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as click_users, -- 商品点击人数 
    t.click_conversion_rate, -- 商品点击-成交率(次数) 
    t.click_through_rate, -- 商品点击率(次数) 
    t.click_user_conversion, -- 商品点击-成交率(人数) 
    t.user_click_rate, -- 商品点击率(人数) 
    cast(t.pay_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as pay_users, -- 商品成交人数 
    cast(t.cart_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as cart_users, -- 商品加购人数 
    cast(t.favor_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as favor_users, -- 商品收藏人数 
    cast(t.pay_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as pay_amount, -- 商品成交金额 
    cast(t.pay_orders * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as pay_orders, -- 商品成交订单数 
    cast(t.pay_quantity * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as pay_quantity, -- 商品成交件数 
    cast(t.settlement_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as settlement_amount, -- 商品实际结算金额 
    cast(t.commission_expense * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as commission_expense, -- 商品实际佣金支出 
    cast(t.bounce_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as bounce_users, -- 商品跳失人数 
    cast(t.refund_amount * nvl(t2.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as refund_amount, -- 商品退款金额 
    cast(t.refund_users * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as refund_users, -- 商品退款人数 
    cast(t.refund_orders * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as refund_orders, -- 商品退款订单数 
    cast(t.refund_quantity * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as refund_quantity, -- 商品退款件数 
    cast(t.good_reviews * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as good_reviews, -- 商品好评数 
    cast(t.bad_reviews * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as bad_reviews, -- 商品差评数 
    cast(t.bad_review_orders * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as bad_review_orders, -- 商品差评订单数 
    cast(t.total_reviews * nvl(t2.payment_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as total_reviews, -- 商品评价数 
    t.bad_review_rate, -- 商品差评率 
    t.good_review_rate, -- 评价好评率 
    t.negative_review_rate, -- 评价差评率
    substr(t.stat_date,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(t.stat_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(t.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(t.stat_date,1,6) as data_month,
    nvl(t3.product_barcode,'-110') as product_barcode,
    nvl(t3.product_name,'Others') as product_name,
    nvl(t3.category_name,'Others') as category_name,
    nvl(t3.product_function,'Others') as product_function,  
    nvl(t3.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function ,
    nvl(t3.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,
    nvl(t3.product_line,'Others') as product_line_name,
    nvl(t3.bu_1,'Consumer') as bu_1,
    nvl(t3.bu_2,'Beauty Care') as bu_2,
    nvl(t4.key_product_line_name,'Others') as key_product_line_name,
    nvl(t4.sub_key_product_line_name,'Others') as sub_key_product_line_name,
    t3.retail_price_tax,
    case when  t.stat_date is null then '00000000'
        else t.stat_date end as ds
from (
    select 
        replace(shop_id,',','') as shop_id, -- 店铺id
        product_image, -- 商品图片
        product_title, -- 商品标题
        replace(product_code,',','') product_code, -- 商品编号
        case when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))
            when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])=4 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[0],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(stat_date,'-',''),1,8) end as stat_date, -- 日期
        CAST(replace(exposure_count,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS exposure_count, -- 商品曝光次数
        CAST(replace(exposure_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS exposure_users, -- 商品曝光人数
        cast(if(replace(exposure_conversion_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(exposure_conversion_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(exposure_conversion_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS exposure_conversion_rate, -- 商品曝光-成交率(次数)
        CAST(replace(exposure_gmv_per_k,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS exposure_gmv_per_k, -- 商品千次曝光成交金额
        cast(if(replace(exposure_user_conversion,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(exposure_user_conversion,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(exposure_user_conversion,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS exposure_user_conversion, -- 商品曝光-成交率(人数)
        CAST(replace(click_count,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS click_count, -- 商品点击次数
        CAST(replace(click_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS click_users, -- 商品点击人数
        cast(if(replace(click_conversion_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_conversion_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_conversion_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_conversion_rate, -- 商品点击-成交率(次数)
        cast(if(replace(click_through_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_through_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_through_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_through_rate, -- 商品点击率(次数)
        cast(if(replace(click_user_conversion,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(click_user_conversion,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(click_user_conversion,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS click_user_conversion, -- 商品点击-成交率(人数)
        cast(if(replace(user_click_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(user_click_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(user_click_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS user_click_rate, -- 商品点击率(人数)
        CAST(replace(pay_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS pay_users, -- 商品成交人数
        CAST(replace(cart_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS cart_users, -- 商品加购人数
        CAST(replace(favor_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS favor_users, -- 商品收藏人数
        CAST(replace(pay_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pay_amount, -- 商品成交金额
        CAST(replace(pay_orders,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS pay_orders, -- 商品成交订单数
        CAST(replace(pay_quantity,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS pay_quantity, -- 商品成交件数
        CAST(replace(settlement_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS settlement_amount, -- 商品实际结算金额
        CAST(replace(commission_expense,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS commission_expense, -- 商品实际佣金支出
        CAST(replace(bounce_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS bounce_users, -- 商品跳失人数
        CAST(replace(refund_amount,',','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount, -- 商品退款金额
        CAST(replace(refund_users,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS refund_users, -- 商品退款人数
        CAST(replace(refund_orders,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS refund_orders, -- 商品退款订单数
        CAST(replace(refund_quantity,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS refund_quantity, -- 商品退款件数
        CAST(replace(good_reviews,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS good_reviews, -- 商品好评数
        CAST(replace(bad_reviews,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS bad_reviews, -- 商品差评数
        CAST(replace(bad_review_orders,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS bad_review_orders, -- 商品差评订单数
        CAST(replace(total_reviews,',','') AS decimal(28,6)) AS total_reviews, -- 商品评价数
        cast(if(replace(bad_review_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(bad_review_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(bad_review_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS bad_review_rate, -- 商品差评率
        cast(if(replace(good_review_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(good_review_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(good_review_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS good_review_rate, -- 评价好评率
        cast(if(replace(negative_review_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(negative_review_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(negative_review_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) AS negative_review_rate -- 评价差评率
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_store_spu_traded
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_store_spu_traded')
) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end = t1.ec_store_code_tp
left join(
    select 
        data_months,
        shop_id,
        spu,
        barcode as  henkel_prod_barcode,
        base_price_rate, -- 基价金额占比
        prod_qty,
        payment_rate -- 支付金额占比
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping
    where ds >0
)t2
on nvl(t.product_code,'') = nvl(t2.spu,'')
and nvl(t.shop_id,'') = nvl(t2.shop_id,'')
and substr(t.stat_date,1,6)=nvl(t2.data_months,'')
left join(
    select
        product_barcode,
        product_name,
        category_name,
        product_function,  
        sub_product_function ,
        brand_name,
        brand_name_en,
        product_line,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        retail_price_tax,  -- 含税零售价
        ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds >0
) t3 
on t2.henkel_prod_barcode = t3.product_barcode 
and t.stat_date=t3.ds
left join (
    SELECT  
        bu_2,
        category_name,
        brand_name_en,
        product_line,
        sub_product_function,
        key_product_line_name,
        sub_key_product_line_name
    FROM  ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_key_product_line_mapping -- 重点产品线
    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_key_product_line_mapping')
) t4
on t3.bu_2=t4.bu_2 
and t3.category_name = t4.category_name
and t3.brand_name_en = t4.brand_name_en
and t3.product_line = t4.product_line
and t3.sub_product_function = t4.sub_product_function

--********************************************************************--
--author:yinqing.yuan
--create time:2025-06-05 11:06:14
--功能描述: 抖音产品mapping表
-- 20250903  yyq  历史月的拉链表是10号cutoff上月的实时数据，用于历史该月，ongoing月是用上月的快照数据
-- 20251224  事实表门店编码取tp侧门店编码
--********************************************************************--
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_01

create table  ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_01 as
select 
    a.shop_id_tp as shop_id,
    a.shop_name,
    a.num_iid as spu, -- spu
    a.commodity_sku as sku, --sku
    a.henkel_item_barcode as barcode, -- barcode
    substr(a.ds,1,6) as pay_months,
    substr(a.ds,1,6) as data_months,
    sum(a.payment_actual) as payment_actual,
    sum(a.base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt,
    sum(b.prod_qty) as prod_qty
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu a 
left join(
    select   
        shop_id
        ,plat_prod_code
        ,henkel_prod_barcode
        ,sum(prod_qty) as prod_qty
        ,ec
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
    where   ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
    group by shop_id,plat_prod_code,henkel_prod_barcode,ec
) b on a.commodity_sku =b.plat_prod_code
     and a.shop_id_tp = b.shop_id
     and a.ec_code=b.ec
     and a.henkel_item_barcode=b.henkel_prod_barcode
where a.ds>='20230101'
and substr(a.ds,1,6)<to_char(now(),'yyyymm')
and b.henkel_prod_barcode is not null
and a.num_iid is not null
    group by a.shop_id_tp,
    a.shop_name,
    a.num_iid,
    a.commodity_sku,
    a.henkel_item_barcode,
    substr(a.ds,1,6)
union all
-- 系统当月用上月的产品mapping
select 
    a.shop_id_tp as shop_id,
    a.shop_name,
    a.num_iid as spu, -- spu
    a.commodity_sku as sku, --sku
    a.henkel_item_barcode as barcode, -- barcode
    substr(a.ds,1,6) as pay_months,
    to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd'),+1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') as data_months,
    sum(a.payment_actual) as payment_actual,
    sum(a.base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt,
    sum(b.prod_qty) as prod_qty
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu a 
left join(
    select   
        shop_id
        ,plat_prod_code
        ,henkel_prod_barcode
        ,sum(prod_qty) as prod_qty
        ,sum(base_price_rate) as base_price_rate
        ,ec
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
    where   ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
    group by shop_id,plat_prod_code,henkel_prod_barcode,ec
) b on a.commodity_sku =b.plat_prod_code
     and a.shop_id_tp = b.shop_id
     and a.ec_code=b.ec
     and a.henkel_item_barcode=b.henkel_prod_barcode
where substr(a.ds,1,6)=to_char(to_date(add_months(getdate(),-1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm')
and b.henkel_prod_barcode is not null
and a.num_iid is not null
group by a.shop_id_tp,
    a.shop_name,
    a.num_iid,
    a.commodity_sku,
    a.henkel_item_barcode,
    substr(a.ds,1,6),
    to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd'),+1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm')
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_02

create table  ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_02 as
select 
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    spu,
    barcode,
    pay_months,
    data_months,
    payment_actual,
    base_sale_amt,
    prod_qty,
    sum(payment_actual) over(partition by shop_id,pay_months,data_months,spu) as payment_actual_ttl,
    sum(base_sale_amt) over(partition by shop_id,pay_months,data_months,spu) as base_sale_amt_ttl,
    sum(prod_qty) over(partition by shop_id,pay_months,data_months,spu) as prod_qty_ttl, -- barcode数量
    count(1) over(partition by shop_id,pay_months,data_months,spu) as prod_num_ttl -- barcode个数
from (
    select 
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    spu,
    barcode,
    pay_months,
    data_months,
    sum(payment_actual) as payment_actual,
    sum(base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt,
    sum(prod_qty) as prod_qty
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_01
group by shop_id,
    shop_name,
    spu,
    barcode,
    pay_months,
    data_months
) a

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping partition (ds)
select 
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    spu,
    barcode,
    pay_months,
    data_months,
    cast(payment_actual as decimal(28,6)) as payment_actual,
    cast(base_sale_amt as decimal(28,6)) as base_sale_amt,
    cast(prod_qty as bigint) as prod_qty,
    cast(case when nvl(base_sale_amt_ttl,0)=0 then prod_qty/prod_qty_ttl
        else  nvl(base_sale_amt/base_sale_amt_ttl,0) end as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_rate, -- 基价金额占比
    cast(case when payment_actual_ttl=0 then 1/prod_num_ttl
        else  nvl(payment_actual/payment_actual_ttl,0) end as decimal(28,6)) as payment_rate, -- 支付金额占比
    data_months as ds    
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_douyin_product_mapping_temp_02
where if(to_char(now(),'dd')<='10',data_months>=to_char(to_date(add_months(getdate(),-1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm'),data_months=to_char(now(),'yyyymm'))

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_live_traffic_conversion partition(ds)
select

    nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name, -- 汉高店铺名称
    t.stat_date as data_date, -- 日期
    t.account_name as account_name_ori, -- 账号
    concat(nvl(t1.store_name,''),'-',t.account_name) as account_name , --账号
    t.live_room_impressions, -- 直播间曝光人数
    t.live_room_entrances, -- 直播间进入人数
    t.impression_to_view_rate, -- 直播间曝光-观看率(人数)
    t.product_impressions, -- 商品曝光人数
    t.product_clicks, -- 商品点击人数
    t.purchasers, -- 成交人数
    t.live_interactions, -- 直播间互动人数
    t.comment_users, -- 评论人数
    t.like_users, -- 点赞人数
    t.share_users, -- 分享人数
    t.live_views, -- 直播间观看次数
    t.order_count, -- 成交订单数
    t.interaction_count, -- 直播间互动次数
    t.comment_count, -- 评论次数
    t.like_count, -- 点赞次数
    t.share_count, -- 分享次数
    substr(t.stat_date,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(t.stat_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(t.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(t.stat_date,1,6) as data_month,
    case when  t.stat_date is null then '00000000'
        else t.stat_date end as ds
from (
    select 
        shop_id, -- 店铺ID
        case when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))
            when stat_date rlike '/' and length(split(stat_date,'/')[0])=4 then concat(split(stat_date,'/')[0],lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(stat_date,'/')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(stat_date,'-',''),1,8) end as stat_date, -- 日期
        account_name,   -- 账号名称
        cast(
            case when live_room_impressions like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(live_room_impressions,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS live_room_impressions,  -- 直播间曝光人数
        cast(
            case when live_room_entrances like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_entrances,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(live_room_entrances,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS live_room_entrances, -- 直播间进入人数
        cast(if(replace(impression_to_view_rate,',','') rlike '%',replace(replace(impression_to_view_rate,',',''),'%','')/100,replace(impression_to_view_rate,',','')) as decimal(28,6)) as impression_to_view_rate, -- 曝光-观看率
        cast(
            case when product_impressions like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(product_impressions,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(product_impressions,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS product_impressions, -- 商品曝光人数
        cast(
            case when product_clicks like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(product_clicks,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(product_clicks,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS product_clicks,  -- 商品点击人数
        cast(
            case when purchasers like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(purchasers,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(purchasers,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS purchasers,   -- 成交人数
        cast(
            case when live_interactions like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_interactions,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(live_interactions,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS live_interactions, -- 直播间互动人数
        cast(
            case when comment_users like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(comment_users,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(comment_users,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS comment_users, -- 评论人数
        cast(
            case when like_users like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(like_users,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(like_users,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS like_users,   -- 点赞人数
        cast(
            case when share_users like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(share_users,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(share_users,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS share_users, -- 分享人数
        cast(
            case when live_views like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_views,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(live_views,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS live_views,   -- 直播间观看次数
        cast(
            case when order_count like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(order_count,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(order_count,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS order_count, -- 成交订单数
        cast(
            case when interaction_count like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(interaction_count,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(interaction_count,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS interaction_count, -- 直播间互动次数
        cast(
            case when comment_count like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(comment_count,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(comment_count,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS comment_count, -- 评论次数
        cast(
            case when like_count like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(like_count,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(like_count,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS like_count,   -- 点赞次数
        cast(
            case when share_count like '%万%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(share_count,',|万','')*10000
                when live_room_impressions like '%亿%' then REGEXP_REPLACE(live_room_impressions,',|亿','')*100000000
                else replace(share_count,',','') end 
            as BIGINT) AS share_count -- 分享次数
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_live_traffic_conversion
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_douyin_live_traffic_conversion')
)t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end = t1.ec_store_code_tp

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_activity_type_temp_01 as
SELECT  distinct
        nvl(t1.store_code,t.shop_id) as shop_id
        ,nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as shop_name
        ,t.start_date
        ,t.end_date
        ,t.activity_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  shop_id --处理时间格式,防止手工文件时间上传不规范
                    ,SUBSTR(
                           CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) END
                           ,
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(start_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) END
                           )
                    ,1,8) AS start_date --活动开始时间
                    ,SUBSTR(
                           CONCAT(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',1),
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',2) END
                           ,
                                  CASE    WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) = 1 THEN CONCAT('0',SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3)) ELSE SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(end_date,'.','-'),'/','-'),'-',3) END
                           )
                    ,1,8) AS end_date --活动结束时间
                    ,upper(activity_type) AS activity_type
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_douyin_activity_type
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_ec_douyin_activity_type')
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON case when t.shop_id = '0' then '601' else t.shop_id end= t1.ec_store_code_tp

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_activity_type PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')

SELECT  shop_id
        ,shop_name
        ,day_id AS dt_date
        ,activity_type
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_yoy --去年同期
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-3,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_qoq --季度环比
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_mom --月度环比
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_dod --日度环比
FROM    (
            SELECT  t.shop_id
                    ,t.shop_name
                    ,t.activity_type
                    ,t1.day_id
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  shop_id --店铺ID
                                ,shop_name --店铺名称
                                ,start_date --活动开始时间
                                ,end_date --活动结束时间
                                ,activity_type --活动类型
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_activity_type_temp_01
                    ) t
            JOIN    (
                        SELECT  '1' AS flag
                                ,day_id
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                    ) t1
            ON      t.flag = t1.flag
            AND     t1.day_id >= t.start_date
            AND     t1.day_id <= t.end_date
            GROUP BY t.shop_id
                     ,t.shop_name
                     ,t.start_date
                     ,t.end_date
                     ,t.activity_type
                     ,t1.day_id
        ) o

    ,remark
    ,order_type
    ,first_channel_name_lastest
    ,second_channel_name_lastest
    ,is_fg
    ,ges
    ,product_base_price
    ,doc_date
    ,dlv_date
    ,po_number
    ,ship_to
    ,name_of_ship_to_party
    ,item
    ,net_price
    ,su
    ,plnt
    ,sloc
    ,rj
    ,dlbl
    ,ordrs
    ,sales_desc
    ,confirmqty
    ,status_va05
    ,billing_date
    ,next_month_flag
    ,if(substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330')
       ,'${bizdate}',null) as ds
from 
(
select  
     t1.id                     as  id                       --数据填报id
    ,t0.period                 as  period                   --统计日期
    ,substr(t0.period,1,6)     as  period_month             --统计月
    ,t1.sales_organization     as  sales_organization  	    --销售组织
    ,t0.saty                   as  saty                	    --销售凭证类型
    ,cast(t0.on_date AS  datetime)  as  created_date        	    --创建日期
    ,cast(t1.bill_date    AS  datetime)  as  bill_date           	    --账单日期
    ,t0.req_dlv_date as  req_dlv_date        	    --交货日期
    ,t0.sold_to_pt          as  customer_code       	    --客户代码
    ,COALESCE(t2.customer_name,'Others')          as  customer_name      	    --客户名
    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others')    as  first_channel_name      	--一级渠道名
    ,case when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t2.channel_hierarchy_2
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('MPD','DT') then t2.region_en
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')        then  t2.channel_hierarchy_1
          else 'Others' end        as  second_channel_name     	--二级渠道名 

    ,nvl(t0.Document,t1.sales_doc)              as  sales_doc             	--销售单号
    --VA05的Status字段值若为'Not Delivered'，订单状态编码为1，否则订单状态编码为5
    ,case when t99.status = '8' then '8_2'
          else nvl(t1.status,case when upper(t0.status) = 'NOT DELIVERED' then '1' else '5' end) end as  status  --订单状态细分编码
    ,t4.partner_status         as  partner_status        	--订单状态
    ,t4.sub_status             as  sub_status            	--订单子状态
    ,cast(t5.rn AS INT)                               as  consumed_working_days 	--当月已消耗工作日
    ,cast(t3.working_days AS INT)            as  working_days          	--当月工作日天数
    ,cast(if(upper(t0.SaTy) in ('ZXRE','ZARA'),-1*t0.Net,t0.Net) AS decimal(38,10)) as  net_value             	--净销额
    ,COALESCE(t6.bu_1,'Others') as  bu_1
    ,COALESCE(t6.bu_2,'Others') as  bu_2
    ,t0.Material  as  product_code
    ,t6.product_name   as  product_name
    ,cast(t0.order_qty AS Bigint)   as   order_qty

    -- SU为SHU或BOX时换算为CON的逻辑为Order qty*箱规 SU为CON时换算为SHU的逻辑为Order qty/箱规
    -- 根据产品主数据获取箱规，不在产品主数据中则使用ZVVMASTERDATA中的Numerator (MARM-UMREZ)字段值，两者均不在则箱规为1
    ,cast(nvl(if(trim(t6.box_size) in ('','-') ,NULL,trim(t6.box_size)),1) as  bigint)                       as  box_size
    ,t0.remark   as  remark
     -- 下月订单：剔除KE24后，Next Month标签为Y的均为下月订单，剩下订单NKA走rdd逻辑，非NKA均为本月订单
    ,case when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  = 'Y' then '下月订单'
          when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and  (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.sold_to_pt,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708')))  
               and to_char(to_date(to_char(t0.req_dlv_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') = to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(substr(t0.period,1,6),'yyyymm'),1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') then '下月订单'
          when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.sold_to_pt,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708')))  
               and to_char(to_date(to_char(t0.req_dlv_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') =  substr(t0.period,1,6)  then '当月订单'
          when upper(nvl(t0.next_month_flag,''))  <> 'Y' and !(nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'NKA' or (nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1,'Others') = 'SELECTIVE RETAILER' and nvl(t0.sold_to_pt,'') not in ('2849669','2849709','2849662','2849708'))) then '当月订单'
          else NULL end  as  order_type
    ,COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') as  first_channel_name_lastest --一级渠道名(最新)
    ,case when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t2.channel_hierarchy_2_lastest
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('MPD','DT') then t2.region_en_lastest
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA') then  t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest
          else 'Others' end        as  second_channel_name_lastest     	--二级渠道名(最新)
  
     -- ZVGSPVVG0382的period字段与VA05的period、订单号字段关联，订单号在VA05里，但不在0382里，2）VA05的Net字段值为0， Rj 字段值为空，Order qty字段值不为0，Created On为当月和上1个月
  
    ,case when t0.Document is not null and t1.sales_doc is null and t0.Net = 0 and (to_char(to_date(to_char(cast(t0.on_date AS  datetime),'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') = substr(t0.period,1,6) or to_char(to_date(to_char(cast(t0.on_date AS  datetime),'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') = to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(substr(t0.period,1,6) ,'yyyymm'),-1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') )
          then 'Y' else 'N' end    as  is_fg
    ,cast(if(upper(t0.SaTy) in ('ZXRE','ZARA'),-1,1) * nvl(t6.product_base_price,0)*(case when  t0.su in ('SHU','BOX') then  cast(t0.order_qty as Bigint) * cast(nvl(if(trim(t6.box_size) in ('','-') ,NULL,trim(t6.box_size)),1) as  bigint)  else  cast(t0.order_qty as Bigint)  end) as  decimal(28,6))   as  ges
    ,cast(nvl(t6.product_base_price,0) as decimal(28,6))  as  product_base_price
    ,t0.doc_date                             as  doc_date              
    ,t0.dlv_date                             as  dlv_date              
    ,t0.po_number                            as  po_number             
    ,t0.ship_to                              as  ship_to               
    ,t0.name_of_ship_to_party                as  name_of_ship_to_party 
    ,t0.item                                 as  item                  
    ,cast(t0.net_price   as decimal(28,6))                         as  net_price             
    ,t0.su                                   as  su                    
    ,t0.plnt                                 as  plnt                  
    ,t0.sloc                                 as  sloc                  
    ,t0.rj                                   as  rj                    
    ,t0.dlbl                                 as  dlbl                  
    ,t0.ordrs                                as  ordrs   
    ,concat(nvl(t0.Document,t1.sales_doc),t0.item)      as  sales_desc
    ,cast(t0.confirmqty   as decimal(28,6))                         as  confirmqty             
    ,t0.status  as  status_va05
    ,NULL  as  billing_date
    ,Upper(t0.next_month_flag)  as  next_month_flag

 (

 select

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_lily_mid_temp

as 
-----接口取出的天猫平台店铺（'14','90','142','442'）数据 和442店铺的历史数据 ，子表金额按照现有的分摊逻辑进行分摊-----
select  orderid
        ,ecommordersn
        ,goodsname
        ,logisticscompany
        ,orderstatus
        ,created
        ,commodity_sku
        ,order_time
        ,storeid
        ,cast(goodsprice as double) as goodsprice 
        ,cast(goodsnumber as int) as goodsnumber 
        ,case when storeid ='568' then cast(orderamount*nvl(sale_rate_568,1) as double)
              else  cast(goodsprice * goodsnumber - sub_discount_fee - (discountfee * sale_rate) + (adjust_fee * sale_rate) + (postfee * sale_rate) as double ) 
              end as payment_actual -- 实际付款金额
        ,trade_state
        ,num_iid -- spu码
        ,province_name
        ,city_name
        ,country_name
from    (
            select  t1.orderid , --	订单id
                    t1.ecommordersn , --	子订单号
                    t1.commodity_sku , --商家码
                    t1.goodsname , --	商品名称
                    t1.goodsnumber , --	商品数量
                    t1.goodsprice , --	商品单价
                    t1.sub_discount_fee,
                    t1.logisticscompany , --	物流公司
                    t1.orderstatus , --	订单状态
                    t1.created , --	创建时间
                    t2.orderpaytime as order_time,
                    t2.discountfee , -- 主订单优惠金额
                    t2.adjust_fee , -- 全场优惠
                    t2.postfee,
                    t2.storeid,
                    cast((t1.goodsprice * t1.goodsnumber - t1.sub_discount_fee) / ( t2.orderamount - t2.adjust_fee + t2.discountfee - t2.postfee) as decimal(28,6)) as sale_rate,
                    t2.trade_state,
                    t1.num_iid, -- spu码
                    t2.province_name,
                    t2.city_name,
                    t2.country_name,
                    cast(case when  sum(t1.goodsnumber * t1.goodsprice) over(partition by t1.orderid) =0 then t1.goodsnumber/sum(t1.goodsnumber) over(partition by t1.orderid)
                        else nvl((t1.goodsnumber * t1.goodsprice)/sum(t1.goodsnumber * t1.goodsprice) over(partition by t1.orderid),0) 
                        end as decimal(28,6)) as sale_rate_568,
                    t2.orderamount as orderamount
            from    (
                        
                        select   commodity_sku
                                ,created
                                ,sub_discount_fee --	子订单优惠
                                ,ecommordersn
                                ,goodsname
                                ,goodsnumber
                                ,goodsprice
                                ,orderid
                                ,orderstatus
                                ,logisticscompany
                                ,trade_adjust_fee --	全场优惠金额
                                ,tradediscountfee --	主订单优惠
                                ,num_iid -- spu码
                        from (
                              select  barcode as commodity_sku
                                      ,created
                                      ,cast(discountfee as double) as sub_discount_fee --	子订单优惠
                                      ,ecommordersn
                                      ,goodsname
                                      ,goodsnumber
                                      ,goodsprice
                                      ,orderid
                                      ,orderstatus
                                      ,logisticscompany
                                      ,cast(trade_adjust_fee as double) as trade_adjust_fee --	全场优惠金额
                                      ,cast(tradediscountfee as double) as tradediscountfee --	主订单优惠
                                       ,num_iid -- spu码
                                      ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY orderid,ecommordersn ORDER BY ds DESC,md5(concat(barcode,created,discountfee,ecommordersn,goodsname,goodsnumber,goodsprice,orderid,orderstatus,logisticscompany,trade_adjust_fee,tradediscountfee,num_iid)) desc) AS rn --主单号+子单号唯一
                              from    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_order_detail_info
                              where   ds >= '20200101'
                        ) t 
                        where rn = 1
                        union all
                        select  barcode as commodity_sku
                                ,created
                                ,cast(payment as double) as sub_discount_fee --历史数据excel给出的是discountfee，与现有接口字段一致
                                ,ecommordersn
                                ,goodsname
                                ,goodsnumber
                                ,goodsprice
                                ,orderid
                                ,orderstatus
                                ,logisticscompany
                                ,cast(trade_adjust_fee as double) as trade_adjust_fee --	全场优惠金额
                                ,cast(tradediscountfee as double) as tradediscountfee --	主订单优惠
                                ,num_iid
                        from    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_order_detail_info_his_442_444  -- 静态历史表，无需去重
                        where   ds = '1'
                    ) t1

            join (
                    select cast(adjust_fee as double) as adjust_fee
                          ,cast(preferential_amount as double) as discountfee
                          ,cast(actual_amount as double) as orderamount
                          ,order_no as orderid
                          ,cast(pay_time as string) as orderpaytime
                          ,cast(postage as double) as postfee
                          ,shop_id as storeid
                          ,trade_state
                           ,province_name
                          ,city_name
                          ,country_name
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_info_lily_mid
                    where ds >= '20200101'
                    and (
                      shop_id in ('14' ,'90' ,'142' ,'442','525','568')
                     or (shop_id='601' and substr(cast(pay_time as string),1,10)>='2024-09-23') -- 新增601店铺：施华蔻专业官方旗舰店 20240923开始从炜能切换到丽人
                    )
             ) t2
            on      t1.orderid = t2.orderid  

        ) t3

        null as express_company_code , -- 快递公司代码
        bcconvert(t.logisticscompany) as express_company_name , -- 快递公司名称
        null as express_num , -- 快递单号
        bcconvert(t.orderstatus) as sub_order_status , -- 子订单状态
        cast(bcconvert(t.created) as datetime) as create_time , -- 交易创建时间
        cast(t2.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price , -- 产品基价
        cast(
          cast(t2.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) * t.goodsnumber * nvl(t1.prod_qty,1) as decimal(28,6)
        ) as base_sale_amt , -- 基价销售金额
        cast(t2.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax , -- 含税零售价
        cast(
          cast(t2.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) * t.goodsnumber * nvl(t1.prod_qty,1) as decimal(28,6)
        ) as retail_tax_amt , -- 零售价销售金额
        nvl(t2.product_barcode,'-110') as henkel_item_barcode , -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
        nvl(t2.product_code,'-110') as henkel_idh_code , -- 汉高idh编号
        nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others') as henkel_brand_code , --汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
        nvl(t2.brand_name,'Others') as henkel_brand , -- 汉高品牌名称
        nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others') as henkel_brand_en , -- 汉高品牌英文名称
        nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others') as henkel_category_code , --汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
        nvl(t2.category_name,'Others') as henkel_category , -- 汉高品类名称
        nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others') as henkel_category_en , -- 汉高品类英文名称
        '20' as first_channel_id , -- 一级渠道id
        'Ecom' as first_channel_name , -- 一级渠道名称
        cast(
          payment_actual / if ((nvl(t.goodsnumber,1) * nvl(t1.prod_qty,1) * nvl(t1.base_price_rate ,1))=0,1,nvl(t.goodsnumber,1) * nvl(t1.prod_qty,1) * nvl(t1.base_price_rate ,1) ) as decimal(28,6)
        ) as unint_price_actual , --实际商品单价
        cast(
          payment_actual * nvl(t1.base_price_rate ,1) as decimal(28,6)
        ) as payment_actual , --实际付款金额
        cast(
          payment_actual / nvl(t5.tax_rate,1.13) * nvl(t1.base_price_rate ,1) as decimal(28,6)
        ) as untax_payment_actual , --实际付款金额未税
        t.storeid as shop_id
        --,t3.stander_store_name as shop_name
        ,nvl(t3.shop_name,'Others') as shop_name
        ,trade_state
        ,t.num_iid -- spu码
        ,t.province_name--收货人的所在省份名称
        ,t.city_name
        ,t.district_name
        ,replace(substr(order_time,1,10),'-','') as ds
        ,'e001' as ec
from    (
select  orderid
        ,ecommordersn
        ,goodsname
        ,logisticscompany
        ,orderstatus
        ,created
        ,commodity_sku
        ,order_time
        ,storeid
        ,goodsprice
        ,goodsnumber
        ,payment_actual
        ,trade_state
        ,num_iid
        ,province_name
        ,city_name
        ,country_name as district_name
from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_lily_mid_temp 
)t
left join(
             select   shop_id
                      ,plat_prod_code
                      ,henkel_prod_barcode
                      ,prod_qty
                      ,base_price_rate
                      ,ec
              from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
              where   ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
              and ec='e001'
) t1 on t.commodity_sku =t1.plat_prod_code 
and t.storeid = t1.shop_id
left join(
   select * from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu 
    where ds <> ''
) t2 on t1.henkel_prod_barcode=t2.product_barcode
and replace(substr(order_time,1,10),'-','') = t2.ds
left join(
-- select store_code,stander_store_name from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos
-- where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')
select  store_code,
            store_name as shop_name,
            ec_store_code_tp 
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu where ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and ec_store_code_tp is not null 

)t3 on t.storeid=t3.ec_store_code_tp
left join(               --去除掉明星活动奖品
 select  outer_product_code
 from    ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_activity_product_info b
        where   ds = '${bizdate}'
 group by outer_product_code
) t4 on t.commodity_sku =t4.outer_product_code
left join (
    select store_code,tax_rate
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_store_tax_rate_mapping
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_store_tax_rate_mapping')
) t5 on t.storeid=t5.store_code
where t4.outer_product_code is null
-- 合并海外店数据,走海外店接口
union all
select 
    ec_code , -- ec编码
    ec_name , -- ec名称
    cast(null as string) as order_no , -- 订单编号
    cast(null as string) as sub_order_no , -- 子订单编号
    commodity_code as commodity_sku , -- 商品sku
    commodity_name as commodity_name , -- 商品名称
    henkel_brand_code as brand_code , -- 品牌代码
    henkel_brand as brand_name , -- 品牌名称
    cast(null as string) as commodity_title , -- 商品标题
    quantity , -- 购买数量
    cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as unit_price , -- 商品单价
    cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as total_price_tax , -- 商品总价/含税
    cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as total_price_untax , -- 商品总价/不含税
    cast(null as string) as express_company_code , -- 快递公司代码
    cast(null as string) as express_company_name , -- 快递公司名称
    cast(null as string) as express_num , -- 快递单号
    cast(null as string) as sub_order_state , -- 子订单状态
    cast(null as datetime) as create_time , -- 交易创建时间
    base_price , -- 产品基价
    base_sale_amt , -- 基价销售金额
    retail_price_tax , -- 含税零售价
    retail_tax_amt , -- 零售价销售金额
    henkel_item_barcode , -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
    henkel_idh_code , -- 汉高idh编号
    henkel_brand_code , -- 品牌代码
    henkel_brand , -- 汉高品牌名称
    henkel_brand_code as henkel_brand_en , -- 汉高品牌英文名称
    henkel_category_code , -- 汉高品类代码
    henkel_category , -- 汉高品类名称
    henkel_category_code as henkel_category_en , -- 汉高品类英文名称
    first_channel_id , -- 一级渠道id
    first_channel_name , -- 一级渠道名称
    unint_price_actual , -- 实际商品单价
    payment_actual , -- 实际付款金额含税
    untax_payment_actual , -- 实际付款金额未税
    shop_id , -- 店铺id
    shop_name , -- 店铺名称
    cast(null as string) as trade_state , -- 主单状态
    cast(null as string) as num_iid , -- 平台spu码
    cast(null as string) as province_name , -- 省
    cast(null as string) as city_name , -- 市

    ds,

from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai
