DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_media_performance_data_temp_02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_media_performance_data_temp_02 AS
SELECT  t.key_id -- 主键ID，由多个字段MD5生成
        ,md5(CONCAT(t1.bu_1,t1.bu_2,t1.category_name,t1.product_line,key_id)) AS key_id_product_line
        ,md5(CONCAT(t1.bu_1,t1.bu_2,t1.category_name,t1.brand_name,key_id)) AS key_id_brand
        ,t.product_barcode_etl AS product_barcode -- 产品条码(已拆分)
        ,t1.product_name AS product_name -- 产品名称(来自维度表)
        ,t1.category_name -- 品类名称(来自维度表)
        ,t1.brand_name -- 品牌名称(来自维度表)
        ,t1.product_function -- 产品功能(来自维度表)
        ,t1.sub_product_function -- 子产品功能(来自维度表)
        ,t1.bu_1 -- 一级业务单元(来自维度表)
        ,t1.bu_2 -- 二级业务单元(来自维度表)
        ,t1.product_line -- 产品线(来自维度表)
        ,CONCAT(TOUPPER(SUBSTR(t.campaign_type,1,1)),TOLOWER(SUBSTR(t.campaign_type,2))) AS campaign_type -- 活动类型
        ,t.campaign_name -- 活动名称
        ,t.data_year -- 年份
        ,CASE   WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month)
                ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month)
        END AS data_month -- 月份(格式化为YYYYMM)
        ,CASE   WHEN LENGTH(t.data_day) = 1 THEN CONCAT(
                       CASE    WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month) ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month) END
                ,'0',data_day)
                ELSE CONCAT(
               CASE    WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month) ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month) END
        ,data_day)
        END AS data_day -- 日期(格式化为YYYYMMDD)
        ,CONCAT(TOUPPER(SUBSTR(t.aec_type,1,1)),TOLOWER(SUBSTR(t.aec_type,2))) AS aec_type -- AEC类型
        ,t.media_city_type -- 媒体城市类型
        ,CASE   WHEN t.media_type IN ('-','/') OR t.media_type IS NULL THEN 'Others'
                ELSE t.media_type
        END AS media_type -- 媒体类型
        ,t.media -- 媒体名称
        ,t.ad_position -- 广告位置
        ,t.ad_format -- 广告格式
        ,t.duration -- 持续时间
        ,t.device -- 设备类型
        ,t.campaign_ta -- 活动目标人群
        ,t.brand_ta -- 品牌目标人群
        ,t.ad_audience_targeting -- 广告受众定向
        ,CASE   WHEN t.city_group IN ('-','/','') THEN NULL
                ELSE t.city_group
        END AS city_group
        ,t.ad_audience_market -- 广告受众市场
        ,t.sales_channel_support -- 销售渠道支持
        ,t.landing_platform -- 落地平台
        ,t.agency_brief_id -- 代理简报ID
        ,t.po_id -- 采购订单ID
        -- 成本相关字段(清洗并转换为DECIMAL(28,6))
        ,CASE   WHEN t.po_amount_wo_vat IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.po_amount_wo_vat,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS po_amount_wo_vat -- PO金额(不含税)，去除¥和逗号
        ,CASE   WHEN t.media_cost_net_w_vat IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.media_cost_net_w_vat,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS media_cost_net_w_vat -- 媒体成本净值(含税)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.ac_w_vat IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.ac_w_vat,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS ac_w_vat -- AC(含税)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.ac_vat_percent IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.ac_vat_percent,'[%]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) / 100 AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS ac_vat_percent -- AC增值税率%，去除%并除以100转换为小数
        ,CASE   WHEN t.tracking_w_vat IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.tracking_w_vat,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS tracking_w_vat -- Tracking(含税)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.tracking_vat_percent IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.tracking_vat_percent,'[%]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) / 100 AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS tracking_vat_percent -- Tracking增值税率%
        ,CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.others_w_vat,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS others_w_vat -- Others(含税)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.others_vat_percent IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.others_vat_percent,'[%]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) / 100 AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS others_vat_percent -- Others增值税率%
        -- 效果指标(清洗并转换为DECIMAL(28,6))
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_imp IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_imp,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_imp -- 实际曝光量，去除千分位逗号
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_uv IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_uv,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_uv -- 实际访客数
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_tauv IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_tauv,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_tauv -- 实际目标人群访客数
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_clicks IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_clicks,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_clicks -- 实际点击量
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_engagement IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_engagement,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_engagement -- 实际互动量
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_ctr IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_ctr,'[%]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) / 100 AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_ctr -- 实际点击率(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_cpm IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_cpm,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_cpm -- 实际千次曝光成本
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_cpc IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_cpc,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_cpc -- 实际点击成本
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_cpe IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_cpe,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_cpe -- 实际互动成本
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_cp_uv IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_cp_uv,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_cp_uv -- 实际访客获取成本
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_cp_tauv IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_cp_tauv,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_cp_tauv -- 实际目标人群获取成本
        -- 触达相关指标
        ,CASE   WHEN t.brand_plan_reach_def IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.brand_plan_reach_def,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS brand_plan_reach_def -- 品牌计划触达(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.campaign_plan_reach_def IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.campaign_plan_reach_def,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS campaign_plan_reach_def -- 活动计划触达(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_campaign_reach_third_party IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_campaign_reach_third_party,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_campaign_reach_third_party -- 活动计划触达(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_brand_reach_publicis IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_brand_reach_publicis,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_brand_reach_publicis -- Publicis追踪品牌触达(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.act_campaign_reach_publicis IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.act_campaign_reach_publicis,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS act_campaign_reach_publicis -- Publicis追踪活动触达(百分比转小数)
        ,CASE   WHEN t.delivery_rate_brand_reach IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.delivery_rate_brand_reach,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))

                ELSE CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(t.delivery_rate_campaign_reach,'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6))
        END AS delivery_rate_campaign_reach -- 活动触达达成率(百分比转小数)
FROM    (
            -- 子查询：拆分product_barcode并生成key_id
            SELECT  TRIM(product_barcode_part) AS product_barcode_etl -- 拆分后的产品条码
                    ,md5(
                        
                        -- 生成唯一键
                        CONCAT(COALESCE(s.id,''),COALESCE(s.bu,''),COALESCE(s.category,''),COALESCE(s.product_line,''),COALESCE(s.product_barcode,''),COALESCE(s.product,''),COALESCE(s.campaign_type,''),COALESCE(s.campaign_name,''),COALESCE(s.data_year,''),COALESCE(s.data_month,''),COALESCE(s.data_day,''),COALESCE(s.aec_type,''),COALESCE(s.media_city_type,''),COALESCE(s.media_type,''),COALESCE(s.media,''),COALESCE(s.ad_position,''),COALESCE(s.ad_format,''),COALESCE(s.duration,''),COALESCE(s.device,''),COALESCE(s.campaign_ta,''),COALESCE(s.ad_audience_targeting,''),COALESCE(s.city_group,''),COALESCE(s.ad_audience_market,''),COALESCE(s.sales_channel_support,''),COALESCE(s.landing_platform,''),COALESCE(s.agency_brief_id,''),COALESCE(s.po_id,''))

            LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(SPLIT(s.product_barcode,'/')) t AS product_barcode_part
        ) t -- 关联产品维度表获取更多产品信息

        data_day,aec_type,media_city_type,platform,id,home_page_link,follower_count_w,account_type,

        ,t1.brand_name
        ,t1.product_function
        ,t1.sub_product_function
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,t1.product_line
        ,decode(t.campaign_type,'mega','Mega',t.campaign_type) as campaign_type
        ,t.campaign
        ,t.data_year
        ,CASE   WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month)
                ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month)
        END AS data_month
        ,CASE   WHEN LENGTH(t.data_day) = 1 THEN CONCAT(
                       CASE    WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month) ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month) END
                ,'0',data_day)
                ELSE CONCAT(
               CASE    WHEN LENGTH(t.data_month) = 1 THEN CONCAT(t.data_year,'0',t.data_month) ELSE CONCAT(t.data_year,t.data_month) END
        ,data_day)
        END AS data_day

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_media_social_retainer_performance_data PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
  bu_1,
  bu_2,
  brand_name,
  data_year,
  data_month,
  data_day,
  aec_type,
  platform,
  po_id,
  po_amount_wo_vat,
  follower_growth,
  total_imp,
  total_engagement
 from (
SELECT  CASE    WHEN toupper(bu) in('SP','SKP') then 'Professional'
                when toupper(bu) in('VS') then 'VS'
                when toupper(bu) in('LAUNDRY','LHC') then 'Consumer'
                when toupper(bu) in('SK') then 'Consumer'
                else 'Others'
                END AS bu_1
        ,case when toupper(bu) in('LAUNDRY','LHC') then 'Laundry'
              when toupper(bu) in('SK') then 'Beauty Care'
         else bu end AS bu_2 -- bu_2 直接取 BU
        ,case when brand in ('LHC','SKP','SP','VS') then NULL 
              when brand ='SK' then 'Extra Care'
              when brand ='SYOSS' then 'Syoss Care'
              else brand end
        as brand_name
        ,data_year
        ,CONCAT(data_year,LPAD(CAST(data_month AS STRING),2,'0')) AS data_month
        ,NULL AS data_day -- 源数据为 '/'，统一置为 NULL
        ,case when aec_type ='/' then null else aec_type end as aec_type
        ,case when platform ='/' or platform is null then 'Others' 
        else platform end as platform
        ,replace(po_id,'/','-')  as po_id -- 清洗数值字段：去除空格、逗号，转换为 DECIMAL
        ,CASE   WHEN po_amount_wo_vat IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                else CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(po_amount_wo_vat),'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) end AS po_amount_wo_vat
        ,CASE   WHEN follower_growth IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                else CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(follower_growth),'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) end AS follower_growth
        ,CASE   WHEN total_imp IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                else CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(total_imp),'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) end AS total_imp
        ,CASE   WHEN total_engagement IN ('-','/') THEN NULL
                else CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(total_engagement),'[^0-9\\.-]','') AS DECIMAL(28,6)) end AS total_engagement
        ,DENSE_RANK() over (PARTITION BY concat(data_year,data_month) order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) AS rn
FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_media_social_retainer_performance_data
WHERE   ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_media_social_retainer_performance_data')
AND     data_year IS NOT NULL
) t where rn = 1

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp01

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp01 as 
select 
    a.state_date,
    '602' as shop_code,
    a.commodity_code as commodity_code,
    b.product_barcode,
    b.product_base_price,
    sum(a.plat_qty) as plat_qty
from (
    select
        case when state_date REGEXP '/' and length(split(state_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(state_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))
            when state_date REGEXP '/' and length(split(state_date,'/')[0])=4 then concat(split(state_date,'/')[0],lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[2],2, '0'))
            when state_date REGEXP '.' and length(split(state_date,'\\.')[0])=4 then concat(split(state_date,'\\.')[0],lPAD(split(state_date,'\\.')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(state_date,'\\.')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(state_date,'-',''),1,8) end as state_date, 
        commodity_code,
        commodity_name,
        sku_id,
        sku_name,
        idh,
        plat_qty
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_prod_mapping_haiwai
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_prod_mapping_haiwai')
    and plat_qty is not null
) a 
left join (
    select 
        product_code,
        product_barcode,
        product_base_price，
        ds
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
    where ds>0
) b 
on a.idh=b.product_code
and a.state_date=b.ds
group by a.state_date,
    a.commodity_code,
    b.product_barcode,
    b.product_base_price
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp02

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp02 as 
SELECT  
    state_date,
    shop_code,
    commodity_code,
    product_barcode,
    plat_qty,
    product_base_price,
    case when product_total_base_price =0 then plat_qty/ if(nvl(product_cnt,0)=0,1,product_cnt)
        else nvl(cast(nvl(product_base_price,0)*plat_qty / product_total_base_price as decimal(28,6)),0) 
      end as base_price_rate    
from (
    select *,
    SUM(nvl(product_base_price,0)*plat_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY state_date,shop_code,commodity_code) as product_total_base_price,
    sum(plat_qty) over(partition by state_date,shop_code,commodity_code) as product_cnt
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp01
) a where nvl(product_cnt,0) <>0

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai partition (ds)
select  
    'e001' as ec_code,
    '丽人丽妆' as ec_name,
    a.state_date,
    a.shop_id,
    --e.stander_store_name as shop_name,
    e.shop_name as shop_name,
    a.commodity_code, -- 主商品ID
    a.commodity_name, -- 商品名称
    nvl(c.product_barcode,'-110') as henkel_item_barcode , -- 汉高商品条形码barcode
    nvl(c.product_code,'-110') as henkel_idh_code , -- 汉高idh编号
    nvl(c.brand_name_en,'Others') as henkel_brand_code , --汉高品牌代码 先使用品牌英文名称作为代码
    nvl(c.brand_name,'Others') as henkel_brand , -- 汉高品牌名称
    nvl(c.category_name_en,'Others') as henkel_category_code , --汉高品类代码 先使用品类英文名称作为代码
    nvl(c.category_name,'Others') as henkel_category , -- 汉高品类名称
    '20' as first_channel_id , -- 一级渠道id
    'Ecom' as first_channel_name , -- 一级渠道名称
    cast(if(a.goodsnumber * nvl(b.plat_qty,1)=0,null,a.pay_amount_tax * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1)/a.goodsnumber * nvl(b.plat_qty,1)) as decimal(28,6)) as unint_price_actual , --实际商品单价
    cast(a.uv as bigint) as uv, -- 商品访客数,未进行拆包处理
    cast(a.pay_amount_tax * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6)) as payment_actual, -- 实际付款金额含税
    cast(a.refund_amount_tax * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1) as decimal(28,6))  as refund_amount_tax, -- 成功退款金额含税
    cast(a.goodsnumber * nvl(b.plat_qty,1) as int) as  quantity,-- 销量
    cast(nvl(d.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6)) as tax_rate,
    cast(c.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price , -- 产品基价
    cast(c.product_base_price * a.goodsnumber * nvl(b.plat_qty,1) as decimal(28,6)) as base_sale_amt , -- 基价销售金额
    cast(c.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_price_tax , -- 含税零售价
    cast(c.retail_price_tax* a.goodsnumber * nvl(b.plat_qty,1) as decimal(28,6)) as retail_tax_amt , -- 零售价销售金额
    cast(a.pay_amount_tax * nvl(b.base_price_rate,1)/nvl(d.tax_rate,1.13) as decimal(28,6)) as untax_payment_actual , --实际付款金额未税
    a.state_date as ds
from (
    select
        case when state_date REGEXP '/' and length(split(state_date,'/')[0])<=2 then concat(split(state_date,'/')[2],lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[0],2, '0'),lPAD(split(state_date,'/')[1],2, '0'))

            when state_date REGEXP '.' and length(split(state_date,'\\.')[0])=4 then concat(split(state_date,'\\.')[0],lPAD(split(state_date,'\\.')[1],2, '0'),lPAD(split(state_date,'\\.')[2],2, '0'))
            else substr(replace(state_date,'-',''),1,8) end as state_date,
        commodity_name,
        commodity_code,
        replace(uv,',','') as uv,
        replace(pay_amount_tax,',','') as pay_amount_tax,
        replace(refund_amount_tax,',','') as refund_amount_tax,
        replace(goodsnumber,',','') as goodsnumber,
        '602' as shop_id
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_lily_sales_daily_info_haiwai

-- 获取DMS和MaiZhi的所有明细数据。 DMS 取20231101(不含)之前的数据, MaiZhi从20231101之后开始取数
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp1

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp1 as
select 
       dist_code 
      ,dist_name 
      ,id
      ,balance_month
      ,pnall
      ,dist_id
      ,dist_type
      ,client_code
      ,client_name
      ,store_nature_name
      ,stock_type
      ,prod_type_name
      ,dist_prod_spec
      ,dist_prod_unit
      ,dist_prod_quantity
      ,dist_prod_price
      ,dist_prod_amt
      ,count_qty
      ,count_unit
      ,base_qty
      ,base_unit
      ,gross_sales
      ,original_amount
      ,tax_rate
      ,dist_prod_code
      ,dist_prod_name
      ,prod_name
      ,dist_store_code
      ,dist_store_name
      ,store_code
      ,prod_code
      ,transfer_time
      ,tax_ind
      ,dist_prod_barcode
      ,bill_date
      ,bill_month
      ,source_code 
      ,sales_channel
      ,dist_store_code_orig
      ,dealerregion         -- 经销商大区(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,dealertype           -- 经销商类型(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,dealercode           -- 经销商编码(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,dealername           -- 经销商名称(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,dealerstatus         -- 经销商状态(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,storestatus          -- 门店状态(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,storetype            -- 门店分类(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,data_source
      ,batch2code
      ,batch2name
      ,OrderNo               -- 主订单编号
      ,SubOrderNo            -- 子订单编号
      ,ProvinceName          -- 省
      ,CityName              -- 市
      ,CountyName            -- 区
      ,StreetName            -- 街道
      ,ActualRefundAmount    -- 实际退款金额含税
      ,RefundQty             -- 退款数量
from 
(
-- 获取DMS数据
  select
    *
    ,null sales_channel
    ,null dist_store_code_orig
    ,null dealerregion -- 经销商大区(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null dealertype   -- 经销商类型(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null dealercode   -- 经销商编码(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null dealername   -- 经销商名称(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null dealerstatus -- 经销商状态(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null storestatus  -- 门店状态(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null storetype    -- 门店分类(ka系统原始数据) 
    ,null batch2code
    ,null batch2name
    ,null as OrderNo               -- 主订单编号
    ,null as SubOrderNo            -- 子订单编号
    ,null as ProvinceName          -- 省
    ,null as CityName              -- 市
    ,null as CountyName            -- 区
    ,null as StreetName            -- 街道
    ,null as ActualRefundAmount    -- 实际退款金额含税
    ,null as RefundQty             -- 退款数量
  from 
  (
    select 
       dist_code as dist_code, 
           dist_name as dist_name, 
           id as id,
           balance_month as balance_month,
           pnall as pnall,
           dist_id as dist_id,
           dist_type as dist_type,
           client_code as client_code,
           client_name as client_name,
           store_nature_name as store_nature_name,
           stock_type as stock_type,
           prod_type_name as prod_type_name,
           dist_prod_spec as dist_prod_spec,
           dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit,
           dist_prod_quantity as dist_prod_quantity,
           dist_prod_price as dist_prod_price,
           dist_prod_amt as dist_prod_amt,
           count_qty as count_qty,
           count_unit as count_unit,
           base_qty as base_qty,
           base_unit as base_unit,
           gross_sales as gross_sales,
           original_amount as original_amount,
           tax_rate as tax_rate,
           dist_prod_code as dist_prod_code,
           dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,
           prod_name as prod_name,
           dist_store_code as dist_store_code,
           dist_store_name as dist_store_name,
           store_code, --标准门店编码
           prod_code,  --标准产品编码
           transfer_time as transfer_time,
           tax_ind as tax_ind,
           dist_prod_barcode as dist_prod_barcode,
          to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as bill_date,
          to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month,
          '3' as source_code--系统来源编号 
      ,'DMS1' data_source     
    from  ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale 
    where ds <>'' 
    and 
    (
      dist_name not like '%手工%'  
      -- and dist_name not in('家乐福','万宁','大润发','盒马','莎莎') --家乐福、万宁、大润发的数据采用手工数，防止有系统数据冲突，在此处过滤
      and nvl(dist_code,'') not in('KA0001','KA0010','KA0005','KA0069','KA0070') --家乐福、万宁、大润发的数据采用手工数，防止有系统数据冲突，在此处过滤
      --and (abs(cast(original_amount as decimal(28,6))) > 0.01 or base_qty <>0)
      -- and dist_type in('LKA','NKA') --剔除Others
      --20230214 如下逻辑过滤资生堂的POS数据，待资生堂数据sign off后再放开
      --and client_code not in('KA0008_191771591101_POS','KA0007_xinyan_finance@163.com_POS')
      --and dist_prod_name not like '%资生堂%'
      --and dist_name <> '麦德龙'  --麦德龙需要取20220301之后的数据
      and nvl(dist_code,'') <> 'KA0004'  --麦德龙需要取20220301之后的数据
      or (
        to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') >='202203'
        --and dist_name = '麦德龙'
        and nvl(dist_code,'') = 'KA0004'
      )
    )
  union all 
    select  dist_code as dist_code,
        case when dist_name like '%人人乐%' then '人人乐'
          when dist_name like '%世纪联华%' then '世纪联华'
          when dist_name like '%物美%' then '物美美廉美'
          when dist_name like '%卜蜂莲花%' then '卜蜂莲花'
          when dist_name like '%天虹%' then '天虹'
          when dist_name like '%步步高%' then '步步高'
        else dist_name end as dist_name,
        null as id,
        null as balance_month,
        pnall as pnall,
        null as dist_id,
        dist_type as dist_type,
        client_code as client_code,
        client_name as client_name,
        null as store_nature_name,
        null as stock_type,
        prod_type_name as prod_type_name,
        null as dist_prod_spec,
        dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit,
        dist_prod_quantity as dist_prod_quantity,
        dist_prod_price as dist_prod_price,
        dist_prod_amt as dist_prod_amt,
        count_qty as count_qty,
        count_unit as count_unit,
        base_qty as base_qty,
        base_unit as base_unit,
        prod_tax_amt as gross_sales,
        dist_prod_amt_calculation as original_amount,--这个字段是金额字段，需要再次核对
        '0.13' as tax_rate,
        prod_code as dist_prod_code, --这个字段存储69码
        dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,
        prod_name as prod_name,
        dist_customer_code as dist_store_code, --这个字段存储门店id
        dist_customer_name as dist_store_name,
        store_code, --标准门店编码
        prod_code,  --标准产品编码
        create_time as transfer_time,
        '1' as tax_ind,
        dist_prod_barcode as dist_prod_barcode,
        replace(bill_date,'-','') as bill_date,
        substr(replace(bill_date,'-',''),1,6) as bill_month,
        '1' as source_code--手工来源编号
        ,'DMS1' data_source
  from dme_ods.s_ka_pos_data_sale_manual 
  where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_ka_pos_data_sale_manual') and dist_type = 'LKA'
  --and (abs(cast(dist_prod_amt_calculation as decimal(28,6))) > 0.01 or base_qty <>0)
  --以下几个系统统一从202201月份开始切数
  and  (substr(replace(bill_date,'-',''),1,6) >='202201' and regexp_count(dist_name, '(世纪联华|物美|卜蜂莲花|天虹|步步高)')=0 or substr(replace(bill_date,'-',''),1,6) < '202201')
  union all 
  --手工数据上传新系统就优先用手工数
  select m.*,'DMS1' data_source from (
    select replace(dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code,
      split_part(split_part(dist_name,'-',1),'—',1) as dist_name,
      id as id,
      balance_month as balance_month,
      pnall as pnall,
      dist_id as dist_id,
      dist_type as dist_type,
      client_code as client_code,
      client_name as client_name,
      store_nature_name as store_nature_name,
      stock_type as stock_type,
      prod_type_name as prod_type_name,
      dist_prod_spec as dist_prod_spec,
      dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit,
      dist_prod_quantity as dist_prod_quantity,
      dist_prod_price as dist_prod_price,
      dist_prod_amt as dist_prod_amt,
      count_qty as count_qty,
      count_unit as count_unit,
      base_qty as base_qty,
      base_unit as base_unit,
      gross_sales as gross_sales,
      original_amount as original_amount,
      tax_rate as tax_rate,
      dist_prod_code as dist_prod_code,
      dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,
      prod_name as prod_name,
      dist_store_code as dist_store_code,
      dist_store_name as dist_store_name,
      store_code, --标准门店编码
      prod_code,  --标准产品编码
      transfer_time as transfer_time,
      tax_ind as tax_ind,
      dist_prod_barcode as dist_prod_barcode,
      to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as bill_date,
      to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month,
      '2' as source_code--系统中手工数据来源编号
    from  ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale where ds <>'' 
    and dist_name like '%手工%' 
    -- and (dist_type in ('LKA') or dist_name in('麦德龙-手工上传'))
    and if(dist_type in ('NKA'),dist_name ='麦德龙-手工上传',1=1)
  ) m
  --手工有可能会出现上传错误的情况，则会有冲销的数据进来，所以这边加上一个逻辑，当某个KA当月都是0的时候就不取
  join(
  select sum(base_qty) as base_qty,
      to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month, 
      split_part(split_part(dist_name,'-',1),'—',1) as dist_name
  from  ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale where ds <>'' 
    and dist_name like '%手工%' 
    -- and (dist_type in ('LKA') or dist_name in('麦德龙-手工上传'))
    and if(dist_type in ('NKA'),dist_name ='麦德龙-手工上传',1=1)
    group by to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm'),split_part(split_part(dist_name,'-',1),'—',1)
  )n on m.dist_name=n.dist_name and m.bill_month=n.bill_month 
    --where nvl(n.base_qty,0) <>0
  union all 
  select t.*,'DMS2' data_source from(
    select dist_code,
           dist_name,
           id as id,
           balance_month as balance_month,
           pnall as pnall,
           dist_id as dist_id,
           dist_type as dist_type,
           client_code as client_code,
           client_name as client_name,
           store_nature_name as store_nature_name,
           stock_type as stock_type,
           prod_type_name as prod_type_name,
           dist_prod_spec as dist_prod_spec,
           dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit,
           dist_prod_quantity as dist_prod_quantity,
           dist_prod_price as dist_prod_price,
           dist_prod_amt as dist_prod_amt,
           count_qty as count_qty,
           count_unit as count_unit,
           base_qty as base_qty,
           base_unit as base_unit,
           gross_sales as gross_sales,
           original_amount as original_amount,
           tax_rate as tax_rate,
           dist_prod_code as dist_prod_code,
           dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,
           prod_name as prod_name,
           dist_store_code as dist_store_code,
           dist_store_name as dist_store_name,
           store_code, --标准门店编码
           prod_code,  --标准产品编码
           transfer_time as transfer_time,
           tax_ind as tax_ind,
           dist_prod_barcode as dist_prod_barcode,
           to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as bill_date,
           to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month,
           '3' as source_code--系统中手工数据来源编号
    from  ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale where ds <>'' 
    and dist_name in('卜蜂莲花','天虹')
    and  to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') in ('202301','202302','202303')
    )t 
    left join(
        select 
        replace(dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code,
        dist_store_code,
        to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month
        from  ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale where ds <>''
        and dist_code like '%SG%'
        and replace(dist_code,'SG-','') in('KA0034','KA0002')
        and  to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') in ('202301','202302','202303')
        group by 
        replace(dist_code,'SG-',''),
        dist_store_code,
        to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm')
    ) t1 on t.dist_code=t1.dist_code and t.dist_store_code=t1.dist_store_code and t.bill_month=t1.bill_month
  where t1.dist_code is null
  ) a1
  union all
-- 获取MaiZhi数据 
  select 
       replace(t1.dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code 
      ,split_part(split_part(t1.dist_name,'-',1),'—',1)  as dist_name 
      ,t1.id as id
      ,t1.balance_month as balance_month
      ,t1.pnall         as pnall
      ,t1.dist_id       as dist_id
      ,t1.dist_type     as dist_type
      ,t1.client_code   as client_code
      ,t1.client_name   as client_name
      ,t1.store_nature_name as store_nature_name
      ,t1.stock_type     as stock_type
      ,t1.prod_type_name as prod_type_name
      ,t1.dist_prod_spec as dist_prod_spec
      ,t1.dist_prod_unit as dist_prod_unit
      ,t1.dist_prod_quantity as dist_prod_quantity
      ,t1.dist_prod_price    as dist_prod_price
      ,t1.dist_prod_amt      as dist_prod_amt
      ,t1.count_qty          as count_qty
      ,t1.count_unit         as count_unit
      ,t1.base_qty           as base_qty
      ,t1.base_unit          as base_unit
      ,t1.gross_sales        as gross_sales
      ,t1.original_amount    as original_amount
      ,t1.tax_rate           as tax_rate
      ,t1.dist_prod_code     as dist_prod_code
      ,t1.dist_prod_name     as dist_prod_name
      ,t1.prod_name          as prod_name
      ,case when t1.dist_code='KA0011' and nvl(t1.sales_channel,'') not like '%线下%' and nvl(t1.sales_channel,'') like '%-%' then split_part(t1.sales_channel,'-',1)
      else t1.dist_store_code end as dist_store_code
      ,t1.dist_store_name    as dist_store_name
      ,t1.store_code         as store_code
      ,t1.prod_code          as prod_code
      ,t1.transfer_time      as transfer_time
      ,t1.tax_ind            as tax_ind
      ,t1.dist_prod_barcode  as dist_prod_barcode
      ,to_char(to_date(t1.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as bill_date
      ,to_char(to_date(t1.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month
      ,t2.source_code
      ,'MaiZhi' data_source
      ,t1.sales_channel      as sales_channel
      ,t1.dist_store_code    as dist_store_code_orig
      ,t1.DealerRegion -- 经销商大区(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.DealerType   -- 经销商类型(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.DealerCode   -- 经销商编码(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.DealerName   -- 经销商名称(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.DealerStatus -- 经销商状态(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.StoreStatus  -- 门店状态(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,t1.StoreType    -- 门店分类(ka系统原始数据) 
      ,case when t1.batch2code is not null and length(t1.batch2code)>1 then batch2code else null end as batch2code
      ,case when batch2name is not null and length(batch2name)>1 then batch2name else null end as batch2name
      ,t1.OrderNo               -- 主订单编号
      ,t1.SubOrderNo            -- 子订单编号
      ,t1.ProvinceName          -- 省
      ,t1.CityName              -- 市
      ,t1.CountyName            -- 区
      ,t1.StreetName            -- 街道
      ,t1.ActualRefundAmount    -- 实际退款金额含税
      ,t1.RefundQty             -- 退款数量
 from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi t1
inner join (
     select 
          t.bill_date,t.dist_code,t.ds,t.source_code
         ,row_number()over(partition by t.bill_date,t.dist_code order by t.ds desc) as rn
       from (
            select  distinct
              a.ds,replace(a.dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code
              ,to_char(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month
              ,to_char(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as bill_date  
              ,'1'  as source_code
          from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi a
          where ds<>''  
        ) t
      ) t2

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp3 as
select dist_type,
    dist_code,
    max(prod_code) as prod_code,
    dist_prod_code,
    dist_prod_name,
    dist_prod_barcode
from (
    select
    dist_type,
    dist_code,
    prod_code,
    dist_prod_code,
    dist_prod_name,
    dist_prod_barcode
    from
    (
        select
            dist_type,
            replace(dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code,
            prod_code,
            dist_prod_code,
            dist_prod_name,
            dist_prod_barcode,
            row_number() over(partition by replace(dist_code,'SG-',''),dist_prod_code,dist_prod_name,dist_prod_barcode order by ds desc,bill_date desc,prod_code desc) rn
        from (
           select dist_type,dist_code,prod_code,dist_prod_code,dist_prod_name,dist_prod_barcode
            ,bill_date
            ,ds
            ,dense_rank()over(partition by to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd'),dist_code order by ds desc) as rn
           from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi
           where ds <> '1' 
           and to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') >= '20231101'
          )
          where rn=1
        --and dist_type in('LKA','NKA') --只取NKA和LKA,过滤Others
        --and length(prod_code) in(13,15)   --只取有效的产品mapping
    ) where rn = 1

    union all 


    select a.dist_type as dist_type,
        replace(a.dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code,
        b.henkel_barcode as prod_code,
        a.dist_prod_code as dist_prod_code,
        a.dist_prod_name as dist_prod_name,
        a.dist_prod_barcode
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi a 
    --迈志的KA POS系统推过来的POS和库存数据中包含了沃尔玛和山姆的Laundry产品、且产品barcode列为qita，这部分数据需进行识别
    join (
        select dist_code, dist_prod_code,max(henkel_barcode) as henkel_barcode
        from dme_ods.s_dist_prod_code_henkel_barcode_mapping
        where ds=max_pt('dme_ods.s_dist_prod_code_henkel_barcode_mapping')
        group by dist_code, dist_prod_code
    ) b on replace(a.dist_code,'SG-','')=b.dist_code and a.dist_prod_code=b.dist_prod_code 
    where a.ds <> '1' 
   -- and a.dist_type in('LKA','NKA') --只取NKA和LKA,过滤Others
    and to_char(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') >= '20231101'
    and lower(a.prod_code) like '%qita%'
    group by a.dist_type,replace(a.dist_code,'SG-',''),b.henkel_barcode,a.dist_prod_code,a.dist_prod_name,a.dist_prod_barcode
) a 
group by dist_type, dist_code,dist_prod_code,dist_prod_name,dist_prod_barcode

       --补上卜蜂莲花和天虹系统有手工没有的这块数据.  原因是:以天虹举例手工上传的数据distname统一为天虹,但是手工填报的数据中只包含部分天虹,如广东天虹.所以会导致其他天虹被上面的排序规则过滤掉.在此处补上
       SELECT *,1 as rn from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp2
       where data_source = 'DMS2' 
  ) a
  left join
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp6 b
          on a.dist_code = b.dist_code
          and a.dist_prod_code = b.dist_prod_code
  left join
      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily_mid_temp7 c
          on a.dist_code = c.dist_code
          and a.dist_store_code = c.dist_store_code
  left join
  (
        select
            case
            when nka_system = '大润发' then 'KA0005'
            when nka_system = '华润' and chain_name = '华润万家' then 'KA0008'
            when nka_system = '华润' and chain_name = '华润乐购' then 'KA0009'
            when nka_system = '永辉' then 'KA0003'
            when nka_system = '麦德龙' then 'KA0004'
            when nka_system = '屈臣氏' then 'KA0011'
            when nka_system = '沃尔玛' and chain_name = '沃尔玛' then 'KA0006'
            when nka_system = '沃尔玛' and chain_name = '沃尔玛山姆会员' then 'KA0007'
            when nka_system = '华润' and chain_name = '华润苏果' then 'KA0068'
            end as dist_code,
            distributor_store_code as dist_store_code,
            store_oneid,
            row_number() over(partition by chain_name,distributor_store_code order by store_oneid) rn
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list
        where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos_store_list')
        group by
            nka_system,
            chain_name,
            distributor_store_code,
            store_oneid
    ) d on a.dist_code = d.dist_code
        and a.dist_store_code = d.dist_store_code
        and d.rn = 1
        and d.dist_code is not null
  where a.rn=1
) t1

      --when t1.fourth_channel_name = '华润苏果' then '间供' --华润苏果间供

      --   case when t1.ds>='20240315' and (t1.DealerCode='100000' or t1.DealerName regexp'直供') then '直供'
      --     else '间供' end 
      --when t1.third_channel_name regexp '永辉' then '间供'
      --else 'Others'
      
      when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' then ( case when t1.dist_region_name in ('华西','华南','华北') then '直供'else '间供' end ) 
      when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0001' then ( case when t1.dist_region_name in ('华东','华南') then '直供' else '间供' end)  --家乐福除家乐福东区和南区直供

    ,t1.delivery_store_name  --汉高线下配送门店名称
    ,t1.henkel_store_code_orig --事实表汉高门店编码
    ,'${bizdate}' as ds

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_store_main_brand_mapping PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')

        ,store_name
        ,main_brand
FROM    (
            SELECT  store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,main_brand
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_ecom_store_main_brand_mapping

        ) t
WHERE   rn = 1

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp_temp01 AS
SELECT  channel_name
        ,compare_date
        ,LEAD(compare_date,1,'99991231') OVER (ORDER BY compare_date ) AS next_compare_date
        ,'1' AS flag
FROM    (
            SELECT  channel_name
                    ,day_id AS compare_date
            FROM    (
                        --获取对比版本
                        SELECT  channel_name
                                ,run_date
                        FROM    (
                                    SELECT  channel_name
                                            ,run_date
                                            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name,run_date ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                                    FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_delivery_schedule_control_cp
                                    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_delivery_schedule_control_cp')
                                ) a
                        WHERE   rn = 1
                    ) t
            JOIN    (
                        SELECT  day_id
                                ,CAST(SUBSTR(day_id,7,2) AS BIGINT) AS dt
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                        WHERE   day_id >= '20260101'
                    ) t1
            ON      t.run_date = t1.dt
        ) o

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.channel_name
        ,t.compare_date
        ,t1.day_id AS push_date
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp_temp01 t
JOIN    (
            SELECT  day_id
                    ,'1' AS flag
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
            WHERE   day_id >= '20260101'
        ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag
AND     t1.day_id > t.compare_date
AND     t1.day_id <= t.next_compare_date

select
 a.KACode

 ,a.IsDelete

--计算基价分摊占比
drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc_temp_03

create table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc_temp_03
as 
select
    shop_id, -- 店铺id
    shop_name, -- 店铺名称
    plat_prod_code, -- 平台产品编码
    henkel_prod_barcode, -- 汉高产品条码
    prod_qty, --商品数量
    nvl(base_price,0) as base_price, --套包内商品总基价
    product_total_base_price, -- 平台商品总基价
    --当平台码包含正装时,且正装基价之和是0时,则按正装产品的个数均摊占比,免费品不分摊
    --当平台码包含正装时,且正装基价之和不是0时,则按正装产品的基价均摊占比,免费票不分摊
    --当平台码包含正装时,免费品不分摊
    CASE WHEN plat_prod_type = 1 THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN product_type = 1 AND COALESCE(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0) = 0 THEN prod_qty / NULLIF(product_cnt_zhengzhuang, 0)
            WHEN product_type = 1 AND COALESCE(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0) <> 0 THEN nvl(base_price / NULLIF(base_price_zhengzhuang, 0),0)
            ELSE 0 
        END
    --当平台码不含正装时,且正装基价之和是0时,则按产品的个数均摊占比
    --当平台码不含正装时,且正装基价之和不是0时,则按产品的基价均摊占比
    WHEN plat_prod_type = 0 THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(product_total_base_price, 0) = 0 THEN prod_qty / NULLIF(product_total_cnt, 0)
            WHEN COALESCE(product_total_base_price, 0) <> 0 THEN nvl(base_price / NULLIF(product_total_base_price, 0),0)
            ELSE 0 
        END
END as base_price_rate,
    c1.product_type, --1代表正装,0代表免费品
    effective_time,
    expiration_time,
    source_type as data_source
from
(
    -- 计算组合中单品的基价,得到的结果集为拆包后的商品价格，如果商品数量*2则对应的价格也会*2,
    -- 也会存在关联不到产品主数据的情况，也会存在套包里有部分关联不到产品主数据的情况
    select
        ec,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        plat_prod_code,
        split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',1) as henkel_prod_barcode,
        prod_qty,--商品数量
        prod_qty * product_base_price as base_price,
        SUM(case when product_type =1 then prod_qty * product_base_price
        else 0 end) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,effective_time,expiration_time) as base_price_zhengzhuang, -- 正装产品基价
        sum(case when product_type =1 then prod_qty else 0 end) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,effective_time,expiration_time) as product_cnt_zhengzhuang,--正装商品数量
        sum(prod_qty * product_base_price) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,effective_time,expiration_time) as product_total_base_price,--套包内商品总基价
        sum(prod_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,effective_time,expiration_time) as product_total_cnt, --套包内商品总数量
        MAX(product_type) OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,effective_time,expiration_time) AS plat_prod_type, --套包类型,包含正装则置正装
        product_type, --套包内商品类型
        effective_time,
        expiration_time,
        source_type
    from
    (
        select
            ec,
            shop_code as shop_id,
            shop_name,
            plat_prod_code,
            henkel_prod_barcode_temp as product_barcode,
            new_henkel_prod_barcode,
            case when split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) is null 
            or split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) ='' then 1 else
            split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',2) end as prod_qty,
            decode(product_type,'正装',1,0) as product_type,
            effective_time,
            expiration_time,
            source_type
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc_temp_02 a
            lateral view explode(split(henkel_prod_barcode_temp,'\\+')) b as new_henkel_prod_barcode
    ) t1
    left join
    (
         select
            product_barcode,
            product_base_price
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
    ) t2 on split_part(new_henkel_prod_barcode,'*',1) = t2.product_barcode 

) c1

--按有效时间拆开至ds分区,且去重,防止数据overlap
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc PARTITION (ds)
SELECT  shop_id
        ,shop_name
        ,plat_prod_code
        ,henkel_prod_barcode
        ,prod_qty
        ,base_price
        ,product_total_base_price
        ,base_price_rate
        ,product_type
        ,effective_time
        ,expiration_time
        ,decode(data_source,'1','手工','2','系统') as data_source
        ,ds
FROM    (
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,plat_prod_code
                    ,henkel_prod_barcode
                    ,prod_qty
                    ,base_price
                    ,product_total_base_price
                    ,base_price_rate
                    ,product_type
                    ,effective_time
                    ,expiration_time
                    ,data_source
                    ,day_id AS ds
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY shop_id,plat_prod_code,henkel_prod_barcode,day_id ORDER BY effective_time DESC ) AS rn
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  shop_id
                                ,shop_name
                                ,plat_prod_code
                                ,henkel_prod_barcode
                                ,prod_qty
                                ,base_price
                                ,product_total_base_price
                                ,base_price_rate
                                ,product_type
                                ,effective_time
                                ,expiration_time
                                ,data_source
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc_temp_03
                    ) t
            JOIN    (
                        SELECT  '1' AS flag
                                ,day_id
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                        WHERE   day_id <= '${bizdate}'
                        AND     day_id >= '20190101'
                    ) t1
            ON      t.flag = t1.flag
            AND     t.effective_time <= t1.day_id
            AND     t.expiration_time >= t1.day_id
        ) o
WHERE   rn = 1

SELECT
   t.bu
   ,t.FCST_Date
   ,t.FCST_Date_Align
   ,t.channel_name
   ,t.dimension_name
   ,COALESCE(t1.update_distributor, t.dist_code) AS dist_code

      bu

      ,FCST_Date_Align
      ,channel_name
      ,dimension_name
      ,dist_code
      ,dist_name_cn
      ,metric_code
      ,metric_name
      ,data_year
      ,data_months
      ,CAST(data_value AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS data_value
      ,update_time
      ,data_source
   FROM (
      SELECT
         bu
         ,FCST_Date
         ,FCST_Date_Align
         ,channel_name
         ,dimension_name
         ,dist_code
         ,dist_name_cn
         ,second_layer_dist_code
         ,second_layer_dist_name
         ,second_layer_dist_category
         ,metric_code
         ,metric_name
         ,data_year
         ,MAP(
             CONCAT(data_year,'01'),Jan,CONCAT(data_year,'02'),Feb,CONCAT(data_year,'03'),Mar,
             CONCAT(data_year,'04'),Apr,CONCAT(data_year,'05'),May,CONCAT(data_year,'06'),Jun,

         ,YTD
         ,H1
         ,H2
         ,Q1
         ,Q2
         ,Q3
         ,Q4
         ,update_time
         ,'MP' AS data_source
      FROM (
          SELECT  *
               ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY FCST_Date_Align ORDER BY ds DESC ) AS rn
          FROM ${dme_ods}.s_cp_mp_data
          WHERE ds<>''
          AND  dimension_name = 'customer'
          AND  bu <> 'CB'
       )
      WHERE rn = 1
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        bu
        ,FCST_Date --后续需要删除此条件
        ,FCST_Date_Align --后续需要删除此条件
        ,channel_name
        ,dimension_name
        ,dist_code
        ,dist_name_cn
        ,second_layer_dist_code
        ,second_layer_dist_name
        ,second_layer_dist_category
        ,metric_code
        ,metric_name
        ,data_year
        ,MAP(
            CONCAT(data_year,'01'),Jan,CONCAT(data_year,'02'),Feb,CONCAT(data_year,'03'),Mar,
            CONCAT(data_year,'04'),Apr,CONCAT(data_year,'05'),May,CONCAT(data_year,'06'),Jun,
            CONCAT(data_year,'07'),Jul,CONCAT(data_year,'08'),Aug,CONCAT(data_year,'09'),Sep,
            CONCAT(data_year,'10'),Oct,CONCAT(data_year,'11'),Nov,CONCAT(data_year,'12'),Dec
        ) AS kv
        ,YTD
        ,H1
        ,H2
        ,Q1
        ,Q2
        ,Q3
        ,Q4
        ,update_time
        ,'KP' AS data_source
      FROM (
           SELECT  *
                 ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY FCST_Date_Align ORDER BY ds DESC ) AS rn
           FROM  ${dme_ods}.s_cp_kp_data
           WHERE ds <>''
           AND   dimension_name = 'customer'
           AND   bu <> 'CB'
       )
      WHERE rn = 1
   ) a
   LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(kv) z AS data_months
   ,data_value
 ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
   select dist_code
      ,update_distributor
   from (
       SELECT  dist_code
             ,update_distributor
             ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dist_code ORDER BY ds DESC ) AS rn
       FROM  ${dme_ods}.s_cp_new_distributor_info
       WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_cp_new_distributor_info')
       AND   TRIM(NVL(update_distributor,''))<>''
   ) O where rn = 1
   ) t1
ON t.dist_code = t1.dist_code

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_fcst_sales_temp01 AS
SELECT
   fcst_date
   ,fcst_date_orig
   ,channel
   ,customer_idh
   ,dist_name_cn
   ,years
   ,months
   ,bu         as bu_2
   ,nvl(ges,0) as ges
   ,nvl(ppd,0) as ppd
   ,nvl(pld,0) as pld
   ,nvl(fg,0)  as fg
   ,nvl(l6a_others,0) as l6a_others
   ,nvl(l6b_others,0) as l6b_others
   ,nvl(ppd,0) + nvl(pld,0) + nvl(fg,0) + nvl(l6a_others,0) as l6a
   ,nvl(ca,0) as ca
   ,nvl(listing_fee,0) as listing_fee
   ,nvl(rebate,0)      as rebate
   ,nvl(logistics_fee,0)   as logistics_fee
   ,nvl(int_agreement,0) as int_agreement
   ,nvl(oos_penalty,0) as oos
   ,nvl(promotion_activities,0) as promotion_activities
   ,nvl(ka_expense,0)  as ka_expense
   ,nvl(ca,0) + nvl(rebate,0) + nvl(ka_expense,0) + nvl(listing_fee,0) + nvl(promotion_activities,0) + nvl(logistics_fee,0) + nvl(oos_penalty,0) + nvl(int_agreement,0) + nvl(deduction,0) + nvl(ror,0) + nvl(l6b_others,0) as l6b
   ,nvl(ror,0)         as ror
   ,nvl(deduction,0)   as deduction
   ,nvl(l10_service_fee,0) as l10_service_fee --L10服务商费用
   ,case when channel ='MPD' then nvl(l17_channel,0)
    else nvl(l17_o2o,0) + nvl(l17_ba,0) + nvl(l17_channel_specific,0) + nvl(l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot,0) + nvl(l17_ec_live_streaming,0) + nvl(l17_ec_customer_service_fee,0) + nvl(l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast,0) + nvl(l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee,0) + nvl(l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production,0) + nvl(l17_ec_data_service_fee,0) + nvl(l17_ec_gift_giveaway,0) + nvl(l17_ec_others,0)  + nvl(l17_ec_not_allocated,0) + nvl(l17_ec_eka_service_fee,0) end as l17_channel
   ,nvl(l17_channel,0) as l17_channel_orig
   ,nvl(l17_ba,0)            as l17_ba
   ,nvl(l17_o2o,0)           as l17_o2o
   ,nvl(l17_channel_specific,0)           as l17_channel_specific
   ,nvl(l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot,0) as l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot
   ,nvl(l17_ec_live_streaming,0) as l17_ec_live_streaming
   ,nvl(l17_ec_customer_service_fee,0) as l17_ec_customer_service_fee
   ,nvl(l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast,0) as l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast
   ,nvl(l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee,0) as l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee
   ,nvl(l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production,0) as l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production
   ,nvl(l17_ec_data_service_fee,0) as l17_ec_data_service_fee
   ,nvl(l17_ec_gift_giveaway,0)    as l17_ec_gift_giveaway
   ,nvl(l17_ec_others,0)           as l17_ec_others                   -- EC其他
   ,nvl(l17_ec_not_allocated,0) as l17_ec_not_allocated
   ,nvl(mini_inv_value,0)       as mini_inv_value
   ,nvl(ges,0) - (nvl(ppd,0) + nvl(pld,0) + nvl(fg,0) + nvl(l6a_others,0)) as ngs -- ngs=nes-l6a
   ,nvl(ges,0) - (nvl(ppd,0) + nvl(pld,0) + nvl(fg,0) + nvl(l6a_others,0)) - (nvl(ca,0) + nvl(rebate,0) + nvl(ka_expense,0) + nvl(listing_fee,0) + nvl(promotion_activities,0) + nvl(logistics_fee,0) + nvl(oos_penalty,0) + nvl(int_agreement,0) + nvl(l6b_py_release,0) + nvl(deduction,0) + nvl(ror,0) + nvl(l6b_others,0)) as nes -- nes=ngs-l6b
   ,nvl(ppd,0) + nvl(pld,0) + nvl(fg,0) + nvl(l6a_others,0) + nvl(ca,0) + nvl(rebate,0) + nvl(ka_expense,0) + nvl(listing_fee,0) + nvl(promotion_activities,0) + nvl(logistics_fee,0) + nvl(oos_penalty,0) + nvl(int_agreement,0) + nvl(l6b_py_release,0) + nvl(deduction,0) + nvl(ror,0) + nvl(l6b_others,0) as ttl_l6 -- L6_TTL = l6a+l6b
   ,nvl(pos_gmv_so_act_untax        ,0) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax         -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
   ,nvl(pos_gmv_so_base_untax       ,0) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax        -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
   ,nvl(pos_gmv_act_untax           ,0) as pos_gmv_act_untax            -- POS实价
   ,nvl(final_inv_value             ,0) as final_inv_value              -- 期末库存
   ,nvl(final_inv_value_fg          ,0) as final_inv_value_fg           -- 期末库存(小样/免费品)
   ,nvl(sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax ,0) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,nvl(sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax ,0) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,nvl(sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax,0) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,nvl(sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax    ,0) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax     -- 近3个月月均SO
   ,nvl(sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax    ,0) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax     -- 近6个月月均SO
   ,nvl(sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax   ,0) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax    -- 近12个月月均SO
   ,l6b_py_release
   ,l17_py_release
   ,l17_allocated
   ,update_time
   ,data_source
   ,nvl(l17_ec_eka_service_fee,0) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee    -- EKA服务费
FROM
(
  --判空前先强转一下,防止来源数据有非数字格式
  SELECT
      FCST_Date_Align as fcst_date    -- 统一版本
      ,fcst_date    as fcst_date_orig -- 原始版本
      ,channel_name as channel
      ,dist_code    as customer_idh
      ,dist_name_cn
      ,data_year    as years
      ,data_months  as months
      ,bu
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L001'  then data_value else 0 end) as ges  -- GES
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L002'  then data_value else 0 end) as ppd  -- PPD
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L003'  then data_value else 0 end) as pld  -- PLD
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L004'  then data_value else 0 end) as fg   -- FG
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L005'  then data_value else 0 end) as l6a_others  -- L6a others
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L006'  then data_value else 0 end) as ngs -- NGS
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L007'  then data_value else 0 end) as ca -- CA
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L008'  then data_value else 0 end) as rebate -- Rebate
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L009'  then data_value else 0 end) as ka_expense  -- KA Expense
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L010'  then data_value else 0 end) as listing_fee -- Listing Fee
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L011'  then data_value else 0 end) as promotion_activities  -- Promotion Activities
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L012'  then data_value else 0 end) as logistics_fee  -- Logistics
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L013'  then data_value else 0 end) as oos_penalty  -- OOS Penalty
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L014'  then data_value else 0 end) as int_agreement  -- Int. Agreement
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L015'  then data_value else 0 end) as deduction  -- Deduction
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L016'  then data_value else 0 end) as ror  -- ROR
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L017'  then data_value else 0 end) as l6b_others  -- L6b others
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L018'  then data_value else 0 end) as nes  -- NES
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L019'  then data_value else 0 end) as l10_service_fee  -- L10服务商费用
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L020'  then data_value else 0 end) as l17_channel  -- L17 Channel
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L021' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_o2o -- O2O
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L022' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ba  -- BA
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L023' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_channel_specific  -- L17 NKA/MPD/DT
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L024' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot  -- EC平台资源包/付费推广
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L025' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_live_streaming        -- EC直播
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L026' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_customer_service_fee  -- EC客服费
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L027' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast-- EC站内自播
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L028' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee            -- EC CRM运营服务费
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L029' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production  -- EC内容采买/内容制作
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L030' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_data_service_fee                     -- EC数据服务费
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L031' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_gift_giveaway                        -- EC礼品赠品
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L032' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee                      -- EKA服务费
      ,sum(case when metric_code='P&L033' and nvl(channel_name,'')<>'MPD' then data_value else 0 end) as l17_ec_others                        -- EC其他
      ,0 as l17_ec_not_allocated
      ,0 as mini_inv_value
      ,sum(case when metric_code='PO&SO001'then data_value else 0 end) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax  -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
      ,sum(case when metric_code='PO&SO002'then data_value else 0 end) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
      ,sum(case when metric_code='PO&SO003'then data_value else 0 end) as pos_gmv_act_untax  -- POS实价

      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV002'	 then data_value else 0 end) as final_inv_value_fg -- 期末库存(小样/免费品)
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV003'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV004'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV005'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV006'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV007'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO
      ,sum(case when metric_code='INV008'	 then data_value else 0 end) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO
      ,0 AS l6b_py_release
      ,0 AS l17_py_release
      ,0 AS l17_allocated
      ,update_time
      ,data_source -- 数据来源(KP/MP)
  FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_fcst_sales_temp00
  group by FCST_Date,FCST_Date_Align,channel_name,dist_code,dist_name_cn,data_year,data_months,bu,data_source,update_time

  union all

  SELECT
      fcst_date
      ,fcst_date as fcst_date_orig
      ,channel
      ,customer_idh
      ,'' as dist_name_cn
      ,years
      ,month_ as months
      ,bu
      ,sum(CAST(ges AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ges  -- GES
      ,sum(CAST(ppd AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ppd  -- PPD
      ,sum(CAST(pld AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as pld  -- PLD
      ,sum(CAST(fg  AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as fg   -- FG
      ,sum(CAST(l6a_others AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l6a_others  -- L6a others
      ,sum(CAST(ngs    AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ngs -- NGS
      ,sum(CAST(ca     AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ca -- CA
      ,sum(CAST(rebate AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as rebate -- Rebate
      ,sum(CAST(ka_expense  AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ka_expense  -- KA Expense
      ,sum(CAST(listing_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as listing_fee -- Listing Fee
      ,sum(CAST(promotion_activities AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as promotion_activities  -- Promotion Activities
      ,sum(CAST(logistics   AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as logistics_fee  -- Logistics
      ,sum(CAST(oos_penalty AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as oos_penalty            -- OOS Penalty
      ,sum(CAST(int_agreement AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as int_agreement  -- Int. Agreement
      ,sum(CAST(deduction AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as deduction      -- Deduction
      ,sum(CAST(ror AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as ror            -- ROR
      ,sum(CAST(l6b_others AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l6b_others     -- L6b others
      ,sum(CAST(nes AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as nes  -- NES
      ,sum(CAST(l10_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l10_service_fee  -- L10服务商费用
      ,sum(CAST(l17_channel AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_channel  -- L17 Channel
      ,sum(CAST(o2o AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_o2o -- O2O
      ,sum(CAST(ba  AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ba  -- BA
      ,sum(CAST(l17 AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_channel_specific  -- L17 NKA/MPD/DT
      ,sum(CAST(ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot  -- EC平台资源包/付费推广
      ,sum(CAST(ec_live_streaming            AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_live_streaming        -- EC直播
      ,sum(CAST(ec_customer_service_fee      AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_customer_service_fee  -- EC客服费
      ,sum(CAST(ec_in_site_self_broadcast    AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast-- EC站内自播
      ,sum(CAST(ec_crm_operation_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee            -- EC CRM运营服务费
      ,sum(CAST(ec_content_purchase_content_production AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production  -- EC内容采买/内容制作
      ,sum(CAST(ec_data_service_fee AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_data_service_fee                     -- EC数据服务费
      ,sum(CAST(ec_gift_giveaway    AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_gift_giveaway -- EC礼品赠品
      ,0 as l17_ec_eka_service_fee                      -- EKA服务费
      ,sum(CAST(ec_others AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_others -- EC其他
      ,sum(CAST(ec_not_allocated AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as l17_ec_not_allocated
      ,sum(CAST(mini_inv         AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as mini_inv_value
      ,sum(CAST(pos_gmv_untax AS DECIMAL(28,6))) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax  -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
      ,0 as pos_gmv_so_base_untax -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
      ,0 as pos_gmv_act_untax  -- POS实价
      ,0 as final_inv_value    -- 期末库存
      ,0 as final_inv_value_fg -- 期末库存(小样/免费品)
      ,0 as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,0 as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,0 as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
      ,0 as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO
      ,0 as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO
      ,0 as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO
      ,0 AS l6b_py_release
      ,0 AS l17_py_release
      ,0 AS l17_allocated
      ,null as update_time
      ,data_source -- 数据来源(KP/MP)
  FROM (
     SELECT
       *,'dt_fcst' AS data_source,CONCAT(years,
               DECODE(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')
        ) as month_
       ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,channel,customer_idh,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
     FROM ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_dt_sales_bts
     WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_dt_sales_bts')
  )
  where rn=1
  group by fcst_date
      ,channel
      ,customer_idh
      ,years
      ,month_
      ,bu
      ,data_source
 ) t

-- GR55计算 全渠道、所有业务,参考dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3版本不做变更
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_temp_02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_temp_02 AS
-- Fcst
SELECT  a.fcst_date
        ,b.channel
        ,CONCAT(a.years,
               DECODE(a.months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')
        ) AS months
        ,a.years
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,b.channel_lastest
        ,b.customer_idh_lastest
        ,a.bu AS bu_1
        ,b.bu_2
        ,CAST(NVL(a.blockcosts_bu,0) AS DECIMAL) AS blockcosts_bu
        ,CAST(NVL(a.operating_income,0) AS DECIMAL) AS operating_income
        ,CAST(NVL(a.operating_charges,0) AS DECIMAL) AS operating_charges
        ,CAST(NVL(a.restruct_charges,0) AS DECIMAL) AS restruct_charges
        ,CAST(NVL(a.a_reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) AS DECIMAL) AS reg_mgmt_costsbu
        ,'gr55_fcst' AS data_source
FROM (
     SELECT  'v_ttl' AS customer_idh
             ,*
             ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,years,months,bu ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
     FROM ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_bts
     WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_bts')
     -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
     -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
     and LENGTH(fcst_date)=8
      ) a
INNER JOIN  (
   SELECT  DISTINCT
      channel
      ,customer_idh
      ,bu_2
      ,bu_1
      ,channel_lastest
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,months
   FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
   where customer_idh ='v_ttl'
   and bu_2 = 'v_bu'
 ) b
ON  a.customer_idh = b.customer_idh
AND a.bu = b.bu_1
AND substr(a.fcst_date,1,6) = b.months
WHERE a.rn = 1

-- GR55计算 act数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_act_temp_02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_act_temp_02 AS
-- ACT
SELECT
    a.month_ AS months
    ,substr(a.month_,1,4)  as  years
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,b.channel_lastest
    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.blockcosts_bu,0)      AS DECIMAL))  AS blockcosts_bu
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.operating_income,0)   AS DECIMAL))  AS operating_income
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.operating_charges,0)  AS DECIMAL))  AS operating_charges
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.restruct_charges,0)   AS DECIMAL))  AS restruct_charges
    ,sum(CAST(NVL(a.a_reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) AS DECIMAL))  AS reg_mgmt_costsbu
    ,'gr55_actual' AS data_source
from 
(
    SELECT  'v_ttl' AS customer_idh
       ,*
       ,CONCAT(a.years,CASE a.months WHEN 'Jan' THEN '01' WHEN 'Feb' THEN '02' WHEN 'Mar' THEN '03' WHEN 'Apr' THEN '04' WHEN 'May' THEN '05' WHEN 'Jun' THEN '06' WHEN 'Jul' THEN '07' WHEN 'Aug' THEN '08' WHEN 'Sep' THEN '09' WHEN 'Oct' THEN '10' WHEN 'Nov' THEN '11' WHEN 'Dec' THEN '12' ELSE NULL END) AS month_
       ,case when profit_center_id in ('841110','841630')          then 'Consumer'
             when profit_center_id in ('845630','845110','845120') then 'Professional'
             when profit_center_id in ('841550')                   then  'VS'  end  as  bu_1
       ,case when profit_center_id in ('841110','841630','845630','841550')  then 'v_bu'
             when profit_center_id in ('845110')  then 'SKP'
             when profit_center_id in ('845120')  then 'SP' end  as  bu_2
       ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY profit_center_id,years,months ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
       ,1  as  flag
    FROM ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts a
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_gr55_act_bts')
) a
inner join(
   SELECT  DISTINCT
      channel
      ,customer_idh
      ,bu_2
      ,bu_1
      ,channel_lastest
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,months
   FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
   where customer_idh ='v_ttl'
) b
ON  a.customer_idh = b.customer_idh
AND a.bu_1 = b.bu_1
AND a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
AND a.month_  = b.months
where a.rn = 1
group by 
    a.month_
    ,substr(a.month_,1,4)
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,b.channel_lastest
    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_adj_tmp03

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_adj_tmp03 AS

        ,b.channel

               DECODE(a.months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')
        ) as months
        ,a.years
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,b.channel_lastest
        ,b.customer_idh_lastest
        ,b.bu_1
        ,a.bu as bu_2
        ,CAST(nvl(a.ges,0) as DECIMAL) as ges
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6a,0) as DECIMAL) as l6a
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6a,0) as DECIMAL) as l6a_others
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6b,0) as DECIMAL) as l6b_others
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6_py_relase,0) as DECIMAL) as l6b_py_release
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6b,0) + nvl(a.l6_py_relase,0) as DECIMAL) as l6b
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l6a,0) + nvl(a.l6b,0) + nvl(a.l6_py_relase,0) as DECIMAL) as l6_ttl
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l10,0) as DECIMAL) as l10
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l11,0) as DECIMAL) as l11
        ,CAST(nvl(a.cog,0) as DECIMAL) as cog
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l16,0) as DECIMAL) as l16
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l17_channel,0) as DECIMAL) as l17_channel_specific
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l17_py_release,0) as DECIMAL) as l17_py_release
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l17_channel,0) + nvl(a.l17_py_release,0) as DECIMAL) as l17_channel
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l17_allocated,0) as DECIMAL) as l17_allocated
        ,CAST(nvl(a.dbkk,0) as DECIMAL) as dbkk
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l30,0) as DECIMAL) as l30
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l31,0) as DECIMAL) as l31
        ,CAST(nvl(a.drmc,0) as DECIMAL) as drmc
        ,CAST(nvl(a.l32,0) as DECIMAL) as l32
        ,'adj' as data_source
FROM    (
    SELECT  CAST(ges as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l6a as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l6b as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l6_py_relase as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l10 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l11 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(cog as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l16 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l17_channel as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l17_py_release as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l17_allocated as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(dbkk as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l30 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l31 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(drmc as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,CAST(l32 as DECIMAL(28,6))
            ,customer_idh
            ,bu
            ,fcst_date
            ,years
            ,MONTHS
            ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fcst_date,years,months,bu,Channel,customer_idh,controlling_type ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id as BIGINT) DESC ) as rn
    FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_fcst_controlling_adj_bts
    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_fcst_controlling_adj_bts')
    -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(create_time,1,10),'-','')
    -- AND     fcst_date >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(modify_time,1,10),'-','')
    and LENGTH(fcst_date)=8
 ) a
LEFT JOIN (
     SELECT  DISTINCT
         channel
        ,customer_idh
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_1
        ,channel_lastest
        ,customer_idh_lastest
        ,months
     FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
  ) b
ON  a.customer_idh = b.customer_idh
AND a.bu = b.bu_2
AND SUBSTR(a.fcst_date,1,6) = b.months

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp05 AS
SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date

--- 如果某个渠道存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测,拉齐版本
--- 先做出每个渠道应该取数的 fcst_date_copy
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_sales_fcst_date_temp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_sales_fcst_date_temp AS
SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
        ,non_latest --是否本周期未上传
        ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
        ,data_source
FROM (
    SELECT  t1.fcst_date
            ,t1.data_source
            ,t1.non_latest --是否本周期未上传
            ,CASE   WHEN t1.non_latest = 'N' THEN t1.fcst_date
                    ELSE t2.fcst_date
            END as fcst_date_copy
            ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.fcst_date,t1.non_latest,t1.data_source ORDER BY CASE   WHEN t1.non_latest = 'N' THEN t1.fcst_date
                    ELSE t2.fcst_date
            END DESC ) as rn
    FROM (
         SELECT  DISTINCT t2.fcst_date as fcst_date
                 ,t2.data_source
                 ,CASE   WHEN t1.fcst_date IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                         ELSE 'N'
                 END as non_latest --是否本周期未上传
         FROM (
             SELECT  DISTINCT b.fcst_date as fcst_date
                     ,a.data_source
             FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp05 a
             LEFT JOIN (
                   SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                           ,1 as flag
                           ,1 as rn
                   FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp05
               ) b
             ON CASE   WHEN a.customer_idh IS NOT NULL THEN 1
             END = b.flag
             AND b.rn = 1
             WHERE   b.fcst_date >= a.fcst_date
          ) t2
         LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp05 t1
         ON  t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
         AND nvl(t1.data_source,'') = nvl(t2.data_source,'')
     ) t1
    LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
                 ,data_source
         FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp05
     ) t2
    ON nvl(t1.data_source,'') = nvl(t2.data_source,'')
    AND t1.fcst_date > t2.fcst_date
 ) t
WHERE   rn = 1 --保留最近一次来补数据

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp06 AS
  SELECT  DISTINCT a.fcst_date
          ,a.non_latest
          ,b.channel
          ,b.bu_1
          ,b.bu_2
          ,a.data_source
          ,a.fcst_date_copy
          ,c.months
          ,SUBSTR(c.months,1,4) as years
          ,b.customer_idh

     -- 合并KP数据维度

     FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_fcst_sales_temp01

    ) a

      SELECT  *

     ) b

       ,CAST(cog_percent_ges AS DECIMAL) AS cog_ges
       ,CAST(l16_percent_nes AS DECIMAL) AS l16_nes
       ,'1' AS flag
       ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bu,Channel,Start_Date ORDER BY ds desc,update_time DESC ) AS rn1 -- 按渠道取同一开始时间最后一次更新的数据
    FROM  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp07
