DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp08

CREATE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp08 AS
-- 合并所有fcst指标
SELECT
   t1.fcst_date
   ,t1.non_latest
   ,t1.channel
   ,t2.fcst_date_orig          as fcst_date_orig -- 原始版本
   ,nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel) as channel_orig   -- 原始渠道（事实数据来源渠道）
   ,t1.months
   ,t1.years
   ,t1.customer_idh
   ,t1.channel_lastest
   ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
   ,t1.bu_1
   ,t1.bu_2
   ,sum(t2.pos_gmv_so_act_untax        ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax         -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
   ,sum(t2.pos_gmv_so_base_untax       ) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax        -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
   ,sum(t2.pos_gmv_act_untax           ) as pos_gmv_act_untax            -- POS实价
   ,SUM(t2.mini_inv_value              ) as mini_inv_value -- 期末库存
   ,sum(t2.final_inv_value             ) as final_inv_value              -- 期末库存
   ,sum(t2.final_inv_value_fg          ) as final_inv_value_fg           -- 期末库存(小样/免费品)
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax ) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax ) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax    ) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax     -- 近3个月月均SO
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax    ) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax     -- 近6个月月均SO
   ,sum(t2.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax   ) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax    -- 近12个月月均SO
   ,SUM(t2.ges) as ges
   ,SUM(t2.ppd) as ppd
   ,SUM(t2.pld) as pld
   ,SUM(t2.fg) as fg
   ,SUM(t2.l6a) as l6a
   ,SUM(t2.l6a_others) as l6a_others
   ,SUM(t2.l6b_others) as l6b_others
   ,SUM(t2.ngs) as ngs
   ,SUM(t2.ca) as ca
   ,SUM(t2.listing_fee) as listing_fee
   ,SUM(t2.rebate) as rebate
   ,SUM(t2.logistics_fee) as logistics_fee
   ,SUM(t2.int_agreement) as int_agreement
   ,SUM(t2.oos) as oos
   ,SUM(t2.promotion_activities) as promotion_activities
   ,SUM(t2.ka_expense) as ka_expense
   ,SUM(t2.l6b) as l6b
   ,0 as l6b_py_release
   ,0 as l17_py_release
   ,SUM(t2.ror) as ror
   ,SUM(t2.deduction) as deduction
   ,SUM(t2.nes) as nes
   ,SUM(t2.l10_service_fee) as l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
   ,SUM(case when t2.channel='MPD' then 0 else t2.l17_channel end) as l17_channel -- L17 Channel  matrix mpd渠道不到L17细项
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ba) as l17_ba -- L17 BA
   ,SUM(t2.l17_o2o) as l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_crm_operation_service_fee) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
   ,SUM(t2.l17_channel_specific) as l17_channel_specific -- L17 (Channel Specific)
   ,sum(t2.ttl_l6) as ttl_l6
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_others) as l17_others
   ,SUM(t2.l17_allocated) as l17_allocated
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_customer_service_fee) as l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_data_service_fee) as l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_platform_resource_package_paid_promot) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_in_site_self_broadcast) as l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_gift_giveaway) as l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_live_streaming) as l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_content_purchase_content_production) as l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_not_allocated) as l17_not_allocated
   ,MAX(t3.l10_ges) as l10_ges_rate
   ,MAX(t3.l11_ges) as l11_ges_rate
   ,MAX(t3.cog_ges) as cog_ges_rate
   ,MAX(t3.l16_nes) as l16_nes_rate
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.L17_Channel,0) + nvl(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) as TTL_L17
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.GES,0) * nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) as L10
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.GES,0) * nvl(t3.l11_ges,0)) as L11
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.GES,0) * nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)) as COG
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0)) as L16
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
   ) - nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) as GP1 -- NES - L10 - L11 - COG - L16
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
   ) - nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - nvl(if(t2.channel='MPD',0,t2.L17_Channel),0)) as Channel_GP2 -- GP1 - L17 Channel
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
   ) - nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Channel,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) as gp2 -- 计算GP1 - TTL L17
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
   ) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0)) as C1 -- 计算，NES - L10 - L11 - COG
   ,cast (null as decimal)  as DBKK
   ,cast (null as decimal)  as L30
   ,cast (null as decimal)  as L31
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
   ) - nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Channel,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Allocated,0)) as ebit_f_ac
   ,cast(null as decimal) as drmc
   ,SUM(nvl(t2.NES,0) - nvl(t2.GES,0) * (
               nvl(t3.l10_ges,0) + nvl(t3.l11_ges,0) + nvl(t3.cog_ges,0)
    ) - nvl(t2.NES,0) * nvl(t3.l16_nes,0) - nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Channel,0) - nvl(t2.L17_Allocated,0) ) as ebit_f_reg -- 计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC
   ,cast (null as decimal)  as L32
   ,t2.data_source
   ,'N' as is_adj
   ,SUM(t2.l17_ec_eka_service_fee) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee    -- EKA服务费
FROM (
   select *
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_tmp06
   where customer_idh <>'v_ttl'
   ) t1
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_fcst_sales_temp01 t2
ON      t1.fcst_date_copy = t2.fcst_date --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
--AND     t1.channel = t2.channel
AND     t1.months = t2.months
AND     t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
AND     nvl(t1.data_source,'') = nvl(t2.data_source,'')
AND     nvl(t1.customer_idh,'') = nvl(t2.customer_idh,'')
LEFT JOIN   ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_index_temp  t3
ON      t2.bu_2 = t3.bu
AND     t2.fcst_date_orig = t3.fcst_date_orig
AND     t2.Customer_IDH = t3.Customer_IDH
AND     t2.data_source =t3.data_source
AND     t3.rn = 1
GROUP BY t1.fcst_date
         ,t1.non_latest
         ,t1.channel
         ,t2.fcst_date_orig          -- 原始版本
         ,nvl(t2.channel,t1.channel)  -- 原始渠道（事实数据来源渠道）
         ,t1.months
         ,t1.years
         ,t1.customer_idh
         ,t1.channel_lastest
         ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
         ,t1.bu_1
         ,t1.bu_2
         ,t2.data_source
UNION ALL
-- 合并adj
SELECT  t2.fcst_date -- 预测日期
        ,NULL as non_latest -- 是否本周期未上传
        ,t2.channel -- 快照渠道
        ,t2.fcst_date as fcst_date_orig -- 原始版本
        ,t2.channel   as channel_orig   -- 原始渠道（事实数据来源渠道）
        ,t2.months -- 月份
        ,t2.years -- 年
        ,t2.customer_idh -- 客户idh
        ,t2.channel_lastest -- 最新渠道
        ,t2.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
        ,t2.bu_1 -- bu_1
        ,t2.bu_2 -- bu_2
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax         -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax        -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as pos_gmv_act_untax            -- POS实价
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as mini_inv_value
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as final_inv_value              -- 期末库存
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as final_inv_value_fg           -- 期末库存(小样/免费品)
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO(小样/免费品)
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax     -- 近3个月月均SO
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax     -- 近6个月月均SO
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax    -- 近12个月月均SO
        ,SUM(t2.ges) as ges -- 集团外毛销售额
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as ppd -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as pld -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as fg -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
        ,SUM(t2.l6a) as l6a
        ,SUM(t2.l6a_others) as l6a_others
        ,sum(t2.l6b_others) as l6b_others
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0)) as ngs -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as ca -- 价差
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as listing_fee -- 进场费
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as rebate -- 返利
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as logistics_fee -- 物流费
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as int_agreement -- Int. Agreement
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as oos -- OSS
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as promotion_activities -- Promotion Activists
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as ka_expense -- KA Expense
        ,SUM(t2.l6b) as l6b -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
        ,SUM(t2.l6b_py_release) as l6b_py_release
        ,SUM(t2.l17_py_release) as l17_py_release
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as ror -- 递减
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as deduction -- Returned or Refunded，退货
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0)) as nes -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
        ,sum(t2.l17_channel) as l17_channel -- L17 Channel
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_ba -- L17 BA
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
        ,SUM(t2.l17_channel_specific) as l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
        ,SUM(l6_ttl) as ttl_l6 -- ttl_l6
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_others -- L17其他
        ,SUM(t2.l17_allocated) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_not_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l10_ges_rate -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l11_ges_rate -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as cog_ges_rate -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l16_nes_rate -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0) + nvl(t2.l17_allocated,0)) as TTL_L17 -- TTL_L17
        ,SUM(t2.L10) as L10 -- L10
        ,SUM(t2.L11) as L11 -- L11
        ,SUM(t2.COG) as COG -- COG
        ,SUM(t2.L16) as L16 -- L16
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0) - nvl(t2.L16,0)) as GP1 -- GP1
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0) - nvl(t2.L16,0) - nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)) as Channel_GP2 -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0) - nvl(t2.L16,0) - nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)- nvl(t2.l17_allocated,0)) as gp2 -- gp2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0)) as C1 -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG  )
        ,SUM(t2.DBKK) as DBKK -- DBKK
        ,SUM(t2.L30) as L30 -- L30
        ,SUM(t2.L31) as L31 -- L31
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0) - nvl(t2.L16,0) - nvl(t2.l17_channel,0) - nvl(t2.l17_allocated,0) - nvl(t2.DBKK,0) + nvl(t2.L30,0) - nvl(t2.L31,0)) as ebit_f_ac -- ebit_f_ac(计算GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
        ,SUM(t2.drmc) as drmc -- drmc
        ,SUM(nvl(t2.ges,0) - nvl(t2.l6a,0) - nvl(t2.l6b,0) - nvl(t2.L10,0) - nvl(t2.L11,0) - nvl(t2.COG,0) - nvl(t2.L16,0) - nvl(t2.l17_channel,0) - nvl(t2.l17_allocated,0) - nvl(t2.DBKK,0) + nvl(t2.L30,0) - nvl(t2.L31,0) - nvl(t2.drmc,0)) as ebit_f_reg -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC-DRMC)
        ,SUM(t2.l32) as l32 -- l32
        ,t2.data_source -- fcst数据来源
        ,'Y' as is_adj -- is_adj
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee  --EKA服务费
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_adj_tmp03 t2
GROUP BY t2.fcst_date -- 预测日期
         ,t2.channel -- 快照渠道
         ,t2.months -- 月份
         ,t2.years -- 年
         ,t2.customer_idh -- 客户idh
         ,t2.channel_lastest -- 最新渠道
         ,t2.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
         ,t2.bu_1 -- bu_1
         ,t2.bu_2 -- bu_2
         ,t2.data_source -- fcst数据来源
union all
-- 合并GR55
SELECT  t1.fcst_date
        ,case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then 'N' else  'Y' end AS non_latest
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.fcst_date as fcst_date_orig
        ,t1.channel as channel_orig
        ,t1.months
        ,substr(t1.months,1,4) as years
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.channel_lastest
        ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,null as pos_gmv_so_act_untax
        ,null as pos_gmv_so_base_untax
        ,null as pos_gmv_act_untax
        ,null as mini_inv_value
        ,null as final_inv_value
        ,null as final_inv_value_fg
        ,null as sell_out_3_mon_avg_fg_untax
        ,null as sell_out_6_mon_avg_fg_untax
        ,null as sell_out_12_mon_avg_fg_untax
        ,null as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax
        ,null as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax
        ,null as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ges
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ppd
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS pld
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS fg
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6a
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6a_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ngs
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ca
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS listing_fee
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS rebate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS logistics_fee
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS int_agreement
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS oos
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS promotion_activities
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ka_expense
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l6b_py_release
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_py_release
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ror
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS deduction
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS nes
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_service_fee -- L10服务商费用
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_channel -- L17 Channel
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_ba -- L17 BA
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_o2o -- L17 O2O
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee -- L17CRM运营服务费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_channel_specific -- L17 (Channel Specific)
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ttl_l6
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_others
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_customer_service_fee -- L17客服费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_data_service_fee -- L17数据服务费
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast -- L17站内自播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_gift_items -- L17礼品赠品
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_live_streaming -- L17直播
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production -- L17内容采买/内容制作
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l10_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l11_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS cog_ges_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS l16_nes_rate
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS TTL_L17
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS L10
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS L11
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS COG
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS L16
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS GP1 -- NES - L10 - L11 - COG - L16
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS Channel_GP2 -- GP1 - L17 Channel
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS gp2 -- 计算GP1 - TTL L17
        ,CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS C1 -- 计算，NES - L10 - L11 - COG
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then t5.blockcosts_bu     else  t4.blockcosts_bu     end) AS DBKK
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then t5.operating_income  else  t4.operating_income  end) AS L30
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then t5.operating_charges else  t4.operating_charges end) AS L31
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then -NVL(t5.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t5.operating_income,0) - NVL(t5.operating_charges,0)  else  -NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0) end) AS ebit_f_ac -- 计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then t5.reg_mgmt_costsbu     else  t4.reg_mgmt_costsbu     end) AS drmc 
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then -NVL(t5.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t5.operating_income,0) - NVL(t5.operating_charges,0) - NVL(t5.reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) else  -NVL(t4.blockcosts_bu,0) + NVL(t4.operating_income,0) - NVL(t4.operating_charges,0) - NVL(t4.reg_mgmt_costsbu,0) end) AS ebit_f_reg -- 计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC
        ,SUM(case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then t5.restruct_charges     else  t4.restruct_charges     end) AS l32
        ,case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then 'gr55_actual'     else 'gr55_fcst'     end as data_source
        ,'N' AS is_adj
        ,CAST(NULL as DECIMAL) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee  --EKA服务费
FROM (
    SELECT  o.fcst_date
            ,o.fcst_date AS fcst_date_copy
            ,m.customer_idh
            ,m.bu_1
            ,m.bu_2
            ,m.channel
            ,m.channel_lastest
            ,m.customer_idh_lastest
            ,m.months
            ,'1' AS flag
    FROM (
          SELECT  fcst_date
                  ,'1' AS flag
          FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_sales_fcst_date_temp
          GROUP BY fcst_date
     ) O
    LEFT JOIN   (
        SELECT
           customer_idh
           ,bu_1
           ,bu_2
           ,channel
           ,channel_lastest
           ,customer_idh_lastest
           ,months
           ,'1' AS flag
        FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
        WHERE customer_idh = 'v_ttl'
        GROUP BY customer_idh
           ,bu_1
           ,bu_2
           ,channel
           ,channel_lastest
           ,customer_idh_lastest
           ,months
     ) m
    ON o.flag = m.flag
    and substr(o.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(m.months,1,4)
 ) t1  -- 统一维度
LEFT JOIN (
   SELECT  a.fcst_date
           ,CASE  WHEN a.fcst_date = b.fcst_date_gr55 THEN 'N'  ELSE 'Y' END AS non_latest
           ,b.*
           ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a.fcst_date,b.data_source ORDER BY b.fcst_date_gr55 DESC ) AS rn
   FROM (
       SELECT  DISTINCT fcst_date
               ,'1' AS flag
       FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_sales_fcst_date_temp
    ) a
   LEFT JOIN (
       SELECT
          fcst_date AS fcst_date_gr55
          ,channel
          ,months
          ,years
          ,customer_idh
          ,channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
          ,blockcosts_bu
          ,operating_income
          ,operating_charges
          ,restruct_charges
          ,reg_mgmt_costsbu
          ,data_source
          ,'1' AS flag
       FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_temp_02
    ) b  -- fcst 数据
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   AND a.fcst_date >= b.fcst_date_gr55
) t4
ON      t1.fcst_date = t4.fcst_date
AND     nvl(t1.bu_2,'') = nvl(t4.bu_2,'')
AND     nvl(t1.bu_1,'') = nvl(t4.bu_1,'')
AND     nvl(t1.months,'') = nvl(t4.months,'')
AND     nvl(t1.customer_idh,'') = nvl(t4.customer_idh,'')
AND     t4.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_act_temp_02 t5
on     nvl(t1.months,'') = nvl(t5.months,'')
AND     nvl(t1.bu_2,'') = nvl(t5.bu_2,'')
AND     nvl(t1.bu_1,'') = nvl(t5.bu_1,'')
AND     nvl(t1.customer_idh,'') = nvl(t5.customer_idh,'')
LEFT JOIN(
    select '1' AS flag
          ,max(months)     as   gr55_act_max_months  -- 数据更新至（仅ACT）
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4_gr55_act_temp_02
) t6
ON  t1.flag = t6.flag
-- where t4.months is not null
GROUP BY t1.fcst_date
        ,case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then 'N' else  'Y' end
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.channel 
        ,t1.months
        ,substr(t1.months,1,4)
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.channel_lastest
        ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,case when substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>t1.months and t1.months <= t6.gr55_act_max_months then 'gr55_actual'     else 'gr55_fcst'     end

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 PARTITION (ds)
SELECT
   t1.fcst_date       -- 预测日期
   ,t1.non_latest     -- 是否本周期未上传
   ,t1.channel        -- 快照渠道
   ,t1.fcst_date_orig -- 原始版本
   ,t1.channel_orig   -- 原始渠道（事实数据来源渠道）
   ,t1.months         -- 月份
   ,t1.years          -- 年
   ,t1.customer_idh   -- 客户idh
   ,t1.channel_lastest -- 最新渠道
   ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
   ,t1.bu_1 -- bu_1

   ,CAST(t1.Channel_GP2 as DECIMAL(28,6)) as Channel_GP2 -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
   ,CAST(t1.gp2 as DECIMAL(28,6)) as gp2 -- gp2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
   ,CAST(t1.C1 as DECIMAL(28,6)) as C1 -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG  )

   ,'${bizdate}' as ds

   ,bu_1

drop table if exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_df_temp1

create table if not exists ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_df_temp1 as
select
 store_code            -- 门店编码
 ,store_name -- 门店名称
 ,bu_2                 -- bu_2
 ,Category_name        -- 品类
 ,substr(replace(Months,'-',''),1,6) as months  -- 月份
 ,frist_channel  as channel_1  -- 一级渠道
 ,second_channel as channel_2  -- 二级渠道
 ,scene_name           -- 场域名称
 ,cast(gmv_pre_refund  as DECIMAL(28,6)) as gmv_pre_refund  -- 退前成交金额（投放口径）
 ,cast(visitor_uv      as DECIMAL(28,6)) as visitor_uv      -- 访客数
 ,cast(pay_user_cnt    as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pay_user_cnt    -- 支付人数
 ,cast(gsv_post_refund as DECIMAL(28,6)) as gsv_post_refund -- 退后成交金额（投放口径）
 ,creator              -- 提交人
 ,modifier             -- 修改人
 ,creator_nickname     -- 提交人昵称
 ,modifier_nickname    -- 修改人昵称
 ,create_time          -- 提交时间
 ,modify_time          -- 修改时间
 ,qbi_system_upload_id -- 上传批次主键
from(
   select 
       *,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code,bu_2,substr(replace(Months,'-',''),1,6) ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
   from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_data
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_data')
) 
where rn=1

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_df partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
 a.store_code            -- 门店编码
 ,nvl(b.store_name,'Others') as store_name -- 门店名称
 ,case when upper(a.bu_2)='VS' then 'VS'
       when upper(a.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then 'Professional'
       when upper(a.bu_2) in ('LAUNDRY','BEAUTY CARE') then 'Consumer'
    end as bu_1          -- bu_1
 ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
 ,case when a.Category_name='整体' then '全品类'
        when upper(a.Category_name) regexp '其他|OTHER|其它' then 'Others'
     else lower(a.Category_name)
    end as Category_name        -- 品类
 ,a.months               -- 月份
 ,a.channel_1            -- 一级渠道
 ,a.channel_2            -- 二级渠道
 ,a.scene_name           -- 场域名称
 ,a.gmv_pre_refund       -- 退前成交金额（投放口径）
 ,a.visitor_uv           -- 访客数
 ,a.pay_user_cnt         -- 支付人数
 ,cast(case when a.Category_name='整体' and channel_1='Total （全店）' then a.gsv_post_refund 
    else a.gmv_pre_refund*c.refund_rate
  end as DECIMAL(28,6)) as gsv_post_refund -- 退后成交金额（投放口径）
 ,a.creator              -- 提交人
 ,a.modifier             -- 修改人
 ,a.creator_nickname     -- 提交人昵称
 ,a.modifier_nickname    -- 修改人昵称
 ,a.create_time          -- 提交时间
 ,a.modify_time          -- 修改时间
 ,a.qbi_system_upload_id -- 上传批次主键
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_df_temp1 a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
 on a.store_code=b.store_code
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
left join(  --xueyang：计算退回率是BY store 不需要BU
  select
     store_code     -- 门店编码
     ,months        -- 月份
     ,bu_2
     ,Category_name
     ,sum(gmv_pre_refund ) as gmv_pre_refund  -- 退前成交金额（投放口径）
     ,sum(gsv_post_refund) as gsv_post_refund -- 退后成交金额（投放口径）
     ,sum(gsv_post_refund)/sum(gmv_pre_refund ) as refund_rate -- 退货率 
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_traffic_df_temp1
   where channel_1='Total （全店）'
   --and Category_name='整体'
  group by 
     store_code     -- 门店编码
     ,months        -- 月份
     ,bu_2
     ,Category_name
) c
 on nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(c.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2  ,'')=nvl(c.bu_2  ,'')
 and nvl(a.Category_name  ,'')=nvl(c.Category_name  ,'')
 and nvl(a.months,'')=nvl(c.months,'')

insert overwrite table ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_paid_media_tm_store_launch_df partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
  substr(replace(a.data_date_new,'-',''),1,8) as data_date -- 日期
  ,substr(replace(a.data_date_new,'-',''),1,6) as months    -- 月份
  ,a.plan_id                 -- 计划ID
  ,a.plan_name               -- 计划名字
  ,cast(a.cost_amt          as DECIMAL(28,6)) as cost_amt          -- 投放费用

  ,cast(a.cart_cnt          as DECIMAL(28,6)) as cart_cnt          -- 总购物车数
  ,cast(a.favorite_cnt      as DECIMAL(28,6)) as favorite_cnt      -- 总收藏数
  ,cast(a.presale_order_cnt as DECIMAL(28,6)) as presale_order_cnt -- 总预售成交笔数
  ,cast(a.presale_order_amt as DECIMAL(28,6)) as presale_order_amt -- 总预售成交金额
  ,cast(a.direct_order_cnt  as DECIMAL(28,6)) as direct_order_cnt  -- 直接成交笔数
  ,cast(a.direct_order_amt  as DECIMAL(28,6)) as direct_order_amt  -- 直接成交金额
  ,cast(a.total_order_cnt   as DECIMAL(28,6)) as total_order_cnt   -- 总成交笔数
  ,cast(a.total_order_amt   as DECIMAL(28,6)) as total_order_amt   -- 总成交金额
  ,a.orig_lvl2_scene_name    -- 原二级场景名字
  ,a.channel_category        -- 渠道分类
  ,a.unit_id                 -- 单元ID
  ,a.product_short_name      -- 商品简称
  ,a.remark                  -- 备注
  ,case when upper(a.product_line) regexp '其他|OTHER|其它' then 'Others'
     else lower(a.product_line)
    end as product_line            -- 品线
  ,a.product_status_category -- 商品状态分类
  ,case when upper(a.bu_2)='VS' then 'VS'
       when upper(a.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then 'Professional'
       when upper(a.bu_2) in ('LAUNDRY','BEAUTY CARE') then 'Consumer'
    end as bu_1            -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                    -- bu_2
  ,case when upper(a.category_name) regexp '其他|OTHER|其它' then 'Others'
     else lower(a.category_name)
    end as category_name           -- 品类
  ,a.store_code              -- 门店编码
  ,nvl(b.store_name,'Others') as store_name -- 门店名称
  ,a.creator                 -- 提交人
  ,a.modifier                -- 修改人
  ,a.creator_nickname        -- 提交人昵称
  ,a.modifier_nickname       -- 修改人昵称
  ,a.create_time             -- 提交时间
  ,a.modify_time             -- 修改时间
  ,a.qbi_system_upload_id    -- 上传批次主键

   select 
     case when INSTR(data_date,'\/')>0 then concat(SPLIT(data_date,'\/')[0] ,lpad(SPLIT(data_date,'\/')[1],2,'0') ,lpad(SPLIT(data_date,'\/')[2],2,'0')) 
        else data_date end as data_date_new
    ,*,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code,bu_2,substr(replace(data_date,'-',''),1,8) ORDER BY CAST(qbi_system_upload_id AS BIGINT) DESC ) AS rn
   from ${dme_ods}.s_ec_paid_media_tm_store_launch_data 
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ec_paid_media_tm_store_launch_data')
) a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
 on a.store_code=b.store_code
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
where a.rn=1

--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: aipl用户模型
--功能描述: 数据导入
--创建者: zuoyi(zuoyi@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2021-06-23 16:19:57
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容

--********************************************************************--
insert overwrite table dme_ads.ads_aipl partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select
	t1.oneid,-- 自定义oneid
	t1.user_id,-- user_id
	t1.phone,-- md5加密手机号码
	t1.imei,-- md5加密设备号imei
	t1.idfa,-- md5加密设备号idfa
	t1.mac,-- md5加密设备号mac
	t1.time_str,-- 时间
	t2.is_member,-- 是否会员
	t2.imp_cnt,-- 最近15天曝光次数
	t2.clk_cnt,-- 最近15天点击次数
	t2.scan_open_cnt,-- 最近15天扫描/打开次数
	t2.interaction_cnt,-- 最近15天互动次数
	t2.collect_coupons_cnt,-- 最近15天领劵次数
	t2.collection_cnt,-- 最近15天收藏/加购次数
	t2.browse_cnt,-- 最近15天浏览次数
	t2.pay_cnt_365d,-- 最近一年购买次数
	t2.pay_cnt_365d_913d-- 过去一年到两年半购买次数
from
(
    select
	    concat(nvl(imei,''),nvl(idfa,''),nvl(bdid,''),nvl(mac,'')) as oneid,-- 自定义oneid
		bdid as user_id,-- user_id
		null phone,-- md5加密手机号码
		imei,-- md5加密设备号imei
		idfa,-- md5加密设备号idfa
		mac,-- md5加密设备号mac
		from_unixtime(cast(max(log_timestamp) as bigint)) as time_str-- 时间
	from
	    dme_ods.ods_ad_monitor
	where
	    ds <> '1'
    group by
        bdid,
        imei,
        idfa,
        mac
) t1
left join
(
    select
        concat(nvl(imei,''),nvl(idfa,''),nvl(bdid,''),nvl(mac,'')) as oneid,-- 自定义oneid
		null as is_member,-- 是否会员
		count(case when event_type='0' then 1 else null end) as imp_cnt,-- 最近15天曝光次数
		count(case when event_type='1' then 1 else null end) as clk_cnt,-- 最近15天点击次数
		null as scan_open_cnt,-- 最近15天扫描/打开次数
		null as interaction_cnt,-- 最近15天互动次数
		null as collect_coupons_cnt,-- 最近15天领劵次数
		null as collection_cnt,-- 最近15天收藏/加购次数
		null as browse_cnt,-- 最近15天浏览次数
		null as pay_cnt_365d,-- 最近一年购买次数
		null as pay_cnt_365d_913d-- 过去一年到两年半购买次数
    from
	    dme_ods.ods_ad_monitor
	where
	    to_char(to_date(ds,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') <= '${bizdate}'
	    and to_date(ds,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-15,'day')
    group by
        bdid,
        imei,
        idfa,
        mac

) t2 on t1.oneid = t2.oneid
where t2.imp_cnt > 0

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_city_attack_city_group_list partition(ds)

    a.mkt_tag,                                       --市场id
    a.prod_tag,                                      -- 产品id

    a.per_tag,                                       --时间id

--所属主题: 尼尔森市场分析
--功能描述: 尼尔森产品主数据（包含所有品类、品牌组合情况） tb_competition_nielsen_product_channel ，目前只能按照每个数据源不同的取数逻辑去取到相应组合的 product_id, 如果没有该组合，则拼接该组合为 唯一 product_id 
--创建者: shiwu(shiwu@henkelhcdfacc)
--创建日期: 2021-08-09 10:50:23
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--********************************************************************--
insert overwrite table  ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_product_channel partition(ds='${bizmonth}')
select
    if(data_source = '', null, upper(data_source)) as data_source, -- 数据来源
    if(product_tag_code = '', null, upper(product_tag_code)) as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签id，如该层级没有则手工补入，保证唯一性即可
    if(product_name = '', null, upper(product_name)) as product_name, -- 产品名称
    if(manufacturer_name = '', null, upper(manufacturer_name)) as manufacturer_name, --制造商
    if(category_name = '', null, upper(category_name)) as category_name, -- 品类
    if(sub_category_name = '', null, upper(sub_category_name)) as sub_category_name, -- 子品类
    if(mid_category_name = '', null, upper(mid_category_name)) as mid_category_name, -- 二级子品类
    if(product_category_combination = '', null,
       upper(product_category_combination)) as product_category_combination, -- 组合品类
    if(brand_name = '', null, upper(brand_name)) as brand_name, -- 品牌
    if(sub_brand_name = '', null, upper(sub_brand_name)) as sub_brand_name, -- 子品牌
    if(hierarchy = '', null, hierarchy) as hierarchy, -- 产品层级
    if(fine_grained = '', null, upper(fine_grained)) as fine_grained, -- 最细粒度内容
    if(last_product_combination = '', null, upper(last_product_combination)) as last_product_combination, -- 最终产品组合
    if(query_category_combination = '', null, upper(query_category_combination)) as query_category_combination, -- 组合品类查询值
    if(query_brand = '', null, upper(query_brand)) as query_brand, -- 品牌查询值
    if(query_subbrand = '', null, upper(query_subbrand)) as query_subbrand                -- 产品线查询值
from
(
    -- category_name
    -- hair care（无法直接取数，该层级数据需要聚合）对应kpi需要聚合
    select
        'hair care'   as data_source, -- 数据来源
        'hair care'   as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签id，如该层级没有则手工补入，保证唯一性即可
        'hair care'   as product_name, -- 产品名称
        ''            as manufacturer_name, --制造商
        'hair care'   as category_name, -- 品类
        ''            as sub_category_name, -- 子品类
        ''            as mid_category_name, -- 二级子品类
        'hair care'   as product_category_combination, -- 组合品类
        ''            as brand_name, -- 品牌
        ''            as sub_brand_name, -- 子品牌
        '1'           as hierarchy, -- 产品层级
        'hair care'   as fine_grained, -- 最细粒度内容
        'hair care'   as last_product_combination, -- 最终产品组合
        'hair care'   as query_category_combination, -- 组合品类查询值
        ''            as query_brand, -- 品牌查询值
        ''            as query_subbrand                -- 产品线查询值

    union all
    -- category_name/brand_name
    -- hair care/brand_name 需要表示三个子品类下所有的品牌，对应kpi需要聚合
    select
        'hair care'                            as data_source, -- 数据来源
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name) as product_tag_code, -- 尼尔森数据中无此组合，用拼接结果表示唯一id
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name) as product_name, -- 产品名称
        ''                                     as manufacturer_name,
        category_name, -- 品类
        ''                                     as sub_category_name, -- 子品类
        ''                                     as mid_category_name, -- 二级子品类
        category_name                          as product_category_combination, -- 组合品类
        brand_name, -- 品牌
        ''                                     as sub_brand_name, -- 子品牌
        '2'                                    as hierarchy, -- 产品层级
        brand_name                             as fine_grained, -- 最细粒度内容
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name) as last_product_combination, -- 最终产品组合
        category_name                          as query_category_combination, -- 组合品类查询值
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name) as query_brand, -- 品牌查询值
        ''                                     as query_subbrand                -- 产品线查询值
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
    where ds = '${bizmonth}'
        and lower(hier_level_name) = 'brand'
        and (data_source = '30_treatment_conditioner' or data_source = '02_shampoo')
    group by
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name), -- 尼尔森数据中无此组合，用拼接结果表示唯一id
        category_name, -- 品类
        brand_name

    union all
    -- category_name/brand_name/sub_brand_name
    -- hair care - brand_name - sub_brand_name 需要聚合所有同名同品牌的产品线，对应kpi需要聚合
    select
        'hair care'                                                 as data_source, -- 数据来源
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name, '/', sub_brand_name) as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签id
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name, '/', sub_brand_name) as product_name, -- 产品名称
        ''                                                          as manufacturer_name,
        category_name, -- 品类
        ''                                                          as sub_category_name, -- 子品类
        ''                                                          as mid_category_name, -- 二级子品类
        category_name                                               as product_category_combination, -- 组合品类
        brand_name, -- 品牌
        sub_brand_name, -- 子品牌
        '3'                                                         as hierarchy, -- 产品层级
        sub_brand_name                                              as fine_grained, -- 最细粒度内容
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name, '/', sub_brand_name) as last_product_combination, -- 最终产品组合
        category_name                                               as query_category_combination, -- 组合品类查询值
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name)                      as query_brand, -- 品牌查询值
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name, '/', sub_brand_name) as query_subbrand                -- 产品线查询值
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
    where ds = '${bizmonth}'
        and lower(hier_level_name) = 'subbrand'
        and (data_source = '30_treatment_conditioner' or data_source = '02_shampoo')
    group by
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name),
        concat(category_name, '/', brand_name, '/', sub_brand_name),
        category_name, -- 品类
        brand_name, -- 品牌
        sub_brand_name

    union all
    -- category_name/sub_category_name
    -- hair care/shampoo
    select
        data_source,
        product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
        product_name, -- 产品名称
        ''                                            as manufacturer_name, -- 制造商名称
        category_name, -- 品类
        sub_category_name, -- 子品类
        ''                                            as mid_category_name, -- 二级子品类
        concat(category_name, '/', sub_category_name) as product_category_combination, -- 组合品类
        ''                                            as brand_name, -- 品牌
        ''                                            as sub_brand_name, -- 子品牌
        '1'                                           as hierarchy, -- 产品层级
        sub_category_name                             as fine_grained, -- 最细粒度内容
        concat(category_name, '/', sub_category_name) as last_product_combination, -- 最终产品组合
        concat(category_name, '/', sub_category_name) as query_category_combination, -- 组合品类查询值
        ''                                            as query_brand, -- 品牌查询值
        ''                                            as query_subbrand                -- 产品线查询值
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
    where ds = '${bizmonth}'
        and lower(product_name) = 'shampoo'
        and data_source = '02_shampoo'

    union all
    -- category_name/sub_category_name/brand_name
    -- hair care/shampoo/brand_name 组合
    select
        data_source,
        product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
        product_name, -- 产品名称

insert
  overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_region_sales_summary_mid partition(ds = '${bizmonth}')
select
    m.market_id,                                                       -- 市场标签编码
    m.market_name,                                                     --  市场名称
    m.province,                                                        --  省份名称
    m.henkel_region,                                                   --  汉高大区
    m.product_id,                                                      --  产品标签编码
    m.product_name,                                                    --  产品名称
    m.category,                                                        --  品类名称
    m.subcategory,                                                     -- 子品类名称
    m.midcategory,                                                     --  二级子品类名称
    m.product_category_combination,                                    -- 产品组合品类名称
    m.manufacturer,                                                    --  制造商名称
    m.brand,                                                           --  品牌名称
    m.subbrand,                                                        --  子品牌名称
    m.hierarchy,                                                       -- 组合层级
    m.fine_grained,                                                    --    对应最细粒度内容
    m.last_product_combination,                                        --    产品最终组合
    m.per_id,                                                          --    时间ID
    m.time_type,                                                       --    时间类型
    m.times,                                                           --    时间
    m.year,                                                            --    年
    cast(m.sales_volume as decimal(28,6))  as sales_volume,           --    销售量
    cast(m.sales_value as decimal(28,6))   as sales_value,            --    销售额
    cast(n.sales_volume as decimal(28,6))  as sales_volume_category,  --    所在品类销售量
    cast(n.sales_value as decimal(28,6))   as sales_value_category,   --    所在品类销售额
    cast(m.sales_value / n.sales_value
        as decimal(28,6))                  as value_share,            --    市场销售额份额
    cast(m.sales_volume / n.sales_volume
        as decimal(28,6))                  as volume_share,           --    市场销售量份额
    cast(m.average_price as decimal(28,6)) as average_price,          --    平均价格
    cast(m.nd_selling as decimal(28,6))    as nd_selling,             --    数值铺货率
    cast(m.wd_selling as decimal(28,6))    as wd_selling,             --    加权铺货率
    cast(((m.sales_value / n.sales_value) / m.wd_selling)
        as decimal(28,6))                  as value_share_in_handler, --    单点销售份额
    cast((m.sales_value / m.wd_selling)
        as decimal(28,6))                  as val_sppd,               --    单点卖力
    m.datasource                                                       --    数据源
from
(
    select
        a.datasource,                                   -- 数据源
        b.market_id,                                    -- 市场标签编码
        b.market_name,                                  -- 市场名称
        b.province,                                     -- 省份名称
        b.henkel_region,                                -- 汉高大区
        a.prod_tag                     as product_id,   -- 产品标签编码
        c.product_name,                                 -- 产品名称
        c.manufacturer,                                 -- 制造商名称
        c.category,                                     -- 品类名称
        c.subcategory,                                  -- 子品类名称
        c.midcategory,                                  -- 二级子品类名称
        c.product_category_combination,                 -- 产品组合品类名称
        c.brand,                                        -- 品牌名称
        c.subbrand,                                     -- 子品牌名称
        c.hierarchy,                                    -- 组合层级
        c.fine_grained,                                 -- 对应最细粒度内容
        c.last_product_combination,                     -- 产品最终组合
        a.per_tag                      as per_id,       -- 时间ID
        'b.月'                          as time_type,    -- 时间类型
        a.data_month                   as times,        -- 时间
        substr(a.data_month, 1, 4)     as year,         -- 年
        a.sales_volume,                                 -- 销售量
        a.sales_value,                                  -- 销售额
        a.nd_selling / 100             as nd_selling,   -- 数值铺货率
        a.wd_selling / 100             as wd_selling,   -- 加权铺货率
        a.sales_value / a.sales_volume as average_price -- 平均价格
    from
    (
        select
            tt1.datasource,
            tt1.mkt_tag,
            tt1.prod_tag,
            tt1.per_tag,
            nvl(tt2.sales_volume,0) as sales_volume,
            nvl(tt2.sales_value,0) as sales_value,
            nvl(tt2.nd_selling,0) as nd_selling,
            nvl(tt2.wd_selling,0) as wd_selling,
            tt1.data_month
        from
        (
			select
        	    datasource,
        	    mkt_tag,
        	    per_tag,
        	    data_month,
        	    prod_tag
        	from
        	(
        		select
        		    time_tag_code as per_tag,
        		    data_month,
        		    '1' as mt
        		from
        		    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_fact_info
        		where
        		    ds <> '1'
        		group by
        		    time_tag_code,
        		    data_month
        	) ttt1
        	left join
        	(
        	    select
        	        '1' as mt,
        	        prod_tag,
                    datasource,
                    mkt_tag
        	    from
        	        ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_info
        	    where
        	        ds = '${bizmonth}'
                group by
                    prod_tag,
                    datasource,
                    mkt_tag
        	) ttt2 on ttt1.mt = ttt2.mt
        	group by
        	    datasource,
        	    mkt_tag,
        	    per_tag,
        	    data_month,
        	    prod_tag
        ) tt1
        left join
        (
            select
                datasource,
                mkt_tag,
                prod_tag,
                per_tag,
                sales_volume,
                sales_value,
                nd_selling,
                wd_selling,
                data_month
            from
                ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_info
            where ds = '${bizmonth}'
        ) tt2 on tt1.datasource = tt2.datasource
            and tt1.mkt_tag = tt2.mkt_tag
            and tt1.prod_tag = tt2.prod_tag
            and tt1.per_tag = tt2.per_tag
            and tt1.data_month = tt2.data_month
    ) as a
    left join
    (
        select
            market_id,
            market_name,
            province,
            henkel_region
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_region_channel
        where
             ds = '${bizmonth}'
    ) as b on a.mkt_tag = b.market_id
    left join
    (
        select
            datasource,
            product_id,
            product_name,
            manufacturer,
            category,
            subcategory,
            midcategory,
            product_category_combination,
            brand,
            subbrand,
            hierarchy,
            fine_grained,
            last_product_combination
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_product_channel
        where ds = '${bizmonth}'
    ) as c on a.prod_tag = c.product_id and a.datasource = c.datasource
    where b.market_id <> ''
) as m
left join
(
    select
        datasource,
        mkt_tag,
        prod_tag,
        category_name,
        per_tag,
        sales_volume,
        sales_value
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_category_region_sales_info
    where ds = '${bizmonth}'
) as n on n.mkt_tag = m.market_id
    and n.category_name = m.product_category_combination
    and n.per_tag = m.per_id
where category is not null

--功能描述: Competiton nielsen 核心KPI ，没有产品Tag的则按相同粒度组合粒度去聚合，以拼接组合为产品Tag
--创建者: shiwu(shiwu@henkelhcdfacc)

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_info partition (ds = '${bizmonth}')
select if(data_source = '', null, upper(data_source))    as data_source,      -- 数据来源
       if(maket_tag_code = '', null, maket_tag_code)     as maket_tag_code,   -- 市场标签编码
       if(product_tag_code = '', null, upper(product_tag_code)) as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
       if(time_tag_code = '', null, time_tag_code)       as time_tag_code,    -- 时间标签编码
       if(sales_volume = '', null, sales_volume)         as sales_volume,     -- 销售数量
       if(sales_value = '', null, sales_value)           as sales_value,      -- 销售金额
       if(nd_selling = '', null, nd_selling)             as nd_selling,       -- 数值销售铺货率
       if(wd_selling = '', null, wd_selling)             as wd_selling,       -- 加权铺货率
       if(data_month = '', null, data_month)             as data_month       -- 数据月份
from
(
    --拿到原本尼尔森数据文件中就存在的所有数据
    select
        data_source,                                  -- 数据来源
        maket_tag_code,                               -- 市场标签编码
        product_tag_code,                             -- 产品标签编码
        time_tag_code,                                -- 时间标签编码
        cast(sales_volume as double) as sales_volume, -- 销售数量
        cast(sales_value as double)  as sales_value,  -- 销售金额
        nd_sell as nd_selling,   -- 数值销售铺货率
        wd_sell as wd_selling,   -- 加权铺货率
        data_month                                    -- 数据月份
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_fact_info
    where ds <> '1'

    union all
    --  haircare 由其下面三个子品类聚合结果 (shampoo,treatment,conditioner)
    --这段代码得到了product_tag_code ='hair car' 的相关数据
    select
        'hair care'       as data_source,  -- 数据来源
        maket_tag_code,                    -- 市场标签编码
        'hair care'       as product_tag_code,                  -- 产品标签编码
        time_tag_code,                     -- 时间标签编码
        sum(sales_volume) as sales_volume, -- 销售数量
        sum(sales_value)  as sales_value,  -- 销售金额
        ''                as nd_selling,   -- 数值销售铺货率
        ''                as wd_selling,   -- 加权铺货率
        data_month                         -- 数据月份
    from
    (
        select a.maket_tag_code,                    -- 市场标签编码
               b.category_name as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
               a.time_tag_code,                     -- 时间标签编码
               a.sales_volume,                      -- 销售数量
               a.sales_value,                       -- 销售金额
               a.data_month                         -- 数据月份
        from
        (
            select
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                maket_tag_code,   -- 市场标签编码
                product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
                time_tag_code,    -- 时间标签编码
                sales_volume,     -- 销售数量
                sales_value,      -- 销售金额
                data_month        -- 数据月份
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_fact_info
            where ds <> '1' and com in ('02','30')
        ) as a
        join
        (
            -- shampoo
            select
                product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                category_name     -- 品类名称
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
            where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info')
                and data_source = '02_shampoo'
                and lower(product_name) = 'shampoo'
                and HIER_LEVEL_NUM ='1'
            union all
            -- treatment 、Conditioner
            select
                product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                category_name     -- 品类名称
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info')
                and data_source = '30_treatment_conditioner'
                and lower(product_name) in('treatment','conditioner') 
                and HIER_LEVEL_NUM ='2'
        ) as b on a.product_tag_code = b.product_tag_code
            and a.data_source = b.data_source
    ) tt1
    group by maket_tag_code,   -- 市场标签编码
             time_tag_code,
             data_month        -- 数据月份

    union all
    --  haircare/brand 对 haircare 下同名品牌进行聚合
    --这里得到了product_tag_code 为 haircare/brand 的相关数据
    select
        'hair care'       as data_source,  -- 数据来源
        maket_tag_code,                    -- 市场标签编码
        product_tag_code,                  -- 产品标签编码
        time_tag_code,                     -- 时间标签编码
        sum(sales_volume) as sales_volume, -- 销售数量
        sum(sales_value)  as sales_value,  -- 销售金额
        ''                as nd_selling,   -- 数值销售铺货率
        ''                as wd_selling,   -- 加权铺货率
        data_month                         -- 数据月份
    from
    (
        select a.maket_tag_code,                                               -- 市场标签编码
               concat(b.category_name, '/', b.brand_name) as product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
               a.time_tag_code,                                                -- 时间标签编码
               cast(a.sales_volume as double)             as sales_volume,     -- 销售数量
               cast(a.sales_value as double)              as sales_value,      -- 销售金额
               a.data_month                                                    -- 数据月份
        from
        (
            select
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                maket_tag_code,   -- 市场标签编码
                product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
                time_tag_code,    -- 时间标签编码
                sales_volume,     -- 销售数量
                sales_value,      -- 销售金额
                data_month        -- 数据月份
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_fact_info
            where ds <> '1' and com in ('02','30')
        ) a
        join
        (
            select
                product_tag_code, -- 市场标签编码
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                category_name,    -- 品类名称
                brand_name        -- 品牌名称
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info')
                and data_source = '02_shampoo'
                and lower(hier_level_name) = 'brand'
            union all
            select
                product_tag_code, -- 市场标签编码
                data_source,      -- 数据来源
                category_name,    -- 品类名称
                brand_name        -- 品牌名称
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_prod_info')
                and data_source = '30_treatment_conditioner'
                and lower(hier_level_name) = 'brand'
        ) b on a.product_tag_code = b.product_tag_code
            and a.data_source = b.data_source
    ) tt2
    group by maket_tag_code,   -- 市场标签编码
             product_tag_code, -- 产品标签编码
             time_tag_code,
             data_month

    union all
    --  category/brand/subbrand  (haircare 对 brand 下同名 subbrand 聚合)
    --  得到了product_tag_code='hair care/brand/subbrand' 的
    select

			henkel_region,                                                  -- 汉高大区

			last_product_combination,                                       -- 产品最终组合
			time_type                                                       -- 时间类型

    ) a

    group by

		last_product_combination,                                       -- 产品最终组合
		time_tag_code,                                                  -- 时间ID

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_summary_mid partition (ds = '${bizmonth}')
select
    m.market_id,                                                      -- 市场ID
    m.market_name,                                                    -- 市场名称
    m.province,                                                       -- 所在省份
    m.henkel_region,                                                  -- 汉高大区
    m.product_id,                                                     -- 产品标签
    m.product_name,                                                   -- 产品名称
    m.category,                                                       -- 品类
    m.subcategory,                                                    -- 子品类
    m.midcategory,                                                    -- 二级子品类
    m.product_category_combination,                                   -- 产品品类组合
    m.manufacturer,                                                   -- 制造商
    m.brand,                                                          -- 品牌
    m.subbrand,                                                       -- 产品线
    m.hierarchy,                                                      -- 组合层级
    m.fine_grained,                                                   -- 对应最细粒度内容
    m.last_product_combination,                                       -- 产品最终组合
    m.per_id,                                                         -- 时间ID
    m.time_type,                                                      -- 时间类型
    m.times,                                                          -- 时间
    m.year,                                                           -- 年
    cast(m.sales_volume as decimal(28,6)),                           -- 销售量
    cast(m.sales_value as decimal(28,6)),                            -- 销售额
    cast(n.sales_volume as decimal(28,6)) as sales_volume_category,  -- 所在品类销售量
    cast(n.sales_value as decimal(28,6))  as sales_value_category,   -- 所在品类销售额
    cast(m.sales_value / n.sales_value
        as decimal(28,6))                 as value_share,            -- 市场销售额份额
    cast(m.sales_volume / n.sales_volume
        as decimal(28,6))                 as volume_share,           -- 市场销售量份额
    cast(m.average_price as decimal(28,6)),                          -- 平均价格
    cast(m.nd_selling as decimal(28,6)),                             -- 数值铺货率
    cast(m.wd_selling as decimal(28,6)),                             -- 加权铺货率
    cast(((m.sales_value / n.sales_value) / m.wd_selling)
        as decimal(28,6))                 as value_share_in_handler, -- 单点销售份额
    cast((m.sales_value / m.wd_selling)
        as decimal(28,6))                 as val_sppd,               -- 单点卖力
    m.datasource                                                      -- 数据源
from
(
    select
        a.datasource,                                    -- 数据源
        b.market_id,                                     -- 市场标签编码
        b.market_name,                                   -- 市场名称
        ''                             as province,      -- 省份名称
        ''                             as henkel_region, -- 汉高大区
        a.prod_tag                     as product_id,    -- 产品标签编码
        c.product_name,                                  -- 产品名称
        c.manufacturer,                                  -- 制造商名称
        c.category,                                      -- 品类名称
        c.subcategory,                                   -- 子品类名称
        c.midcategory,                                   -- 二级子品类名称
        c.product_category_combination,                  -- 产品组合品类名称
        c.brand,                                         -- 品牌名称
        c.subbrand,                                      -- 子品牌名称
        c.hierarchy,                                     -- 组合层级
        c.fine_grained,                                  -- 对应最细粒度内容
        c.last_product_combination,                      -- 产品最终组合
        a.per_tag                      as per_id,        -- 时间ID
        'b.月'                          as time_type,     -- 时间类型
        a.data_month                   as times,         -- 时间
        substr(a.data_month, 1, 4)     as year,          -- 年
        a.sales_volume,                                  -- 销售量
        a.sales_value,                                   -- 销售额
        a.nd_selling / 100             as nd_selling,    -- 数值铺货率
        a.wd_selling / 100             as wd_selling,    -- 加权铺货率
        a.sales_value / a.sales_volume as average_price  -- 平均价格
    from
    (
        select
            tt1.datasource,
            tt1.mkt_tag,
            tt1.prod_tag,
            tt1.per_tag,
            nvl(tt2.sales_volume,0) as sales_volume,
            nvl(tt2.sales_value,0) as sales_value,
            nvl(tt2.nd_selling,0) as nd_selling,
            nvl(tt2.wd_selling,0) as wd_selling,
            tt1.data_month
        from
        (
			select
        	    datasource,
        	    mkt_tag,
        	    per_tag,
        	    data_month,
        	    prod_tag
        	from
        	(
        		select
        		    time_tag_code as per_tag,
        		    data_month,
        		    '1' as mt
        		from
        		    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nielsen_fact_info
        		where
        		    ds <> '1'
        		group by
        		    time_tag_code,
        		    data_month
        	) ttt1
        	left join
        	(
        	    select
        	        '1' as mt,
        	        prod_tag,
                    datasource,
                    mkt_tag
        	    from
        	        ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_info
        	    where
        	        ds = '${bizmonth}'
                group by
                    prod_tag,
                    datasource,
                    mkt_tag
        	) ttt2 on ttt1.mt = ttt2.mt
        	group by
        	    datasource,
        	    mkt_tag,
        	    per_tag,
        	    data_month,
        	    prod_tag
        ) tt1
        left join
        (
            select
                datasource,
                mkt_tag,
                prod_tag,
                per_tag,
                sales_volume,
                sales_value,
                nd_selling,
                wd_selling,
                data_month
            from
                ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_sales_info
            where ds = '${bizmonth}'
        ) tt2 on tt1.datasource = tt2.datasource
            and tt1.mkt_tag = tt2.mkt_tag
            and tt1.prod_tag = tt2.prod_tag
            and tt1.per_tag = tt2.per_tag
            and tt1.data_month = tt2.data_month
    ) as a
    left join
    (
        select
            market_id,
            market_name
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_market_channel
        where ds = '${bizmonth}'
    ) as b on a.mkt_tag = b.market_id
    left join
    (
        select
            datasource,
            product_id,
            product_name,
            manufacturer,
            category,
            subcategory,
            midcategory,
            product_category_combination,
            brand,
            subbrand,
            hierarchy,
            fine_grained,
            last_product_combination
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_product_channel
        where ds = '${bizmonth}'
    ) as c on a.prod_tag = c.product_id
        and a.datasource = c.datasource
    where b.market_id <> ''
) as m
left join
(
    select
        datasource,
        mkt_tag,
        prod_tag,
        product_category_combination,
        per_tag,
        sales_volume,
        sales_value
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_competition_nielsen_category_sales_info
    where ds = '${bizmonth}'
) as n on n.mkt_tag = m.market_id
    and n.product_category_combination = m.product_category_combination
    and n.per_tag = m.per_id

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_consumer_nka_sku_sales partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
		nvl(t1.product_barcode,'Others') as sku_id,--单品id
		nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as sku_name,--单品名称
		nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') as product_line_id,--产品线id
		nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') as product_line_name,--产品线名称
		nvl(t1.category_name_en,'Others') as category_code,--品类代码
		nvl(t1.category_name,'Others') as category_name,--品类名称
		nvl(t1.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_code,--品牌代码
		nvl(t1.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,--品牌名称
        ttt.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_id,  --渠道四级
        ttt.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_name, --渠道四级
        ttt.third_channel_name as third_channel_id, --渠道三级
        ttt.third_channel_name as third_channel_name, --渠道三级
        ttt.second_channel_name as second_channel_id, --渠道二级
        ttt.second_channel_name as second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
        ttt.first_channel_name as first_channel_id, --渠道一级
        ttt.first_channel_name as first_channel_name, --渠道一级
        --modify by shiwu 和其他模块保持统一，统一从dwd的销售数据里面取一级二级三级四级渠道信息
        ttt.pri_store_code as store_id,--门店ID
        nvl(t2.store_name,'Others') as store_name,--门店名称
		nvl(t2.city_name,'Others') as city_id,--城市id
		nvl(t2.city_name,'Others') as city_name,--城市名称
        --modify by shiwu 从门店主数据中取省份信息
        nvl(t2.province_name,'Others') as province_id,
        nvl(t2.province_name,'Others') as province_name,
        cast (ttt.sale_untax_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt,--pos累计销售额
		ttt.sale_num as sku_sale_num, --sku销售数量
        ttt.months as monthly --月份
from
(
    select
        t0.henkel_prod_code as henkel_prod_code,--Henkel产品idh
        t0.pri_store_code as pri_store_code,--Henkel门店oneID
        t0.first_channel_name, --渠道一级
        t0.second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
        t0.third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
        t0.fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
        -- t0.first_class_name_cn as first_class_name_cn,
        -- t0.second_class_name_cn as second_class_name_cn,
        t0.months,
        t0.years,
        sum(t0.sale_num) as sale_num,--销售数量
        sum(t0.sale_untax_amt) as sale_untax_amt--pos累计销售额
        -- sum(t0.base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt --pos累计基价销售额
        from(
            --modify by shiwu , kA数据切换为系统数据 和手工数并存
                select 
                henkel_prod_code as henkel_prod_code,
                henkel_store_code as pri_store_code,
                first_channel_name, --渠道一级
                second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
                third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
                fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
                ds as months,--月份
                substr(ds,1,4) as years,--年度
                base_unit_qty as sale_num,--销售数量
                original_amt_untax as sale_untax_amt--pos累计销售额
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu where ds >='202201'  -- ka-pos销售表
                --过滤销售都是空的数据
                and(base_unit_qty is not null or original_amt_tax is not null)
                --家乐福、万宁、莎莎和大润发后续仍然是月提供，故此处需要将家乐福、万宁和大润发、莎莎单独处理
                and first_class_code in('p00701','p00301','KA0001','KA0010','KA0005','KA0070')
                and ds < to_char(now(),'yyyymm') -- 过滤当月数据
                and if(first_class_code='KA0005',ds<'202401',1=1)
                and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
                and upper(bu_2)='BEAUTY CARE'
and data_source regexp '手工报表'
                union all 
                --ka pos系统数据
                select 
                henkel_prod_code as henkel_prod_code,
                henkel_store_code as pri_store_code,
                first_channel_name, --渠道一级
                second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
                third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
                fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
                substr(ds,1,6) as months,--月份
                substr(ds,1,4) as years,--年度
                base_unit_qty as sale_num,--销售数量
                original_amt_untax as sale_untax_amt--pos累计销售额
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily where ds >='20220101'  -- ka-pos销售表
                --过滤销售都是空的数据
                and(base_unit_qty is not null or original_amt_tax is not null)
                --家乐福、万宁和大润发后续仍然是月提供，固此处需要将家乐福、万宁和大润发单独处理
                and first_class_code not in('p00701','p00301','KA0070','KA0011') -- 剔除屈臣氏用code(KA0011)
                --屈臣氏数据单独处理月份
               -- and third_channel_name <> '屈臣氏'
                and ds < to_char(now(),'yyyymm') -- 过滤当月数据
                and if(first_class_code='KA0005',ds>='20240101',1=1)
                and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
                and upper(bu_2)='BEAUTY CARE'
                
                union all
                
                --ka pos系统屈臣氏数据，需要按照屈臣氏日历重新mapping一下月份
                select 
                henkel_prod_code as henkel_prod_code,
                henkel_store_code as pri_store_code,
                first_channel_name, --渠道一级
                second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
                third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
                fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
                substr(b.mapping_time,1,6) as months,--月份
                substr(b.mapping_time,1,4) as years,--年度
                base_unit_qty as sale_num,--销售数量
                original_amt_untax as sale_untax_amt--pos累计销售额
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily a  -- ka-pos销售表
                left join (select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_watsons_mapping_time where ds = '${bizdate}') b --屈臣氏日历mapping表
                on a.ds = substr(b.time_now,1,8)
                and b.time_type = 'C.月'
                and length(b.time_now) > 8
                and b.ds='${bizdate}'
                where a.ds >='20220101'
                  and a.ds <> '20220102' --历史数据已经包含20220102这周的屈臣氏数据，这里需要剔除
                --过滤销售都是空的数据
                and(base_unit_qty is not null or original_amt_tax is not null)
                --屈臣氏数据单独处理月份
                and first_class_code in('KA0011') -- 取屈臣氏用code(KA0011)
               -- and third_channel_name in('屈臣氏')
                and a.ds < to_char(now(),'yyyymm') -- 过滤当月数据
                and UPPER(a.first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
                and upper(a.bu_2)='BEAUTY CARE'
------------------------------------------------------------修改  : 报表为月力度
                union all
                --ka历史手工数据
                select 
                henkel_prod_code as henkel_prod_code,
                henkel_store_code as pri_store_code,
                first_channel_name, --渠道一级
                second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
                third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
                fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
                ds as months,--月份
                substr(ds,1,4) as years,--年度
                base_unit_qty as sale_num,--销售数量
                original_amt_untax as sale_untax_amt--pos累计销售额
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu where ds < '202201'  -- ka-pos销售表
                --过滤销售都是空的数据
                and(base_unit_qty is not null or original_amt_tax is not null)
                and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
                and upper(bu_2)='BEAUTY CARE'
            ) t0
            group by 
            t0.henkel_prod_code,
            t0.pri_store_code,
            t0.first_channel_name, --渠道一级
            t0.second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
            t0.third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
            t0.fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
            t0.months,
            t0.years

) ttt
----KA-POS关联产品信息 
left outer join (
    select  
        *
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product')
) t1
--使用idh做关联
on ttt.henkel_prod_code=t1.product_code
----KA-POS关联门店信息 
left outer join(
    select
        *
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos')

on ttt.pri_store_code=t2.store_oneid

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_consumer_product_channel partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
    case when t.category_name_en is null or t.category_name_en='' then 'Others'
         else t.category_name_en end as  category_code,--产品品类代码
    case when t.category_name is null or t.category_name='' then 'Others'
         else t.category_name end as category_name,--产品品类名称
    case when t.brand_name_en is null or t.brand_name_en='' then 'Others'
         else t.brand_name_en end  as brand_code,--品牌代码
    case when t.brand_name is null or t.brand_name='' then 'Others' 
         else t.brand_name end as   brand_name,--品牌名称
    t.product_line as product_line_id,--产品线id
    t.product_line as product_line_name,--产品线名称
    case when t.product_function is null or t.product_function='' then 'Others' 
         else t.product_function end as product_function,--产品功能
    case when t.product_pack is null or t.product_pack='' then 'Others' 
         else t.product_pack end as product_pack,--产品包装
    case when (concat(colour_chroma,'.',main_colour_hue)='' 
                or concat(colour_chroma,'.',main_colour_hue) is null 
                or concat(colour_chroma,'.',main_colour_hue)='.')
         then 'Others' else concat(colour_chroma,'.',main_colour_hue) 
         end as colour_hue,--色调
    t.product_barcode as sku_id,--产品id
    t.product_name as sku_name, --产品名称
    concat(t.product_name,'-',t.product_barcode) as sku_name_id,--产品名称和ID拼接
    t.category_name_en_sort,--品类排序字段
    t.brand_name_en_sort,--品牌排序字段
    t.product_line_sort,--产品线排序字段
    t.product_name_sort, --SKU排序字段
    t.product_pack_type --产品包装分类
from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos t
left outer join (
     select
          sku_id
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_consumer_ecom_sku_sales
     where ds='${bizdate}'

) t1
on t.product_barcode=t1.sku_id
where t.ds='${bizdate}' and t1.sku_id is not null
    group by

        t.brand_name_en,

        t.product_line,
        t.product_function,
        t.product_pack,
        t.colour_chroma,
        t.main_colour_hue,
        t.product_barcode,
        t.product_name,
        t.category_name_en_sort,
        t.brand_name_en_sort,
        t.product_line_sort,
        t.product_name_sort,
        t.product_pack_type

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_analysis_01_temp

--按PH5 的NGS占比来拆分not assgnied 的l3
select a.ph5_code,a.months,cast(a.l3/b.l3_ttl * c.l3 as decimal(28,6)) as l3 from(

                      ,ds as months
                      ,cast(l3 as decimal(28,6)) as  l3

              where   ds >= '202001' and product_code <> 'Not assigned'
              and bu_2='Beauty Care'
group by  ds
) b on a.months=b.months
left join(
select  ds as monthly,l3 
              from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke30_data_info_bu
              where   ds >= '202001' and product_code='Not assigned'
              and bu_2='Beauty Care'
)c on a.months=c.monthly
union all --和原有的l3做合并
select 
cast(product_code as bigint) ph5_code
                      ,ds months
                      ,cast(l3 as decimal(28,6)) as  l3 
from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke30_data_info_bu
              where   ds >= '202001' and product_code <> 'Not assigned'

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_analysis_02_temp

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_analysis_02_temp as 
-- insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_analysis_01 partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    o.product_id,
    o.product_name_en,
    o.product_name,
    o.category_name_en,
    o.category_name,
    o.brand_name_en,
    o.brand_name,
    o.product_line,
    o.ph5_code,
    nvl(m.ph5_name,'Others') as ph5_name,
    o.ngs,
    o.con,
    o.nes,
    o.monthly,
    o.yearly,
    case when o.box_size is null OR o.box_size in ('Others','无信息') then NULL 
         else cast(o.box_size as BIGINT) end as box_size
 from(
select  
nvl(t.product_id,'Others') as product_id,
nvl(q.product_name_en,'Others') as product_name_en,
nvl(q.product_name,'Others') as product_name,
nvl(q.category_name_en,'Others') as category_name_en,
nvl(q.category_name,'Others') as category_name,
nvl(q.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_name_en,
nvl(q.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,
nvl(q.product_line,'Others') as product_line ,
q.box_size    as   box_size,
coalesce(t.ph5_code,p.ph5_code) as ph5_code,
nvl(cast(t.ngs as decimal(28,6)),0) as ngs,
cast(nvl(t.con,0) as bigint) as con,
--拆分的时候出现的情况比较多。
--情景一：当有ph5的nes，却没有ph5的NGS的时候，即 t.ph5_ngs is null ，则直接取ph5的nes
--情景二：当有ph5的nes，但是ph5的NGS为0的时候，因为一个PH5会对应多个idh，则按ph5对应的idh的个数去拆分
--情景三：则为正常情况，既有ph5的nes又有PH5的NGS
case when t.ph5_ngs is null then cast(nvl(p.l3,0) as decimal(28,6))
when ph5_ngs=0 then cast(nvl(p.l3,0)/ph5_product_cnt as decimal(28,6))
else cast(nvl(t.zb*p.l3,0) as decimal(28,6)) end as nes,
coalesce(t.months,p.months) as monthly,
substr(coalesce(t.months,p.months),1,4) as yearly
from    (
            select  o.*
                    ,case   when m.ph5_ngs is null or m.ph5_ngs = 0 then 0
                            else o.ngs / m.ph5_ngs
                    end as zb,
                    m.ph5_ngs,
                    m.ph5_product_cnt
            from    (
                        select  product_id
                                ,ph5_code
                                ,months
                                ,sum(sku_ngs_amt) ngs --销售总金额GES
                                ,sum(sku_quantity_amt) con --临时促销折扣总费用
                                ,sum(adn_pb) adn_pb --发票激励奖金总数
                                ,sum(cbn_if) cbn_if --发票上的合作改善基金总数
                        from    (
                                 --step1:拿到by sku粒度的数量，ngs,adn_pb,cbn_if
                                    SELECT  product_id
                                            ,if(product_hirachy_number is null,0,cast(product_hirachy_number as bigint)) ph5_code --产品hirachy数
                                            ,sku_ngs_amt 
                                            ,nvl(- adn_promotion_bonus ,0) adn_pb --发票激励奖金
                                            ,nvl(- cbn_imp_fund ,0) cbn_if --发票上的合作改善基金
                                            ,quantity_consumer_units as sku_quantity_amt
                                            ,to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date ,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
                                    from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
                                    where   ds >= '20200101'
                                    and     ds < to_char( datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}' ,'yyyymmdd') ,'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
                                    and     product_id is not null
                                    and bu_2='Beauty Care'
                                ) a 
                        group by  product_id
                                  ,ph5_code
                                  ,months
                    ) o
            left join  (
                --step2:拿到by ph5粒度的ngs
                          select  ph5_code
                                  ,months
                                  ,sum(sku_ngs_amt) as ph5_ngs --销售总金额GES
                                  ,count(distinct product_id) as ph5_product_cnt
                          from    (
                                      SELECT  product_id
                                            ,if(product_hirachy_number is null,0,cast(product_hirachy_number as bigint)) ph5_code --产品hirachy数
                                            ,sku_ngs_amt --免费品
                                            ,to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date ,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
                                    from    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
                                    where   ds >= '20200101'
                                    and     ds < to_char( datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}' ,'yyyymmdd') ,'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
                                    and     product_id is not null
                                  ) a
                          group by  ph5_code
                                    ,months
                      ) m
            on      o.ph5_code = m.ph5_code
            and     o.months = m.months
        ) t
full join  (
              select   ph5_code
                      ,months
                      ,l3 as  l3 --L6b Discounts off in总和
              from    ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_analysis_01_temp
            ) p
on      t.ph5_code = p.ph5_code
and     t.months = p.months
left join(
--关联主数据

product_name,

category_name_en,
category_name,

brand_name,

,substr(ds,1,6) as months
from dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu
