--DT/WS
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_dt_mpd_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_dt_mpd_tmp1 as
select
    t.month
    ,sum(t.sell_out) as sell_out
    ,sum(t.sale_num) as sale_num
    ,sum(t.sell_in) as sell_in
    ,sum(t.inventory) as inventory
    ,nvl(t.category,'Others') as category
    ,t.channel
    ,nvl(t.region,'Others') as region
    ,nvl(t.customer_id,'Others') as customer_id -- 客户id
    ,t.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from
(
    select
        coalesce(t1.month,t2.month,t3.month) as month
        ,t2.sell_out
        ,t2.sale_num
        ,t1.sell_in
        ,t3.inventory
        ,coalesce(t1.henkel_category_en,t2.category,t3.category) as category
        ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.channel,t3.channel) as channel
        ,coalesce(t1.region,t2.region_en,t3.region) as region
        ,coalesce(t1.customer_id,t2.customer_id,t3.customer_id) as customer_id -- 客户id
        ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    from
    (
        select
            tt1.month     --以过账日期作为时间
           -- ,case when t5.customer_idh is not null and tt1.month >= t5.begin_month and tt1.month <= t5.end_month then t5.customer_type
           --       else tt1.first_channel_name      
           --       end  as  first_channel_name                 --渠道  
            ,tt1.first_channel_name
            ,sum(tt1.sell_in) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
            ,tt1.henkel_category_en                    --品类
            ,tt2.region_en region
            ,tt1.customer_id -- 客户id
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from
        (
            select
                to_char(posting_date,'yyyymm') as month     --以过账日期作为时间
                ,first_channel_name                 --渠道
                --,sum(gross_sales_price) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
                ,sum(ges) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
                ,henkel_category_en                    --品类
                ,customer_id
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu where ds >='20200101'
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            and first_channel_name in ('MPD','DT')
            and to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') <='${bizdate}'  --后期需要调整参数，当前页面只要20年数据，后面调整为进
            and customer_id is not null
            and quantity_consumer_units is not null --观察数据过滤脏数据
            and product_id is not null
            group by
                to_char(posting_date,'yyyymm')
                ,first_channel_name
                ,henkel_category_en
                ,customer_id
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        ) tt1
        left join
        (
            select
                customer_code                         --用户id
                ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
                ,region_en                     --大区
                ,substr(ds,1,6) as month
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                where ds like '%01'
                and channel_hierarchy_1 != 'NKA'
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
        ) tt2
        on tt1.customer_id = tt2.customer_code and tt1.first_channel_name = tt2.channel_hierarchy_1
        and tt1.month = tt2.month
      --  left join
      --  (
      --      select 
      --          *
      --      from 
      --      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf
      --      where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf')
      --  ) t5
      --  on tt1.customer_id = t5.customer_idh 
      --  where (t5.customer_idh is not null and tt1.month >= t5.begin_month and tt1.month <= t5.end_month)
      --        OR t5.customer_idh is null
        group by
            tt1.month
            ,tt1.first_channel_name
            ,tt1.henkel_category_en
            ,tt2.region_en,tt1.customer_id 
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) t1
    full outer join
    (
        select
            tt3.category_name_en as category
            ,sum(tt1.sell_out) as sell_out
            ,sum(sale_num) as sale_num
            ,tt1.first_channel_name as channel
            ,tt2.region_en
            ,tt1.month
            ,tt1.dist_code as customer_id
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from
        (
           select 
                a.month,
                a.sale_num,
                a.sell_out,
                a.dist_code ,
                a.prod_barcode,
                a.first_channel_name
                ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
           from(
               select
                  substr(bill_date,1,6) as month, --经销商编码
                  sum(base_qty) as sale_num,--出库数量
                  sum(base_qty * base_price) as sell_out, --sell_out销售额
                  dist_code,
                  prod_barcode,first_channel_name
                  ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
                from
                  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale_bu
                where
                  --当月
                    ds <>''
                  and bu_2 = 'Beauty Care'
                  and prod_code not like '%qita%' 
                  and store_code <>'qita'
                  and brand_name <> '' 
                  and brand_name is not null 
                  and first_channel_name in ('MPD','DT')
                group by substr(bill_date,1,6),dist_code,prod_barcode,first_channel_name,first_channel_name_lastest
             ) a 
           --  join 
           --  (
           --      select dist_code
           --      from dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor 
           --      where ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor') 
           --        and (dist_type_code in('批发客户','常规','深分') 
           --        or dist_code in ('Small DT_Centre','Small DT_East','Small DT_North','Small DT_South','Small DT_West') ----DT 需要计算小经销商
           --        or dist_code in('1967491') --广大在8月份转为WS,dms系统还未更新.
           --        )
           --   ) b 
           --   on a.dist_code=b.dist_code
        ) tt1
        left join
        (
            select
                customer_code                         --用户id
                ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
                ,region_en                     --大区
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu 
                where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu') and channel_hierarchy_1 != 'NKA'
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            --补上小经销商的大区
            -- union all 
            -- select customer_code,channel_hierarchy_1,region_en 
            -- from ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info
        ) tt2
        on tt1.dist_code = tt2.customer_code
        left join
        (
             select
                product_barcode
                ,category_name_en
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
        ) tt3
        on tt1.prod_barcode = tt3.product_barcode
      --  left join
      --  (
      --      select 
      --          *
      --      from 
      --      ${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf
      --      where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf')
      --  ) t5
      --  on tt1.dist_code = t5.customer_idh 
      --  where (t5.customer_idh is not null and tt1.month >= t5.begin_month and tt1.month <= t5.end_month)
      --        OR t5.customer_idh is null
        group by
             tt3.category_name_en
            ,tt1.first_channel_name
            ,tt2.region_en
            ,tt1.month,tt1.dist_code
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        
    ) t2
    on t1.month = t2.month and t1.henkel_category_en = t2.category and t1.first_channel_name = t2.channel and t1.region = t2.region_en
    and nvl(t1.customer_id,'')=nvl(t2.customer_id,'')
    and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
    full outer join
    (
        select
            tt1.month
            ,tt2.category_name_en as category
            ,sum(tt1.inventory) as inventory
            ,tt1.first_channel_name  as  channel
            ,tt3.region_en as region
            ,tt1.dist_code as customer_id
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from
        (
           --库存
           select 
                sum(stock_num)      as stock_num
               ,sum(inventory)      as inventory
               ,month
               ,prod_code 
               ,a.dist_code ,a.first_channel_name
               ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
           from(
               select
                   dist_code,
                   pnall as org_name,
                   stock_type,  --仓库类型
                   prod_barcode as henkel_item_barcode, --产品条码
                   prod_code,
                   base_qty as stock_num,   --库存数量
                   dist_type,
                   base_qty*base_price as inventory,
                   substr(ds,1,6) as month,
                   ds,first_channel_name,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
               from
                   ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
              where ds <>'' 
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
                and prod_brand_name <>'' 
                and prod_brand_name is not null 
               -- and stock_type not like '%赠品%'
               -- and stock_type not like '%代销%' 
                and first_channel_name in ('MPD','DT')
                and base_qty <> 0
           ) a 
           join(
               select o.dist_code
                   ,o.stock_date 
               from(
                   select 
                     dist_code,
                     max(stock_date) as stock_date,
                     substr(stock_date,1,6) as stock_month
                  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
                 where ds>='20200101'
                   and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
                   and ds<= '${bizdate}' 
                  group by 
                      substr(stock_date,1,6),dist_code
               )o 
             -- join
             -- (
             --      select dist_code
             --   from dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor 
             --   where ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor') 
             --     and (dist_type_code in('批发客户','常规','深分') 
             --     or dist_code in ('Small DT_Centre','Small DT_East','Small DT_North','Small DT_South','Small DT_West') ----DT 需要计算小经销商
             --     or dist_code in('1967491') --广大在8月份转为WS,dms系统还未更新.
             --     )
             -- )m on o.dist_code=m.dist_code
           ) b 
           on a.dist_code=b.dist_code 
           and a.ds =b.stock_date
           group by month,a.dist_code,prod_code,a.first_channel_name,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        ) tt1
        left join
        (
            select
                product_code
                ,category_name_en
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu where 
                ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
        ) tt2
        on tt1.prod_code = tt2.product_code    --匹配出产品品类
        left join
        (
            select
                customer_code                         --用户id
                ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
                ,region_en                     --大区
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu') 
                and channel_hierarchy_1 != 'NKA'
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            --   union all -删除小经销商的逻辑
            -- select customer_code,channel_hierarchy_1,region_en 
            -- from ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info

        ) tt3
        on tt1.dist_code = tt3.customer_code       --匹配渠道
       -- left join
       -- (
       --     select 
       --         *
       --     from 
       --     ${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf
       --     where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_channel_changes_mf')
       -- ) t5
       -- on tt1.dist_code = t5.customer_idh 
       -- where (t5.customer_idh is not null and tt1.month >= t5.begin_month and tt1.month <= t5.end_month)
       --       OR t5.customer_idh is null
        group by
            tt1.month
            ,tt2.category_name_en
            ,tt1.first_channel_name
            ,tt3.region_en,tt1.dist_code
            ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) t3                                                  --根据用户id匹配出 渠道信息以及大区信息
    on t1.henkel_category_en = t3.category and t1.month = t3.month and t1.first_channel_name = t3.channel and t1.region = t3.region
    and nvl(t1.customer_id,'')=nvl(t3.customer_id,'')
    and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
    where coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.channel,t3.channel) is not null
) t
where t.channel in ('DT','MPD') and month >= '202001'           --数据从2020年1月分之后才进行关注 且只计算channel为DT/WS的数据
group by t.month
    ,nvl(t.category,'Others')
    ,channel,nvl(t.customer_id,'Others')
    ,t.region
    ,t.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道

--Ecom数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_ecom_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_ecom_tmp1 as
select
     t.month
    ,sum(t.sell_out) as sell_out
    ,sum(t.sell_in) as sell_in
    ,sum(t.inventory) as inventory
    ,nvl(t.category,'Others') as category
    ,t.channel
    ,nvl(t.customer_code,'Others') as customer_code
    ,nvl(t.customer_name,'Others') as customer_name
    ,t.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from
(
    select
        coalesce(t1.month,t2.month,t3.month,t4.month) as month
        ,t2.sell_out
        ,t1.sell_in
        ,case when coalesce(t1.customer_code,t2.customer_code,t3.customer_code,t4.customer_code) = '1616258' then (nvl(t3.inventory,0) + nvl(t1.git,0)) 
              else (nvl(t3.inventory,0) + nvl(t4.git,0))  end  as inventory 
              --ecom库存=静态+在途（git）
              --丽人在途库存GIT=Gross sales Price（GES）- PDD free goods*(-1)
        ,coalesce(t1.category_name,t2.category_name,t3.category_name,t4.category_name) as category
        ,coalesce(t1.channel,t2.channel,t3.channel,t4.channel) as channel
        ,coalesce(t1.customer_code,t2.customer_code,t3.customer_code,t4.customer_code) as customer_code
        ,coalesce(t1.customer_name,t2.customer_name,t3.customer_name,t4.customer_name) as customer_name
        ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    from
    (   ---ecom渠道sell-in
        select 
            a.customer_code                as  customer_code, --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
            nvl(customer_name_en,'Others') as  customer_name,--客户英文名
            nvl(category_code, 'Others')   as  category_code,
            --品类代码
            nvl(category_name, 'Others')   as  category_name,--品类名称
            'Ecom'      AS  channel,
            'Sell-in'   as  value_type,
            sum(ges)    as  sell_in,
            -- sum(ges-pfg)    as  git,  --剔除中小样的GES就是GIT，这里不用再减去PFG
            sum(ges)    as  git,
            months  as  month
            ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from 
        (
            SELECT
                if(customer_id is null,'0',customer_id) as  customer_code   --客户ID
                ,product_id
                ,ds
                -- ,gross_sales_price       as  ges  -- 销售金额GES
                ,ges as ges
                ,nvl(-ppd_free_goods,0)  as  pfg  
                ,to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
                ,bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu 
            where ds >= '20200101'
            and ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            --and to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') <='${bizdate}'
        )a
        left join(
            select
                product_code,  --产品编码
                product_barcode,  --产品条形码
                product_name as sku_name, --产品名称
                product_name_en as sku_name_en,--产品英文名称
                category_name_en as category_name,  --品类
                category_name_en as category_code, --品类id
                whether_ecom_sample_product --是否Ecom标记小样(1是|0否)
            from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            -- and source_type <> 'professional'
        ) b on a.product_id = b.product_code
        left join
        (
            select
                customer_code,  --客户编码
                customer_name_en ,  --客户中文
                customer_name, -- 客户英文
                channel_hierarchy_1
            from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
        ) c on a.customer_code = c.customer_code
        where --c.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom' and
        a.customer_code in  ('1967491','1787667','2801680','1616258','2771155','2530190','2925773') --广大（1967491）、炜能（2530190）、鲲驰（1787667）、傲讯财（2771155）、丽人（1616258）和哆米（2801680）、沃义(2925773)

          and b.whether_ecom_sample_product = '0'
        group by a.customer_code           
            ,nvl(customer_name_en,'Others') 
            ,nvl(category_code, 'Others')   
            ,nvl(category_name, 'Others')   
            ,'Ecom'     
            ,'Sell-in'  
            ,months
            ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) t1
    full outer join
    (   ---ecom渠道sell-out
--modify by shiwu 20230410 丽人2021年的数据不做变动，即不过滤中小样等
        select 
            a.customer_code                 as  customer_code, --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
            COALESCE(customer_name_en,a.dist_name,'Others') as  customer_name,--客户英文名
            nvl(category_code, 'Others')    as  category_code,
            --品类代码
            nvl(category_name, 'Others')    as  category_name,--品类名称
            'Ecom'       AS  channel,
            'Sell-out'   as  value_type,
            sum(base_sale_amt)    as  sell_out,   --sell-out金额
            sum(sale_num)         as  sale_num,   --sell-out数量
            months                as  month
            ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from 
        (
            select
                prod_code                as prod_code,--Henkel产品idh
                dist_code                as customer_code, --经销商编码
                dist_name                as dist_name,
                sum(base_qty)            as sale_num,      --数量
                sum(base_qty*base_price) as base_sale_amt, --sell_out销售额
                substr(ds,1,6)           as months
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale_bu a
            where a.ds <>'' 
            and a.bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            and (prod_code is not null  and  trim(prod_code) <> '') 
            and (
             dist_code in ('1967491','1787667','2801680','2771155','2530190','2925773'))--广大（1967491）、炜能（2530190）、鲲驰（1787667）、傲讯财（2771155）、丽人（1616258）和哆米（2801680）、沃义(2925773)
             or(
                 dist_code ='1616258' and substr(ds,1,6) >='202201'
             )
            group by  
                prod_code,
                dist_code,
                dist_name,
                substr(ds,1,6)
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        )a
        left join(
            select
            product_code,  --产品编码
            product_barcode,  --产品条形码
            category_name_en as category_name,  --品类
            category_name_en as category_code, --品类id
            whether_ecom_sample_product --是否Ecom标记小样(1是|0否)
            ,bu_2
            from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            -- and source_type <> 'professional'

        left join
        (

            channel_hierarchy_1
            from

        group by a.customer_code

                group by

                    ,dist_code

            group by

        group by a.customer_code

            ,months

    and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
    full outer join
    (  
    --ecom渠道git
    --如果Sales Unit='BOX', GIT=产品基价 * Confirmed Quantity * con per Box
    --如果Sales Unit='CON' ,GIT=产品基价 * Confirmed Quantity 
        
           select 
               a.customer_code                    as  customer_code, --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
               a.customer_name_en                 as  customer_name,--客户英文名
               nvl(a.category_name_en, 'Others')  as  category_code,
               --品类代码
               nvl(a.category_name_en, 'Others')  as  category_name,--品类名称
               a.channel                          as  channel,
               'git'                              as  value_type,
               sum(a.git)                           as  git,         --在途金额
               sum(a.git_qty)                       as  git_qty,    --在途数量
               a.monthly                            as  month
               ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from
            (   select
                     idh            
                    ,customer_code              
                    ,customer_name_en           
                    ,customer_name   
                    ,category_name
                    ,category_name_en
                    ,sales_unit
                    ,monthly
                    ,channel
                    ,case when sales_unit = 'BOX' then  sum(nvl(box_size*confirmed_quantity*product_base_price,0))
                          when sales_unit = 'CON' then  sum(nvl(confirmed_quantity*product_base_price,0))
                          end    as  git
                    ,case when sales_unit = 'BOX' then  sum(nvl(box_size*confirmed_quantity,0))
                          when sales_unit = 'CON' then  sum(nvl(confirmed_quantity,0))
                          end    as  git_qty
                    ,channel_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
                from
                    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_git_data_stock

                group by
                    idh            
                    ,customer_code              
                    ,customer_name_en           
                    ,customer_name   
                    ,category_name
                    ,category_name_en
                    ,sales_unit
                    ,monthly
                    ,channel
                    ,channel_lastest            
        )a
        left join
        (
            select
                product_code,  --产品条形码
                category_name_en as category_name,  --品类
                category_name_en as category_code, --品类id
                whether_ecom_sample_product --是否Ecom标记小样(1是|0否)
                ,bu_2
            from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
            -- and source_type <> 'professional'
        ) b 
        on a.idh = b.product_code
        where b.bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
          and b.whether_ecom_sample_product = '0'
        group by a.customer_code              
               ,a.customer_name_en             
               ,nvl(a.category_name_en, 'Others') 
               ,a.channel                      
               ,monthly
               ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
       
        union all
     
        --202202月及之前的数据，只有总数，没有明细，直接union
        select
              customer_code                                                                               as  customer_code, --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
             customer_name_en                                                                             as  customer_name,--客户英文名
             nvl(category_name_en, 'Others')                                                              as  category_code,
             nvl(category_name_en, 'Others')                                                              as  category_name,--品类名称
             channel                                                                                      as  channel,
             'git'                                                                                        as  value_type,
             sum(nvl(confirmed_quantity,0))                                                               as  git,         --在途金额
             nvl(NULL,0)                                                                                  as  git_qty,    --在途数量
             monthly                                                                                      as  month
             ,channel_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
         from
             ${dme_cdm}.dwd_git_data_stock
         where ds =  max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_git_data_stock')
           and channel = 'Ecom' and monthly <= '202202'
         group by
              customer_code                                                                            
             ,customer_name_en                                                                         
             ,nvl(category_name_en, 'Others')                                                        
             ,channel                                                                                  
             ,monthly
             ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
             
     ) t4                                                 
     on t1.category_name = t4.category_name 
     and t1.month = t4.month 
     and t1.channel = t4.channel 
     and t1.customer_code = t4.customer_code
    and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
) t
inner join

    select distinct

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp1 as
select
    coalesce(t1.customer_group,t4.customer_group,t5.ka_name) as ka_name
    ,coalesce(t1.month,t4.month,t5.month) as month
    ,sum(t5.sell_out) as sell_out
    ,sum(t4.inventory) as inventory
    ,sum(t1.sell_in) as sell_in
    ,coalesce(t1.channel_hierarchy_1,t4.channel_hierarchy_1,t5.channel_hierarchy_1) as channel
    ,'' as region
    ,nvl(coalesce(t1.category,t4.henkel_category_en,t5.henkel_category_name_en),'Others') as category
    ,nvl(coalesce(t1.customer_id,t4.customer_id,t5.customer_id),'Others') as  customer_code
    ,'' as  customer_name
    ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest,t5.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from
(
    select
        tt1.month
        ,sum(sell_in) as sell_in
        ,tt2.customer_group
        ,tt2.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,tt1.category
        ,tt1.customer_id
        ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    from
    (
        select
            to_char(posting_date,'yyyymm') as month     --以过账日期作为时间
            ,customer_id                        --用户id
            --,sum(gross_sales_price) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
            ,sum(ges) as sell_in --基价Sell-in额
            ,product_id                         --商品code
            ,henkel_category_en as  category
            ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu where ds >='20200101'         --ke24销售表
                and to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') <='${bizdate}'  --后期需要调整参数，当前页面只要20年数据，后面调整为进
                and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
                and customer_id is not null
                and quantity_consumer_units is not null --观察数据过滤脏数据
                and product_id is not null
        group by
            to_char(posting_date,'yyyymm')
            ,customer_id
            ,product_id
            ,henkel_category_en
            ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) tt1
    left join
    (
        SELECT
            customer_code                         --用户id
            ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
            ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end as customer_group
           ,substr(ds,1,6) as month
        from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu where ds like '%01'
            and channel_hierarchy_1 = 'NKA'
            and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
        group by
            customer_code
            ,channel_hierarchy_1
            ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end,substr(ds,1,6)
    ) tt2
    on tt1.customer_id = tt2.customer_code
    and tt1.month = tt2.month
    where tt2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'NKA'
    group by
        tt2.customer_group
        ,tt2.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,tt1.category
        ,tt1.month
        ,tt1.customer_id
        ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
) t1

    -- left join

    --      from

             else z1.KA_Name_En

        group by tt3.customer_group

) t5

-- 计算所有客户最早有sellin月份起的sellout数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_01 as
select 
  t.month
  ,t.ka_name
  ,t.channel
  ,t.region
  ,t.category
  ,t.customer_code
  ,t.customer_name
  ,nvl(t.sell_out,0) as sell_out
from ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_00 t
inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_sellin t2 -- 限制从最早sell in日期开始
on  nvl(t.month        ,'')>=nvl(t2.min_month   ,'') 
and nvl(t.ka_name      ,'')=nvl(t2.ka_name      ,'')
and nvl(t.channel      ,'')=nvl(t2.channel      ,'')
and nvl(t.customer_code,'')=nvl(t2.customer_code,'')
and nvl(t.customer_name,'')=nvl(t2.customer_name,'')
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_1 as
select
     t1.ka_name
    ,t1.month
    ,(sum(nvl(t1.sell_out,0))/ max(t2.month_cnt) ) as inventory_12_mon_avg  -- 客户维度近12月月均sellout
    ,(sum(nvl(t1.sell_out,0))/ 12) as inventory_12_mon_avg_all  -- 固定12月月均sellout
    ,t1.channel
    ,t1.region
    ,t1.category
    ,t1.customer_code
    ,t1.customer_name
    ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out,0))   as  sell_out_inv
    , max(t2.month_cnt)        as  month_cnt
from
(
    select
        t1.ka_name
        ,t1.month
        ,t2.sell_out
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.region
        ,t1.category
        ,t2.month as month_t
        ,t1.customer_code
        ,t1.customer_name
    from
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_00 t1
    left join
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_01 t2
    on nvl(t1.category,'') = nvl(t2.category,'') 
    and nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'') 
    and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'') 
    and t1.channel = t2.channel
    and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'') 
    and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'') 
    where datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') >= 0 
    and datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') < 12 
    and t1.month >= t2.month 
    and t1.month <= '${bizmonth}' 
    and t2.month <= '${bizmonth}'
) t1 
left join 
(
    select
         t1.ka_name
        ,t1.month
        ,t1.channel
        ,count(distinct t2.month) as month_cnt
        ,t1.customer_code
        ,t1.customer_name
        ,t1.region
    from
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_00 t1
    left join
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_01 t2
    on nvl(t1.category,'') = nvl(t2.category,'') 
    and nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'') 
    and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'') 
    and t1.channel = t2.channel
    and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'') 
    and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'') 
    where datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') >= 0 
    and datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') < 12 
    and t1.month >= t2.month 
    and t1.month <= '${bizmonth}' 
    and t2.month <= '${bizmonth}'
   -- and t2.sell_out is not null
    group by  t1.ka_name
        ,t1.month
        ,t1.channel
        ,t1.customer_code
        ,t1.customer_name
        ,t1.region
) t2                      
 on nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'') 
and t1.channel = t2.channel
and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'') 
and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'')  --计算出12月平均库存 
and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'') 
and t1.month = t2.month
group by
    t1.ka_name
    ,t1.month
    ,t1.channel
    ,t1.region
    ,t1.category
    ,t1.customer_code
    ,t1.customer_name

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_2 as

        ka_name
        ,month
        ,case substr(month,5,2)
            when '01' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q1')
            when '02' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q1')
            when '03' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q1')
            when '04' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q2')
            when '05' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q2')
            when '06' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q2')
            when '07' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q3')
            when '08' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q3')
            when '09' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q3')
            when '10' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q4')
            when '11' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q4')
            when '12' then concat(substr(month,1,4),'Q4')
        end as quarter
        ,substr(month,1,4) as year
        ,sell_out
        ,inventory
        ,sell_in
        ,channel
        ,region
        ,category
        ,customer_code
        ,customer_name

--mapping出每个月与每个季度的12个月均出库未税销额
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp3

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp3 as
select
    year
    ,quarter
    ,month
    ,channel
    ,currency as amount_type
    ,region
    ,category
    ,ka_name
    ,customer_code
    ,customer_name
    ,(sell_out/amt) as sell_out
    ,(inventory/amt) as inventory
    ,(sell_in/amt) as sell_in
    ,(inventory_12_mon_avg/amt) as inventory_12_mon_avg -- 客户维度近12月月均sellout
    ,(inventory_12_mon_avg_all/amt) as inventory_12_mon_avg_all  -- 固定12月月均sellout
from
(
    select
        year
        ,quarter
        ,month
        ,cast(sell_out as double) sell_out
        ,cast(inventory as double) inventory
        ,cast(sell_in as double) sell_in
        ,channel
        ,region
        ,category
        ,ka_name
        ,customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,cast(inventory_12_mon_avg as double) as inventory_12_mon_avg -- 客户维度近12月月均sellout
        ,cast(inventory_12_mon_avg_all as double) as inventory_12_mon_avg_all  -- 固定12月月均sellout
        ,case
            when amt is not null and amt != 0 and a.month >= b.begin_month and a.month <= b.end_month
                then amt
            else 1
        end as amt                  --汇率值
        ,currency
    from
    (
        select
            t1.ka_name
            ,t1.month
            ,t1.quarter
            ,t1.year
            ,t1.sell_out
            ,t1.inventory
            ,t1.sell_in
            ,t1.channel
            ,t1.region
            ,t1.category
            ,t1.customer_code
            ,t1.customer_name
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg -- 客户维度近12月月均sellout
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg_all  -- 固定12月月均sellout
            ,'1' as tag
        from
        (
            select
                 tt1.ka_name
                ,tt1.month
                ,tt1.quarter
                ,tt1.year
                ,tt1.sell_out
                ,tt1.inventory
                ,tt1.sell_in
                ,tt1.channel
                ,tt1.region
                ,tt1.category
                ,tt1.customer_code
                ,tt1.customer_name
            from
                ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_2 tt1
        ) t1
        left join
            ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp2_1 t2
        on nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'') 
        and t1.channel = t2.channel 
        and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'') 
        and nvl(t1.category,'') = nvl(t2.category,'')
        and t1.month = t2.month 
        and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'')
        and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'')
        ) a
        left join
        (
            select
                amt
                ,currency
                ,if(begin_month is null,'000000',begin_month) begin_month                --开始时间 yyyymm 包括开始不包括结束
                ,if(end_month is null,'999999',end_month) end_month                  --结束时间 yyyymm
                ,'1' as tag
            from
                ${dme_cdm}.dim_controlling_blue_table_exchange_rate
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_controlling_blue_table_exchange_rate')
        ) b
        on a.tag = b.tag
        where a.month >= b.begin_month and a.month < b.end_month        --当月汇率数据mapping 出 欧元单位计算结果
) z where month <= '${bizmonth}'

    ,tt1.channel

        inventory_12_mon_avg -- 客户维度近12月月均sellout
        ,inventory_12_mon_avg_all  -- 固定12月月均sellout
        ,INVENTORY
        ,quarter,channel,region,category,ka_name,amount_type,month,customer_code,customer_name
        ,row_number() over(partition by quarter,channel,region,category,ka_name,amount_type,customer_code,customer_name order by month desc ) rk
    from
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_tmp3

    and nvl(tt1.ka_name,'') = nvl(tt2.ka_name,'') 
    and nvl(tt1.amount_type,'') = nvl(tt2.amount_type,'') 
    and nvl(tt1.customer_code,'') = nvl(tt2.customer_code,'') 
    and nvl(tt1.customer_name,'') = nvl(tt2.customer_name,'') 
    where tt2.rk = 1

    ,tt1.quarter

    ,tt2.inventory
    ,tt1.sell_in
    ,tt1.channel
    ,tt1.region
    ,tt1.category
    ,tt1.ka_name
    ,tt1.customer_code
    ,tt1.customer_name

--Ecom数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_ecom_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_ecom_tmp1 as
select
     t.month
    ,sum(t.sell_out) as sell_out
    ,sum(t.sell_in) as sell_in
    ,sum(t.inventory) as inventory
    ,nvl(t.category,'Others') as category
    ,nvl(t.henkel_brand,'Others')   as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
    ,nvl(t.henkel_brand_en,'Others')as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
    ,t.channel
    ,nvl(t.customer_code,'Others') as customer_code
    ,nvl(t.customer_name,'Others') as customer_name
    ,t.bu_1
    ,t.bu_2
    ,t.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from (
       ---ecom渠道sell-in
        select
           if(a.customer_id is null,'0',customer_id) as customer_code --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
           ,nvl(a.customer_name_en,'Others')         as customer_name --客户英文名
           ,nvl(a.henkel_category_code, 'Others')    as category_code --品类代码
           ,nvl(a.henkel_category_en, 'Others')      as category --品类名称
           ,nvl(a.henkel_brand, 'Others')         as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
           ,nvl(a.henkel_brand_en, 'Others')      as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
           ,'Ecom'      AS channel
           ,'Sell-in'   as value_type
           ,sum(a.ges)  as sell_in
           ,sum(a.ges)  as git
           ,0 as SELL_OUT
           ,0 as sale_num   
           ,0 as inventory_num  
           ,0 as inventory --库存数量
           ,SUBSTR(a.ds,1,6) as month
           ,a.bu_1
           ,a.bu_2
           ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a
        left join(
            select
              product_code     --产品编码
              ,whether_ecom_sample_product --是否Ecom标记小样(1是|0否)
              ,bu_1,bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            -- and source_type <> 'professional'
        ) b
        on a.product_id = b.product_code
        and a.bu_1 = b.bu_1
        and a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
        where a.ds >= '20200101'
        and a.ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
        and a.bu_2='Laundry'
        AND UPPER(a.first_channel_name)='ECOM'
        AND nvl(b.whether_ecom_sample_product,'0')='0'  -- 剔除小样
        group by if(a.customer_id is null,'0',customer_id)
           ,nvl(a.customer_name_en,'Others')      
           ,nvl(a.henkel_category_code, 'Others') 
           ,nvl(a.henkel_category_en, 'Others')   
           ,nvl(a.henkel_brand, 'Others')         
           ,nvl(a.henkel_brand_en, 'Others')
           ,SUBSTR(a.ds,1,6)
           ,a.bu_1
           ,a.bu_2
           ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
      union all
       ---ecom渠道sell-out、Inventory
        select
           a.customer_code                 as customer_code --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
           ,COALESCE(c.customer_name_en,a.dist_name,'Others') as  customer_name--客户英文名
           ,nvl(b.category_code ,'Others') as category_code --品类代码
           ,nvl(b.category_name ,'Others') as category --品类名称
           ,nvl(b.henkel_brand, 'Others')         as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
           ,nvl(b.henkel_brand_en, 'Others')      as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
           ,a.channel
           ,a.value_type
           ,0 as sell_in
           ,0 as git
           ,sum(a.base_sale_amt)   as sell_out   --sell-out金额
           ,sum(a.sale_num)        as sale_num   --sell-out数量
           ,sum(inv_sale_num     ) as inventory_num      --零售线商品期末库存未税销额
           ,sum(inv_base_sale_amt) as inventory --库存数量
           ,a.months                as month
           ,a.bu_1
           ,a.bu_2
           ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from (
            -- ecom渠道sell-out
            select
                prod_code                 as prod_code     --Henkel产品idh
                ,dist_code                as customer_code --经销商编码
                ,dist_name                as dist_name
                ,'Ecom'                   as channel
                ,'Sell-out'               as value_type
                ,sum(base_qty)            as sale_num      --数量
                ,sum(base_qty*base_price) as base_sale_amt --sell_out销售额
                ,0 as inv_sale_num      --零售线商品期末库存未税销额
                ,0 as inv_base_sale_amt --库存数量
                ,substr(ds,1,6)           as months
                ,bu_1,bu_2
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale_bu a
            where a.ds <>''
             and (prod_code is not null and trim(prod_code) <> '')
             and a.bu_2='Laundry'
             AND UPPER(a.first_channel_name_new)='ECOM'
            group by prod_code, dist_code, dist_name, substr(ds,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            -- ecom渠道Inventory
            union all
            select
                a.prod_code         as prod_code     --Henkel产品idh
                ,a.dist_code        as customer_code --经销商编码
                ,a.dist_name        as dist_name
                ,'Ecom'             as channel
                ,'Inventory'        as value_type
                ,0 as sale_num      --数量
                ,0 as base_sale_amt --sell_out销售额
                ,sum(a.base_qty)              as inv_sale_num      --零售线商品期末库存未税销额
                ,sum(a.base_qty*a.base_price) as inv_base_sale_amt --库存数量
                ,substr(a.ds,1,6)             as months
                ,a.bu_1,a.bu_2
                ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu a
            inner join (
                  select 
                      dist_code,
                      max(ds) as ds,
                      bu_2
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
                where ds<>''
                and bu_2='Laundry'
                AND UPPER(first_channel_name)='ECOM'
                group by dist_code,substr(stock_date,1,6),bu_2
            ) t1
             on a.dist_code = t1.dist_code
             and a.ds = t1.ds        --取每个ka_code当月最大库存日期数据
             and a.bu_2=t1.bu_2
            where a.ds<>''
             and (a.prod_barcode is not null  and  trim(a.prod_barcode) <> '')
             and a.bu_2='Laundry'
             AND UPPER(a.first_channel_name)='ECOM'
            group by a.prod_code ,a.dist_code ,a.dist_name, substr(a.ds,1,6),a.bu_1,a.bu_2
                ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        )a
        left join(
            select
              product_code     --产品编码
              ,product_barcode  --产品条形码
              ,category_name_en as category_name  --品类
              ,category_name_en as category_code --品类id
              ,brand_name as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
              ,brand_name_en as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
              ,whether_ecom_sample_product --是否Ecom标记小样(1是|0否)
              ,bu_1,bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            -- and source_type <> 'professional'
        ) b
        on a.prod_code = b.product_code
        and a.bu_1 = b.bu_1
        and a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
        left join (
            select
              customer_code    --客户编码
              ,customer_name_en --客户中文
              ,customer_name  -- 客户英文
              ,channel_hierarchy_1
              ,bu_1,bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
            where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
        ) c
        on a.customer_code = c.customer_code
        and a.bu_1 = c.bu_1
        and a.bu_2 = c.bu_2
        where nvl(b.whether_ecom_sample_product,'0')='0'  -- 剔除小样
        group by a.customer_code
           ,COALESCE(c.customer_name_en,a.dist_name,'Others')
           ,nvl(b.category_code ,'Others') 
           ,nvl(b.category_name ,'Others') 
           ,nvl(b.henkel_brand, 'Others')     
           ,nvl(b.henkel_brand_en, 'Others')  
           ,a.channel
           ,a.value_type
           ,a.months 
           ,a.bu_1
           ,a.bu_2
           ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
) t
inner join (
    --按月看不在ecom渠道的数据不取
    select distinct
        customer_code,  --客户编码
        customer_name_en ,  --客户中文
        customer_name, -- 客户英文
        channel_hierarchy_1,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        substr(ds,1,6) as months
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01%'
    and channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom'
) c
on t.customer_code = c.customer_code
 and t.month = c.months
 and t.bu_1 = c.bu_1
 and t.bu_2 = c.bu_2
where  month >= '202001'           --数据从2020年1月分之后才进行关注
group by
    t.month
    ,nvl(t.category,'Others')
    ,t.channel
    ,nvl(t.customer_code,'Others')
    ,nvl(t.customer_name,'Others'),nvl(t.henkel_brand,'Others')
    ,nvl(t.henkel_brand_en,'Others') ,t.bu_1,t.bu_2
    ,t.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道

--MPD数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_mpd_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_mpd_tmp1 as
select
    coalesce(t1.month,t2.month) as month,
    coalesce(t1.channel,t2.channel) as channel,
    coalesce(t1.region,t2.region) as region,
    coalesce(t1.customer_code,t2.customer_code) as customer_code, -- 客户id
    coalesce(t1.customer_name,t2.customer_name) as customer_name ,-- 客户id
    coalesce(t1.category_code,t2.category_code) as category_code,
    coalesce(t1.category,t2.category) as category,
    coalesce(t1.henkel_brand,t2.henkel_brand) as henkel_brand,
    coalesce(t1.henkel_brand_en,t2.henkel_brand_en) as henkel_brand_en,
    coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1) as bu_1,
    coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2) as bu_2,
    sum(t2.sell_out) as sell_out,
    sum(t2.sale_num) as sale_num,
    sum(t1.sell_in) as sell_in,
    sum(t2.inventory) as inventory
    ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from
(
    select
        SUBSTR(ds,1,6) as month,     --以过账日期作为时间
        first_channel_name  as channel,               --渠道
        henkel_region_en as region,
        customer_id  as customer_code,
        customer_name_en  as customer_name,
        henkel_category_code as category_code,     ----品类代码
        henkel_category_en  as category,              --品类
        henkel_brand,
        henkel_brand_en,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        sum(ges) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
        ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu 
    where ds >='20200101'         --ke24销售表
    and ds <='${bizdate}'  --后期需要调整参数，当前页面只要20年数据，后面调整为进
    and upper(bu_2)='LAUNDRY'
    and UPPER(first_channel_name)in('DT','MPD')
    and customer_id is not null
    and quantity_consumer_units is not null --观察数据过滤脏数据
    and product_id is not null
    group by
        SUBSTR(ds,1,6),
        first_channel_name,
        henkel_region_en,
        customer_id,
        customer_name_en,
        henkel_category_code,
        henkel_category_en,
        henkel_brand,
        henkel_brand_en,
        bu_1,
        bu_2   
        ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
) t1

        bu_2
        ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        union all 
        --库存
        select 
            a.month,
            a.dist_code,
            a.dist_name,
            a.prod_code,
            a.first_channel_name,
            a.bu_1,
            a.bu_2,
            0 as sale_num,
            0 as sell_out,
            sum(a.stock_num)      as stock_num,
            sum(a.inventory)      as inventory
            ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from(
            select
                dist_code,
                dist_name,
                prod_code,
                base_qty as stock_num,   --库存数量
                base_qty*base_price as inventory,
                substr(ds,1,6) as month,
                ds,
                first_channel_name,
                bu_1,
                bu_2
                ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
            where ds >='20200101'
            and upper(bu_2)='LAUNDRY'
            and prod_brand_name <>'' 
            and prod_brand_name is not null 
            and stock_type not like '%赠品%'
            and stock_type not like '%代销%' 
            and upper(first_channel_name)in('DT','MPD')
            and base_qty <> 0
        ) a 
        join(
            select 
                dist_code,
                max(stock_date) as stock_date,
                substr(stock_date,1,6) as stock_month,
                bu_1,
                bu_2
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
            where ds>='20200101'
            and upper(bu_2)='LAUNDRY'
            and upper(first_channel_name)in('DT','MPD')
            and ds<= '${bizdate}' 
            group by 
            substr(stock_date,1,6),
            dist_code,
            bu_1,
            bu_2
        ) b 
        on a.dist_code=b.dist_code 
        and a.ds =b.stock_date
        and nvl(a.bu_1,'') =nvl(b.bu_1,'')
        and nvl(a.bu_2,'') =nvl(b.bu_2,'')
        group by 
        a.month,
        a.dist_code,
        a.dist_name,
        a.prod_code,
        a.first_channel_name,
        a.bu_1,
        a.bu_2
        ,a.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) tt1
    left join
    (
        select
            customer_code ,                        --用户id
            customer_name_en,
            region_en ,                    --大区
            bu_1,
            bu_2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu') 
        and channel_hierarchy_1 in('DT','MPD')
    ) tt2
    on tt1.dist_code = tt2.customer_code
    and tt1.bu_1 = tt2.bu_1
    and tt1.bu_2 = tt2.bu_2
    left join
    (
        select
            product_code,
            category_name_en,
            brand_name,
            brand_name_en,
            bu_1,
            bu_2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
    ) tt3
    on tt1.prod_code = tt3.product_code
    and tt1.bu_1 = tt3.bu_1
    and tt1.bu_2 = tt3.bu_2
    group by
        tt1.month,
        tt1.first_channel_name,
        nvl(tt2.region_en,'Others'),
        tt1.dist_code,
        COALESCE(tt2.customer_name_en,tt1.dist_name,'Others'),
        nvl(tt3.category_name_en,'Others') ,
        nvl(tt3.brand_name,'Others'),
        nvl(tt3.brand_name_en,'Others'),
        tt1.bu_1,
        tt1.bu_2
        ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    
) t2
on nvl(t1.month,'')=nvl(t2.month,'') 
and nvl(t1.channel,'')=nvl(t2.channel,'') 
and nvl(t1.region,'')=nvl(t2.region,'')
and nvl(t1.customer_code,'')=nvl(t2.customer_code,'')
and nvl(t1.customer_name,'')=nvl(t2.customer_name,'')
and nvl(t1.category_code,'')=nvl(t2.category_code,'')
and nvl(t1.category,'')=nvl(t2.category,'')
and nvl(t1.henkel_brand,'')=nvl(t2.henkel_brand,'')
and nvl(t1.henkel_brand_en,'')=nvl(t2.henkel_brand_en,'')
and nvl(t1.bu_1,'')=nvl(t2.bu_1,'')
and nvl(t1.bu_2,'')=nvl(t2.bu_2,'')
and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
where coalesce(t1.channel,t2.channel) is not null
group by 
    coalesce(t1.month,t2.month),
    coalesce(t1.channel,t2.channel),
    coalesce(t1.region,t2.region),
    coalesce(t1.customer_code,t2.customer_code), -- 客户id
    coalesce(t1.customer_name,t2.customer_name),-- 客户id
    coalesce(t1.category_code,t2.category_code),
    coalesce(t1.category,t2.category),
    coalesce(t1.henkel_brand,t2.henkel_brand),
    coalesce(t1.henkel_brand_en,t2.henkel_brand_en),
    coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1),
    coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2)
    ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest)

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_all_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_all_tmp1 as
select
    coalesce(t1.customer_group,t4.customer_group,t5.ka_name) as ka_name
    ,coalesce(t1.month,t4.month,t5.month) as month
    ,sum(t5.sell_out) as sell_out
    ,sum(t4.inventory) as inventory
    ,sum(t1.sell_in) as sell_in
    ,coalesce(t1.channel_hierarchy_1,t4.channel_hierarchy_1,t5.channel_hierarchy_1) as channel
    ,cast(null as string) as region
    ,nvl(coalesce(t1.category,t4.henkel_category_en,t5.henkel_category_name_en),'Others') as category
    ,coalesce(t1.henkel_brand,t4.henkel_brand,t5.henkel_brand)          as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
    ,coalesce(t1.henkel_brand_en,t4.henkel_brand_en,t5.henkel_brand_en) as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
    ,coalesce(t1.customer_code,t4.customer_code,t5.customer_code) as  customer_code
    ,cast(null as string) as  customer_name
    ,coalesce(t1.bu_1,t4.bu_1,t5.bu_1) as bu_1
    ,coalesce(t1.bu_2,t4.bu_2,t5.bu_2) as bu_2
    ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest,t5.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
from (
    select
        tt1.month
        ,sum(tt1.sell_in) as sell_in
        ,tt2.customer_group
        ,tt2.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,tt1.category
        ,tt1.henkel_brand    as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
        ,tt1.henkel_brand_en as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
        ,tt1.bu_1
        ,tt1.bu_2
        ,tt1.customer_id as customer_code
        ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    from (
        select
            SUBSTR(ds,1,6)  as month     --以过账日期作为时间
            ,customer_id                        --用户id
            ,sum(ges) as sell_in  --基价Sell-in额
            ,henkel_category_en as  category
            ,henkel_brand    as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
            ,henkel_brand_en as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
            ,bu_1
            ,bu_2
            ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
         where ds >='20200101'         --ke24销售表
          and ds <='${bizdate}'  --后期需要调整参数，当前页面只要20年数据，后面调整为进
          and bu_2='Laundry'
          AND UPPER(first_channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
          and customer_id is not null
          and quantity_consumer_units is not null --观察数据过滤脏数据
          and product_id is not null
        group by SUBSTR(ds,1,6)
            ,customer_id
            ,product_id
            ,henkel_category_en,henkel_brand,henkel_brand_en
            ,bu_1
            ,bu_2
            ,first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
    ) tt1
    left join (
        SELECT
            customer_code                         --用户id
            ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
            ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end as customer_group
            ,bu_2
            ,substr(ds,1,6) as month
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
        where ds like '%01' -- = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
          and bu_2='Laundry'
          AND UPPER(channel_hierarchy_1) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
        group by
            customer_code
            ,channel_hierarchy_1
            ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end,bu_2,substr(ds,1,6)
    ) tt2
    on tt1.customer_id = tt2.customer_code
    and tt1.bu_2 = tt2.bu_2
    and tt1.month = tt2.month
    group by
        tt2.customer_group
        ,tt2.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,tt1.category,tt1.henkel_brand ,tt1.henkel_brand_en
        ,tt1.month,tt1.bu_1,tt1.bu_2
        ,tt1.customer_id 
        ,tt1.first_channel_name_lastest -- 客户最新渠道
) t1

               ,channel_hierarchy_1,bu_2,substr(ds,1,6)

        on tt1.dist_system_name_en_new = tt3.customer_group_en_lv2
        and tt1.bu_2=tt3.bu_2
        and substr(tt1.ds,1,6)=tt3.month
        group by tt3.customer_group
            ,substr(tt1.ds,1,6)
            ,tt1.henkel_category_name_en
            ,tt1.henkel_brand_name_cn
            ,tt1.henkel_brand_name_en
            ,tt3.channel_hierarchy_1,tt1.bu_1,tt1.bu_2
   union all
   -- 合并Laundry沃尔玛的sellout
   
    select
        sum(a.base_qty*a.base_price) as sell_out
        ,z3.customer_group as ka_name
        ,substr(a.ds,1,6) as month
        ,b.henkel_category_name_en
        ,b.henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
        ,b.henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
        ,z3.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,a.dist_code  as customer_code
        ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale_bu a   --NKA库存数据汇总月表
   left join(
      select distinct
        product_code     --产品编码
        ,category_name_en as henkel_category_name_en
        ,brand_name as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
        ,brand_name_en as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
        ,bu_1,bu_2
      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
      where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
      and bu_2='Laundry'
   ) b
    on a.prod_code = b.product_code
    and a.bu_1 = b.bu_1
    and a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
   left join (
       SELECT
           customer_code
           ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end as customer_group
           ,channel_hierarchy_1
           ,bu_2,substr(ds,1,6) as month
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
       where ds like '%01' -- = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
       and bu_2='Laundry'
       AND UPPER(channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
       group by customer_code
           ,case when customer_group_en_lv1='CRV' and nvl(customer_group,'') not regexp 'Tesco' then 'CRV'
             else customer_group
            end
           ,channel_hierarchy_1,bu_2,substr(ds,1,6)
    ) z3
    on a.dist_code= z3.customer_code    --匹配通用ka name
    and a.bu_2=z3.bu_2
    and substr(a.ds,1,6)=z3.month
   where a.ds >='20200101'
   and a.prod_code is not null
   and a.prod_code != '-110'
   and a.bu_2='Laundry'
   and ((a.dist_code ='708859'  and substr(a.ds,1,4)<'2024')-- 24年前取手工沃尔玛数据
    or (substr(a.ds,1,4)='2022' and a.dist_code ='2509858') -- 22年山姆sellout数据 取手工
   ) 
  -- and a.data_source='手工'
   AND UPPER(a.first_channel_name_new) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
    group by z3.customer_group
        ,substr(a.ds,1,6)
        ,b.henkel_category_name_en
        ,b.henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
        ,b.henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
        ,z3.channel_hierarchy_1
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,a.dist_code  
        ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
) t5
on nvl(t1.customer_group,'') = nvl(t5.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(t1.month     ,'') =nvl(t5.month  ,'')
 and nvl(t1.category  ,'') =nvl(t5.henkel_category_name_en  ,'')
 and nvl(t1.henkel_brand   ,'') = nvl(t4.henkel_brand,'')
 and nvl(t1.henkel_brand_en,'') = nvl(t4.henkel_brand_en,'')
 and nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1,'') =nvl(t5.channel_hierarchy_1  ,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_1 ,'') = nvl(t5.bu_1,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_2 ,'') = nvl(t5.bu_2,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_code ,'') = nvl(t5.customer_code,'')
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest ,'') = nvl(t5.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
where coalesce(t1.channel_hierarchy_1,t4.channel_hierarchy_1,t5.channel_hierarchy_1) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
group by

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_foc_tmp1 as
select
    case when nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then
          case when t1.customer_group regexp 'CRV-SG|HomeClub|Wanjia' then 'CRV'

             else t1.customer_group
           end
      else null 
     end as ka_name     --Ecom渠道 ka_name为空
    ,a.months as month
    ,sum(a.sellout_qty *t2.product_base_price) as sell_out
    ,sum(a.stock_num   *t2.product_base_price) as inventory
    ,sum(a.sellin_num  *t2.product_base_price) as sell_in
    ,sum(a.sellout_qty ) as sellout_qty
    ,sum(a.stock_num   ) as stock_num  
    ,sum(a.sellin_num  ) as sellin_num 
    ,nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom') as channel
    ,case when UPPER(nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom')) regexp 'NKA|SELECTIVE RETAILER|ECOM' then null 
        else nvl(t1.region_en,'Others') end as region
    ,t2.category_name_en as category
    ,t2.brand_name    as henkel_brand    --汉高品牌名称
    ,t2.brand_name_en as henkel_brand_en --汉高品牌英文名称
    ,a.customer_code  as customer_code
    ,t2.bu_1
    ,t2.bu_2
 from(
   select
      months      -- 月份
      ,idh       as product_code   -- 产品idh
      ,case when shop_code='2925773' and months<='202307' then '1967491'
       else shop_code end as customer_code   -- 客户code
      ,sellout_qty        -- sellout数量
      ,stock_num          -- 库存数量 
      ,0 as sellin_num    -- sellin数量 
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_blue_table_foc_sell_out_inventory
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_blue_table_foc_sell_out_inventory')
   union all
   select
      months      -- 月份
      ,product_code    -- 产品idh
      ,case when customer_idh='2925773' and months<='202307' then '1967491'
       else customer_idh end as customer_code   -- 客户code
      ,0 as sellout_qty -- sellout数量
      ,0 as stock_num   -- 库存数量
      ,order_quantity as sellin_num    --  sellin数量
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_blue_table_foc_sell_in 
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_blue_table_foc_sell_in')
   and upper(trim(for_l_or_b))='B 买赠'
   and upper(trim(platform)) not regexp'WS|MPD'
 ) a
 left join(
    select
       product_code
      ,product_name
      ,product_base_price
      ,product_barcode   
      ,category_name     
      ,category_name_en  
      ,brand_name        
      ,brand_name_en
      ,bu_1,bu_2   
      ,ds  
      ,row_number()over(partition by product_code,substr(ds,1,6) order by ds desc) as rn     
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
	where (ds=TO_CHAR(date(LAST_DAY(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd'))),'yyyyMMdd')
       or ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
       )
 ) t2
 on a.product_code = t2.product_code
 and a.months=substr(t2.ds,1,6)
 and t2.rn=1
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu t1
  on nvl(a.customer_code,'')=nvl(t1.customer_code,'')
  and t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
  and nvl(t2.bu_2,'Beauty Care')=t1.bu_2
 group by case when nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then
          case when t1.customer_group regexp 'CRV-SG|HomeClub|Wanjia' then 'CRV'
               when t1.customer_group regexp 'CRV-Tesco' then 'Tesco'
             else t1.customer_group
           end
      else null 
     end
    ,a.months
    ,nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom')
    ,case when UPPER(nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Ecom')) regexp 'NKA|SELECTIVE RETAILER|ECOM' then null 
        else nvl(t1.region_en,'Others') end
    ,t2.category_name_en 
    ,t2.brand_name     --汉高品牌名称
    ,t2.brand_name_en  --汉高品牌英文名称
    ,a.customer_code  
    ,t2.bu_1
    ,t2.bu_2

    ,a.ka_type
    ,a.customer_code
    ,a.customer_name
    ,min(a.month) as min_month 
from ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf a

                --    case when datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(if(t2.month<'202304',null,t2.month),'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then t2.month end  
                 when  -- 23年2681303赛夫及其他经销商和ka的round过去12个月
                    datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then t2.month
               end
           else  -- 22年其他经销商和ka的round过去12个月
            case when datediff(to_date(t1.month,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.month,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then t2.month end
         end) as month_cnt_cust  -- 到客户维度的逻辑
        ,t1.customer_code
        ,t1.customer_name
        ,t1.region
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp2_2 t1
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp2_2 t2
    on nvl(t1.category,'') = nvl(t2.category,'')
    and nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'')
    and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'')
    and t1.channel = t2.channel
    and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'')
    and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'')
    and nvl(t1.henkel_brand,'') = nvl(t2.henkel_brand,'')
    and nvl(t1.henkel_brand_en,'') = nvl(t2.henkel_brand_en,'')
    and nvl(t1.bu_1,'') = nvl(t2.bu_1,'')
    and nvl(t1.bu_2,'') = nvl(t2.bu_2,'')
    where t1.month >= t2.month
    and t1.month <= '${bizmonth}'
    and t2.month <= '${bizmonth}'
    and t2.sell_out is not null
    and if(upper(t1.channel)='ECOM' and t1.month>='202301' and t1.bu_2='Laundry',upper(t1.henkel_brand_en) in ('BREF','PERSIL') ,1=1)
   -- and nvl(t2.sell_out,0)<>0

        ,t1.bu_2

 on nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'')

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp3

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp3 as
select
    year
    ,quarter
    ,month
    ,channel
    ,currency as amount_type
    ,region
    ,category
    ,ka_name
    ,customer_code
    ,customer_name
    ,(sell_out/amt) as sell_out
    ,(inventory/amt) as inventory
    ,(sell_in/amt) as sell_in 
    ,inventory_12_mon_avg_all     /amt as inventory_12_mon_avg_all     -- 全bu沿用beauty care的其他维度逻辑
    ,inventory_12_mon_avg_bc_cust /amt as inventory_12_mon_avg_bc_cust -- 全bu沿用beauty care的客户维度逻辑
    ,inventory_12_mon_avg_channel /amt as inventory_12_mon_avg_channel -- 不同渠道所有客户的逻辑
    ,inventory_12_mon_avg_cust    /amt as inventory_12_mon_avg_cust    -- 到客户维度的逻辑
    ,bu_1
    ,bu_2
from
(
    select
        a.year
        ,a.quarter
        ,a.month
        ,cast(a.sell_out as double) sell_out
        ,cast(a.inventory as double) inventory
        ,cast(a.sell_in as double) sell_in
        ,a.channel
        ,a.region
        ,a.category
        ,a.ka_name
        ,a.customer_code
        ,a.customer_name
        ,cast(a.inventory_12_mon_avg_all     as double) as inventory_12_mon_avg_all -- 全bu沿用beauty care的其他维度逻辑
        ,cast(a.inventory_12_mon_avg_bc_cust as double) as  inventory_12_mon_avg_bc_cust -- 全bu沿用beauty care的客户维度逻辑
        ,cast(a.inventory_12_mon_avg_channel as double) as inventory_12_mon_avg_channel
        ,cast(a.inventory_12_mon_avg_cust    as double) as inventory_12_mon_avg_cust
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,case when b.amt is not null and b.amt != 0 and a.month >= b.begin_month and a.month <= b.end_month
                then b.amt
            else 1
        end as amt                  --汇率值
        ,b.currency
    from (
        select
            t1.ka_name
            ,case substr(t1.month,5,2)
                when '01' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q1')
                when '02' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q1')
                when '03' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q1')
                when '04' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q2')
                when '05' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q2')
                when '06' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q2')
                when '07' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q3')
                when '08' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q3')
                when '09' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q3')
                when '10' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q4')
                when '11' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q4')
                when '12' then concat(substr(t1.month,1,4),'Q4')
             end as quarter
            ,substr(t1.month,1,4) as year
            ,t1.month
            ,t1.sell_out
            ,t1.inventory
            ,t1.sell_in
            ,t1.channel
            ,t1.region
            ,t1.category
            ,t1.customer_code
            ,t1.customer_name
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg_all -- 全bu沿用beauty care的其他维度逻辑
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg_bc_cust -- 全bu沿用beauty care的客户维度逻辑
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg_channel
            ,t2.inventory_12_mon_avg_cust
            ,t1.bu_1
            ,t1.bu_2
            ,'1' as tag
        from(
          select
              ka_name     --Ecom渠道 ka_name为空
              ,month
              ,sum(sell_out ) as sell_out 
              ,sum(inventory) as inventory
              ,sum(sell_in  ) as sell_in  
             -- ,sum(case when upper(channel)='ECOM' and t1.month>='202301' and bu_2='Laundry'
             --    and upper(henkel_brand_en) in ('BREF','PERSIL') then sell_out end) as sell_out_inv_months -- 计算laundry 库存周转周期使用(2023年起，Ecom单个客户、Ecom 只round Bref和Persil两个品牌的Sell out)
              ,channel
              ,region
              ,category
              ,customer_code
              ,customer_name
              ,bu_1
              ,bu_2
          from ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp2
          group by ka_name,month ,channel ,region ,category ,customer_code ,customer_name ,bu_1 ,bu_2
        ) t1
        left join ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_blue_table_clannel_collect_by_month_mf_bu_tmp2_3 t2
        on nvl(t1.ka_name,'') = nvl(t2.ka_name,'')
        and t1.channel = t2.channel
        and nvl(t1.region,'') = nvl(t2.region,'')
        and nvl(t1.category,'') = nvl(t2.category,'')
        and t1.month = t2.month
        and nvl(t1.customer_code,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code,'')
        and nvl(t1.customer_name,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name,'')
        and nvl(t1.bu_1,'') = nvl(t2.bu_1,'')
        and nvl(t1.bu_2,'') = nvl(t2.bu_2,'')
        ) a
        left join (
            select
                amt
                ,currency
                ,if(begin_month is null,'000000',begin_month) begin_month                --开始时间 yyyymm 包括开始不包括结束
                ,if(end_month is null,'999999',end_month) end_month                  --结束时间 yyyymm
                ,'1' as tag
            from dme_cdm.dim_controlling_blue_table_exchange_rate
            where ds = max_pt('dme_cdm.dim_controlling_blue_table_exchange_rate')
        ) b
        on a.tag = b.tag
        where a.month >= b.begin_month and a.month < b.end_month        --当月汇率数据mapping 出 欧元单位计算结果
) z where month <= '${bizmonth}'

                 ,case when channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then customer_group_cn_lv2 else customer_name end  as customer_name_lastest                  
                 ,channel_name_lastest   
                 ,region_lastest

              and ds like '%01'
        ) t2
         on t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_code 
        and t1.month = t2.months
        and t1.bu_2  = t2.bu_2
        left join
        (
            select
                sum(tt1.ges           ) as ges
               ,sum(tt1.ppd           ) as ppd
               ,sum(tt1.pld           ) as pld
               ,sum(tt1.fg            ) as fg
               ,sum(tt1.ges-tt1.ppd-tt1.pld-tt1.fg) as ngs
               ,tt1.posting_date        as postingdate
               ,if(tt1.first_channel_name != 'NKA',tt1.customer_id,tt2.customer_group) as customer_id

                    ,cast(sum(ppd_free_goods * -1) as double)               as fg               --赠品金额
                    ,to_char(to_date(posting_date,'yyyy-mm-dd 00:00:00'),'yyyymm') as posting_date
                    ,customer_id                             --经销商code
                    ,first_channel_name
                    ,bu_2
                from

                group by to_char(to_date(posting_date,'yyyy-mm-dd 00:00:00'),'yyyymm')
                         ,customer_id
                         ,first_channel_name
                         ,bu_2
            ) tt1
            left join
            (
                select
                      distinct 
                      substr(ds,1,6)         AS    months            
                     ,channel_hierarchy_1    AS    customer_type            
                     ,region_en
                     ,customer_code            
                     ,customer_name              
                     ,case when customer_group_en_lv1 = 'RT' then customer_group_en_lv2 else customer_group end  as  customer_group
                     ,channel_name   
                     ,bu_2    
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                where nvl(ds,'') <> '' 
                  and bu_2 in ('Laundry' ,'Beauty Care')
                  and ds like '%01'
             ) tt2
             on tt1.customer_id   = tt2.customer_code         --获取到手工表所展示英文idh
             and tt1.posting_date = tt2.months         
             and tt1.bu_2         = tt2.bu_2       
             group by if(tt1.first_channel_name != 'NKA',tt1.customer_id,tt2.customer_group),tt1.posting_date,tt1.bu_2 
        ) t3
         on t1.customer_idh = t3.customer_id 
        and t1.month = t3.postingdate
        and t1.bu_2  = t3.bu_2
        left join
        (
            select
                 sum(tt1.nts)                   as nts
                ,sum(tt1.ttl_l10)               as ttl_l10
                ,sum(tt1.l11_transp_w_h_cst)    as l11_transp_w_h_cst
                ,sum(tt1.ttl_l12)               as ttl_l12

                ,sum(tt1.ttl_c)                 as ttl_c

                ,sum(tt1.ttl_a2)                as ttl_a2
                ,sum(tt1.ttl_d)                 as ttl_d
                ,if(tt2.channel_name='NKA',tt2.customer_group,tt1.customer_code)  as customer_id
                ,ds
                ,tt1.bu_2
            from
            (
                select
                     sum(l9)    as nts
                    ,sum(l10)   as ttl_l10                       --Commission（佣金）
                    ,sum(l11)   as l11_transp_w_h_cst            --Transport/Warehouse，运输和仓库管理相关费用
                    ,sum(l12)   as ttl_l12
                    ,sum(l13)   as l13_processing_cost           --L13加工成本
                    ,sum(l14)   as l14_total_manufactur          --即Total_Manufacturing_Cost，制造类费用
                    ,sum(l16)   as l16_additional_opera          --即Added_Operational_Cost，额外运营费用
                    ,sum(L17a)  as ttl_a
                    ,sum(L17b)  as ttl_b
                    ,sum(L17c)  as ttl_c
                    ,sum(l17)   as ttl_l17
                    ,sum(l17a1) as ttl_a1
                    ,sum(l17a2) as ttl_a2
                    ,sum(l17d)  as ttl_d
                    ,case when customer_code = 'Not assigned' then 'Others' else customer_code end  as  customer_code
                    ,bu_2
                    ,months  as  ds
                from
                    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_customer_summary_bu 
                where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_customer_summary_bu') and bu_2 in ('Laundry')
                group by case when customer_code = 'Not assigned' then 'Others' else customer_code end,months,bu_2
                
                union all 
                
                select
                     sum(l9)    as nts
                    ,sum(l10)   as ttl_l10                       --Commission（佣金）
                    ,sum(l11)   as l11_transp_w_h_cst            --Transport/Warehouse，运输和仓库管理相关费用
                    ,sum(l12)   as ttl_l12
                    ,sum(l13)   as l13_processing_cost           --L13加工成本
                    ,sum(l14)   as l14_total_manufactur          --即Total_Manufacturing_Cost，制造类费用
                    ,sum(l16)   as l16_additional_opera          --即Added_Operational_Cost，额外运营费用
                    ,sum(L17a)  as ttl_a
                    ,sum(L17b)  as ttl_b
                    ,sum(L17c)  as ttl_c
                    ,sum(l17)   as ttl_l17
                    ,sum(l17a1) as ttl_a1
                    ,sum(l17a2) as ttl_a2

                    ,customer_code

                from

            ) tt1
            left join
            (

                   ,channel_hierarchy_1    AS    customer_type            
                   ,region_en
                   ,customer_code            
                   ,customer_name

                   ,channel_name   
                   ,bu_2    
                from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu

            ) tt2
             on tt1.customer_code   = tt2.customer_code         --获取到手工表所展示英文idh
