            and tt1.bu_2         = tt2.bu_2
            group by if(tt2.channel_name='NKA',tt2.customer_group,tt1.customer_code),ds,tt1.bu_2
        ) t4
         on t1.customer_idh = t4.customer_id
        and t1.month = t4.ds
        and t1.bu_2  = t4.bu_2
        ) tt
    ) t

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads_dev}.tb_direct_sale_store_mapping_time partition(ds ='${bizdate}')

--周
select 
 case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
    '-0',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) >10 and 
    substr(day_id,5,2)='01'
    then concat
    (
      cast(year(dateadd(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    else concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
  end as mapping_time,
  day_id as time_now,
 to_char(dateadd(dateadd(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy'), 
WEEKOFYEAR(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),- (weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'))*7 + 
WEEKDAY(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd')) -WEEKDAY(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), 
-(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy')),'dd'),
-(7-weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))-1),'dd'),'yyyymmdd')
as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'周' as mapping_type
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'

union all
--月
select
     a.mapping_time,
     a.time_now,
     case when a.rn = 1 then b.time_now  else a.time_yoy end   as  time_yoy,
     case when a.rn = 1 then c.time_now  else a.time_mom end   as  time_mom,
     a.mapping_type
from  
(
    select
         substr(day_id,1,6) as mapping_time,
         day_id as time_now,
         to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
         to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
         '月' as mapping_type
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by substr(day_id,1,6) order by day_id desc) as  rn
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
    where day_id <='${bizdate}'
)a
left join 
(  
    select
         day_id as time_now
        ,substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),+12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd'),1,6) as  mapping_time
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by substr(day_id,1,6) order by day_id desc) as  rn
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
    where day_id <='${bizdate}'
)b
 on a.mapping_time = b.mapping_time
and a.rn = b.rn --月同比中最后一天需要关联获取同比月最后一天
and b.rn = 1
left join 
(
    select
         day_id as time_now
        ,substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),+1,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd'),1,6) as  mapping_time
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by substr(day_id,1,6) order by day_id desc) as  rn
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
    where day_id <='${bizdate}'
)c
on a.mapping_time = c.mapping_time
and a.rn = c.rn  --月环比中最后一天需要关联获取环比月最后一天
and c.rn = 1

union all
 
select
day_id as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'日' as mapping_type
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'

and t1.app_id = t2.app_id

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu partition(ds)
select 
    sku_id                                  --单品id
   ,sku_name                                --单品名称
   ,sku_name_id                             --产品名称和ID
   ,product_line_id                         --产品线id
   ,product_line_name                       --产品线名称
   ,product_line_mark                       --产品线标记
   ,high_product_mark                       --高端化产品标记
   ,new_product_mark                        --新品标记
   ,mock_up_mark                            --是否小样
   ,category_code                           --品类代码
   ,category_name                           --品类名称
   ,brand_code                              --品牌代码
   ,brand_name                              --品牌名称
   ,product_function                        --产品功能/一级子品类
   ,sub_product_function                    --二级子品类
   ,product_pack                            --产品包装
   ,product_pack_type                       --产品包装分类
   ,colour_chroma                           --色度
   ,colour_hue                              --色调
   ,main_colour_hue                         --主色调
   ,store_code                              --店铺代码
   ,store_name                              --店铺名称
   ,store_type                              --店铺类型
   ,sku_price                               --sku价格
   ,sum(sku_sale_num  )  as sku_sale_num                            --sku销售数量
   ,cast(sum(sku_sales_amt ) as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt     --pos累计销售额未税
   ,sum(order_num     )  as order_num                               --订单数量
   ,dt_date                                 --时间
   ,bu_1                                    --业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
   ,bu_2                                    --业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
   ,bu_3                                    --业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   ,cast(sum(sku_sales_amt_tax )   as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt_tax                  --pos累计销售额(含税) 
   ,tax_rate                                --产品税率
   ,sales_channel                           --销售渠道
   ,henkel_idh_code                         --产品IDH编码
   ,cast(sum(base_price_amt                ) as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt                          --基价销额未税
   ,cast(sum(base_price_amt_tax            ) as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt_tax                      --基价销额含税
   ,sum(return_num                    )  as return_num                              --退货数量
   ,cast(sum(return_amt                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt                              --退款金额未税
   ,cast(sum(return_amt_tax                ) as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt_tax                          --退货金额含税
   ,cast(sum(base_price_return_amt         ) as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_return_amt                   --基价退货金额未税
   ,cast(sum(base_price_return_amt_tax     ) as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_return_amt_tax               --基价退货金额含税
   ,sum(sku_sale_num       ) -  sum(return_num               )            as post_return_num                         --退后数量
   ,cast(sum(sku_sales_amt      ) -  sum(return_amt               )  as decimal(28,6))          as post_return_amt                         --退后金额未税
   ,cast(sum(sku_sales_amt_tax  ) -  sum(return_amt_tax           )  as decimal(28,6))          as post_return_amt_tax                     --退后金额含税
   ,cast(sum(base_price_amt     ) -  sum(base_price_return_amt    )  as decimal(28,6))          as base_price_post_return_amt              --基价退后金额未税
   ,cast(sum(base_price_amt_tax ) -  sum(base_price_return_amt_tax)  as decimal(28,6))          as base_price_post_return_amt_tax          --基价退后金额含税
   ,customer_code                                 --汉高客户编码 
   ,nvl(customer_name,'Others')                   --汉高客户名称中文 
   ,data_type
   ,platform
   ,henkel_store_category
   ,henkel_store_category_lv1
   ,henkel_store_category_lv2
   ,first_channel_name
   ,second_channel_name
   ,third_channel_name
   ,fourth_channel_name
   ,province_name --标准省份名称
   ,city_name --城市名称
   ,ds
from (
    
    
    --正单
    select
    /*+mapjoin(t1,t11,t2,t3,t4)*/
    		ttt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_id,--单品id
    		nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as sku_name,--单品名称
        concat(nvl(t1.product_name,'Others'),'-',ttt.henkel_item_barcode) as sku_name_id,--产品名称和ID
    		case when t1.product_line is null or t1.product_line='' then 'Others'
            else t1.product_line end as product_line_id,--产品线id
    		case when t1.product_line is null or t1.product_line='' then 'Others'
            else t1.product_line end as product_line_name,--产品线名称
    		case when t4.product_barcode is not null then '1' else '0' end as product_line_mark,--核心产品线标记
    		case when t1.premiumisation_product='1' then '1' else '0' end as high_product_mark,--高端化产品标记
    		case when t11.new_product='1' then '1' else '0' end as new_product_mark,--新品标记
            case when t3.product_barcode is not null then '1' else '0' end  as mock_up_mark,--是否小样 1是 0否
    		case when t1.category_name_en is null or t1.category_name_en='' then 'Others'
                 else t1.category_name_en end as category_code,--品类代码
    		case when t1.category_name is null or t1.category_name='' then 'Others'
                 else t1.category_name end as category_name,--品类名称
    		case when t1.brand_name_en is null or t1.brand_name_en='' then 'Others' 
                 else t1.brand_name_en end as brand_code,--品牌代码
    		case when t1.brand_name is null or t1.brand_name='' then 'Others'
             else t1.brand_name end as brand_name,--品牌名称
        case when (t1.product_function is null or t1.product_function='') then 'Others'
             else t1.product_function end as product_function,--产品功能/一级子品类
        --sub_product_function
        case when (t1.sub_product_function is null or t1.sub_product_function='') then 'Others'
             else t1.sub_product_function end as sub_product_function,--二级子品类
        case when (t1.product_pack is null or t1.product_pack='') then 'Others'
             else t1.product_pack end as product_pack,--产品包装
        case when t1.product_pack_type is null or t1.product_pack_type='' then 'Others'
             else t1.product_pack_type end product_pack_type,--产品包装分类
        case when (t1.colour_chroma is null or t1.colour_chroma='') then 'Others'
             else t1.colour_chroma end as colour_chroma,--色度
        case when (concat(t1.colour_chroma,'.',t1.main_colour_hue)='' 
                or concat(t1.colour_chroma,'.',t1.main_colour_hue) is null 
                or concat(t1.colour_chroma,'.',t1.main_colour_hue)='.')
         then 'Others' else concat(t1.colour_chroma,'.',t1.main_colour_hue) 
         end as colour_hue,--色调
        case when (t1.main_colour_hue is null or t1.main_colour_hue='') then 'Others'
             else t1.main_colour_hue end as main_colour_hue,--主色调
    		ttt.shop_id as store_code,--门店代码
    		ttt.shop_name as store_name,--门店名称
        -- t2.store_type as store_type,--门店类型
         null as store_type,--门店类型
    		cast(ttt.unit_price as decimal(28,6)) as sku_price,--sku价格/含税零售价(含税)
    		ttt.sale_num as sku_sale_num,--sku销售数量
    		cast(ttt.sale_untax_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt,--pos累计销售额(未税)
        null as order_num,--订单数量
    		pay_time as dt_date,--时间 业务时间
        ttt.bu_1 as bu_1,
        ttt.bu_2 as bu_2,
        ttt.bu_3, -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    	cast(ttt.sale_untax_amt*ttt.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt_tax, --pos累计销售额(含税)
        cast(ttt.tax_rate as decimal(28,6)) as tax_rate, -- 税率
        ttt.sales_channel,
        ttt.henkel_idh_code               
        ,ttt.base_sale_amt       as base_price_amt        --基价销额未税          
        ,ttt.base_sale_amt_tax   as base_price_amt_tax    --基价销额含税          
        ,cast(0 as bigint) as return_num                       --退货数量                       
        ,cast(0 as  decimal(28,6)) as return_amt               --退款金额未税              
        ,cast(0 as  decimal(28,6)) as return_amt_tax           --退货金额含税                
        ,cast(0 as  decimal(28,6)) as base_price_return_amt    --基价退货金额未税   
        ,cast(0 as  decimal(28,6)) as base_price_return_amt_tax--基价退货金额含税
        ,ttt.customer_code   --汉高客户编码
        ,ttt.customer_name   --汉高客户名称中文
        ,ttt.data_type
        ,ttt.platform
        ,ttt.henkel_store_category
        ,ttt.henkel_store_category_lv1
        ,ttt.henkel_store_category_lv2
        ,ttt.first_channel_name
        ,ttt.second_channel_name
        ,ttt.third_channel_name
        ,ttt.fourth_channel_name
        ,ttt.province_name --标准省份名称
        ,ttt.city_name --城市名称
        ,'${bizdate}' as ds --时间分区
    	
    from
        (      
                select
                    t0.henkel_item_barcode as henkel_item_barcode,--Henkel产品barcode
                    t0.shop_id shop_id,
                    t0.shop_name,
                    t0.pay_time pay_time,
                    count(distinct sub_order_no) as order_num,
                    t0.unit_price as unit_price,--商品单价
                    sum(t0.quantity) as sale_num,--销售数量
                    sum(t0.untax_payment_actual) as sale_untax_amt,--pos累计销售额
                    sum(t0.base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt, --pos累计基价销售额
                    t0.bu_1 bu_1,
                    t0.bu_2 bu_2,
                    t0.bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
                    ,t0.tax_rate -- 税率
                    ,t0.sales_channel
                    ,t0.customer_code 
                    ,t0.customer_name 
                    ,t0.henkel_idh_code
                    ,sum(t0.base_sale_amt_tax) as base_sale_amt_tax  --基价销额含税
                    ,t0.data_type
                    ,t0.platform
                    ,t0.henkel_store_category
                    ,t0.henkel_store_category_lv1
                    ,t0.henkel_store_category_lv2
                    ,t0.first_channel_name
                    ,t0.second_channel_name
                    ,t0.third_channel_name
                    ,t0.fourth_channel_name
                    ,t0.province_name --标准省份名称
                    ,t0.city_name --城市名称
                from(
                    select 
                        henkel_item_barcode,
                        sub_order_no,
                        shop_id,
                        shop_name,
                        retail_price_tax as unit_price,
                        quantity,
                        untax_payment_actual,
                        base_sale_amt,
                        ds as pay_time,
                        bu_1,
                        bu_2,

                ,t0.data_type

    ----ECOM-POS关联产品信息 本期

    ----ECOM 渠道主数据

    --     where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_pos')
    -- ) t2 on ttt.shop_id=t2.store_code

    --正单获取订单数量（从主订单中获取）
    union all 
    select
        null as sku_id,--单品id
        null as sku_name,--单品名称
        null as sku_name_id,--产品名称和ID
        'Others' as product_line_id,--产品线id
        'Others' as product_line_name,--产品线名称
        '0' as product_line_mark,--产品线标记
        '0' as high_product_mark,--高端化产品标记
        '0' as new_product_mark,--新品标记
        '0' as mock_up_mark,--是否小样
        'Others' as category_code,--品类代码
        'Others' as category_name,--品类名称
        'Others' as brand_code,--品牌代码
        'Others' as brand_name,--品牌名称

        'Others' as sub_product_function,--二级子品类
        'Others' as product_pack,--产品包装

        'Others' as colour_chroma,--色度
        'Others' as colour_hue,--色调

        t.shop_name as store_name,--店铺名称

        ,cast(NULL as  decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt_tax    --基价销额含税          
        ,cast(NULL as  bigint) as return_num                       --退货数量                       
        ,cast(NULL as  decimal(28,6)) as return_amt               --退款金额未税              
        ,cast(NULL as  decimal(28,6)) as return_amt_tax           --退货金额含税                
        ,cast(NULL as  decimal(28,6)) as base_price_return_amt    --基价退货金额未税

        ,t.customer_code   --汉高客户编码

                shop_name,
                 ds,
                 bu_1,

                 tax_rate,
                 sales_channel
                ,customer_code 
                ,customer_name 
                ,province_name --标准省份名称

    ) t

    -- ) t1 on t.shop_id=t1.store_code
    
    --获取退单明细
    union all 
    
    select                                                                                                                        
    		ttt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_id,--单品id                                                                        		ttt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_id,--单品id
    		nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as sku_name,--单品名称        
            concat(nvl(t1.product_name,'Others'),'-',ttt.henkel_item_barcode) as sku_name_id,--产品名称和ID
    		case when t1.product_line is null or t1.product_line='' then 'Others'                                                  
            else t1.product_line end as product_line_id,--产品线id                                                            		 
    		case when t1.product_line is null or t1.product_line='' then 'Others'                                                  
            else t1.product_line end as product_line_name,--产品线名称                                                        		 
    		case when t4.product_barcode is not null then '1' else '0' end as product_line_mark,--核心产品线标记                 
    		case when t1.premiumisation_product='1' then '1' else '0' end as high_product_mark,--高端化产品标记               	 
    		case when t1.new_product='1' then '1' else '0' end as new_product_mark,--新品标记                                    
            case when t3.product_barcode is not null then '1' else '0' end  as mock_up_mark,--是否小样 1是 0否                   
    		case when t1.category_name_en is null or t1.category_name_en='' then 'Others'                                     	 
                 else t1.category_name_en end as category_code,--品类代码                                                        
    		case when t1.category_name is null or t1.category_name='' then 'Others'                                           	 
                 else t1.category_name end as category_name,--品类名称                                                           
    		case when t1.brand_name_en is null or t1.brand_name_en='' then 'Others'                                           	 
                 else t1.brand_name_en end as brand_code,--品牌代码                                                              
    		case when t1.brand_name is null or t1.brand_name='' then 'Others'                                                 	 
                 else t1.brand_name end as brand_name,--品牌名称                                                                 
            case when (t1.product_function is null or t1.product_function='') then 'Others'                                   	 
                 else t1.product_function end as product_function,--产品功能                                                     
            case when (t1.sub_product_function is null or t1.sub_product_function='') then 'Others'                                
                 else t1.sub_product_function end as sub_product_function,--二级子品类                                             
            case when (t1.product_pack is null or t1.product_pack='') then 'Others'                                                
                 else t1.product_pack end as product_pack,--产品包装                                                               
            case when t1.product_pack_type is null or t1.product_pack_type='' then 'Others'                                       
                 else t1.product_pack_type end product_pack_type,--产品包装分类                                                
            case when (t1.colour_chroma is null or t1.colour_chroma='') then 'Others'                                          
                 else t1.colour_chroma end as colour_chroma,--色度                                                             
            case when (concat(t1.colour_chroma,'.',t1.main_colour_hue)=''

            case when (t1.main_colour_hue is null or t1.main_colour_hue='') then 'Others'

    		ttt.shop_id as store_code,--店铺代码                                                                               
    		--t2.stander_store_name as store_name,--店铺名称
            ttt.shop_name as store_name,  --店铺名称                                                           
            --t2.store_type as store_type,--店铺类型
            null as store_type,--店铺类型                                                                             
            cast(t1.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as sku_price,--含税建议零售价                                           
            cast(0 as bigint) as sku_sale_num,--sku销售数量                                                                                         
            cast(0 as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt,--pos累计销售额(未税)                                                                                
            cast(NULL as bigint) as order_num,--订单数量                                                                                               
            ttt.pay_time as dt_date,--时间                                                                                     
            ttt.bu_1,                                                                                                         
            ttt.bu_2,                                                                                                         
            ttt.bu_3, -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)                                                                          
            cast(0 as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt_tax, --pos累计销售额(含税)                                                                          
            ttt.tax_rate, -- 税率                                                                                                 
            ttt.sales_channel    -- 销售渠道 自营专区 
            ,ttt.henkel_idh_code               
            ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt         --基价销额未税         
            ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt_tax     --基价销额含税         
            ,ttt.return_num  as return_num     --退货数量                       
            ,cast(ttt.return_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt      --退款金额未税              
            ,cast(ttt.return_amt as decimal(28,6))       as return_amt_tax    --退货金额含税                
            ,cast(ttt.base_sales_amt as decimal(28,6))           as base_price_return_amt    --基价退货金额未税   
            ,cast(ttt.base_sales_amt_tax as decimal(28,6))       as base_price_return_amt_tax--基价退货金额含税
            ,ttt.customer_code   --汉高客户编码
            ,ttt.customer_name   --汉高客户名称中文    
            ,cast(null as string) as data_type
            ,ttt.platform
            ,ttt.henkel_store_category
            ,ttt.henkel_store_category_lv1
            ,ttt.henkel_store_category_lv2 
            ,ttt.first_channel_name
            ,ttt.second_channel_name
            ,ttt.third_channel_name
            ,ttt.fourth_channel_name         
            ,ttt.province_name --标准省份名称
            ,ttt.city_name --城市名称
            ,'${bizdate}' as ds --时间分区                                                                                      
    	                                                                                                                       
    from                                                                                                                       
        (                                                                                                                      
         select  henkel_product_barcode as henkel_item_barcode,--Henkel产品barcode                                             
            shop_id,
            shop_name,

            sum(return_amt) as return_amt ,--退货金额含税
            sum(item_num) as return_num ,--退货数量
            bu_1,
            bu_2,bu_3,
            sales_channel,
            henkel_idh_code,
            sum(return_amt_untax) as return_amt_untax    , -- 退货金额未税
            sum(base_sales_amt) as base_sales_amt        ,--基价退货金额未税

            customer_code ,
            customer_name 
            ,tax_rate
            ,platform
            ,henkel_store_category
            ,henkel_store_category_lv1
            ,henkel_store_category_lv2
            ,first_channel_name
            ,second_channel_name
            ,third_channel_name
            ,fourth_channel_name      
            ,t1.province_name --标准省份名称
            ,t0.city_name --城市名称

        left join (

            where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_city_province_mapping')
        ) t1
         on t0.city_name=t1.district_name
        where ds>='20200101'
        group by henkel_product_barcode,henkel_idh_code,

            shop_name,
            ds,

            sales_channel,

    left outer join (

            ${dme_ods}.s_ec_core_product_line
        where ds='${bizdate}'
        group by

--合并数据拉出宽表
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_database_tmp

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_database_tmp as
select   
    t1.fcst_date
   ,t1.years   
   ,decode(t1.month_filter,'Jan','Q1','Feb','Q1','Mar','Q1','Apr','Q2','May','Q2','Jun','Q2','Jul','Q3','Aug','Q3','Sep','Q3','Oct','Q4','Nov','Q4','Dec','Q4') as  quarter
   ,t1.month_filter        as  months
   ,cast(NULL  as  string) as  status  
   ,t1.sub_channel_lastest as  region 
   ,t1.channel_lastest     as  channel     
   ,t1.sub_channel_lastest as  sub_channel     
   ,case when t1.channel_lastest = 'NKA'  then t1.customer_idh_lastest
         else t1.channel_lastest  end   as  system_name
   ,t1.customer_idh_lastest  as  customer_idh    
   ,t1.customer_name_lastest as  customer_name
   ,t1.adj_release
   ,t1.py_release
   ,t1.ges  
   ,t1.ppd  
   ,t1.pld  
   ,t1.fg   
   ,t1.ngs  
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  others                             
   ,t1.rebate	                                                                                                                                  as  rebate                             
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  logstic                            
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  ca                                 
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  Int_agreement                      
   ,t1.rebate                                                                                                                                     as  ttl_copa                           
   ,t1.l6_b_adj                                                                                                                                   as  rebate_adj_cy                      
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  logistics_adj_cy                   
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  ca_adj_cy                          
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  int_agreement_adj_cy               
   ,t1.listing_fee                                                                                                                                as  listing_fee_cy                     
   ,t1.retailer_rebate	                                                                                                                          as  retailer_rebate_cy                 
   ,t1.int_agreement                                                                                                                              as  int_agreement_cy                   
   ,t1.oos                                                                                                                                        as  oos_cy                             
   ,t1.promotion_activists                                                                                                                        as  promotion_activists_cy             
   ,t1.ka_expense                                                                                                                                 as  ka_expense_cy                      
   ,t1.logistic_fee                                                                                                                               as  logistics_cy                       
   ,t1.ca                                                                                                                                         as  ca_cy                              
   ,(t1.l6_b_adj+t1.listing_fee+t1.retailer_rebate+t1.int_agreement+t1.oos+t1.promotion_activists+t1.ka_expense+t1.logistic_fee+t1.ca)	          as  ttl_cy                             
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  listing_fee_py                     
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  retailer_rebate_py                 
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  int_agreement_py                   
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  oos_py                             
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  promotion_activists_py             
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  ka_expense_py                      
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  rebate_py                          
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  logstic_py                         
   ,cast(0	as  decimal(38,10))                                                                                                                   as  ca_py

--- DP报表数据SKU明细
-- Top产品季度更新，每季度第一个月更新当季度三个月的Top产品
-- 以2023年Q2为例，2023年4-6月的Top35产品计算方式为：
-- Step1. Demand_Demonstration_Rawdata取period_month为202304的记录，根据产品编码IDH剔除FCA Exclusive list表中的所有产品
-- Step2. 将Sum_of_last_6month_Historical_Sales、Sum_of_next_5month_Manual_Forecast等12个字段之和作为销售数量，P24_EAN与产品主数据的产品条码Barcode匹配，取IDH最大的产品的基价作为该条码产品的基价，计算销售数量*基价作为近12个月的产品基价销额
-- Step3. 取近12个月基价销额最大的35个Barcode作为Top35产品
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_historical_fca_top_sku partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
    t.quarter   as   period     
   ,nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others')  as  category_name_en     
   ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others')  as   brand              
   ,t.barcode as product_barcode        
   ,nvl(t2.product_name_en,'Others')  as  product_name_en        
   ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others')  as  product_name_cn        
   ,max(nvl(t1.product_base_price,0))  as  product_base_price
   ,nvl(sum(t1.history_sales_6_month + t1.forecast_sales_6_month) * max(nvl(t1.product_base_price,0)),0)  as  r12m_sales
   ,nvl(sum(t1.history_sales_6_month),0)    as  history_sales_6_month
   ,nvl(sum(t1.forecast_sales_6_month),0)    as  forecast_sales_6_month
   ,rank() over(partition by t.quarter,t.bu_2 order by nvl(sum(t1.history_sales_6_month + t1.forecast_sales_6_month),0) * max(nvl(t1.product_base_price,0)) desc) as  rn
   ,nvl(t1.p05_umbrella_brand,'Others')  as  p05_umbrella_brand
   ,t.bu_1
   ,t.bu_2
   ,t.channel  as  channel
from 
(
    select  distinct
            channel
           ,barcode 
           ,bu_1
           ,bu_2
           ,quarter
           ,product_code
    from (
       select 
           channel
          ,barcode 
          ,product_idh  as  product_code
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
          ,concat(substr(period,1,4),DECODE(substr(period,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))   as   quarter
       from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_historical_fca
       where ds = '${bizdate}'
       
       union all 
       
       select 
           customer_channel as channel
          ,product_barcode as barcode 
          ,product_code
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
          ,concat(substr( period_month,1,4),DECODE(substr( period_month,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))    as    quarter      
       from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data
       where ds = '${bizdate}'
   )a
)t

left join  (
    select
         concat(substr(t1.period_month,1,4),DECODE(substr(t1.period_month,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))    as    quarter      
        ,t1.period_month           
        ,sales_channel_type     
        ,brand              
        ,product_barcode        
        ,product_code           
        ,product_name_en        
        ,product_name_cn        
        ,customer_channel  
        ,product_base_price    
        ,(cast(nvl(last_6month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(last_5month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(last_4month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(last_3month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(last_2month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10)) 
          +cast(nvl(last_1month_sales,0)      as decimal(38,10)))    as    history_sales_6_month    
        ,(cast(nvl(current_month_forecast,0) as decimal(38,10)) 
          +cast(nvl(next_1month_forecast,0)   as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(next_2month_forecast,0)   as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(next_3month_forecast,0)   as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(next_4month_forecast,0)   as decimal(38,10))  
          +cast(nvl(next_5month_forecast,0)   as decimal(38,10)))     as    forecast_sales_6_month 
        ,p05_umbrella_brand
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data t1
    inner join(
         select
            concat(substr(period_month,1,4),DECODE(substr(period_month,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))    as    quarter      
           ,min(period_month)  as period_month
         from
             ${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data 
         where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data')
         group by concat(substr(period_month,1,4),DECODE(substr(period_month,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))
     ) t3
     on t1.period_month = t3.period_month
    and concat(substr(t1.period_month,1,4),DECODE(substr(t1.period_month,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4')) = t3.quarter
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_demand_demonstration_data')
)t1
on  t.barcode = t1.product_barcode 
and t.bu_2 = t1.bu_2    
and t.quarter = t1.quarter 
and t.product_code = t1.product_code 
left join(
    select
     distinct
       product_name
      ,product_name_en
      ,product_base_price
      ,product_barcode   
      ,category_name     
      ,category_name_en  
      ,brand_name        
      ,brand_name_en     
      ,bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
) t2
on t.barcode = t2.product_barcode
left join 
(
    select     
         product_idh 
        ,exclude         
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by product_idh order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
    from dme_ods.s_fca_exclusive_list 
    where ds = max_pt('dme_ods.s_fca_exclusive_list')
      and exclude = 'Y'
)t4
on t.product_code = t4.product_idh
and t4.rn = 1
where t4.product_idh is null 
group by t.quarter           
   ,nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others') 
   ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others')  
   ,t.barcode        
   ,nvl(t2.product_name_en,'Others')   
   ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others') 
   ,nvl(t1.p05_umbrella_brand,'Others') 
   ,t.bu_1
   ,t.bu_2
   ,t.channel

insert
  overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_mapping_time partition (ds = '${bizdate}') --年
select
  substr('${bizdate}', 1, 4) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
  substr('${bizdate}', 1, 6) as time_now,--当前月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
  'A.年' as type,
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-2,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as time_mon,
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-2,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as time_moy,
  '1' as time_type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月/4周
union all
--季
select
  --时间映射查询年/季度/月/周
  concat(substr('${bizdate}', 1, 4),'Q',quarter(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'))) as mapping_time,
  substr('${bizdate}', 1, 6) as time_now,--当前月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -3, 'mm'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
  'B.季' as type, --周期类型1年/2季度/3月/4周
  to_char(dateadd(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),-3,'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_mon,
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -6, 'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_moy,
  '2' as time_type
union all
  --月
select
  substr('${bizdate}', 1, 6) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
  substr('${bizdate}', 1, 6) as time_now,--当前月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -12, 'mm'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -1, 'mm'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
  'C.月' as type,
  to_char(dateadd(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_mon,
  to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -2, 'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_moy,
  '3' as time_type --周期类 型1年/2季度/3月/4周
union all
  --周
select
  case when substring('${bizdate}', 5, 2) = 12 and WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 
       then concat(substring(DATEADD(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),+ 1,'yyyy'),1,4),'-0',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')))
       when substring('${bizdate}', 5, 2) = 1 and WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) > 20 
       then concat(substring(DATEADD(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),1,4),'-',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')))
       else (case when weekofyear(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 
                  then concat(substring('${bizdate}', 1, 4),'-0',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')))
                  else concat(substring('${bizdate}', 1, 4),'-',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')))

       ,ka_code      -- ka编码
       ,ka_name      -- ka名称
       ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
    from sku_stock_temp

) a 
left join product_amount_type_temp b  
on a.bu_1=b.bu_1
group by 
    a.bu_1,
    a.bu_2,
    a.category_name,
    a.first_product_function,
    a.second_product_function,
    a.brand_name,

    a.province_name,
    a.supply_type,
    a.mapping_supply_type,
    a.product_cateory_desc,    
    a.supply_type_channel,

    case when a.product_cateory_desc='正装' then '正品'
        when a.product_cateory_desc='小样' then '赠品'
    else a.product_cateory_desc end,
    a.distributor_type,

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_sale_ws_bu_temp_0

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_sale_ws_bu_temp_0 AS
SELECT  t.customer_code
        ,t.customer_name
        ,t.product_barcode
        ,t.product_name
        ,t.sku_barcode_name
        ,t.product_line_id
        ,t.product_line_name
        ,t.category_code
        ,t.category_name
        ,t.brand_code
        ,t.brand_name
        ,t.first_product_function
        ,t.second_product_function
        ,t.product_pack
        ,t.product_pack_type
        ,t.colour_hue
        ,t.henkel_store_code
        ,t.henkel_store_name
        ,t.bu_1
        ,t.bu_2
        ,t.bu_3
        ,t.first_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.first_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.second_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_id_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,city_name
        ,'1' AS time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,t1.months -- 月份
        ,t.store_category  
        ,t.store_category_lv1 
        ,t.store_category_lv2
        ,t.cooperation_status
        ,t.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,t.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.is_expired_customer  -- Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
FROM    (
            SELECT  dist_code AS customer_code
                    ,dist_name AS customer_name
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,product_name
                    ,product_barcode_name AS sku_barcode_name
                    ,product_line_en AS product_line_id
                    ,product_line AS product_line_name
                    ,category_name_en AS category_code
                    ,category_name
                    ,brand_name_en AS brand_code
                    ,brand_name
                    ,product_function AS first_product_function
                    ,sub_product_function AS second_product_function
                    ,product_pack
                    ,product_pack_type
                    ,colour_hue
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,bu_3
                    ,first_channel_id_lastest
                    ,first_channel_name_lastest
                    ,second_channel_id_lastest
                    ,second_channel_name_lastest
                    ,third_channel_id_lastest
                    ,third_channel_name_lastest
                    ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
                    ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
                    ,city_name
                    ,'1' AS flag
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,store_name as henkel_store_name
                    ,store_category  
                    ,store_category_lv1 
                    ,store_category_lv2
                    ,cooperation_status
                    ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
                    ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
                    ,is_expired_customer
                    ,ka_code      -- ka编码
                    ,ka_name      -- ka名称
                    ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
            WHERE   ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            --and first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('MPD')
            and first_channel_name_lastest IN ('MPD')
            GROUP BY dist_code
                     ,dist_name 
                     ,product_barcode
                     ,product_name
                     ,product_barcode_name
                     ,product_line_en
                     ,product_line
                     ,category_name_en
                     ,category_name
                     ,brand_name_en
                     ,brand_name
                     ,product_function
                     ,sub_product_function
                     ,product_pack
                     ,product_pack_type
                     ,colour_hue
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
                     ,bu_3
                     ,first_channel_id_lastest
                     ,first_channel_name_lastest
                     ,second_channel_id_lastest
                     ,second_channel_name_lastest
                     ,third_channel_id_lastest
                     ,third_channel_name_lastest
                     ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
                     ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
                     ,city_name
                     ,henkel_store_code
                     ,store_name
                     ,store_category  
                     ,store_category_lv1 
                     ,store_category_lv2
                     ,cooperation_status
                     ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
                     ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
                     ,is_expired_customer
                     ,ka_code      -- ka编码
                     ,ka_name      -- ka名称
                     ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
        ) t
INNER JOIN  (
                SELECT  month_id AS months
                        ,'1' AS flag
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                WHERE   month_id >= '202001'
                AND     month_id <= SUBSTR('${bizdate}',1,6)
                GROUP BY month_id
            ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_ws_bu_monthly_temp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_ws_bu_monthly_temp AS
SELECT  customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name
        ,brand_code
        ,brand_name
        ,first_product_function
        ,second_product_function
        ,product_pack
        ,product_pack_type
        ,colour_hue
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,henkel_store_name
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_3
        ,first_channel_id_lastest
        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_id_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_id_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,'1' AS time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,months -- 月份
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sale_num,0)) AS sale_num -- 当月销量       
        ,SUM(NVL(t.base_sale_amt,0)) AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额       
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sale_num,0)) AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sale_num,0)) AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
        ,store_category  
        ,store_category_lv1 
        ,store_category_lv2
        ,sum(NVL(base_sale_amt_tax,0)) as base_sale_amt_tax
        ,sum(NVL(3m_base_sale_amt_tax,0)) as 3m_base_sale_amt_tax
        ,sum(NVL(12m_base_sale_amt_tax,0)) as 12m_base_sale_amt_tax
        ,cooperation_status
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sales_amt_act,0)) AS sales_amt_act     -- 当月实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 3m_sales_amt_act -- 近3个月月均实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 12m_sales_amt_act -- 近12个月月均实际销额
        ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,is_expired_customer
        ,ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
        ,city_name
FROM    (
            -- 获取当月数据
            SELECT  t1.*
                    ,t2.sales_num AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额
                    ,t2.base_price_amt*1.13 as base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt as  sales_amt_act        
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act         
            FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_sale_ws_bu_temp_0 t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.months,'') = COALESCE(t2.dt_month,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.cooperation_status,'') = COALESCE(t2.cooperation_status,'') 
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_name     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name,'')
            and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            -- and t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('MPD')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('MPD')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近3月数据
            SELECT  t1.*     
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额  
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt_tax 
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act           
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额
                    ,t2.base_price_amt*1.13 AS 3m_base_sale_amt_tax 
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 3m_sales_amt_act   
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act
            FROM  ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_sale_ws_bu_temp_0 t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t1.months,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(t2.dt_month,'yyyymm'),'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 2
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.cooperation_status,'') = COALESCE(t2.cooperation_status,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_name     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name,'')
            and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            -- and t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('MPD')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('MPD')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近12月数据
            SELECT  t1.*    
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act              
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act      
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
                    ,t2.base_price_amt*1.13 AS 12m_base_sale_amt_tax
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 12m_sales_amt_act
            FROM  ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_sale_ws_bu_temp_0 t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.cooperation_status,'') = COALESCE(t2.cooperation_status,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.ka_name     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name     ,'')
            and     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name,'')
            AND     DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t1.months,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(t2.dt_month,'yyyymm'),'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 11
            and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            -- and t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('MPD')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('MPD')
        ) t
GROUP BY customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,product_barcode

        ,product_line_id

   tt.product_line_id,         --产品线id

   tt.category_code,         --品类代码
   tt.category_name,         --品类名称
   tt.brand_code,         --品牌代码
   tt.brand_name,         --品牌名称
   tt.first_product_function,         --产品功能一级
   tt.second_product_function,         --产品功能二级
   tt.product_pack,         --产品包装
   tt.product_pack_type,         --产品包装分类
   tt.colour_hue,--色调
   tt.first_channel_id_lastest as first_channel_id,         --一级渠道id
   tt.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name,         --一级渠道名称
   tt.second_channel_id_lastest as second_channel_id,         --二级渠道id
   tt.second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name,         --二级渠道名称
   tt.third_channel_id_lastest as third_channel_id,
   tt.third_channel_name_lastest as third_channel_name,
   tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest as fourth_channel_id,
   tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name,
   tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest as dist_code,         --客户编码
   tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest as dist_name,         --客户名称
   tt.third_channel_id_lastest as province_id,   --省份id
   tt.third_channel_name_lastest as province_name, --省份名称
   tt.city_name as city_id,
   tt.city_name as city_name,
   tt.second_channel_id_lastest as henkel_region_id,         --汉高大区id
   tt.second_channel_name_lastest as henkel_region_name,         --汉高大区名称
   cast(sum(tt.sale_num     ) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_num,         --销量
   cast(sum(tt.base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt,--销额
   --如果该sku在此经销商销售不足三个月，则按实际月份平均，近12个月月均同理
   cast(sum(tt.3m_sale_num      ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_num,   --近3个月月均销量
   cast(sum(tt.3m_base_sale_amt ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_amt,   --近3个月月均销额
   cast(sum(tt.12m_sale_num     ) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_num,  --近12个月月均销量
   cast(sum(tt.12m_base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_amt,  --近12个月月均销额
   tt.months as dt_date,    -- 月
   tt.time_type,  -- 1 月，2 周
   tt.bu_1, 
   tt.bu_2,
   tt.bu_3,    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   -- 为空的以及和门店主数据匹配不到的，转换为Others
   tt.store_category    ,
   tt.store_category_lv1,
   tt.store_category_lv2,
   cast(sum(tt.base_sale_amt_tax    ) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt_tax,
   cast(sum(tt.3m_base_sale_amt_tax ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_amt_tax,   --近3个月月均销额
   cast(sum(tt.12m_base_sale_amt_tax) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_amt_tax,  --近12个月月均销额
   cooperation_status,
   cast(sum(tt.sales_amt_act    ) as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_amt_act,-- 实价销额
   cast(sum(tt.3m_sales_amt_act ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sales_amt_act,
   cast(sum(tt.12m_sales_amt_act) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sales_amt_act
   ,tt.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,tt.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   ,tt.is_expired_customer
   ,tt.ka_code      -- ka编码
   ,tt.ka_name      -- ka名称
   ,tt.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
   ,min(t4.min_date_3m ) as so_min_date_3m  -- 近3个月最早so日期
   ,min(t4.min_date_12m) as so_min_date_12m -- 近12个月最早so日期
   ,max(t4.max_date) as so_max_date -- 最近so日期
   ,max(cast(case when t4.diff_month_cnt_3>3 then 3 else t4.diff_month_cnt_3 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
   ,max(cast(case when t4.diff_month_cnt_12>12 then 12 else t4.diff_month_cnt_12 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
   ,'${bizdate}' AS ds 
   ,'1' as dt_type
 FROM (
   SELECT *
   FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_ws_bu_monthly_temp a
   --WHERE (nvl(a.sale_num,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.3m_sale_num,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.12m_sale_num,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.sales_amt_act,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.3m_sales_amt_act,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.12m_sales_amt_act,0) <> 0 )
 ) tt
 --找出sku所属经销商最早的购买日期，及距今天数，用于判断及计算库存周转周期
 LEFT OUTER JOIN (
   SELECT
     a.product_barcode
     ,a.dist_code
     ,a.henkel_store_code
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_3m
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_12m
     ,least(a.max_date,b.months) as max_date
     ,b.months
     --,(datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     --,(datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
   FROM (
    SELECT 
      product_barcode
      ,dist_code
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,min(dt_month) AS min_date
      ,max(dt_month) AS max_date
      ,'1' AS flag
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
    WHERE ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
    and first_channel_name_lastest IN ('MPD')
    and to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd') <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY product_barcode ,dist_code ,henkel_store_code
   ) a
   INNER JOIN (
      SELECT 
        month_id AS months
        ,'1' AS flag
      FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
      WHERE month_id >= '202001'
      AND month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
      GROUP BY month_id
    ) b
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   WHERE (datediff(TO_DATE(b.months, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymm'), 'mm')+1) >= 0
 ) t4
  ON nvl(tt.customer_code    ,'') = nvl(t4.dist_code        ,'')
 AND nvl(tt.product_barcode  ,'') = nvl(t4.product_barcode  ,'')
 AND nvl(tt.henkel_store_code,'') = nvl(t4.henkel_store_code,'')
 and nvl(tt.months           ,'') = nvl(t4.months           ,'')
group by 
   tt.product_barcode ,   --单品barcode
   tt.product_name ,         --单品名称
   tt.sku_barcode_name, --单品barcode+名称
   tt.product_line_id,         --产品线id
   tt.product_line_name,         --产品线名称
   tt.category_code,         --品类代码
   tt.category_name,         --品类名称
   tt.brand_code,         --品牌代码
   tt.brand_name,         --品牌名称
   tt.first_product_function,         --产品功能一级
   tt.second_product_function,         --产品功能二级
   tt.product_pack,         --产品包装
   tt.product_pack_type,         --产品包装分类
   tt.colour_hue,--色调
   tt.first_channel_id_lastest ,         --一级渠道id
   tt.first_channel_name_lastest ,         --一级渠道名称
   tt.second_channel_id_lastest  ,         --二级渠道id
   tt.second_channel_name_lastest,         --二级渠道名称
   tt.third_channel_id_lastest   ,
   tt.third_channel_name_lastest ,
   tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest  ,
   tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest,
   tt.city_name ,
   tt.city_name ,
   tt.months,    -- 月
   tt.time_type,  -- 1 月，2 周
   tt.bu_1, 
   tt.bu_2,
   tt.bu_3,    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   -- 为空的以及和门店主数据匹配不到的，转换为Others
   tt.store_category    ,
   tt.store_category_lv1,
   tt.store_category_lv2,
   cooperation_status
   ,tt.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,tt.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   ,tt.is_expired_customer
   ,tt.ka_code      -- ka编码
   ,tt.ka_name      -- ka名称
   ,tt.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型

insert  overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_distributor_stock_ws_bu partition(ds)
select  tt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_barcode , --单品id
        tt.product_name as sku_name , --单品名称
        concat(tt.product_name ,'-' ,tt.henkel_item_barcode) as sku_barcode_name , --单品barcode+名称
        tt.product_line as product_line_id , --产品线id
        tt.product_line as product_line_name , --产品线名称
        tt.category_name_en as category_code , --品类代码
        tt.category_name as category_name , --品类名称
        tt.brand_name_en as brand_code , --品牌代码
        tt.brand_name as brand_name , --品牌名称
        tt.product_function as first_product_function , --产品功能一级
        tt.sub_product_function as second_product_function , --产品功能二级
        if(tt.bu_2='Laundry',null,tt.product_pack)as product_pack,       --产品包装
        tt.product_pack_type as product_pack_type , --产品包装分类
        case when (concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)=''
            or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue) is null
            or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)='.')
            and tt.bu_2<>'Laundry'
       then 'Others' else concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)  end as colour_hue ,                  --色调
        tt.first_channel_id_lastest as first_channel_id , --一级渠道id
        tt.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name , --一级渠道名称
        tt.second_channel_id_lastest as second_channel_id , --二级渠道id
        tt.second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name , --二级渠道名称
        tt.third_channel_id_lastest as third_channel_id , --三级渠道id
        tt.third_channel_name_lastest as third_channel_name , --三级渠道名称
        tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest as fourth_channel_id , --四级渠道id
        tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name , --四级渠道名称
        nvl(tt.dist_code ,'Others') as dist_code , --经销商编码
        nvl(tt.customer_name ,'Others') as dist_name , --经销商名称
        nvl(tt.province_name_lastest ,'Others') as province_id , --省份id
        nvl(tt.province_name_lastest ,'Others') as province_name , --省份名称
        tt.city_name as city_id , --城市id
        tt.city_name as city_name , --城市名称
        nvl(tt.henkel_region_name_lastest ,'Others') as henkel_region_id , --汉高大区id
        nvl(tt.henkel_region_name_lastest ,'Others') as henkel_region_name , --汉高大区名称
        tt.stock_type as stock_type , --仓库类型
        cast(tt.stock_num as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_num , --库存数量
        cast(tt.base_stock_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_amt , --基价库存金额
        tt.base_price , --产品基价
        tt.dt_date as dt_date , --时间
        tt.dt_type as time_type , --时间类型
        tt.bu_1,
        tt.bu_2,
        tt.bu_3,
        cast(NULL  as  string)  as store_category,
        cast(NULL  as  string)  as store_category_lv1,
        cast(NULL  as  string)  as store_category_lv2,
        cast(tt.base_stock_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_amt_tax,
        tt.cooperation_status,
        tt.channel_customer_permission,      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        tt.region_customer_permission, -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        tt.is_expired_customer, -- Others/合作中/已关闭
        '${bizdate}' as ds --时间分区
from   (
     --月数据
    select  a.dist_code
            ,a.org_name
            ,a.stock_type
            ,a.prod_barcode as henkel_item_barcode
            ,a.prod_code
            ,a.stock_num
            ,a.dist_type
            ,a.stock_amt as base_stock_amt
            ,a.dt_date as dt_date
            ,'1' as dt_type
            ,a.base_price
            ,a.bu_1
            ,a.bu_2
            ,a.bu_3
            ,a.sub_product_function
            ,a.brand_name
            ,a.brand_name_en
            ,a.product_function
            ,a.product_name
            ,a.product_line
            ,a.category_name
            ,a.category_name_en
            ,a.product_pack
            ,a.product_pack_type
            ,a.colour_chroma
            ,a.main_colour_hue
            ,a.customer_name
            ,a.province_name_lastest
            ,a.henkel_region_name_lastest
            ,a.first_channel_id_lastest
            ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
            ,a.second_channel_id_lastest
            ,a.second_channel_name_lastest
            ,a.third_channel_id_lastest
            ,a.third_channel_name_lastest
            ,a.fourth_channel_id_lastest
            ,a.fourth_channel_name_lastest
            ,a.city_name
            ,a.cooperation_status
            ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
            ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
            ,a.is_expired_customer  -- Others/合作中/已关闭
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid a
    where a.ds=MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid')
    and (upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('MPD')) AND a.date_type = '月'
) tt

        ,t.product_line_name

        ,t.second_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.third_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.third_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.city_name
        ,t.province_name
        ,t.region_name
        ,t1.time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,t1.dt_date        -- 月/周
        ,t1.min_day_id
        ,t.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,t.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.store_category       -- 门店分类

        ,t.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级

        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型

            SELECT  dist_code AS customer_code
                    ,dist_name as customer_name
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,product_name
                    ,product_barcode_name AS sku_barcode_name
                    ,product_line_en AS product_line_id

                    ,brand_name

                    ,bu_3

                    ,first_channel_name_lastest
                    ,second_channel_id_lastest
                    ,second_channel_name_lastest
                    ,third_channel_id_lastest
                    ,third_channel_name_lastest
                    ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
                    ,fourth_channel_name_lastest

                    ,province_name
                    ,region_name

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.dt_sellout_data_tmp AS
SELECT  customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name

        ,second_product_function

        ,colour_hue

        ,customer_channel

        ,province_name
        ,region_name

        ,store_lv
        ,store_type_level1
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_3

        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,t.dt_date        -- 月/周
        ,t.min_day_id
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sale_num,0)) AS sale_num -- 当月销量       
        ,SUM(NVL(t.base_sale_amt,0)) AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sales_amt_act,0)) AS sales_amt_act     -- 当月实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sale_num,0)) AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 3m_sales_amt_act -- 近3个月月均实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sale_num,0)) AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 12m_sales_amt_act -- 近12个月月均实际销额
        ,t.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,t.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,t.store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,t.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,t.is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
FROM    (
            -- 获取当前时间数据
            SELECT  t1.*
                    ,t2.sales_num AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt as  sales_amt_act            
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额  
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act       
            FROM ${dme_ads}.dt_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND if(t1.time_type='1',t1.dt_date = t2.dt_month,t1.dt_date = t2.dt_week)
            AND     t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
            --AND     t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA')
            AND     t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others') 
            UNION ALL -- 获取近3月数据
            SELECT  t1.*     
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额   
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act   
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额    
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act 
            FROM ${dme_ads}.dt_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND if(t1.time_type='1',datediff(TO_DATE(t1.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(t2.dt_month, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 2
            ,datediff(to_date(t1.min_day_id,'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t2.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),'dd') between 0 and 89)
            AND     t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
            --AND     t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA')
            AND     t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近12月数据
            SELECT  t1.*    
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额    
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act           
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act      
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 12m_sales_amt_act
            FROM ${dme_ads}.dt_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND if(t1.time_type='1',datediff(TO_DATE(t1.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(t2.dt_month, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 11
            ,datediff(to_date(t1.min_day_id,'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t2.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),'dd') between 0 and 364)
            AND     t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
            --AND     t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA')
            AND     t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others')
        ) t
GROUP BY customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name
        ,brand_code
        ,brand_name
        ,first_product_function

        ,product_pack
        ,product_pack_type
        ,colour_hue
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,henkel_store_name
        ,customer_channel
        ,customer_nature
        ,supply_type
        ,supply_type_name
        ,distributor_type
        ,city_name
        ,province_name
        ,region_name
        ,store_type_seg
        ,store_lv
        ,store_type_level1
        ,bu_1

        ,bu_3
        ,first_channel_id_lastest
        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_id_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_id_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,dt_date        -- 月/周
        ,min_day_id
        ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,t.store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,t.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,t.is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型

   cast(sum(tt.3m_sale_num     ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_num,   --近3个月月均销量
   cast(sum(tt.3m_base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_amt,   --近3个月月均销额

   cast(sum(tt.12m_base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_amt, --近12个月月均销额

   ,tt.ka_code      -- ka编码
