   ,tt.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
   ,min(t4.min_date_3m ) as so_min_date_3m  -- 近3个月最早so日期
   ,min(t4.min_date_12m) as so_min_date_12m -- 近12个月最早so日期
   ,max(t4.max_date) as so_max_date -- 最近so日期
   ,max(cast(case when nvl(t4.diff_month_cnt_3,0)>3 then 3 else t4.diff_month_cnt_3 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
   ,max(cast(case when nvl(t4.diff_month_cnt_12,0)>12 then 12 else t4.diff_month_cnt_12 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
   ,'${bizdate}' AS ds 
   ,tt.time_type as dt_type
 FROM (
 	 SELECT *
 	 FROM ${dme_ads}.dt_sellout_data_tmp a
 	 --WHERE (a.sale_num <> 0 OR a.3m_sale_num <> 0 OR a.12m_sale_num <> 0 
   --   or a.sales_amt_act<>0 or a.3m_sales_amt_act<>0 or a.12m_sales_amt_act<>0
   --   )
 ) tt
 --找出sku所属经销商最早的购买日期，及距今天数，用于判断及计算库存周转周期
 LEFT OUTER JOIN (
     --月
   SELECT
     a.product_barcode
     ,a.dist_code
     ,a.henkel_store_code
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_3m
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_12m
     ,least(a.max_date,b.months) as max_date
     ,b.months  as  dt_date
    --,(datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
    --,(datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
     ,'1' as time_type
   FROM (
    SELECT 
      product_barcode
      ,dist_code
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,min(nvl(substr(dt_date,1,6), dt_month)) AS min_date
      ,max(nvl(substr(dt_date,1,6), dt_month)) AS max_date
      ,'1' AS flag
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
    WHERE ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
        --AND first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA')
        AND first_channel_name_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others')
    and to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd') <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY product_barcode, dist_code,henkel_store_code
   ) a
   INNER JOIN (
      SELECT 
        month_id AS months
        ,'1' AS flag
      --   ,max(day_id) AS day_id
      FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
      WHERE month_id >= '202001'
      AND month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
      GROUP BY month_id
    ) b
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   WHERE (DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(b.months,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) > 0
--周
    union all 

    SELECT
     a.product_barcode
     ,a.dist_code
     ,a.henkel_store_code
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 90 -- 近90天有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_3m
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 365 -- 近365天有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_12m
     ,least(a.max_date,b.day_id) as max_date
     ,b.dt_date
     --,(datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30 as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     --,(datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30 as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差   
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 90 -- 近90天有销售
        then (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30
        end as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 365 -- 近365天有销售
        then (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30
        end as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差        
     ,'2' as time_type
   FROM (
    SELECT 
      product_barcode
      ,dist_code
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,min(nvl(dt_date,to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd'))) AS min_date
      ,max(nvl(dt_date,to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd'))) AS max_date
      ,'1' AS flag
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
    WHERE ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
        --and   first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA')
        AND     first_channel_name_lastest IN ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others')
    and to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd') <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY product_barcode, dist_code,henkel_store_code
   ) a
   INNER JOIN (
      SELECT 
        week_id AS dt_date
        ,'1' AS flag
        ,max(day_id) AS day_id
      FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
      WHERE day_id >= '${uddate1}' --[yyyymmdd-90]
        and day_id <= '${bizdate}'
      GROUP BY week_id
    ) b
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   WHERE (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) > 0
 ) t4
  ON nvl(tt.customer_code    ,'') = nvl(t4.dist_code        ,'')
 AND nvl(tt.product_barcode  ,'') = nvl(t4.product_barcode  ,'')
 AND nvl(tt.henkel_store_code,'') = nvl(t4.henkel_store_code,'')
 AND nvl(tt.time_type        ,'') = nvl(t4.time_type        ,'')
 and nvl(tt.dt_date          ,'') = nvl(t4.dt_date          ,'')
 group by 
   tt.product_barcode,   --单品barcode
   tt.product_name  ,         --单品名称
   tt.sku_barcode_name, --单品barcode+名称
   tt.product_line_id,         --产品线id
   tt.product_line_name,         --产品线名称
   tt.category_code,         --品类代码
   tt.category_name,         --品类名称
   tt.brand_code,         --品牌代码
   tt.brand_name,         --品牌名称
   tt.first_product_function,         --产品功能一级
   tt.second_product_function,         --产品功能二级
   tt.product_pack,         --产品包装
   tt.product_pack_type,         --产品包装分类
   tt.colour_hue,--色调
   tt.first_channel_id_lastest   ,         --一级渠道id
   tt.first_channel_name_lastest ,         --一级渠道名称
   tt.second_channel_id_lastest  ,         --二级渠道id
   tt.second_channel_name_lastest,         --二级渠道名称
   tt.third_channel_id_lastest   ,
   tt.third_channel_name_lastest ,
   tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest  ,
   tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest,
   tt.customer_code ,         --客户编码
   tt.customer_name ,         --客户名称
   tt.province_name ,   --省份id
   tt.province_name , --省份名称
   tt.city_name ,
   tt.city_name ,
   tt.region_name ,         --汉高大区id
   tt.region_name ,         --汉高大区名称
   tt.henkel_store_code, --门店编码
   tt.henkel_store_name,  --门店名称
   tt.customer_channel,  --客户渠道
   tt.customer_nature,  --客户性质
   tt.supply_type, --直/间供类型id
   tt.supply_type_name,  --直/间供类型名称
   case when tt.time_type ='2' then concat(substr(tt.dt_date,1,4),'-',substr(tt.dt_date,5,2))
   else tt.dt_date end , -- 日期
   tt.time_type,  -- 1 月，2 周
   tt.bu_1, 
   tt.bu_2,
   tt.distributor_type, -- 经销商类型
   tt.store_type_seg, --收货方类型
   tt.store_lv, --门店等级
   store_type_level1, --  收货方类型leve1,
   tt.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   ,tt.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,tt.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   ,tt.store_category       -- 门店分类
   ,tt.store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
   ,tt.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
   ,tt.is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
   ,tt.ka_code      -- ka编码

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_dim_tmp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_dim_tmp AS
SELECT  t.customer_code
        ,t.customer_name
        ,t.product_barcode
        ,t.product_name
        ,t.sku_barcode_name
        ,t.product_line_id
        ,t.product_line_name
        ,t.category_code
        ,t.category_name
        ,t.brand_code
        ,t.brand_name
        ,t.first_product_function
        ,t.second_product_function
        ,t.product_pack
        ,t.product_pack_type
        ,t.colour_hue
        ,t.bu_1
        ,t.bu_2
        ,t.bu_3
        ,t.first_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.first_channel_name_lastest
        ,t.second_channel_id_lastest
        ,t.second_channel_name_lastest
        ,'1' AS time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,t1.months -- 月份
        ,t.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,t.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.henkel_store_code
        ,t.henkel_store_name
        ,t.store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,t.store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,t.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,t.is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
        ,t.city_name
FROM    (
            SELECT  dist_code AS customer_code
                    ,dist_name AS customer_name
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,product_name
                    ,product_barcode_name AS sku_barcode_name
                    ,product_line_en AS product_line_id
                    ,product_line AS product_line_name
                    ,category_name_en AS category_code
                    ,category_name
                    ,brand_name_en AS brand_code
                    ,brand_name
                    ,product_function AS first_product_function
                    ,sub_product_function AS second_product_function
                    ,product_pack
                    ,product_pack_type
                    ,colour_hue
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,bu_3
                    ,first_channel_id_lastest
                    ,first_channel_name_lastest
                    ,second_channel_id_lastest
                    ,second_channel_name_lastest
                    ,'1' AS flag
                    ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
                    ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,store_name as henkel_store_name
                    ,store_category       -- 门店分类
                    ,store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
                    ,store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
                    ,is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
                    ,ka_code      -- ka编码
                    ,ka_name      -- ka名称
                    ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
                    ,city_name
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
            WHERE ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            --and  first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('Ecom')
            and first_channel_name_lastest IN ('Ecom')
            GROUP BY dist_code
                     ,dist_name
                     ,product_barcode
                     ,product_name
                     ,product_barcode_name
                     ,product_line_en
                     ,product_line
                     ,category_name_en
                     ,category_name
                     ,brand_name_en
                     ,brand_name
                     ,product_function
                     ,sub_product_function
                     ,product_pack
                     ,product_pack_type
                     ,colour_hue
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
                     ,bu_3
                     ,first_channel_id_lastest
                     ,first_channel_name_lastest
                     ,second_channel_id_lastest
                     ,second_channel_name_lastest
                     ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
                     ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,store_category       -- 门店分类
                    ,store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
                    ,store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
                    ,is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
                    ,ka_code      -- ka编码
                    ,ka_name      -- ka名称
                    ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
                    ,city_name
        ) t
INNER JOIN  (
                SELECT  month_id AS months
                        ,'1' AS flag
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                WHERE   month_id >= '202001'
                AND     month_id <= SUBSTR('${bizdate}',1,6)
                GROUP BY month_id
            ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag

-- 获取当月、近三月、近12月数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_data_tmp

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_data_tmp AS
SELECT  customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name
        ,brand_code
        ,brand_name
        ,first_product_function
        ,second_product_function
        ,product_pack
        ,product_pack_type
        ,colour_hue
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_3
        ,first_channel_id_lastest
        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_id_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,'1' AS time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,months -- 月份
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sale_num,0)) AS sale_num -- 当月销量       
        ,SUM(NVL(t.base_sale_amt,0)) AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sales_amt_act,0)) AS sales_amt_act     -- 当月实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sale_num,0)) AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 3m_sales_amt_act -- 近3个月月均实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sale_num,0)) AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 12m_sales_amt_act -- 近12个月月均实际销额
        ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,t.henkel_store_code
        ,t.henkel_store_name
        ,t.store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,t.store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,t.store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,t.is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,t.ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,t.ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,t.KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
        ,t.city_name
FROM    (
            -- 获取当月数据
            SELECT  t1.*
                    ,t2.sales_num AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt as  sales_amt_act            
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额  
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act         
            FROM ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.months,'') = COALESCE(t2.dt_month,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category    ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category    ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_name     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name,'')
            AND     t2. ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            -- AND     t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('Ecom')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('Ecom')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近3月数据
            SELECT  t1.*     
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额   
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act   
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额    
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act 
            FROM ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t1.months,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(t2.dt_month,'yyyymm'),'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 2
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category    ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category    ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_name     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name,'')
            AND     t2. ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            --AND     t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('Ecom') 
            AND     t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('Ecom')
            --and t2.product_barcode <>'-110'
            UNION ALL -- 获取近12月数据
            SELECT  t1.*    
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额    
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act           
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act

                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 12m_sales_amt_act
            FROM ${dme_ads}.ecom_sellout_month_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.customer_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.dist_name,'')
            AND     DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t1.months,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(t2.dt_month,'yyyymm'),'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 11
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_name,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_name,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category    ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category    ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code     ,'')

 LEFT OUTER JOIN (
 	 SELECT
     a.product_barcode

     ,a.henkel_store_code
     
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then a.min_date

     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.months, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售

                        ,'2' as time_type

                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day

                and     day_id <= '${bizdate}'

                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                GROUP BY week_id

            ) t1

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.nka_sellout_data_tmp AS
SELECT  product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name
        ,brand_code

        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_id_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_id_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,henkel_store_name
        ,city_name
        ,province_name
        ,region_name
        ,supply_type
        ,supply_type_name
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_3
        ,time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,dt_date        -- 月/周
        ,min_day_id
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sale_num,0)) AS sale_num -- 当月销量       
        ,SUM(NVL(t.base_sale_amt,0)) AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.sales_amt_act,0)) AS sales_amt_act     -- 当月实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sale_num,0)) AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额 
        ,SUM(NVL(t.3m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 3m_sales_amt_act -- 近3个月月均实际销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sale_num,0)) AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_base_sale_amt,0)) AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额
        ,SUM(NVL(t.12m_sales_amt_act,0)) as 12m_sales_amt_act -- 近12个月月均实际销额
        ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
FROM    (
            -- 获取当前时间数据
            SELECT  t1.*
                    ,t2.data_source  
                    ,t2.sales_num AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt as  sales_amt_act            
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额  
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act          
            FROM ${dme_ads}.nka_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.supply_type,'') = COALESCE(t2.supply_type,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.third_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.third_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND case when t1.time_type='1' then t1.dt_date = t2.dt_month --月关联月
                   when t1.time_type='2' then t1.dt_date = t2.dt_week  --周关联周
                   else t1.dt_date = t2.dt_date end                   --日关联日 
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.is_expired_customer,'') = COALESCE(t2.is_expired_customer,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_name            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name       ,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name       ,'')
            AND  t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            --and  t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近3月数据
            SELECT  t1.*   
                    ,t2.data_source   
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额   
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act   
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额    
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 3m_sales_amt_act
                    ,0 AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,0 AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,0 AS 12m_sales_amt_act 
            FROM ${dme_ads}.nka_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.supply_type,'') = COALESCE(t2.supply_type,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.third_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.third_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND if(t1.time_type='1',datediff(TO_DATE(t1.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(t2.dt_month, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 2
            ,datediff(to_date(t1.min_day_id,'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t2.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),'dd') between 0 and 89)
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.is_expired_customer,'') = COALESCE(t2.is_expired_customer,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_name            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name       ,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name       ,'')
            AND  t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
            --and  t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
            and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
            UNION ALL -- 获取近12月数据
            SELECT  t1.*    
                    ,t2.data_source 
                    ,0 AS sale_num -- 当月销量             
                    ,0 AS base_sale_amt -- 当月销额    
                    ,0 AS sales_amt_act           
                    ,0 AS 3m_sale_num -- 近3个月月均销量         
                    ,0 AS 3m_base_sale_amt -- 近3个月月均销额   
                    ,0 AS 3m_sales_amt_act      
                    ,t2.sales_num AS 12m_sale_num -- 近12个月月均销量        
                    ,t2.base_price_amt AS 12m_base_sale_amt -- 近12个月月均销额 
                    ,t2.actual_sales_amt AS 12m_sales_amt_act
            FROM ${dme_ads}.nka_sellout_dim_tmp t1
            inner JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid  t2
            ON      COALESCE(t1.product_barcode,'') = COALESCE(t2.product_barcode,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.henkel_store_code,'') = COALESCE(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.supply_type,'') = COALESCE(t2.supply_type,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.third_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.third_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'') = COALESCE(t2.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'')
            AND if(t1.time_type='1',datediff(TO_DATE(t1.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(t2.dt_month, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 11
            ,datediff(to_date(t1.min_day_id,'yyyymmdd'),to_date(t2.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),'dd') between 0 and 364)
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category     ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category     ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv1 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv1 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.store_category_lv2 ,'') = COALESCE(t2.store_category_lv2 ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.is_expired_customer,'') = COALESCE(t2.is_expired_customer,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_code            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_code            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.ka_name            ,'') = COALESCE(t2.ka_name            ,'')
            AND     COALESCE(t1.KA_Type_Name       ,'') = COALESCE(t2.KA_Type_Name       ,'')
            AND   t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
           --and  t2.first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
           and t2.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
        ) t
GROUP BY product_barcode
        ,product_name
        ,sku_barcode_name
        ,product_line_id
        ,product_line_name
        ,category_code
        ,category_name
        ,brand_code
        ,brand_name
        ,first_product_function
        ,second_product_function
        ,product_pack
        ,product_pack_type
        ,colour_hue
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,henkel_store_name
        ,supply_type
        ,supply_type_name
        ,city_name
        ,province_name
        ,region_name
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,bu_3
        ,first_channel_id_lastest
        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_id_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_id_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,time_type -- 时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
        ,dt_date        -- 月/周
        ,min_day_id
        ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
        ,store_category       -- 门店分类
        ,store_category_lv1   -- 门店分类一级
        ,store_category_lv2   -- 门店分类二级
        ,is_expired_customer  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
        ,ka_code      -- ka编码
        ,ka_name      -- ka名称
        ,KA_Type_Name -- ka类型

   tt.region_name as henkel_region_id,         --汉高大区id
   tt.region_name as henkel_region_name,         --汉高大区名称
   tt.supply_type, --直/间供类型id

   cast(sum(tt.sale_num     ) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_num, --销量
   cast(sum(tt.base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt, --销额
 --月按整月计算,周和日按天计算
   cast(sum(tt.3m_sale_num      )as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_num,   --近3个月月均销量
   cast(sum(tt.3m_base_sale_amt )as decimal(28,6)) as three_sale_amt,   --近3个月月均销额
   cast(sum(tt.12m_sale_num     )as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_num,  --近12个月月均销量
   cast(sum(tt.12m_base_sale_amt)as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sale_amt, --近12个月月均销额
   case when tt.time_type ='2' then concat(substr(tt.dt_date,1,4),'-',substr(tt.dt_date,5,2))
   else tt.dt_date end as dt_date, -- 日期
   tt.time_type,  -- 1 月，2 周
   substr(tt.dt_date,1,4) as year,

   tt.bu_2,
   tt.bu_3,    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
   cast(sum(tt.sales_amt_act    ) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt_act,-- 实价销额
    -- Bug修复
   cast(sum(tt.3m_sales_amt_act ) as decimal(28,6)) as three_sales_amt_act,
   cast(sum(tt.12m_sales_amt_act) as decimal(28,6)) as twelve_sales_amt_act,
   tt.channel_customer_permission,      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   tt.region_customer_permission, -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   tt.store_category     ,  -- 门店分类
   tt.store_category_lv1 ,  -- 门店分类一级
   tt.store_category_lv2 ,  -- 门店分类二级
   tt.is_expired_customer,  -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商），Others/合作中/已关闭
   tt.ka_code     , -- ka编码
   tt.ka_name     , -- ka名称
   tt.KA_Type_Name, -- ka类型
   min(t4.min_date_3m ) as so_min_date_3m,  -- 近3个月最早so日期
   min(t4.min_date_12m) as so_min_date_12m, -- 近12个月最早so日期
   max(t4.max_date) as so_max_date, -- 最近so日期
   max(cast(case when nvl(t4.diff_month_cnt_3,0)>3 then 3 else t4.diff_month_cnt_3 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_3,  -- 近3个月月份差
   max(cast(case when nvl(t4.diff_month_cnt_12,0)>12 then 12 else t4.diff_month_cnt_12 end as decimal(38,10))) as diff_month_cnt_12, -- 近12个月月份差
   '${bizdate}' AS ds, 
   tt.time_type as dt_type
 FROM (
 	 SELECT *
 	 FROM ${dme_ads}.nka_sellout_data_tmp a
 	  --WHERE (nvl(a.sale_num,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.3m_sale_num,0) <> 0 OR nvl(a.12m_sale_num,0) <> 0 or nvl(a.sales_amt_act,0) <> 0 or nvl(a.3m_sales_amt_act,0) <> 0 or nvl(a.12m_sales_amt_act,0) <> 0)
      --月数据不取日和周
   WHERE (case when a.third_channel_name_lastest in('万宁','莎莎')--,'大润发')
       and a.time_type in('2','3') then 1=0
      else 1=1 end )
 ) tt
 --找出sku所属经销商最早的购买日期，及距今天数，用于判断及计算库存周转周期
 LEFT OUTER JOIN (
     --月
   SELECT
     a.product_barcode
     ,a.henkel_store_code
     ,a.second_channel_name_lastest
     ,a.third_channel_name_lastest
     ,a.fourth_channel_name_lastest
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_3m
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_12m
     ,least(a.max_date,b.dt_date) as max_date
     ,b.dt_date
    --,(datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
    --,(datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 3 -- 近3个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.max_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) <= 12 -- 近12个月有销售
        then (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) 
        end as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差
     ,'1' as time_type
   FROM (
    SELECT 
      product_barcode
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,second_channel_name_lastest
      ,third_channel_name_lastest
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
      ,min(dt_month) AS min_date
      ,max(dt_month) AS max_date
      ,'1' AS flag
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
    WHERE ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
     and first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
     and to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd') <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP BY product_barcode
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,second_channel_name_lastest
      ,third_channel_name_lastest
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
   ) a
   INNER JOIN (
      SELECT 
        month_id AS dt_date
        ,'1' AS flag
      FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
      WHERE month_id >= '202001'
      AND month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
      GROUP BY month_id
    ) b
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   WHERE (datediff(to_date(b.dt_date, 'yyyymm'), to_date(a.min_date,'yyyymm'),'mm')+1) >= 0
   
--周
    union all 

    SELECT
     a.product_barcode
     ,a.henkel_store_code
     ,a.second_channel_name_lastest
     ,a.third_channel_name_lastest
     ,a.fourth_channel_name_lastest
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 90 -- 近90天有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_3m
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 365 -- 近365天有销售
        then a.min_date
        end as min_date_12m
     ,least(a.max_date,b.day_id) as max_date
     ,b.dt_date
     --,(datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30 as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     --,(datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30 as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差   
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 90 -- 近90天有销售
        then (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30
        end as diff_month_cnt_3  -- 近3个月月份差
     ,case when (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.max_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) <= 365 -- 近365天有销售
        then (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1)/30
        end as diff_month_cnt_12 -- 近12个月月份差   
     ,'2' as time_type
   FROM (
    SELECT 
      product_barcode
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,second_channel_name_lastest
      ,third_channel_name_lastest
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
      ,min(nvl(dt_date,to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd'))) AS min_date
      ,max(nvl(dt_date,to_char(TO_DATE(dt_month,'yyyymm'),'yyyymmdd'))) AS max_date
      ,'1' AS flag
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
    WHERE ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid') 
     and first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
     and dt_date <= '${bizdate}'
    GROUP By product_barcode
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,second_channel_name_lastest
      ,third_channel_name_lastest
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
   ) a
   INNER JOIN (
      SELECT 
        week_id AS dt_date
        ,'1' AS flag
        ,max(day_id) AS day_id
      FROM ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
      WHERE day_id >= '${uddate1}' --[yyyymmdd-90]
        and     day_id <= '${bizdate}'
      GROUP BY week_id
    ) b
    ON a.flag = b.flag
   WHERE (datediff(TO_DATE(b.day_id, 'yyyymmdd'), TO_DATE(a.min_date, 'yyyymmdd'), 'dd')+1) >= 0

--创建sellin的临时表:
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sell_in_temp

create table  ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sell_in_temp as 
select t.*,
  substr(ds,1,4) as year, --年
      concat(to_char(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',quarter(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd'))) as quarter,--季度
      substr(ds,1,6) as month, -- 月份
  case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(ds, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
    '-0',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    when weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) >10 and 
    substr(ds,5,2)='01'
    then concat
    (
      cast(year(dateadd(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    else concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(ds, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
  end as week
 from(
--Ecom不用过滤中小样,所以Ecom和其他渠道单独取值
    select
      customer_id,  --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
      product_id,  --产品id用于关联dwd_master_data_product_pos
      cast(sku_ngs_amt as decimal(19, 2)) as sku_ngs_amt, --sell-in销售金额
      nvl(quantity_consumer_units, 0) * product_base_price as sku_sale_amt,
      nvl(quantity_consumer_units, 0) as sku_quantity_amt,--产品销售数量
      ds
      ,channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu 
        where ds >= '20200101'
        and ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
        and first_channel_name <>'Ecom'
        and bu_2='Beauty Care'
     union all 
        select
      a.customer_id,  --客户id用于关联dwd_sap_customer_info
      a.product_id,  --产品id用于关联dwd_master_data_product_bu
      cast(sku_ngs_amt as decimal(19, 2)) as sku_ngs_amt, --sell-in销售金额
      nvl(quantity_consumer_units, 0) * product_base_price as sku_sale_amt,
      nvl(quantity_consumer_units, 0) as sku_quantity_amt,--产品销售数量
      a.ds
      ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a
    join(
          select
                product_code  --产品编码
            from
            ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            where
            ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
            and bu_2='Beauty Care'
           -- and whether_ecom_sample_product ='0'
    ) b on a.product_id=b.product_code
        where a.ds >= '20200101'
        and a.ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
        and a.first_channel_name = 'Ecom' and customer_id <>'2895928' --2895928 这家不要,只取--广大（1967491）、炜能（2530190）、鲲驰（1787667）、傲讯财（2771155）、丽人（1616258）和哆米（2801680）
        and a.bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
) t where sku_ngs_amt <>0 or sku_quantity_amt <>0

  nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as second_product_function,   --产品功能二级

  nvl(b.product_pack_type,'Others') as product_pack_type,         --产品包装分类

  c.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_name,   --四级渠道名称
  a.customer_id as dist_code,   --经销商编码
  c.customer_name as dist_name,   --经销商名称
  c.province_en as province_id,   --省份id
  c.province_name as province_name,   --省份名称
  null as city_id,   --城市id
  null as city_name,   --城市名称
  c.henkel_region as henkel_region_id,   --汉高大区id
  c.henkel_region as henkel_region_name,   --汉高大区名称

  null as customer_name,   --门店名称
  null as customer_channel,   --客户渠道
  null as customer_nature, --客户性质
  null as supply_type,   --直/间供类型id
  null as supply_type_name,   --直/间供类型名称
  null as stock_type,   --仓库类型

  a.sku_quantity_amt as sku_sale_quantity,   --sell_in累计销售数量
  a.year as year,   --年
  a.quarter as quarter,   --季度
  a.month as month,   --月份
  a.week as week,   --周

  cast(a.sku_sale_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sale_amt_tax,
  cooperation_status,
  cast(a.sku_ngs_amt as decimal(28,6))  as sku_sale_amt_act,

  a.region_customer_permission, -- 客户区域（权限字段）

  '${bizdate}' as ds
from
${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sell_in_temp a 
  join(
     select
      product_code,  --产品编码
      product_barcode,  --产品条形码
      product_name as sku_name, --产品名称

      product_line as product_line_name,--产品线

      product_pack as product_pack, --产品包装
      nvl(core_product_line, '0') as core_product_line_code, --核心产品线（1核心产品线，0非核心品产品线）
      decode(
        nvl(core_product_line, '0'),
        '1',
        '核心产品线',
        '非核心产品线'
      ) as core_product_line_name,
      case
        when (
          concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) = ''
          or concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) is null
          or concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) = '.'
        ) then 'Others'
        else concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue)
      end as colour_hue
    from
      dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu
    where
      ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
      and bu_2 ='Beauty Care'
  ) b on a.product_id=b.product_code
 join(
        select
          a.customer_code,
          a.customer_name_en,
          a.customer_name,
          nvl(a.province_en_lastest,'Others') as province_en,
          nvl(a.region,'Others') as henkel_region,   --大区中文
          nvl(a.province,'Others') as province_name,          --省份中文
          a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_id,
          a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as first_channel_name,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then nvl(d.KA_Group_Name,'Others')
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' then a.customer_name
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.region,'Others')
        else 'Others' end as second_channel_id,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then nvl(d.KA_Group_Name,'Others')
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' then a.customer_name
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.region,'Others')
        else 'Others' end as second_channel_name,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then a.customer_group_cn_lv1
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.province,'Others')
        else 'Others' end as third_channel_id,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then a.customer_group_cn_lv1
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.province,'Others')
        else 'Others' end as third_channel_name,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then     
           case when a.customer_group_cn_lv1 REGEXP'华润' then a.customer_group_cn_lv2
             else a.customer_group_cn_lv1 end
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' then null
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in('DT','MPD') then a.customer_name
        else 'Others' end as fourth_channel_id,
        case
        when a.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then        
           case when a.customer_group_cn_lv1 REGEXP'华润' then a.customer_group_cn_lv2

with
--创建sellin的临时表:
ke24_data_tmp as (
--Ecom过滤中小样数据
 select
   a.product_barcode        -- 单品barcode
   ,a.sku_name              -- 单品名称
   ,concat(a.sku_name, '-', a.product_barcode) as sku_barcode_name      -- 单品barcode+名称
   ,a.product_line_code     -- 产品线id
   ,a.product_line_name     -- 产品线名称
   ,a.henkel_category_code as category_code         -- 品类代码
   ,a.henkel_category      as category_name         -- 品类名称
   ,a.henkel_brand_code    as brand_code            -- 品牌代码
   ,a.henkel_brand         as brand_name            -- 品牌名称
   ,a.product_function      -- 产品功能一级
   ,a.sub_product_function  -- 产品功能二级
   ,a.product_pack          -- 产品包装
   ,a.product_pack_type     -- 产品包装分类
   ,a.colour_hue            -- 色调
   ,a.first_channel_name
   ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest    -- 一级渠道名称
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and a.customer_id in ('2849669','2849662') then t3.customer_group
    when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then nvl(c.KA_Group_Name,'Others')
     when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in ('ECOM','B2B&LKA')  then a.customer_name
     when a.first_channel_name_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.henkel_region_lastest,'Others')
     else 'Others' 
    end as second_channel_name_lastest -- 二级渠道名称
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and a.customer_id in ('2849669','2849662') then t3.customer_name
    when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.customer_group_cn_lv1
     when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','B2B&LKA') then null
     when a.first_channel_name_lastest in('DT','MPD') then nvl(a.province_lastest,'Others')
      else 'Others' 
    end as third_channel_name_lastest  -- 三级渠道名称
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and a.customer_id in ('2849669','2849662') then null
    when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 
        case when a.customer_group_cn_lv1 REGEXP'华润' then a.customer_group_cn_lv2
         else a.customer_group_cn_lv1 end
     when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','B2B&LKA') then null
     when a.first_channel_name_lastest in('DT','MPD') then a.customer_name
     else 'Others' 
    end as fourth_channel_name_lastest  -- 四级渠道名称
   ,a.customer_id           -- 经销商编码
   ,a.customer_name         -- 经销商名称
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in ('B2B&LKA') then null
      else nvl(a.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en          -- 省份id
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in ('B2B&LKA') then null
      else nvl(a.province_lastest,'Others') end as province_name -- 省份名称
   ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in ('B2B&LKA') then null
      else nvl(a.henkel_region_lastest,'Others') end as henkel_region         -- 汉高大区名称
  -- ,cast(a.sku_ngs_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sale_amt         -- sell_in销量
   ,cast(a.sku_ngs_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt_act
   ,cast(nvl(a.quantity_consumer_units, 0)as decimal(28,6))     as sku_sale_quantity    -- sell_in累计销售数量
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2
   ,a.bu_3
   ,substr(a.ds,1,4) as year --年
   ,concat(to_char(to_date(a.ds, 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',quarter(to_date(a.ds, 'yyyymmdd'))) as quarter--季度
   ,substr(a.ds,1,6) as month -- 月份
   ,case
   --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
     when substr(a.ds, 5, 2) = 12 and weekofyear(to_date(a.ds, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 
       then concat(cast(year(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),'-0',cast(weekofyear(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string))
     --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
     when weekofyear(to_date(a.ds, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 
       then concat(cast(year(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string),'-0',cast(weekofyear(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string))
     --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
     when weekofyear(to_date(a.ds, 'yyyymmdd')) >10 and substr(a.ds,5,2)='01'
      then concat(cast(year(dateadd(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy')) as string),'-',cast(weekofyear(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string))
     else concat(cast(year(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string),'-',cast(weekofyear(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd')) as string))
    end as week 
   ,a.ds   --时间
   ,nvl(a.quantity_consumer_units, 0)*a.product_base_price as sale_base_amt
   ,nvl(a.quantity_consumer_units, 0)*a.product_base_price*1.13 as sale_base_amt_tax
   ,t3.cooperation_status
   ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   ,t3.is_expired_customer
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a
 left join(
   select
       product_code  --产品编码
       ,bu_1,bu_2
       ,whether_ecom_sample_product
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
   where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
 ) b 
  on a.product_id=b.product_code
  and a.bu_1=b.bu_1
  and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 left join (
    select distinct KA_Name_En_lv1,KA_Group_Name
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
 ) c
  on a.customer_group_en_lv1 = c.KA_Name_En_lv1
--  left join ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule c
--   on if(a.customer_group_cn_lv1 REGEXP '山姆','沃尔玛山姆会员',a.customer_group_cn_lv1) =c.nka_system
--   and c.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule')

left outer join(
  select
     a.customer_code
     ,a.bu_1
     ,a.bu_2
     ,substr(a.ds,1,6) as months
     ,customer_group
     ,customer_name
     ,cooperation_status
     ,is_expired_customer
  from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu a
  where ds like '%01'
) t3 
on a.customer_id = t3.customer_code
 and a.bu_1=t3.bu_1
 and a.bu_2=t3.bu_2
 and substr(a.ds,1,6)=t3.months

 where a.ds >= '20200101'
 and a.ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
 and upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest)  in('NKA','ECOM','DT','MPD','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')
 and nvl(a.bu_2,'') not in ('Beauty Care')  -- 处理逻辑剔除Beauty Care的数据
 --and (
 --  upper(a.first_channel_name) <>'ECOM'
 --  or (
 --    upper(a.first_channel_name) = 'ECOM' 
 --    and case when upper(a.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then 1=1 
 --       else coalesce(b.whether_ecom_sample_product,'0')='0' end
 --     )  --laundry过滤中小样,专业线不过滤
 --   )

)


insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sell_in_bu partition(ds)

   ,a.henkel_region        as henkel_region_name   -- 汉高大区名称
   ,null                   as henkel_store_code    -- 门店编码
   ,null                   as henkel_store_name    -- 门店名称

   ,null                   as customer_nature      -- 客户性质

   ,a.sku_sale_quantity    as sku_sale_quantity    -- sell_in累计销售数量
   ,a.year    as year    --年

   ,a.month   as monthly --月份
   ,a.week    as weekly  --周
   ,a.ds      as dt_date --时间
   ,'1'       as time_type --时间类型1：月、2：周、3：日
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2
   ,null as distributor_type  -- 经销商类型
   ,null as store_type_seg    -- 收货方类型
   ,null as store_lv  -- 门店等级

   ,cast(NULL  as  string)  as store_category_lv2 
   ,cast(a.sale_base_amt_tax as  DECIMAL(28,6)) as sku_sale_amt_tax

   ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_dt_bu partition(ds)
select
  tt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_barcode  -- 单品id
  ,tt.product_name as sku_name            -- 单品名称
  ,concat(tt.product_name,'-',tt.henkel_item_barcode) as sku_barcode_name  --单品barcode+名称
  ,tt.product_line as product_line_id   --产品线id
  ,nvl(tt.product_line,'Others') as product_line_name             --产品线名称
  ,tt.category_name_en               --品类代码
  ,tt.category_name as category_name                 --品类名称
  ,tt.brand_name_en as brand_code                    --品牌代码
  ,tt.brand_name as brand_name                    --品牌名称
  ,tt.product_function as first_product_function        --产品功能一级
  ,tt.sub_product_function as second_product_function       --产品功能二级
  ,tt.product_pack as product_pack                  --产品包装
  ,tt.product_pack_type product_pack_type                --产品包装分类
  ,case when (concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)='' 
        or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue) is null 
        or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)='.')
    then 'Others' else concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue) 
   end  as colour_hue                 --色调
  ,tt.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_id           --一级渠道id
  ,tt.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name         --一级渠道名称
  ,tt.second_channel_id_lastest as second_channel_id           --二级渠道id
  ,tt.second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name         --二级渠道名称
  ,tt.third_channel_id_lastest as third_channel_id    --三级渠道id
  ,tt.third_channel_name_lastest as third_channel_name  --三级渠道名称
  ,tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest as fourth_channel_id           --四级渠道id
  ,tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name     --四级渠道名称
  ,case when tt.dist_code is null or tt.dist_code ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.dist_code end as dist_code                   --经销商编码
  ,case when tt.customer_name is null or tt.customer_name ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.customer_name end as dist_name               --经销商名称
  ,case  when upper(tt.first_channel_name_lastest)='B2B&LKA' then null
    when tt.province_name_lastest is null or tt.province_name_lastest ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.province_name_lastest end as province_id             --省份id
  ,case  when upper(tt.first_channel_name_lastest)='B2B&LKA' then null
    when tt.province_name_lastest is null or tt.province_name_lastest ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.province_name_lastest end as province_name           --省份名称
  ,tt.city_name as city_id                 --城市id
  ,tt.city_name as city_name               --城市名称
  ,case  when upper(tt.first_channel_name_lastest)='B2B&LKA' then null
    when tt.henkel_region_name_lastest is null or tt.henkel_region_name_lastest ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.henkel_region_name_lastest end     as henkel_region_id        --汉高大区id
  ,case  when upper(tt.first_channel_name_lastest)='B2B&LKA' then null
    when tt.henkel_region_name_lastest is null or tt.henkel_region_name_lastest ='' then 'Others'
    else tt.henkel_region_name_lastest end     as henkel_region_name      --汉高大区名称
  ,null as customer_code        --门店编码
  ,null as customer_name        --门店名称
  ,null as customer_channel     --门店渠道
  ,null as customer_nature      --客户性质
  ,null as supply_type          --直间供类型
  ,null as supply_type_name     --直间供类型描述
  ,tt.stock_type as stock_type  --仓库类型
  ,cast(tt.stock_num as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_num    --库存数量
  ,cast(tt.base_stock_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_amt    --基价库存金额
  ,cast(tt.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price --产品基价
  ,tt.dt_date as dt_date               --时间
  ,tt.dt_type as time_type             --时间类型
   ,null as distributor_type  -- 经销商类型
   ,null as store_type_seg    -- 收货方类型
   ,null as store_lv  -- 门店等级
  ,tt.bu_1     -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
  ,tt.bu_2     -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
  ,null as store_type_level1 -- 收货方类型leve1
  ,tt.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
  ,tt.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,tt.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,'${bizdate}' as ds                  --时间分区
from (
    --月数据
    select 
        a.dist_code            -- 经销商编码
        ,a.org_name            -- 城市名称
        ,a.stock_type          -- 仓库类型
        ,a.prod_barcode as henkel_item_barcode -- 单品barcode
        ,a.prod_code           -- 
        ,a.stock_num           -- 库存数量
        ,a.dist_type           -- 经销商类型
        ,a.stock_amt as base_stock_amt      -- 基价库存金额
        ,a.dt_date as dt_date           -- 数据日期
        ,a.dt_date as months
        ,'1' as dt_type             -- 日期类型1：月，2：周，3：日
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,a.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
        ,a.sub_product_function
        ,a.brand_name
        ,a.brand_name_en
        ,a.product_function
        ,a.product_name
        ,a.product_line
        ,a.category_name
        ,a.category_name_en
        ,a.product_pack
        ,a.product_pack_type
        ,a.colour_chroma
        ,a.main_colour_hue
        ,a.customer_name
        ,a.province_name_lastest
        ,a.henkel_region_name_lastest
        ,a.first_channel_id_lastest
        ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
        ,a.second_channel_id_lastest
        ,a.second_channel_name_lastest
        ,a.third_channel_id_lastest
        ,a.third_channel_name_lastest
        ,a.fourth_channel_id_lastest
        ,a.fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,a.base_price
        ,a.city_name
        ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid a
    where a.ds=MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid')
    and upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','B2B&LKA','Others')
    -- and (
    --     a.data_source not in ('KA系统', 'KA手工报表') 
    --     and (
    --             upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','B2B&LKA') 
    --             or a.dist_code in ('2849662') -- '2849669'已经转mpd了
    --         )
    -- ) 
    AND a.date_type = '月'
    
    union all
    --周数据
    select 
        a.dist_code            -- 经销商编码
        ,a.org_name            -- 城市名称
        ,a.stock_type          -- 仓库类型
        ,a.prod_barcode as henkel_item_barcode -- 单品barcode
        ,a.prod_code           -- 
        ,a.stock_num           -- 库存数量
        ,a.dist_type           -- 经销商类型
        ,a.stock_amt as base_stock_amt      -- 基价库存金额
        ,REPLACE(a.dt_date, 'W', '-') as dt_date             -- 数据日期
        ,REPLACE(a.dt_date, 'W', '-') as months
        ,'2' as dt_type             -- 日期类型1：月，2：周，3：日
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,a.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
        ,a.sub_product_function

insert  overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_ecom_bu partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select  
    a.product_barcode  as sku_barcode  --单品barcode
    ,a.product_name    as sku_name     --单品名称
    ,concat(a.product_name,'-',a.product_barcode) as sku_barcode_name  --单品barcode+名称
    ,a.product_line as product_line_id     --产品线id
    ,a.product_line as product_line_name   --产品线名称
    ,a.category_name_en as category_code       --品类代码
    ,a.category_name as category_name       --品类名称
    ,a.brand_name_en as brand_code          --品牌代码
    ,a.brand_name as brand_name          -- 品牌名称         
    ,a.product_function as first_product_function  --产品功能一级
    ,a.sub_product_function as second_product_function  --产品功能二级
    ,if(a.bu_2='Laundry',null, a.product_pack)as product_pack       --产品包装
    ,a.product_pack_type as product_pack_type  --产品包装分类
    ,case when (nvl(concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue),'')='' or concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue)='.')
        and a.bu_2<>'Laundry' then 'Others' 
        else concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue) 
    end   as colour_hue         --色调
    ,a.first_channel_id_lastest as first_channel_id   --一级渠道id
    ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name --一级渠道名称
    ,a.second_channel_id_lastest as second_channel_id  --二级渠道id
    ,a.second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name 
    ,null as third_channel_id   --三级渠道id
    ,null as third_channel_name --三级渠道名称
    ,null as henkel_store_code  --店铺编码
    ,null as henkel_store_name  --店铺名称
    ,cast(sum(a.stock_num)  as bigint)        as sku_stock_num    --库存数量
    ,cast(sum(a.stock_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_amt    --库存金额
    ,cast(a.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price --产品基价
    ,null as stock_type       --仓库类型
    ,null as product_cateory  --产品类别
    ,null as product_cateory_desc  --产品类别描述
    ,a.dt_date as dt_date   -- 时间
    ,'1' as time_type
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,a.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid a
where a.ds=MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid') 
and a.first_channel_name_lastest = 'Ecom' AND a.date_type = '月' 
-- 不包含本月
and a.stock_date >= '20200101' 
and a.stock_date < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}' ,'yyyymmdd') ,'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
group by 
    a.product_barcode, --单品barcode
    a.product_name,  --单品名称
    a.product_line, --产品线id
    a.category_name_en,  --品类代码
    a.category_name, --品类名称
    a.brand_name_en, --品牌代码
    a.brand_name,    -- 品牌名称         
    a.product_function, --产品功能一级
    a.sub_product_function, --产品功能二级
    a.product_pack, --产品包装
    a.product_pack_type, --产品包装分类
    case when (nvl(concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue),'')='' or concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue)='.')
     and a.bu_2<>'Laundry' then 'Others' 
     else concat(a.colour_chroma,'.',a.main_colour_hue) 
    end ,--色调
    a.first_channel_id_lastest,
    a.first_channel_name_lastest,
    a.second_channel_id_lastest, --二级渠道id
    a.second_channel_name_lastest,
    cast(a.base_price as decimal(28,6)),  --产品基价
    a.dt_date,  -- 时间
    a.bu_1,
    a.bu_2
    ,a.bu_3    -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    ,a.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_nka_bu partition(ds)
select
    tt.henkel_item_barcode as sku_barcode --单品id
    ,tt.product_name       as sku_name    --单品名称
    ,concat(tt.product_name,'-',tt.henkel_item_barcode) as sku_barcode_name  --单品barcode+名称
    ,nvl(tt.product_line,'Others')     as product_line_id     --产品线id
    ,nvl(tt.product_line,'Others')     as product_line_name   --产品线名称
    ,nvl(tt.category_name_en,'Others') as category_code       --品类代码
    ,nvl(tt.category_name,'Others')    as category_name       --品类名称
    ,nvl(tt.brand_name_en,'Others')    as brand_code          --品牌代码
    ,nvl(tt.brand_name,'Others')       as brand_name          --品牌名称
    ,nvl(tt.product_function,'Others') as first_product_function   --产品功能一级
    ,nvl(tt.sub_product_function,'Others') as  assecond_product_function    --产品功能二级
    ,if(tt.bu_2='Laundry',null,nvl(tt.product_pack,'Others')) as product_pack                     --产品包装
    ,nvl(tt.product_pack_type,'Others') as product_pack_type                --产品包装分类
    ,case when (concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)=''
            or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue) is null
            or concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)='.')
        and tt.bu_2<>'Laundry'
    then 'Others' else concat(tt.colour_chroma,'.',tt.main_colour_hue)  end as colour_hue                   --色调
    ,if(tt.bu_2 in('SP','SKP') AND UPPER(tt.first_channel_id_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'),'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
        ,tt.first_channel_id_lastest) as first_channel_id          --一级渠道id
    ,if(tt.bu_2 in('SP','SKP') AND UPPER(tt.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'),'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
        ,tt.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name        --一级渠道名称
    ,tt.second_channel_id_lastest as second_channel_id         --二级渠道id
    ,tt.second_channel_name_lastest as  second_channel_name      --二级渠道名称
    ,tt.third_channel_id_lastest as third_channel_id          --三级渠道id
    ,tt.third_channel_name_lastest as   third_channel_name      --三级渠道名称
    ,tt.fourth_channel_id_lastest as fourth_channel_id         --四级渠道id
    ,tt.fourth_channel_name_lastest as    fourth_channel_name          --四级渠道名称
    ,nvl(tt.henkel_store_code,'Others')    as henkel_store_code --汉高门店编码
    ,nvl(tt.henkel_store_name,'Others')    as henkel_store_name --汉高门店名称
    ,nvl(tt.province_name_lastest,'Others') as province_id       --省份id
    ,nvl(tt.province_name_lastest,'Others') as province_name     --省份名称
    ,nvl(tt.city_name,'Others')     as  city_id          --城市id
    ,nvl(tt.city_name,'Others')     as city_name                     --城市名称
    ,nvl(tt.henkel_region_name_lastest,'Others') as henkel_big_region_id          --汉高大区id
    ,nvl(tt.henkel_region_name_lastest,'Others') as henkel_big_region_name        --汉高大区名称
    ,case when  tt.supply_type_name='直供' then '1' 
    when  tt.supply_type_name='间供' then '2' 
        else tt.supply_type_name end  as supply_type_id --直/间供类型id,间供2，直供1
        ,tt.supply_type_name   as supply_type_name -- 直/间供类型名称
    ,cast(tt.stock_num as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_num        --库存数量
    ,cast(tt.base_stock_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_stock_amt   --基价库存金额
    ,cast (tt.base_price as decimal(28,6)) as base_price         --产品基价
    ,tt.dt_date                 --时间
    ,tt.time_type                    --时间类型
    ,tt.bu_1
    ,tt.bu_2
    ,tt.bu_3
    ,tt.channel_customer_permission      -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,tt.region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,'${bizdate}' as ds --时间分区
FROM (

    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_nka_bu_tmp01 a

        ,a.dt_date              -- 时间

------------------------------年-------------------------------
select
substr(day_id,1,4) as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'A.年' as time_type,

from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all 
--年 如果今年是平年，去年是闰年，需要补充一条记录
select
year_ as mapping_time,
null as time_now,
concat(cast(year_ as bigint)-1,'0229') as time_yoy,
concat(cast(year_ as bigint)-1,'0229') as time_mom,
'A.年' as time_type,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(concat(cast(year_ as bigint)-1,'0229'),'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mon
from
( 
select  substr(day_id,1,6) as month_,
        substr(day_id,1,4) as year_
 from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day

and substr(day_id,5,2) in('02')

) a

and day_id like '%01'

union all
-------------------------------------周-------------------------------------
select 
 case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
    '-0',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
   when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 01 
   and  weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) > 50 then concat
   (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) - 1 as string),
      '-',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    else concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
  end as mapping_time,
  day_id as time_now,
 to_char(dateadd(dateadd(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy'), 
WEEKOFYEAR(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),- (weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'))*7 + 
WEEKDAY(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd')) -WEEKDAY(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), 
-(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy')),'dd'),
-(7-weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))-1),'dd'),'yyyymmdd')
as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'D.周' as time_type,
to_char(dateadd(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mon

from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
--------------------------------日-----------------------------------
union all
select
day_id as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'E.日' as time_type,
to_char(dateadd(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mon
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all
select
    mapping_time
    ,time_now
    ,time_yoy
    ,time_mom
    ,time_type
    ,time_mon
from
    ${dme_ads}.tb_watsons_mapping_time where ds='${bizdate}'

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    a.henkel_prod_code as sku_id, --单品id
    nvl(b.product_name,'Others') as sku_name,
    nvl(b.product_code,'Others') as sku_name_id,--产品IDH
    case when d.product_barcode is not null then '1' 
        else '0' end as sell_sku_mark,--必售sku标记
    a.must_sell_sku_store_type as must_sell_sku_store_type, --必销sku门店类型
    nvl(b.product_line,'Others')  as product_line_name,--产品线名称
    decode(b.core_product_line,'1','1','0') as product_line_mark,--核心产品线标记
    null as product_series_id,--产品系列id
    null as product_series_name,--产品系列名称
    decode(b.premiumisation_product,'1','1','0') as high_product_mark,--高端化产品标记
    decode(b.new_product,'1','1','0') as new_product_mark,--新品标记
    nvl(b.category_name_en,'Others') as category_code,--品类代码
    nvl(b.category_name,'Others') as category_name,--品类名称
    nvl(b.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_code,--品牌代码
    nvl(b.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,--品牌名称
    nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as product_function,--产品功能/一级子品类
    nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function,--二级子品类
    nvl(b.product_pack_type,'Others') as product_pack_type,--产品包装分类
    nvl(b.product_pack,'Others') as product_pack,--产品包装
    nvl(b.product_pack_ori,'Others') as product_pack_ori,--产品包装原始值
    nvl(b.main_colour_hue,'Others') as main_colour_hue,--主色调
    case when (concat(b.colour_chroma,'.',b.main_colour_hue)='' 
        or concat(b.colour_chroma,'.',b.main_colour_hue) is null 
        or concat(b.colour_chroma,'.',b.main_colour_hue)='.')
        then 'Others' else concat(b.colour_chroma,'.',b.main_colour_hue) 
    end as colour_hue,--色调
    a.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_id,--四级渠道id chain_name(NKA)  chain_name(LKA)
    a.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_name,--四级渠道名称
    a.third_channel_name as third_channel_id,--三级渠道id nka_customer_name(NKA)
    a.third_channel_name as third_channel_name,--三级渠道名称
    a.second_channel_name as second_channel_id,--二级渠道id   channel_group(NKA)  henkel_region(LKA)
    a.second_channel_name as second_channel_name,--二级渠道名称
    a.first_channel_name as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id store_definition(NKA LKA ECOM)
    a.first_channel_name as first_channel_name,--一级渠道名称
    a.dist_store_code as store_code, --经销商门店编码
    a.dist_store_name as store_name, --经销商门店名称
    nvl(c.store_oneid,'Others') as henkel_store_code, --汉高门店代码
    nvl(c.store_name,'Others') as henkel_store_name, --汉高门店名称
    nvl(c.store_lv,'Others') as store_grade_mark_code,--门店级别标记
    nvl(c.store_lv,'Others') as store_grade_mark,--门店级别标记
    -- decode(c.whether_ba,'1','1','0') as store_ba_mark,--BA门店标记
    -- decode(c.whether_ba,'1','BA门店','非BA门店') as store_ba_mark_desc,--BA门店标记
    -- decode(c.sfa_store,'1','1','0') as store_sfa_mark,--SFA门店标记
    -- decode(c.sfa_store,'1','SFA门店','非SFA门店') as store_sfa_mark_desc,--SFA门店标记
    '' as store_ba_mark,--BA门店标记
    '' as store_ba_mark_desc,--BA门店标记
    '' as store_sfa_mark,--SFA门店标记
    '' as store_sfa_mark_desc,--SFA门店标记
    nvl(c.store_type_seg,'Others') as store_type_mark_code,--门店类型标记
    nvl(c.store_type_seg,'Others') as store_type_mark,--门店类型标记
    a.first_class_code as ka_code,--ka代码
    case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name) ='线上分销' then a.first_class_name
     else a.ka_name end as ka_name,--ka名称
    -- a.first_class_name as ka_name,--ka名称
    nvl(c.city_name,'Others') as city_id,--城市id
    nvl(c.city_name,'Others') as city_name,--城市名称
    nvl(c.province_name,'Others') as province_id,--省份id
    nvl(c.province_name,'Others') as province_name,--省份名称
    --modify by shiwu 2022/1/12 LKA的经销商大区放汉高大区列
    case when a.first_channel_name in ('LKA','OT') then nvl(c.henkel_region,'Others')
    else nvl(c.distributor_region_name,'Others') end as big_region_id,--大区名称
    --modify by shiwu 2022/1/12 LKA的经销商大区放汉高大区列
    case when a.first_channel_name in ('LKA','OT') then nvl(c.henkel_region,'Others')
    else nvl(c.distributor_region_name,'Others') end as big_region_name,--大区名称
    nvl(c.henkel_region,'Others') as henkel_big_region_id,--汉高大区id
    nvl(c.henkel_region,'Others') as henkel_big_region_name,--汉高大区名称
    cast(b.retail_price_tax as decimal(28,6)) as sku_price,--sku价格/含税零售价
    a.base_unit_qty as sku_sale_num,--sku销售数量
    cast(a.original_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt,--pos累计销售额
    cast(a.base_sales_amt as decimal(28,6)) as sku_base_sales_amt,--pos累计基价销售额
    substr(bill_month,1,4) as year, --年
    bill_month as month, --月
    case when a.first_class_code='KA0011' then concat(a.bill_month,'a')
     else a.bill_month end  as dt_date, --日期（月数据存放月，日数据存放日）,upd : 屈臣氏数据日期拼接标识a，以方便mapping到屈臣氏的日历
    'monthly' as time_type, --日期类型(monthly,daily)
    b.product_barcode as sku_barcode, --产品条码
    a.bu_1,
    a.bu_2,
    a.supply_type,
    a.supply_type_name
    ,a.dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(线上O2O门店与已有经销商门店 有差异)'  
    ,a.delivery_store_code -- 汉高线下配送门店编码  
    ,a.DealerCode  -- 经销商编码 
    ,a.bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)   
    ,a.store_category     -- 汉高门店分类
    ,a.store_category_lv1 -- 汉高门店一级分类
    ,a.store_category_lv2 -- 汉高门店二级分类
    ,a.customer_name                    -- 客户中文
    ,a.region_cust_lastest              -- 区域(最新)
    ,a.region_en_cust_lastest           -- 区域英文(最新)
    ,a.province_cust_lastest            -- 省份(最新)
    ,a.province_en_cust_lastest         -- 省份英文(最新)
    ,a.first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
    ,a.second_channel_name_cust_lastest -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
    ,a.third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
    ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
    ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,a.channel_ka_Permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.delivery_store_name -- 汉高线下配送门店名称
    ,a.sales_channel     -- 销售渠道
from(
  select 
    first_class_code, --KA代码
    first_class_name, --KA名称
    first_channel_name, --渠道一级
    second_channel_name,  --渠道二级
    third_channel_name,  --渠道三级
    fourth_channel_name,  --渠道四级
    bill_month,  --开单月份
    base_unit_qty,  --数量

    original_amt_untax,  --销额未税
    base_sales_amt,--基价金额
    henkel_prod_code,  --产品idh
    henkel_store_code,  --门店编码
    dist_store_code, --经销商门店编码
    dist_store_name, --经销商门店名称
    case when first_class_code='KA0011' then 'WTS'
        else 'Hyper' end as must_sell_sku_store_type,  --必售sku门店类型
    --由于屈臣氏第四层级需要特殊处理才能和门店等级关联
    case when first_class_code='KA0011' then '屈臣氏'
    else fourth_channel_name end as fourth_channel_link,
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and supply_type_name='直供' then '1' 
     when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') and supply_type_name='间供' then '2' 
      end as supply_type, -- 直/间供类型id
    case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')then supply_type_name end as supply_type_name --直/间供类型名称
    ,dist_store_code_orig -- 原始经销商门店编码(线上O2O门店与已有经销商门店 有差异)'  
    ,delivery_store_code -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
    ,delivery_store_name -- 汉高线下配送门店名称
    ,DealerCode  -- 经销商编码
    ,bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP) 
    
    ,nvl(henkel_store_category    ,'Others') as store_category     -- 汉高门店分类
    ,nvl(henkel_store_category_lv1,'Others') as store_category_lv1 -- 汉高门店一级分类
    ,nvl(henkel_store_category_lv2,'Others') as store_category_lv2 -- 汉高门店二级分类
    ,customer_name                    -- 客户中文
    ,region_cust_lastest              -- 区域(最新)
    ,region_en_cust_lastest           -- 区域英文(最新)
    ,province_cust_lastest            -- 省份(最新)
    ,province_en_cust_lastest         -- 省份英文(最新)
    ,first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
    ,second_channel_name_cust_lastest -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
    ,third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
    ,fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
    ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,channel_ka_Permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）
    ,sales_channel    
    ,dist_system_name  as  ka_name
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu 
    where  ds >='202001'  -- ka-pos销售表
    -- and upper(bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY','SKP','SP','VS')
