drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_l6_customer_brand_summary_01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_l6_customer_brand_summary_01 as
select 
       customer_id
      ,t2.customer_name_en   AS  customer_name_en
      ,t2.customer_name      AS  customer_name
      ,t1.product_id
      ,t1.product_barcode
      ,t1.henkel_brand_code
      ,coalesce(t4.brand,'Others')     as  henkel_brand
      ,coalesce(t4.brand,'Others')     as  henkel_brand_en         --品牌英文
      ,coalesce(t4.category_en ,'Others')        as  henkel_category_code
      ,coalesce(t4.category ,'Others')     as  henkel_category 
      ,coalesce(t4.category_en ,'Others')  as  henkel_category_en
      ,t3.product_function
      ,t3.sub_product_function
      ,case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 is null or t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = '' then 'Others' else t2.channel_hierarchy_1 end  AS   first_channel_id
      ,case when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 is null or t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = '' then 'Others' else t2.channel_hierarchy_1 end  AS   first_channel_name
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.region_en
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'NKA'         then t2.channel_hierarchy_2
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom'        then t2.customer_name_en
          else NULL end   AS   second_channel_id
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.region_en
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'NKA'         then t2.channel_hierarchy_2
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 = 'Ecom'        then t2.customer_name
          else NULL end   AS   second_channel_name
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.province_en
          else NULL end   AS   third_channel_id
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.province_en
          else NULL end   AS   third_channel_name                                          
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.customer_name_en
          else NULL end   AS   fourth_channel_id
      ,case
          when t2.channel_hierarchy_1 in ('DT','MPD') then t2.customer_name
          else NULL end   AS   fourth_channel_name
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then nvl(quantity_consumer_units,0) else 0 end AS    con
      ,nvl(ges          ,0)                    AS    ges   
      ,case when substr(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),1,4) < '2024' and t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') then nvl(-product_listing_discount,0) +nvl(-adn_promotion_bonus,0)
            else  nvl(-product_listing_discount  ,0) end     AS    pld   
      ,nvl(-product_promotion_discount,0)      AS    ppd   
      ,nvl(-ppd_free_goods            ,0)      AS    pfg         
      ,case when substr(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),1,4) < '2024' and t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') then 0
            else  nvl(-adn_promotion_bonus       ,0) end   AS    adn           --票扣返利(adn)
      ,nvl(abf_assortment_bonus       ,0)      AS    abf           --账扣返利(abf)
      ,nvl(promotion_bonus_invoice    ,0)      AS    ca            --CA(adf)    
      ,nvl(euf_agreement_bonus        ,0)      AS    euf           --全球协议/间供返利 (euf)        
      ,nvl(gbf_growth_bonus           ,0)      AS    gbf           --新品进场费/间供合同返利/合同固定费用/陈列费+海报费+其他/LKA合同返利 (gbf)
      ,nvl(logistics_invoice          ,0)      AS    qlf           --物流费(qlf)
      ,nvl(rpf_returns_provisio       ,0)      AS    rpf           --ROR退货预估(rpf)
      ,nvl(dpf_deduction_provis       ,0)      AS    dpf           --Deduction(dpf)
      --,nvl(material_costs             ,0)      AS    standard_cog  --产品成本
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then nvl(material_costs,0) else 0 end AS standard_cog  --产品成本
      ,nvl(ppf_prod_prom_disc         ,0)      AS    ppf           --价差CA（incl. 清货费OSMI Clearance）
      ,nvl(lff_prod_listing_fee       ,0)      AS    lff           --进场费(NKA/DT)
      ,nvl(fff_flexibility_fund       ,0)      AS    fff           --二次陈列费+海报费+其他（合同外）(NKA/DT)
      ,nvl(pxf_prod_except_disc       ,0)      AS    pxf           --缺货罚款(NKA)
      ,nvl(hqf_hq_services            ,0)      AS    hqf           --信息费(NKA)
      --l14Cog相关指标 剔除L内部销售PC为878111/878119/878368/878388
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(material_costs ,0)        else 0 end     AS   material_costs   
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(packaging_costs ,0)       else 0 end     AS   packaging_costs  
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(misc_costs ,0)            else 0 end     AS   misc_costs       
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(materialcosts_varian ,0)  else 0 end     AS   materialcosts_varian
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(lma_line_12 ,0)           else 0 end     AS   lma_line_12      
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(ic_cog_hedging ,0)        else 0 end     AS   ic_cog_hedging   
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(processcosts_subcont ,0)  else 0 end     AS   processcosts_subcont
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(processcosts_variabl ,0)  else 0 end     AS   processcosts_variabl
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(processcosts_fix ,0)      else 0 end     AS   processcosts_fix 
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(processcosts_varianc ,0)  else 0 end     AS   processcosts_varianc
      ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('Beauty Care') OR (t1.bu_2 in ('Laundry') and t1.profit_center_id not in ('878111','878119','878368','878388')) then  nvl(lma_line_13 ,0)           else 0 end     AS   lma_line_13    
      ,to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
      ,substr(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),1,4)       as years
      ,t1.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,t1.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
(
    select *  
    from   ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu 
    where ds >= '20210101'
    and ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
    and bu_2 in ('Beauty Care','Laundry')
)t1
left outer join 
(
   select distinct
          customer_code
          ,region_en_lastest  as  region_en
          ,channel_hierarchy_2_lastest  as  channel_hierarchy_2
          ,customer_name
          ,province_en_lastest  as  province_en
          ,customer_name_en
          ,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest  as  channel_hierarchy_1
          ,substr(ds,1,6)  as months 
          ,bu_2
  from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
  where ds like '%01' 
    and bu_2 in ('Beauty Care','Laundry')
)t2 
on t1.customer_id = t2.customer_code
and to_char(to_date(to_char(t1.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') = t2.months
and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
left outer join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu t3 
on t1.product_id = t3.product_code
and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
and t3.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
left join
 --修改取数逻辑为通过PH5 code关联获取汉高品类品牌
(
         select 
            distinct 
            case when length(ph5) = 11 then concat('0',cast(ph5 as string)) 
                 else ph5 end  as ph5            --ph5编码，兼容首位为0但是被excel自动转数值的情况
          ,brand   --产品名
          ,category
          ,category_en
          ,dense_rank() over(partition by case when length(ph5) = 11 then concat('0',cast(ph5 as string)) 
                 else ph5 end order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
         from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_brand_mapping 
         where ds = '${bizdate}'
           and brand <> '#'  
)t4 on if(t1.product_hirachy_number is null,'####',cast(t1.product_hirachy_number as string)) = t4.ph5
and t4.rn = 1

insert overwrite table  ${dme_ads}.tb_l6_customer_brand_summary  partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
       customer_id
      ,customer_name_en
      ,customer_name
      ,henkel_brand
      ,henkel_brand_en
      ,henkel_category_code
      ,henkel_category
      ,product_function
      ,sub_product_function
      ,henkel_category_en
      ,first_channel_id
      ,first_channel_name
      ,second_channel_id
      ,second_channel_name
      ,third_channel_id
      ,third_channel_name                                          
      ,fourth_channel_id
      ,fourth_channel_name
      ,sum(con                             )   AS   con                               --销量
      ,sum(ges                             )   AS   ges                               --全称Gross External Sales，即外部总销售额
      ,sum(pld                             )   AS   pld                               --Price List Discount
      ,sum(ppd                             )   AS   ppd                               --Price Promotion Discount
      ,sum(pfg                             )   AS   pfg                               --免费货
      ,sum((pld+ppd+pfg)                   )   AS   l6a                               --(ppd Prod.Prom.Disc 0+pld PriceList Disc 1+PPD free good)*-1  
      ,sum(ges-(pld+ppd+pfg)               )   AS   ngs                               --GES-L6a 
      ,sum(adn                             )   AS   adn                               --票扣返利(adn)
      ,sum(abf                             )   AS   abf                               --账扣返利(abf)
      ,sum(ca                              )   AS   ca                                --CA(adf)    
      ,sum(euf                             )   AS   euf                               --全球协议/间供返利 (euf)        
      ,sum(gbf                             )   AS   gbf                               --新品进场费/间供合同返利/合同固定费用/陈列费+海报费+其他/LKA合同返利 (gbf)
      ,sum(qlf                             )   AS   qlf                               --物流费(qlf)
      ,sum(rpf                             )   AS   rpf                               --ROR退货预估(rpf)
      ,sum(dpf                             )   AS   dpf                               --Deduction(dpf)
      ,sum((adn+abf+ca+euf+gbf+qlf+rpf+dpf+ppf+lff+fff+pxf+hqf))                     AS   l6b             --=adn*-1+abf+adf+euf+gbf+qlf+rpf+dpf
      ,sum((pld+ppd+pfg)+(adn+abf+ca+euf+gbf+qlf+rpf+dpf+ppf+lff+fff+pxf+hqf))       AS   l6_w_ror        --L6包含退货预估
      ,sum((pld+ppd+pfg)+(adn+abf+ca+euf+gbf+qlf+dpf+ppf+lff+fff+pxf+hqf))           AS   l6_wo_ror       --L6不包含退货预估
      ,sum(ges-(pld+ppd+pfg)-(adn+abf+ca+euf+gbf+qlf+rpf+dpf+ppf+lff+fff+pxf+hqf))   AS   nes             --NES
      ,sum(standard_cog+ packaging_costs+ processcosts_subcont)                      AS   standard_cog    --产品成本
      ,months
      ,years
      ,sum(ppf)                                AS    ppf               --价差CA（incl. 清货费OSMI Clearance）
      ,sum(lff)                                AS    lff       --进场费(NKA/DT)
      ,sum(fff)                                AS    fff  --二次陈列费+海报费+其他（合同外）(NKA/DT)
      ,sum(pxf)                                AS    pxf               --缺货罚款(NKA)
      ,sum(hqf)                                AS    hqf               --信息费(NKA)
      ,sum(material_costs + packaging_costs + misc_costs + materialcosts_varian + lma_line_12 + ic_cog_hedging + processcosts_subcont + processcosts_variabl + processcosts_fix + processcosts_varianc + lma_line_13) AS cog  --l14 COG 
      ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_ads}.tb_l6_customer_brand_summary_01
group by   customer_id
      ,customer_name_en
      ,customer_name
      ,henkel_brand
      ,henkel_brand_en
      ,henkel_category_code
      ,henkel_category
      ,henkel_category_en
      ,product_function
      ,sub_product_function
      ,first_channel_id
      ,first_channel_name
      ,second_channel_id
      ,second_channel_name
      ,third_channel_id
      ,third_channel_name                                          
      ,fourth_channel_id
      ,fourth_channel_name
      ,months
      ,years
      ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
      ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_ecom_product_mapping_info PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
--丽人&鲲驰
SELECT  a.ec_name
        ,a.shop_id
        ,a.shop_name as store_name
        ,a.commodity_sku
        ,a.commodity_name
        ,a.untax_payment_actual
        ,a.min_sales_day
        ,a.max_sales_day
        ,CURRENT_DATE() AS etl_time --c.shop_id as ec_store_code_tp
        ,a.shop_id_tp as ec_store_code_tp
        ,null as combined_products
        ,platform
FROM    (
            SELECT  case when shop_id ='30192076' then concat(ds,'-',commodity_sku)
                    else commodity_sku end as commodity_sku
                    ,CAST(SUM(untax_payment_actual) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS untax_payment_actual
                    ,MAX(ec_name) AS ec_name
                    ,shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,platform
                    ,MAX(commodity_name) AS commodity_name
                    ,MAX(ds) AS max_sales_day
                    ,MIN(ds) AS min_sales_day
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= '20250101'
            AND     ec_name IN ('丽人丽妆','鲲驰')
            AND     nvl(commodity_sku,'') <>''
            AND     lower(commodity_sku) <> 'null'
            AND     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'shopping voucher'
            and     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'platform subsidy'
            and     shop_name not like '%已关闭%'
            GROUP BY case when shop_id ='30192076' then concat(ds,'-',commodity_sku)
                    else commodity_sku end
                     ,shop_id
                     ,shop_name
                     ,shop_id_tp
                     ,platform
        ) a
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
                group by shop_id,plat_prod_code

                union all 
                select shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc')
                group by shop_id,plat_prod_code

                union all 
                select shop_code as shop_id,
                concat(state_date,'-',commodity_code) as plat_prod_code
                 from dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp02
                 group by shop_code,concat(state_date,'-',commodity_code)

            ) b
ON      a.commodity_sku = b.plat_prod_code
AND     a.shop_id_tp = b.shop_id 
WHERE   b.plat_prod_code IS NULL
AND     abs(a.untax_payment_actual) > 0 

union all 

select a.ec_name
        ,a.shop_id
        ,a.shop_name as store_name
        ,a.commodity_sku
        ,a.commodity_name
        ,a.untax_payment_actual
        ,a.min_sales_day
        ,a.max_sales_day
        ,CURRENT_DATE() AS etl_time --c.shop_id as ec_store_code_tp
        ,a.shop_id_tp as ec_store_code_tp
        ,nvl(b.combined_products,'') as combined_products
        ,platform
        from (
            SELECT  case when shop_id ='30192076' then concat(ds,'-',commodity_sku)
                    else commodity_sku end as commodity_sku
                    ,CAST(SUM(untax_payment_actual) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS untax_payment_actual
                    ,MAX(ec_name) AS ec_name
                    ,shop_id
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,shop_name
                    ,platform
                    ,MAX(commodity_name) AS commodity_name
                    ,MAX(ds) AS max_sales_day
                    ,MIN(ds) AS min_sales_day
                    ,max(henkel_category) as henkel_category
                    ,count(DISTINCT nvl(henkel_category,'Others')) as henkel_category_num
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= '20250101'
            AND     ec_name IN ('丽人丽妆','鲲驰')
            AND     nvl(commodity_sku,'') <>''
            AND     lower(commodity_sku) <> 'null'
            AND     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'shopping voucher'
            and     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'platform subsidy'
            and     shop_name not like '%已关闭%'
            and     abs(untax_payment_actual) >0
            GROUP BY case when shop_id ='30192076' then concat(ds,'-',commodity_sku)
                    else commodity_sku end 
                     ,shop_id
                     ,shop_id_tp
                     ,shop_name
                     ,platform
) a 
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                        ,WM_CONCAT(',', CONCAT(henkel_prod_barcode, '*', prod_qty,'(',decode(product_type,'1','正装','非正装'),')')) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY henkel_prod_barcode, prod_qty)  AS combined_products
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping')
                and ec='e001'
                group by shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                union all 
                select shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                        ,WM_CONCAT(',', CONCAT(henkel_prod_barcode, '*', prod_qty)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY henkel_prod_barcode, prod_qty)  AS combined_products
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_standard_product_mapping_kunc')
                group by shop_id
                        ,plat_prod_code
                union all 
                select shop_code as shop_id,
                concat(state_date,'-',commodity_code) as plat_prod_code
                ,WM_CONCAT(',', CONCAT(product_barcode, '*', plat_qty)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_barcode, plat_qty)  AS combined_products
                 from dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_sales_daily_info_lily_haiwai_temp02
                 group by shop_code,concat(state_date,'-',commodity_code)
            ) b
ON      a.commodity_sku = b.plat_prod_code
AND     a.shop_id_tp = b.shop_id 
WHERE   b.plat_prod_code IS not NULL
and  a.henkel_category_num =1 and nvl(a.henkel_category,'Others') ='Others'

WITH first_part AS -- Sell in
(
   select  customer_id as customer_code
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,cast(sum(sku_ngs_amt)as decimal(19,2)) as sku_ngs_amt
                    ,min(day) as min_sales_day
                    ,max(day) as max_sales_day
            from    ${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu
            where   ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_sku_sales_summary_bu')
            and     customer_name = 'Others'
            and     customer_id is not null
            and     abs(sku_ngs_amt) > 0
            and customer_id <>0 
            and customer_id <> 'Not assigned'
            group by  customer_id
                      ,bu_2
                      ,bu_1)
,second_part AS -- Daily Sales Report底表
(
    SELECT  customer_code
            ,bu_1
            ,bu_2
            ,SUM(net_value) AS sku_ngs_amt
            ,MIN(min_sales_day) AS min_sales_day
            ,MAX(max_sales_day) AS max_sales_day
    FROM    (
                SELECT  bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                        ,customer_code
                        ,SUM(net_value) AS net_value
                        ,MIN(period_month) AS min_sales_day -- 非销售日期 creared date
                        ,MAX(period_month) AS max_sales_day
                FROM    dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data')
                AND     (customer_name = 'Others' or customer_name is null)
                and     customer_code <>'Others'
                and     customer_code <> 'Not assigned'
                and     bu_1 <>'Others'
                AND     period_month >= '202501'
                AND     period = TO_CHAR(LASTDAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT(period_month,'01'),'yyyymmdd')),'yyyymmdd')
                AND     customer_code IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY bu_1
                         ,bu_2
                         ,customer_code
                UNION ALL
                SELECT  bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                        ,customer_code
                        ,SUM(net_value) AS net_value
                        ,MIN(period_month) AS min_sales_day
                        ,MAX(period_month) AS max_sales_day
                FROM    dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data t1
                JOIN    (
                            SELECT  MAX(period) AS max_period
                            FROM    dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data')
                        ) t2
                ON      t1.period = t2.max_period
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_ads.tb_sales_report_data')
                AND     (customer_name = 'Others' or customer_name is null)
                and     customer_code <>'Others'
                and     customer_code <> 'Not assigned'
                AND     period != TO_CHAR(LASTDAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT(period_month,'01'),'yyyymmdd')),'yyyymmdd')
                AND     customer_code IS NOT NULL
                and     bu_1 <>'Others'
                GROUP BY bu_1
                         ,bu_2
                         ,customer_code
            ) t1
    WHERE   net_value > 0
    GROUP BY customer_code
             ,bu_1
             ,bu_2
)

WITH s_monitor_master_data_product_remark_temp AS

            ,creator
            ,modifier
            ,creator_nickname
            ,modifier_nickname
            ,create_time

                        ,modifier
                        ,creator_nickname

                        ,create_time
                        ,modify_time
                        ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_code ORDER BY modify_time DESC ) AS rn
                FROM    (

                                    ,creator
                                    ,modifier
                                    ,creator_nickname
                                    ,modifier_nickname
                                    ,create_time

                            FROM    ${dme_ods}.s_monitor_master_data_product_remark
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_monitor_master_data_product_remark')
                        ) t3
            ) t4

(
select * from (

            ,CAST(SUM(sku_ngs_amt) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS sku_ngs_amt

    GROUP BY sku_id
             ,bu_2

)t where abs(sku_ngs_amt)>0
)

 SELECT     product_code

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_master_data_product_info PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,t1.product_code
        ,t1.sku_ngs_amt
        ,t1.min_sales_day
        ,t1.max_sales_day
        ,NVL(t2.status,'待补充') AS status
        ,COALESCE(
            h.first_missing_date,  -- 如果历史数据中存在，使用最早的日期
            '${bizdate}'           -- 否则使用当前日期作为首次出现日期
        ) AS first_missing_date
        ,CASE
            WHEN f.product_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'KE24'  -- 只有first part或两者都有
            when s.product_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'VA05'
            ELSE 'KE30'                                  -- 只有second part
        END AS data_source
        ,t1.gp2
FROM    (
            SELECT  COALESCE(f.product_code,s.product_code,o.product_id) AS product_code
                    ,COALESCE(f.bu_1,s.bu_1,o.bu_1) AS bu_1
                    ,COALESCE(f.bu_2,s.bu_2,o.bu_2) AS bu_2
                    ,cast(COALESCE(f.sku_ngs_amt,s.sku_ngs_amt) as  DECIMAL(19,2)) AS sku_ngs_amt
                    ,nvl(o.gp2,0) as gp2
                    ,COALESCE(f.min_sales_day,s.min_sales_day,o.min_sales_day) AS min_sales_day
                    ,COALESCE(f.max_sales_day,s.max_sales_day,o.max_sales_day) AS max_sales_day
            FROM    first_part f
            FULL OUTER JOIN  second_part s
            ON      f.product_code = s.product_code
            full outer join third_part o
            on f.product_code = o.product_id
            WHERE   f.product_code IS NOT NULL
            OR      s.product_code IS NOT NULL
            or      o.product_id IS NOT NULL 
        ) t1
LEFT JOIN s_monitor_master_data_product_remark_temp t2
ON t1.product_code = t2.product_code
LEFT JOIN first_part f ON t1.product_code = f.product_code
LEFT JOIN second_part s ON t1.product_code = s.product_code
left join third_part o on t1.product_code = o.product_id
-- 关联历史数据获取首次出现日期
LEFT JOIN historical_data h ON t1.product_code = h.product_code
WHERE   abs(t1.sku_ngs_amt) > 0
and t1.product_code not in ('Not assigned','未分配的')

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_mapping_time_temp 
as 
--周
select 
 case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
    '-0',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) >10 and 
    substr(day_id,5,2)='01'
    then concat
    (
      cast(year(dateadd(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    else concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
  end as mapping_time,
  day_id as time_now,
 to_char(dateadd(dateadd(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy'), 
WEEKOFYEAR(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),- (weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'))*7 + 
WEEKDAY(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd')) -WEEKDAY(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), 
-(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy')),'dd'),
-(7-weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))-1),'dd'),'yyyymmdd')
as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'D.周' as `type`
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all
--月
select
substr(day_id,1,6) as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'C.月' as `type`
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all
--年
select
substr(day_id,1,4) as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'A.年' as `type`
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all
select
day_id as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'E.日' as `type`
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'
union all
--季度
select 
  CONCAT(
    SUBSTR(day_id, 1, 4),
    'Q',
    QUARTER(TO_DATE(day_id, 'yyyymmdd'))
  ) AS mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-3,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'B.季' as `type`
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}'

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_mapping_time partition(ds ='${bizdate}')
select mapping_time,
    time_now,
    time_yoy,
    time_mom,
    type,
    case when type='D.周' then concat(mapping_time,'(',substr(before,5,4),'-',substr(last,5,4),')')
        else mapping_time end mapping
from (
    select mapping_time,time_now,time_yoy,time_mom,type,
    first_value(time_now) over(partition by type,mapping_time order by time_now desc) last,
    first_value(time_now) over(partition by type,mapping_time order by time_now ) before
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_ngs_mapping_time_temp
) a

       product_code

   ,nvl(t2.second_class_name       ,'Not Categorized')   
   ,nvl(t2.third_class_name        ,'Not Categorized')          
   ,nvl(t2.fourth_class_name       ,'Not Categorized') 
   ,case when t1.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP') then  'SELECTIVE RETAILER'

   ,t3.subchannel 
   ,t3.customer_idh

   ,t1.bill_month

    SELECT  ka_group_name AS subchannel

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_pos_customer_report_bu_tmp30

select 
    a.channel        
   ,a.subchannel     
   ,a.customer_idh   
   ,a.customer_name  
   ,a.years
   ,a.months          
   ,a.bu_2
   ,sum(d.kp_value)  as     kp_amt_ytd

   select distinct
       channel        
      ,subchannel     
      ,customer_idh   
      ,customer_name  
      ,years
      ,months          
      ,bu_2
      ,kp_value  
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_pos_customer_report_bu_tmp2 
)a

   select distinct
       channel        
      ,subchannel     
      ,customer_idh   
      ,customer_name  
      ,years
      ,months          
      ,bu_2
      ,kp_value  
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_pos_customer_report_bu_tmp2 
) d
 on nvl(a.channel             ,'')= nvl(d.channel             ,'')
and nvl(a.subchannel          ,'')= nvl(d.subchannel          ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_idh        ,'')= nvl(d.customer_idh        ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_name       ,'')= nvl(d.customer_name       ,'')
and nvl(a.years               ,'')= nvl(d.years               ,'')
and nvl(a.bu_2               ,'')= nvl(d.bu_2               ,'')
and a.months >= d.months  
group by  a.channel        
   ,a.subchannel     
   ,a.customer_idh   
   ,a.customer_name  
   ,a.years
   ,a.months          
   ,a.bu_2

   ,cast(nvl(sum(b.base_unit_qty),0)    as decimal(38,10))          as   act_qty_ytd
   ,cast(nvl(max(d.kp_amt_ytd ),0) as decimal(38,10))                 as   kp_amt_ytd

   ,a.years

       ,t1.second_class_name

           ,fourth_class_name

           ,subchannel

           ,customer_name

           ,1  as  flag
       from  ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_pos_customer_report_bu_tmp2

)a

 on nvl(a.first_class_name    ,'')= nvl(b.first_class_name    ,'')
and nvl(a.second_class_name   ,'')= nvl(b.second_class_name   ,'')
and nvl(a.third_class_name    ,'')= nvl(b.third_class_name    ,'')
and nvl(a.fourth_class_name   ,'')= nvl(b.fourth_class_name   ,'')
and nvl(a.channel             ,'')= nvl(b.channel             ,'')

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 AS
SELECT  NVL(t1.channel,t2.channel) AS channel
        ,NVL(t1.subchannel,t2.subchannel) AS subchannel
        ,NVL(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh) AS customer_idh
        ,NVL(t1.customer_name,t2.customer_name) AS customer_name
        ,MAX(CAST(NVL(t1.ngs,0) AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS sellin
        ,MAX(CAST(NVL(t2.kp_value,0) AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS kp_value
        ,NVL(t1.months,t2.months) AS months
        ,NVL(t1.years,t2.years) AS years
        ,NVL(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1) AS bu_1
        ,NVL(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2) AS bu_2
        ,NVL(t1.supply_type,t2.supply_type) AS supply_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  channel
                    ,subchannel
                    ,customer_idh
                    ,customer_name
                    ,months
                    ,years
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,supply_type
                    ,SUM(ngs) AS ngs
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_detail_bu
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_detail_bu')
            GROUP BY channel
                     ,subchannel
                     ,customer_idh
                     ,customer_name
                     ,months
                     ,years
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
                     ,supply_type
        ) t1
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  a.years
                        ,a.months
                        ,a.ka AS customer_idh
                        ,a.kp_type
                        ,a.kp_value --,b.channel
                        ,CASE   WHEN a.bu IN ('SKP','SP') THEN 'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
                                WHEN a.bu IN ('Beauty Care','Laundry') THEN 'NKA'
                        END AS channel
                        ,b.subchannel
                        ,b.customer_name
                        ,CASE   WHEN a.bu IN ('SKP','SP') THEN 'Professional'
                                WHEN a.bu IN ('Beauty Care','Laundry') THEN 'Consumer'
                        END AS bu_1
                        ,a.bu AS bu_2
                        ,a.supply_type
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_nka_pos_sellin_kp_bu a
                LEFT JOIN   (
                                --  select  distinct 
                                --    channel               
                                --   ,subchannel            
                                --   ,customer_idh 
                                --   ,customer_name 
                                --  from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_mapping_bu                               
                                -- where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ka_mapping_bu')
                                SELECT  ka_group_name AS subchannel
                                        ,ka_name_en_lv1 AS customer_idh
                                        ,ka_name_cn_lv1 AS customer_name
                                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka
                                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
                                AND     ka_type_name = 'NKA'
                                GROUP BY ka_group_name
                                         ,ka_name_en_lv1
                                         ,ka_name_cn_lv1
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT  'non-Watsons' AS subchannel
                                        ,'Lirui' AS customer_idh
                                        ,'利芮' AS customer_name
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT  'non-Watsons' AS subchannel
                                        ,'CRV' AS customer_idh
                                        ,'华润' AS customer_name
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT  'non-Watsons' AS subchannel
                                        ,'RTE' AS customer_idh
                                        ,'大润发' AS customer_name
                            ) b
                ON      a.ka = b.customer_idh 
                -- and case when a.bu in ('SKP','SP') then  'SELECTIVE RETAILER'
                --          when a.bu in ('Beauty Care','Laundry') then 'NKA' end  = b.channel
                WHERE   a.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_nka_pos_sellin_kp_bu')
                AND     a.kp_type = 'sellin'
            ) t2
ON      NVL(t1.months,'') = NVL(t2.months,'')
AND     NVL(t1.customer_idh,'') = NVL(t2.customer_idh,'')
AND     NVL(t1.bu_2,'') = NVL(t2.bu_2,'')
AND     NVL(t1.supply_type,'') = NVL(t2.supply_type,'')
GROUP BY NVL(t1.channel,t2.channel)
         ,NVL(t1.subchannel,t2.subchannel)
         ,NVL(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh)
         ,NVL(t1.customer_name,t2.customer_name)
         ,NVL(t1.months,t2.months)
         ,NVL(t1.years,t2.years)
         ,NVL(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1)
         ,NVL(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2)
         ,NVL(t1.supply_type,t2.supply_type)

---计算YTD
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
select
    a.channel
   ,a.subchannel
   ,a.customer_idh
   ,a.customer_name           
   ,max(a.sellin)     as   sellin
   ,max(a.kp_value)     as   kp_value
   ,max(a.sellin_ytd)     as   sellin_ytd
   ,max(a.kp_value_ytd)     as   kp_value_ytd
   ,a.months
   ,a.years
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2
   ,max(a.sellin_py)     as   sellin_py
   ,max(a.kp_value_py)     as   kp_value_py
   ,cast(nvl(sum(e.sellin),0)    as decimal(38,10))     as   sellin_ytd_py
   ,a.supply_type
from (
     select
         a.channel
        ,a.subchannel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.customer_name           
        ,cast(nvl(max(c.sellin),0)    as decimal(38,10))     as   sellin
        ,cast(nvl(max(c.kp_value ),0) as decimal(38,10))     as   kp_value
        ,cast(nvl(sum(b.sellin),0)    as decimal(38,10))     as   sellin_ytd
        ,cast(nvl(sum(b.kp_value ),0) as decimal(38,10))     as   kp_value_ytd
        ,a.months
        ,a.years
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,cast(nvl(max(d.sellin),0)    as decimal(38,10))     as   sellin_py
        ,cast(nvl(max(d.kp_value ),0) as decimal(38,10))     as   kp_value_py
        ,a.supply_type
     from ( --先全量虚拟出表头
         select
             distinct 
             t1.channel
            ,t1.subchannel
            ,t1.customer_idh
            ,t1.customer_name
            ,t1.bu_1
            ,t1.bu_2
            ,t2.months
            ,t2.years
            ,t1.supply_type
         from (
             select distinct 
                 channel
                ,subchannel
                ,customer_idh
                ,customer_name
                ,bu_1
                ,bu_2
                ,supply_type
                ,1  as  flag
            from  ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 
         )t1
         left join  (
             select distinct 
                 months
                ,years
                ,1  as  flag
            from  ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 
         )t2
         on t1.flag = t2.flag
     )a
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 b --关联计算YTD
      on nvl(a.channel      ,'')= nvl(b.channel        ,'')
     and nvl(a.subchannel   ,'')= nvl(b.subchannel     ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh   ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_name,'')= nvl(b.customer_name  ,'')
     and nvl(a.years        ,'')= nvl(b.years          ,'')
     and nvl(a.bu_2        ,'')= nvl(b.bu_2          ,'')
     and nvl(a.supply_type        ,'')= nvl(b.supply_type          ,'')
     and a.months >= b.months       
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 c --取出当月
      on nvl(a.channel      ,'')= nvl(c.channel      ,'')
     and nvl(a.subchannel   ,'')= nvl(c.subchannel   ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')= nvl(c.customer_idh ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_name,'')= nvl(c.customer_name,'')
     and nvl(a.years        ,'')= nvl(c.years        ,'')
     and nvl(a.months       ,'')= nvl(c.months       ,'')
     and nvl(a.bu_2       ,'')= nvl(c.bu_2       ,'')
     and nvl(a.supply_type        ,'')= nvl(c.supply_type          ,'')
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sellin_customer_report_bu_tmp2 d --关联计算py
      on nvl(a.channel      ,'')= nvl(d.channel        ,'')
     and nvl(a.subchannel   ,'')= nvl(d.subchannel     ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')= nvl(d.customer_idh   ,'')
     and nvl(a.customer_name,'')= nvl(d.customer_name  ,'')
     and nvl(a.bu_2        ,'')= nvl(d.bu_2          ,'')
     and nvl(cast((cast(a.years as int)-1) as string) ,'')= nvl(d.years ,'') 
     and substr(a.months,5,2) = substr(d.months,5,2)  
     and nvl(a.supply_type        ,'')= nvl(d.supply_type          ,'')
     where a.months <= substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
     group by   a.channel
        ,a.subchannel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.customer_name

drop table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm_temp03

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm_temp03 as
select  distinct
      t1.bill_date      -- 单据日期
      ,t1.dist_code     -- 经销商编码
  from (
      select
        bill_date     -- 单据日期
        ,dist_code      -- 经销商编码
        ,sum(base_qty)    as base_qty    -- 数量
        ,sum(ges        ) as ges         -- GES价格
        ,sum(sku_ngs_amt) as sku_ngs_amt -- NGS价格
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm_temp01
     group by bill_date,dist_code
   ) t1
  left join (
      select tt1.bill_date       -- 单据日期
             ,tt1.dist_code      -- 经销商编码
             ,sum(tt1.base_qty)   as base_qty    -- 数量
             ,sum(tt1.ges        ) as ges        -- GES价格
             ,sum(tt1.sku_ngs_amt) as sku_ngs_amt -- NGS价格
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm tt1
        inner join (
           select
               bill_date
               ,dist_code
               ,max(ds) as ds
          from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm
          where ds <'${bizdate}'
          group by bill_date ,dist_code
       ) tt2
       on tt1.bill_date = tt2.bill_date
       and nvl(tt1.dist_code,'') = nvl(tt2.dist_code,'')
       and tt1.ds = tt2.ds
      where tt1.ds <'${bizdate}'
      group by tt1.bill_date,tt1.dist_code
  ) t2
   on t1.bill_date  = t2.bill_date
   and nvl(t1.dist_code ,'') = nvl(t2.dist_code ,'')
  left join (
    select distinct bill_date,dist_code from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellin_crm_temp02
  ) t3
   on t1.bill_date=t3.bill_date
   and nvl(t1.dist_code ,'') = nvl(t3.dist_code ,'')
  where concat(t3.bill_date,nvl(t3.dist_code,'')) is null -- 剔除新增
  and (nvl(t1.base_qty,0) <> nvl(t2.base_qty,0)
   or nvl(t1.ges,0) <> nvl(t2.ges,0)
   or nvl(t1.sku_ngs_amt     ,0) <> nvl(t2.sku_ngs_amt     ,0)
  )

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp04

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp04 AS
SELECT  dt_date AS bill_date -- 单据日期
        ,henkel_store_code AS store_code -- 汉高门店编码
        ,store_name AS store_name -- 汉高门店名称
        ,dist_code AS dist_code -- 经销商编码
        ,dist_name AS dist_name -- 经销商名称
        ,product_code AS prod_code -- 汉高产品编码
        ,product_name AS prod_name -- 汉高产品名称
        ,category_name AS type_name -- 汉高品类名称中文
        ,brand_name AS brand_name -- 汉高品牌名称中文
        ,CAST(SUM(actual_sales_amt) AS DECIMAL(28,4)) AS dist_prod_amt -- 经销商产品金额
        ,CAST(SUM(base_price_amt) AS DECIMAL(28,4)) AS base_sale_amt -- sell_out销售额
        ,CAST(SUM(sales_num) AS BIGINT) AS base_qty -- 基本单位数量
        ,bu_2
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t1
WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
AND     first_channel_name_lastest = 'DT'
AND     bu_1 = 'Professional'
and     product_code <>'Others'
and     substr(dt_date,1,4)>='202301'
GROUP BY dt_date
         ,henkel_store_code
         ,store_name
         ,dist_code
         ,dist_name
         ,product_code
         ,product_name
         ,category_name
         ,brand_name
         ,bu_2

-- 获取历史有变化的经销商对应的单据日期
drop table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp06

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp06 as
select  distinct
      t1.bill_date      -- 单据日期
      ,t1.dist_code     -- 经销商编码
  from (
      select 
        bill_date     -- 单据日期
        ,store_code     -- 汉高门店编码
        ,dist_code      -- 经销商编码
        ,prod_code      -- 汉高产品编码
        ,sum(dist_prod_amt) as dist_prod_amt  -- 经销商产品金额
        ,sum(base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt  -- sell_out销售额
        ,sum(base_qty     ) as base_qty       -- 基本单位数量
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp04 
     group by bill_date,store_code,dist_code,prod_code     
   ) t1
  left join (
      select tt1.bill_date       -- 单据日期
             ,tt1.store_code     -- 汉高门店编码
             ,tt1.dist_code      -- 经销商编码
             ,tt1.prod_code      -- 汉高产品编码
             ,sum(tt1.dist_prod_amt) as dist_prod_amt  -- 经销商产品金额
             ,sum(tt1.base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt  -- sell_out销售额
             ,sum(tt1.base_qty     ) as base_qty       -- 基本单位数量
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm tt1
        inner join (
           select bill_date
               ,dist_code 
               ,max(ds) as ds  
          from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm
          where ds <'${bizdate}'
          group by bill_date ,dist_code
       ) tt2 
       on tt1.bill_date = tt2.bill_date
       and tt1.dist_code = tt2.dist_code
       and tt1.ds = tt2.ds
      where tt1.ds <'${bizdate}'
      group by tt1.bill_date,tt1.store_code,tt1.dist_code,tt1.prod_code
  ) t2
   on t1.bill_date  = t2.bill_date
   and nvl(t1.store_code,'') = nvl(t2.store_code,'')
   and nvl(t1.dist_code ,'') = nvl(t2.dist_code ,'')
   and nvl(t1.prod_code ,'') = nvl(t2.prod_code ,'')
  left join (
    select distinct bill_date,dist_code from ${dme_ads}.tb_order_sellout_crm_temp05
  ) t3
   on t1.bill_date=t3.bill_date
   and t1.dist_code=t3.dist_code
  where t3.dist_code is null -- 剔除新增
  and (nvl(t1.dist_prod_amt,0) <> nvl(t2.dist_prod_amt,0)
   or nvl(t1.base_sale_amt,0) <> nvl(t2.base_sale_amt,0)
   or nvl(t1.base_qty     ,0) <> nvl(t2.base_qty     ,0)
  )

--从ke24中取GES、PPD、PLD、FG
create table ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_ke24_base as
select
customer_code  -- 客户ID
,months  --月份
,sum(ges) ges   --销售总金额GES
,sum(ppd) ppd   --临时促销折扣总费用
,sum(pld) pld   --固定促销折扣总费用
,sum(pfg) pfg   --免费品总数
,sum(adn_pb) adn_pb     --发票激励奖金总数
,sum(cbn_if) cbn_if     --发票上的合作改善基金总数
from
(
    SELECT
    if(customer_id is null,'0',customer_id) customer_code   --客户ID
    ,gross_sales_price ges  -- 销售金额GES
    ,-product_promotion_discount ppd    --临时促销折扣费用
    ,-product_listing_discount pld      --固定促销折扣费用
    ,-ppd_free_goods pfg                --免费品
    ,-adn_promotion_bonus adn_pb        --发票激励奖金
    ,-cbn_imp_fund cbn_if               --发票上的合作改善基金
    --更改
   -- ,to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd'),-1),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') months   --月份
    ,to_char(to_date(to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
    -- ,to_char(to_date(posting_date,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') months
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info where ds >= '20200101'
    --and ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
    and ds < to_char(datetrunc(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),'yyyymmdd')
)t
group by customer_code,months

--整合数据

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_base as
select
substr(months,1,4) years    --年
,(case   when substr(months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then concat(substr(months,1,4),'Q1')
        when substr(months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then concat(substr(months,1,4),'Q2')
        when substr(months,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then concat(substr(months,1,4),'Q3')
        when substr(months,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then concat(substr(months,1,4),'Q4') end) quarters--季度
,months         --月份
,customer_code  --客户代码
,customer_name  --客户名称
,customer_name_en       --客户名称英文
,region_en  --区域
,province_en    --省份
,channel_name   --渠道名
,customer_group --客户分类
,channel_hierarchy_1    --渠道层级第一级
,channel_hierarchy_2    --渠道层级第二级
,channel_hierarchy_3    --渠道层级第三级
,channel_hierarchy_4    --渠道层级第四级
,ges    --销售总金额GES
,ppd    --临时促销折扣总费用
,pld    --固定促销折扣总费用
,pfg    --免费品总数
,adn_pb --发票激励奖金总数
,cbn_if --发票上的合作改善基金总数
,l6b_ke30   --L6b Discounts off in
,l10    --L10 Commissions
,l11    --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
,l14    --L14 Total manufactur
,l16    --L16 Additional opera
,l17a   --L17a Advertising
,l17b   --Z0170 Total L17b
,l17c   --L17c Market Research
,l17    --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
,(ppd+pld+pfg) l6a                              --16a = ke24临时促销折扣费用+ke24固定促销折扣费用+ke24免费品
,(adn_pb+cbn_if+l6b_ke30) l6b                   --l6b=ke24发票激励奖金总数+ke24发票上的合作改善基金总数+ke30的L6b
,(ppd+pld+pfg) + (adn_pb+cbn_if+l6b_ke30) l6    --L6=L6a+L6b
,(ges - (ppd+pld+pfg)) ngs                      --ngs = ke24销售金额GES -16a
,(ges - (ppd+pld+pfg) - (adn_pb+cbn_if+l6b_ke30)) nes  -- nes = ngs - l6b
,(ges - (ppd+pld+pfg) - (adn_pb+cbn_if+l6b_ke30) - l10 - l11 - l14 - l16) gp1
-- gp1= nes - L10 Commissions - L11 Transp - W/H Cst - L14 Total manufactur - L16 Additional opera
,(ges - (ppd+pld+pfg) - (adn_pb+cbn_if+l6b_ke30) - l10 - l11 - l14 - l16 - l17) gp2 --gp2=gp1-L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
from
(
    select
    t1.customer_code
    ,t1.months
    -- 渠道转换需求，替换为最新的渠道相关字段字段
    ,coalesce(t4.channel_name_lastest,'Others') as channel_name    --渠道
    ,coalesce(t4.customer_group,'Others')       customer_group  --客户分类
    ,case when t4.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or t4.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then null else nvl(t4.region_en_lastest,'Others') end as region_en       --区域英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除
    ,case when t4.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'Ecom' or t4.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest = 'NKA' then null else nvl(t4.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en     --省份英文名  将NKA与Ecom从Others中摘除
    ,coalesce(t4.customer_name_en,'Others')     customer_name_en--客户英文名
    ,coalesce(t4.customer_name,'Others')        customer_name   --客户名
    ,t4.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as channel_hierarchy_1    --渠道层级第一级
    ,t4.channel_hierarchy_2_lastest as channel_hierarchy_2    --渠道层级第二级
    ,t4.channel_hierarchy_3_lastest as channel_hierarchy_3    --渠道层级第三级
    ,t4.channel_hierarchy_4_lastest as channel_hierarchy_4   --渠道层级第四级
    ,coalesce(t2.ges,0) ges    --销售金额GES
    ,coalesce(t2.ppd,0) ppd    --临时促销折扣费用
    ,coalesce(t2.pld,0) pld    --固定促销折扣费用
    ,coalesce(t2.pfg,0) pfg    --免费品
    ,coalesce(t2.adn_pb,0) adn_pb   --发票激励奖金
    ,coalesce(t2.cbn_if,0) cbn_if   --发票上的合作改善基金
    ,coalesce(t3.l6b_ke30,0) l6b_ke30   --L6b Discounts off in
    ,coalesce(t3.l10,0) l10     --L10 Commissions
    ,coalesce(t3.l11,0) l11     --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
    ,coalesce(t3.l14,0) l14     --L14 Total manufactur
    ,coalesce(t3.l16,0) l16     --L16 Additional opera
    ,coalesce(t3.l17a,0) l17a   --L17a Advertising
    ,coalesce(t3.l17b,0) l17b   --Z0170 Total L17b
    ,coalesce(t3.l17c,0) l17c   --L17c Market Research
    ,coalesce(t3.l17,0) l17     --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
    from
    (
        select
        distinct
        customer_code       --客户编号
        ,months             --月份
        from
        (
            select
            customer_code   --客户编号
            ,months         --月份
            from ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_ke24_base

            union all

            select
            customer_code   --客户编号
            ,months         --月份
            from ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_ke30_base
        )t
    )t1

    left join

    (select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_ke24_base) t2
    on t1.customer_code = t2.customer_code and t1.months = t2.months

    left join

    (select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_customer_summary_ke30_base) t3
    on t1.customer_code = t3.customer_code and t1.months = t3.months

    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer t4
    on t1.customer_code = t4.customer_code
    and t4.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') -- 取客户最新渠道信息客
   
)tt

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_mapping_time partition(ds)
select
    mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
	month_now,--当前月份
	month_mom,--上期月份
	month_yoy,--同期月份
	type,--周期类型1年/2季度/3月
	row_number() over (partition by 1 order by type asc, month_now desc) rn, --顺序
    case when type=1 then 'A.年'
         when type=2 then 'B.季'
         when type=3 then 'C.月' end as  type_chi,--周期类型名称
    substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as ds
from (
--年
select
    	substr('${bizdate}',1,4) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
		substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as month_now,--当前月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
		1 as type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月
		
union 
--季
select
        --时间映射查询年/季度/月
    	concat(substr('${bizdate}',1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'))) as mapping_time,
		substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as month_now,--当前月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-3,'mm'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
		2 as type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月

union
--月
select
    	substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
		substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as month_now,--当前月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_yoy,--同期月份
		3 as type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月

union

select
    	substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),1,4) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
		substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),1,6) as month_now,--当前月份
		to_char(dateadd(to_date(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymm') as month_mom,--上期月份

		1 as type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月
		
union

    	concat(substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd'))) as mapping_time,

		2 as type --周期类型1年/2季度/3月

--月
select
    	substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),1,6) as mapping_time,--时间映射查询年/季度/月
		substr(to_char(dateadd(to_date('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd'),1,6) as month_now,--当前月份

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_pl_product_summary_bu PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  
        SUBSTR(t.months,1,4) AS years --年度
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.months,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(t.months,'yyyymm'))) AS quarter --季度
        ,t.months --月份
        ,t.product_ph5_code AS ph5_code --ph5编码
        -- if(prd_hirarchy_5 = 'Not assigned',prd_hirarchy_5,substr(prd_hirarchy_5,14))
        , case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.ph5_name,'Others')
        else nvl(t.product_ph5_name_en,'Others') end AS ph5_name --ph5名称
        ,case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others')
        else nvl(t3.category,'Others') end as category_name_en --品类英文
        ,case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others')
        else nvl(t3.brand,'Others') end as brand_name_en --品类英文
        ,t.bu_1 -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
        ,t.bu_2 --业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
        ,CAST(SUM(ges) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ges --销售金额GES
        ,CAST(SUM(ppd) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ppd --临时促销折扣费用
        ,CAST(SUM(pld) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pld --固定促销折扣费用
        ,CAST(SUM(fg) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS pfg --免费品
        ,CAST(SUM(adn) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS adn_pb --发票激励奖金
        ,CAST(SUM(cbn) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS cbn_if --发票上的合作改善基金
        ,CAST(SUM(l6b_ke30) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6b_ke30 --Ke30的l6b
        ,CAST(SUM(l10) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l10 --L10 Commissions
        ,CAST(SUM(l11) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l11 --L11 Transp - W/H Cst
        ,CAST(SUM(l14_cog) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l14 --L14 Total manufactur
        ,CAST(SUM(l16) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l16 --L16 Additional opera
        ,CAST(SUM(l17a) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17a --L17a Advertising
        ,CAST(SUM(l17b) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17b --Z0170 Total L17b
        ,CAST(SUM(l17c) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17c --L17c Market Research
        ,CAST(SUM(ttl_l17) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l17 --L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
        ,CAST(SUM(l6a) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6a --16a = 临时促销折扣费用+固定促销折扣费用+免费品
        ,CAST(SUM(l6b) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6b --l6b=发票激励奖金总数+发票上的合作改善基金总数+L6b 
        ,CAST(SUM(l6) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS l6 --L6=L6a+L6b
        ,CAST(SUM(ngs) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS ngs --ngs=销售金额GES-16a
        ,CAST(SUM(nes) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS nes -- nes = ngs - l6b
        ,CAST(SUM(gp1) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS gp1 -- gp1= nes - L10 Commissions - L11 Transp - W/H Cst - L14 Total manufactur - L16 Additional opera
        ,CAST(SUM(ttl_gp2) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS gp2 --gp2=gp1-L17 Adv Prm & Mrk Re
        ,CAST(SUM(l10_mark_up_ii) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS mark_up_ii --mark_up_ii
        ,REPLACE(SUBSTR(GETDATE(),1,10),'-','') AS update_time --ETL更新时间
        ,t.bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_product_pl_m_bu t
LEFT JOIN   (
--零售线产品名称从s_master_data_product_idh_ph5_mapping 取
--零售线品类品牌从产品主数据取
--专业线ph5 name从事实数据取
--专业线品类品牌从s_ph5_category_brand_laundry/s_ph5_category_brand_professional 取
                SELECT  ph5_code --ph5编码
                        ,ph5_name --ph5名称
                        ,category_name_en --品类英文
                        ,brand_name_en --品牌英文
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  t1.ph5_code --ph5编码
                                    ,t1.ph5_name --ph5名称
                                    ,t2.category_name_en --品类英文
                                    ,t2.brand_name_en --品牌英文
                                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ph5_code ORDER BY priority1 + nvl(priority2,0) DESC ) AS nums
                            FROM    (
                                        SELECT  DISTINCT idh --idh编码
                                                ,case when length(ph5_code)=11 then concat('0',ph5_code) else ph5_code end as ph5_code --ph5编码
                                                ,ph5_name --ph5名称
                                                ,IF(ph5_name IS NULL OR ph5_name = '',0,1) AS priority1
                                        FROM    dme_ods.s_master_data_product_idh_ph5_mapping
                                        WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                                    ) t1
                            LEFT JOIN   (
                                            SELECT  product_code --产品编码
                                                    ,category_name_en --品类英文
                                                    ,brand_name_en --品牌英文
                                                    ,IF(category_name_en = 'Others',0,1) + IF(brand_name_en = 'Others',0,1) priority2 --品类英文+品牌英文
                                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
                                            WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                                        ) t2
                            ON      t1.idh = t2.product_code
                        ) t
                WHERE   nums = 1
            ) t2
ON      t.product_ph5_code = t2.ph5_code
left join(
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,'Laundry' AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_laundry')
       union 
       select 
         ph5         --  ph5_code   
         ,category    --  品类名称  
         ,brand       --  品牌名称  
         ,bu AS bu_2
         ,row_number()over(partition by ph5 order by idh_code desc) rn
       from ${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional
       where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ph5_category_brand_professional')
)t3 on t.product_ph5_code=t3.ph5
and upper(t.bu_2)=upper(t3.bu_2)
and t3.rn=1
WHERE   t.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_product_pl_m_bu')
AND     t.bu_2 IN ('SKP','SP','Laundry','Beauty Care')
GROUP BY 
        SUBSTR(t.months,1,4)
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(t.months,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(t.months,'yyyymm')))
        ,t.months
        ,t.product_ph5_code
        , case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.ph5_name,'Others')
        else nvl(t.product_ph5_name_en,'Others') end 
        ,case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others')
        else nvl(t3.category,'Others') end 
        ,case when t.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others')
        else nvl(t3.brand,'Others') end 
        ,t.bu_1
        ,t.bu_2
        ,t.bu_3

-------------------------------------周-------------------------------------
select 
 case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
    '-0',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
   when substr(day_id, 5, 2) = 01 
   and  weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) > 50 then concat
   (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) - 1 as string),
      '-',
    cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
  )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    else concat
  (
      cast(year(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(weekofyear(to_date(day_id, 'yyyymmdd')) as string)
    )
  end as mapping_time,
  day_id as time_now,
 to_char(dateadd(dateadd(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy'), 
WEEKOFYEAR(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),- (weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'))*7 + 
WEEKDAY(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), -(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd')) -WEEKDAY(dateadd(datetrunc(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'), 
-(weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))+1),'dd'),'yyyy'),-1,'yyyy')),'dd'),
-(7-weekday(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))-1),'dd'),'yyyymmdd')
as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'D.周' as time_type,
to_char(dateadd(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-7,'dd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mon

from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}' and day_id>='20200101'

	case when t2.category_name is null or t2.category_name='' then 'Others' 
             else t2.category_name end as category_name,--品类名称
	case when t2.brand_name_en is null or t2.brand_name_en='' then 'Others'
             else t2.brand_name_en end as brand_code,--品牌代码
	case when t2.brand_name is null or t2.brand_name='' then 'Others'

    substr('${bizdate}',1,6) as ds

    product_line_mark as product_line_mark,--核心产品线标记

    new_product_mark as new_product_mark,--新品标记

    category_name as category_name,--品类名称

    brand_name as brand_name,--品牌名称
    fourth_channel_id as fourth_channel_id,--四级渠道id chain_name(NKA)  chain_name(LKA)
    fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_name,--四级渠道名称
    third_channel_id as third_channel_id,--三级渠道id nka_customer_name(NKA)
    third_channel_name as third_channel_name,--三级渠道名称
    second_channel_id as second_channel_id,--二级渠道id   channel_group(NKA)  henkel_region(LKA)
    second_channel_name as second_channel_name,--二级渠道名称
    first_channel_id as first_channel_id,--一级渠道id store_definition(NKA LKA ECOM)
    first_channel_name as first_channel_name,--一级渠道名称
    store_code as store_code, --经销商门店编码
    store_name as store_name, --经销商门店名称
    henkel_store_code as henkel_store_code, --汉高门店代码
    henkel_store_name as henkel_store_name, --汉高门店名称
    store_grade_mark_code as store_grade_mark_code,--门店级别标记
    store_grade_mark as store_grade_mark,--门店级别标记
    store_ba_mark as store_ba_mark,--BA门店标记
    store_sfa_mark as store_sfa_mark,--SFA门店标记

    ka_name as ka_name,--ka名称

    city_name as city_name,--城市名称
    province_id as province_id,--省份id
    province_name as province_name,--省份名称
    big_region_id as big_region_id,--大区id
    big_region_name as big_region_name,--大区名称
    henkel_big_region_id as henkel_big_region_id,--汉高大区id
    henkel_big_region_name as henkel_big_region_name,--汉高大区名称
    sku_price as sku_price,--sku价格/含税零售价
    sku_sale_num as sku_sale_num,--sku销售数量
    sku_sales_amt as sku_sales_amt,--pos累计销售额
    sku_base_sales_amt as sku_base_sales_amt,--pos累计基价销售额
    month as month, --月
    year as year, --年
    dt_date as dt_date, --日期（月数据存放月，日数据存放日）
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    supply_type,
    supply_type_name,
    bu_3, -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    cast(1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as tax_rate ,-- 税率
    store_category as store_category,     -- 汉高门店分类
    store_category_lv1 as store_category_lv1, -- 汉高门店一级分类
    store_category_lv2 as store_category_lv2 -- 汉高门店二级分类
    ,cast(sku_base_sales_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt_tax  -- 基价销额含税
    ,0 as return_num          -- 退货数量
    ,0 as return_amt          -- 退款金额未税
    ,0 as return_amt_tax      -- 退货金额含税
    ,sku_sale_num  as post_return_num -- 退后数量
    ,sku_sales_amt as post_return_amt     -- 退后金额未税
    ,cast(sku_sales_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as post_return_amt_tax -- 退后金额含税

    ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
    ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,a.channel_ka_Permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）
    ,cast(a.sku_base_sales_amt as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_post_return_amt  -- 基价退前销额未税
    ,cast(a.sku_base_sales_amt*1.13 as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_post_return_amt_tax  --基价退前销额含税
   ,a.sales_channel  -- 销售渠道
   ,a.delivery_store_code --  送达门店编码
   ,a.delivery_store_name --  送达门店名称

      nvl(t.sku_id          ,'-110') as sku_id      --单品id
      ,nvl(t.sku_id         ,'-110') as sku_barcode --单品id
      ,nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as sku_name    --单品名称
      ,nvl(t.henkel_idh_code,'-110') as sku_name_id --产品IDH
      ,null                          as sell_sku_mark            --必售sku标记
      ,null                          as must_sell_sku_store_type --必售sku门店类型
      ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') as product_line_id --产品线id
      ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') as product_line_name --产品线名称
      ,decode(t1.core_product_line,'1','1','0') as product_line_mark --核心产品线标记
      ,null as product_series_id   -- 产品系列id
      ,null as product_series_name -- 产品系列名称
      ,decode(t1.premiumisation_product,'1','1','0') as high_product_mark --高端化产品标记
      ,decode(t1.new_product,'1','1','0')  as new_product_mark --新品标记
      ,nvl(t1.category_name_en,'Others')   as category_code    --品类代码
      ,nvl(t1.category_name     ,'Others') as category_name --品类名称
      ,nvl(t1.brand_name_en     ,'Others') as brand_code    --品牌代码
      ,nvl(t1.brand_name        ,'Others') as brand_name    --品牌名称
      ,t.fourth_channel_name as fourth_channel_id    -- ecom置为NULL
      ,t.fourth_channel_name  -- ecom置为NULL
      ,t.third_channel_name as third_channel_id     -- ecom改为门店名称
      ,t.third_channel_name   -- ecom改为门店名称
      ,t.second_channel_name as second_channel_id   --ecom改为store_type:专业线，零售线
      ,t.second_channel_name --ecom改为store_type:专业线，零售线
      ,t.first_channel_name       as first_channel_id    --一级渠道id store_definition(NKA LKA ECOM)
      ,t.first_channel_name  --一级渠道名称
      ,t.store_code as store_code          --门店代码
      ,t.store_name as store_name          --门店名称
      ,t.store_code as henkel_store_code   --门店代码
      ,t.store_name as henkel_store_name   --门店名称
      ,'Others'     as store_grade_mark_code --门店级别标记
      ,'Others'     as store_grade_mark      --门店级别标记
      ,'0'          as store_ba_mark         --BA门店标记
      ,'0'          as store_sfa_mark        --SFA门店标记
      ,'Others'     as store_type_mark_code  --门店类型标记
      ,'Others'     as store_type_mark       --门店类型标记
      ,t.store_name as ka_code --ka代码
      ,t.store_name as ka_name --ka名称
      ,t.city_name as city_id         --城市id 将ecom数据中的 大区省份等信息置为空
      ,t.city_name as city_name       --城市名称
      ,t.province_name as province_id     --省份id
      ,t.province_name as province_name   --省份名称A
      ,null as big_region_id   --大区id
      ,null as big_region_name --大区名称
      ,null as henkel_big_region_id   --汉高大区id
      ,null as henkel_big_region_name --汉高大区名称
      ,cast(t.sku_price     as decimal(28,6)) as sku_price          --sku价格/含税零售价
      ,sum(t.sku_sale_num)                         as sku_sale_num       --sku销售数量
      ,cast(sum(t.sku_sales_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as sku_sales_amt      --pos累计销售额
      ,cast(sum(t.base_price_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as sku_base_sales_amt --pos累计基价销售额
      ,substr(t.dt_date,1,6) as month --月份
      ,substr(t.dt_date,1,4) as year --年度
      ,case when t.dt_date<'20220101' then substr(t.dt_date,1,6) else t.dt_date end as dt_date
      ,t.bu_1
      ,t.bu_2
      ,null as supply_type
      ,null as supply_type_name
      ,t.bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
      ,t.tax_rate -- 税率
      ,t.henkel_store_category as store_category     -- 汉高门店分类
      ,t.henkel_store_category_lv1 as store_category_lv1 -- 汉高门店一级分类
      ,t.henkel_store_category_lv2   as store_category_lv2 -- 汉高门店二级分类
      ,cast(sum(t.base_price_amt_tax )  as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_amt_tax  -- 基价销额含税
      ,cast(sum(t.return_num         )  as bigint) as return_num          -- 退货数量
      ,cast(sum(t.return_amt         )  as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt          -- 退款金额未税
      ,cast(sum(t.return_amt_tax     )  as decimal(28,6)) as return_amt_tax      -- 退货金额含税
      ,cast(sum(t.post_return_num    )  as bigint) as post_return_num     -- 退后数量
      ,cast(sum(t.post_return_amt    )  as decimal(28,6)) as post_return_amt     -- 退后金额未税
      ,cast(sum(t.post_return_amt_tax)  as decimal(28,6)) as post_return_amt_tax -- 退后金额含税
      ,t.customer_code      -- 客户编码
      ,t.customer_name      -- 客户中文
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.region_lastest     ,'Others') end as region_cust_lastest      -- 区域(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.region_en_lastest  ,'Others') end as region_en_cust_lastest   -- 区域英文(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.province_lastest   ,'Others') end as province_cust_lastest    -- 省份(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.province_en_lastest,'Others') end as province_en_cust_lastest -- 省份英文(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then '直供客户' else nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') end as first_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then if(t4.KA_Group_Name='Others','OT',t4.KA_Group_Name)
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.region_lastest,'Others')
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then nvl(t2.customer_name,'Others')
           else 'Others'
         end as second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then nvl(t3.chain_name,'Others')
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.province_lastest,'Others')
           else null
         end as third_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then null
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.customer_name,'Others')
           else null
         end as fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）
      ,cast(sum(t.base_price_post_return_amt)  as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_post_return_amt      -- 基价退后未税金额
      ,cast(sum(t.base_price_post_return_amt_tax)  as decimal(28,6)) as base_price_post_return_amt_tax      -- 基价退后含税金额    
      ,t.sales_channel  -- 销售渠道
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu t
  left outer join (
      select  
          *
      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu  --关联产品主数据
      where ds<>''
  ) t1
  on t.sku_id=t1.product_barcode
  and t.dt_date =t1.ds
  and t.bu_1=t1.bu_1
  and t.bu_2=t1.bu_2
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu t2
   on t.customer_code=t2.customer_code
   and substr(t.dt_date,1,6)=substr(t2.ds,1,6)
   and t2.ds like '%01'
   and t.bu_2=t2.bu_2 
  left join (
    select distinct store_code,ka_code,split(chain_name,'-')[0] as chain_name
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(store_code,'')<>''
    and upper(store_category) in ('线上分销','ECOM')
  ) t3
   on case when t.customer_code='100006' then t.store_code end=t3.store_code
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka t4
   on t3.ka_code = t4.KA_Code
   and t4.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
  where t.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu')
  and (nvl(t.sku_sale_num,0)<>0 or nvl(t.sku_sales_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(t.base_price_amt,0)<>0 
           or nvl(t.base_price_amt_tax,0)<>0 or nvl(t.return_num,0)<>0 or nvl(t.return_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(t.return_amt_tax,0)<>0
           or nvl(t.post_return_num,0)<>0 or nvl(t.post_return_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(t.post_return_amt_tax,0)<>0 
      )
  group by 
      nvl(t.sku_id         ,'-110') --单品id
      ,nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') --单品名称
      ,nvl(t.henkel_idh_code,'-110') --产品IDH
      ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') --产品线id
      ,decode(t1.core_product_line,'1','1','0')       --核心产品线标记
      ,decode(t1.premiumisation_product,'1','1','0')  --高端化产品标记
      ,decode(t1.new_product,'1','1','0')  --新品标记
      ,nvl(t1.category_name_en,'Others')   --品类代码
      ,nvl(t1.category_name     ,'Others') --品类名称
      ,nvl(t1.brand_name_en     ,'Others') --品牌代码
      ,nvl(t1.brand_name        ,'Others') --品牌名称
      ,t.fourth_channel_name
      ,t.third_channel_name
      ,t.second_channel_name
      ,t.first_channel_name
      ,t.store_code --门店代码
      ,t.store_name --门店名称
      ,t.city_name       --城市名称
      ,t.province_name   --省份名称A
      ,cast(t.sku_price     as decimal(28,6))      --sku价格/含税零售价
      ,substr(t.dt_date,1,6)  --月份
      ,substr(t.dt_date,1,4) --年度
      ,case when t.dt_date<'20220101' then substr(t.dt_date,1,6) else t.dt_date end
      ,t.bu_1
      ,t.bu_2
      ,t.bu_3 -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
      ,t.tax_rate -- 税率
      ,t.henkel_store_category      -- 汉高门店分类
      ,t.henkel_store_category_lv1  -- 汉高门店一级分类
      ,t.henkel_store_category_lv2  -- 汉高门店二级分类
      ,t.customer_code      -- 客户编码
      ,t.customer_name      -- 客户中文
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.region_lastest     ,'Others') end  -- 区域(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.region_en_lastest  ,'Others') end  -- 区域英文(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.province_lastest   ,'Others') end  -- 省份(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') or upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then 'Others' else nvl(t2.province_en_lastest,'Others') end  -- 省份英文(最新)
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then '直供客户' else nvl(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others') end   -- 客户维度一级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then if(t4.KA_Group_Name='Others','OT',t4.KA_Group_Name)
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.region_lastest,'Others')
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) ='ECOM' then nvl(t2.customer_name,'Others')
           else 'Others'
         end   -- 客户维度二级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then nvl(t3.chain_name,'Others')
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.province_lastest,'Others')
           else null
         end   -- 客户维度三级渠道（最新）
      ,case when t.customer_code in('100006','100000') then null
            when upper(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest) in ('MPD','DT') then nvl(t2.customer_name,'Others')
           else null
         end   -- 客户维度四级渠道（最新）    
      ,t.sales_channel  -- 销售渠道
)

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_price_mapping_time partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select
substr(day_id,1,4) as mapping_time,
day_id as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
'A.年' as time_type
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}' and day_id>='20200101'
union all 
--年 如果今年是平年，去年是闰年，需要补充一条记录
select
year_ as mapping_time,
null as time_now,
concat(cast(year_ as bigint)-1,'0229') as time_yoy,
concat(cast(year_ as bigint)-1,'0229') as time_mom,
'A.年' as time_type
from
( 
select  substr(day_id,1,6) as month_,
        substr(day_id,1,4) as year_
 from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
where  day_id <='${bizdate}'
and day_id>='20200101'
and substr(day_id,5,2) in('02') 
and ((cast(substr(day_id,1,4)as bigint)-1) %4=0  and (cast(substr(day_id,1,4)as bigint)-1) %100 != 0 or (cast(substr(day_id,1,4)as bigint)-1)%400=0 )
group by substr(day_id,1,6),substr(day_id,1,4)
) a 
--拼接一个年
union all

select
substr(day_id,1,4) as mapping_time,
substr(day_id,1,6) as time_now,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_yoy,
to_char(dateadd(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymm') as time_mom,
'A.年'
from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day where day_id <='${bizdate}' and day_id>='20200101'
and day_id like '%01'

union all
