---前端逻辑 ，先根据两个筛选器筛出每月最后一天是哪天，再join取月的数据

drop  table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1 AS
select 
   t2.region_cn               as  region	      
  ,t2.province_cn             as  province	  
  ,t.customer_code	          as  customer_code
  ,t2.customer_name           as  customer_name
  ,t3.customer_system         as  customer_type	      
  ,t3.customer_head_of_sales  as  customer_head_of_sales
  ,t3.provincial_manager      as  provincial_manager
  ,t.value_type
  ,t.actual_num
  ,t.actual_amt
  ,t.data_date
from 
(  --sell_out
    select 
         a.data_date
        ,a.dist_code        as  customer_code
        ,sum(a.sale_num)    as  actual_num
        ,sum(a.sell_out)    as  actual_amt
        ,'Sell Out (Base price)'  as  value_type
    from(
        select
           bill_date as  data_date, --单据日期
           sum(base_qty) as sale_num,--出库数量
           sum(base_qty * base_price) as sell_out, --sell_out销售额
           dist_code
        from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale
        where
              ds <>''
          and prod_type_name = '零售线' and prod_code not like '%qita%' 
          and store_code <>'qita'
          and brand_name <> '' 
          and brand_name is not null 
        group by bill_date,dist_code
    ) a 
    join 
    (   --常规为DT、化妆品渠道为COS、深分为BC
        select dist_code 
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor 
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor') 
        and dist_type_code in('化妆品渠道','常规','深分')
    ) b 
    on a.dist_code=b.dist_code
    group by a.data_date
        ,a.dist_code 
        
    union all 
    
    --expense_claim
    select 
         to_char(to_date(data_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as  data_date
        ,customer_idh as customer_code
        ,sum(cast(NULL as decimal))                  as  actual_num
        ,sum(cast(actual_expense_claim as decimal))  as  actual_amt
        ,'Expense Claim'                        as  value_type
    from dme_ods.s_ar_rawdata_sop 
    where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_ar_rawdata_sop') 
    group by to_char(to_date(data_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') 
        ,customer_idh
        
    union all 

    --cash_collection
    select 
         to_char(to_date(data_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd') as  data_date
        ,customer_idh as customer_code
        ,sum(cast(NULL as decimal))                    as  actual_num
        ,sum(cast(actual_cash_collection as decimal))  as  actual_amt
        ,'Cash Collection'                        as  value_type
    from dme_ods.s_ar_rawdata_sop
    where ds =max_pt('dme_ods.s_ar_rawdata_sop') 
    group by to_char(to_date(data_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd')
        ,customer_idh
        
    union all 
    
    --sell_in
    select 
         period                                 as  data_date
        ,customer_code
        ,sum(cast(NULL as decimal))                  as  actual_num
        ,sum(cast(mtd_sales_value as decimal))       as  actual_amt
        ,'Sell In (NGS)'                              as  value_type
    from 
    ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_report_data
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_sales_report_data') 
      and period >= '20230101'
    group by period
        ,customer_code
        
    union all 
      
    ----sell_in 历史数据      
    select to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd')             as  data_date
          ,customer_id
          ,sum(cast(NULL as decimal))                   as  actual_num
          ,sum(gross_sales_price+product_promotion_discount+product_listing_discount+ppd_free_goods)  as  actual_amt
          ,'Sell In (NGS)'                              as  value_type
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info
    where 
        ds is not null
        and to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd') between '20220101' and '20221231'
    group by customer_id, to_char(posting_date,'yyyymmdd')
)t
join 
(   --常规为DT、化妆品渠道为COS、深分为BC
    --关联DMS的销售负责人mapping，取到销售负责和省经理
    select 
         t1.dist_code
        ,decode(t1.dist_type_code,'常规','DT','深分','BC','化妆品渠道','COS')  as  customer_system
        ,t2.customer_head_of_sales
        ,t2.provincial_manager
    from dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor t1
    left join
    (
        select 
            customer_code
           ,customer_head_of_sales
           ,provincial_manager
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_sales_head_mapping_sop
        where ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_customer_sales_head_mapping_sop') 
        group by customer_code
            ,customer_head_of_sales
            ,provincial_manager
    )t2
    on t1.dist_code = t2.customer_code
    where t1.ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_dms_mdm_distributor') 
      and t1.dist_type_code in('化妆品渠道','常规','深分')
    group by  t1.dist_code
        ,decode(t1.dist_type_code,'常规','DT','深分','BC','化妆品渠道','COS')
        ,t2.customer_head_of_sales
        ,t2.provincial_manager
) t3 
on t.customer_code = t3.dist_code
left join
(
    select
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch  as  region_cn
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch  as  province_cn
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer a 
    left join (  --取省份的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'province'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )b
    on a.province_en = b.area_en
     left join (  --取区域的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'area'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )c
    on a.region_en = c.area_en
    where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') 
    group by
        customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch  
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch 
        
   union all 
   
   --补上小经销商的信息
   select distinct
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,decode(region_en,'Central','中区','East','东区','North','北区','South','南区','West','西区')  as  region_cn
        ,'Others'  as  province_en
        ,'Others'  as  province_cn    
   from ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info
   
)t2
on t.customer_code = t2.customer_code
where substr(t.data_date,1,4) >= '2022' --先保留2023年之后的当期数据，保障同比可计算，因此需要到2022

-- 取出所有的维度集合
drop  table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp111

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp111 AS
select
    distinct
     t.region	             
    ,t.province	          
    ,t.customer_code         
    ,t.customer_name         
    ,t.customer_type	     
    ,t.customer_head_of_sales
    ,t.provincial_manager 
    ,t1.value_type
    ,t.months
    ,case when t1.value_type not in ('Sell In (NGS)','Expense Claim','Cash Collection') then b.data_date else c.data_date end as data_date
from 
(
    select 
        distinct
        region	             
        ,province	          
        ,customer_code         
        ,customer_name         
        ,customer_type	     
        ,customer_head_of_sales
        ,provincial_manager 
       -- ,value_type
        ,substr(data_date,1,6) as months
        ,1  as flag
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1
    
    union 
    
    select 
        distinct
        region	             
        ,province	          
        ,customer_code         
        ,customer_name         
        ,customer_type	     
        ,customer_head_of_sales
        ,provincial_manager
       -- ,value_type
        ,months
        ,1  as flag
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp11
)t
left join 
(
     select 'AR Balance'             as  value_type,1  as flag union all
     select 'Cash Collection'        as  value_type,1  as flag union all
     select 'Expense Claim'          as  value_type,1  as flag union all
     select 'Sell In (NGS)'          as  value_type,1  as flag union all
     select 'Sell Out (Base price)'  as  value_type,1  as flag
)t1
on t.flag = t1.flag
left join (
    select 
        substr(data_date,1,6) as months
       ,data_date
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1
    group by substr(data_date,1,6)
       ,data_date
)b
on t.months = b.months
and t1.value_type <> 'Sell In (NGS)'
left join (
    select 
        substr(data_date,1,6) as months
       ,data_date
       ,value_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1
    where value_type in ('Sell In (NGS)','Expense Claim','Cash Collection')
    group by substr(data_date,1,6)
       ,data_date
       ,value_type
)c
on t.months = c.months
and t1.value_type = c.value_type

---算出每天的MTD值，用作天粒度的筛选
drop  table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp2 AS
--非sellin的数据，join出每月截止当天的MTD数据
---这段做了笛卡尔积，如果性能太差，可考虑分区域拆分来做笛卡尔积
select 
   t1.region	             as region	              
  ,t1.province	             as province	          
  ,t1.customer_code          as customer_code         
  ,t1.customer_name          as customer_name         
  ,t1.customer_type	         as customer_type	      
  ,t1.customer_head_of_sales as customer_head_of_sales
  ,t1.provincial_manager     as provincial_manager    
  ,t1.value_type             as value_type
  ,t1.data_date              as data_date
  ,t1.months                 as months
  ,sum(t2.actual_num)                                           as actual_num
  ,sum(t2.actual_amt)                                           as actual_amt
from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp111 t1
left join 
(
   select  t1.region	             
          ,t1.province	          
          ,t1.customer_code         
          ,t1.customer_name         
          ,t1.customer_type	     
          ,t1.customer_head_of_sales
          ,t1.provincial_manager 
          ,t1.value_type
          ,t1.months
          ,t1.data_date
          ,t2.actual_num
          ,t2.actual_amt
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp111 t1
   left join ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1 t2
   on  t1.region	             = t2.region	             
   and t1.province	             = t2.province	          
   and t1.customer_code          = t2.customer_code         
   and t1.customer_name          = t2.customer_name         
   and t1.customer_type	         = t2.customer_type	     
   and t1.customer_head_of_sales = t2.customer_head_of_sales
   and t1.provincial_manager     = t2.provincial_manager 
   and t1.value_type             = t2.value_type
   -- and t1.months                 = t2.months
   and t1.data_date              = t2.data_date

)t2 
on t1.months = t2.months
and t1.value_type = t2.value_type
and t1.customer_code = t2.customer_code
and ((t2.value_type not in ('Sell In (NGS)','Expense Claim','Cash Collection') and  t2.months>= '202301') 
     OR (t2.months< '202301' and t2.value_type not in ('Expense Claim','Cash Collection') ))
where  (t1.data_date >= t2.data_date and t1.value_type <> 'AR Balance' )--要算每天的MTD
OR (t1.data_date <= '${bizdate}' and t1.value_type = 'AR Balance' )     --AR Balance的月数据，所以不需要算每天的MTD
group by t1.region	            
  ,t1.province	             
  ,t1.customer_code          
  ,t1.customer_name          
  ,t1.customer_type	         
  ,t1.customer_head_of_sales 
  ,t1.provincial_manager     
  ,t1.value_type             
  ,t1.data_date              
  ,t1.months 

union  all 

--sellin的销售数据，由于data_date不连贯，所以，单独拎出来关联
select 
   t1.region	              
  ,t1.province	          
  ,t1.customer_code         
  ,t1.customer_name         
  ,t1.customer_type	      
  ,t1.customer_head_of_sales
  ,t1.provincial_manager    
  ,t1.value_type
  ,t1.data_date
  ,t1.months
  ,t2.actual_num
  ,t2.actual_amt
from ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp111 t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_dt_sop_tmp1 t2 
on    t1.data_date              = t2.data_date         
and   t1.customer_code          = t2.customer_code         
and   t1.customer_name          = t2.customer_name         
and   t1.region                 = t2.region                
and   t1.province               = t2.province

--从DMS取数时剔除KA名称为'大润发华南'的记录
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_ka_sop_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_ka_sop_tmp1 AS
select
    a.dist_code                AS  customer_code  --经销商编码
   ,t2.customer_name           AS  customer_name 
   ,case when b.channel_name = '大润发华南' then '南区' else t2.region_cn end    AS  Region
   ,case when b.channel_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t2.province_cn end  AS  Province --当KA名称为'大润发华北'时省份调整为'山东省'
   ,b.store_code               AS  store_code
   ,b.store_name               AS  store_name
   ,b.nature_name              AS  ka_type
   ,case when b.channel_name like '%华润苏果%' then '华润苏果'  else  b.channel_name  end  AS  ka_name
   ,t3.rkam                    AS  rkam
   ,sum(base_qty)              AS  sale_num       --数量
   ,sum(base_qty*base_price)   AS  base_sale_amt  --sell_out销售额
   ,a.bill_date                AS  data_date
   ,substr(a.bill_date,1,6)    AS  months
   ,substr(a.bill_date,1,4)    AS  years
   ,concat(substr(a.bill_date,1,4),DECODE(substr(a.bill_date,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))    as    quarter      
from
   ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale a
join (
    select store_code,store_name,nature_name,channel_name
     from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_store 
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_mdm_store')   
      and nature_name in ('LKA','NKA') --只取门店性质为LKA或NKA的记录
     -- and channel_name <> '大润发华南'
    group by  store_code,store_name,nature_name,channel_name    
)b
on a.store_code = b.store_code
left join
(
    select
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch  as  region_cn
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch  as  province_cn
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer a 
    left join (  --取省份的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'province'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )b
    on a.province_en = b.area_en
    left join (  --取区域的中文
        select area_en,area_ch
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dim_area_trans') 
          and area_type = 'area'
        group by area_en,area_ch
    )c
    on a.region_en = c.area_en
    where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer') 
    group by
          customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,c.area_ch 
        ,province_en
        ,b.area_ch 
        
   union all 
   
   --补上小经销商的信息
   select distinct
         customer_code                         --用户id
        ,customer_name
        ,channel_hierarchy_1                   --一级渠道
        ,region_en                             --大区
        ,decode(region_en,'Central','中区','East','东区','North','北区','South','南区','West','西区')  as  region_cn
        ,'Others'  as  province_en
        ,'Others'  as  province_cn    
   from ${dme_cdm}.dim_dt_small_customer_info
   
   
) t2
on a.dist_code = t2.customer_code
left join 
(  
    select
         province         
        ,ka_type           
        ,region_ka_name    
        ,rkam    
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping a 
   where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping') 
   group by province         
        ,ka_type           
        ,region_ka_name    
        ,rkam 
)t3
 on case when b.channel_name like '%华润苏果%' then '华润苏果'  else  b.channel_name  end = t3.region_ka_name
and case when b.channel_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t2.province_cn end = t3.province
where a.ds<>'' and a.prod_type_name = '零售线' 
and a.prod_code not like '%qita%' 
and a.store_code <>'qita'
and a.brand_name <> '' 
and a.brand_name is not null 
group by a.dist_code          
   ,t2.customer_name          
   ,case when b.channel_name  = '大润发华南' then '南区' else t2.region_cn end              
   ,case when b.channel_name = '大润发华北' then '山东省' else t2.province_cn end 
   ,b.store_code              
   ,b.store_name              
   ,b.nature_name             
   ,case when b.channel_name like '%华润苏果%' then '华润苏果'  else  b.channel_name  end           
   ,t3.rkam                   
   ,a.bill_date   
   ,substr(a.bill_date,1,6)   
   ,substr(a.bill_date,1,4)   
   ,concat(substr(a.bill_date,1,4),DECODE(substr(a.bill_date,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))

---计算POS
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_ka_sop_tmp2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_daliy_report_ka_sop_tmp2 AS
select
    t2.distributer_code                              AS  customer_code  --经销商编码
   ,t3.customer_name                                 AS  customer_name 
   ,case when t1.third_channel_name = '家家悦' then '东区'
         else nvl(t1.henkel_region_name,t2.henkel_region) end      AS  region
   ,case when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name = '大润发')  then t2.province_name
         when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name <> '大润发') OR t1.third_channel_name like '%世纪联华%' then t1.province_name
         when t1.dist_system_type = 'LKA' AND t1.third_channel_name not like '%世纪联华%' then t3.province  
         end                                         AS  Province 
   ,t2.store_code                                    AS  store_code
   ,t2.store_name                                    AS  store_name
   ,t1.dist_system_type                              AS  ka_type
   ,case when t1.third_channel_name = '华润'   then  t1.fourth_channel_name 
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('山东省')  then  '大润发华北'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省') then '大润发华东'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name not in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省','山东省') then t2.chain_name   
         else t1.third_channel_name end              AS  ka_name
   ,t4.rkam                                          AS  rkam
   ,sum(t1.base_unit_qty)                            AS  base_unit_qty
   ,sum(t1.original_amt_untax)                       AS  original_amt_untax
   ,sum(t1.base_sales_amt)                           AS  base_sales_amt
   ,t1.bill_date  AS  data_date
   ,substr(t1.bill_date,1,6)    AS  months
   ,substr(t1.bill_date,1,4)    AS  years
   ,concat(substr(t1.bill_date,1,4),DECODE(substr(t1.bill_date,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))    as    quarter      
from 
(  select
         henkel_store_code
        ,base_sales_amt     --基价销额
        ,original_amt_untax --原始销额，未税
        ,base_unit_qty      --原始销量
        ,henkel_region_name
        ,province_name
        ,dist_system_type
        ,third_channel_name
        ,fourth_channel_name
        ,bill_date
    from  ---上线前需要改回生产的表
       ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily 
    where ds >='20220101' and third_channel_name <> '台客隆' --仅2021存在两笔，先剔除
    and base_unit_qty <> 0
    and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
    
    union all 
    
    --'大润发'根据省份，区分为'大润发华北'（山东省）和'大润发华东'（江苏省、浙江省、上海、安徽省）
    select 
       coalesce(a.store_code,'-110') as henkel_store_code
      ,cast(nvl(a.base_qty,0) * nvl(t2.product_base_price,0) AS DECIMAL(28,2))    as base_sales_amt  
      ,cast(case when tax_ind = 1 then nvl(original_amount,0)/(nvl(cast(tax_rate as double),0) + 1)
            else nvl(original_amount,0)
            end AS DECIMAL(28,2))        as original_amt_untax -- 原始金额(未税）
      ,cast(base_qty as bigint)          as base_unit_qty
      ,cast(NULL  as string)             as henkel_region_name
      ,cast(NULL  as string)             as province_name
      ,a.dist_type                       as dist_system_type
      ,a.dist_name                       as third_channel_name
      ,cast(NULL  as string)             as fourth_channel_name
      ,to_char(to_date(
         case when bill_date like '%/%' then
            concat(split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',1),
            '-',
            case when length(split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',2))=1 then concat('0',split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',2)) else                  split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',2) end,
            '-',
            case when length(split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',3))=1 then concat('0',split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',3)) else                  split_part(split_part(bill_date,' ',1),'/',3) end,
            ' 00:00:00'
            )
         else bill_date end 
        , 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymmdd')  as  bill_date
    from
        ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale a
    left join 
    (
    -- 获取产品主数据中产品的相关信息
    select
        product_code as henkel_prod_code, -- KA产品编码
        product_base_price -- 产品基价
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product
    where
        ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product')
    ) t2 on a.prod_code = t2.henkel_prod_code    
   where a.ds <> '1'
      and to_char(to_date(bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') >= '202201'
      and a.dist_code = 'KA0005'  -- 大润发数据不在POS日表中，需要额外释放
      and a.dist_name = '大润发'  -- 除此之外均为大润发手工的月数据
) t1  --ka_pos销售信息
left join
(   select
         store_code
        ,store_name
        ,distributer_code
        ,distributer_province
        ,henkel_region
        ,province_name
        ,city_name
        ,store_manager
        ,ba_name
        ,chain_name
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos                                --pos需求用门店主数据表
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_pos')
) t2
on t1.henkel_store_code = t2.store_code
left join
(
    SELECT
         customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,province
    from
        ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer 
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer')
    group by
        customer_code
        ,customer_name
        ,province
) t3
on t2.distributer_code = t3.customer_code
left join 
(  
    select
         province         
        ,ka_type           
        ,region_ka_name    
        ,rkam    
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping a 
   where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_region_rkam_mapping') 
   group by province         
        ,ka_type           
        ,region_ka_name    
        ,rkam 
)t4
on case when t1.third_channel_name = '华润'   then  t1.fourth_channel_name 
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('山东省')  then  '大润发华北'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省') then '大润发华东'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name not in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省','山东省') then t2.chain_name   
         else t1.third_channel_name end   = t4.region_ka_name
and case when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name = '大润发')  then t2.province_name
         when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name <> '大润发') OR t1.third_channel_name like '%世纪联华%' then t1.province_name
         when t1.dist_system_type = 'LKA' AND t1.third_channel_name not like '%世纪联华%' then t3.province 
         end = t4.province
where t3.customer_name is not null 
group by t2.distributer_code                         
   ,t3.customer_name                                 
   ,case when t1.third_channel_name = '家家悦' then '东区'
         else nvl(t1.henkel_region_name,t2.henkel_region) end        
   ,case when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name = '大润发')  then t2.province_name
         when (t1.dist_system_type = 'NKA' and t1.third_channel_name <> '大润发') OR t1.third_channel_name like '%世纪联华%' then t1.province_name
         when t1.dist_system_type = 'LKA' AND t1.third_channel_name not like '%世纪联华%' then t3.province   
         end                                        
   ,t2.store_code                                   
   ,t2.store_name                                   
   ,t1.dist_system_type                             
   ,case when t1.third_channel_name = '华润'   then  t1.fourth_channel_name 
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('山东省')  then  '大润发华北'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省') then '大润发华东'   
         when t1.third_channel_name = '大润发' and t2.province_name not in ('江苏省','浙江省','上海市','安徽省','山东省') then t2.chain_name   
         else t1.third_channel_name end             
   ,t4.rkam                                          
   ,t1.bill_date
   ,substr(t1.bill_date,1,6)   
   ,substr(t1.bill_date,1,4)   
   ,concat(substr(t1.bill_date,1,4),DECODE(substr(t1.bill_date,5,2),'01','Q1','02','Q1','03','Q1','04','Q2','05','Q2','06','Q2','07','Q3','08','Q3','09','Q3','10','Q4','11','Q4','12','Q4'))

     ,t1.rkam

--算出每一期的当期值
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_report_data partition (ds)
select 
    t1.period                    as  period                       --统计日期
   ,t1.period_month              as  period_month                 --统计月
   ,t1.sales_organization       as  sales_organization           --销售组织
   ,t1.saty                     as  saty                         --销售凭证类型
   ,t1.created_date             as  created_date                 --创建日期
   ,t1.bill_date                as  bill_date                    --账单日期
   ,t1.req_dlv_date             as  req_dlv_date                 --交货日期
   ,nvl(t1.customer_code ,'Others')        as  customer_code                --客户代码
   ,nvl(t1.customer_name ,'Others')        as  customer_name                --客户名
   ,nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest  ,'Others')        as  first_channel_name           --一级渠道名
   ,nvl(case when t1.second_channel_name_lastest in ('HomeClub','Wanjia','CRV-SG','Tesco','CRV-W')   then 'CRV'
             else t1.second_channel_name_lastest end  ,'Others')                as  second_channel_name          --二级渠道名
   ,t1.sales_doc                as  sales_doc                    --销售单号
   ,t1.status                   as  status                       --订单状态细分编码
   ,t1.partner_status           as  partner_status               --订单状态
   ,t1.sub_status               as  sub_status                   --订单子状态
   ,case when  t1.sub_status = '1. Frozen Orders' then '1. Frozen Orders' 
         when  t1.sub_status IN ('2a. Finance Released- To be picked','2b. Finance Released- To be delivered')  then '2. Finance Released - TO BE Good Issued'  
         when  t1.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then '3. Order Finalized & Goods Issued'  end       as  custom_status                   --自定义订单状态
   ,t1.consumed_working_days    as  consumed_working_days        --当月已消耗工作日
   ,t1.working_days             as  working_days                 --当月工作日天数
   ,t1.net_value                as  net_value                    --销额
   ,cast(NULL as decimal(38,10))              AS  ngs_target                   --当月NGS目标值  
   ,case when t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value  else NULL end                                                                                                      as  mtd_sales_value 
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                           as  frozen_orders 
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                 as  released_orders                 --待拣配订单销额
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2a. Finance Released- To be picked'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                            as  2a_released_orders              --已出库待送达订单净销额
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2b. Finance Released- To be delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                         as  2b_released_orders              --已出库待送达订单净销额
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                               as  2c_released_orders              --已送达订单净销额
   ,case when t1.order_type in ('当月订单' ,'下月订单') then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                                                           as  received_orders_reject_returns  --剔除退单订单净销额（包含当月订单和NKA下月交货订单）
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单'  then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                as  est_sales_value_current         --剔除退单已发出订单净销额
   ,case when t1.order_type in ('下月订单') then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                                                                       as  est_sales_value_next            --剔除退单NKA下月交货订单净销额
   ,case when t1.sub_status in ('2c. Finance Released- Delivered','2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing') and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                as  released_orders_reject_returns  --剔除退单已送达订单净销额
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end                                                           as  frozen_orders_reject_returns    --剔除退单冻结订单净销额
   ,case when t1.sub_status IN ('2a. Finance Released- To be picked','2b. Finance Released- To be delivered')  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL end  as  good_issued_reject_returns      --剔除退单待送达订单净销额
   ,t1.bu_1 as bu_1
   ,t1.bu_2 as bu_2
   ,nvl(t1.product_code,'Others') as product_code
   ,nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as product_name
   ,nvl(t1.order_qty,0  ) as order_qty      
   ,case when t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty  else NULL end                                                                                                      as mtd_sales_qty                      
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                           as frozen_order_qty                   
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                 as released_order_qty                  --待拣配订单销量
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2a. Finance Released- To be picked'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                            as a_released_order_qty                --已出库待送达订单净销量
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2b. Finance Released- To be delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                         as b_released_order_qty                --已出库待送达订单净销量
   ,case when t1.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                               as c_released_order_qty                --已送达订单净销量
   ,case when t1.order_type in ('当月订单' ,'下月订单') then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                                                           as received_orders_reject_return_qty   --剔除退单订单净销量（包含当月订单和NKA下月交货订单）
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单'  then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                as est_sales_current_qty               --剔除退单已发出订单净销量
   ,case when t1.order_type in ('下月订单') then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                                                                       as est_sales_next_qty                  --剔除退单NKA下月交货订单净销量
   ,case when t1.sub_status in ('2c. Finance Released- Delivered','2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing') and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                as released_orders_reject_return_qty   --剔除退单已送达订单净销量
   ,case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                                           as frozen_orders_reject_return_qty     --剔除退单冻结订单净销量
   ,case when t1.sub_status IN ('2a. Finance Released- To be picked','2b. Finance Released- To be delivered')  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL end  as good_issued_reject_return_qty       --剔除退单待送达订单净销量
   ,t1.box_size
   ,t1.remark
   ,t1.order_type
   ,t1.is_fg
   ,t1.ges
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.net_value else NULL  end  as decimal(28,6))  as  d_released_orders              --已送达订单净销额w/o billing
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end  as BIGINT)  as  d_released_order_qty           --已送达订单净销量w/o billing
   
   ,cast(case when t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges  else NULL end                                                                                                        as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_mtd_sales_value 
   ,cast(case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                             as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_frozen_orders 
   ,cast(case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                   as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_released_orders                 --待拣配订单销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2a. Finance Released- To be picked'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                              as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_2a_released_orders              --已出库待送达订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2b. Finance Released- To be delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                           as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_2b_released_orders              --已出库待送达订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                 as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_2c_released_orders              --已送达订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.order_type in ('当月订单' ,'下月订单') then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                                                as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_received_orders_reject_returns  --剔除退单订单净销额（包含当月订单和NKA下月交货订单）
   ,cast(case when t1.partner_status = '2. Finance Released Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单'  then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                  as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_est_sales_value_current         --剔除退单已发出订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.order_type in ('下月订单') then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                                                            as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_est_sales_value_next            --剔除退单NKA下月交货订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status in ('2c. Finance Released- Delivered','2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing') and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_released_orders_reject_returns  --剔除退单已送达订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.partner_status = '1. Frozen Orders' and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end                                                             as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_frozen_orders_reject_returns    --剔除退单冻结订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status IN ('2a. Finance Released- To be picked','2b. Finance Released- To be delivered')  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL end    as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_good_issued_reject_returns      --剔除退单待送达订单净销额
   ,cast(case when t1.sub_status = '2d. Finance Released- Delivered w/o billing'  and t1.order_type = '当月订单' then t1.ges else NULL  end  as decimal(28,6))                                            as  ges_d_released_orders               --已送达订单净销额w/o billing
   ,t1.product_base_price
   ,if(substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330')
       ,'${bizdate}',null) as ds

with
product_data_tmp as(
 select
  a.product_barcode as sku_barcode, --产品id
  a.product_name as sku_name,  --产品名称
  concat(a.product_name, '-', a.product_barcode) as sku_barcode_name,--产品名称和ID
  case
    when a.category_name_en is null
    or a.category_name_en = '' then 'Others'
    else a.category_name_en
  end as category_code,--产品品类代码
  case
    when a.category_name is null
    or a.category_name = '' then 'Others'
    else a.category_name
  end as category_name,--产品品类名称
  case
    when a.brand_name_en is null
    or a.brand_name_en = '' then 'Others'
    else a.brand_name_en
  end as brand_code,--品牌代码
  case
    when a.brand_name is null
    or a.brand_name = '' then 'Others'
    else a.brand_name
  end as brand_name,--品牌名称
  a.product_line as product_line_id,--产品线id
  a.product_line as product_line_name,--产品线名称
  case
    when a.product_function is null
    or a.product_function = '' then 'Others'
    else a.product_function
  end as first_product_function,--产品功能/一级子品类
  --sub_product_function
  case
    when a.sub_product_function is null
    or a.sub_product_function = '' then 'Others'
    else a.sub_product_function
  end as second_product_function,--二级子品类
  a.product_pack as product_pack,--产品包装
  a.product_pack_type, --产品包装分类
  case
    when a.bu_2<>'Laundry' and (
      concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) = ''
      or concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) is null
      or concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue) = '.'
    ) then 'Others'
    else concat(colour_chroma, '.', main_colour_hue)
  end as colour_hue,--色调
  a.category_name_en_sort,--品类排序字段
  a.brand_name_en_sort,--品牌排序字段
  a.product_line_sort,--产品线排序字段
  a.product_name_sort --SKU排序字段

    group by

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sellout_daily_sale_bu partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select
  t1.product_barcode  as sku_barcode -- 单品barcode
  ,t1.product_name    as sku_name    -- 单品名称
  ,concat(t1.product_name, '-', t1.product_barcode) as sku_barcode_name -- 单品barcode+名称
  ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others')     as product_line_id   -- 产品线id
  ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others')     as product_line_name -- 产品线名称
  ,nvl(t1.category_name_en,'Others') as category_code     -- 品类代码
  ,nvl(t1.category_name,'Others')    as category_name     -- 品类名称
  ,nvl(t1.brand_name_en,'Others')    as brand_code        -- 品牌代码
  ,nvl(t1.brand_name,'Others')       as brand_name        -- 品牌名称
  ,nvl(t1.product_function,'Others')     as first_product_function  -- 产品功能一级
  ,nvl(t1.sub_product_function,'Others') as second_product_function -- 产品功能二级
  ,nvl(t1.product_pack,'Others')         as product_pack            -- 产品包装
  ,nvl(t1.product_pack_type,'Others')    as product_pack_type       -- 产品包装分类
  ,nvl(case when length(concat(t2.colour_chroma, '.', t2.main_colour_hue))<=1 then 'Others'
       else concat(t2.colour_chroma, '.', t2.main_colour_hue)
       end,'Others')             as colour_hue         -- 色调
  ,nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'Others') as first_channel_id   -- 一级渠道id
  ,nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'Others') as first_channel_name -- 一级渠道名称
  ,nvl(t1.second_channel_id_lastest  ,'Others') as second_channel_id   -- 二级渠道id
  ,nvl(t1.second_channel_name_lastest,'Others') as second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
  ,nvl(t1.third_channel_id_lastest  ,'Others') as third_channel_id    -- 三级渠道id
  ,nvl(t1.third_channel_name_lastest,'Others') as third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
  ,nvl(t1.fourth_channel_id_lastest  ,'Others') as fourth_channel_id   -- 四级渠道
  ,nvl(t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest,'Others') as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道
  ,t1.henkel_store_code           as henkel_store_id     -- 门店code
  ,t1.store_name as henkel_store_name   -- 门店名称
  ,nvl(t1.province_name,'Others') as province_id     -- 省份id
  ,nvl(t1.province_name,'Others') as province_name   -- 省份名称
  ,nvl(t1.city_name,'Others') as city_id             -- 城市名称
  ,nvl(t1.city_name,'Others') as city_name           -- 城市名称
  ,nvl(t1.region_name,'Others') as henkel_region_id
  ,nvl(t1.region_name,'Others') as henkel_region_name -- 汉高大区
  ,null as product_cateory
  ,null as product_cateory_desc
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('MPD','Ecom') then null
       else t1.supply_type
    end as supply_type         -- 直/间供类型id
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('MPD','Ecom') then null
       else t1.supply_type_name
    end as supply_type_name    -- 直/间供类型名称
  ,cast(t1.sales_num      as decimal(28, 6)) as sales_num  -- 销量
  ,cast(t1.base_price_amt as decimal(28, 6)) as sales_amt  -- 销额
  ,case when t1.third_channel_name_lastest regexp '屈臣氏' and t1.data_source regexp '手工报表' then concat(t1.dt_month,'a')
        when t1.third_channel_name_lastest regexp '屈臣氏' and t1.data_source not regexp '手工报表' then concat(t1.dt_date,'a')
     else t1.dt_date
    end as dt_date
  ,t1.bu_1    -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
  ,t1.bu_2    -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('B2B&LKA','DT') then nvl(t1.distributor_type,'Others')
       else null
    end  as distributor_type -- 经销商类型
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('B2B&LKA','DT') then nvl(t1.store_type_seg,'Others')
       else null
    end  as store_type_seg   -- 收货方类型
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('B2B&LKA','DT') then if(t1.bu_1='Professional',nvl(t1.store_lv,'Others'),null)
       else null
    end as store_lv
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest in ('B2B&LKA','DT') then cast(t1.actual_sales_amt as DECIMAL(28,6))
       else null
    end as sales_amt_act      -- 实价销额
  ,t1.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,t1.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,nvl(t1.product_function_cn    ,'Others') as first_product_function_cn  -- 一级子品类(中文)
  ,nvl(t1.sub_product_function_cn,'Others') as second_product_function_cn -- 二级子品类(中文)
  ,nvl(t1.dist_code          ,'Others') as dist_code           -- 经销商编码
  ,nvl(t1.dist_name          ,'Others') as dist_name           -- 经销商名称
  ,nvl(t1.is_expired_customer,'Others') as is_expired_customer -- 合作状态（适用所有渠道的经销商）
  ,nvl(t1.store_category     ,'Others') as store_category      -- 门店分类
  ,nvl(t1.store_category_lv1 ,'Others') as store_category_lv1  -- 门店一级分类
  ,nvl(t1.store_category_lv2 ,'Others') as store_category_lv2  -- 门店二级分类
  ,nvl(t1.ka_code     ,'Others') as ka_code      -- ka编码
  ,nvl(t1.ka_name     ,'Others') as ka_name      -- ka名称
  ,nvl(t1.KA_Type_Name,'Others') as KA_Type_Name -- ka类型
from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu t2
on t1.product_barcode=t2.product_barcode
and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
and t2.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
--and upper(t1.bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY','SKP','SP')

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_ka_pos_tpm partition(ds='${bizdate}')
-- POS
select
  t.dist_system_code
  ,t.base_unit_qty
  ,t.base_unit_name
  ,t.original_amt_tax
  ,t.original_amt_untax
  ,t.henkel_prod_code
  ,t.henkel_prod_barcode
  ,t.dist_store_code
  ,t.henkel_store_code
  ,case when upper(t.first_channel_name) in ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t.first_channel_name
    else 'OT' END AS first_channel_name
  ,t.bill_date
  ,t.start_date
  ,t.end_date
  ,t.month
  ,getdate() as extract_time
  ,coalesce(t.DealerCode,t4.distributer_code,'Others') as distributer_code -- 经销商编码
  ,coalesce(t.DealerName,t4.distributer_name,'Others') as distributer_name -- 经销商名称
from(
  select  
    a.dist_system_code
    ,a.base_unit_qty
    ,a.base_unit_name
    ,cast(a.original_amt_tax as decimal(20, 4)) as original_amt_tax
    ,cast(a.original_amt_untax as decimal(20, 4)) as original_amt_untax
    ,a.henkel_prod_code
    ,a.henkel_prod_barcode
    ,a.dist_store_code
    ,a.henkel_store_code
    ,a.first_channel_name
    ,a.ds as bill_date
    ,case when a.dist_system_code = 'KA0011' then to_char(date_add(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd'),-6),'yyyyMMdd') 
      else a.ds
     end as start_date
    ,a.ds as end_date
    ,substr(a.ds,1,6) as month
    ,a.DealerCode
    ,a.DealerName
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily a
  where a.ds >='${bizmonth}'-- '20230101'
  and a.ds<='${bizdate}'
  --and upper(bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY','SKP','SP')
  union all
   -- 取月度手工上传数据
  select  
    a.dist_system_code
    ,a.base_unit_qty
    ,a.base_unit_name
    ,cast(a.original_amt_tax as decimal(20, 4)) as original_amt_tax
    ,cast(a.original_amt_untax as decimal(20, 4)) as original_amt_untax
    ,a.henkel_prod_code
    ,a.henkel_prod_barcode
    ,a.dist_store_code
    ,a.henkel_store_code
    ,a.first_channel_name
    ,to_char(lastday(to_date(concat(a.ds,'01'),'yyyyMMdd')),'yyyyMMdd') as bill_date
    ,concat(a.ds,'01') as start_date
    ,to_char(lastday(to_date(concat(a.ds,'01'),'yyyyMMdd')),'yyyyMMdd') as end_date
    ,a.ds as month
    ,a.DealerCode
    ,a.DealerName
  from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu a
  where a.ds >='${bizmonth}'-- '20230101'
  and a.ds<=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
  and a.data_source = '手工报表'
  --and upper(bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE','LAUNDRY','SKP','SP')
 ) t
 left join(
     -- 获取门店主数据中门店的oneid
     select
       store_oneid as henkel_store_code,-- 汉高门店编码
       store_name as henkel_store_name, -- 汉高门店名称
       nka_customer_name,
       henkel_region,
       distributer_code,                  -- 经销商编码
       distributer_name,                  -- 经销商名称
       distributor_region_name as dist_region_name,
       substr(ds,1,6) as month_link
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
     where ds like '%01'
 ) t4 
   on nvl(t.henkel_store_code,'Others') = t4.henkel_store_code
   and t.month = t4.month_link
 where (upper(t.first_channel_name) in ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') OR t4.henkel_store_code is not null)

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_detail_mtd_temp00 as
select
 a.bill_date
 ,a.months       -- 数据月份
 ,a.ka_code   -- ka编码
 ,a.ka_name   -- ka名称
 ,a.dist_code   -- 客户编码
 ,a.dist_name   -- 客户名称
 ,a.DT_direct_customer_code -- dt渠道直供客户
 ,a.DT_direct_customer_name -- dt渠道直供客户名称
 ,a.henkel_store_code   -- 汉高门店编码
 ,a.henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
 ,a.province_name       -- 汉高门店所在省份
 ,a.henkel_region_name  -- 汉高门店所在大区
 ,a.dist_region_name    -- 汉高门店所在经销商大区
 ,a.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
 ,a.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
 ,a.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
 ,a.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
 ,a.prod_code           -- 汉高产品编码
 ,a.prod_barcode        -- 汉高barcode
 ,a.prod_name           -- 汉高产品名称
 ,a.category_name       -- 汉高品类名称中文
 ,a.category_name_en    -- 汉高品类名称英文
 ,a.brand_name          -- 汉高品牌名称中文
 ,a.brand_name_en       -- 汉高品牌名称英文
 ,a.product_line_name   -- 产品线
 ,a.whether_ecom_sample_product-- 是否小样
 ,a.base_price     -- 产品基价（未税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_ngs       ) as sellin_ngs_tax            -- ngs(含税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_ngs_untax) as sellin_ngs_untax           -- ngs(不含税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_ges_untax)   as sellin_ges_untax         -- GES
 ,sum(a.sellin_nes_untax) as sellin_nes_untax           -- NES
 ,sum(a.sellin_base_amt  ) as sellin_base_amt_tax       -- sellin基价金额（含税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_base_amt_untax) as sellin_base_amt_untax --sellin基价金额（未税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_num       ) as sellin_num            -- sellin 数量
 ,sum(a.sellout_actual_amt) as sellout_actual_amt_tax    -- sell_out实际销售额（含税）
 ,sum(a.sellout_base_amt  ) as sellout_base_amt_tax      -- sell_out基价销售额（含税）
 ,sum(a.sellout_base_amt_untax) as sellout_base_amt_untax --
 ,sum(a.sellout_num       ) as sellout_num           -- sell_out数量（含税）
 ,sum(a.base_stock_amt   ) as base_stock_amt_tax        -- 基价库存金额（含税）
 ,sum(a.base_stock_amt_untax) as base_stock_amt_untax
 ,sum(a.stock_num        ) as stock_num             -- 实际库存（含税）
 ,a.data_source         -- 数据来源
 ,a.data_table
 ,a.bu_1
 ,a.bu_2
 ,a.etl_date      -- 数据加工时间
 ,a.channel_customer_Permission
 ,a.region_customer_Permission
from(
   -- sellout 数据
   select
     t1.bill_date
     ,t1.months       -- 数据月份
     ,t1.dist_code   -- 客户编码
     ,t1.dist_name   -- 客户名称
     ,t1.ka_code   -- ka编码
     ,t1.ka_name   -- ka名称
     ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest='DT' AND UPPER(t1.data_table)='KE24' then
          case when t1.province_name regexp'上海' then '上海直供' else '杭州苑苑' end
        when upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.ka_code_customer
       else t1.dist_code
      end as DT_direct_customer_code -- dt渠道直供客户
     ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest='DT' AND UPPER(t1.data_table)='KE24' then
          case when t1.province_name regexp'上海' then '上海直供' else '杭州苑苑' end
        when upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.ka_name_customer
       else t1.dist_name
      end as DT_direct_customer_name -- dt渠道直供客户名称
     ,t1.store_code as henkel_store_code   -- 汉高门店编码
     ,t1.store_name as henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
     ,t1.province_name_lastest      as province_name       -- 汉高门店所在省份
     ,t1.henkel_region_name_lastest as henkel_region_name  -- 汉高门店所在大区
     ,t1.dist_region_name    -- 汉高门店所在经销商大区
     ,t1.first_channel_name_lastest  as first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
     ,t1.second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
     ,t1.third_channel_name_lastest  as third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
     ,t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
     ,t1.prod_code           -- 汉高产品编码
     ,t1.prod_barcode        -- 汉高barcode
     ,t1.prod_name           -- 汉高产品名称
     ,t1.category_name       -- 汉高品类名称中文
     ,t1.category_name_en    -- 汉高品类名称英文
     ,t1.brand_name          -- 汉高品牌名称中文
     ,t1.brand_name_en       -- 汉高品牌名称英文
     ,t1.product_line_name   -- 产品线
     ,t1.whether_ecom_sample_product-- 是否小样
     ,t1.base_price     -- 产品基价（未税）
     ,null as sellin_ngs            -- ngs(含税）
     ,null as sellin_ngs_untax      -- ngs(不含税）
     ,null as sellin_ges_untax      -- GES
     ,null as sellin_nes_untax      -- NES
     ,null as sellin_base_amt       -- sellin基价金额（含税）
     ,null as sellin_base_amt_untax -- sellin基价金额（不含税）
     ,null as sellin_num            -- sellin 数量
     ,t1.dist_prod_amt_tax  as sellout_actual_amt    -- sell_out实际销售额（含税）
     ,t1.base_sale_amt*1.13 as sellout_base_amt      -- sell_out基价销售额（含税）
     ,t1.base_sale_amt as sellout_base_amt_untax     -- sell_out基价销售额（未税）
     ,t1.base_qty      as sellout_num           -- sell_out数量（含税）
     ,null as base_stock_amt -- 基价库存金额（含税）
     ,null as base_stock_amt_untax
     ,null as stock_num      -- 实际库存（含税）
     ,t1.data_source         -- 数据来源
     ,t1.data_table
     ,t1.bu_1
     ,t1.bu_2
     ,t1.ds as etl_date      -- 数据加工数据
     ,t1.channel_customer_Permission
     ,t1.region_customer_Permission
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sellout_detail_prof t1
   where t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sellout_detail_prof')

   union all
   -- 库存 数据
   select
     t1.stock_date as bill_date
     ,t1.months      -- 数据月份
     ,t1.dist_code   -- 客户编码
     ,t1.dist_name   -- 客户名称
     ,t1.ka_code   -- ka编码
     ,t1.ka_name   -- ka名称
     ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest='DT' and nvl(t4.channel_name2,'') regexp '直供' then
          case when t1.province_name regexp'上海' then '上海直供' else '杭州苑苑' end
        when upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.ka_code_customer
        else t1.dist_code

          case when t1.province_name regexp'上海' then '上海直供' else '杭州苑苑' end

        else t1.dist_name
     end as DT_direct_customer_name -- dt渠道直供客户名称
     ,t1.henkel_store_code   -- 汉高门店编码
     ,t1.henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
     ,t1.province_name_lastest      as province_name       -- 汉高门店所在省份
     ,t1.henkel_region_name_lastest as henkel_region_name  -- 汉高门店所在大区
     ,t1.dist_region_name    -- 汉高门店所在经销商大区
     ,t1.first_channel_name_lastest  as first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道

     ,t1.third_channel_name_lastest  as third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
     ,t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称

     ,t1.henkel_brand_en     as brand_name_en       -- 汉高品牌名称英文
     ,t1.product_line        as product_line_name   -- 产品线
     ,t1.whether_ecom_sample_product as whether_ecom_sample_product-- 是否小样

     ,null as sellin_ngs            -- ngs(含税）
     ,null as sellin_ngs_untax      -- ngs(不含税）
     ,null as sellin_ges_untax      -- GES 
     ,null as sellin_nes_untax      -- NES
     ,null as sellin_base_amt       -- sellin基价金额（含税）

     ,t1.bu_1
     ,t1.bu_2
     ,t1.ds as etl_date      -- 数据加工数据
     ,t1.channel_customer_Permission
     ,t1.region_customer_Permission
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_stock_detail_prof t1
   left join(
      select

     ,t1.bu_1

     on t1.customer_id = t4.customer_code

--      and t3.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule')
   left join  (
    --  SELECT *,row_number()over(partition by ka_name_en_lv2) as rn
    --  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka_info
    --  where nvl(ka_name_en_lv2,'')<>''
        SELECT

            case when ka_code='KA0008' then 'HomeClub' else ka_name_en end as ka_name_en_lv2

   left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu b

 ,nvl(a.bu_2             ,'Others') as bu_2              -- bu_2

 ,a.data_table    -- 来源数据表
 ,sum(a.sellin_ngs     ) as sellin_ngs            -- ngs(含税）
 ,sum(a.sellin_base_amt) as sellin_base_amt       -- sellin基价金额（含税）

 ,sum(a.sellin_nes_untax) as sellin_nes_untax -- nes(不含税）

drop table if exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp03

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp03 as
select
  t1.months         -- 数据月份
  ,t1.customer_code -- 客户编码
  ,t1.customer_name -- 客户名称

  ,t1.henkel_store_code -- 汉高门店编码
  ,t1.henkel_store_name -- 汉高门店名称
  ,t1.province_name -- 省份
  ,t1.bu_2          -- bu_2
  ,t1.sku_id        -- 产品编码
  ,t1.sku_name      -- 产品名称
  ,t1.prod_barcode  -- 产品条码
  ,t1.brand_name    -- 品牌
  ,t1.brand_name_en -- 品牌英文
  ,t1.category_code -- 品类英文
  ,t1.category_name -- 品类中文
  ,t1.product_line_name -- 产品线
  ,max(t1.sellin_ngs     ) as sellin_ngs            -- ngs(含税）
  ,max(t1.sellin_base_amt) as sellin_base_amt       -- sellin基价金额（含税）
  ,max(t1.sellin_num     ) as sellin_num            -- sellin 数量
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_ngs      end) as sellin_ngs_py      -- 去年ngs(含税）
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_base_amt end) as sellin_base_amt_py -- 去年sellin基价金额（含税）
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_num      end) as sellin_num_py      -- 去年sellin 数量
  ,max(t1.sellout_actual_amt) as sellout_actual_amt -- sell_out实际销售额（含税）
  ,max(t1.sellout_base_amt  ) as sellout_base_amt   -- sell_out基价销售额（含税）
  ,max(t1.sellout_num   ) as sellout_num    -- sell_out数量
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellout_actual_amt end) as sellout_actual_amt_py -- 去年sell_out实际销售额（含税）
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellout_base_amt   end) as sellout_base_amt_py   -- 去年sell_out基价销售额（含税）
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellout_num        end) as sellout_num_py   -- 去年sell_out数量
  ,max(t1.base_stock_amt) as base_stock_amt -- 实际库存（含税）
  ,max(t1.stock_num     ) as stock_num      -- 实际库存数量
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.stock_num          end) as stock_num_py   -- 去年库存数量
--***本次新加***--
 ,max(t1.sellin_ngs_untax) as sellin_ngs_untax
 ,max(t1.sellin_ges_untax) as sellin_ges_untax -- ges(不含税）
 ,max(t1.sellin_nes_untax) as sellin_nes_untax -- nes(不含税）
 ,max(t1.sellout_base_amt_untax) as sellout_base_amt_untax -- sell_out基价销售额（不含税）
 ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_ngs_untax      end) as sellin_ngs_untax_py      -- 去年ngs(未税）
 ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_ges_untax      end) as sellin_ges_untax_py      -- 去年ges(未税）
 ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellin_nes_untax      end) as sellin_nes_untax_py      -- 去年nes(未税）
 ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=12 then t2.sellout_base_amt_untax      end) as sellout_base_amt_untax_py      -- 去年sell_out基价销售额(未税）
--***本次新加***--
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),if(t2.months<nvl(t2.min_months,'299912'),null,to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 then t2.sellout_base_amt end)
   /count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),if(t2.months<nvl(t2.min_months,'299912'),null,to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 then t2.months end)
      as inventory_12_mon_avg	-- 近12月平均sellout（含税）
  ,max(case when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t2.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=1 then t2.base_stock_amt end) as base_stock_amt_1m	  -- 月初库存	月初库存（含税）
  ,t1.ka_name
  ,t1.channel_customer_permission
  ,t1.region_customer_permission
from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp02 t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp02 t2
   on  nvl(t1.customer_code    ,'')= nvl(t2.customer_code    ,'')

   and nvl(t1.henkel_store_code,'')= nvl(t2.henkel_store_code,'')
   and nvl(t1.henkel_store_name,'')= nvl(t2.henkel_store_name,'')
   and nvl(t1.province_name    ,'')= nvl(t2.province_name    ,'')
   and nvl(t1.bu_2             ,'')= nvl(t2.bu_2             ,'')
   and nvl(t1.sku_id           ,'')= nvl(t2.sku_id           ,'')
   and nvl(t1.sku_name         ,'')= nvl(t2.sku_name         ,'')
   and nvl(t1.prod_barcode     ,'')= nvl(t2.prod_barcode     ,'')
   and nvl(t1.brand_name       ,'')= nvl(t2.brand_name       ,'')
   and nvl(t1.brand_name_en    ,'')= nvl(t2.brand_name_en    ,'')
   and nvl(t1.category_code    ,'')= nvl(t2.category_code    ,'')
   and nvl(t1.category_name    ,'')= nvl(t2.category_name    ,'')
   and nvl(t1.product_line_name,'')= nvl(t2.product_line_name,'')
   and nvl(t1.ka_name          ,'')= nvl(t2.ka_name          ,'')
   and nvl(t1.channel_customer_permission ,'')= nvl(t2.channel_customer_permission ,'')
   and nvl(t1.region_customer_permission  ,'')= nvl(t2.region_customer_permission  ,'')
   and t1.months>=t2.months
 group by t1.months         -- 数据月份
  ,t1.customer_code -- 客户编码
  ,t1.customer_name -- 客户名称
  ,t1.channel       -- 一级渠道
  ,t1.region        -- 汉高区域
  ,t1.henkel_store_code -- 汉高门店编码
  ,t1.henkel_store_name -- 汉高门店名称
  ,t1.province_name -- 省份
  ,t1.bu_2          -- bu_2
  ,t1.sku_id        -- 产品编码
  ,t1.sku_name      -- 产品名称
  ,t1.prod_barcode  -- 产品条码
  ,t1.brand_name    -- 品牌
  ,t1.brand_name_en -- 品牌英文
  ,t1.category_code -- 品类英文
  ,t1.category_name -- 品类中文
  ,t1.product_line_name -- 产品线

-- 20240604  yyq   新增B2B&LKA渠道数据
-- 20240914  yyq   新增sellout mpd laundry数据
-- 20241022  mass  去掉渠道过滤条件，全渠道推送

-- 20251024  shiwu  统一调整数据从tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid出
-- 20251106  shiwu  sales_num转bigint类型
-- 20251106  shiwu  剔除产品条码为空的数据
-- 20251218  shiwu  调整依赖关系
-- 20260113  shiwu  将first_channel_name_lastest = '屈臣氏' 调整为 third_channel_name_lastest = '屈臣氏'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sell_out_tpm PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
-- Sell out
SELECT  NVL(a.dist_code,'') AS dist_code -- 经销商编码
        ,NVL(a.henkel_store_code,'') AS store_code -- 门店编码
        ,'' AS store_nature_name -- 门店性质名称
        ,NVL(a.product_code,'') AS prod_code -- 产品编码
        ,NVL(a.product_barcode,'') AS prod_barcode -- 产品条码
        ,'' AS prod_num -- 产品批号
        ,'' AS expire_date -- 有效期
        ,NVL(CAST(SUM(a.actual_sales_amt) AS DECIMAL(20,4)),0) AS dist_prod_amt -- 经销商产品金额
        ,cast(NVL(SUM(a.sales_num),0) as bigint) AS base_qty -- 基本单位数量
        ,'个' AS base_unit -- 基本单位
        ,NVL(CAST(a.base_price AS DECIMAL(20,4)),0) AS base_price -- 产品基价
        ,NVL(CAST(SUM(a.base_price_amt) AS DECIMAL(20,4)),0) AS base_sales_amt -- 经销商出货金额( 产品基价*销量)
        ,NVL(a.rs,'') AS rs -- 销售/退货
        ,NVL(a.first_channel_name_lastest,'') AS first_channel_name -- 一级渠道名称
        ,dt_date AS update_time -- 更新日期
        ,CASE   WHEN a.third_channel_name_lastest = '屈臣氏' AND data_source <> 'KA手工报表' THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(a.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),-6),'yyyyMMdd')
                WHEN a.data_source = 'KA手工报表' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(dt_date,1,4),'01')
                ELSE a.dt_date
        END AS start_date
        ,a.dt_date AS end_date -- 销售周期结束时间
        ,a.dt_month
        ,GETDATE() AS extract_time
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid a
WHERE   a.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
AND     a.dt_month >= '${bizmonth}' -- '20230101'
AND     a.dt_month <= SUBSTR('${bizdate}',1,6) -- and upper(a.first_channel_name) in ('DT','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA')
-- and a.ds <='${bizdate}'
-- and coalesce(base_price,'')<>''
and nvl(product_barcode,'-110') <>'-110'
GROUP BY NVL(a.dist_code,'')  -- 经销商编码
        ,NVL(a.henkel_store_code,'') -- 门店编码
        ,NVL(a.product_code,'')  -- 产品编码
        ,NVL(a.product_barcode,'')  -- 产品条码
        ,NVL(CAST(a.base_price AS DECIMAL(20,4)),0) 
        ,NVL(a.rs,'')  -- 销售/退货
        ,NVL(a.first_channel_name_lastest,'')  -- 一级渠道名称
        ,dt_date  -- 更新日期
        ,CASE   WHEN a.third_channel_name_lastest = '屈臣氏' AND data_source <> 'KA手工报表' THEN TO_CHAR(DATE_ADD(TO_DATE(a.dt_date,'yyyymmdd'),-6),'yyyyMMdd')
                WHEN a.data_source = 'KA手工报表' THEN CONCAT(SUBSTR(dt_date,1,4),'01')
                ELSE a.dt_date
        END 
        ,a.dt_date  -- 销售周期结束时间
        ,a.dt_month

      --when t1.first_channel_name in ('DT','MPD') and nvl(t4.henkel_region_name,'')='' then 'Others'

with
post_data_tmp as (
select 
  substr(d.mapping_time,1,4) as year
  ,d.mapping_time as month 
  ,a.month as org_month
  ,a.category_code
  ,a.category_name
  ,a.brand_code	
  ,a.brand_name
  ,a.first_channel_name	
  ,a.second_channel_name	
  ,a.second_channel_id	
  ,a.third_channel_id
  ,a.third_channel_name
  ,nvl(c.prod_line_tmkt_1,'其他') as prod_line_tmkt_1  -- 一级产品线
  ,nvl(c.prod_line_tmkt_2,'其他') as prod_line_tmkt_2  -- 二级产品线
  ,null as master_prod_dme   -- dme产品线名称
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name) in ('NKA') THEN nvl(e.ka_name_en_lv1,'Others')
     else a.second_channel_name
   end as report_channel_name -- 报表展示渠道
  ,sum(a.sku_sale_num      ) as sku_sale_num           -- sku销售数量
  ,sum(a.sku_sales_amt)      as sku_sales_amt          -- pos累计销售额
  ,sum(a.sku_base_sales_amt) as sku_base_sales_amt     -- pos累计基价销售额
from (
  select *,1 as flag
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu
  where ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu')
  and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','ECOM')
  and upper(bu_2)='BEAUTY CARE' 
  ) a
left join(
    select  
        *,substr(ds,1,6) as month_link
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product  --关联产品主数据
    where ds like '%01'
) b 
on a.sku_id=b.product_code
and a.month = b.month_link
left join (
  select *,1 as flag 
   ,row_number()over(partition by category_code,brand_code,category_hierarchy_2,category_hierarchy_1,product_line_code,sku_code ) as rn
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_pos_line_mapping
  where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_pos_line_mapping')
  and Status='Active'
  ) c
on a.flag=c.flag
and if(coalesce(trim(c.sku_code),'')='',1=1,trim(c.sku_code)=trim(a.sku_id))
and if(coalesce(trim(c.category_code),'')='',1=1,upper(trim(c.category_code))=upper(trim(a.category_code)))
and if(coalesce(trim(c.brand_code),'')='',1=1,upper(trim(c.brand_code))=upper(trim(a.brand_code)))
and if(coalesce(trim(c.category_hierarchy_2),'')='',1=1,upper(trim(c.category_hierarchy_2))=upper(trim(b.sub_product_function)))
and if(coalesce(trim(c.category_hierarchy_1),'')='',1=1,upper(trim(c.category_hierarchy_1))=upper(trim(b.product_function)))
and if(coalesce(trim(c.product_line_code),'')='',1=1,trim(c.product_line_code)=trim(a.product_line_name))
and c.rn=1
inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time d
 on a.dt_date=d.time_now
  and d.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time')
  and d.time_type ='C.月'
  and coalesce(d.time_now,'')<>''
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka e
on a.ka_code=e.ka_code
and e.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')    
group by  substr(d.mapping_time,1,4),d.mapping_time
  ,a.month
  ,a.category_code
  ,a.category_name
  ,a.brand_code
  ,a.brand_name
  ,a.first_channel_name
  ,a.second_channel_name
  ,a.second_channel_id
  ,a.third_channel_id
  ,a.third_channel_name
  ,nvl(c.prod_line_tmkt_1,'其他') 
  ,nvl(c.prod_line_tmkt_2,'其他')  
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name) in ('NKA') THEN nvl(e.ka_name_en_lv1,'Others')
     else a.second_channel_name
   end
)

--合并total pos和O2O pos数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp as
           select 
                   a.bill_month          as sales_months
                  ,a.first_channel_name  as channel_name
                  ,a.second_channel_name as channel_group
                  ,coalesce(c.o2o_pos_ka_name,e.o2o_pos_ka_name,d.o2o_pos_ka_name,a.third_channel_name) as retailer_name
                  ,case when a.henkel_category_name_cn in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护' 
                        else coalesce(trim(a.henkel_category_name_cn),'Others') end as henkel_category_name_cn
                  ,case when a.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care' 
                        else coalesce(trim(a.henkel_category_name_en),'Others') end as henkel_category_name_en 
                  ,coalesce(a.henkel_brand_name_cn,'Others')  as henkel_brand_name_cn
                  ,coalesce(a.henkel_brand_name_en,'Others')  as henkel_brand_name_en 
		    ,cast(sum(a.original_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) as total_pos
		    ,0  as amt_untax
             from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly a
             left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu b
             ON a.henkel_prod_code=b.product_code
             and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')

             left join (
                    select ka_code,province_name,o2o_pos_ka_name
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(province_name,'')) !=0
                    group by ka_code,province_name,o2o_pos_ka_name

             ) c
             on  concat(nvl(a.dist_system_code,''),nvl(case when a.province_name like '%广西%' then '广西'
                                                               when a.province_name='%内蒙古%' then '内蒙'
                                                               when a.province_name='%宁夏%' then '宁夏'
                                                               when a.province_name='%新疆%' then '新疆'
                                                               when a.province_name='%西藏%' then '西藏'
                                                               else  regexp_replace(replace(a.province_name,'Others',''),'省|市','') end,'')
                       )=concat(nvl(c.ka_code,''),nvl(c.province_name,''))

              left join (
                    select ka_code,region_name,o2o_pos_ka_name
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(region_name,'')) !=0
                    and length(nvl(province_name,'')) =0
                    group by ka_code,region_name,o2o_pos_ka_name

             ) e
             on  concat(nvl(a.dist_system_code,''),nvl(replace(a.henkel_region_name,'Others',''),''))=concat(nvl(e.ka_code,''),nvl(e.region_name,''))


             left join (
                    select ka_code,o2o_pos_ka_name 
                    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping
                    where ds= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tmkt_o2o_pos_ka_name_mapping')
                    and length(nvl(province_name,''))=0 
                    and length(nvl(region_name,''))=0
                    group by ka_code,o2o_pos_ka_name
             ) d
             on  nvl(a.dist_system_code,'')=nvl(d.ka_code,'')

             
            where a.ds <= max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly')
            -- and ((a.fourth_channel_name not in ('沃尔玛山姆会员') or a.fourth_channel_name is null)
            --   or (a.second_channel_name not in ('中区','西区') and third_channel_name = '卜蜂莲花'))
              and (
                  nvl(a.dist_system_code,'') <>'KA0007'
                  or (a.second_channel_name not in ('中区','西区') and third_channel_name = '卜蜂莲花')
              )   
              and nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care') in ('Beauty Care','VS')
              and (c.ka_code is not null or e.ka_code is not null or d.ka_code is not null or a.dist_system_code='KA0011') -- 取KA mapping表能匹配上的KA数据和屈臣氏
              and UPPER(a.first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
         group by  a.bill_month,a.first_channel_name,a.second_channel_name
                  ,coalesce(c.o2o_pos_ka_name,e.o2o_pos_ka_name,d.o2o_pos_ka_name,a.third_channel_name)
                  ,case when a.henkel_category_name_cn in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护' 
                        else coalesce(trim(a.henkel_category_name_cn),'Others') end 
                  ,case when a.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care' 
                        else coalesce(trim(a.henkel_category_name_en),'Others') end  
                  ,coalesce(a.henkel_brand_name_cn,'Others') ,coalesce(a.henkel_brand_name_en,'Others')
				  
	union 	  
	
         select 
                  b.sales_months
                , b.channel_name
                , b.channel_group 				
                , case when b.retailer_name in ('银座','统一银座') then '银座'
                       else b.retailer_name end   as retailer_name
                , case when b.henkel_category_name in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护' 
                       else coalesce(b.henkel_category_name,'Others') end as henkel_category_name_cn
                , case when b.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care' 
                       else coalesce(b.henkel_category_name_en,'Others') end as henkel_category_name_en 
                , b.henkel_brand_name    as henkel_brand_name_cn
                , b.henkel_brand_name_en as henkel_brand_name_en
                , 0                      as total_pos
                , sum(b.amt_untax)       as amt_untax
             from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info b
            where b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info')           
         group by b.sales_months, b.channel_name, b.channel_group
                , case when b.retailer_name in ('银座','统一银座') then '银座'
                       else b.retailer_name end   
                , case when b.henkel_category_name in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护' 
                       else coalesce(b.henkel_category_name,'Others') end 
                , case when b.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care' 
                       else coalesce(b.henkel_category_name_en,'Others') end
                , b.henkel_brand_name , b.henkel_brand_name_en

select 
      t1.channel_name
    , t1.sales_months
    , t1.retailer_name

                when t.retailer_name = '银座' and t.channel_group in ('东区','中区')  then '东区'

        , t.henkel_brand_name_en 
        , sum(t.total_pos)  as total_pos
        , sum(t.amt_untax)  as amt_untax
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_o2o_pos_sale_info_temp t  
    group by t.sales_months, t.channel_name, t.retailer_name
            , case when t.retailer_name = '家家悦' and t.channel_group in ('东区','北区') then '东区'
                    when t.retailer_name = '银座' and t.channel_group in ('东区','中区')  then '东区'

            , t1.retailer_name
            , t1.region_name
            , t1.province_name
            , t1.city_name
            , t1.channel_group
            , t1.store_code
            , t1.store_name
            , t1.retailer_platform_name
            , t1.product_code

            , sum(t1.sales_qty) as sales_qty
            , sum(t1.amt_untax) as amt_untax

            , t1.henkel_product_name
            , t1.henkel_product_name_en
            , case when t1.henkel_category_name in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护'

            , case when t1.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care'

            , sum(t1.GMV) as GMV
            , t1.standard_platform_name
            , t1.dashboard_data_type
            , t1.data_source
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info t1
        where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_o2o_pos_sale_info')  
        group by t1.channel_name
            , t1.sales_months 
            , t1.retailer_name
            , t1.region_name
            , t1.province_name
            , t1.city_name
            , t1.channel_group
            , t1.store_code
            , t1.store_name
            , t1.retailer_platform_name
            , t1.product_code
            , t1.product_name
            , t1.henkel_barcode
            , t1.henkel_store_code
            , t1.henkel_store_name
            , t1.product_barcode
            , t1.henkel_product_name
            , t1.henkel_product_name_en
            , case when t1.henkel_category_name in ('护理','洗护') then '洗护' 
                    else coalesce(t1.henkel_category_name,'Others') end
            , case when t1.henkel_category_name_en in ('Treatment','Hair Care')  then 'Hair Care'

            , t1.henkel_brand_name_en
            , t1.henkel_sub_product_function
            , t1.henkel_product_line
            , t1.henkel_product_pack_ori
            , t1.standard_platform_name
            , t1.dashboard_data_type
            , t1.data_source

on t2.sales_months = t1.sales_months
and trim(t1.retailer_name) = trim(t2.retailer_name)

and trim(t2.henkel_brand_name_en) = trim(t1.henkel_brand_name_en)
and trim(t1.channel_name) = trim(t2.channel_name)
