drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_01 as
   select   substr(t1.ds,1,6)  as months  --年月
          , t1.store_code           --门店编码
          , t1.store_name		 --门店名称 
		, t1.first_channel_id     --一级渠道 
		, t1.second_channel_name  --二级渠道名称
		, t1.third_channel_name   --三级渠道名称
		, t1.fourth_channel_name  --四级渠道名称
		, t1.henkel_region        --汉高大区
          , t1.distributor_region_name --经销商区域
          , t1.province_name        --省份
	   	, case when t2.supply_type_name=2 then '直供'
              when t2.supply_type_name=1 then '间供'
              when t2.supply_type_name=0 then 'Others'
            --   when t1.fourth_channel_name ='华润万家' then ( case when t1.distributor_region_name in ('华西','华南','华北') then '直供'else '间供' end ) 
            --   when t1.third_channel_name ='家乐福' then ( case when t1.distributor_region_name in ('华东','华南') then '直供' else '间供' end) --家乐福除家乐福东区和南区直供
            --   when t1.third_channel_name in ('屈臣氏','沃尔玛','麦德龙','万宁','莎莎','沃尔玛山姆会员') then '直供' --'屈臣氏','沃尔玛','麦德龙','万宁','莎莎') 直供
            --   when t1.fourth_channel_name = '华润乐购' then '直供' --华润乐购直供
            --   when t1.fourth_channel_name = '华润苏果' then '间供' --华润苏果间供

            --   when t1.third_channel_name regexp '大润发' then 
            --     case when t1.ds>='20240315' and  t1.distributer_code regexp'直供' then '直供'
            --         else '间供' end 
            --   when t1.third_channel_name regexp '永辉' then '间供'

            --   when t1.fourth_channel_name regexp 'OLE|BLT' then '间供' --间供
            --   when t1.fourth_channel_name regexp '家家悦' then '间供' --间供

                when t1.ka_code ='KA0008' then ( case when t1.distributor_region_name in ('华西','华南','华北') then '直供'else '间供' end ) 
                when t1.ka_code ='KA0001' then ( case when t1.distributor_region_name in ('华东','华南') then '直供' else '间供' end) --家乐福除家乐福东区和南区直供
                when t1.ka_code in ('KA0011','KA0006','KA0004','KA0010','KA0070','KA0007') then '直供' --'屈臣氏','沃尔玛','麦德龙','万宁','莎莎') 直供
                when t1.ka_code = 'KA0009' then '直供' --华润乐购直供
                when t1.ka_code = 'KA0068' then '间供' --华润苏果间供

                when t1.ka_code regexp 'KA0005' then 
                    case when t1.ds>='20240315' and  t1.distributer_code regexp'直供' then '直供'
                        else '间供' end 
                when t1.ka_code regexp 'KA0003' then '间供'

                when t1.fourth_channel_name regexp 'OLE|BLT' then '间供' --间供
                when t1.fourth_channel_name regexp '家家悦' then '间供' --间供
              else 'Others'
              end as supply_type_name   --直/间供类型名称
        ,t1.ka_code
      from (select t1.* ,'1' as flag
		             , t1.store_definition  as first_channel_id --一级渠道
                   , case when t1.store_definition = 'NKA' then t1.channel_group                         
                          when t1.store_definition = 'LKA' and t1.chain_name ='红旗' then '西区'
                          when t1.store_definition = 'LKA' then nvl(t1.henkel_region,'Others')
                          else 'Others' end as second_channel_name   --二级渠道名称
						 , case when t1.store_definition = 'NKA' then t1.nka_customer_name
                          when t1.store_definition = 'LKA' and t1.chain_name ='红旗' then '红旗' --红旗不到门店粒度,用代码做匹配
                          when t1.store_definition = 'LKA' then nvl(if(t1.chain_name = '',null,t1.chain_name),'Others')
                          else t1.nka_customer_name end as third_channel_name --三级渠道名称
						 , case when t1.store_definition = 'LKA' then null
                                --20230921 添加沃尔玛山姆的判断,使沃尔玛山姆的数据不受门店mapping的影响,而更准确
                                -- when t1.nka_customer_name ='KA0007' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
	                       else nvl(if(t1.chain_name = '',null,t1.chain_name),'Others')
                          end as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称						
			      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t1                    
					   -- left join(select nka_system,channel_group
-- from ${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule
-- where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_master_data_store_nka_channel_group_rule')) t4
-- on t1.nka_customer_name = t4.nka_system
              where t1.ds like '%01' 
                and t1.ds >= '20220101' 
                 ) t1	
        left join ( 
           select henkel_store_code,ds
                 ,max(case when supply_type_name='直供' then 2
                      when supply_type_name='间供' then 1
                      else 0 end
                    ) as supply_type_name
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_monthly_bu 
           where ds<>''
           and nvl(henkel_store_code,-110)<>-110
           and upper(bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE')
           group by henkel_store_code,ds
       ) t2 
       on substr(t1.ds,1,6)=t2.ds
       and t1.store_code =t2.henkel_store_code
      where t1.store_effective = '1'
       and t1.first_channel_id in ('NKA','LKA')
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_02

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_02 as

            select
                 t1.months               --年月
              , t1.store_code           --门店编码
              , t1.store_name		     --门店名称 
              , t1.province_name        --省份
				      , t1.first_channel_id     --一级渠道

				      , t1.third_channel_name   --三级渠道名称
				      , t1.fourth_channel_name  --四级渠道名称
				      , t1.henkel_region        --汉高大区
              , t1.supply_type_name     --NKA直供/间供
              , case when t1.first_channel_id = 'LKA' then 'LKA'
         		         when t1.first_channel_id = 'NKA' then concat('NKA',t1.supply_type_name)
                         else 'Others' end  as channel_name_1  --LKA/NKA直供/NKA间供
         	 	  , case when t1.first_channel_id = 'LKA' then t1.second_channel_name
                     when t1.first_channel_id = 'NKA' and t1.supply_type_name ='直供'  then

         		          when t1.first_channel_id = 'NKA' and t1.supply_type_name ='间供' then t1.henkel_region else 'Others' end  as channel_name_2   --LKA大区/NAK经销商
             , case when t1.first_channel_id = 'LKA' then t1.third_channel_name
         		          when t1.first_channel_id = 'NKA' and t1.supply_type_name ='直供' 
                            then (case when t1.ka_code ='KA0001' then concat(t1.fourth_channel_name,'-',t1.distributor_region_name)

                                       when t1.ka_code = 'KA0008' and t1.province_name in ('福建省','广东省','广西壮族自治区') then concat(t1.fourth_channel_name,'-','华南')
                                       when t1.ka_code = 'KA0008' and t1.province_name in ('重庆市','四川省') then concat(t1.fourth_channel_name,'-','西南')
                                       when t1.ka_code = 'KA0008' and t1.province_name in ('湖南省') then concat(t1.fourth_channel_name,'-','湖南')
                                       end)
                         when t1.first_channel_id = 'NKA' and t1.supply_type_name ='间供' then (case when t1.ka_code='KA0005' then t1.third_channel_name else t1.fourth_channel_name end )
         			       else 'Others' end	as channel_name_3   --经销商/零售商名称
                  , t2.category_code          --品类 
                  , t2.shelf_sales_category   --动销品类
                  , t2.shelf_sales_prod_line  --动销产品线
                  , t2.shelf_sales_store_type --动销产品线
                  , t2.benchmark_line	       --对标产品线
                --  , t2.brand_code             --品牌
                --  , t2.category_hierarchy_2   --二级子品类
              from (select *, '1' as flag from ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_01) t1
	      left join (select  distinct category_code,shelf_sales_category,shelf_sales_prod_line,benchmark_line,shelf_sales_store_type,
                            '1' as flag
                      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_shelf_sales_product_line_mapping 
         		         where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_shelf_sales_product_line_mapping')
         		      	) t2
                on t1.flag = t2.flag
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_03

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_tmkt_shelf_sales_info_temp_03 as
            select
                    t1.month           as org_month  --机构自然年月
                  , t4.mapping_time    as month --年月
                  , t1.henkel_store_code     --汉高门店编码
                  , t1.store_name		         --门店名称                        
                  , t1.category_code         --品类
                  , t3.shelf_sales_category  --动销产品类目
                  , t3.shelf_sales_prod_line --动销产品线
                  , t3.benchmark_line	       --对标产品线
				          , t1.shelf_sales_store     --动销门店flag
                  , sum(coalesce(t1.sku_sales_amt,0)) as sku_sales_amt   --销售金额
                  , sum(coalesce(t1.sku_sale_num,0))  as sku_sales_num  --销售数量 
               from (select t.* ,'1' as flag ,
                           case when t.sku_sale_num <>0  or sku_sales_amt <> 0 then '1' else '0' end as shelf_sales_store --动销门店flag
                      from ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu t
                     where t.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu')
                     and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA') 
                     and upper(bu_2) in ('BEAUTY CARE')
                    ) t1
          left join (select  *,substr(ds,1,6) as month_link
                       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product  --关联产品主数据
                      where ds like '%01'
                    ) t2 
                on t1.sku_id= t2.product_code
               and t1.month = t2.month_link
          left join (select *,'1' as flag
                       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_shelf_sales_product_line_mapping 
         			 where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_shelf_sales_product_line_mapping')
         		       ) t3
                on t1.flag = t3.flag
         	   and if(coalesce(trim(t3.category_code),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.category_code) = trim(t1.category_code))
         	   and if(coalesce(trim(t3.brand_code),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.brand_code) = trim(t1.brand_code))
         	   and if(coalesce(trim(t3.product_line),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.product_line) = trim(t1.product_line_name))
             and if(coalesce(trim(t3.barcode),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.barcode) = trim(t1.sku_barcode))
             and if(coalesce(trim(t3.category_hierarchy_1),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.category_hierarchy_1) = trim(t2.product_function))	  
         	   and if(coalesce(trim(t3.category_hierarchy_2),'')='',1=1,trim(t3.category_hierarchy_2) = trim(t2.sub_product_function))
          inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time t4
                  on t1.dt_date=t4.time_now
                 and t4.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time')
                 and t4.time_type ='C.月'
                 and coalesce(t4.time_now,'')<>''      
         group by   t1.month,t4.mapping_time
                  , t1.henkel_store_code
                  , t1.store_name
                  , t1.category_code
                  , t3.shelf_sales_category
                  , t3.shelf_sales_prod_line
                  , t3.benchmark_line
                  , t1.shelf_sales_store

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2_tmp1
as
select
     t.months   as  months                      --月(格式为YYYYMM)
    ,''  as  month_en                                --月(英文缩写)
    ,substr(t.months,1,4)    as  years                      --年
    ,t.customer_idh  as  customer_idh              --idh
    ,t.channel       as  channel          --渠道
    ,t.sub_channel   as  sub_channel                --子渠道
    ,t.customer_name as  customer_name  --Customer Name
    ,''                   as  business_lines --业务线
    ,ges                                     --销售总额
    ,ppd                                     --Price_Promotion_Discount，商品折扣活动费用
    ,pld                                     --Price_Listing_Discount，商品陈列活动费用
    ,fg                                      --Free_Goods，赠品金额
    ,ppd+pld+fg                                               as l6_a                      
    ,ngs                                     --全称Net_Gross_Sales，即净销售总额
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (ca_cy) else (ca_py+ca_cy) end                                                      as  ca                                  
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (listing_fee_cy) else (listing_fee_cy+listing_fee_py) end                           as  listing_fee                     
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (rebate) else (rebate_py+rebate) end                                                as  rebate                    
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (logistics_cy) else (logistics_cy+logstic_py)  end                                  as  logistic_fee   
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (int_agreement_cy) else (int_agreement_cy+int_agreement_py)  end                    as  int_agreement   
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (retailer_rebate_cy) else (retailer_rebate_cy+retailer_rebate_py)  end              as  retailer_rebate      
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (oos_cy) else (oos_cy+oos_py)  end                                                  as  oos               
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (promotion_activists_cy) else (promotion_activists_cy+promotion_activists_py)  end  as  promotion_activists 
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'Y' then (ka_expense_cy) else (ka_expense_cy+ka_expense_py)  end                             as  ka_expense                      
    ,case when t5.adj_release = 'N' then l6_b_adj
          when t5.adj_release = 'Y' then 0 
          end  as l6_b_adj                              --调整FCST的L6B费用
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                    end   as l6_b_wo_ror                      
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ppd+pld+fg) + ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ppd+pld+fg) + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction     end   as trade_spend_wo_ror                      
    ,ror                                                      as ror                                   --退货
    ,deduction                                                                                         --递减
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                    end     as l6_b_w_ror                
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                    end   as l6_total  
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then nes
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then nes + l6_b_adj
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ngs - (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) - ror - deduction
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ngs - (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) - ror - deduction + l6_b_adj
          end   as  nes  --外部净销售额；计算口径为NGS-L6b
    ,t2.bdp                                                   as l10_bdp                               --L10的细分项-坏账准备金
    ,dsr                                                      as l10_dsr                               --L10的细分项-理货员
    ,surtax                                                   as l10_sur_tax                           --L10的细分项-税
    ,l10_royalties                                            as l10_royalties                         --置0，实际发生后可从sap获取
    ,ttl_l10                                                  as l10_commission                        --Commission（佣金）
    ,l11_transp_w_h_cst                                       as l11_t_w                               --Transport/Warehouse，运输和仓库管理相关费用
    ,material_cost                                            as l12_goods_sold                        --L12细项-原料成本
    ,ror_return                                               as l12_provision_cog                     --L12细项
    ,tp_price_others                                          as l12_tp_price_others                   --L12细项
    ,l13_processing_cost                                      as l13                                   --L13加工成本
    ,l14_total_manufactur                                     as l14_cog                               --即Total_Manufacturing_Cost，制造类费用
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (c1)
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (c1) + l6_b_adj
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (c1 + ttl_py)
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (c1 + ttl_py) + l6_b_adj
          end  as  product_contribution                  
    ,l16_additional_opera                                     as l16                                   --额外运营费用
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then gp1
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then gp1 + l6_b_adj
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (gp1 + ttl_py) 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (gp1 + ttl_py) + l6_b_adj
          end  as  gp1  --即Gross_Profit_1，为NES扣除L10、L11、L14和L16四类费用后的一类利润；计算口径为NES_-_L10_-L11_-_L14_-_L16
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N'  then  po_a+po_b+po_c+manual_a+manual_b+manual_c + t2.py_release
          else po_a+po_b+po_c+manual_a+manual_b+manual_c end  as l17_channel                           --（说明：该指标为中间指标，页面不展示）
    ,mkt_total                                                as l17_mkt                      
    ,digital_total                                            as l17_digital
    ,ttl_o2o                                                  as l17_nka_tm_o2o                 
    ,ba                                                       as l17_ba
    ,case when t5.adj_release = 'N' then l17_adj
          when t5.adj_release = 'Y' then 0 
          end  as l17_adj                               --用于Controlling调整FCST的L17费用
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ttl_l17
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ttl_l17 - l17_adj
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (ttl_l17-t2.py_release) 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ttl_l17-t2.py_release) - l17_adj
          end  as l17_total                             --即市场费用，L17a（Advertising，广告费）、L17b（Promotion，促销费用）、L17c（Market_Research，市场调研费）三类费用之和；TTL_L17=L17a+L17b+L17c
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then gp1-ttl_l17
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then gp1-ttl_l17 + l6_b_adj + l17_adj
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (gp1 + ttl_py) - (ttl_l17-t2.py_release) 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (gp1 + ttl_py) - (ttl_l17-t2.py_release) + l6_b_adj + l17_adj
          end   as   gp2 
    ,nvl(t4.total_ar,0)                                       as net_ar_balance                        --净应收账款（含税）
    ,nvl(t4.bdp,0)                                            as bdp_balance                           --坏账准备金（未税）
    ,cast(NULL  as  decimal)                                  as sales_allowance                       --销售费用余额（未税）
    ,nvl(t3.collection,0)                                     as collection                            --回款（含税）
    ,nvl(t3.l6b_expense_claim,0)                              as l6b_expense_claim                     --L6b费用核销（含税）
    ,cast(0  as  decimal)                                     as l17_expense_claim                     --L17费用核销（含税）
    ,deduction                                                as deduction_l6b_deduction
    ,ror                                                      as ror_l6b_ror
    ,ror_return                                               as expected_product_returns_60d          --L12细项
    --计算，Net AR Balance(w tax）- BDP Balance(wo tax) - Sales allowance（L6b Provision Bal/wo tax) - Deduction (L6b deduction) - ROR (L6b ROR) + 60D Expected Product Returns (COG-L12)
    ,cast(NULL  as  decimal)     as  cnwc_ar                               --营运资金
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N'  then  (pld + rebate + rebate_py + int_agreement_cy + int_agreement_py)
          else (pld + rebate + int_agreement_cy) end                   as contractual_l6
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ppd+pld+fg) + ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction 
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then (ppd+pld+fg) + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                          end    as    trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda      --(L6_A+L6_B_wo_RoR*)/GES
    ,case when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+ttl_py + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction               
          when t5.py_release = 'N' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + ttl_py +(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                         
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'N' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + l6_b_adj+(ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                        
          when t5.py_release = 'Y' and t5.adj_release = 'Y' then ror + (ppd+pld+fg) + (ttl_cy+ttl_copa) + deduction                    end    as    trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa        --(L6_A+L6_B_w_RoR**)/GES      
    ,t5.py_release    as   py_release  --剔除PY
    ,t5.adj_release   as   adj_release --剔除adj
    ,t2.mark_up_ii    as   l10_mark_up_ii
    ,t6.pos 
    ,t.bu_1
    ,t.bu_2
    ,t.channel_lastest        
    ,t.sub_channel_lastest    
    ,t.customer_idh_lastest   
    ,t.customer_name_lastest

   ,case when t8.customer_idh is not null and t1.bu_2 = 'Laundry' and t1.months < '202401'  then 0 else

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2_tmp1 
as
select 
   month                                                                                                                                                 as  month
  ,month_en                                                                                                                                              as  month_en
  ,year                                                                                                                                                  as  year
  ,customer_idh                                                                                                                                          as  customer_idh
  ,customer_type                                                                                                                                         as  customer_type

  ,fg                                                                                                                                                    as  fg
  ,l6a                                                                                                                                                   as  l6_a
  ,l6a_others                                                                                                                                            as  l6a_others
  ,ngs                                                                                                                                                   as  ngs
  ,(ca_cy)                                                                                                  as  ca
  ,(listing_fee_cy)                                                                                         as  listing_fee
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  nka_expense
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  lka_contract_fee
  ,(rebate)                                                                                                 as  rebate
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  indirect_rebate
  ,(logistics_cy)                                                                                             as  logistic_fee
  ,(int_agreement_cy)                                                                                       as  agreement
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  nd_dis_dm_others
  ,(ror_cy)                                                                                                 as  return_provision_ror
  ,(deduction_cy)                                                                                           as  deduction
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6_b - l6b_py_release - ror_cy else l6_b_wo_ror end                                                                  as  l6_b_wo_ror
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6_b - l6b_py_release else l6_b end                                                                                  as  l6_b_w_ror
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6a +l6_b - l6b_py_release else  l6a +l6_b end                                                                       as  l6_total
  -- 历史遗留指标命名错误，此处需按照trade_spend_wo_ror的口径计算，前端需将该指标用作trade_spend_wo_ror的展示
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6a +l6_b - ror_cy - l6b_py_release else  l6a +l6_b - ror_cy end                                                                       as  trade_spend_w_ror
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then nes + l6b_py_release else nes end                                                                                    as  nes

  ,dsr                                                                                                                                                   as  l10_dsr

  ,ttl_l10                                                                                                                                               as  l10_commission
  ,l11_transp_w_h_cst                                                                                                                                    as  l11_t_w
  ,material_cost                                                                                                                                         as  l12_goods_sold
  ,ror_return                                                                                                                                            as  l12_provision_cog
  ,tp_price_others                                                                                                                                       as  l12_tp_price_others
  ,l13_processing_cost                                                                                                                                   as  l13_processing_cost
  ,l14_total_manufactur                                                                                                                                  as  l14_cog
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then c1 + l6b_py_release else c1 end                                                                                      as  c1
  ,l16_additional_opera                                                                                                                                  as  l16_umc
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then gp1 + l6b_py_release else gp1 end                                                                                    as  gp1
  ,l17_channel_breakdown                                                                                                                                 as  l17_nka_fix
  ,ttl_o2o                                                                                                                                               as  l17_nka_tm_o2o
  ,l17_channel_breakdown                                                                                                                                 as  l17_nka
  ,mkt_total                                                                                                                                             as  l17_mkt
  ,ba                                                                                                                                                    as  l17_ba
  ,ttl_a                                                                                                                                                 as  l17_a
  ,ttl_b                                                                                                                                                 as  l17_b
  ,ttl_c                                                                                                                                                 as  l17_c
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then (ttl_l17-py_release) else ttl_l17  end                                                                               as  l17_total
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then gp2 + l6b_py_release + py_release else gp2 end                                                                       as  gp2
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  pos_sale_amt
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6a +l6_b -  l6b_py_release else  l6a + l6_b end                                                                     as  trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6a +l6_b -  l6b_py_release - ror_cy else  l6a +l6_b - ror_cy end                                                    as  trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda
  ,(pld +  rebate  + int_agreement_cy)                                                                                                                   as  contractual_ges_actual
  ,(ppd + fg + ca_cy + logistics_cy)                                                                                                                       as  tactical_ges_actual
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then NULL else py_release end                                                                                             as  py_release
  ,a.is_not_py                                                                                                                                           as  is_not_py

  ,ttl_a2                                                                                                                                                as  l17_a2
  ,ttl_d                                                                                                                                                 as  l17_d
  ,digital_total                                                                                                                                         as  l17_digital
  ,bu_1                                                                                                                                                  as  bu_1
  ,bu_2                                                                                                                                                  as  bu_2
  ,mark_up_ii                                                                                                                                            as  mark_up_ii
  ,cast(0 as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                           as  retailer_rebate

  ,customer_idh_snapshot                                                                                                                                 as  customer_idh_snapshot

  ,region_cn                                                                                                                                             as  region_cn

  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then NULL else l6b_py_release end                                                                                         as  l6b_py_release

  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l17_breakdown_by_nature - py_release  else l17_breakdown_by_nature end                                               as  l17_breakdown_by_nature
  ,merchandising_l10
  ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then nes + l6b_py_release - nts else internal_sales end internal_sales

    ,nvl(case when COALESCE(t2.channel_name_lastest,tt.customer_type,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then replace(b.sub_channel,'NKA-','')
          when COALESCE(t2.channel_name_lastest,tt.customer_type,'Others') in ('Ecom') then 'Ecom'

              when COALESCE(t2.channel_name,tt.customer_type,'Others') in ('Ecom') then 'Ecom'

    ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

(
   -- 取ecom pos
    select
            case when substr(ds,1,6) <= '202307' and  customer_code = '2925773' then '1967491' else customer_code end  as  customer_idh
           ,null as dist_system_name_en
           ,sum(cast(untax_payment_actual as decimal(28,6))) as pos_sales_amt

           ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

           ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
       where ds>='20210101'  and data_source_name <> 'PG'  and customer_code <> '100006' -- 过滤老PG的数据

           ,substr(ds,1,6)  
           ,bu_2,bu_1
           ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
           ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
       
   union all
   
   ------------ KA POS取直供数据----------------
 
   select
       customer_group_en_lv2  as customer_idh,dist_system_name_en,
       sum(cast(original_amt_untax as decimal(28,6))) as pos_sales_amt,

   and first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')  -- 限制NKA及SR 防止LKA OT有直供数据

--计算慢流品数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_slow_moving_v2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_slow_moving_v2
as

select  
     sum(ges)                                    as ges              --销售总额
    ,sum(ppd)                                    as ppd              --商品折扣活动费用
    ,sum(pld  )                                  as pld              --商品陈列活动费用
    ,sum(fg)                                     as fg               --赠品金额
    ,sum(l6a_pro)                                as l6_a     
    ,sum(sku_ngs_amt)                            as ngs     
    ,sum(l6a_others)         as l6a_others
    ,to_char(to_date(posting_date,'yyyy-mm-dd 00:00:00'),'yyyymm') as months
    ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(t1.customer_group = 'RT',customer_group_en_lv2,t1.customer_group) else t1.customer_id end as customer_idh                             --经销商code
    ,bu_2
from
    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu t1
where ds != '' 
-- 此处L的判断条件不改为加工后的PPD字段，需要用原始product_promotion_discount判断，且不释放其他BU
  and ((bu_2 in ('Laundry') and product_promotion_discount <> 0) OR bu_2 in ('Beauty Care'))
  and slow_moving = 'Y'
group by to_char(to_date(posting_date,'yyyy-mm-dd 00:00:00'),'yyyymm')
         ,case when t1.first_channel_name_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(t1.customer_group = 'RT',customer_group_en_lv2,t1.customer_group) else t1.customer_id end
         ,bu_2

--默认选择“All”，即包括慢流品订单，展示内容与迭代前相同；
--筛选器选择“Slow moving”时仅计算慢流品订单GES至NES指标值，其中L6b细分指标的指标值为0，NES以下指标的指标值为空白；
--筛选器选择“Exclude slow moving”，仅计算剔除慢流品订单后的GES至NES指标值，NES以下指标的指标值为空白
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2_tmp22

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2_tmp22 as
select
 distinct
    t1.month
	,t1.month_en
	,t1.year
	,t1.customer_idh
	,t1.customer_type
	,t1.region
	,t1.customer_name
	,t1.system_name
	,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.ges
          when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving'          then   nvl(t2.ges,0)
          when t3.slow_moving = 'Exclude slow moving'  then   nvl(t1.ges,0) - nvl(t2.ges,0) end  as  ges

          when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving'          then   nvl(t2.ppd,0)

-- insert overwrite table dme_ads.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_month_mf_v2 PARTITION (ds='${bizmonth}')
select
     t1.months                                                                                                                                                               as       month
    ,t1.years                                                                                                                                                                as       year
    ,decode(substr(t1.months,5,2),'01','Jan','02','Feb','03','Mar','04','Apr','05','May','06','Jun','07','Jul','08','Aug','09','Sep','10','Oct','11','Nov','12','Dec' )      as       month_en
    ,t1.quarters                                                                                                                                                             as       quarter
    ,t6.status                                                                                                                                                               as       status
    ,nvl(case when t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')                then replace(b.sub_channel,'NKA-','') 
          when t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('Ecom')                                    then t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest
          else t1.region_en_lastest  end,'Others')                                                                                               as       region 
    ,nvl(t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,'Others')                                                                                                                                          as       customer_type
    ,nvl(case when t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(t1.customer_group = 'RT',customer_group_en_lv2,t1.customer_group) else t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest end,'Others')                                      as       system_name
    ,nvl(case when t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(t1.customer_group = 'RT',customer_group_en_lv2,t1.customer_group) else decode(t1.customer_code,'Not assigned','Others',t1.customer_code) end,'Others')   as       customer_idh
    ,nvl(case when t1.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then t1.customer_group_cn_lv2 else t1.customer_name end,'Others')                                        as       customer_name
    ,cast(sum(t1.ges                    ) as decimal(28,6))                                                                                       as       ges
    ,cast(sum(t1.ppd                    ) as decimal(28,6))                                                                                       as       ppd
    ,cast(sum(t1.pld                    ) as decimal(28,6))                                                                                       as       pld
    ,cast(sum(t1.pfg                    ) as decimal(28,6))                                                                                       as       fg
    ,cast(sum(t1.ngs                    ) as decimal(28,6))                                                                                       as       ngs
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       others
    ,cast(sum(t1.rebate_cy                       )  as decimal(28,6))                                                                                      as       rebate
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       logstic
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       ca
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       int_agreement
    ,cast(sum(t1.rebate_cy                       )  as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                       as       ttl_copa
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       rebate_adj_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       logistics_adj_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       ca_adj_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       int_agreement_adj_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.listing_fee_cy                                 )     as decimal(28,6))                                                                                   as       listing_fee_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       retailer_rebate_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       indirect_rebate_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       bga_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       contract_expense_nka_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       nd_dis_dm_others_cy
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                        as       lka_contract_fee_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.int_agreement_cy                                     )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       int_agreement_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.oos_penalty_cy                                       )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       oos_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.promotion_activities_cy                              )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       promotion_activists_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.ka_expense_cy                                        )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ka_expense_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.logistics_cy                                         )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       logistics_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.ca_cy                                                )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ca_cy
    --计算，Rebate adj. CY+Logistics adj. CY+CA adj. CY+Int. agreement adj CY+Listing Fee CY+Int. Agreement CY+OOS Penalty CY+Promotion Activists CY+KA Expense CY+Logistics CY+CA CY+L6 B others CY
    ,cast(sum(t1.listing_fee_cy+t1.int_agreement_cy+t1.oos_penalty_cy+t1.promotion_activities_cy+t1.ka_expense_cy+t1.logistics_cy+t1.ca_cy+t1.l6b_others_cy )  as decimal(28,6)) as       ttl_cy
    ,cast(sum(t1.listing_fee_py                                       )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       listing_fee_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       retailer_rebate_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.int_agreement_py                                     )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       int_agreement_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.oos_penalty_py                                       )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       oos_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.promotion_activities_py                              )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       promotion_activists_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.ka_expense_py                                        )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ka_expense_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       indirect_rebate_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       bga_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       nka_expense_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       nd_dis_dm_others_py
    ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6)                                                   )                                                                                            as       lka_contract_fee_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.rebate_py                                            )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       rebate_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.logistics_py                                         )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       logstic_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.ca_py                                                )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ca_py

    -- 计算，Listing Fee PY+Int. Agreement PY+OOS Penalty PY+Promotion Activities PY+KA Expense PY+Rebate PY+LOGSTIC PY+CA PY+Int. agreement adj PY+L6 B others PY
    ,cast(sum(t1.py_release-t1.ror_py-t1.deduction_py)  as decimal(28,6))  as       ttl_py
    ,cast(sum(t1.l6b-t1.ror-t1.deduction-t1.rebate_cy)  as decimal(28,6))                                                                 as       ttl_mannual_accr
    ,cast(sum(t1.ror                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ror

    ,cast(sum(t1.nes                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       nes

    ,cast(sum(t1.l10                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ttl_l10
    ,cast(sum(t1.l11                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l11_transp_w_h_cst
    ,cast(sum(t1.l12_goods_sold                                       )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       material_cost
    ,cast(sum(t1.l12_provision_cog                                    )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ror_return
    ,cast(sum(t1.l12_tp_price_others                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       tp_price_others
    ,cast(sum(t1.l12                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       ttl_l12
    ,cast(sum(t1.l13                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l13_processing_cost
    ,cast(sum(t1.l14                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l14_total_manufactur
    ,cast(sum(t1.c1                                                   )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       c1
    ,cast(sum(t1.l16                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l16_additional_opera
    ,cast(sum(t1.gp1                                                  )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       gp1
    ,cast(max(nvl(t5.ttl_o2o ,0)          )        as decimal(28,6)                   )                                                                                        as       ttl_o2o
    ,cast(max(nvl(t5.po_a     ,0) )   as decimal(28,6)                                 )             as   po_a         
    ,cast(max(nvl(t5.po_b     ,0) )   as decimal(28,6)                                 )             as   po_b

    ,cast(sum(t1.l17a                                                 )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                    as       ttl_a
    ,cast(sum(t1.l17b                                                 )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                    as       ttl_b
    ,cast(sum(t1.l17c                                                 )   as decimal(28,6))                                                                                    as       ttl_c

    ,cast(sum(t1.l6b-t1.ror_cy  )             as decimal(28,6)                         )                                                                                        as       l6_b_wo_ror
    ,cast(nullif(sum(t1.l6a),0)/nullif(sum(t1.ges),0)                     as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l6_a_ges
    ,cast(nullif(sum((t1.l6b-t1.ror_cy)),0)/nullif(sum(t1.ges),0)         as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       l6_b_ges_wo_ror
    ,cast(nullif(sum((t1.l6-t1.ror_cy)),0)/nullif(sum(t1.ges),0 )         as decimal(28,6))                                                                                     as       trade_spend_wo_ror

    ,cast(sum(t1.deduction_py   )    as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                       as       deduction_py

    ,cast(sum(t1.l6b_others_py  )    as decimal(28,6))                                                                                                                       as       l6b_others_py
    ,cast(max(nvl(t5.po_a,0) + nvl(t5.po_b,0 ) + nvl(t5.po_c,0 )+ nvl(t5.manual_a,0 )+ nvl(t5.manual_b,0 )+ nvl(t5.manual_c,0 )  ) as decimal(28,6))                            as       l17_channel_breakdown

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_region_mf_v2_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_region_mf_v2_tmp1 AS
-- 用新的逻辑
select  --distinct
    region                                                                                     as   region
   ,month                                                                                      as   month
   ,month_en                                                                                   as   month_en
   ,year                                                                                       as   year
   ,customer_type                                                                              as   customer_type
   ,ges                                                                                        as   ges
   ,ppd                                                                                        as   ppd
   ,pld                                                                                        as   pld
   ,fg                                                                                         as   fg
   ,ngs                                                                                        as   ngs
   ,(ca_cy)                                       as   ca
   ,(listing_fee_cy)                            as   listing_fee
   ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6))                                                               as   nka_expense
   ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6))                                                               as   lka_contract_fee
   ,(rebate)                                    as   rebate
   ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6))                                                               as   indirect_rebate
   ,(int_agreement_cy)                          as   int_agreement
   ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6))                                                               as   nd_dis_dm_others
   ,(ror_cy)                                    as   return_provision_ror
   ,(deduction_cy)                              as   deduction
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then nes + l6b_py_release else nes end                         as   nes
   ,ttl_l10                                                                                    as   l10_commission
   ,l11_transp_w_h_cst                                                                         as   l11_t_w
   ,l14_total_manufactur                                                                       as   l14_cog
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then c1 + l6b_py_release else c1 end                           as   c1
   ,l16_additional_opera                                                                       as   l16_umc
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then gp1 + l6b_py_release else gp1 end                         as   gp1
   ,ttl_o2o                                                                                    as   l17_nka_tm_o2o
   ,mkt_total                                                                                  as   l17_mkt
   ,ba                                                                                         as   l17_ba
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then ttl_l17 - py_release else ttl_l17 end                     as   l17_total
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then gp2 + l6b_py_release + py_release else gp2 end            as   gp2
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then l6a +l6_b - l6b_py_release - ror_cy else l6a +l6_b - ror_cy end  as   trade_spending_wo_ror
   ,a.is_not_py                                                                                as   is_not_py
   ,bu_1                                                                                       as   bu_1
   ,bu_2                                                                                       as   bu_2
   ,cast(NULL  as decimal(28,6))                                                               as   retailer_rebate
   ,(ka_expense_cy)                           as   ka_expense
   ,(promotion_activists_cy)                  as   promotion_activists
   ,(logistics_cy)                            as   logistic_fee
   ,(oos_cy)                                  as   oos
   ,digital_total                                                                              as   digital_total
   ,region_cn                                                                                  as   region_cn
   ,l6a_others                                                                                 as   l6a_others
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then NULL else l6b_py_release end                              as   l6b_py_release
   ,l6b_others_cy                                                                              as   l6b_others
   ,l17_channel_breakdown                                                                      as   l17_channel_breakdown
   ,case when a.is_not_py = 'Y' then NULL else py_release end                                  as   py_release
   ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
   ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
    ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_month_mf_v2 t
left join 
(
    select  'Y' as is_not_py,'1' as  flag union all 
    select  'N' as is_not_py,'1' as  flag 
    
)a
on case when t.month is not null then '1' else '' end = a.flag
where t.ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_month_mf_v2')
and customer_type in ('DT','MPD')

--将所有指标写入value_type 以及值写入index_value
--insert overwrite table dme_ads.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_region_mf_v2 partition(ds='${bizmonth}')
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_region_mf_v2 partition(ds='${bizmonth}')
select
    tmp.region            --大区
    ,month             --月份
    ,month_en          --月份(英文缩写)
    ,year              --年
    ,customer_type     --渠道
    ,value_type        --指标名称
    ,cast(sum(case when value is not null and instr(value,'-') != 0 then
    replace(value,'-','') * (-1)
    when value is null then 0
    when value is not null and instr(value,'-') = 0 then value 
    else 0
    end) as decimal(28,6))  as  index_value  --指标值
    ,is_not_py
    ,bu_1
    ,bu_2
    ,region_cn
    ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
    (select
        region            --大区
        ,month             --月份
        ,month_en          --月份(英文缩写)
        ,year              --年
        ,customer_type     --渠道
        ,map(
            "ges",nvl(ges,0),                                         --销售总额
            "ppd",nvl(ppd,0),                                         --Price_Promotion_Discount，商品折扣活动费用
            "pld",nvl(pld,0),                                         --Price_Listing_Discount，商品陈列活动费用
            "fg",nvl(fg,0),                                           --Free_Goods，赠品金额
            "ngs",nvl(ngs,0),                                         --全称Net_Gross_Sales，即净销售总额；
            "ca",nvl(ca,0),                                           --价差
            "listing_fee",nvl(listing_fee,0),                         --新品进场费
            "nka_expense",nvl(nka_expense,0),                         --合同固定费用
            "lka_contract_fee",nvl(lka_contract_fee,0),               --LKA 合同返利
            "rebate",nvl(rebate,0),                                   --返利
            "indirect_rebate",nvl(indirect_rebate,0),                 --间供合同返利
            "int_agreement",nvl(int_agreement,0),                     --全球协议返利
            "2nd_dis_dm_others",nvl(nd_dis_dm_others,0),               --陈列费+海报费+其他
            "return_provision_ror",nvl(return_provision_ror,0),       --退货
            "deduction",nvl(deduction,0),                             --递减
            "nes",nvl(nes,0),                                         --"全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；计算口径为NGS-L6b"
            "l10_commission",nvl(l10_commission,0),                   --Commission（佣金）
            "l11_t_w",nvl(l11_t_w,0),                                 --Transport/Warehouse，运输和仓库管理相关费用
            "l14_cog",nvl(l14_cog,0),                                 --即Total_Manufacturing_Cost，制造类费用
            "c1",nvl(c1,0),                                           --
            "l16_umc",nvl(l16_umc,0),                                 --即Added_Operational_Cost，额外运营费用
            "gp1",nvl(gp1,0),                                         --即Gross_Profit_1，为NES扣除L10、L11、L14和L16四类费用后的一类利润；计算口径为NES_-_L10_-L11_-_L14_-_L16
            "l17_nka_tm_o2o",nvl(l17_nka_tm_o2o,0),                   --
            "l17_mkt",nvl(l17_mkt,0),                                 --
            "l17_ba",nvl(l17_ba,0),                                   --
            "l17_total",nvl(l17_total,0),                             --即市场费用，L17a（Advertising，广告费）、L17b（Promotion，促销费用）、L17c（Market_Research，市场调研费）三类费用之和；TTL_L17=L17a+L17b+L17c
            "gp2",nvl(gp2,0),                                         --即Gross_Profit_2，为GP1扣除L17费用后的一类利润；计算口径为GP1-L17
            "retailer_rebate",nvl(retailer_rebate,0),
            "ka_expense",nvl(ka_expense,0),
            "promotion_activists",nvl(promotion_activists,0),
            "logistic_fee",nvl(logistic_fee,0),
            "oos",nvl(oos,0),
            "digital_total",nvl(digital_total,0),
            "trade_spending_wo_ror",nvl(trade_spending_wo_ror,0),
            "l6a_others",nvl(l6a_others,0),
            "l6b_py_release",nvl(l6b_py_release,0),
            "l6b_others",nvl(l6b_others,0),
            "l17_channel_breakdown",nvl(l17_channel_breakdown,0),
            "py_release",nvl(py_release,0)  
        ) as kv
        ,is_not_py
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,region_cn
        ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
        ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    from
        ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_region_mf_v2_tmp1 ) tmp
        
    
    lateral view explode(kv) t as value_type,value
    
    group by  region            --大区

--by Customer、by Region两页添加Slow Moving单选筛选器，可下拉选择“All”、“Slow moving”、“Exclude slow moving”，
--默认选择“All”，即包括慢流品订单，展示内容与迭代前KP相同；
--筛选器选择“Slow moving”时仅计算慢流品，KP为空白；
--筛选器选择“Exclude slow moving”，GES至NES为实际KP值，NES以下指标的指标值为空白

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_kp_target_mf_v2_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_kp_target_mf_v2_tmp1 
as
select
      t1.month
     ,t1.month_en
     ,t1.quarter
     ,t1.year
     ,t1.customer_id_lastest    as  customer_id      --customer_id    
     ,t1.customer_type_lastest  as  customer_type    --渠道
     ,t1.region_lastest         as  region           --'大区
     ,t1.customer_name_lastest  as  customer_name    --Customer Name
     ,t1.system_name_lastest    as  system_name
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ges                      end  as  ges
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ppd                      end  as  ppd                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.pld                      end  as  pld                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.fg                       end  as  fg                     
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.l6_a                     end  as  l6_a                   
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ngs                      end  as  ngs                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ca                       end  as  ca                     
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.rebate                   end  as  rebate                 
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.logistic_fee             end  as  logistic_fee           
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.l6_b_wo_ror              end  as  l6_b_wo_ror            
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.deduction                end  as  deduction              
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.return_provision         end  as  return_provision       
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.l6_b_w_ror               end  as  l6_b_w_ror             
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.l6_total                 end  as  l6_total               
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.trade_spend_w_ror        end  as  trade_spend_w_ror      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.nes                      end  as  nes                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l10_bdp                       else  NULL  end  as  l10_bdp                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l10_dsr                       else  NULL  end  as  l10_dsr                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.mark_up_ii                    else  NULL  end  as  mark_up_ii                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l10_sur_tax                   else  NULL  end  as  l10_sur_tax              
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l10_commission                else  NULL  end  as  l10_commission           
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l11_t_w                       else  NULL  end  as  l11_t_w                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l12_goods_sold                else  NULL  end  as  l12_goods_sold           
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l12_provision_cog             else  NULL  end  as  l12_provision_cog        
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l12_tp_price_others           else  NULL  end  as  l12_tp_price_others      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l13_processing_cost           else  NULL  end  as  l13_processing_cost      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l14_cog                       else  NULL  end  as  l14_cog                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.c1                            else  NULL  end  as  c1                       
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l16_umc                       else  NULL  end  as  l16_umc                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.gp1                           else  NULL  end  as  gp1                      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_nka_tm_o2o                else  NULL  end  as  l17_nka_tm_o2o           
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_nka                       else  NULL  end  as  l17_nka                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_mkt                       else  NULL  end  as  l17_mkt                  
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_ba                        else  NULL  end  as  l17_ba                   
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_a                         else  NULL  end  as  l17_a                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_b                         else  NULL  end  as  l17_b                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_c                         else  NULL  end  as  l17_c                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_total                     else  NULL  end  as  l17_total                
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_a1                        else  NULL  end  as  l17_a1                   
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_a2                        else  NULL  end  as  l17_a2                   
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_d                         else  NULL  end  as  l17_d                    
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.gp2                           else  NULL  end  as  gp2                      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.pos                           else  NULL  end  as  pos                      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.listing_fee             end  as  listing_fee              
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.nka_expense             end  as  nka_expense              
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.lka_contract_fee        end  as  lka_contract_fee         
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.indirect_rebate         end  as  indirect_rebate          
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.agreement               end  as  agreement                
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.nd_dis_dm_others        end  as  nd_dis_dm_others         
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ror                     end  as  ror                      
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.nd_display_dm_others    end  as  nd_display_dm_others     
     ,t3.slow_moving  as  slow_moving
     ,t1.bu_1
     ,t1.bu_2
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.retailer_rebate        end  as  retailer_rebate         
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.ka_expense             end  as  ka_expense              
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.promotion_activists    end  as  promotion_activists     
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'Slow moving' then  NULL  else t1.oos                    end  as  oos                     
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l10_royalties       else  NULL  end  as  l10_royalties                        
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l17_digital         else  NULL  end  as  l17_digital                          
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.trade_spend_wo_ror  else  NULL  end  as  trade_spend_wo_ror                   
     ,case when t3.slow_moving = 'All'  then  t1.l12_goods_sold + t1.l12_provision_cog + t1.l12_tp_price_others else  NULL  end  as  ttl_12       
from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_target_mf_v2 t1
left join 
(
--by Customer、by Region两页添加Slow Moving单选筛选器，
--可下拉选择“All”、“Slow moving”、“Exclude slow moving”，

    select 'All'                  as  slow_moving,1 as flag  union all 
    select 'Slow moving'          as  slow_moving,1 as flag  union all 
    select 'Exclude slow moving'  as  slow_moving,1 as flag 
)t3
on  case when t1.customer_id is not null then 1 end =  t3.flag
where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_controlling_target_mf_v2')
