--计算GES的分摊比率，渠道为Others的不参与分摊计算，YTD中若涉及FCST月份，则用GES的FCST值
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp2 as
select  
    t1.fcst_date                                                         
   ,t1.months                      
   ,t1.years 
   ,t1.customer_idh                
   ,t1.bu_2                
   ,cast((t1.ges/t2.ges)  as decimal(38,10))           AS  ges_ratio
from 
(    --计算出每个月各客户的YTD
    select  
        t1.fcst_date                                                         
       ,t1.months                      
       ,t1.years 
      -- ,t1.channel   
       ,t1.customer_idh 
       ,t1.bu_2      
       ,nvl(sum(t2.ges)           ,0)  AS  ges
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 t1       
    inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 t2
     on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
    and t1.years    = t2.years
    and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
    and t1.bu_2         = t2.bu_2
    and t1.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t1.py_release    =  'N'
    and t2.py_release    =  'N'
    where t1.months >= t2.months
      and t1.channel <> 'Others'
      and t2.channel <> 'Others'
    group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
        ,t1.months                      
        ,t1.years 
       -- ,t1.channel
        ,t1.customer_idh
        ,t1.bu_2 
)t1
left join (
    select   --计算出每个月的totalYTD
        t1.fcst_date                                                         
       ,t1.months                      
       ,t1.years
       ,t1.bu_2        
       ,nvl(sum(t2.ges)           ,0)  AS  ges
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 t1       
    inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 t2
    on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
    and t1.years    = t2.years
    and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    and t1.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t1.py_release    =  'N'
    and t2.py_release    =  'N'
    where t1.months >= t2.months
      and t1.channel <> 'Others'
      and t2.channel <> 'Others'
      group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
               ,t1.months                      
               ,t1.years 
               ,t1.bu_2        
)t2
on  t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date                                                      
and t1.months    = t2.months                   
and t1.years     = t2.years    
and t1.bu_2     = t2.bu_2

--计算O2O、BA的分摊比率，渠道为Others的不参与分摊计算，只看actual的YTD
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp3

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp3 as
select  
    t1.fcst_date                                                         
   ,t1.customer_idh  
   ,t1.bu_2    
   ,case when t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o = 0 then 0 else cast((t1.l17_nka_tm_o2o/t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o )  as decimal(38,10)) end         AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o_ratio
   ,case when t2.l17_ba = 0 then 0 else  cast((t1.l17_ba/t2.l17_ba )  as decimal(38,10))   end                              AS  l17_ba_ratio
from 
(   --计算出每客户的YTD,2
    select  
        t1.fcst_date                                                         
       ,t1.customer_idh                
       ,t1.bu_2        
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from (
       select 
       distinct fcst_date,customer_idh,channel,bu_2
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1
    ) t1       
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2 t2
     on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4)    = t2.years
    and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t2.py_release    =  'N'
    where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) >= t2.months
      and t1.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and t2.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and substr(t1.fcst_date,5,2) <> '01' --非1月，用本年的YTD
    group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
        ,t1.customer_idh,t1.bu_2 
        
    union all 
    
    select  
        t1.fcst_date                                                         
       ,t1.customer_idh  
       ,t1.bu_2            
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from (
       select 
       distinct fcst_date,customer_idh,channel,bu_2
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1
    ) t1       
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2 t2
     on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4) = (t2.years+1)
    and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
    and t2.py_release    =  'N'
    where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) >= t2.months
      and t1.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and t2.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and substr(t1.fcst_date,5,2) = '01' --1月，用去年的YTD
    group by  t1.fcst_date                                                         
        ,t1.customer_idh,t1.bu_2 
    
)t1
left join (
    select  
        t1.fcst_date,t1.bu_2                                                         
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from (
       select 
       distinct fcst_date,customer_idh,channel,bu_2
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1
    ) t1       
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2 t2
     on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4)    = t2.years
     and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
     and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
     and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
     and t2.py_release    =  'N'
    where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) >= t2.months
      and t1.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and t2.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and substr(t1.fcst_date,5,2) <> '01' --非1月，用本年的YTD
    group by  t1.fcst_date ,t1.bu_2                                                        
        
    union all 
    
    select  
        t1.fcst_date    ,t1.bu_2                                                     
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_nka_tm_o2o),0)  AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o
       ,nvl(sum(t2.l17_ba)        ,0)  AS  l17_ba
    from (
       select 
       distinct fcst_date,customer_idh,channel,bu_2
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1
    ) t1       
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v2 t2
     on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4) = (t2.years+1)
    and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
    and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) >= t2.months
      and t1.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and t2.channel not in ('MPD','Ecom')
      and t2.adj_release   =  'N'
      and t2.py_release    =  'N'
      and substr(t1.fcst_date,5,2) = '01' --1月，用去年的YTD
    group by  t1.fcst_date  ,t1.bu_2                                                       
)t2
on  t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date                                                      
and  t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2

--- 待分摊的Total值如果某个渠道存在本期没有上传，那就沿用上一期的预测
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_fcst_total_title

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_fcst_total_title as
select distinct
    fcst_date
   ,non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
   ,fcst_date_copy --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
   ,rn
   ,bu_2
from(
    select 
        t1.fcst_date
        ,t1.bu_2          
        ,t1.non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
        ,case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end  as  fcst_date_copy
        ,dense_rank() over(partition by  t1.fcst_date,t1.non_latest,t1.bu_2 order by case when t1.non_latest  = 'N' then t1.fcst_date else t2.fcst_date end desc) as rn
    from 
    (
    select 
    distinct
         t2.fcst_date  as  fcst_date 
        ,t2.bu_2       
        ,case when t1.fcst_date is null then 'Y' else 'N' end   as   non_latest  --是否本周期未上传
    from  
    ( 
            select 
            distinct
                b.fcst_date  as fcst_date                                                    
               ,a.bu_2
            from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 a
            left join 
            (
            select 
                distinct fcst_date,1  as  flag 
            from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1
            )b
            on case when a.customer_idh  is not null then 1 end = b.flag
            where b.fcst_date >= a.fcst_date
    )t2
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_fcst_total t1

select

   ,channel

   ,ka_expense

   ,promotion_activists            
   ,logistic_fee                  
   ,oos                            
   ,int_agreement

   ,l6_b_wo_ror                      
   ,trade_spend_wo_ror               
   ,ror

   ,l6_total

   ,l11_t_w                          
   ,l12_goods_sold                   
   ,l12_provision_cog                
   ,l12_tp_price_others              
   ,l13                              
   ,l14_cog                          
   ,nes - (case when adj_release = 'N' then (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax + l10_adj)
                else (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax) end) - l11_t_w - l14_cog          as   product_contribution       --计算，NES - L10 Commission - L11 Transport &Warehouse - L14 COG        
   ,l16                              
   ,(nes - (case when adj_release = 'N' then (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax + l10_adj)
                 else (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax) end) - l11_t_w - l14_cog) - l16  as  gp1                         --计算，Product Contribution - L16 UMC
   ,l17_channel                      
   ,l17_mkt                          
   ,l17_digital                      
   ,l17_nka_tm_o2o                   
   ,l17_ba                           
   ,l17_adj                          
   ,l17_total                        
   ,((nes - (case when adj_release = 'N' then (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax + l10_adj)
                  else (l10_bdp + l10_dsr + l10_sur_tax) end) - l11_t_w - l14_cog) - l16) - l17_total  as  gp2              --GP1 - L17 Total                        
   ,net_ar_balance    --待计算                
   ,bdp_balance                      
   ,sales_allowance   --待计算               
   ,collection                       
   ,l6b_expense_claim                
   ,l17_expense_claim                
   ,deduction_l6b_deduction          
   ,ror_l6b_ror                      
   ,expected_product_returns_60d     
   ,cnwc_ar                          
   ,contractual_l6                   
   ,trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda      
   ,trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa   
   ,adj_release
   ,py_release 
   ,case when is_fcst = 'Y' then 'FCST' else 'Act' end  data_type
   ,l10_mark_up_ii 
   ,pos  
   ,bu_1
   ,bu_2
   ,l10_adj                     
from
(
    select  
        distinct
         t1.fcst_date                                                         
        ,t1.channel                      
        ,t1.months                       
        ,t1.years                        
        ,t1.customer_idh                 
        ,t1.ges                AS  ges                         
        ,t1.ppd                AS  ppd                         
        ,t1.pld                AS  pld                         
        ,t1.fg                 AS  fg                          
        ,t1.l6_a               AS  l6_a                        
        ,t1.ngs                AS  ngs                         
        ,t1.ca                   AS  ca                          
        ,t1.rebate               AS  rebate                      
        ,t1.retailer_rebate      AS  retailer_rebate             
        ,t1.ka_expense           AS  ka_expense                  
        ,t1.listing_fee          AS  listing_fee                 
        ,t1.promotion_activists  AS  promotion_activists         
        ,t1.logistic_fee        AS  logistic_fee               
        ,t1.oos                  AS  oos                         
        ,t1.int_agreement        AS  int_agreement               
        ,t1.l6_b_adj           AS  l6_b_adj                    
        ,t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction            AS  l6_b_wo_ror                 
        ,t1.l6_a + t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction  AS  trade_spend_wo_ror          
        ,t1.ror                AS  ror                         
        ,t1.deduction          AS  deduction                   
        ,t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction + t1.ror            AS  l6_b_w_ror                  
        ,t1.l6_a + t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction + t1.ror  AS  l6_total                    
        ,t1.ngs - (t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction + t1.ror) AS  nes                         
        ,t1.l10_bdp AS  l10_bdp                     
        ,case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' and t1.channel in ('NKA') then nvl(t1.l10_dsr,0) + nvl(t2.l10_dsr,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)  else nvl(t2.l10_dsr,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0) end  AS  l10_dsr 
        --计算，(NES - l10_bdp - l10_dsr - l11_t_w - l14_cog)*1.56%   
        ,((t1.ngs - (t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction) + t1.ror)
            - (t1.l10_bdp) 
            - (case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 when t1.fcst_date >= '20240101' and t1.channel in ('NKA') then nvl(t1.l10_dsr,0) + nvl(t2.l10_dsr,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)  else nvl(t2.l10_dsr,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0) end) 
            - ((nvl(t2.l11_warehouse,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (t1.ges * nvl(t4.l11_transport,0))) 
            - (t1.l12_goods_sold + (nvl(t2.l12_provision_cog,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (nvl(t2.l12_tp_price_others,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (nvl(t2.l13,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)))) * nvl(t4.l10_sur_tax,0)  AS  l10_sur_tax                 
        ,nvl(t2.l10_royalties,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)                                  AS  l10_royalties               
        ,t1.l10_commission                                                AS  l10_commission   --待计算            
        ,(nvl(t2.l11_warehouse,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (t1.ges * nvl(t4.l11_transport,0))  AS  l11_t_w                     
        ,t1.l12_goods_sold                                                AS  l12_goods_sold              
        ,nvl(t2.l12_provision_cog,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)                              AS  l12_provision_cog           
        ,nvl(t2.l12_tp_price_others,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)                            AS  l12_tp_price_others         
        ,nvl(t2.l13,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)                                            AS  l13     
        --计算，l12_goods_sold + l12_provision_cog + l12_tp_price_others + L13   
        ,t1.l12_goods_sold + (nvl(t2.l12_provision_cog,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (nvl(t2.l12_tp_price_others,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) + (nvl(t2.l13,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) AS  l14_cog                    
        ,t1.product_contribution    AS  product_contribution          --待计算  
        ,nvl(t2.l16_umc,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)  AS  l16                               
        ,t1.gp1                     AS  gp1                           --待计算 
        ,t1.l17_channel             AS  l17_channel                 
        ,nvl(t2.l17_mkt,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)  AS  l17_mkt                     
        ,nvl(t2.l17_digital,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)        AS  l17_digital                 
        ,case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 else nvl(t2.l17_o2o,0) * nvl(t5.l17_nka_tm_o2o_ratio,0) end AS  l17_nka_tm_o2o              
        ,case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 else nvl(t2.l17_ba,0)  * nvl(t5.l17_ba_ratio,0)         end AS  l17_ba                      
        ,t1.l17_adj                           AS  l17_adj                     
        ,(t1.l17_channel 
          + (nvl(t2.l17_mkt,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) 
          + (nvl(t2.l17_digital,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)) 
          + (case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 else nvl(t2.l17_o2o,0) * nvl(t5.l17_nka_tm_o2o_ratio,0) end) 
          + (case when t1.channel in ('Ecom','MPD') then 0 else nvl(t2.l17_ba,0)  * nvl(t5.l17_ba_ratio,0)         end) 
          + (t1.l17_adj)) AS  l17_total         --计算， l17_channel + l17_mkt + l17_digital + l17_nka_tm_o2o + l17_ba + l17_adj          
        ,t1.gp2                      AS  gp2                                --待计算                     
        ,t1.net_ar_balance           AS  net_ar_balance                     --待计算
        ,t1.bdp_balance              AS  bdp_balance                 
        ,t1.sales_allowance          AS  sales_allowance                    --待计算            
        ,t1.collection               AS  collection                  
        ,t1.l6b_expense_claim        AS  l6b_expense_claim           
        ,t1.l17_expense_claim        AS  l17_expense_claim           
        ,t1.deduction_l6b_deduction  AS  deduction_l6b_deduction     
        ,t1.ror_l6b_ror              AS  ror_l6b_ror                 
        ,nvl(t2.l12_provision_cog,0) * nvl(t3.ges_ratio,0)  AS  expected_product_returns_60d
        ,t1.cnwc_ar                  AS  cnwc_ar                     
        ,t1.pld + t1.rebate + t1.int_agreement         AS  contractual_l6              
        ,t1.l6_a + t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction           AS  trade_spend_wo_ror_per_scda 
        ,t1.l6_a + t1.ca + t1.rebate + t1.retailer_rebate + t1.ka_expense + t1.listing_fee + t1.promotion_activists + t1.logistic_fee + t1.oos + t1.int_agreement + t1.l6_b_adj + t1.deduction + t1.ror  AS  trade_spend_w_ror_per_csa  
        ,t1.adj_release
        ,t1.py_release  
        ,t1.is_fcst
        ,t1.l10_mark_up_ii 
        ,t1.pos  
        ,t1.bu_1
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,t1.l10_adj                     
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp1 t1                           
    left join 
    (
         select 
             t4.years             
            ,t4.months                  
            ,t4.l10_dsr            
            ,t4.l10_royalties      
            ,t4.l11_warehouse      
            ,t4.l12_provision_cog

            ,t4.l13

            ,t4.l17_digital

            ,t1.fcst_date             
            ,t4.bu_2
         from  ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_fcst_total_title t1
         left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_fcst_total t4 
          on t1.fcst_date_copy    = t4.fcst_date   --本周期上传的用本周期fcst_date，未上传的用最新一次上传的fcst_date
         and t1.bu_2      = t4.bu_2      
         and t4.rn = 1
         where t4.bu_2 is not null 
    )t2
      on t1.fcst_date = t2.fcst_date
      and t1.years  = t2.years
      and t1.months = t2.months
      and t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp2 t3
      on t1.fcst_date    = t3.fcst_date                                                        
      and t1.months       = t3.months                     
      and t1.years        = t3.years       
      and t1.customer_idh = t3.customer_idh 
      and t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2 
    left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2_tmp3 t5
       on t1.fcst_date    = t5.fcst_date                                                        
      and t1.customer_idh = t5.customer_idh

   and t1.bu_2 = a.bu_2

      and t1.fcst_date >= t4.start_fcst_date and t1.fcst_date < t4.end_fcst_date

select     
   max(t1.months)  as   months        
  ,'-'     as  channel           
  ,'-'     as  sub_channel       
  ,'-'     as  customer_idh         
  ,'-'     as  customer_name 
  ,'ACT'   as    data_type
  ,t1.bu_2

    select distinct month  as  months,bu_2

    where ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_month_mf_v2')
)t1

(
    select 
         distinct to_char(to_date(date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as  months
    from ${dme_ods}.s_bdp_rawdata_sop a
    where a.ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_bdp_rawdata_sop') 
)t2
on t1.months = t2.months    
inner join 
(
    select distinct months from (
        select 
            concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months                  
            ,row_number() over(partition by channel,customer_idh,years,months order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as  rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_act_cnwc_sales_controlling a
        where a.ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_act_cnwc_sales_controlling')

    where rn = 1
)t3
on t1.months = t3.months  
inner join 
(
   select 
       months
   from ${dme_ods}.s_monthly_actual_aging_report_bc
   where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_monthly_actual_aging_report_bc') 
   group by months
)t4
 on t1.months = t4.months  
inner join 
(
   select distinct 
     concat(year,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as  months
   from ${dme_ods}.s_profitability_nes_report
   where ds =max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_profitability_nes_report') 
)t5
 on t1.months = t5.months  
group by t1.bu_2

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_ar_allowance_bts_v2_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_ar_allowance_bts_v2_tmp1 as
select 
    t1.fcst_date           
   ,t1.channel          
   ,t1.months           
   ,t1.years            
   ,t1.customer_idh     
   ,t1.ngs  
   ,t1.l6_b_wo_ror   
   ,t1.collection       
   ,t1.l6b_expense_claim
   ,t1.l17_expense_claim
   ,nvl(t4.net_ar_balance_ratio1,0) AS  net_ar_balance_ratio1
   ,nvl(t4.net_ar_balance_ratio2,0) AS  net_ar_balance_ratio2
   ,nvl(t4.net_ar_balance,0)    AS   net_ar_balance_ratio
   ,nvl(t4.sales_allowance,0)   AS   sales_allowance_ratio   
   ,nvl(t2.sales_allowance,0)   AS   sales_allowance_last
   ,nvl(t2.net_ar_balance,0)    AS   net_ar_balance_last
   ,case when t1.channel = 'DT' then nvl(t2.net_ar_balance,0) + t1.ngs * nvl(t4.net_ar_balance_ratio1,0) * nvl(t4.net_ar_balance_ratio2,0) - t1.collection - t1.l6b_expense_claim - t1.l17_expense_claim 
         when t1.channel in ('NKA','Ecom') then  nvl(t2.net_ar_balance,0) + t1.ngs * nvl(t4.net_ar_balance,0) - t1.collection - t1.l6b_expense_claim - t1.l17_expense_claim  end    AS  net_ar_balance 
   ,nvl(t2.sales_allowance,0) + t1.l6_b_wo_ror - if(t1.channel= 'NKA',(t1.l6b_expense_claim),if(nvl(t4.sales_allowance,0) = 0,0,(t1.l6b_expense_claim/nvl(t4.sales_allowance,0))))  AS  sales_allowance
   ,t1.adj_release
   ,t1.py_release
   ,t1.bu_2   
from 
(
    select 
        fcst_date           
       ,channel          
       ,months           
       ,years            
       ,customer_idh     
       ,ngs              
       ,l6_b_wo_ror  
       ,collection       
       ,l6b_expense_claim
       ,l17_expense_claim
       ,adj_release
       ,py_release 
       ,bu_2
       ,rk
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_ar_allowance_bts_v2_tmp0 
    where rk=1
   
)t1
left join
(
    select 
        fcst_date           
       ,channel          
       ,months           
       ,years
       ,customer_idh       
       ,cast(sales_allowance  as decimal)  as   sales_allowance  
       ,cast(net_ar_balance   as decimal)  as   net_ar_balance   
       ,adj_release
       ,py_release 
       ,dense_rank() over(partition by fcst_date,customer_idh,bu_2 order by months desc) as rk
       ,bu_2
    from 
   (   
        select 
             fcst_date           
            ,channel          
            ,months           
            ,years
            ,customer_idh       
            ,sum(cast(sales_allowance  as decimal))  as   sales_allowance  
            ,sum(cast(net_ar_balance   as decimal))  as   net_ar_balance   
            ,adj_release
            ,py_release 
            ,'Beauty Care'  as  bu_2
         from  ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v2 
         where data_type = 'Act'
         group by  fcst_date           
            ,channel          
            ,months           
            ,years
            ,customer_idh       
            ,adj_release
            ,py_release 
    )t
)t2
   on t1.fcst_date    = t2.fcst_date          
  and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
  and t1.adj_release  = t2.adj_release
  and t1.py_release   = t2.py_release
  and t1.bu_2   = t2.bu_2
  and t2.rk = 1
 left join  
 (   select
         distinct 
         customer_idh                         --用户id
         ,bu_2
         ,sub_channel                         
     from
         ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v2  
     where channel = 'NKA'
 )a
 on t1.customer_idh  = a.customer_idh      
 and t1.bu_2   = t2.bu_2
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling t4
on case when  t1.channel = 'NKA' then a.sub_channel else t1.channel end = t4.channel 
  and t1.years   = t4.years 
  and t1.months  = t4.months  
  and t4.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_ratio_sales_biz_controlling')
  and t1.fcst_date >= t4.start_fcst_date and t1.fcst_date < t4.end_fcst_date
  and t1.bu_2   = t4.bu
where t1.rk = 1

         when t1.channel in ('NKA','Ecom') then  nvl(t2.net_ar_balance,0) + t1.ngs * t2.net_ar_balance_ratio - t1.collection - t1.l6b_expense_claim - t1.l17_expense_claim  end  AS  net_ar_balance
   ,nvl(t2.sales_allowance,0) + t1.l6_b_wo_ror - if(t1.channel= 'NKA',(t1.l6b_expense_claim),if(nvl(t2.sales_allowance_ratio,0) = 0,0,(t1.l6b_expense_claim/nvl(t2.sales_allowance_ratio,0))))  AS  sales_allowance
   ,t1.adj_release
   ,t1.py_release 
   ,t1.bu_2
from 
(
    select 
        fcst_date           
       ,channel          
       ,months           
       ,years            
       ,customer_idh     
       ,ngs              
       ,l6_b_wo_ror  
       ,collection       
       ,l6b_expense_claim
       ,l17_expense_claim
       ,adj_release
       ,py_release 
       ,rk
       ,bu_2
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_ar_allowance_bts_v2_tmp0 
   where rk = 15
)t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_ar_allowance_bts_v2_tmp14 t2
   on t1.fcst_date    = t2.fcst_date          
  and t1.customer_idh = t2.customer_idh
  and t1.adj_release  = t2.adj_release
  and t1.py_release   = t2.py_release
  and t1.bu_2   = t2.bu_2

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_sku_nes_report_prof_temp_01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_sku_nes_report_prof_temp_01 as
select
  t.years              -- 年份
  ,t.months            -- 月份
  ,t.bu_1              -- BU1
  ,t.bu_2              -- BU2
  ,t.category          -- 品类（中文）
  ,t.category_en       -- 品类（英文）
  ,t.brand             -- 品牌（中文）
  ,t.brand_en          -- 品牌（英文）
  ,t.line              -- 产品线
  ,t.ph5               -- PH5编码
  ,t.ph5_name          -- PH5名称
  ,t.sku_idh           -- 产品编码
  ,t.sku_name          -- 产品名称（中文）
  ,t.sku_name_en       -- 产品名称（英文）
  ,t.region            -- 客户区域（中文）
  ,t.region_en         -- 客户区域（英文）
  ,t.province          -- 客户省份（中文）
  ,t.province_en       -- 客户省份（英文）
  ,t.customer_code     -- 客户编码
  ,t.customer_name     -- 客户名称（中文）
  ,t.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
  ,t.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道
  ,t.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道
  ,t.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道
  ,t.customer_group      -- 客户分类Customer Group
  ,sum(t.ges       ) as ges                  -- 销售总额
  ,sum(t.ges_cons  ) as ges_cons             -- 销售数量
  ,sum(t.ppd       ) as ppd                  -- 商品折扣活动费用
  ,sum(t.pld       ) as pld                  -- 商品陈列活动费用
  ,sum(t.free_goods) as free_goods           -- 赠品金额
  ,cast(sum(t.foc_cons  )as double) as foc_cons             -- 赠品销售数量
  ,sum(t.l6a_others) as l6a_others           -- L6A其他费用
  ,sum(t.l6a       ) as l6a                  -- L6A费用
  ,sum(t.ngs       ) as ngs                  -- 净销售总额
  ,cast(sum(nvl(t.ges_cons,0)-nvl(t.foc_cons,0))as double) as ngs_cons   -- NGS销售数量
  ,sum(t.gbf       ) as gbf                  -- 有条件返利
  ,sum(t.ppf       ) as ppf                  -- 价差
  ,sum(t.qlf       ) as qlf                  -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(t.l6b,0)-nvl(t.gbf,0)-nvl(t.ppf,0)-nvl(t.qlf,0)) as l6b_others           -- L6B其他费用
  ,sum(t.l6b       ) as l6b            -- L6B费用
  ,sum(t.nes       ) as nes -- 外部净销售额
  ,t.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,t.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
 from(
   select
     substr(a.ds,1,4)  as years             -- 年份
     ,substr(a.ds,1,6) as months            -- 月份
     ,a.bu_1              -- BU1
     ,a.bu_2              -- BU2
     ,nvl(a.henkel_category   ,'Others') as category          -- 品类（中文）
     ,nvl(a.henkel_category_en,'Others') as category_en       -- 品类（英文）
     ,nvl(a.henkel_brand      ,'Others') as brand             -- 品牌（中文）
     ,nvl(a.henkel_brand_en   ,'Others') as brand_en          -- 品牌（英文）
     ,nvl(a.product_line_name ,'Others') as line              -- 产品线
     ,if(b.ph5_code='Not assigned' or trim(b.ph5_name)='','Others',nvl(b.ph5_code,'Others')) as ph5           -- PH5编码
     ,if(b.ph5_name='Not assigned' or trim(b.ph5_name)='','Others',nvl(b.ph5_name,'Others')) as ph5_name    -- PH5名称
     ,nvl(a.product_id ,'Others') as sku_idh           -- 产品编码
     ,nvl(a.sku_name   ,'Others') as sku_name          -- 产品名称（中文）
     ,nvl(a.sku_name_en,'Others') as sku_name_en       -- 产品名称（英文）
     ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA','NKA') then null 
         else a.henkel_region_lastest    end as region            -- 客户区域（中文）
     ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA','NKA') then null 
         else a.henkel_region_en_lastest end as region_en         -- 客户区域（英文）
     ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA','NKA') then null 
         else a.province_lastest    end as province         -- 客户省份（中文）
     ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('ECOM','SELECTIVE RETAILER','B2B&LKA','NKA') then null 
         else a.province_en_lastest end as province_en       -- 客户省份（英文）
     ,a.customer_id      as customer_code     -- 客户编码
     ,a.customer_name    as customer_name     -- 客户名称（中文）
     ,a.first_channel_name_lastest first_channel_name -- 一级渠道
     ,a.second_channel_name_lastest second_channel_name -- 二级渠道
     ,a.third_channel_name_lastest  third_channel_name-- 三级渠道
     ,a.fourth_channel_name_lastest fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道
     ,a.customer_group      -- 客户分类Customer Group
     ,a.product_hirachy_number
     ,a.ges as ges                 -- 销售总额
     ,a.quantity_consumer_units     as ges_cons          -- 销售数量
     ,a.ppd               -- 商品折扣活动费用
     ,a.pld               -- 商品陈列活动费用
     ,a.fg as free_goods  -- 赠品金额
     ,a.quantity_consumer_units*(a.fg/if(nvl(a.ges,0)=0,null,a.ges)) as foc_cons          -- 赠品销售数量
     ,a.l6a_others as l6a_others        -- L6A其他费用
     ,a.L6a_pro as l6a               -- L6A费用
     ,a.gbf_growth_bonus     as gbf               -- 有条件返利
     ,a.ppf_prod_prom_disc   as ppf               -- 价差
     ,a.logistics_invoice    as qlf               -- 物流费
     ,a.sku_ngs_amt as ngs            -- 净销售总额
     ,a.L6b_pro as l6b            -- L6B费用
     ,a.nes            -- 外部净销售额
     ,a.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
     ,a.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a
  left join (
     select product_code as ph5_code,product_name_en as ph5_name 
         ,row_number()over(partition by product_code order by ds desc) rn
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke30_data_info_bu  
     where ds<>''
     --and bu_2 in ('SKP','SP')
   ) b
  on if(a.product_hirachy_number is null,'0',a.product_hirachy_number)=coalesce(b.ph5_code,'')
  and b.rn=1
  where a.ds<>''
  --and a.bu_2 in ('SKP','SP')
) t
group by
  t.years              -- 年份
  ,t.months            -- 月份
  ,t.bu_1              -- BU1
  ,t.bu_2              -- BU2
  ,t.category          -- 品类（中文）
  ,t.category_en       -- 品类（英文）
  ,t.brand             -- 品牌（中文）
  ,t.brand_en          -- 品牌（英文）
  ,t.line              -- 产品线
  ,t.ph5               -- PH5编码
  ,t.ph5_name          -- PH5名称
  ,t.sku_idh           -- 产品编码
  ,t.sku_name          -- 产品名称（中文）
  ,t.sku_name_en       -- 产品名称（英文）
  ,t.region            -- 客户区域（中文）
  ,t.region_en         -- 客户区域（英文）
  ,t.province          -- 客户省份（中文）
  ,t.province_en       -- 客户省份（英文）
  ,t.customer_code     -- 客户编码
  ,t.customer_name     -- 客户名称（中文）
  ,t.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
  ,t.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道
  ,t.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道
  ,t.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道
  ,t.customer_group      -- 客户分类Customer Group
  ,t.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,t.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

  ,cast(sum(b.foc_cons  ) as double)        as foc_cons             -- 赠品销售数量
  ,cast(sum(b.l6a_others) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l6a_others           -- L6A其他费用

  ,cast(sum(b.nes       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as nes         -- 外部净销售额
  ,cast(sum(c.ges       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as ges_1m      -- 上月销售总额
  ,cast(sum(d.ges       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as ges_py      -- 去年销售总额

  ,cast(sum(d.ges_cons  ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as ges_cons_py -- 去年销售数量

  ,cast(sum(d.ngs       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as ngs_py      -- 去年净销售总额

  ,cast(sum(c.nes       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as nes_1m      -- 上月外部净销售额
  ,cast(sum(d.nes       ) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as nes_py      -- 去年外部净销售额

-- 计算 DT 渠道当月进销存实际值,包含 sell in、sell out、inventory三部分销量和含税基价/ngs含税数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01 as
select
	a.months,                                       								-- 月份
	coalesce(c.region_lastest,a.henkel_region_name,'Others') region,                        -- 汉高区域
	coalesce(a.bu_2,'Others') bu_2,                                            		-- skp/sp
	coalesce(a.category_name_en,'Others') category,                                 -- 汉高品类名称中文
	a.brand_name_en brand,                                							-- 汉高品牌名称英文
	coalesce(a.product_line_name,'Others') product_line,                     		-- 产品线
	coalesce(c.channel_lastest,a.first_channel_name) channel,  			                    -- 一级渠道
	a.prod_code product_idh,                             							-- 汉高产品编码
	coalesce(a.prod_barcode,'-110') product_barcode,                       			-- 汉高barcode
	coalesce(a.prod_name,'Others') product_name,                            		-- 汉高产品名称
	coalesce(b.customer_code,a.dt_direct_customer_code) customer_code,              -- 客户编码
	case 
		when coalesce(c.channel_lastest,a.first_channel_name,'Others')='DT' and coalesce(b.customer_code,a.dt_direct_customer_code) regexp '上海直供|杭州苑苑' 
			then coalesce(b.customer_code,a.dt_direct_customer_code) 
		when coalesce(c.channel_lastest,a.first_channel_name,'Others') in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') 
			then coalesce(b.customer_code,a.dt_direct_customer_code) 
		else coalesce(c.customer_name,a.dt_direct_customer_name,'Others')
	end customer_name,																-- 客户名称
	a.henkel_store_code salon_code, 					  							-- 汉高门店编码
	a.henkel_store_name salon_name, 					  							-- 汉高门店名称
	a.sellin_ngs_tax as  si_gs,						  							    -- sellin含税ngs
	a.sellin_num si_volume,						  									-- sellin 销量
	a.sellout_base_amt_tax so_fp,						  							-- sellout 含税基价（全价）
	a.sellout_num so_volume,						  								-- sellout 销量
	a.base_stock_amt_tax inventory_fp,		     		  							-- inventory 含税基价（全价）
	a.stock_num inventory_volume          				  							-- inventory 销量
	,nvl(c.channel_customer_permission,a.channel_customer_permission) as channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	,nvl(c.region_customer_permission,a.region_customer_permission ) as region_customer_permission -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from 
(
-- 专业线进销存月度数据
	select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_detail_mtd
	where ds <> ''
) a
left join
(
-- 专业线dt 经销商
	select distinct sap_code,customer_code from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dt_dealercode_mapping_professional b
	where b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_dt_dealercode_mapping_professional')
)b on a.dist_code = b.sap_code 
left join 
(
-- 转换sap客户,原有部分dt客户渠道会有变化
	select distinct 
		region         					-- 大区中文
		,customer_code
		,customer_name
		,channel_hierarchy_1 as channel	-- 客户渠道 
		,region_lastest         					-- 大区中文(最新) 
		,channel_hierarchy_1_lastest as channel_lastest	-- 客户渠道(最新) 
		,bu_2
		,substr(ds,1,6) as months
		,channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
		,region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
	where ds like '%01'
)c on coalesce(b.customer_code,a.dt_direct_customer_code) = c.customer_code
	and a.months = c.months
	and a.bu_2 = c.bu_2
where coalesce(c.channel_lastest,a.first_channel_name) = 'DT'

-- 补全时间和业务维度
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp02

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp02 as
select
	t1.months,
	t2.region,
	t2.bu_2,
	t2.category,
	t2.brand,
	t2.channel,
	t2.product_line,
	t2.product_name,
	t2.product_barcode,
	t2.product_idh,
	t2.customer_code,
	t2.customer_name,
	t2.salon_code,
	t2.salon_name,
	sum(t3.si_gs) si_gs,
	sum(t3.si_volume) si_volume,
	sum(t3.so_fp) so_fp,
	sum(t3.so_volume) so_volume,
	sum(t3.inventory_volume) inventory_volume,
	sum(t3.inventory_fp) inventory_fp,
	t4.min_months_customer,
	t5.min_months_product,
	case 
		when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t4.min_months_customer,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t4.min_months_customer,'yyyymm'),'mm') + 1
		else 12
	end min_months_customer_dif,
	case 
		when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t5.min_months_product,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t5.min_months_product,'yyyymm'),'mm') + 1
		else 12
	end min_months_product_dif,
	case 
		when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t4.min_months_customer,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then  t4.min_months_customer
		else substr(replace(add_months(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),-11),'-',''),1,6)
	end min_months_customer_start,
	case 
		when datediff(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(t5.min_months_product,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11 then  t4.min_months_customer
		else substr(replace(add_months(to_date(t1.months,'yyyymm'),-11),'-',''),1,6)
	end min_months_product_start
	,t2.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	,t2.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from
(
-- 补全时间维度
     select month_id as months,'1' as flag
     from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
     where month_id >='202001' and month_id < substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
     group by month_id
)t1
left join 
(
-- 补全报表用到的维度
	select distinct
    '1' flag,
		region,
		bu_2,
		category,
		brand,
		channel,
		product_line,
		product_name,
		product_barcode,
		product_idh,
		customer_code,
		customer_name,
		salon_code,
		salon_name
	    ,channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	    ,region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
	from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01
)t2 on t1.flag = t2.flag
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01 t3
on coalesce(t1.months,'') = coalesce(t3.months,'')
   and coalesce(t2.region,'')= coalesce(t3.region,'')
   and coalesce(t2.bu_2,'')= coalesce(t3.bu_2,'')
   and coalesce(t2.category,'')= coalesce(t3.category,'')
   and coalesce(t2.brand,'')= coalesce(t3.brand,'')
   and coalesce(t2.channel,'')= coalesce(t3.channel,'')
   and coalesce(t2.product_line,'')= coalesce(t3.product_line,'')
   and coalesce(t2.product_name,'')= coalesce(t3.product_name,'')
   and coalesce(t2.product_barcode,'')= coalesce(t3.product_barcode,'')
   and coalesce(t2.product_idh,'')= coalesce(t3.product_idh,'')
   and coalesce(t2.customer_code,'')= coalesce(t3.customer_code,'')
   and coalesce(t2.customer_name,'')= coalesce(t3.customer_name,'')
   and coalesce(t2.salon_code,'')= coalesce(t3.salon_code,'')
   and coalesce(t2.salon_name,'')= coalesce(t3.salon_name,'')
   and coalesce(t2.channel_customer_permission,'')= coalesce(t3.channel_customer_permission,'')
   and coalesce(t2.region_customer_permission,'')= coalesce(t3.region_customer_permission,'')
left join 
(
-- 最早 客户 sellout 的日期
	select 
		customer_code, bu_2, min(months) as min_months_customer
	from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01
	-- where coalesce(so_fp,0) <> 0
	where so_volume is not null
	group by customer_code,bu_2
)t4
  on  coalesce(t2.customer_code,'') = coalesce(t4.customer_code,'')
  and coalesce(t2.bu_2,'') = coalesce(t4.bu_2,'')
left join 
(
-- 最早 sku sellout 的日期
	select 
		customer_code, bu_2,product_idh, min(months) as min_months_product
	from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp01
	where so_volume is not null
	group by customer_code,bu_2,product_idh
)t5
  on  coalesce(t2.customer_code,'') = coalesce(t5.customer_code,'')
  and coalesce(t2.bu_2,'') = coalesce(t5.bu_2,'')
  and coalesce(t2.product_idh,'') = coalesce(t5.product_idh,'')
group by 
	t1.months,
	t2.region,
	t2.bu_2,
	t2.category,
	t2.brand,
	t2.channel,
	t2.product_line,
	t2.product_name,
	t2.product_barcode,
	t2.product_idh,
	t2.customer_code,
	t2.customer_name,
	t2.salon_code,
	t2.salon_name,
	t4.min_months_customer,
	t5.min_months_product
	,t2.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	,t2.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
	t.years,                            -- 年份
	t.quarters,                         -- 季度
	t.months,                           -- 月份
	t.region,                           -- 汉高区域
	t.bu_2,                             -- 专业线SKP和SP
	t.category,                         -- 品类(英文)
	t.brand,                            -- 品牌(英文)
	t.channel,                          -- 一级渠道
	t.product_line,                     -- 产品线
	t.product_name,                     -- 产品名称
	t.product_barcode,                  -- 产品条码
	t.product_idh,                      -- 产品编码
	t.customer_code,                    -- 客户编码
	t.customer_name,                    -- 客户名称
	t.salon_code,                       -- 汉高门店编码
	t.salon_name,                       -- 汉高门店名称
	t.si_gs,                            -- 当月sellin含税ngs
	t.si_gs_last_month,                 -- 上月sellin含税ngs
	t.si_gs_last_quarter,               -- 上季度sellin含税ngs
	t.si_gs_last_year,                  -- 上年sellin含税ngs
	t.si_volume,                        -- 当月sellin 销量
	t.so_fp,                            -- 当月sellout含税基价金额
	t.so_fp_last_month,                 -- 上月sellout基价金额(含税)
	t.so_fp_last_quarter,               -- 上季度sellout基价金额(含税)
	t.so_fp_last_year,                  -- 上年sellout基价金额(含税)
	t.so_volume,                        -- 当月sellout销量
	t.inventory_fp,                     -- inventory含税基价金额
	t.inventory_fp_last_month,          -- 上月inventory基价金额(含税)
	t.inventory_fp_last_year,           -- 上年inventory基价金额(含税)
	t.inventory_volume,                 -- 当月inventory销量
	t.so_sku_12_mon_avg,                -- 近12月sku层级平均sellout(含税)
	lag(t.so_sku_12_mon_avg,1) over( partition by t.region,t.bu_2,t.category,t.brand,t.channel,t.product_line,t.product_name,t.product_barcode,t.product_idh,t.customer_code,t.customer_name,t.salon_code,t.salon_name,t.channel_customer_permission,t.region_customer_permission order by t.months) so_sku_12_mon_avg_last_month,				   		-- 上月近12月sku层级平均sellout(含税)
	so_customer_12_mon_avg,           -- 近12月经销商层级平均sellout(含税)
	lag(t.so_customer_12_mon_avg,1) over( partition by t.region,t.bu_2,t.category,t.brand,t.channel,t.product_line,t.product_name,t.product_barcode,t.product_idh,t.customer_code,t.customer_name,t.salon_code,t.salon_name,t.channel_customer_permission,t.region_customer_permission order by t.months) so_customer_12_mon_avg_last_month,				-- 上月近12月经销商层级平均sellout(含税)
	to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date,
	nvl(a.dist_store_nums,1) as dist_store_nums -- 分销门店数
	,t.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	,t.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from 
(
	select 
		t1.years,
		t1.months,
		t1.quarters,
		t1.region,
		t1.bu_2,
		t1.category,
		t1.brand,
		t1.channel,
		t1.product_line,
		t1.product_name,
		t1.product_barcode,
		t1.product_idh,
		t1.customer_code,
		t1.customer_name,
		t1.salon_code,
		t1.salon_name,
	    t1.channel_customer_permission, -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	    t1.region_customer_permission,  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
		cast(max(t1.si_gs) 						 as decimal(28,6)) 	si_gs,
		cast(max(t1.si_gs_last_month) 			 as decimal(28,6)) 	si_gs_last_month,
		cast(max(t1.si_gs_last_quarter) 		 as decimal(28,6)) 	si_gs_last_quarter,
		cast(max(t1.si_gs_last_year) 			 as decimal(28,6)) 	si_gs_last_year,
		max(t1.si_volume) si_volume,
		cast(max(t1.so_fp) 						 as decimal(28,6)) 	so_fp,
		cast(max(t1.so_fp_last_month) 			 as decimal(28,6)) 	so_fp_last_month,
		cast(max(t1.so_fp_last_quarter) 		 as decimal(28,6)) 	so_fp_last_quarter,
		cast(max(t1.so_fp_last_year) 			 as decimal(28,6)) 	so_fp_last_year,
		max(t1.so_volume) so_volume,
		cast(max(t1.inventory_fp) 				 as decimal(28,6)) 	inventory_fp,
		cast(max(t1.inventory_fp_last_month) 	 as decimal(28,6)) 	inventory_fp_last_month,
		cast(max(t1.inventory_fp_last_year) 	 as decimal(28,6)) 	inventory_fp_last_year,
		max(t1.inventory_volume) inventory_volume,
		cast(sum(case when t2.months between t1.min_months_customer_start and t1.months then t2.so_fp end) 
			/ max(t1.min_months_customer_dif) as decimal(28,6)) so_customer_12_mon_avg,
		cast(sum(case when t2.months between t1.min_months_product_start and t1.months then t2.so_fp end) 
			/ max(t1.min_months_product_dif) as decimal(28,6)) so_sku_12_mon_avg
	from 
	(
		-- 计算 上年 上月 等值	
		select 
			substr(months,1,4) years,                            								-- 年份
			months,                                       										-- 月份
			case quarter(to_date(months,'YYYYmm'))
				when 1 then concat (substr(months,1,4),'Q1')
				when 2 then concat (substr(months,1,4),'Q2')
				when 3 then concat (substr(months,1,4),'Q3')
				when 4 then concat (substr(months,1,4),'Q4')
			end quarters                                         								-- 季度
			,region
			,bu_2
			,category
			,brand
			,channel
			,product_line
			,product_name
			,product_barcode
			,product_idh
			,customer_code
			,customer_name
			,salon_code
			,salon_name
	        ,channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	        ,region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
			,min_months_customer_dif
			,min_months_product_dif
			,min_months_customer_start
			,min_months_product_start
			,si_gs
			,lag(si_gs,1) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months) si_gs_last_month
			,lag(si_gs,3) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months) si_gs_last_quarter
			,lag(si_gs,12) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months ) si_gs_last_year
			,si_volume
			,so_fp
			,lag(so_fp,1) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months) so_fp_last_month
			,lag(so_fp,3) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months) so_fp_last_quarter
			,lag(so_fp,12) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months ) so_fp_last_year
			,so_volume
			,inventory_fp
			,lag(inventory_fp,1) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months) inventory_fp_last_month
			,lag(inventory_fp,12) over( partition by region,bu_2,category,brand,channel,product_line,product_name,product_barcode,product_idh,customer_code,customer_name,salon_code,salon_name,channel_customer_permission,region_customer_permission order by months ) inventory_fp_last_year
			,inventory_volume
		from
			${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp02
	) t1
	left join 
	(
		-- 计算 上年 上月 等值	
		select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof_dt_temp02
		where nvl(so_fp,0) != 0
	) t2
	on  nvl(t1.region         ,'') = nvl(t2.region         ,'')
	and nvl(t1.bu_2           ,'') = nvl(t2.bu_2           ,'')
	and nvl(t1.category       ,'') = nvl(t2.category       ,'')
	and nvl(t1.brand          ,'') = nvl(t2.brand          ,'')
	and nvl(t1.channel        ,'') = nvl(t2.channel        ,'')
	and nvl(t1.product_line   ,'') = nvl(t2.product_line   ,'')
	and nvl(t1.product_name   ,'') = nvl(t2.product_name   ,'')
	and nvl(t1.product_barcode,'') = nvl(t2.product_barcode,'')
	and nvl(t1.product_idh    ,'') = nvl(t2.product_idh    ,'')
	and nvl(t1.customer_code  ,'') = nvl(t2.customer_code  ,'')
	and nvl(t1.customer_name  ,'') = nvl(t2.customer_name  ,'')
	and nvl(t1.salon_code     ,'') = nvl(t2.salon_code     ,'')
	and nvl(t1.salon_name     ,'') = nvl(t2.salon_name     ,'')
    and nvl(t1.channel_customer_permission,'')= nvl(t2.channel_customer_permission,'')
    and nvl(t1.region_customer_permission,'') = nvl(t2.region_customer_permission,'')
	and 
		(
			t2.months between t1.min_months_customer_start and t1.months
			or t2.months between t1.min_months_product_start and t1.months
		)
	group by 
		t1.years,
		t1.months,
		t1.quarters,
		t1.region,
		t1.bu_2,
		t1.category,
		t1.brand,
		t1.channel,
		t1.product_line,
		t1.product_name,
		t1.product_barcode,
		t1.product_idh,
		t1.customer_code,
		t1.customer_name,
		t1.salon_code,
		t1.salon_name,
	    t1.channel_customer_permission, -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
	    t1.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
)t 
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums a
on t.months =substr(a.ds,1,6)
and t.salon_code=a.store_code
and a.ds <>''
where nvl(si_gs,0) + nvl(si_gs_last_month,0) + nvl(si_gs_last_quarter,0) + nvl(si_gs_last_year,0) + nvl(si_volume,0) + nvl(so_fp,0) + nvl(so_fp_last_month,0) + nvl(so_fp_last_quarter,0) + nvl(so_fp_last_year,0) + nvl(so_volume,0) + nvl(inventory_fp,0) + nvl(inventory_fp_last_month,0) + nvl(inventory_fp_last_year,0) + nvl(inventory_volume,0) + nvl(so_sku_12_mon_avg,0) + nvl(so_customer_12_mon_avg,0)  <> 0

select
   customer_id -- 客户编号
   ,first_channel_name
   ,second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
   ,third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称

   ,l10       --L10 Commissions总和
   ,l11       --L11 Transp - W/H Cst总和
   ,l14       --L14 Total manufactur总和
   ,l16       --L16 Additional opera总和
   ,l17       --Adv Prm & Mrk Re总和
   ,nes
   ,gp1
   ,data_source  -- 数据来源
   ,data_table
   ,bu_1
   ,bu_2
   ,1.13 as tax_rate -- 汇率
   ,ds
   ,ngs_con
from(

      customer_id -- 客户编号

      ,third_channel_name_lastest  as third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
      ,product_id  -- 产品编号
      ,product_base_price  as base_price  -- 产品基价
      ,sum(sku_ngs_amt)    as sellin_ngs  -- ngs
      ,sum(quantity_consumer_units* product_base_price) as sellin_base_amt -- sellin基价金额
      ,sum(quantity_consumer_units)  as sellin_num       -- sellin 数量
      ,sum(ges       ) as ges          -- 销售总金额GES
      ,sum(L6a_pro   ) as L6a_pro      -- 专业线L6a
      ,sum(L6b_pro   ) as L6b_pro      -- 专业线L6b
      ,sum(mark_up_ii) as mark_up_ii   --内卖成本费用
      ,null  as l10       --L10 Commissions总和
      ,null  as l11       --L11 Transp - W/H Cst总和
      ,null  as l14       --L14 Total manufactur总和
      ,null  as l16       --L16 Additional opera总和
      ,null  as l17       --Adv Prm & Mrk Re总和
      ,sum(nes) as nes
      ,null as gp1
      ,'ke24' as data_source  -- 数据来源
      ,'ke24' as data_table
      ,bu_1
      ,bu_2
      ,ds
      ,sum(quantity_consumer_units)    as ngs_con       --  NGS CON
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu t1
    where ds<>''
    and bu_2 in ('SKP','SP')
    group by customer_id,first_channel_name_lastest,product_id,product_base_price,bu_1,bu_2,ds
      ,second_channel_name_lastest -- 二级渠道名称
      ,third_channel_name_lastest  -- 三级渠道名称
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest -- 四级渠道名称
union all 

SELECT  
        customer_id
        ,first_channel_name_lastest AS first_channel_name
        ,second_channel_name_lastest AS second_channel_name
        ,third_channel_name_lastest AS third_channel_name
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest AS fourth_channel_name
        ,product_id
        ,NULL AS base_price -- 产品基价
        ,NULL AS sellin_ngs -- ngs
        ,NULL AS sellin_base_amt -- sellin基价金额
        ,NULL AS sellin_num -- sellin 数量
        ,NULL AS ges -- 销售总金额GES
        ,NULL AS L6a_pro -- 专业线L6a
        ,NULL AS L6b_pro -- 专业线L6b
        ,NULL AS mark_up_ii --内卖成本费用
        ,SUM(l10) AS l10 --L10 Commissions总和
        ,SUM(l11) AS l11 --L11 Transp - W/H Cst总和
        ,SUM(l14_cog) AS l14 --L14 Total manufactur总和
        ,SUM(l16) AS l16 --L16 Additional opera总和
        ,SUM(ttl_l17) AS l17 --Adv Prm & Mrk Re总和
        ,null as nes
        ,sum(gp1) as gp1
        ,'ke30' AS data_source -- 数据来源
        ,'ke30' AS data_table
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,CONCAT(months,'01') AS ds
        ,null                    as ngs_con       --  NGS CON
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_product_pl_m_bu
WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_product_pl_m_bu')
AND     bu_2 IN ('SKP','SP')
GROUP BY 
        customer_id
        ,first_channel_name_lastest
        ,second_channel_name_lastest
        ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ,fourth_channel_name_lastest
        ,product_id
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,months
        
 union all
 
 -- FG CON 用于计算NGS CON
    select
      customer_id -- 客户编号
      ,first_channel_name_lastest  as first_channel_name
      ,second_channel_name_lastest as second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
      ,third_channel_name_lastest  as third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest as fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
      ,product_id  -- 产品编号
      ,product_base_price                               as base_price  -- 产品基价
      ,NULL                                             as sellin_ngs  -- ngs
      ,NULL                                             as sellin_base_amt -- sellin基价金额
      ,NULL                                             as sellin_num       -- sellin 数量
      ,NULL                                             as ges          -- 销售总金额GES
      ,NULL                                             as L6a_pro      -- 专业线L6a
      ,NULL                                             as L6b_pro      -- 专业线L6b
      ,NULL                                             as mark_up_ii   --内卖成本费用
      ,null                                             as l10       --L10 Commissions总和
      ,null                                             as l11       --L11 Transp - W/H Cst总和
      ,null                                             as l14       --L14 Total manufactur总和
      ,null                                             as l16       --L16 Additional opera总和
      ,null                                             as l17       --Adv Prm & Mrk Re总和
      ,null                                             as nes
      ,null                                             as gp1
      ,'ke24'                                           as data_source  -- 数据来源
      ,'ke24'                                           as data_table
      ,bu_1
      ,bu_2
      ,ds
      ,sum(-(quantity_consumer_units * (fg/if(nvl(ges,0)=0,null,ges))) )                   as ngs_con       -- FG CON 用于计算NGS CON
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu t1
    where ds<>''
    and bu_2 in ('SKP','SP')
    group by customer_id,first_channel_name_lastest,product_id,product_base_price,bu_1,bu_2,ds
      ,second_channel_name_lastest -- 二级渠道名称
      ,third_channel_name_lastest  -- 三级渠道名称
      ,fourth_channel_name_lastest -- 四级渠道名称

 )

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_mkt_pos_sale_detail_mtd_prof_temp02 as

 -- sap数据
  select
     t1.ds as bill_date
     ,substr(t1.ds,1,6) as months      -- 数据月份
     ,t1.customer_id   as dist_code   -- 客户编码
     ,t2.customer_name as dist_name   -- 客户名称
     ,NULL as ka_code   -- ka编码
     ,NULL as ka_name   -- ka名称
     ,case when upper(t1.first_channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then coalesce(t2.customer_group,'Others')
       else t1.customer_id
      end as display_customer_code -- 外显客户编码
     ,case when upper(t1.first_channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then coalesce(t2.customer_group_cn_lv2,'Others')
       else t2.customer_name
      end as display_customer_name -- 外显客户名称
     ,null as henkel_store_code   -- 汉高门店编码
     ,null as henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
     ,null as city_name           -- 汉高门店所在省份
     ,t2.province  as province_name       -- 汉高门店所在省份
     ,t2.region    as henkel_region_name  -- 汉高门店所在大区
     ,null as dist_region_name    -- 汉高门店所在经销商大区
     ,t1.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
     ,t1.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
     ,t1.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
     ,t1.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
     ,t1.product_id      as prod_code           -- 汉高产品编码
     ,b.product_barcode  as prod_barcode        -- 汉高barcode
     ,b.product_name         as prod_name           -- 汉高产品名称
     ,b.category_name       -- 汉高品类名称中文
     ,b.category_name_en    -- 汉高品类名称英文
     ,b.brand_name          -- 汉高品牌名称中文
     ,b.brand_name_en       -- 汉高品牌名称英文
     ,b.product_line as product_line_name   -- 产品线中文名称
     ,b.product_line_en     -- 产品线英文名称
     ,case when nvl(b.whether_ecom_sample_product,'0')='0' and upper(t1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then 'N' ELSE 'Y' END as whether_ecom_sample_product-- 是否小样
     ,cast(b.product_base_price as DECIMAL(28,6))  as base_price  -- 产品基价
     ,t1.sellin_ngs     *t1.tax_rate as sellin_ngs_tax      -- 净销售总额NGS(含税)
     ,t1.sellin_ngs                  as sellin_ngs_untax    -- 净销售总额NGS(未税)
     ,t1.sellin_base_amt*t1.tax_rate as sellin_base_amt_tax -- sellin基价金额(含税)
     ,t1.sellin_base_amt             as sellin_base_amt_untax -- sellin基价金额(未税)
     ,t1.sellin_num                  as sellin_num      -- sellin 数量
     ,t1.ges            *t1.tax_rate as ges_tax             -- 销售总金额GES(含税)
     ,t1.ges                         as ges_untax           -- 销售总金额GES(未税)
     ,t1.L6a_pro        *t1.tax_rate as L6a_pro_tax         -- 专业线L6a(含税)
     ,t1.L6b_pro        *t1.tax_rate as L6b_pro_tax         -- 专业线L6b(含税)
     ,t1.nes            *t1.tax_rate as nes_tax             -- 外部净销售额NES(含税)
     ,t1.nes                         as nes_untax           -- 外部净销售额NES(未税)
     ,t1.gp1            *t1.tax_rate as gp1_tax

    ,null as sellout_base_amt        -- sell_out基价销售额（含税）

    ,t.ges_untax             -- 销售总金额GES(未税)
    ,t.L6a_pro_tax           -- 专业线L6a(含税)
    ,t.L6b_pro_tax           -- 专业线L6b(含税)
    ,t.nes_tax               -- 外部净销售额NES(含税)
    ,t.nes_untax             -- 外部净销售额NES(未税)
    ,t.gp1_tax
    ,t.gp1_untax

    ,t.pos_sale_amt_untax      -- pos销售额(未税)
    ,t.pos_base_sale_amt_tax   -- pos基价销售额(含税)
    ,t.pos_base_sale_amt_untax -- pos基价销售额(未税)
    ,t.pos_num   -- pos数量

    ,t.data_table    -- 来源数据表
    ,t.ngs_con   -- ngs数量
    ,t.store_category        -- 汉高门店分类

 on a.dist_code=t1.sap_code
 and t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_dt_dealercode_mapping_professional')
left join(
   select
      *
      ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
   from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
   where ds like '%01'
) t2  -- 直供NKA POS的渠道走KA渠道，其余走客户渠道
 on if(upper(a.supply_type_name) regexp '直供',1<>1,nvl(t1.customer_code,a.dist_code) = t2.customer_code)
 and a.bu_2=t2.bu_2
 and a.months=t2.months
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu t3
 on a.sku_id=t3.product_code
 and a.bu_2=t3.bu_2
 and t3.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t4

group by
 a.months        -- 数据月份
 ,a.dist_code    -- 客户编码
 ,a.dist_name    -- 客户名称
 ,nvl(t1.customer_code,a.dist_code)  -- 客户编码
 ,nvl(t1.customer_code,a.display_customer_code)  -- 客户编码
 ,case when upper(coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,a.channel,'Others')) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.display_customer_name

 ,coalesce(t2.channel_hierarchy_1_lastest,a.channel,'Others')      -- 一级渠道
 ,coalesce(t2.region_lastest,a.region,'Others')     -- 汉高区域
 ,a.henkel_store_code   -- 汉高门店编码
 ,a.henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
 ,coalesce(t4.city_name,a.city_name,'Others')          -- 汉高门店所城市
 ,coalesce(t4.province_name,a.province_name,'Others')  -- 汉高门店所在省份
 ,a.bu_1          -- bu_1
 ,a.bu_2          -- bu_2
 ,a.sku_id        -- 产品编码
 ,coalesce(t3.product_name,'Others')       -- 产品名称
 ,a.prod_barcode  -- 产品条码
 ,coalesce(t3.category_name_en,'Others')  -- 品类英文
 ,coalesce(t3.category_name   ,'Others')  -- 品类中文
 ,coalesce(t3.brand_name      ,'Others')  -- 汉高品牌名称中文
 ,coalesce(t3.brand_name_en   ,'Others')  -- 汉高品牌名称英文
 ,coalesce(t3.product_line    ,'Others')  -- 产品线中文
 ,coalesce(t3.product_line_en ,'Others')  -- 产品线英文
 ,coalesce(t3.sub_product_function,'Others')
 ,a.data_source   -- 数据来源
 ,a.data_table    -- 来源数据表
 ,if(t3.sample_product regexp '小样','1','0')
 ,a.store_category        -- 汉高门店分类 
 ,a.store_category_lv1    -- 汉高门店一级分类

       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as sellout_num_last_quarter      -- 上季Sell Out销量
  ,lag(t.sellout_num,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as sellout_num_last_year         -- 去年Sell Out销量
  ,t.nes_untax as NES                             -- NES(未税)
  ,lag(t.nes_untax,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as NES_last_year -- 去年NES(未税)

       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as NGS_last_year -- 去年NGS(未税)
  ,t.pos_sale_amt_tax as POS                 -- POS
  ,lag(t.pos_sale_amt_tax,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as POS_last_year -- 去年POS
  ,t.dist_store_nums               -- 当月分销门店数
  ,lag(t.gp1_untax,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as GP1_last_year -- GP1(未税)
  ,t.gp1_untax as GP1                             -- 去年GP1(未税)
  ,t.bu_1                          -- bu_1
  ,t.bu_2                          -- bu_2
  ,to_char(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(now())),'yyyyMMddhhmiss') as create_date--数据创建日期
  ,t.sample_product -- 小样标签(1：小样，0：非小样)
  ,t.ngs_con                    -- 当月NGS销量

       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as ngs_con_last_month         -- 上月NGS销量
  ,lag(t.ngs_con,3) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as ngs_con_last_quarter       -- 上季NGS销量
  ,lag(t.ngs_con,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as ngs_con_last_year          -- 去年NGS销量
  ,t.store_category      -- 汉高门店分类 
  ,t.store_category_lv1  -- 汉高门店一级分类 
  ,t.store_category_lv2  -- 汉高门店二级分类 
  ,t.ka_code   -- ka编码 
  ,t.ka_name   -- ka名称 
  ,t.pos_num                    -- 当月POS销量
  ,lag(t.pos_num,12) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as pos_num_last_year          -- 去年POS销量
  ,lag(t.nes_untax,1) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as NES_last_month         -- 上月NES
  ,lag(t.sellin_ngs_untax,1) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as ngs_last_month         -- 上月NGS未税
  ,lag(t.sellin_ngs_untax,3) over(partition by Channel,t.Region,t.store_code,t.store_name,t.province_name,t.city_name,t.Customer_Code,t.Customer_Name,t.Category_name,t.Category_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en,t.Brand_name,t.Brand_name_en,t.subcategory_name_en_new,t.Brand_name_en_new,t.Product_Line_en,t.Product_Barcode,t.Product_IDH,t.Product_Name
       ,t.bu_2,t.sample_product,t.store_category,t.store_category_lv1,t.store_category_lv2,t.ka_code,t.ka_name order by t.month) as ngs_last_quarter       -- 上季NGS未税
from(
    select
       a.Year   --  年
      ,a.Quarter--  季度
      ,a.Month  --  月份
      ,a.Customer_Code -- 客户编码
      ,a.Customer_Name -- 外显客户名称
      ,a.channel       -- 一级渠道
      ,nvl(a.region,'Others')  as region        -- 汉高区域
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.store_code   ) as store_code    -- 汉高门店编码
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.store_name   ) as store_name    -- 汉高门店名称
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.province_name) as province_name -- 汉高门店所在省份
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.city_name    ) as city_name     -- 汉高门店所城市
      ,a.bu_1          -- bu_1
      ,a.bu_2          -- bu_2
      ,a.Product_IDH       -- 产品编码
      ,a.Product_Name      -- 产品名称
      ,a.Product_Barcode   -- 产品条码
      ,a.category_name_en  -- 品类英文
      ,a.category_name     -- 品类中文
      ,a.brand_name        -- 汉高品牌名称中文
      ,a.brand_name_en     -- 汉高品牌名称英文
      ,a.product_line_en   -- 产品线英文
      ,a.subcategory_name_en     -- 二级子品类
      ,a.subcategory_name_en_new -- 子品类英文(转换后)
      ,a.Brand_name_en_new       -- 品牌英文(转换后)
      ,cast(sum(b.sellout_actual_amt_tax) as decimal(28,6)) as sellout_actual_amt_tax  -- sell_out实际销售额（含税）
      ,cast(sum(b.sellout_base_amt_tax  ) as decimal(28,6)) as sellout_base_amt_tax    -- sell_out基价销售额（含税）
      ,cast(sum(b.sellout_num           ) as bigint       ) as sellout_num             -- sell_out数量（含税）
      ,cast(sum(b.sellin_ngs_untax      ) as decimal(28,6)) as sellin_ngs_untax        -- 净销售总额NGS(未税)
      ,cast(sum(b.sellin_ngs_tax        ) as decimal(28,6)) as sellin_ngs_tax          -- 净销售总额NGS(含税)
      ,cast(sum(b.sellin_num            ) as bigint       ) as sellin_num              -- sellin 数量
      ,cast(sum(b.ges_untax             ) as decimal(28,6)) as ges_untax               -- 销售总金额GES(含未税税)
      ,cast(sum(b.L6a_pro_tax           ) as decimal(28,6)) as L6a_pro_tax             -- 专业线L6a(含税)
      ,cast(sum(b.L6b_pro_tax           ) as decimal(28,6)) as L6b_pro_tax             -- 专业线L6b(含税)
      ,cast(sum(b.nes_untax             ) as decimal(28,6)) as nes_untax               -- 外部净销售额NES(未税)
      ,cast(sum(b.gp1_untax             ) as decimal(28,6)) as gp1_untax               -- GP1(未税)
      ,cast(sum(b.pos_sale_amt_tax      ) as decimal(28,6)) as pos_sale_amt_tax        -- pos销售额(含税)
      ,cast(sum(b.pos_base_sale_amt_tax ) as decimal(28,6)) as pos_base_sale_amt_tax   -- pos基价销售额(含税)
      ,cast(sum(b.pos_num               ) as bigint       ) as pos_num                 -- pos数量
      ,max(nvl(c.dist_store_nums,1)) as dist_store_nums         -- 当月分销门店数
      ,a.sample_product -- 小样标签(1：小样，0：非小样)
      ,cast(sum(b.ngs_con               ) as bigint       ) as ngs_con                 -- pos数量
      ,a.store_category      -- 汉高门店分类 
      ,a.store_category_lv1  -- 汉高门店一级分类 
      ,a.store_category_lv2  -- 汉高门店二级分类 
      ,a.ka_code   -- ka编码 
      ,a.ka_name   -- ka名称 
     from  ${dme_ads}.tb_mkt_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp03 a
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_mkt_sku_sale_summary_prof_temp02 b
     on nvl(a.Month,'')=nvl(b.Months,'')
      and nvl(a.Customer_Code          ,'')=nvl(b.Customer_Code          ,'')
      and nvl(a.Customer_Name          ,'')=nvl(b.Customer_Name          ,'')
      and nvl(a.channel                ,'')=nvl(b.channel                ,'')
      and nvl(a.region                 ,'')=nvl(b.region                 ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_code             ,'')=nvl(b.store_code             ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_name             ,'')=nvl(b.store_name             ,'')
      and nvl(a.province_name          ,'')=nvl(b.province_name          ,'')
      and nvl(a.city_name              ,'')=nvl(b.city_name              ,'')
      and nvl(a.bu_1                   ,'')=nvl(b.bu_1                   ,'')
      and nvl(a.bu_2                   ,'')=nvl(b.bu_2                   ,'')
      and nvl(a.Product_IDH            ,'')=nvl(b.Product_IDH            ,'')
      and nvl(a.Product_Name           ,'')=nvl(b.Product_Name           ,'')
      and nvl(a.Product_Barcode        ,'')=nvl(b.Product_Barcode        ,'')
      and nvl(a.category_name_en       ,'')=nvl(b.category_name_en       ,'')
      and nvl(a.category_name          ,'')=nvl(b.category_name          ,'')
      and nvl(a.brand_name             ,'')=nvl(b.brand_name             ,'')
      and nvl(a.brand_name_en          ,'')=nvl(b.brand_name_en          ,'')
      and nvl(a.product_line_en        ,'')=nvl(b.product_line_en        ,'')
      and nvl(a.subcategory_name_en    ,'')=nvl(b.subcategory_name_en    ,'')
      and nvl(a.subcategory_name_en_new,'')=nvl(b.subcategory_name_en_new,'')
      and nvl(a.Brand_name_en_new      ,'')=nvl(b.Brand_name_en_new      ,'')
      and nvl(a.sample_product         ,'')=nvl(b.sample_product         ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_category             ,'')=nvl(b.store_category          ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_category_lv1         ,'')=nvl(b.store_category_lv1      ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_category_lv2         ,'')=nvl(b.store_category_lv2      ,'')
      and nvl(a.ka_code         ,'')=nvl(b.ka_code      ,'')
      and nvl(a.ka_name         ,'')=nvl(b.ka_name      ,'')
    left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_salon_dist_store_nums c
      on a.month =substr(c.ds,1,6)
      and a.store_code=c.store_code
      and c.ds <>''
    group by a.Year   --  年
      ,a.Quarter--  季度
      ,a.Month  --  月份
      ,a.Customer_Code -- 客户编码
      ,a.Customer_Name -- 外显客户名称
      ,a.channel       -- 一级渠道
      ,nvl(a.region,'Others')  -- 汉高区域
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.store_code   )  -- 汉高门店编码
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.store_name   )  -- 汉高门店名称
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.province_name)  -- 汉高门店所在省份
      ,if(a.channel='Ecom',null,a.city_name    )  -- 汉高门店所城市
      ,a.bu_1          -- bu_1
      ,a.bu_2          -- bu_2
      ,a.Product_IDH       -- 产品编码
      ,a.Product_Name      -- 产品名称
      ,a.Product_Barcode   -- 产品条码
      ,a.category_name_en  -- 品类英文
      ,a.category_name     -- 品类中文
      ,a.brand_name        -- 汉高品牌名称中文
      ,a.brand_name_en     -- 汉高品牌名称英文
      ,a.product_line_en   -- 产品线英文
      ,a.subcategory_name_en     -- 二级子品类
      ,a.subcategory_name_en_new -- 子品类英文(转换后)
      ,a.Brand_name_en_new       -- 品牌英文(转换后)
      ,a.sample_product -- 小样标签(1：小样，0：非小样)
      ,a.store_category      -- 汉高门店分类 
      ,a.store_category_lv1  -- 汉高门店一级分类 
      ,a.store_category_lv2  -- 汉高门店二级分类 
      ,a.ka_code   -- ka编码 
      ,a.ka_name   -- ka名称 
 ) t
)
where nvl(sellin_base_amt,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_base_amt_last_month ,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_base_amt_last_quarter ,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_base_amt_last_year,0)<>0
or nvl(sellin_num ,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_num_last_month,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_num_last_quarter,0)<>0 or nvl(sellin_num_last_year ,0)<>0 
 or sellout_base_amt is not null -- 分销分店数需要sellout 非空的数据（为0的也需要）
 or sellout_base_amt_last_month is not null or sellout_base_amt_last_quarter is not null or sellout_base_amt_last_year is not null 
 or sellout_num is not null 
 or sellout_num_last_month is not null or sellout_num_last_quarter is not null or sellout_num_last_year is not null or NES is not null 
or nvl(NES_last_year,0)<>0 or nvl(NGS,0)<>0 or nvl(NGS_last_year,0)<>0 or nvl(POS,0)<>0 or nvl(POS_last_year,0)<>0  or nvl(GP1_last_year,0)<>0 or nvl(GP1,0)<>0 
or nvl(ngs_con,0)<>0 or nvl(ngs_con_last_month,0)<>0 or nvl(ngs_con_last_quarter,0)<>0 or nvl(ngs_con_last_year,0)<>0  
or nvl(pos_num,0)<>0 or nvl(pos_num_last_year,0)<>0 or nvl(NES_last_month,0)<>0 or nvl(ngs_last_month,0)<>0 or nvl(ngs_last_quarter,0)<>0
