  second_channel_name,                      -- 渠道名称
  region,                             -- 大区名称
  ka_platform,                          -- ka名称
  category_code,                          -- 品类名称
  brand_code,                           -- 品牌名称
  product_line_name,                        -- 产品线名称
  sku_barcode,                          -- 单品barcode
  sku_name,                           -- 产品名称
  city_name,                            -- 城市名称
  sub_product_function,                                           -- 子产品功能
  product_pack_ori,                                               -- 产品包装原始值
  CAST(sum(sku_sales_amt) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) sku_sales_amt,    -- pos累计销售额
  sum(sku_sale_num) sku_sale_num,                 -- sku销售数量
  sku_price,                                      -- sku价格/含税零售价
  to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date
  ,third_channel_name     -- 三级渠道名称
  ,fourth_channel_name    -- 四级渠道名称
  ,store_category         -- 汉高门店分类
  ,store_category_lv1     -- 汉高门店一级分类
  ,store_category_lv2     -- 汉高门店二级分类
  ,henkel_store_name      -- 门店名称
  ,henkel_store_code      -- 门店代码
  ,supply_type_name       -- 直间供标签
  ,province_name          -- 省份名称
  ,sum(return_num          )  as   return_num           -- 退货数量 
  ,CAST(sum(return_amt          ) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) as   return_amt           -- 退款金额未税 
  ,CAST(sum(return_amt_tax      ) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) as   return_amt_tax       -- 退货金额含税 
  ,sum(post_return_num     )  as   post_return_num      -- 退后数量 
  ,CAST(sum(post_return_amt     ) AS DECIMAL(28,6))  as   post_return_amt      -- 退后金额未税 
  ,CAST(sum(post_return_amt_tax ) AS DECIMAL(28,6))  as   post_return_amt_tax  -- 退后金额含税 
from
(
  select
    case when length(replace(t1.dt_date,'a','')) = 8 then replace(t1.dt_date,'a','') end dt_date,   -- 日期
    t3.weeks,                             -- 周
    t5.mapping_time as month,              -- 月份 yyyymm
    concat(substr(t5.mapping_time,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(t5.mapping_time,'YYYYmm'))) quarters, -- 季度
    substr(t5.mapping_time,1,4) as year,   -- 年度
    t1.bu_2,                              -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
    t1.first_channel_name,                -- 渠道名称
    t1.second_channel_name,               -- 渠道名称
    t1.henkel_big_region_name region,     -- 大区名称
    case 
      when UPPER(t1.first_channel_name) = 'ECOM' then t2.platform 
      when UPPER(t1.first_channel_name) in('SELECTIVE RETAILER','线上分销','O2O') then t1.ka_name 
    end as ka_platform,                         -- ka名称
    t1.category_code,                         -- 品类名称
    t1.brand_code,                            -- 品牌名称
    t1.product_line_name,                       -- 产品线名称
    t1.sku_barcode,                           -- 单品barcode
    t1.sku_name,                            -- 产品名称
    t1.city_name,                           -- 城市名称
    t1.sku_sales_amt * t1.tax_rate as sku_sales_amt,                -- pos累计销售额
    t1.sku_sale_num,                          -- sku销售数量
    t4.sku_price,                                                       -- sku价格/含税零售价
    t4.sub_product_function,                                            -- 子产品功能
    t4.product_pack_ori                                                 -- 产品包装原始值
    ,t1.third_channel_name     -- 三级渠道名称
    ,t1.fourth_channel_name    -- 四级渠道名称
    ,t1.store_category         -- 汉高门店分类
    ,t1.store_category_lv1     -- 汉高门店一级分类
    ,t1.store_category_lv2     -- 汉高门店二级分类
    ,t1.henkel_store_name      -- 门店名称
    ,t1.henkel_store_code      -- 门店代码
    ,t1.supply_type_name       -- 直间供标签
    ,t1.province_name          -- 省份名称
    ,t1.return_num             -- 退货数量 
    ,t1.return_amt             -- 退款金额未税 
    ,t1.return_amt_tax         -- 退货金额含税 
    ,t1.post_return_num        -- 退后数量 
    ,t1.post_return_amt        -- 退后金额未税 
    ,t1.post_return_amt_tax    -- 退后金额含税 
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu t1
  left join 
  (
    select distinct store_code,chain_name as platform from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
  ) t2
  on t1.store_code = t2.store_code 
  left join
  (
    select distinct time_now,mapping_time weeks from ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time
    where ds = '${bizdate}' and time_type = 'D.周' --and time_now not like '%a'
  ) t3 on t1.dt_date = t3.time_now
  left join(
        -- 取 产品包装原始值 和 子产品功能
        SELECT
      ds,
      product_barcode, 
      CAST(retail_price_tax AS DECIMAL(28,6)) sku_price, 
      sub_product_function, 
      product_pack_ori 
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        WHERE ds <> ''
    ) t4 
  on t1.sku_barcode = t4.product_barcode 
  and case when length(t1.dt_date) <> 8 then concat(t1.dt_date,'01') else t1.dt_date end = t4.ds
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time t5
   on t1.dt_date=t5.time_now
   and t5.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_mapping_time')
   and t5.time_type ='C.月'
   and coalesce(t5.time_now,'')<>''
  where t1.ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu') 
  and t1.bu_2 IN ('SKP','SP')
  -- and UPPER(t1.first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','OT','ECOM','线上分销')
) t
group by 
  dt_date,                                                        -- 日期
  weeks,                                                          -- 周
  month,                                                          -- 月份 yyyymm
  quarters,                                                       -- 季度
  year,                                                           -- 年度
  bu_2,                             -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
  first_channel_name,                       -- 渠道名称

  sku_name,                           -- 产品名称
  city_name,                            -- 城市名称
  sub_product_function,                                           -- 子产品功能
  product_pack_ori,                                               -- 产品包装原始值
  sku_price

  ,fourth_channel_name    -- 四级渠道名称

--********************************************************************--

 
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_report_target_data partition (ds)
select a.monthly          as  period_month
     ,a.channel           as  first_channel_name
     ,case when a.customer_idh in('v_dt','v_mpd','v_ws') or a.sub_channel_name like '%v_%' then '未知' 
           --when a.sub_channel_name in ('HomeClub','Wanjia','CRV-SG','Tesco')   then 'CRV'
           else a.sub_channel_name end  as  second_channel_name 
     ,sum(a.ngs_target)  as  ngs_target
     ,b.period
     ,a.bu_1
     ,a.bu_2
     ,case when a.customer_idh like '%v_%' then '未知' else a.customer_idh end   as  customer_code
     ,COALESCE(t2.customer_name,t3.customer_name,'未知')  as   customer_name
     ,cast(sum(a.ges_fg)     as  decimal(28,6)) as   ges_fg      
     ,cast(sum(a.ges_normal) as  decimal(28,6)) as   ges_normal   
     ,if(substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330')
       ,'${bizdate}',null) as ds
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_ngs_target a
left join (
    select  distinct 
             period
            ,period_month,bu_1,bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_cnr_data
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_cnr_data')
)b
on  b.period_month = a.monthly
and a.bu_1=b.bu_1
and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
left join (
        SELECT distinct
             customer_code                         --用户id
            ,customer_name
            ,substr(ds,1,6) as months
            ,bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
    where ds like '%01' 
)t2
 on a.customer_idh = t2.customer_code
and a.monthly = t2.months
and a.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
 left join (
     SELECT distinct
          customer_idh_lastest as customer_idh                         --用户id
         ,customer_name_lastest as customer_name
         ,months
         ,bu_2
     from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
  )t3
  on a.customer_idh = t3.customer_idh
 and a.monthly = t3.months
 and a.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
where a.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sales_report_ngs_target')
and  a.channel <> 'TTL'
and substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330') -- 新增23:30批次更新数据
group by a.monthly,a.channel,b.period,a.bu_1,a.bu_2
     ,case when a.customer_idh like '%v_%' then '未知' else a.customer_idh end
     ,t2.customer_name
     ,COALESCE(t2.customer_name,t3.customer_name,'未知') 
     ,case when a.customer_idh in('v_dt','v_mpd','v_ws') or a.sub_channel_name like '%v_%' then '未知' 
           --when a.sub_channel_name in ('HomeClub','Wanjia','CRV-SG','Tesco')   then 'CRV'
           else a.sub_channel_name end

  a.weekly,           							-- 周
  a.daily,            							-- 日

  a.traget_name,      							-- QBI仪表板名称 报表名称
  a.workspace_name,   							-- 工作空间
  cast(a.event_cnt as int) event_cnt,           -- 单日访问次数

    select  distinct groups,dept,email  from

        select  trim(user_group)  as  groups,trim(dept)  as  dept,trim(email)  as  email,
        dense_rank() over(order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_manual_account_mapping
        where ds = '${bizdate}'
    )t
    where rn = 1
) b

        from ${dme_ods}.s_manual_sector_mapping
        where ds = '${bizdate}'
    )t
    where rn = 1
) c 
  on lower(a.traget_name) = lower(c.sector_name) 
where a.ds = '${bizdate}' 
and workspace_name ='henkel_beautycare'
and b.dept is not null

   ,t1.customer_id    as   customer_code

   ,cast(sum(t1.ngs) as  decimal(28,6))  as  ngs
   ,t1.months
   ,substr(t1.months,1,4)       as years
   ,t1.bu_1
   ,t1.bu_2
   ,'Direct'   as  supply_type
   ,t1.product_id      as  product_idh

   ,nvl(t4.second_class_name ,'Not Categorized' )  as  second_class_name
   ,NULL  as  region
   ,NULL  as  porivice
   ,NULL  as  city
from 
(
      select to_char(to_date(to_char(t1.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') as months
       ,sum(sku_ngs_amt)  as  ngs

       ,bu_2
       ,product_id

    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu  t1
    where ds >= '20220101'
      and ds < '${bizdate}'
     -- and customer_id in ('703505','4013994')
     and bu_2  in ('Laundry','SKP','SP','Beauty Care')  
     group by to_char(to_date(to_char(t1.posting_date,'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymm') 
       ,customer_id  
       ,bu_1
       ,bu_2    
       ,product_id
       ,product_barcode,sku_name
)t1

(
    select
        distinct 
        substr(ds,1,6)          AS    months            
        ,channel_hierarchy_1    AS    channel            
        ,customer_code          AS    customer_idh            
        ,customer_name          AS    customer_name

        ,region_en

    where ds like '%01' --and customer_code in ('703505','4013994')
    and channel_hierarchy_1 in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') 
) t2 
 on t1.customer_id = t2.customer_idh
and t1.months = t2.months

(

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_filter_data_category PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  'BI Report' AS module
        ,'Sell_in' AS report_name
        ,'Category' AS filter_name
        ,CASE   WHEN (t1.check_value IS NULL) THEN CONCAT('缺失','-',t2.check_value)
                WHEN (
                            t2.check_value IS NULL
                ) THEN CONCAT('新增','-',t1.check_value)
        END AS described
FROM    (
            SELECT  REPLACE(CONCAT(NVL(category_code,' '),'_',NVL(product_function,' ')),'_ ','') AS check_value
            FROM    dme_ads.tb_ngs_customer_product_channel t1
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT("dme_ads.tb_ngs_customer_product_channel")
            GROUP BY REPLACE(CONCAT(NVL(category_code,' '),'_',NVL(product_function,' ')),'_ ','')
        ) t1
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  check_value
                FROM    dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule t2
                WHERE   t2.ds = MAX_PT("dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule")
                AND     t2.report_name LIKE '%,BI Report-Sell_in%'
                AND     filter_name = 'Category'
                AND     check_status = '1'
            ) t2
ON      t1.check_value = t2.check_value
WHERE   t2.check_value IS NULL
OR      t1.check_value IS NULL
UNION ALL

(

                                            ELSE channel
                                    END AS region
                                    ,bu_2

                            FROM    dme_ads.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT("dme_ads.tb_sku_sale_summary_prof")
)                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,region
                                ,bu_2
                                ,customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        WHERE   lower(channel) IN ('dt','ecom','selective retailer','others','b2b&lka')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,region
                                ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total') AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        WHERE   lower(channel) IN ('dt','lka')
                        GROUP BY year
                                 ,channel
                                 ,region
                                 ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,region
                                ,'Total' AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        WHERE   lower(channel) IN ('dt','lka')
                        GROUP BY year
                                 ,channel
                                 ,region
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,channel AS region
                                ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total') AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        GROUP BY year
                                 ,channel
                                 ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,channel AS region
                                ,'Total' AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        GROUP BY year
                                 ,channel
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,'全国' AS channel
                                ,'全国' AS region
                                ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total') AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        GROUP BY year
                                 ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,'全国' AS channel
                                ,'全国' AS region
                                ,'Total' AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer

WITH                         t_base AS 
(

                                    ,channel

                                            ELSE channel
                                    END AS region
                                    ,bu_2

                        FROM    t_base
                        WHERE   lower(channel) IN ('dt','ecom','selective retailer','others','b2b&lka')
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,channel
                                ,region
                                ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total') AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base
                        WHERE   lower(channel) IN ('dt','lka')
                        GROUP BY year

                        UNION ALL

                                ,NULL AS customer

                        SELECT  year

                                ,CONCAT(bu_2,' ','Total') AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base

                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT  year
                                ,'全国' AS channel

                                ,'Total' AS bu_2
                                ,NULL AS customer
                        FROM    t_base

            FROM    dme_ads.tb_ka_pos_product_channel_bu t1
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT("dme_ads.tb_ka_pos_product_channel_bu")
            AND     store_ba_mark_desc IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY store_ba_mark_desc
        ) t1
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  check_value
                FROM    dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule t2
                WHERE   t2.ds = MAX_PT("dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule")
                AND     t2.report_name LIKE '%,TMKT Raw Data Download-KA POS%'
                AND     filter_name = 'BA门店'
                AND     check_status = '1'
            ) t2
ON      t1.check_value = t2.check_value
WHERE   t2.check_value IS NULL
OR      t1.check_value IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT  'BI Report' AS module
        ,'TMKT Raw Data Download-KA POS' AS report_name
        ,'SFA门店' AS filter_name
        ,CASE   WHEN (t1.check_value IS NULL) THEN CONCAT('缺失','-',t2.check_value)
                WHEN (
                            t2.check_value IS NULL
                ) THEN CONCAT('新增','-',t1.check_value)
        END AS described
FROM    (
            SELECT  store_sfa_mark_desc AS check_value
            FROM    dme_ads.tb_ka_pos_product_channel_bu t1
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT("dme_ads.tb_ka_pos_product_channel_bu")
            AND     store_sfa_mark_desc IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY store_sfa_mark_desc
        ) t1
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  check_value
                FROM    dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule t2
                WHERE   t2.ds = MAX_PT("dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule")
                AND     t2.report_name LIKE '%,TMKT Raw Data Download-KA POS%'
                AND     filter_name = 'SFA门店'
                AND     check_status = '1'
            ) t2
ON      t1.check_value = t2.check_value
WHERE   t2.check_value IS NULL
OR      t1.check_value IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT  *
FROM    (
            SELECT  '1'
                    ,'1'
                    ,'single'
                    ,'没有异常'
            FROM    dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT("dme_ods.s_filter_data_rule")
            LIMIT   1
        )

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs_tmp1

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs_tmp1 as
 select
    substr(a.ds,1,6) as months -- 数据月份
    ,a.ka_code                 -- ka编码
    ,a.ka_name                 -- ka名称
    ,a.dist_type               -- ka分类
    ,a.product_barcode         -- 沙宣产品条码
    ,a.store_code              -- 门店编码
    ,a.store_name              -- 门店名称
    ,a.first_channel_name      -- 一级渠道
    ,a.second_channel_name     -- 二级渠道
    ,a.third_channel_name      -- 三级渠道
    ,a.fourth_channel_name     -- 四级渠道
    ,a.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.fourth_channel_name_ka    -- 四级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.first_channel_name_store  -- 一级渠道名称（门店）
    ,a.second_channel_name_store -- 二级渠道名称（门店）
    ,a.third_channel_name_store  -- 三级渠道名称（门店）
    ,max(a.ds) as max_stock_date -- 最大库存日期
    ,sum(a.stock_num ) as stock_num                                      -- 当月库存数量
    ,sum(a.stock_num*a.product_base_price_tax  ) as base_stock_amt_tax     -- 当月基价库存金额（含税）
    ,sum(a.stock_num*a.product_base_price_untax) as base_stock_amt_untax   -- 当月基价库存金额（未税）
    ,sum(a.stock_num*a.retail_price_tax        ) as retail_stock_amt_tax   -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（含税）
    ,sum(a.stock_num*a.retail_price_untax      ) as retail_stock_amt_untax -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（未税）
    ,'1' as flag
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_vs a
 inner join (
   select
      substr(ds,1,6) as months -- 数据月份
      ,ka_code
      ,DealerCode,max(ds) as max_ds
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_vs
   where ds <> ''
   --and nvl(product_class,'')<>'FG'
   group by substr(ds,1,6),ka_code,dist_type
 ) b
  on a.ka_code=b.ka_code
  and nvl(a.DealerCode,'')=nvl(b.DealerCode,'')
  and a.ds=b.max_ds
 where a.ds <> ''
  --and nvl(a.product_class,'')<>'FG'
 group by ds
    ,substr(a.ds,1,6) -- 数据月份
    ,a.ka_code                 -- ka编码
    ,a.ka_name                 -- ka名称
    ,a.dist_type               -- ka分类

    ,a.second_channel_name     -- 二级渠道
    ,a.third_channel_name      -- 三级渠道
    ,a.fourth_channel_name     -- 四级渠道
    ,a.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
    ,a.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.fourth_channel_name_ka    -- 四级渠道名称（ka）
    ,a.first_channel_name_store  -- 一级渠道名称（门店）
    ,a.second_channel_name_store -- 二级渠道名称（门店）
    ,a.third_channel_name_store  -- 三级渠道名称（门店）

       ,a.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.fourth_channel_name_ka    -- 四级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.first_channel_name_store  -- 一级渠道名称（门店）
       ,a.second_channel_name_store -- 二级渠道名称（门店）
       ,a.third_channel_name_store  -- 三级渠道名称（门店）
       ,max(b.max_stock_date) as max_stock_date  -- 最大库存日期
       ,sum(b.stock_num                ) as stock_num                  -- 当月库存数量
       ,sum(b.base_stock_amt_tax       ) as base_stock_amt_tax         -- 当月基价库存金额（含税）
       ,sum(b.base_stock_amt_untax     ) as base_stock_amt_untax       -- 当月基价库存金额（未税）
       ,sum(b.retail_stock_amt_tax     ) as retail_stock_amt_tax       -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（含税）
       ,sum(b.retail_stock_amt_untax   ) as retail_stock_amt_untax     -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（未税）
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs_tmp2 a
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs_tmp1 b
      on nvl(a.ka_code             ,'')=nvl(b.ka_code            ,'')
      and nvl(a.ka_name            ,'')=nvl(b.ka_name            ,'')
      and nvl(a.dist_type   ,'')=nvl(b.dist_type   ,'')
      and nvl(a.product_barcode    ,'')=nvl(b.product_barcode    ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_code         ,'')=nvl(b.store_code         ,'')
      and nvl(a.store_name         ,'')=nvl(b.store_name         ,'')
      and nvl(a.first_channel_name ,'')=nvl(b.first_channel_name ,'')
      and nvl(a.second_channel_name,'')=nvl(b.second_channel_name,'')
      and nvl(a.third_channel_name ,'')=nvl(b.third_channel_name ,'')
      and nvl(a.fourth_channel_name,'')=nvl(b.fourth_channel_name,'')
      and nvl(a.first_channel_name_cust  ,'')=nvl(b.first_channel_name_cust  ,'')
      and nvl(a.second_channel_name_cust ,'')=nvl(b.second_channel_name_cust ,'')
      and nvl(a.third_channel_name_cust  ,'')=nvl(b.third_channel_name_cust  ,'')
      and nvl(a.fourth_channel_name_cust ,'')=nvl(b.fourth_channel_name_cust ,'')
      and nvl(a.first_channel_name_ka    ,'')=nvl(b.first_channel_name_ka    ,'')
      and nvl(a.second_channel_name_ka   ,'')=nvl(b.second_channel_name_ka   ,'')
      and nvl(a.third_channel_name_ka    ,'')=nvl(b.third_channel_name_ka    ,'')
      and nvl(a.fourth_channel_name_ka   ,'')=nvl(b.fourth_channel_name_ka   ,'')
      and nvl(a.first_channel_name_store ,'')=nvl(b.first_channel_name_store ,'')
      and nvl(a.second_channel_name_store,'')=nvl(b.second_channel_name_store,'')
      and nvl(a.third_channel_name_store ,'')=nvl(b.third_channel_name_store ,'')
      and a.months=b.months
      group by a.years   -- 年
       ,a.quarters-- 季度
       ,a.months  -- 数据月份
       ,a.ka_code               -- ka编码
       ,a.ka_name               -- ka名称
       ,a.dist_type             -- ka分类
       ,a.product_barcode       -- 沙宣产品条码
       ,a.store_code            -- 门店编码
       ,a.store_name            -- 门店名称
       ,a.first_channel_name    -- 一级渠道
       ,a.second_channel_name   -- 二级渠道
       ,a.third_channel_name    -- 三级渠道
       ,a.fourth_channel_name   -- 四级渠道
       ,a.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
       ,a.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
       ,a.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs partition (ds='${bizdate}')
select
  t1.years                -- 年
  ,t1.quarters            -- 季度
  ,t1.months              -- 月份
  ,t1.max_stock_date      -- 最大库存日期
  ,t1.ka_code             -- KA编码
  ,t1.ka_name             -- KA名称
  ,t1.dist_type    -- KA类型
  ,nvl(t2.product_code,'Others') as product_code      -- 沙宣产品编码
  ,t1.product_barcode                                 -- 沙宣产品编码
  ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others')  as product_name     -- 沙宣产品名称
  ,nvl(t2.brand_name,'Others')    as brand_name_cn    -- 沙宣品牌名称中文
  ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_name_en    -- 沙宣品牌名称英文
  ,nvl(t2.category_name,'Others') as category_name_cn -- 沙宣品类名称中文
  ,nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others')  as category_name_en  -- 沙宣品类名称英文
  ,nvl(t2.sub_category_name,'Others') as sub_category_name -- 沙宣子品类名称
  ,nvl(t2.product_line,'Others')  as product_line   -- 沙宣产品线
  ,nvl(t2.product_pack,'Others')  as product_pack   -- 产品规格
  ,nvl(t2.product_type,'Others')  as product_type   -- 产品种类
  ,nvl(t2.product_class,'Others') as product_class  -- 产品分类
  ,t1.store_code                  as stock_code-- 沙宣仓库编码
  ,nvl(t1.store_name,'Others')    as stock_name -- 沙宣仓库名称
  ,nvl(t1.store_code_new,'Others') as store_code  -- 沙宣门店编码
  ,nvl(t3.store_name,'Others') as store_name -- 沙宣门店名称
  ,nvl(t3.province_name,'Others') as province_name -- 沙宣门店所在省份
  ,nvl(t3.city_name,'Others')     as city_name     -- 沙宣门店所在城市
  ,nvl(t3.henkel_region,'Others') as region_name   -- 沙宣门店所在大区
  ,t1.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道名称
  ,t1.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
  ,t1.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
  ,cast(t1.stock_num                 as decimal(28,6)) as stock_num                 -- 当月库存数量           
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_tax        as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_tax        -- 当月基价库存金额（含税）     
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_untax      as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_untax      -- 当月基价库存金额（未税）     
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax      as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_tax      -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（含税）  
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax    as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_untax    -- 当月建议零售价库存金额（未税）  
  ,cast(t1.stock_num_lm              as decimal(28,6)) as stock_num_lm              -- 上月库存数量           
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_tax_lm     as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_tax_lm     -- 上月基价库存金额（含税）     
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_untax_lm   as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_untax_lm   -- 上月基价库存金额（未税）     
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax_lm   as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_tax_lm   -- 上月建议零售价库存金额（含税）  
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax_lm as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_untax_lm -- 上月建议零售价库存金额（未税）  
  ,cast(t1.stock_num_py              as decimal(28,6)) as stock_num_py              -- 去年同期库存数量         
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_tax_py     as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_tax_py     -- 去年同期基价库存金额（含税）   
  ,cast(t1.base_stock_amt_untax_py   as decimal(28,6)) as base_stock_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期基价库存金额（未税）   
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax_py   as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_tax_py   -- 去年同期建议零售价库存金额（含税）
  ,cast(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax_py as decimal(28,6)) as retail_stock_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期建议零售价库存金额（未税）
  ,nvl(t2.product_function,'Others') as first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(t2.sub_product_function,'Others') as product_function  -- 二级子品类
  ,t1.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name_ka    -- 四级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.first_channel_name_store  -- 一级渠道名称（门店）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_store -- 二级渠道名称（门店）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_store  -- 三级渠道名称（门店）
from (
    select a.*
       ,case when a.dist_type='NC' then coalesce(b.store_code,a.store_code,'Others')
         else coalesce(a.store_code,'Others') end as store_code_new 
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_stock_sku_summary_vs_tmp3 a    
    left join (
       select stock_code,store_code,stander_store_name,create_time,modify_time
           ,row_number()over(partition by stock_code order by create_time desc,modify_time desc) as rn
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_vs
       where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_vs')
     ) b 
     on a.store_code = b.stock_code
     and a.dist_type='NC'
     and b.rn=1
 ) t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu t2
 on t1.product_barcode = t2.product_barcode
 and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
 and t2.bu_2='VS'
left join dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_bu t3
 on t1.store_code_new = t3.store_code
 and t3.ds=max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
where nvl(t1.stock_num,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_tax,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_untax,0)<>0 
or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.stock_num_lm,0)<>0 
or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_tax_lm,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_untax_lm,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax_lm,0)<>0 
or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax_lm,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.stock_num_py,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_tax_py,0)<>0 
or nvl(t1.base_stock_amt_untax_py,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_tax_py,0)<>0 or nvl(t1.retail_stock_amt_untax_py,0)<>0

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_summary_daily_vs partition (ds='${bizdate}')
select
  t4.year_id     as years    -- 年
  ,t4.quarter_id as quarters -- 季度
  ,t4.month_id   as months   -- 月份
  ,t1.ds         as bill_date -- 日
  ,t1.ka_code             -- KA编码
  ,t1.ka_name             -- KA名称
  ,t1.dist_type    -- KA类型
  ,nvl(t2.product_code,'Others') as product_code      -- 沙宣产品编码
  ,t1.product_barcode                                 -- 沙宣产品编码
  ,nvl(t2.product_name,'Others')  as product_name     -- 沙宣产品名称
  ,nvl(t2.brand_name,'Others')    as brand_name_cn    -- 沙宣品牌名称中文
  ,nvl(t2.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_name_en    -- 沙宣品牌名称英文
  ,nvl(t2.category_name,'Others') as category_name_cn -- 沙宣品类名称中文
  ,nvl(t2.category_name_en,'Others')  as category_name_en  -- 沙宣品类名称英文
  ,nvl(t2.sub_category_name,'Others') as sub_category_name -- 沙宣子品类名称
  ,nvl(t2.product_line,'Others')  as product_line   -- 沙宣产品线
  ,nvl(t2.product_pack,'Others')  as product_pack   -- 产品规格
  ,nvl(t2.product_type,'Others')  as product_type   -- 产品种类
  ,nvl(t2.product_class,'Others') as product_class  -- 产品分类
  ,t1.store_code          -- 沙宣门店编码
  ,coalesce(t3.store_name,'Others') as store_name -- 沙宣门店名称
  ,nvl(t3.province_name,'Others') as province_name -- 沙宣门店所在省份
  ,nvl(t3.city_name,'Others')     as city_name     -- 沙宣门店所在城市
  ,nvl(t3.henkel_region,'Others') as region_name   -- 沙宣门店所在大区
  ,t1.first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道名称
  ,t1.second_channel_name -- 二级渠道名称
  ,t1.third_channel_name  -- 三级渠道名称
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name -- 四级渠道名称
  ,t1.sales_channel       -- 销售渠道
  ,cast(t1.sales_num              as decimal(28,6)) as sales_num                  -- 当月销售数量
  ,cast(t1.sales_amt_tax          as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt_tax              -- 当月实际销售额(含税)
  ,cast(t1.sales_amt_untax        as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amt_untax            -- 当月实际销售额(未税)
  ,cast(t1.base_sales_amt_tax     as decimal(28,6)) as base_sales_amt_tax         -- 当月基价销售额(含税)
  ,cast(t1.base_sales_amt_untax   as decimal(28,6)) as base_sales_amt_untax       -- 当月基价销售额(未税)
  ,cast(t1.retail_sales_amt_tax   as decimal(28,6)) as retail_sales_amt_tax       -- 当月建议零售价销售额(含税)
  ,cast(t1.retail_sales_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as retail_sales_amt_untax     -- 当月建议零售价销售额(未税)
  ,nvl(t2.product_function,'Others') as first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(t2.sub_product_function,'Others') as product_function  -- 二级子品类
  ,t1.first_channel_name_cust   -- 一级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_cust  -- 二级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_cust   -- 三级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name_cust  -- 四级渠道名称（经销商）
  ,t1.first_channel_name_ka     -- 一级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_ka    -- 二级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_ka     -- 三级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.fourth_channel_name_ka    -- 四级渠道名称（ka）
  ,t1.first_channel_name_store  -- 一级渠道名称（门店）
  ,t1.second_channel_name_store -- 二级渠道名称（门店）
  ,t1.third_channel_name_store  -- 三级渠道名称（门店）
  ,t5.stock_code -- 仓库编码
  ,t5.stock_name -- 仓库名称
from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_summary_daily_vs_tmp1 t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu t2
 on t1.product_barcode = t2.product_barcode
 and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
 and t2.bu_2='VS'
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t3
 on t1.store_code = t3.store_code
 and t3.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
left join dme_cdm.dim_day t4
 on t1.ds = t4.day_id 
left join (
   select stock_code,stock_name,store_code,stander_store_name,create_time,modify_time
       ,row_number()over(partition by stock_code order by create_time desc,modify_time desc) as rn
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_vs
   where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_ecom_vs')
 ) t5 
on t1.store_code = t5.store_code
and t5.rn=1

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_data_source_list_update_monitor_v2 PARTITION (ds='${bizdate}')
SELECT  CAST(a.rid AS BIGINT) rid
        ,a.data_source
        ,a.data_source_description
        ,a.dme_table
        ,a.data_group
        ,b.data_start_time
        ,b.data_end_time
        ,nvl(b.data_update_time,'19700101') AS update_time
        ,a.rule_name AS update_frequency
        ,c.update_status as update_deferred_status
        ,TO_CHAR(CAST(c.update_plan_date AS DATETIME),'yyyymmdd') AS plan_update_date

) b

--@exclude_input=dme_ads.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp2
--@exclude_input=dme_cdm.dim_day
--@exclude_input=dme_ads.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1
--odps sql 
--********************************************************************--
--author:pengfei.wang
--create time:2025-01-08 10:47:32
--********************************************************************--
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1 as
select
    a.day_id,
    a.day_dt
from
(
    select
    	to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd') day_dt,
        day_id,
		month_id,
	    1 flag
    from 
        ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
) a
left join 
(
	-- 活动最大结束日期
	select
		'202401' min_date,
		max(activity_end_month) max_date,
		1 flag
	from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail	
	where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail')	
) b on a.flag = b.flag
where a.month_id between b.min_date and b.max_date
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp2 as
-- 月
select
	substr(day_id,1,6) as mapping_time,
	day_id as time_now,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-1,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
	'C.月' as `type`
from ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1
union all
-- 年
select
	substr(day_id,1,4) as mapping_time,
	day_id as time_now,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
	'A.年' as `type`
from ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1
union all
--季度
select 
	CONCAT( SUBSTR(day_id, 1, 4), 'Q', QUARTER(day_dt) ) AS mapping_time,
	day_id as time_now,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-12,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_yoy,
	to_char(dateadd(day_dt,-3,'mm') ,'yyyymmdd') as time_mom,
	'B.季' as `type`
from ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp1

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time partition(ds ='${bizdate}')
select mapping_time,
    time_now,
    time_yoy,
    time_mom,
    type,
	to_char(now(),'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mi:ss') etl_date
from 
    ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_mapping_time_tmp2

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu_hsa partition (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT
  case when a.dt_date like '%a' and length(a.dt_date) = 9 then substr(a.dt_date,1,8)  
       when (length(a.dt_date) = 6 OR length(a.dt_date) = 7) then d.max_date
       else a.dt_date end  as  data_date,
  h.mapping_time as data_week,
  g.mapping_time as data_month,
  f.mapping_time as data_quarter,
  e.mapping_time as data_year,
  a.bu_1,
  a.bu_2,
  a.sku_idh as product_code,
  a.sku_barcode as product_barcode, 
  a.sku_name as product_name,
  a.category_code,
  a.category_name,
  a.product_function,
  a.sub_product_function,
  a.brand_code,
  a.brand_name,
  a.product_line_name,
  a.product_pack_type,
  a.product_pack,
  a.product_pack_ori,
  a.main_colour_hue,
  a.colour_hue,
  a.henkel_store_code,
  a.store_code as ka_store_code,
  a.henkel_store_name,
  a.henkel_big_region_name as henkel_region_name,
  a.big_region_name as ka_region_name,
  a.province_name,
  a.city_name,
  a.first_channel_name,
  a.second_channel_name,
  a.third_channel_name,
  a.fourth_channel_name,
  a.store_ba_mark_desc,
  a.store_sfa_mark_desc,
  cast(sku_sales_amt as decimal(28,6)) AS product_sales_amt_wot,
  cast(sku_sale_num as decimal(28,6)) AS product_sale_num,
  cast(g.product_base_price as decimal(28,6)) as product_base_price_wot,
  cast(sku_base_sales_amt as decimal(28,6)) as  product_base_sales_amt_wot,  --pos基价销额
  cast(a.product_rsp as decimal(28,6)) as product_rsp_wt,
  cast(a.rsp_sale_amt as decimal(28,6)) AS product_rsp_sale_amt_wt
FROM 
   (
     SELECT
       case when length (dt_date) = 7 then substr(dt_date,1,6)
       else dt_date end as dt_date,
       category_code,
       category_name,
       brand_code,
       brand_name,
       product_line_name,
       sku_id as sku_idh, 
       sku_barcode,
       sku_name,
       product_function,
       sub_product_function,  --二级子品类
       product_pack_type,
       product_pack,
       product_pack_ori,
       first_channel_name,
       second_channel_name,
       third_channel_name,
       fourth_channel_name,
       ka_name,
       colour_hue,
       main_colour_hue,
       henkel_store_name,
       henkel_big_region_id,
       henkel_big_region_name,
       big_region_id,
       big_region_name,
       province_id,
       province_name,
       city_id,
       city_name,
       store_ba_mark_desc,
       store_sfa_mark_desc,
       sum(sku_sales_amt) AS sku_sales_amt,
       sum(sku_sale_num) AS sku_sale_num,
       sum(sku_base_sales_amt)  as   sku_base_sales_amt,  --pos基价销额
       henkel_store_code,
       store_code,
       sku_price  as   product_rsp,
       sum(sku_sale_num * sku_price) AS rsp_sale_amt,
       bu_1,
       bu_2  
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu 
   where ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu')
    and UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('LKA','NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER','OT')
     GROUP BY
       case when length (dt_date) = 7 then substr(dt_date,1,6)
       else dt_date end,
       category_code,
       category_name,
       brand_code,
       brand_name,
       product_line_name,
       sku_id ,
       sku_barcode,
       sku_name,
       product_function,
       sub_product_function,  --二级子品类
       product_pack_type,
       product_pack,
       product_pack_ori,
       first_channel_name,
       second_channel_name,
       third_channel_name,
       fourth_channel_name,
       ka_name,
       colour_hue,
       main_colour_hue,
       henkel_store_name,
       henkel_big_region_id,
       henkel_big_region_name,
       big_region_id,
       big_region_name,
       province_id,
       province_name,
       city_id,
       city_name,
       store_ba_mark_desc,
       store_sfa_mark_desc,
       henkel_store_code,
       store_code,
       sku_price,
       bu_1,
       bu_2  
    )a
left join (
    select mapping_time,max(time_now) as max_date
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time 
    where time_type = 'C.月'
      and time_now not like '%a'
      and ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
    group by mapping_time
)d
on substr(a.dt_date,1,6) = d.mapping_time
left join (
    select mapping_time,time_now
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time  
    where time_type = 'A.年'
      and ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
    group by mapping_time,time_now
)e
on a.dt_date = e.time_now
left join (
    select mapping_time,time_now
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time  
    where time_type = 'B.季'
      and ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
    group by mapping_time,time_now
)f
on a.dt_date = f.time_now
left join (
    select mapping_time,time_now
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time  
    where time_type = 'C.月'
      and ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
    group by mapping_time,time_now
)g
on a.dt_date = g.time_now
left join (
    select mapping_time,time_now
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time  
    where time_type = 'D.周'
      and ds = max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
    group by mapping_time,time_now

on a.dt_date = h.time_now
left join(

    ,t1.bu_1                          -- 业务条线一级(Consumer/Professional)
    ,t1.bu_2                          -- 业务条线二级(Beauty Care/Laundry/SP/SKP)
    ,t1.bu_3                          -- 业务条线三级(SKP&SP/SP/SKP)
    ,t1.ka_code
    ,t1.ka_name
    ,t1.supply_type_name
    ,t1.henkel_store_code 
    ,t1.stock_num           as stock_num   -- 库存数量
    ,t1.base_stock_amt      as stock_amt -- 基价库存金额
    ,t1.base_price                    -- 产品基价
    ,t1.ds                  as stock_date
    ,case 
        when substring(t1.ds, 5, 2) = 12 and WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd')) = 1 
        then concat(
                substring(DATEADD(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'),  +1 ,'yyyy'), 1, 4),'W0',
                WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'))
            )
        when substring(t1.ds, 5, 2) = 1 and WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd')) > 20 
        then concat(
                substring(DATEADD(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'),  -1 ,'yyyy'), 1, 4),'W',
                WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'))
            )
    else (
        case when WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'))<10
        then  concat(substring(t1.ds, 1, 4),'W0',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd')))
        else  concat(substring(t1.ds, 1, 4),'W',WEEKOFYEAR(to_date(t1.ds,'yyyymmdd'))) 
        end
    )
    end as week_flag
    ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t1.ds, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyymm') AS month_flag -- 生成2024W43 格式的周
    ,CONCAT(YEAR(TO_DATE(t1.ds, 'yyyymmdd')), 'Q', CEIL(MONTH(TO_DATE(t1.ds, 'yyyymmdd')) / 3)) AS quarter_flag  -- 生成 2024Q3 格式的季度
    ,YEAR(TO_DATE(t1.ds, 'yyyymmdd')) AS year_flag -- 直接输出年份，如 2024
    ,t1.channel_ka_permission as channel_customer_permission
    ,CONCAT(t1.channel_ka_permission, '_Others') as region_customer_permission
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu t1
where t1.ds <> ''

            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') and lower(t1.second_channel_name_lastest) regexp 'sephora' then '丝芙兰'
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') then nvl(t1.third_channel_name_lastest, t1.dist_name)
            when t1.data_source in ('KA手工报表', 'KA系统') then t1.third_channel_name_lastest
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest in('B2B&LKA','Ecom') THEN NULL
            -- WHEN t1.dist_code in ('2849662') and upper(t1.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then NVL(IF(t1.bu_1 = 'Professional',t3.customer_name, t3.province_name_lastest),'Others')
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'MPD' then NVL(t3.province_name_lastest,'Others')
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'DT' THEN NVL(IF(t1.bu_1 = 'Professional',t3.customer_name, t3.province_name_lastest),'Others')
            else 'Others'
        end as third_channel_name_lastest -- 最新三级渠道名称
        ,case 
            WHEN data_source ='dms_ka' then NULL
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') and lower(t1.second_channel_name_lastest) regexp 'sams|xinyan' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') and lower(t1.second_channel_name_lastest) regexp 'sephora' then '丝芙兰'
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') then t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest
            when t1.data_source in ('KA手工报表', 'KA系统') then t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest in('B2B&LKA','Ecom') THEN NULL
            --WHEN t1.dist_code in ('2849662') and upper(t1.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then null
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'MPD' then t1.dist_code
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'DT' THEN if(t1.bu_1='Professional',t3.customer_name, nvl(t1.dist_code,'Others'))
            else 'Others'
        end as fourth_channel_id_lastest -- 最新四级渠道ID
        ,case WHEN data_source ='dms_ka' then NULL
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') and lower(t1.second_channel_name_lastest) regexp 'sams|xinyan' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') and lower(t1.second_channel_name_lastest) regexp 'sephora' then '丝芙兰'
            -- when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' and upper(t1.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('SELECTIVE RETAILER', 'NKA') then t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest
            when t1.data_source in ('KA手工报表', 'KA系统') then t1.fourth_channel_name_lastest
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest in('B2B&LKA','Ecom') THEN NULL
            --WHEN t1.dist_code in ('2849662') and upper(t1.bu_2) in ('SKP','SP') then null
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'MPD' then t3.customer_name
            WHEN t1.first_channel_name_lastest = 'DT' THEN IF(t1.bu_1='Professional',t3.customer_name, nvl(t3.customer_name,'Others'))
            else 'Others'
        end as fourth_channel_name_lastest -- 最新四级渠道名称
        -- 不同粒度的关联键
        ,case 
            when t1.data_source = 'dms' and upper(t1.first_channel_name) = 'ECOM' then CONCAT('dms', nvl(t1.dist_code, ''),nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''))
            when t1.data_source = 'dms' then CONCAT('dms', nvl(t1.dist_code, ''),nvl(t1.bu_1, ''),nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''))
            when t1.data_source = 'dms_ka' then CONCAT('dms', nvl(t1.dist_code, ''),nvl(t1.bu_1, ''),nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''))
            when t1.data_source = 'ke24' then CONCAT('ke24', nvl(t1.dist_code, ''), nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''))
            when t1.data_source = 'git' then CONCAT('git', nvl(t1.dist_code, ''), nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''))
            when t1.data_source in ('KA手工报表', 'KA系统') then CONCAT('ka_stock', nvl(t1.ka_name, ''),nvl(t1.dist_code, ''),nvl(t1.bu_1, ''),nvl(t1.bu_2, ''),nvl(t1.bu_3, ''),nvl(t1.ka_code, ''))
        end as link
        ,t3.cooperation_status
        ,t1.channel_customer_permission
        ,t1.region_customer_permission
        ,t3.is_expired_customer
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp02  t1
    -- 客户相关
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT  a.province AS province_name --省份
                ,a.region AS henkel_region_name --大区中文
                ,a.province_lastest AS province_name_lastest --汉高大区(最新)
                ,a.region_lastest AS henkel_region_name_lastest --省份名称(最新)
                ,a.customer_code
                ,a.customer_name
                ,a.customer_group
                ,a.bu_1
                ,a.bu_2
                ,SUBSTR(a.ds,1,6) AS months
                ,cooperation_status
                ,is_expired_customer
        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu a
        where ds like '%01'
    ) t3
    ON      t1.dist_code = t3.customer_code
    AND     t1.bu_1 = t3.bu_1
    AND     t1.bu_2 = t3.bu_2
    AND     SUBSTR(t1.stock_date,1,6) = t3.months
    -- 门店相关
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT  store_oneid
                ,store_name --客户名称
                ,chain_name --客户渠道
                ,store_definition --客户性质
                ,store_type_seg --门店类型
                ,STORE_LV -- 门店等级
                ,city_name
                ,henkel_region
                ,province_name
        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
        GROUP BY store_oneid
                ,store_name
                ,chain_name
                ,store_definition
                ,store_type_seg
                ,STORE_LV
                ,city_name
                ,henkel_region
                ,province_name
    ) t2
    ON      t1.henkel_store_code = t2.store_oneid
) t2
group by 
    t2.data_source
    -- ,t2.org_name             -- 组织全称
    ,t2.stock_type
    ,t2.prod_barcode                  -- Henkel产品条码
    ,t2.dist_code                     -- 经销商编码

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp04 as 
select *, stock_date as dt_date, '日' as date_type from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03 
where nvl(data_source,'') not in ('ke24', 'git')
union all
select t1.*, dt_date, date_type from (
select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03 where 
case when bu_2 = 'VS' then 1=1
     when first_channel_name = 'Ecom' then 1=1
     when first_channel_name = 'MPD' 
       -- and nvl(stock_type,'') not like '%赠品%' 
       -- and nvl(stock_type,'') not like '%代销%'
        -- and nvl(prod_brand_name,'') <>''
        and stock_num <> 0 then 1=1
     when first_channel_name in('DT','B2B&LKA') and bu_1 ='Consumer' 
       -- and nvl(stock_type,'') not like '%赠品%' 
       -- and nvl(stock_type,'') not like '%代销%'
        -- and nvl(prod_brand_name,'') <>''
        and stock_num <> 0 then 1=1
     when first_channel_name in('DT','B2B&LKA') and bu_1 ='Professional' then 1=1
     when upper(first_channel_name) in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 1=1
     else 1=0 end
) t1
inner join (
    select 
        week_flag as dt_date, max(stock_date) as stock_date, link, '周' as date_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03
    where week_flag is not null
    group by link, week_flag
    union all 
    select 
        month_flag as dt_date, max(stock_date) as stock_date, link, '月' as date_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03
    where month_flag is not null
    group by link, month_flag
    union all 
    select 
        quarter_flag as dt_date, max(stock_date) as stock_date, link, '季' as date_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03
    where quarter_flag is not null
    group by link, quarter_flag
    union all 
    select 
        TO_CHAR(year_flag) as dt_date, max(stock_date) as stock_date, link, '年' as date_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid_temp03
    where year_flag is not null
    group by link, year_flag
) t2 on t1.link = t2.link and t1.stock_date = t2.stock_date

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid_dms_01_temp AS
SELECT
    NVL(prod_barcode, '-110') AS product_barcode,  -- Henkel产品barcode
    NVL(store_code, '-110') AS henkel_store_code,  -- Henkel门店编码
    NVL(dist_code, '-110') AS dist_code,  -- 经销商编码
    NVL(dist_store_code, '-110') AS dist_store_code,
    nvl(dist_store_name,'Others') as dist_store_name,
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    bu_3,
    channel_name,
    first_channel_name,
    second_channel_name,
    third_channel_name,
    fourth_channel_name,
    -- first_channel_name_new,
    first_channel_name_lastest,
    second_channel_name_lastest,
    third_channel_name_lastest,
    fourth_channel_name_lastest,
    -- first_channel_name_new_lastest,
    store_type_level1,
    base_qty AS sales_num,  -- 销售数量
    base_qty * base_price AS sales_amt,  -- 基价金额
    dist_prod_amt AS dist_prod_amt,  -- 实价金额
    dist_prod_amt/1.13 AS dist_prod_amt_untax,  -- 实价金额(未税）
    case when --bu_2 ='SP'-- and nvl(dist_name,'') not regexp '丝芙兰' 
        upper(first_channel_name_lastest) IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
        then 'dms_ka' else 'dms' end as data_source,
    case when --bu_2 ='SP' --and nvl(dist_name,'') not regexp '丝芙兰'
        --AND 
        upper(first_channel_name_lastest) IN('SELECTIVE RETAILER')
        then '间供' else null end as supply_type_name,
    ds,
    store_category,
    store_category_lv1,
    store_category_lv2,
    rs,
    base_price,
    channel_customer_permission,
    region_customer_permission
FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_sale_bu 
WHERE
    ds <> ''
    and case when bu_2 = 'VS' then 1=1 -- VS数据不做任何过滤 
             when UPPER(first_channel_name) = 'MPD' and bu_1 in('Consumer','Professional') then 1=1
             when UPPER(first_channel_name) IN ('OTHERS') and bu_1 in('Professional') then 1=1

         ,t1.ka_code
         ,t1.ka_name
         ,t1.KA_Type_Name

    bu_2,
    henkel_category_name,       -- 汉高品类
    henkel_frist_subcategory_name,   -- 汉高一级子品类
    henkel_second_subcategory_name,    -- 汉高二级子品类
    henkel_brand_name, -- 汉高品牌
    henkel_product_line, --汉高产品线
    henkel_product_barcode, -- 汉高商品条码
    henkel_product_name, -- 汉高商品名称
    store_id,
    henkel_store_name,
    concat(henkel_product_name,'-',henkel_product_barcode) as sku,
    case when data_source='商家版'  then henkel_category_name
        else category_tp end as category_tp ,--平台品类
    case when data_source='商家版'  then '整体'
        when data_source='品牌版' and data_granularity='Category' then '整体'
        when data_source='品牌版' and data_granularity='Subcategory' then third_category_tp end as third_category_tp, -- 平台子品类
    cast(sum(traded_amount) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_amount, -- 成交金额    
    cast(sum(traded_peoples) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_peoples, -- 成交人数
    cast(sum(traded_order_num) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_order_num, -- 成交单量
    cast(sum(uv) as decimal(28,6)) as uv, -- 访客数
    cast(sum(traded_products) as decimal(28,6)) as traded_products, -- 成交商品数
    cast(sum(add_purchases_products) as decimal(28,6)) as add_purchases_products, -- 加购商品数
    cast(sum(add_purchases_peoples) as decimal(28,6)) as add_purchases_peoples, -- 加购人数

--功能描述: 京东关键词类型mapping表
--20250512  yyq     通用词定义为品类词
--20251224  yyq     门店表切换到dwd_master_data_store_bu
--20260109  yyq     剔除丝蕴京东自营官旗店铺
--********************************************************************--
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_keywords_type_mapping_kunchi partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
    nvl(t1.store_name,'Others') as store_name, -- 店铺
    a.keywords, -- 关键词
    nvl(t1.store_code,a.store_id) as store_id, -- 店铺id
    a.keywords_type -- 词类
from (
    SELECT 
        store_name, -- 店铺
        keywords, -- 关键词
        store_id, -- 店铺id
        keywords_type, -- 词类
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY store_id,keywords  ORDER BY case when keywords_type='品牌词' then 1  when keywords_type='品类词' then 2 else 3 end) AS rn -- 同一个店铺词类优先级
    from (
        select 
            store_name, -- 店铺
            keywords as keywords_ori,
            lower(keywords) as keywords, -- 关键词
            keywords_type as keywords_type_ori, -- 词类
            store_id, -- 店铺id
            case when keywords_type='品牌词' then '品牌词'
                when keywords_type='类目词' then '品类词'
                when keywords_type='通用词' then '品类词'
                else '其他词'  end keywords_type,
            ROW_NUMBER() over(partition by store_id,keywords order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
        from ${dme_ods}.s_keywords_type_campaign_kunchi -- 取最新一次上传的全量数据
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_keywords_type_campaign_kunchi')
        and nvl(store_id,'') not in ('104')
    ) a 
    where keywords is not null 
    and rn=1
) a 
LEFT JOIN   (
    select  store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and nvl(ec_store_code_tp,'') <>''
    group by store_code,store_name,ec_store_code_tp
) t1
ON a.store_id = t1.ec_store_code_tp
where a.rn=1

union all
select
    dt_date,
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    henkel_category_name,       -- 汉高品类
    henkel_frist_subcategory_name,   -- 汉高一级子品类
    henkel_second_subcategory_name,    -- 汉高二级子品类
    henkel_brand_name, -- 汉高品牌
    henkel_product_line, --汉高产品线
    henkel_product_barcode, -- 汉高商品条码
    henkel_product_name, -- 汉高商品名称
    store_id,
    henkel_store_name,
    sku,
    traded_amount, -- 成交金额    
    traded_peoples, -- 成交人数
    traded_order_num, -- 成交单量
    uv, -- 访客数
    traded_products, -- 成交商品数
    add_purchases_products, -- 加购商品数
    add_purchases_peoples, -- 加购人数
    pv, -- 浏览量
    stay_duration_avg , -- 平均停留时长
    gmv,
    b.date_type,
    substr(dt_date,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(dt_date,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(dt_date,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(dt_date,1,6) as data_month
from (
    select 
        a.ds as dt_date, -- 日期
        a.bu_1,
        a.bu_2,
        nvl(b.category_name,'Others')  as henkel_category_name, -- 品类
        nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as henkel_frist_subcategory_name,--产品功能/一级子品类
        nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as henkel_second_subcategory_name,--二级子品类
        nvl(b.brand_name,'Others') as henkel_brand_name,--品牌名称
        nvl(b.product_line,'Others') as henkel_product_line,--产品线名称
        a.henkel_item_barcode as henkel_product_barcode, -- barcode
        nvl(b.product_name,'Others')  as henkel_product_name,--产品名称
        a.shop_id as store_id,--门店代码
        a.shop_name as henkel_store_name,--门店名称
        concat(nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),'-',a.henkel_item_barcode) as sku,--产品名称和ID
        null as traded_amount, -- 成交金额    
        null as traded_peoples, -- 成交人数
        null as traded_order_num, -- 成交单量
        null as uv, -- 访客数
        null as traded_products, -- 成交商品数
        null as add_purchases_products, -- 加购商品数
        null as add_purchases_peoples, -- 加购人数
        null as pv, -- 浏览量
        null as stay_duration_avg , -- 平均停留时长
        sum(a.payment_actual) as gmv,
        '1' as tag
    from  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu a 
    left join (
        select
            product_barcode,
            product_name,
            category_name,
            product_function,  
            sub_product_function ,
            brand_name,
            brand_name_en,
            product_line,
            bu_2
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
    ) b
    on a.henkel_item_barcode=b.product_barcode
    where to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    and a.shop_id in ('30170779','30170777','30170770','30170794','30170776','30192081','30192082','30163419') 
    group by a.ds , -- 日期
        a.bu_1,
        a.bu_2,
        nvl(b.category_name,'Others') , -- 品类
        nvl(b.product_function,'Others'),--产品功能/一级子品类
        nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others'),--二级子品类
        nvl(b.brand_name,'Others'),--品牌名称
        nvl(b.product_line,'Others'),--产品线名称
        a.henkel_item_barcode , -- barcode
        nvl(b.product_name,'Others') ,--产品名称
        a.shop_id,--门店代码
        a.shop_name,--门店名称
        concat(nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),'-',a.henkel_item_barcode)
) a
join  (
    select '店铺粒度' as date_type,'1' as tag
    union all
    select '产品粒度' as date_type,'1' as tag
) b on a.tag=b.tag

--DME需推送SKU粒度的正单数据，初始化时包含25年1~3月的POS数据，日度推送，常规增量推送上月与当月数据，
--针对个别手工交数的店铺(丽人laundry+沃亿拼多多)，DME需推送去年全年和当年全量的POS数据量
--手工数据门店编码:446 ,沃亿
--20251228  shwu  从dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu取数将shop_id改为shop_id_tp,ec_name改为customer_name
--********************************************************************--
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_sku_ecom_pos_tpm PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  
        NULL AS dist_system_code -- '统一置空'
        ,CAST(base_unit_qty AS BIGINT) AS base_unit_qty -- '基本单位数量'
        ,'个' AS base_unit_name -- '基本单位'
        ,CAST(original_amt_tax AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS original_amt_tax -- '原始金额(含税)'
        ,CAST(original_amt_untax AS DECIMAL(20,4)) AS original_amt_untax -- '原始金额(未税)'
        ,henkel_prod_code -- '商家处产品编码'
        ,henkel_prod_barcode -- '汉高产品条形码 '
        ,dist_store_code -- 'KA门店编码'
        ,NULL AS henkel_store_code --'统一置空'
        ,'Ecom' AS first_channel_name -- '一级渠道名称,统一置Ecom'
        ,bill_date --'单据日期(yyyymmdd)'
        ,NULL AS start_date -- '统一置空'
        ,NULL AS end_date --'统一置空'
        ,SUBSTR(bill_date,1,6) AS month -- '销售月'
        ,GETDATE() AS extract_time --'接口同步时间'
FROM    (
            SELECT  SUM(quantity) AS base_unit_qty
                    ,SUM(total_price_tax) AS original_amt_tax
                    ,SUM(total_price_untax) AS original_amt_untax
                    ,commodity_sku AS henkel_prod_code
                    ,henkel_item_barcode AS henkel_prod_barcode
                    -- ,shop_id AS dist_store_code
                    ,shop_id_tp AS dist_store_code
                    ,ds AS bill_date
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= '20250101' --同步25年之后的数
            AND     (
                        NVL(total_price_tax,0) <> 0
                        OR      NVL(quantity,0) <> 0
            )
            AND     (
                        -- CASE   WHEN shop_id IN ('446') OR ec_name = '沃亿' THEN ds >= '${uddate1}' --uddate1近两年
                        --         ELSE ds >= '${bizmonth}' --近两个月
                        -- END
                        CASE   WHEN shop_id_tp IN ('446') OR customer_name = '北京沃亿商业管理有限公司' THEN ds >= '${uddate1}' --uddate1近两年
                                ELSE ds >= '${bizmonth}' --近两个月
                        END   
            )
            GROUP BY commodity_sku
                     ,henkel_item_barcode
                     --,shop_id
                     ,shop_id_tp
                     ,ds
        ) t

-- 处理重点产品mapping数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp01

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp01 as

 distinct
 year             -- 年
 ,bu_2            -- BU
 ,category_name   -- 品类
 ,brand_name      -- 品牌
 ,product_line    -- 产品线
 ,product_pack    -- 产品规格

-- 处理漫流品ngs数据
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp02

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp02 as
select
 year              -- 年份
 ,month            -- 日期
 ,customer_code    -- 客户代码
 ,product_code     -- IDH
 ,sum(quantity) as quantity         -- 数量
 ,sum(ngs_amount_untax) as ngs_amount_untax -- 未税金额
 ,sum(ngs_amount_tax)   as ngs_amount_tax   -- 含税金额
from(
  select
   year
   ,concat(substr(month,1,4),substr(replace(month,'/','0'),-2)) as month
   ,customer_code
   ,customer_name
   ,product_code
   ,product_name
   ,quantity
   ,ngs_amount_untax
   ,ngs_amount_tax
   ,comments
   ,create_time
   ,modify_time
   ,qbi_system_upload_id
   ,dense_rank() over(partition by year,month order by qbi_system_upload_id desc) as  rn
  from ${dme_ods}.s_slow_moving_product_ngs_info
  where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_slow_moving_product_ngs_info')
)
where rn=1
group by year,month ,customer_code ,product_code

-- 获取ke24数据，达标重点产品
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp03

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp03 as
select
  to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyy')      as years      -- 年份
  ,to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymm')   as months     -- 月份
  ,to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd') as bill_date  -- 日期
  ,a.customer_id           as customer_code         -- 经销商编码
  ,a.customer_name         as customer_name         -- 经销商名称
  ,a.henkel_region_lastest as henkel_region         -- 汉高区域
  ,a.province_lastest      as province_name         -- 汉高省份
  ,a.product_barcode       as product_barcode       -- barcode
  ,a.product_id            as product_code          -- IDH
  ,nvl(b.product_name,'Others')  as product_name    -- 产品名称
  ,if(nvl(b.category_name,'其他')='Others','其他',b.category_name) as category_name   -- 品类中文
  ,nvl(b.brand_name,'Others')    as brand_name      -- 品牌中文
  ,nvl(b.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_name_en   -- 品牌英文
  ,nvl(b.product_line,'Others')  as product_line    -- 产品线
  ,nvl(b.product_function_cn,'其他')     as first_product_function  -- 一级子品类中文
  ,nvl(b.sub_product_function_cn,'其他') as second_product_function -- 二级子品类中文
  ,nvl(b.product_pack_ori,'Others') as product_pack -- 产品规格
  ,a.bu_1                    -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                    -- bu_2
  ,case when to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyymmdd')<'20250101' then 
      case when a.bu_2 ='Beauty Care' then a.ges/0.85*0.525
         when a.bu_2='Laundry'    then a.ges/0.85*0.5
         when upper(a.bu_2)='SKP' then a.ges*0.5
         when upper(a.bu_2)='SP'  then a.ges*0.65
        end 
    else a.sku_ngs_amt end as ngs_amount_untax  -- ngs未税
  ,nvl(a.quantity_consumer_units,0) as sellin_num -- sellin数量
  ,case when c.year is not null then 'Y' else 'N' end as is_imporant_product -- 是否重点产品(Y是,N否)
  ,nvl(d.cooperation_status,'Others') as cooperation_status
  ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b
 on a.product_barcode=b.product_barcode
 and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp01 c
 on to_char(a.posting_date,'yyyy')=c.year
 and if(c.bu_2   is not null,UPPER(a.bu_2)=UPPER(c.bu_2),1=1)
 and if(c.category_name   is not null,upper(trim(b.category_name))=upper(trim(c.category_name)),1=1)
 and if(c.brand_name      is not null,upper(trim(b.brand_name))=upper(trim(c.brand_name      )),1=1)
 and if(c.product_line    is not null,upper(trim(b.product_line))=upper(trim(c.product_line  )),1=1)
 and if(c.product_pack    is not null,upper(trim(b.product_pack_ori))=upper(trim(c.product_pack )),1=1)
 and if(c.product_function is not null,upper(trim(b.product_function_cn))=upper(trim(c.product_function)),1=1)
 and if(c.sub_product_function is not null,upper(trim(b.sub_product_function_cn))=upper(trim(c.sub_product_function)),1=1)
 and if(c.brand_name_en is not null,upper(trim(b.brand_name_en))=upper(trim(c.brand_name_en)),1=1)
 and if(c.product_barcode is not null,upper(trim(a.product_barcode))=upper(trim(c.product_barcode)),1=1)
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu d
on a.bu_2=d.bu_2
and a.customer_id=d.customer_code
where a.ds >='20200101'
and a.first_channel_name_lastest='MPD'
and d.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads_dev}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary partition (ds='${bizdate}')
select
  years       -- 年份
  ,months     -- 月份
  ,bill_date  -- 日期
  ,customer_code           -- 经销商编码
  ,customer_name           -- 经销商名称
  ,henkel_region           -- 汉高区域
  ,province_name           -- 汉高省份
  ,product_barcode         -- barcode
  ,product_name            -- 产品名称
  ,category_name           -- 品类中文
  ,brand_name              -- 品牌中文
  ,brand_name_en           -- 品牌英文
  ,product_line            -- 产品线
  ,first_product_function  -- 一级子品类中文
  ,second_product_function -- 二级子品类中文
  ,product_pack            -- 产品规格
  ,is_imporant_product     -- 是否重点产品(Y是,N否)
  ,bu_1                    -- bu_1
  ,bu_2                    -- bu_2
  ,cast(sum(nvl(ngs_amount_untax,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ngs_amount_untax  -- ngs未税
  ,cast(sum(nvl(sellin_num,0)) as bigint) as sellin_num        -- sellin数量
  ,case when bu_2='Laundry' then product_pack else product_line end as product_line_report -- 产品线前端展示
  ,to_char(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(now())),'yyyyMMddhhmiss') as create_date--数据创建日期
  ,cooperation_status
  ,cast(sum(nvl(ngs_amount_untax,0)*1.13) as decimal(28,6)) as ngs_amount_tax
  ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,is_slow_moving_product      -- 是否漫流产品(Y是,N否)
  ,product_code          -- IDH
from(
  select
    years      -- 年份
    ,months     -- 月份
    ,bill_date  -- 日期
    ,customer_code           -- 经销商编码
    ,customer_name           -- 经销商名称
    ,henkel_region           -- 汉高区域
    ,province_name           -- 汉高省份
    ,product_barcode         -- barcode
    ,product_name            -- 产品名称
    ,category_name           -- 品类中文
    ,brand_name              -- 品牌中文
    ,brand_name_en   -- 品牌英文
    ,product_line            -- 产品线
    ,first_product_function  -- 一级子品类中文
    ,second_product_function -- 二级子品类中文
    ,product_pack            -- 产品规格
    ,is_imporant_product     -- 是否重点产品(Y是,N否)
    ,bu_1                    -- bu_1
    ,bu_2                    -- bu_2
    ,ngs_amount_untax  -- ngs未税
    ,sellin_num        -- sellin数量
    ,null SlowMoving_ngs_amount_untax -- 漫流品ngs未税
    ,null SlowMoving_sellin_num       -- 漫流品sellin数量
    ,cooperation_status
    ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,'N' as is_slow_moving_product      -- 是否漫流产品(Y是,N否)
    ,product_code          -- IDH
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp03 a
  union all
  -- 合并漫流品数据
  select  
    a.year   as years      -- 年份
    ,a.month as months     -- 月份
    ,concat(a.month,'01') as bill_date     -- 日期
    ,a.customer_code       as customer_code -- 经销商编码
    ,nvl(d.customer_name        ,'Others') as customer_name -- 经销商名称
    ,nvl(d.region_lastest,'Others')        as henkel_region -- 汉高区域
    ,nvl(d.province_lastest,'Others')      as province_name -- 汉高省份
    ,nvl(b.product_barcode,'-110') as product_barcode       -- barcode
    ,nvl(c.product_name ,'Others') as product_name          -- 产品名称
    ,if(nvl(c.category_name,'其他')='Others','其他',c.category_name) as category_name         -- 品类中文
    ,nvl(c.brand_name   ,'Others') as brand_name            -- 品牌中文
    ,nvl(c.brand_name_en,'Others') as brand_name_en   -- 品牌英文
    ,nvl(c.product_line ,'Others') as product_line          -- 产品线
    ,nvl(c.product_function_cn,'其他')     as first_product_function  -- 一级子品类中文
    ,nvl(c.sub_product_function_cn,'其他') as second_product_function -- 二级子品类中文
    ,nvl(c.product_pack_ori,'Others') as product_pack -- 产品规格
    ,'N' as is_imporant_product     -- 是否重点产品(Y是,N否)
    ,nvl(b.bu_1,'Consumer')    as bu_1 -- bu_1
    ,nvl(b.bu_2,'Beauty Care') as bu_2 -- bu_2
    ,cast(a.ngs_amount_untax as decimal(28,6))as ngs_amount_untax  -- ngs未税
    ,cast(a.quantity         as decimal(28,6))as ellin_num        -- sellin数量
    ,cast(a.ngs_amount_untax as decimal(28,6))as SlowMoving_ngs_amount_untax -- 漫流品ngs未税
    ,cast(a.quantity as bigint) as SlowMoving_sellin_num       -- 漫流品sellin数量
    ,nvl(d.cooperation_status,'Others') as cooperation_status
    ,nvl(d.channel_customer_Permission,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
    ,nvl(d.region_customer_Permission,'Others_Others') as region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
    ,'Y' as is_slow_moving_product      -- 是否漫流产品(Y是,N否)
    ,a.product_code          -- IDH
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_ngs_sale_summary_tmp02 a
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu b
   on a.product_code=b.product_code
   and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu c
   on b.product_barcode=c.product_barcode
   and b.bu_2=c.bu_2
   and c.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu d
   on a.month=substr(d.ds,1,6)
   and b.bu_2=d.bu_2
   and a.customer_code=d.customer_code
   and d.ds like '%01'
)
where nvl(ngs_amount_untax,0)<>0 or nvl(SlowMoving_ngs_amount_untax,0)<>0
   or nvl(sellin_num,0)<>0 or nvl(SlowMoving_sellin_num,0)<>0
group by years       -- 年份
  ,months     -- 月份
  ,bill_date  -- 日期
  ,customer_code           -- 经销商编码
  ,customer_name           -- 经销商名称
  ,henkel_region           -- 汉高区域
  ,province_name           -- 汉高省份
  ,product_barcode         -- barcode
  ,product_name            -- 产品名称
  ,category_name           -- 品类中文
  ,brand_name              -- 品牌中文
  ,brand_name_en           -- 品牌英文
  ,product_line            -- 产品线
  ,first_product_function  -- 一级子品类中文
  ,second_product_function -- 二级子品类中文
  ,product_pack            -- 产品规格
  ,is_imporant_product     -- 是否重点产品(Y是,N否)
  ,bu_1                    -- bu_1
  ,bu_2                    -- bu_2
  ,case when bu_2='Laundry' then product_pack else product_line end
  ,cooperation_status
  ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,is_slow_moving_product      -- 是否漫流产品(Y是,N否)
  ,product_code          -- IDH

 ,if(upper(a.dist_store_name) regexp 'DAIPIPEI|DAIQUEREN','Others',nvl(a.dist_store_name,'Others')) as dist_store_name --KA门店名称

          when t1.dist_system_name regexp '麦德龙' then 'KA0004'

          when t1.dist_system_name regexp '莎莎'   then 'KA0070'

    ,t1.store_name as dist_store_name --KA门店名称
    ,t1.henkel_store_code        --汉高门店编码
    ,t1.henkel_store_name        --汉高门店名称
    ,t1.delivery_store_code      -- 汉高线下配送门店编码 
    ,t1.product_barcode as henkel_prod_barcode --汉高产品条码
    ,null as bu_1
    ,null as bu_2
    ,t1.type as sales_channel_type -- 销售渠道类型
    ,if(t1.type='O2O',t1.dashboard_data_type,null)    as Domain_flag   -- 公域/私域
    ,if(t1.type='O2O' and t1.dashboard_data_type='公域',t1.standard_platform_name,null) as o2o_platform  -- o2o平台
    ,if(t1.type='O2O',t1.sales_qty ,t1.sales_qty*-1)  as pos_cnt       -- pos销量
    ,if(t1.type='O2O',t1.amt_untax ,t1.amt_untax*-1)  as pos_amt_untax -- pos实际金额(未税)

    and channel_name IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
    and data_source ='手工数据'   -- 系统数据需剔除手工上传部分O2O数据

-- by月份计算期初、期末时间点
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp02

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp02 as
select
  month_id
  ,month_start
  ,least('${bizdate}',month_end) as month_end
  ,quarter_start
  ,least('${bizdate}',quarter_end) as quarter_end
  ,year_start
  ,least('${bizdate}',year_end) as year_end
from(
 select distinct
   month_id
   ,concat(month_id,'01') as month_start
   ,to_char(date(last_day(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))),'yyyymmdd')  as month_end
   ,to_char(date(
     add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))- 1)
      ,-(pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3)))
     ),'yyyymmdd') AS quarter_start
   ,to_char(date(
      last_day(add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1)
      ,+  (2 - pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3))))
     ),'yyyymmdd')  AS quarter_end
   ,concat(year_id,'0101')  as year_start
   ,concat(year_id,'1231')  as year_end
 from dme_cdm.dim_day
 where month_id >='202001' and month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
)

   select distinct ka_name

      select ka_name

   )
   where rn = 1
) t5
on t1.ka_name=t5.ka_name
 group by
 t1.first_channel_name   -- 渠道名称
 ,t1.second_channel_name -- KA二级渠道
 ,t1.third_channel_name  -- KA三级渠道
 ,t1.bill_month          -- 销售月份

 ,t4.quarter_start -- 季初时间
 ,t4.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
 ,t4.year_start    -- 年初时间
 ,t4.year_end      -- 年末时间
 ,t1.ka_code             -- ka编码
 ,t1.ka_name             -- ka名称
 ,if(t5.ka_name is not null,nvl(t2.distributor_region_name,'Others'),null)  -- 零售商大区域
 ,t1.dist_store_code     -- KA门店编码
 ,t1.dist_store_name     -- KA门店名称
 ,case when t1.ka_code ='KA0011' then t1.delivery_store_code
   else if(t2.store_oneid is not null,t1.henkel_store_code,concat(t1.ka_code,t1.dist_store_code))

 ,if(t2.store_oneid is not null,t1.henkel_store_code,concat(t1.ka_code,'+',t1.dist_store_code))   --汉高门店编码
 ,if(t2.store_oneid is not null,t1.henkel_store_name,t3.dist_store_name)   --汉高门店名称

 ,t1.bu_1
 ,t1.bu_2
 ,t1.sales_channel_type -- 销售渠道类型
 ,t1.Domain_flag   -- 公域/私域
 ,t1.o2o_platform  -- o2o平台
