 ,t1.sales_channel -- 销售渠道
 ,t1.data_source

-- by门店+产品+渠道+日 计算同环比
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp04

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp04 as
select
 bill_date,bill_month
 ,ka_name
 ,henkel_store_code
 ,henkel_prod_barcode
 ,sales_channel_type
 ,sum(pos_amt_untax)    as pos_amt_untax    -- pos实际金额(未税)
 ,sum(pos_amt_untax_lm) as pos_amt_untax_lm -- 上月同期pos实际金额(未税)
 ,sum(pos_amt_untax_py) as pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期pos实际金额(未税)
 ,sum(pos_cnt      ) as pos_cnt       -- pos数量
 ,sum(pos_cnt_lm   ) as pos_cnt_lm    -- 上月同期pos数量
 ,sum(pos_cnt_py   ) as pos_cnt_py    -- 去年同期pos数量
 ,case when sum(pos_amt_untax_lm)=0 then 0
    else sum(pos_amt_untax)/sum(pos_amt_untax_lm)-1
   end as rate_mon -- 环比
 ,case when sum(pos_amt_untax_py)=0 then 0
    else sum(pos_amt_untax)/sum(pos_amt_untax_py)-1
   end as rate_yoy -- 同比
from (
   select
      bill_date
      ,bill_month          --销售日期
      ,ka_name
      ,henkel_store_code
      ,henkel_prod_barcode
      ,sales_channel_type
      ,sum(pos_amt_untax) as pos_amt_untax -- pos实际金额(未税)
      ,sum(pos_cnt      ) as pos_cnt       -- pos数量
      ,null as pos_amt_untax_lm -- 上月同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt_lm       -- 上月同期pos数量
      ,null as pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt_py       -- 去年同期pos数量
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
   group by bill_date,ka_name ,henkel_store_code ,henkel_prod_barcode,sales_channel_type,bill_month 
    union all
   select
      case when a.ka_code ='KA0011' and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') >= '202202' and b.time_mom <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
       else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+1)),'yyyymmdd') end  as bill_date
      ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') as bill_month -- 销售月份
      ,a.ka_name
      ,a.henkel_store_code
      ,a.henkel_prod_barcode
      ,a.sales_channel_type
      ,null as pos_amt_untax -- pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt       -- pos数量
      ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax) as pos_amt_untax_lm -- 上月同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,sum(a.pos_cnt      ) as pos_cnt_lm       -- 上月同期pos数量
      ,null as pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt_py       -- 去年同期pos数量
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03 a
   left join 
   (    select  distinct d.time_now as time_mom,dd.time_now,b.mapping_time
        from  
        (   select time_mom,time_now,mapping_time
               ,dense_rank() over(partition by time_mom order by time_now asc) as  rn 
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'C.月' 
        )b
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )c
        on b.time_mom=c.time_now
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
                 ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )d
         on c.mapping_time=d.mapping_time
        and d.rn = 1
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )cc
        on b.time_now=cc.time_now
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
                 ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )dd
         on cc.mapping_time=dd.mapping_time
        and dd.rn = 1
        where b.rn = 1   
   )b
   on concat(a.bill_date,'a')=b.time_mom
   and a.ka_code ='KA0011' 
   group by  case when a.ka_code ='KA0011'  and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') >= '202202' and b.time_mom <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
       else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+1)),'yyyymmdd') end 
     ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') 
     ,a.ka_name,a.henkel_store_code ,a.henkel_prod_barcode,a.sales_channel_type
    union all
   select
      case when  a.ka_code ='KA0011'  and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') >= '202301' and b.time_yoy <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
       else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+12)),'yyyymmdd') end as bill_date
      ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') as bill_month -- 销售月份
      ,a.ka_name
      ,a.henkel_store_code
      ,a.henkel_prod_barcode
      ,a.sales_channel_type
      ,null as pos_amt_untax -- pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt       -- pos数量
      ,null as pos_amt_untax_lm -- 上月同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,null as pos_cnt_lm       -- 上月同期pos数量
      ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax) as pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期pos实际金额(未税)
      ,sum(a.pos_cnt      ) as pos_cnt_py       -- 去年同期pos数量
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03 a
   left join 
   (    
      select  distinct d.time_now as time_yoy,dd.time_now,b.mapping_time
        from  
        (   select time_yoy,time_now,mapping_time
               ,dense_rank() over(partition by time_yoy order by time_now asc) as  rn 
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'C.月' 
        )b
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )c
        on b.time_yoy=c.time_now
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
                 ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )d
         on c.mapping_time=d.mapping_time
        and d.rn = 1
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )cc
        on b.time_now=cc.time_now
        left join 
        (
          select  time_now,mapping_time
                 ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
           where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
           and b.time_type = 'D.周'
        )dd
         on cc.mapping_time=dd.mapping_time
        and dd.rn = 1
        where b.rn = 1 
   )b
   on concat(a.bill_date,'a')=b.time_yoy
   and a.ka_code ='KA0011' 
   group by case when  a.ka_code ='KA0011'  and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') >= '202301' and b.time_yoy <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
       else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+12)),'yyyymmdd') end
     ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') 
     ,a.ka_name,a.henkel_store_code ,a.henkel_prod_barcode,a.sales_channel_type
)t
where bill_date<='${bizdate}'
group by bill_date,bill_month ,ka_name ,henkel_store_code ,henkel_prod_barcode,sales_channel_type

-- 新店标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp05

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp05 as
select
 month_id
 ,month_start   -- 月初时间
 ,month_end     -- 月末时间
 ,quarter_start -- 季初时间
 ,quarter_end   -- 季末时间
 ,year_start    -- 年初时间
 ,year_end      -- 年末时间
 ,ka_name
 ,henkel_store_code
 ,sales_channel_type
 ,bill_date_min   -- 近两年首次动销日期
 ,if(month_start<=bill_date_min,'Y','N')   AS new_store_flag_mtd  -- 新店标签（月度）
 ,if(quarter_start<=bill_date_min,'Y','N') AS new_store_flag_qtd  -- 新店标签（季度）
 ,if(year_start<=bill_date_min,'Y','N')    AS new_store_flag_ytd  -- 新店标签（年度）
from(
  select
   a.month_id
   ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.henkel_store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
   ,min(b.bill_date_min) as bill_date_min   -- 近两年首次动销日期
  from(
      select distinct
        month_id
        ,month_start   -- 月初时间
        ,month_end     -- 月末时间
        ,quarter_start -- 季初时间
        ,quarter_end   -- 季末时间
        ,year_start    -- 年初时间
        ,year_end      -- 年末时间
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp02
  ) a
  left join (
      select
        substr(bill_date,1,6) as months
        ,ka_name
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,sales_channel_type
        ,min(bill_date) as bill_date_min
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
      where (pos_amt_untax*pos_cnt) is not null
      group by substr(bill_date,1,6),ka_name,henkel_store_code,sales_channel_type
  ) b
   on a.flag=b.flag
   and substr(b.months,1,4) between substr(a.month_id,1,4)-1 and substr(a.month_id,1,4)
   and a.month_id>=b.months
  group by
   a.month_id
   ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.henkel_store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
)

-- 闭店标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp06_01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp06_01 as
 select
   a.bill_month
   ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.ka_name
   ,a.henkel_store_code
   ,a.sales_channel_type
   ,0 as close_store_flag_mtd -- 闭店标签
 from(
     select 
       bill_month
       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,sales_channel_type
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
     group by 
       bill_month
       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,sales_channel_type
 ) a
 inner join (
     select
       bill_month,max(bill_date) as bill_date
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,sales_channel_type
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
     where (pos_amt_untax*pos_cnt) is not null
     group by bill_month,ka_name,henkel_store_code ,sales_channel_type
 ) b
  on a.flag=b.flag
  and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
  and nvl(a.henkel_store_code,'')=nvl(b.henkel_store_code,'')
  and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(b.sales_channel_type,'')
 where DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 0 and 29
 group by
  a.bill_month
  ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
  ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
  ,a.ka_name
  ,a.henkel_store_code
  ,a.sales_channel_type

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp06

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp06 as
 select
   a.bill_month

       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,henkel_prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
       ,sales_channel_type
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
     group by 
       bill_month
       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,henkel_prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
       ,sales_channel_type
 ) a

     select
       bill_month,max(bill_date) as bill_date
       ,ka_name
       ,henkel_store_code
       ,henkel_prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
       ,sales_channel_type
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka_temp03
     where (pos_amt_untax*pos_cnt) is not null
     group by bill_month,ka_name,henkel_store_code,henkel_prod_barcode ,sales_channel_type
 ) b

  ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
  ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
  ,a.ka_name
  ,a.henkel_store_code
  ,a.henkel_prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
  ,a.sales_channel_type

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
   a.bill_date            -- 日期
  ,a.bill_month as months -- 月份
  ,concat(substr(a.bill_month,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(a.bill_month,'yyyymm'))) as quarter -- 季度
  ,substr(a.bill_month,1,4) as years -- 年
  ,d.month_start         -- 月初时间
  ,d.month_end           -- 月末时间
  ,d.quarter_start       -- 季初时间
  ,d.quarter_end         -- 季末时间
  ,d.year_start          -- 年初时间
  ,d.year_end            -- 年末时间
  ,a.BU_1                -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name             -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name  -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name  -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.dist_region_name   as distributor_region_name     -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region_name as henkel_region               -- 汉高区域
  ,a.henkel_store_code as store_code                   -- 门店编码
  ,a.henkel_store_name as store_name                   -- 门店名称
  ,nvl(b.category_name         ,'Others') as category_name           -- 品类
  ,nvl(b.product_function_cn   ,'Others') as first_product_function  -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(b.brand_name            ,'Others') as brand_name              -- 品牌
  ,nvl(b.product_line          ,'Others') as product_line            -- 产品线
  ,nvl(a.henkel_prod_barcode   ,'Others') as product_barcode         -- 产品条码
  ,nvl(b.product_name          ,'Others') as product_name            -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type            -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag                   -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform                  -- O2O平台
  ,t1.product_listing_date         -- 上市日期
  ,a.newprod_flag                  -- 新品标签
  ,a.Sub_new_product_flag          -- 次新品标签
  ,a.new_store_flag_mtd            -- 新店标签（月度）
  ,a.new_store_flag_qtd            -- 新店标签（季度）
  ,a.new_store_flag_ytd            -- 新店标签（年度）
  ,a.close_store_flag_mtd          -- 闭店标签（月度）
  ,if(nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y',a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'N') as oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd    -- 老品新上架标签（月度）
  ,if(nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y',a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'N') as oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd  -- 老品下架标签（月度）
  ,cast(a.discount_price_rate as DECIMAL(28,4)) as discount_price -- 价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,a.discount_price_level1         -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,a.discount_price_level2         -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,a.Activity_resource_bits        -- 店内活动/资源位
  ,a.Block_trades_flag             -- 团购/大宗
  ,t3.store_first_sales_date_m     -- 门店首次动销日期MTD
  ,t3.store_recent_sales_date_m    -- 门店最近动销日期MTD
  ,t4.store_prod_first_sales_date_m  -- 门店+产品首次一次动销日期MTD
  ,t4.store_prod_recent_sales_date_m -- 门店+产品最近一次动销日期MTD
  ,cast(sum(a.pos_cnt              ) as bigint       ) as pos_cnt          -- pos销量

-- by月份计算期初、期末时间点
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp00

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp00 as
select
  year_id
  ,quarter_id
  ,month_id
  ,month_start                                        -- 月初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',month_end) as month_end         -- 月末时间
  ,quarter_start                                      -- 季初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',quarter_end) as quarter_end     -- 季末时间
  ,year_start                                         -- 年初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',year_end) as year_end           -- 年末时间
from(
 select distinct
   year_id
   ,quarter_id
   ,month_id
   ,concat(month_id,'01') as month_start
   ,to_char(date(last_day(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))),'yyyymmdd')  as month_end
   ,to_char(date(
     add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))- 1)
      ,-(pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3)))
     ),'yyyymmdd') AS quarter_start
   ,to_char(date(
      last_day(add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1)
      ,+  (2 - pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3))))
     ),'yyyymmdd')  AS quarter_end
   ,concat(year_id,'0101')  as year_start
   ,concat(year_id,'1231')  as year_end
 from dme_cdm.dim_day
 where month_id >='202001' and month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
)

-- 月度数据处理
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp01_m

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp01_m as
select
  a.months                    -- 月份
  ,'月'   as date_type      -- 月份/季度/年
  ,a.months as date_value     -- 202401/2024Q1/2024 YTD
  ,a.month_start as date_start  -- 期初日期
  ,a.month_end   as date_end    -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name       -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name      -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name       -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类
  ,a.first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,a.brand_name               -- 品牌
  ,a.product_line             -- 产品线
  ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name             -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag              -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform             -- O2O平台
  ,a.product_listing_date     -- 上市日期
  ,a.Block_trades_flag        -- 团购/大宗
  ,min(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) then a.store_first_sales_date_m end) as new_store_first_sales_date -- 老品新店首次动销日期
  ,min(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_first_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_onshelves_date -- 老品老店新上架日期
  ,max(case when nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_recent_sales_date_m end) as close_store_recent_sales_date -- 闭店老品老店最后一次动销时间
  ,max(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_recent_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date -- 老品下架老品老店最后一次动销时间
 -- ,discount_price           -- 价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level1 end as discount_price_level1    -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level2 end as discount_price_level2    -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax -- 当期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax     -- 当期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax -- 当期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax -- 当期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as newprod_amt_untax_py                 -- 去年同期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_amt_untax_py        -- 去年同期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax_py    -- 去年同期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as newprod_pos_cnt               -- 当期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_pos_cnt      -- 当期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt  -- 当期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end)   as new_store_pos_cnt  -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as close_store_pos_cnt-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as Activity_pos_cnt -- 当期活动POS销量

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as newprod_pos_cnt_py              -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_pos_cnt_py     -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end)   as new_store_pos_cnt_py   -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as close_store_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt_py  -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Activity_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期活动POS销量
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax)    as pos_amt_untax        -- POS未税销售额MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt)          as pos_cnt              -- POS数量MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax -- RSP POS含税销售额MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_py  ) as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期POS未税销售额MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_py        ) as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期POS数量MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_lm     ) as pos_amt_untax_ma      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_lm           ) as pos_cnt_ma            -- 上月同期POS数量MTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka a
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
group by
  a.months                    -- 月份
  ,a.month_start    -- 期初日期
  ,a.month_end      -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name       -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name      -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name       -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类
  ,a.first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,a.brand_name               -- 品牌
  ,a.product_line             -- 产品线
  ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name             -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag              -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform             -- O2O平台
  ,a.product_listing_date     -- 上市日期
  ,a.Block_trades_flag        -- 团购/大宗
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level1 end -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level2 end -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）

--季度： 新店标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp02_q

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp02_q as
select
 quarter_id
 ,month_id
 ,ka_name
 ,store_code
 ,sales_channel_type
 ,if(quarter_start<=bill_date_min,'Y','N') AS new_store_flag_qtd  -- 新店标签（季度）
from(
  select
   a.quarter_id
   ,a.year_id
   ,a.month_id
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
   ,min(b.bill_date_min) as bill_date_min   -- 近两年首次动销日期
  from(
      select distinct
        quarter_id
        ,year_id
        ,month_id
        ,quarter_start -- 季初时间
        ,quarter_end   -- 季末时间
        ,year_start    -- 年初时间
        ,year_end      -- 年末时间
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp00
  ) a
  left join (
      select
        years
        ,quarter
        ,months
        ,ka_name
        ,store_code
        ,sales_channel_type
        ,min(bill_date) as bill_date_min
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka
      where (pos_amt_untax is not null or pos_cnt is not null)
      and ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
      group by years,months,quarter,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type
  ) b
   on a.flag=b.flag
   and b.years between a.year_id-1 and a.year_id
   and a.month_id>=b.months
  group by
   a.quarter_id
   ,a.year_id
   ,a.month_id
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
)

--季度： 闭店标签标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_01_q

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_01_q as
 select
   a.month_id
   ,a.quarter
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.ka_name
   ,a.store_code
   ,a.sales_channel_type
   ,'N' as close_store_flag_qtd         -- 闭店标签
 from(
     select distinct month_id,quarter_id as quarter,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,quarter_start -- 季初时间
       ,quarter_end   -- 季末时间 
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp_q
   ) a
  left join (
     select
        months,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type,max(bill_date) as bill_date
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka
      where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
      and (pos_amt_untax is not null or pos_cnt is not null)
      group by months,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type
    ) b
  on nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
  and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(b.store_code,'')
  and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(b.sales_channel_type,'')
  and nvl(a.month_id,'')>=nvl(b.months,'')
  and substr(a.month_id,1,4)<=substr(b.months,1,4)+1
 where DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 0 and 29
 group by
   a.month_id
   ,a.quarter
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.ka_name
   ,a.store_code

--季度： 老品新上架标签、老品下架标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_q

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_q as
 select
   a.month_id
   ,a.quarter
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
   ,a.ka_name
   ,a.store_code
   ,a.product_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
   ,a.sales_channel_type
   ,min(if(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.quarter_start,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 1 and 90,'N','Y')) as oldprod_onshelves_flag_qtd -- 老品新上架标签
   ,min(if(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 0 and 89,'N','Y')) as oldprod_offshelves_flag_qtd  -- 老品下架标签
 from( 
   select distinct month_id,quarter_id as quarter,ka_name,store_code,product_barcode,sales_channel_type
   ,month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,quarter_start -- 季初时间
   ,quarter_end   -- 季末时间 
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp_q
   ) a
 left join  (
   select
      months,ka_name,store_code,product_barcode,sales_channel_type,max(bill_date) as bill_date
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
    and (pos_amt_untax is not null or pos_cnt is not null)
    group by months,ka_name,store_code,product_barcode,sales_channel_type
 ) b
 on nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(b.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(b.product_barcode,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(b.sales_channel_type,'')
 and nvl(a.month_id,'')>=nvl(b.months,'')
 and substr(a.month_id,1,4)<=substr(b.months,1,4)+1
 where (DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.quarter_start,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 1 and 90
  or DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 0 and 89
  )
 group by
   a.month_id
   ,a.quarter
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
  ,a.quarter_start -- 季初时间
  ,a.quarter_end   -- 季末时间
  ,a.ka_name
  ,a.store_code
  ,a.product_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
  ,a.sales_channel_type

-- 季度标签加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp04_q

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp04_q as
select
  a.month_id as months        -- 月份
  ,'季'    as date_type     -- 月份/季度/年
  ,a.quarter_id as date_value -- 202401/2024Q1/2024 YTD
  ,a.quarter_start as date_start  -- 期初日期
  ,a.quarter_end   as date_end    -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name       -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name      -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name       -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类
  ,a.first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,a.brand_name               -- 品牌
  ,a.product_line             -- 产品线
  ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name             -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag              -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform             -- O2O平台
  ,a.product_listing_date     -- 上市日期
  ,a.Block_trades_flag        -- 团购/大宗
  ,a.discount_price_level1    -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,a.discount_price_level2    -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,a.newprod_flag             -- 新品标签
  ,a.Sub_new_product_flag     -- 次新品标签
  ,a.Activity_resource_bits   -- 店内活动/资源位
  ,nvl(c.new_store_flag_qtd,'N') as new_store_flag_mtd     -- 新店标签（季度）
  ,nvl(e.close_store_flag_qtd,'Y') as close_store_flag_mtd -- 闭店标签（季度）
  ,nvl(d.oldprod_onshelves_flag_qtd,'Y') as oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd    -- 老品新上架标签（季度）
  ,nvl(d.oldprod_offshelves_flag_qtd,'Y') as oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd  -- 老品下架标签（季度）
  ,nvl(c1.new_store_flag_qtd,'Y') as new_store_flag_mtd_py     -- 去年同期新店标签（季度）
  ,nvl(e1.close_store_flag_qtd,'Y') as close_store_flag_mtd_py -- 去年同期闭店标签（季度）
  ,nvl(d1.oldprod_onshelves_flag_qtd,'Y') as oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd_py    -- 去年同期老品新上架标签（季度）
  ,nvl(d1.oldprod_offshelves_flag_qtd,'Y') as oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd_py  -- 去年同期老品下架标签（季度）
  ,min(t3.store_first_sales_date_m) as store_first_sales_date_m     -- 门店首次动销日期QTD
  ,max(t3.store_recent_sales_date_m) as store_recent_sales_date_m   -- 门店最近动销日期QTD
  ,min(t4.store_prod_first_sales_date_m) as store_prod_first_sales_date_m   -- 门店+产品首次一次动销日期QTD
  ,max(t4.store_prod_recent_sales_date_m) as store_prod_recent_sales_date_m -- 门店+产品最近一次动销日期QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt              ) as pos_cnt          -- pos销量QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax        ) as pos_amt_untax    -- pos实际金额(未税)QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax   ) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax -- RSP POS含税销售额QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_py           ) as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期pos销量QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_py     ) as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期pos实际金额(未税)QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额QTD
  ,cast(null as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pos_amt_untax_lm      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额QTD
  ,cast(null as bigint       ) as pos_cnt_lm            -- 上月同期POS数量QTD
  ,cast(null as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额QTD
from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp_q a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp02_q c1
 on substr(a.month_id,1,4)=substr(c1.month_id,1,4)+1
 and substr(a.month_id,5)=substr(c1.month_id,5)
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(c1.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(c1.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(c1.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp02_q c
 on a.month_id=c.month_id
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(c.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(c.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(c.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_q d
 on a.quarter_id=d.quarter
 and a.month_id=d.month_id
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(d.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(d.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(d.product_barcode,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(d.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_q d1
 on substr(a.quarter_id,1,4)=substr(d1.quarter,1,4)+1
 and substr(a.quarter_id,5)=substr(d1.quarter,5)
 and substr(a.month_id,5,2)=substr(d1.month_id,5,2)
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(d1.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(d1.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(d1.product_barcode,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(d1.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_01_q e
 on a.quarter_id=e.quarter
 and a.month_id=e.month_id
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(e.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(e.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(e.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp03_01_q e1
 on substr(a.quarter_id,1,4)=substr(e1.quarter,1,4)+1
 and substr(a.quarter_id,5)=substr(e1.quarter,5)
 and substr(a.month_id,5,2)=substr(e1.month_id,5,2)
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(e1.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(e1.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(e1.sales_channel_type,'')
left join (
  select
    a.month_id
    ,a.quarter_id
    ,a.ka_name
    ,a.store_code
    ,a.sales_channel_type
    ,min(b.bill_date) as store_first_sales_date_m -- 门店首次动销日期MTD
    ,max(b.bill_date) as store_recent_sales_date_m -- 门店最近动销日期MTD
  from (
    select distinct month_id,month_end,quarter_id,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp_q
    ) a
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka b
   on a.quarter_id=b.quarter
   and nvl(a.month_id,'')>=nvl(b.months,'')
   and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
   and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(b.store_code,'')
   and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(b.sales_channel_type,'')
   and (b.pos_amt_untax is not null or b.pos_cnt is not null)
   and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
   group by a.month_id,a.quarter_id,a.ka_name,a.store_code,a.sales_channel_type
) t3
 on a.quarter_id=t3.quarter_id
 and nvl(a.month_id,'')=nvl(t3.month_id,'')
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(t3.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(t3.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(t3.sales_channel_type,'')
left join (
  select

    ,a.quarter_id
    ,a.ka_name
    ,a.store_code
    ,a.product_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
    ,a.sales_channel_type
    ,min(bill_date) as store_prod_first_sales_date_m  -- 门店+产品首次一次动销日期MTD
    ,max(bill_date) as store_prod_recent_sales_date_m -- 门店+产品最近一次动销日期MTD
  from (
    select distinct month_id,month_end,quarter_id,ka_name,store_code,product_barcode,sales_channel_type
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp_q
    ) a
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka b
   on a.quarter_id=b.quarter
   and nvl(a.month_id,'')>=nvl(b.months,'')
   and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
   and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(b.store_code,'')
   and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(b.product_barcode,'')
   and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(b.sales_channel_type,'')
   and (b.pos_amt_untax is not null or b.pos_cnt is not null)
   and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
   group by a.month_id,a.quarter_id,a.ka_name,a.store_code,a.product_barcode,a.sales_channel_type
) t4
 on a.quarter_id=t4.quarter_id
 and nvl(a.month_id,'')=nvl(t4.month_id,'')
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(t4.ka_name,'')

 and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(t4.product_barcode,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(t4.sales_channel_type,'')  
group by
  a.month_id         -- 月份
  ,a.quarter_id   -- 202401/2024Q1/2024 YTD
  ,a.quarter_start    -- 期初日期
  ,a.quarter_end      -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1

  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称

  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类

-- 季度指标计算
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp05_q

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp05_q as
select
  a.months                    -- 月份
  ,a.date_type      -- 月份/季度/年
  ,a.date_value     -- 202401/2024Q1/2024 YTD
  ,a.date_start  -- 期初日期
  ,a.date_end    -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name       -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name      -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name       -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类
  ,a.first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,a.brand_name               -- 品牌
  ,a.product_line             -- 产品线
  ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name             -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag              -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform             -- O2O平台
  ,a.product_listing_date     -- 上市日期
  ,a.Block_trades_flag        -- 团购/大宗
  
  ,min(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) then a.store_first_sales_date_m end) as new_store_first_sales_date -- 老品新店首次动销日期
  ,min(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_first_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_onshelves_date -- 老品老店新上架日期
  ,max(case when nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_recent_sales_date_m end) as close_store_recent_sales_date -- 闭店老品老店最后一次动销时间
  ,max(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_recent_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date -- 老品下架老品老店最后一次动销时间
 -- ,discount_price           -- 价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level1 end as discount_price_level1    -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level2 end as discount_price_level2    -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax -- 当期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax     -- 当期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax -- 当期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax -- 当期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as newprod_amt_untax_py                 -- 去年同期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_amt_untax_py        -- 去年同期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax_py    -- 去年同期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd_py='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.close_store_flag_mtd_py='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd_py='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd_py='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as newprod_pos_cnt               -- 当期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_pos_cnt      -- 当期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt  -- 当期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end)   as new_store_pos_cnt  -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as close_store_pos_cnt-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as Activity_pos_cnt -- 当期活动POS销量

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as newprod_pos_cnt_py              -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_pos_cnt_py     -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.new_store_flag_mtd_py='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end)   as new_store_pos_cnt_py   -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.close_store_flag_mtd_py='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as close_store_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd_py='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt_py  -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd_py='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(a.new_store_flag_mtd_py,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Activity_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期活动POS销量
  
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax)    as pos_amt_untax        -- POS未税销售额QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt)          as pos_cnt              -- POS数量QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax -- RSP POS含税销售额QTD

  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_lm     ) as pos_amt_untax_ma      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_lm           ) as pos_cnt_ma            -- 上月同期POS数量QTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额QTD
from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp04_q a

-- 年度：新店标签 加工
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp08_y

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp08_y as
select
 year_id
 ,month_id
 ,ka_name
 ,store_code
 ,sales_channel_type
 ,if(year_start<=bill_date_min,'Y','N')    AS new_store_flag_mtd  -- 新店标签（年度）
from(
  select
   a.year_id
   ,a.month_id
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
   ,min(b.bill_date_min) as bill_date_min   -- 近两年首次动销日期
  from(
      select distinct
        year_id
        ,month_id
        ,year_start    -- 年初时间
        ,year_end      -- 年末时间
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp00
  ) a
  left join (
      select
        years
        ,months
        ,ka_name
        ,store_code
        ,sales_channel_type
        ,min(bill_date) as bill_date_min
        ,'1' AS flag
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka
      where (pos_amt_untax is not null or pos_cnt is not null)
      and ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
      group by years,months,ka_name,store_code,sales_channel_type
  ) b
   on a.flag=b.flag
   and b.years between a.year_id-1 and a.year_id
   and a.month_id>=b.months
  group by
   a.year_id
   ,a.month_id
   ,a.year_start    -- 年初时间
   ,a.year_end      -- 年末时间
   ,b.ka_name
   ,b.store_code
   ,b.sales_channel_type
)

select

  ,a.year_start as date_start -- 期初日期
  ,a.year_end   as date_end   -- 期末日期
  ,a.BU_1                     -- BU_1
  ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,a.first_channel_name       -- KA一级渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name      -- KA二级渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name       -- KA三级渠道
  ,a.distributor_region_name  -- 零售商区域
  ,a.henkel_region            -- 汉高区域
  ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,a.store_name               -- 门店名称
  ,a.category_name            -- 品类
  ,a.first_product_function   -- 一级子品类
  ,a.brand_name               -- 品牌
  ,a.product_line             -- 产品线
  ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name             -- 产品名称
  ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,a.Domain_flag              -- O2O公域/私域
  ,a.o2o_platform             -- O2O平台
  ,a.product_listing_date     -- 上市日期
  ,a.Block_trades_flag        -- 团购/大宗  
  
  ,min(case when c.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) then a.store_first_sales_date_m end) as new_store_first_sales_date -- 老品新店首次动销日期
  ,min(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(d.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_first_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_onshelves_date -- 老品老店新上架日期
  ,max(case when nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(e.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_recent_sales_date_m end) as close_store_recent_sales_date -- 闭店老品老店最后一次动销时间
  ,max(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null) and nvl(d.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.store_prod_recent_sales_date_m end) as oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date -- 老品下架老品老店最后一次动销时间
 -- ,discount_price           -- 价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level1 end as discount_price_level1    -- 一级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' then a.discount_price_level2 end as discount_price_level2    -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax -- 当期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax     -- 当期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax -- 当期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when c.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(e.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax -- 当期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as newprod_amt_untax_py                 -- 去年同期新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_amt_untax_py        -- 去年同期老品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Sub_newprod_amt_untax_py    -- 去年同期次新品POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when c1.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(e1.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d1.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y'  then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d1.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_amt_untax_py end) as Activity_pos_amt_untax_py -- 去年同期活动POS未税销售额

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as newprod_pos_cnt               -- 当期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_pos_cnt      -- 当期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt  -- 当期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when c.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt end)   as new_store_pos_cnt  -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(e.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as close_store_pos_cnt-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt end) as Activity_pos_cnt -- 当期活动POS销量

  ,sum(case when a.newprod_flag='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as newprod_pos_cnt_py              -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_pos_cnt_py     -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  ,sum(case when a.Sub_new_product_flag='Y'  then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期次新品POS数量
  ,sum(case when c1.new_store_flag_mtd='Y' and nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end)   as new_store_pos_cnt_py   -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(e1.close_store_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as close_store_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d1.oldprod_onshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt_py  -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and nvl(d1.oldprod_offshelves_flag_mtd,'Y')='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,sum(case when nvl(a.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(c1.new_store_flag_mtd,'')<>'Y' and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y' then a.pos_cnt_py end) as Activity_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期活动POS销量
  
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax)    as pos_amt_untax        -- POS未税销售额YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt)          as pos_cnt              -- POS数量YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax -- RSP POS含税销售额YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_py  ) as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期POS未税销售额YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_py        ) as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期POS数量YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax_lm     ) as pos_amt_untax_ma      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_cnt_lm           ) as pos_cnt_ma            -- 上月同期POS数量YTD
  ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额YTD

 and a.month_id=c.month_id
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(c.ka_name,'')
 and nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(c.store_code,'')
 and nvl(a.sales_channel_type,'')=nvl(c.sales_channel_type,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp08_y c1
 on a.date_value=c1.year_id+1
 and substr(a.month_id,5,2)=substr(c1.month_id,5,2)
 and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(c1.ka_name,'')

  ,cast(a.close_store_pos_cnt        as bigint) as close_store_pos_cnt         -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt  as bigint) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt as bigint) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt  -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.Activity_pos_cnt           as bigint) as Activity_pos_cnt            -- 当期活动POS销量

  ,cast(a.newprod_pos_cnt_py            as bigint) as newprod_pos_cnt_py            -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  ,cast(a.oldprod_pos_cnt_py            as bigint) as oldprod_pos_cnt_py            -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  ,cast(a.Sub_newprod_pos_cnt_py        as bigint) as Sub_newprod_pos_cnt_py        -- 去年同期次新品POS数量
  ,cast(a.new_store_pos_cnt_py          as bigint) as new_store_pos_cnt_py          -- 去年同期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.close_store_pos_cnt_py        as bigint) as close_store_pos_cnt_py        -- 去年同期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt_py  as bigint) as oldprod_onshelves_pos_cnt_py  -- 去年同期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt_py as bigint) as oldprod_offshelves_pos_cnt_py -- 去年同期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  ,cast(a.Activity_pos_cnt_py           as bigint) as Activity_pos_cnt_py           -- 去年同期活动POS销量
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_untax          as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_untax               -- POS未税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_cnt                as bigint       ) as pos_cnt                     -- POS数量(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax     as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax          -- RSP POS含税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_untax_py       as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_untax_py            -- 去年同期POS未税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_cnt_py             as bigint       ) as pos_cnt_py                  -- 去年同期POS数量(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py  as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py       -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_untax_ma       as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_untax_ma            -- 上月同期POS未税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_cnt_ma             as bigint       ) as pos_cnt_ma                  -- 上月同期POS数量(MTD/QTD/YTD)
  ,cast(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma  as decimal(28,6)) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma       -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额(MTD/QTD/YTD)
from (
  select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp01_m
  union all
  select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp05_q
  union all
  select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_index_nka_temp10_y
) a
where a.months<=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
and  a.months>='202301'
and (a.pos_amt_untax is not null or a.pos_cnt is not null or a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax is not null 
   or a.pos_amt_untax_py is not null or a.pos_cnt_py is not null or a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py is not null
   or a.pos_amt_untax_ma is not null or a.pos_cnt_ma is not null or a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax_ma is not null
 )

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp00

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp00 as
select b.store_code,b.product_barcode,b.activity_fee_3,a.day_id
from ( 
    select day_id,'1' as flag
    from dme_cdm.dim_day
    where month_id >='202001' and month_id <=substr('${bizdate}',1,6)
    group by day_id
 ) a
 inner join (
   SELECT  
       store_code,product_barcode,activity_start_date,activity_end_date
       ,activity_fee_3,'1' as flag
   FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail
   where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_tpm_activity_detail')
   AND flag_status is not null
   AND activity_channel IN ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
   AND activity_type_name='批复表'
   AND activity_fee_1='L6b'
   AND ((activity_fee_2='KA Expense' AND activity_fee_3='Standee(合同内)')
     OR activity_fee_2='Promotion activities' AND activity_fee_3 IN ('海报_线下','地堆','陈列费（麦德龙）','海报_线上','促销端架' )
    )
   GROUP BY store_code,product_barcode,activity_start_date,activity_end_date,activity_fee_3
) b
on a.flag=b.flag
and a.day_id between b.activity_start_date and b.activity_end_date
group by b.store_code,b.product_barcode,b.activity_fee_3,a.day_id

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp01 as
select
  months -- 销售月份
  ,BU_2                     -- BU_2
  ,ka_name                  -- KA名称
  ,store_code               -- 门店编码
  ,product_barcode          -- 产品条码
  ,sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
  ,expense_account
  ,sum(pos_amt_untax_py ) as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期POS未税销售额MTD
  ,sum(pos_cnt_py       ) as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期POS数量MTD
  ,sum(pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
  ,sum(pos_amt_untax_lm     ) as pos_amt_untax_lm      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额MTD
  ,sum(pos_cnt_lm           ) as pos_cnt_lm            -- 上月同期POS数量MTD
  ,sum(pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
from(
  select
     to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') as months -- 销售月份
     ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
     ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
     ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
     ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
     ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
     ,t5.activity_fee_3 as expense_account
     ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax  ) as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期POS未税销售额MTD
     ,sum(a.pos_cnt        ) as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期POS数量MTD
     ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
     ,null as pos_amt_untax_lm      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额MTD
     ,null as pos_cnt_lm            -- 上月同期POS数量MTD
     ,null as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka a
  left join (    
       select  distinct d.time_now as time_yoy,dd.time_now,b.mapping_time
         from  
         (   select time_yoy,time_now,mapping_time
                ,dense_rank() over(partition by time_yoy order by time_now asc) as  rn 
           from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
            where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and b.time_type = 'C.月' 
         )b
         left join 
         (
           select  time_now,mapping_time
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
            where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and b.time_type = 'D.周'
         )c
         on b.time_yoy=c.time_now
         left join 
         (
           select  time_now,mapping_time
                  ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
            where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and b.time_type = 'D.周'
         )d
          on c.mapping_time=d.mapping_time
         and d.rn = 1
         left join 
         (
           select  time_now,mapping_time
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
            where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and b.time_type = 'D.周'
         )cc
         on b.time_now=cc.time_now
         left join 
         (
           select  time_now,mapping_time
                  ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
            from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
            where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
            and b.time_type = 'D.周'
         )dd
          on cc.mapping_time=dd.mapping_time
         and dd.rn = 1
         where b.rn = 1 
    )b
    on concat(a.bill_date,'a')=b.time_yoy
    and a.ka_name regexp '屈臣氏'
  inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp00 t5
   on nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(t5.store_code,'')
   and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(t5.product_barcode,'')
   and case when  a.ka_name regexp '屈臣氏' and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm') >= '202301' and b.time_yoy <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
         else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+12)),'yyyymmdd') end= t5.day_id    
  where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
  and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y'        -- 店内活动/资源位
  group by to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+12)),'yyyymm')
     ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
     ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
     ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
     ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
     ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
     ,t5.activity_fee_3
   -- 上月值
  union all
  select
     to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') as months                    -- 月份
     ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
     ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
     ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
     ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
     ,a.sales_channel_type       -- 销售渠道
     ,t5.activity_fee_3 as expense_account
     ,null as pos_amt_untax_py   -- 去年同期POS未税销售额MTD
     ,null as pos_cnt_py         -- 去年同期POS数量MTD
     ,null as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_py -- 去年同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
     ,sum(a.pos_amt_untax     ) as pos_amt_untax_lm      -- 上月同期POS未税销售额MTD
     ,sum(a.pos_cnt           ) as pos_cnt_lm            -- 上月同期POS数量MTD
     ,sum(a.pos_amt_rsp_inctax) as pos_amt_rsp_inctax_lm -- 上月同期RSP POS含税销售额MTD
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka a      
  left join( 
    select  distinct d.time_now as time_mom,dd.time_now,b.mapping_time
    from  
       (   select time_mom,time_now,mapping_time
              ,dense_rank() over(partition by time_mom order by time_now asc) as  rn 
         from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
          where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
          and b.time_type = 'C.月' 
       )b
       left join 
       (
         select  time_now,mapping_time
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
          where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
          and b.time_type = 'D.周'
       )c
       on b.time_mom=c.time_now
       left join 
       (
         select  time_now,mapping_time
                ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
          where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
          and b.time_type = 'D.周'
       )d
        on c.mapping_time=d.mapping_time
       and d.rn = 1
       left join 
       (
         select  time_now,mapping_time
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
          where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
          and b.time_type = 'D.周'
       )cc
       on b.time_now=cc.time_now
       left join 
       (
         select  time_now,mapping_time
                ,dense_rank() over(partition by mapping_time order by time_now desc) as  rn 
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df b
          where   b.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
          and b.time_type = 'D.周'
       )dd
        on cc.mapping_time=dd.mapping_time
       and dd.rn = 1
       where b.rn = 1   
  )b
   on concat(a.bill_date,'a')=b.time_mom
   and a.ka_name regexp '屈臣氏' 
  inner join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_activity_nka_temp00 t5
   on nvl(a.store_code,'')=nvl(t5.store_code,'')
   and nvl(a.product_barcode,'')=nvl(t5.product_barcode,'')
   and case when a.ka_name regexp '屈臣氏' and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm') >= '202202' and b.time_mom <> '20220102a' then substr(b.time_now,1,8)
         else to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyymmdd'),+1)),'yyyymmdd') end= t5.day_id    
  where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_pos_sale_summary_nka')
  and a.Activity_resource_bits='Y'        -- 店内活动/资源位
  group by to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),+1)),'yyyymm')  -- 月份
     ,a.BU_2                     -- BU_2
     ,a.ka_name                  -- KA名称
     ,a.store_code               -- 门店编码
     ,a.product_barcode          -- 产品条码
     ,a.sales_channel_type,t5.activity_fee_3
)
group by 
    months -- 销售月份
    ,BU_2                     -- BU_2

    ,store_code               -- 门店编码
    ,product_barcode          -- 产品条码

-- 20250623   mass     替换ke24表，任务调整成30分钟批次，其中只新增23:30批次任务更新任务

-- 20260330	mass  调整CRV的客户编码取值逻辑（含CRV-W客户）

--算出每一期的当期值
insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_sales_report_2c_data partition (ds)
   
select 
    t1.period                    as  period                       --统计日期
   ,t1.period_month              as  period_month                 --统计月
   ,nvl(t1.customer_code ,'Others')        as  customer_code                --客户代码
   ,nvl(t1.customer_name ,'Others')        as  customer_name                --客户名
   ,nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest  ,'Others')        as  first_channel_name           --一级渠道名
   ,nvl(t1.second_channel_name_lastest ,'Others')                as  second_channel_name          --二级渠道名
   ,t1.status                   as  status                       --订单状态细分编码
   ,t4.partner_status           as  partner_status               --订单状态
   ,t4.sub_status               as  sub_status                   --订单子状态
   ,case when  t4.sub_status = '1. Frozen Orders' then '1. Frozen Orders' 
         when  t4.sub_status IN ('2a. Finance Released- To be picked','2b. Finance Released- To be delivered')  then '2. Finance Released - TO BE Good Issued'  
         when  t4.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then '3. Order Finalized & Goods Issued'  end       as  custom_status                   --自定义订单状态
   ,cast(case when t4.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then t1.net_value else NULL  end    as decimal(28,6))                                            as  c_released_orders              --已送达订单净销额
   ,t1.bu_1 as bu_1
   ,t1.bu_2 as bu_2
   ,case when t4.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then t1.order_qty else NULL  end                                               as c_released_order_qty                --已送达订单净销量
   ,t1.is_fg
   ,cast(case when t4.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then t1.ges else NULL  end  as decimal(28,6))         as  ges_2c_released_orders              --已送达订单净销额  
   ,case when t4.sub_status = '2c. Finance Released- Delivered' then t1.order_qty_box  else NULL  end                                               as c_released_order_qty_box                --已送达订单净销量
   ,if(substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330')
       ,'${bizdate}',null) as ds

from (

      SELECT
           t.period_month  
          ,t.period
          ,t1.*
      from(
            select distinct
                day_id as  period
               ,month_id  as  period_month
           from dme_cdm.dim_day
               where day_id >= '20240701'
                 and day_id <= '${bizdate1}'
      )t
      inner join (
         SELECT
               customer_id                                                                                                      as  customer_code
              ,customer_name                                                                                                    as  customer_name
              ,first_channel_name                                                                                               as  first_channel_name
              ,case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')   then second_channel_name                          
                         when first_channel_name in ('MPD','DT') then henkel_region_en                                           
                         when first_channel_name in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')   then  first_channel_name                               
                         else 'Others' end                                                                                      as  second_channel_name
              ,'8'   as  status
              ,sum(cast(if(upper(t1.billing_type) in ('ZXRE','ZARE'),-1,1)*quantity_consumer_units  as  bigint) )                                                                  as  order_qty
              ,cast(sum(cast(if(upper(t1.billing_type) in ('ZXRE','ZARE'),-1,1)*quantity_consumer_units as  bigint)/cast(COALESCE(t6.box_size,1) as  bigint)  ) as  bigint )       as  order_qty_box
              ,sum(cast(sku_ngs_amt  as  decimal(38,10))     )                                                                  as  net_value
              ,sum(cast(ges as  decimal(28,6))               )                                                                  as  ges
              ,first_channel_name_lastest                                                                                       as  first_channel_name_lastest
              ,case when first_channel_name_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')   then customer_group_en_lv1           
                         when first_channel_name_lastest in ('MPD','DT') then henkel_region_en                                   
                         when first_channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')   then  first_channel_name_lastest               
                         else 'Others' end                                                                                      as  second_channel_name_lastest
               ,case when nvl(ppd_free_goods,0) <> 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end                                                      as  is_fg        
              ,t1.bu_1                                                                                                             as  bu_1
              ,t1.bu_2                                                                                                             as  bu_2  
              ,to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd') AS ds              
         from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu_mid t1
         left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu t6
           on t1.product_id=t6.product_code
           and t6.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
         where t1.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu_mid')
          and to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')>= '20240701'
         group by   customer_id                                                                                                 
              ,customer_name                                                                                                    
              ,first_channel_name                                                                                               
              ,case when first_channel_name in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')   then second_channel_name                          
                         when first_channel_name in ('MPD','DT') then henkel_region_en                                          
                         when first_channel_name in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')   then  first_channel_name                              
                         else 'Others' end                                                                                      
              ,first_channel_name_lastest                                                                                       
              ,case when first_channel_name_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')   then customer_group_en_lv1          
                         when first_channel_name_lastest in ('MPD','DT') then henkel_region_en                                  
                         when first_channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom','B2B&LKA')   then  first_channel_name_lastest              
                         else 'Others' end                                                                                      
               ,case when nvl(ppd_free_goods,0) <> 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end                                                      
               ,t1.bu_1                                                                                                          
              ,t1.bu_2                                                                                                           
             ,to_char(to_date(substr(t1.posting_date,1,10),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')                                                                                                               
      )t1                                                                                                                       
      on t.period_month = substr(t1.ds,1,6)
      and t.period >= t1.ds
   --  left join 
   --  (
   --      SELECT
   --            period
   --      from
   --          ${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info
   --      where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_data_source_cs_sell_in_info')
   --      group by
   --            period
   --  )t3
   --  and t.period = t3.period
)t1
left join (
        SELECT
             status_code                         
            ,partner_status
            ,sub_status
        from
            ${dme_ods}.s_cs_sell_in_order_status_mapping
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_cs_sell_in_order_status_mapping')
        group by
             status_code                         
            ,partner_status
            ,sub_status
)t4
on  t1.status  = t4.status_code
where substr('${etl_time}',9,4) in ('1100','1200','1300','1400','1500','1600','1700','1800','1900','2000','2100','2200','2300','2330') -- 新增23:30批次更新数据
