INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_activity_type PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  shop_id
        ,shop_name
        ,day_id AS dt_date
        ,activity_type
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-12,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_yoy --去年同期
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-3,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_qoq --季度环比
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_mom --月度环比
        ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(day_id,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'dd'),'yyyymmdd') AS dt_dod --日度环比
FROM    (
            SELECT  t.shop_id
                    ,t.shop_name
                    ,t.activity_type
                    ,t1.day_id
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  shop_id --店铺ID
                                ,shop_name --店铺名称
                                ,start_date --活动开始时间
                                ,end_date --活动结束时间
                                ,activity_type --活动类型
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_tm_activity_type
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_tm_activity_type')
                        and nvl(shop_id,'') not in ('SHN00019')
                    ) t
            JOIN    (
                        SELECT  '1' AS flag
                                ,day_id
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                    ) t1
            ON      t.flag = t1.flag
            AND     t1.day_id >= t.start_date
            AND     t1.day_id <= t.end_date
            GROUP BY t.shop_id
                     ,t.shop_name
                     ,t.start_date
                     ,t.end_date
                     ,t.activity_type
                     ,t1.day_id
        ) o

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_launch_daily_report PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  SUBSTR(stat_date,1,4) AS data_year
        ,CONCAT(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(stat_date,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) AS data_quarter
        ,SUBSTR(stat_date,1,6) AS data_month
        ,stat_date AS data_date
        ,shop_id
        ,shop_name
        ,NULL AS bu_1
        ,NULL AS bu_2
        ,NULL AS category_name
        ,NULL AS product_function
        ,NULL AS sub_product_function
        ,NULL AS brand_name
        ,NULL AS product_line_name
        ,NULL AS sku
        ,NULL AS product_barcode
        ,first_channel_name
        ,second_channel_name
        ,CAST(sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS sales_amount
        ,CAST(cost AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS cost
        ,CAST(impressions AS BIGINT) AS impressions
        ,CAST(clicks AS BIGINT) AS clicks
        ,CAST(orders AS BIGINT) AS orders
FROM    (
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,stat_date
                    ,gmv AS sales_amount
                    ,NULL AS cost
                    ,impressions
                    ,clicks
                    ,sale_orders AS orders
                    ,first_channel_name
                    ,second_channel_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_brandzone
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_brandzone')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,stat_date
                    ,total_sale_amount AS sales_amount
                    ,cost
                    ,impressions
                    ,clicks
                    ,total_sale_orders AS orders
                    ,NULL AS first_channel_name
                    ,NULL AS second_channel_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_tms
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_tms')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,stat_date
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_除猫超_淘宝客' THEN settle_amount
                            WHEN data_source = '丽人投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN transaction_amount
                            WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN pay_amount
                    END AS sales_amount
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_除猫超_淘宝客' THEN settle_total_cost
                            WHEN data_source = '丽人投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN estimated_commission + estimated_service_fee
                            WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN tk_total_investment
                    END AS cost
                    ,NULL AS impressions
                    ,clicks
                    ,CASE   WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_除猫超_淘宝客' THEN settle_orders
                            WHEN data_source = '丽人投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN transaction_count
                            WHEN data_source = '鲲驰投放数据模板_猫超_淘宝客' THEN NULL
                    END AS orders
                    ,first_channel_name
                    ,second_channel_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_tbk
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_tbk')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,stat_date
                    ,total_sale_amount AS sales_amount
                    ,cost
                    ,impressions
                    ,clicks
                    ,total_sale_orders AS orders
                    ,first_channel_name
                    ,second_channel_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_scene_ex_tms
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_launch_scene_ex_tms')
            AND     first_channel_name IS NOT NULL
            union all 
            --丽人非猫超淘宝客
            SELECT  shop_id
                    ,shop_name
                    ,stat_date
                    ,pay_amount AS sales_amount
                    ,cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as cost
                    ,cast(null as bigint) as impressions
                    ,cast(visitors as bigint) as clicks
                    ,cast(null as bigint) as orders
                    ,original_second_channel_name as first_channel_name
                    ,original_third_channel_name as second_channel_name
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_store_traffic_ex_tms
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_store_traffic_ex_tms')
            AND     original_third_channel_name='淘宝客'
            and nvl(shop_id_tp,'') <>'446'
            and ec='e001'

        ) t
    where to_date(stat_date,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    and nvl(shop_id,'') not in ('SHN00019')

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_store_order_sales_analysis PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  SUBSTR(o.stat_date,1,4) AS data_year
        ,CONCAT(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(o.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(o.stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) AS data_quarter
        ,SUBSTR(o.stat_date,1,6) AS data_month
        ,o.stat_date AS data_date
        ,o.shop_id
        ,o.shop_name AS shop_name
        ,o.bu_1 AS bu_1
        ,o.bu_2 AS bu_2
        ,NVL(m.category_name,'Others') AS category_name
        ,NVL(m.product_function,'Others') AS product_function
        ,NVL(m.sub_product_function,'Others') AS sub_product_function
        ,NVL(m.brand_name,'Others') AS brand_name
        ,NVL(m.product_line,'Others') AS product_line_name
        ,NVL(n.key_product_line_name,'Others') AS key_product_line_name
        ,NVL(n.sub_key_product_line_name,'Others') AS sub_key_product_line_name
        ,CONCAT(NVL(m.product_name,'Others'),'-',o.product_barcode) AS sku
        ,o.product_barcode
        ,NVL(m.product_name,'Others') AS product_name
        ,CAST(sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS sales_amount
        ,CAST(rsp_sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp_sales_amount
        ,CAST(refund_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount
        ,CAST(offtake_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS offtake_amount
FROM    (
            --正单
            SELECT  COALESCE(t.ds,t1.ds) AS stat_date
                    ,COALESCE(t.shop_id,t1.shop_id) AS shop_id
                    ,COALESCE(t.henkel_item_barcode,t1.henkel_item_barcode) AS product_barcode
                    ,COALESCE(t.sales_amount,0) AS sales_amount
                    ,COALESCE(t.rsp_sales_amount,0) AS rsp_sales_amount
                    ,COALESCE(t1.refund_amount,0) AS refund_amount
                    ,COALESCE(t.sales_amount,0) - COALESCE(t1.refund_amount,0) AS offtake_amount
                    ,COALESCE(t.bu_1,t1.bu_1) AS bu_1
                    ,COALESCE(t.bu_2,t1.bu_2) AS bu_2
                    ,COALESCE(t.shop_name,t1.shop_name) AS shop_name
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  ds
                                ,shop_id
                                ,SUM(payment_actual) AS sales_amount
                                ,SUM(retail_tax_amt) AS rsp_sales_amount
                                ,NVL(henkel_item_barcode,'-110') AS henkel_item_barcode
                                ,bu_1
                                ,bu_2
                                ,shop_name
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                        WHERE   ds >='20230101'
                        -- AND     shop_id_tp IN ('14','765276150','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
                        AND     shop_id_tp IN ('14','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
                        GROUP BY ds
                                 ,shop_id
                                 ,NVL(henkel_item_barcode,'-110')
                                 ,bu_1
                                ,bu_2
                                ,shop_name
                    ) t --退单
            FULL JOIN   (
                            SELECT  ds
                                    ,shop_id
                                    ,SUM(return_amt) AS refund_amount
                                    ,NVL(henkel_product_barcode,'-110') AS henkel_item_barcode
                                    ,bu_1
                                    ,bu_2
                                    ,shop_name
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu
                            WHERE    ds >='20230101'
                            -- AND     shop_id_tp IN ('14','765276150','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
                            AND     shop_id_tp IN ('14','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
                            GROUP BY ds
                                     ,shop_id
                                     ,NVL(henkel_product_barcode,'-110')
                                     ,bu_1
                                    ,bu_2
                                    ,shop_name
                        ) t1
            ON      t.ds = t1.ds
            AND     t.shop_id = t1.shop_id
            AND     t.henkel_item_barcode = t1.henkel_item_barcode
            AND     t.bu_1 = t1.bu_1
            AND     t.bu_2 = t1.bu_2
            AND     t.shop_name = t1.shop_name
        ) o
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,product_name
                        ,category_name
                        ,product_function
                        ,sub_product_function
                        ,brand_name
                        ,brand_name_en
                        ,product_line
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
            ) m
ON      o.product_barcode = m.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  bu_2
                        ,category_name
                        ,brand_name_en
                        ,product_line
                        ,sub_product_function
                        ,key_product_line_name
                        ,sub_key_product_line_name
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_key_product_line_mapping
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_key_product_line_mapping')
            ) n
ON      m.bu_2=n.bu_2 
AND     m.category_name = n.category_name
AND     m.brand_name_en = n.brand_name_en
AND     m.product_line = n.product_line
AND     m.sub_product_function = n.sub_product_function
where length(o.stat_date)=8 and (sales_amount<>0 or rsp_sales_amount<>0 or refund_amount<>0)

        ,CONCAT(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(stat_date,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyy'),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(stat_date,'yyyymmdd'))) AS data_quarter

        ,NULL AS bu_2

        ,NULL AS product_function
        ,NULL AS sub_product_function
        ,NULL AS brand_name
        ,NULL AS product_line_name
        ,NULL AS sku
        ,NULL AS product_barcode
        ,CAST(sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS sales_amount
        ,CAST(t.pay_quantity * t2.retail_price_tax AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp_sales_amount
        ,CAST(refund_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount
        ,CAST(offtake_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS offtake_amount
        ,CAST(visitors AS BIGINT) AS visitors
        ,CAST(pay_peoples AS BIGINT) AS pay_peoples
        ,CAST(pv AS BIGINT) AS pv
        ,CAST(cart_users AS BIGINT) AS cart_users
        ,CAST(cart_quantity AS BIGINT) AS cart_quantity
        ,CAST(favor_peoples AS BIGINT) AS favor_peoples
FROM    (
            select shop_id,
                   shop_name,
                   item_id as plat_product_id,
                   item_name as plat_product_name,
                   stat_date,
                   pay_amount as sales_amount,
                   case when shop_id_tp='446' then initiate_refund_amount
                        else  refund_success_amount end as refund_amount,
                   pay_amount-(case when shop_id_tp='446' then initiate_refund_amount else  refund_success_amount end) AS offtake_amount,
                   pay_quantity,
                   visitors as visitors,
                   pay_users as pay_peoples,
                   pv as pv,
                   cart_users,
                   cart_quantity,
                   favor_users AS favor_peoples
             from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_store_spu_traded
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_tm_store_spu_traded')
            and to_date(stat_date,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
            and nvl(shop_id,'') not in ('SHN00019')
)t

SELECT  product_id
        ,shop_id
        ,tags
        ,data_month
        ,sum(retail_price_tax) as retail_price_tax
FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping
WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping')
group by product_id
        ,shop_id
        ,tags
        ,data_month
) t2 on t.shop_id=t2.shop_id

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01 as
SELECT 
    dt_date,
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    order_no,
    henkel_item_barcode,
    product_name,
    sku,
    category_name,
    product_function,
    sub_product_function,
    brand_name,
    product_line,
    quantity,
    if(qty_all>1 or sku_num>1,'组合','单品') as prod_type,
    count(distinct order_no) over(partition by dt_date,shop_id) as order_num_all
from (
    select
        a.dt_date,
        a.shop_id,
        a.shop_name,
        a.bu_1,
        a.bu_2,
        a.order_no,
        a.henkel_item_barcode,
        nvl(b.product_name,'Others') as product_name,
        concat(nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),'-',a.henkel_item_barcode) as sku,
        nvl(b.category_name,'Others') as category_name,
        nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as product_function,
        nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function,
        nvl(b.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,
        nvl(b.product_line,'Others') as product_line,
        a.quantity,
        count(distinct a.henkel_item_barcode) over(partition by order_no) as sku_num,
        sum(distinct a.quantity) over(partition by order_no) as qty_all
    from (
        SELECT 
            ds as dt_date,
            shop_id,
            shop_name,
            bu_1,
            bu_2,
            order_no,
            henkel_item_barcode,
            sum(quantity) as quantity
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu 
        where ds>='20230101'
        -- and shop_id_tp in ('14','765276150','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
        and shop_id_tp in ('14','442','0','601','525','101','446','602','30163423','30197948','30163422')
        and order_no is not null
        group by 
            ds,
            shop_id,
            shop_name,
            bu_1,
            bu_2,
            order_no,
            henkel_item_barcode
    ) a
    left join (
        select
            product_barcode,
            product_name,
            category_name,
            product_function,  
            sub_product_function ,
            brand_name,
            product_line
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
    ) b
    on a.henkel_item_barcode=b.product_barcode
) a
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_02

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_02 as
SELECT 
    order_no,
    sku_group,
    if(category_group not like '%+%',concat(category_group,'组合'),category_group) as category_group,
    if(product_line_group not like '%+%',concat(product_line_group,'组合'),product_line_group) as product_line_group
from (
    SELECT 
        order_no,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(sku_group))) as sku_group,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(category_name))) as category_group,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(product_line))) as product_line_group
    from (
        select 
            order_no,
            product_name,
            quantity,
            category_name,
            product_line,
            concat_ws('*',product_name,quantity) as sku_group
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01
        where prod_type='组合'
    ) a 
    group by order_no
) a

        ,COALESCE(o.product_line,m.product_line_name) AS product_line_name
        ,COALESCE(o.key_product_line_name,m.key_product_line_name) AS key_product_line_name
        ,COALESCE(o.sub_key_product_line_name,m.sub_key_product_line_name) AS sub_key_product_line_name
        ,COALESCE(o.sku,m.sku) AS sku
        ,COALESCE(o.product_barcode,m.product_barcode) AS product_barcode
        ,COALESCE(o.product_name,m.product_name) AS product_name
        ,CAST(m.sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS sales_amount
        ,CAST(m.rsp_sales_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS rsp_sales_amount
        ,CAST(m.refund_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS refund_amount
        ,CAST(m.offtake_amount AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS offtake_amount
        ,visitors
        ,pay_peoples
        ,pv
        ,cart_users
        ,cart_quantity
        ,favor_peoples
        ,'商品粒度' AS data_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  t.data_year
                    ,t.data_quarter
                    ,t.data_month
                    ,t.data_date
                    ,t.shop_id
                    ,t.shop_name
                    ,nvl(t1.product_barcode,'-110') as product_barcode
                    ,nvl(t1.bu_1,'Consumer') as bu_1
                    ,nvl(t1.bu_2,'Beauty Care') as bu_2
                    ,nvl(t1.category_name,'Others') as category_name
                    ,nvl(t1.product_function,'Others') as product_function
                    ,nvl(t1.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function
                    ,nvl(t1.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name
                    ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others') as product_line
                    ,nvl(t1.key_product_line_name,'Others') as key_product_line_name
                    ,nvl(t1.sub_key_product_line_name,'Others') as sub_key_product_line_name
                    ,nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') as product_name
                    ,CONCAT(nvl(t1.product_name,'Others'),'-',nvl(t1.product_barcode,'-110')) AS sku
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.visitors * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS visitors
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.pay_peoples * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS pay_peoples
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.pv * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS pv
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.cart_users * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS cart_users
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.cart_quantity * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS cart_quantity
                    ,CAST(round(SUM(t.favor_peoples * nvl(t1.payment_amount_rate,1))) AS BIGINT) AS favor_peoples
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  data_year
                                ,data_quarter
                                ,data_month
                                ,data_date
                                ,shop_id
                                ,shop_name
                                ,plat_product_id
                                ,visitors
                                ,pay_peoples
                                ,pv
                                ,cart_users
                                ,cart_quantity
                                ,favor_peoples
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_store_paltform_sales_detail
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_store_paltform_sales_detail')
                    ) t
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  *
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dim_ec_tm_product_mapping')
                        ) t1
            ON      t.data_month = t1.data_month
            AND     t.shop_id = t1.shop_id
            AND     t.plat_product_id = t1.product_id
            GROUP BY t.data_year
                     ,t.data_quarter
                     ,t.data_month
                     ,t.data_date
                     ,t.shop_id
                     ,t.shop_name
                    ,nvl(t1.product_barcode,'-110')
                    ,nvl(t1.bu_1,'Consumer')
                    ,nvl(t1.bu_2,'Beauty Care')
                    ,nvl(t1.category_name,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.product_function,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.sub_product_function,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.brand_name,'Others') 
                    ,nvl(t1.product_line,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.key_product_line_name,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.sub_key_product_line_name,'Others')
                    ,nvl(t1.product_name,'Others') 
        ) o
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  *
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_store_order_sales_analysis
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_tm_store_order_sales_analysis')
            ) m
ON      o.data_date = m.data_date
AND     o.shop_id = m.shop_id
AND     o.product_barcode = m.product_barcode

        ,cast(nvl(t.visitors,t1.visitors)as bigint) as visitors

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3_temp01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3_temp01 as 
SELECT  month
        ,customer_idh_snapshot
        ,is_not_py
        ,customer_type
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,SUM(ges) AS ges
        ,SUM(ngs) AS ngs
        ,SUM(nes) AS nes
        ,SUM(ttl_l6) AS ttl_l6
        ,SUM(l6a) AS l6a
        ,SUM(ppd) AS ppd
        ,SUM(pld) AS pld
        ,SUM(fg) AS fg
        ,SUM(l6a_others) AS l6a_others
        ,SUM(l6_b_w_ror) AS l6b
        ,SUM(ca) AS ca
        ,SUM(rebate) AS rebate
        ,SUM(ka_expense) AS ka_expense
        ,SUM(listing_fee) AS listing_fee
        ,SUM(promotion_activistes) AS promotion_activistes
        ,SUM(logistics_fee) AS logistics_fee
        ,SUM(oos) AS oos
        ,SUM(int_agreement) AS int_agreement
        ,SUM(l6b_py_release) AS l6b_py_release
        ,SUM(deduction) AS deduction
        ,SUM(ror) AS ror
        ,SUM(l6b_others) AS l6b_others
        ,SUM(l10_service_fee) AS l10_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release) AS l17_channel
        ,sum(l17_o2o) as l17_o2o
        ,sum(l17_ba) as l17_ba
        ,sum(l17_channel_specific) as l17_channel_specific
        ,SUM(l17_py_release) AS l17_py_release
        ,SUM(l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion
        ,SUM(l17_live_streaming) AS l17_live_streaming
        ,SUM(l17_customer_service_fee) AS l17_customer_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_instore_self_broadcast) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast
        ,SUM(l17_crm_operation_service_fee) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_content_purchase_and_production) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production
        ,SUM(l17_data_service_fee) AS l17_data_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_gift_items) AS l17_gift_items
        ,SUM(l17_others) AS l17_others
        ,SUM(l17_not_allocated) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,SUM(gp1) AS gp1
        ,SUM(gp1 - (l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release)) AS channel_gp2 --GP1 - L17 Channel
        ,SUM(ttl_l17 - (l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release)) AS l17_allocated
        ,SUM(ttl_l17) AS ttl_l17
        ,SUM(gp2) AS gp2
        ,SUM(l10) AS l10
        ,SUM(l11) AS l11
        ,SUM(l14_cog) AS l14_cog
        ,SUM(l16) AS l16
        ,SUM(c1) AS c1
        ,sum(internal_sales) as internal_sales
        ,sum(nts) as nts
        ,'Profitability' as data_source
FROM    (
            SELECT   month
                    ,nvl(t2.customer_group_en_lv1,t1.customer_idh_snapshot)  AS  customer_idh_snapshot
                    ,customer_type
                    ,is_not_py
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ges' THEN index_value END) AS ges
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ngs' THEN index_value END) AS ngs
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'nes' THEN index_value END) AS nes
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_total' THEN index_value END) AS ttl_l6
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_a' THEN index_value END) AS l6a
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ppd' THEN index_value END) AS ppd
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'pld' THEN index_value END) AS pld
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'fg' THEN index_value END) AS fg
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6a_others' THEN index_value END) AS l6a_others --SUM(CASE WHEN value_type = '' THEN index_value END) AS  l6b,
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ca' THEN index_value END) AS ca
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'rebate' THEN index_value END) AS rebate
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ka_expense' THEN index_value END) AS ka_expense
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'listing_fee' THEN index_value END) AS listing_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'promotion_activists' THEN index_value END) AS promotion_activistes
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'logistic_fee' THEN index_value END) AS logistics_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'oos' THEN index_value END) AS oos
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'agreement' THEN index_value END) AS int_agreement
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6b_py_release' THEN index_value END) AS l6b_py_release
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'deduction' THEN index_value END) AS deduction
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_b_w_ror' THEN index_value END) AS l6_b_w_ror
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'return_provision_ror' THEN index_value END) AS ror
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6b_others' THEN index_value END) AS l6b_others
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'merchandising_l10' THEN index_value END) AS l10_service_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_nka_tm_o2o' THEN index_value END) AS l17_o2o
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_ba' THEN index_value END) AS l17_ba
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_nka' THEN index_value END) AS l17_channel_specific
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'py_release' THEN index_value END) AS l17_py_release
                    ,0 AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion --L17平台资源包/付费推广
                    ,0 AS l17_live_streaming --L17直播
                    ,0 AS l17_customer_service_fee --L17客服费
                    ,0 AS l17_instore_self_broadcast --L17站内自播
                    ,0 AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee --L17CRM运营服务费
                    ,0 AS l17_content_purchase_and_production --L17内容采买/内容制作
                    ,0 AS l17_data_service_fee --L17数据服务费
                    ,0 AS l17_gift_items --L17礼品赠品
                    ,0 AS l17_others --L17其他
                    ,0 AS l17_not_allocated --L17未分配
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'gp1' THEN index_value END) AS gp1 --,MAX() AS channel_gp2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_total' THEN index_value END) AS ttl_l17
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'gp2' THEN index_value END) AS gp2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l10_commission' THEN index_value END) AS l10
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l11_t_w' THEN index_value END) AS l11
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l14_cog' THEN index_value END) AS l14_cog
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l16_umc' THEN index_value END) AS l16
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'c1' THEN index_value END) AS c1
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'internal_sales' THEN index_value END) AS internal_sales
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'nts' THEN index_value END) AS nts
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2 t1
            left join 
            (
                 select  distinct
                    customer_group_en_lv1
                   ,customer_group_en_lv2
                 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                 where nvl(ds,'') like '%01'
                 and (channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') or channel_hierarchy_1 in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'))
                 and customer_group_en_lv1 not in ('CLH','DIA','Jiami','Lushang','NGS','Others','Parkn shop','Sanjiu') -- 过滤一些无效的KA，需要注意如果这些KA生效了需要释放
            )t2
            on t1.customer_idh_snapshot = t2.customer_group_en_lv2
            WHERE   t1.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2')
            AND     t1.slow_moving = 'All'
            GROUP BY month
                     ,nvl(t2.customer_group_en_lv1,t1.customer_idh_snapshot)
                     ,customer_type
                     ,is_not_py
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
        ) t
GROUP BY month
         ,customer_idh_snapshot
         ,is_not_py
         ,customer_type
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2

select
  customer_idh
  ,bu
  ,years
  ,months
  ,cast(blockcosts_bu      as decimal(28,6)) as DBKK  -- Blockcosts BU
  ,cast(operating_income   as decimal(28,6)) as L30   -- 30 Operating Income
  ,cast(operating_charges  as decimal(28,6)) as L31   -- 31 Operating Charges
  ,cast(restruct_charges   as decimal(28,6)) as L32   -- 32 Restruct Charges
  ,cast(a_reg_mgmt_costsbu as decimal(28,6)) as DRMC  -- 35a Reg Mgmt CostsBU
  ,max(months)over(partition by data_source) AS gr55_month_max
  ,data_source
from(
    select
      'v_ttl' AS  customer_idh
      ,bu
      ,years
      ,concat(years,decode(months,'Jan','01','Feb','02','Mar','03','Apr','04','May','05','Jun','06','Jul','07','Aug','08','Sep','09','Oct','10','Nov','11','Dec','12')) as months
      ,blockcosts_bu      -- Blockcosts BU
      ,operating_income   -- 30 Operating Income
      ,operating_charges  -- 31 Operating Charges
      ,restruct_charges   -- 32 Restruct Charges
      ,a_reg_mgmt_costsbu -- 35a Reg Mgmt CostsBU
      ,'gr55_act' as data_source
      ,dense_rank() over(partition by years,months,bu order by cast(qbi_system_upload_id as bigint) desc) as rn
    from ${dme_ods}.s_gr55_act_bts
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_gr55_act_bts')
 )
where rn=1

  fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,months               -- 月份
  ,years                -- 年
  ,customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道

  ,sum(nvl(normal                               ,0)) as normal                                -- normal
  ,sum(nvl(financial_swc_inv_value              ,0)) as financial_swc_inv_value               -- 财务SWC
  ,sum(nvl(pos_gmv_pre_untax                    ,0)) as pos_gmv_pre_untax                     -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(nvl(ges                                  ,0)) as ges                                   -- 集团外毛销售额
  ,sum(nvl(ngs                                  ,0)) as ngs                                   -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
  ,sum(nvl(nes                                  ,0)) as nes                                   -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
  ,sum(nvl(ttl_l6                               ,0)) as	ttl_l6                                -- l6_total
  ,sum(nvl(l6a                                  ,0)) as l6a                                   -- l6_a
  ,sum(nvl(ppd                                  ,0)) as ppd                                   -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(pld                                  ,0)) as pld                                   -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(fg                                   ,0)) as fg                                    -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
  ,sum(nvl(l6a_others                           ,0)) as l6a_others                            -- l6a_others
  ,sum(nvl(l6b                                  ,0)) as l6b                                   -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
  ,sum(nvl(ca                                   ,0)) as ca                                    -- 价差
  ,sum(nvl(rebate                               ,0)) as rebate                                -- 返利
  ,sum(nvl(ka_expense                           ,0)) as ka_expense                            -- KA Expense
  ,sum(nvl(listing_fee                          ,0)) as listing_fee                           -- 进场费
  ,sum(nvl(promotion_activities                 ,0)) as promotion_activities                  -- Promotion Activists
  ,sum(nvl(logistics_fee                        ,0)) as logistics_fee                         -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(oos                                  ,0)) as oos                                   -- OSS
  ,sum(nvl(int_agreement                        ,0)) as int_agreement                         -- Int. Agreement
  ,sum(nvl(l6b_py_release                       ,0)) as l6b_py_release                        -- l6_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(deduction                            ,0)) as deduction                             -- Returned or Refunded，退货
  ,sum(nvl(ror                                  ,0)) as ror                                   -- 递减
  ,sum(nvl(l6b_others                           ,0)) as l6b_others                            -- l6b_others
  ,sum(nvl(l10_service_fee                      ,0)) as l10_service_fee                       -- L10服务商费用
  ,sum(nvl(l17_channel                          ,0)) as l17_channel                           -- L17 Channel
  ,sum(nvl(l17_o2o                              ,0)) as l17_o2o                               -- L17 O2O
  ,sum(nvl(l17_ba                               ,0)) as l17_ba                                -- L17 BA
  ,sum(nvl(l17_channel_specific                 ,0)) as l17_channel_specific                  -- l17_channel_specific
  ,sum(nvl(l17_py_release                       ,0)) as l17_py_release                        -- l17_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion,0)) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,sum(nvl(l17_live_streaming                   ,0)) as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,sum(nvl(l17_customer_service_fee             ,0)) as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_instore_self_broadcast           ,0)) as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,sum(nvl(l17_crm_operation_service_fee        ,0)) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_content_purchase_and_production  ,0)) as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,sum(nvl(l17_data_service_fee                 ,0)) as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_gift_items                       ,0)) as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,sum(nvl(l17_others                           ,0)) as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,sum(nvl(l17_not_allocated                    ,0)) as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  ,sum(nvl(gp1                                  ,0)) as gp1                                   -- GP1
  ,sum(nvl(channel_gp2                          ,0)) as channel_gp2                           -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,sum(nvl(l17_allocated                        ,0)) as l17_allocated                         -- L17 Allocated
  ,sum(nvl(ttl_l17                              ,0)) as ttl_l17                               -- TTL_L17
  ,sum(nvl(gp2                                  ,0)) as gp2                                   -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,sum(nvl(l10_ges_rate                         ,0)) as l10_ges_rate                          -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l11_ges_rate                         ,0)) as l11_ges_rate                          -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(cog_ges_rate                         ,0)) as cog_ges_rate                          -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l16_nes_rate                         ,0)) as l16_nes_rate                          -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l10                                  ,0)) as l10                                   -- L10
  ,sum(nvl(l11                                  ,0)) as l11                                   -- L11
  ,sum(nvl(cog                                  ,0)) as cog                                   -- COG
  ,sum(nvl(l16                                  ,0)) as l16                                   -- L16
  ,sum(nvl(c1                                   ,0)) as c1                                    -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,sum(nvl(dbkk                                 ,0)) as dbkk                                  -- DBKK
  ,sum(nvl(l30                                  ,0)) as l30                                   -- L30
  ,sum(nvl(l31                                  ,0)) as l31                                   -- L31
  ,sum(nvl(ebit_f_ac                            ,0)) as ebit_f_ac                             -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,sum(nvl(drmc                                 ,0)) as drmc                                  -- drmc
  ,sum(nvl(ebit_f_reg                           ,0)) as ebit_f_reg                            -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,sum(nvl(l32                                  ,0)) as l32                                   -- l32

  ,sum(nvl(initial_inv_value                    ,0)) as initial_inv_value                     -- 期初库存
  ,sum(nvl(final_inv_value                      ,0)) as final_inv_value                       -- 期末库存
  ,is_adj -- is_adj
  ,'FCST' AS  is_fcst
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3
where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
 group by
  fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,months               -- 月份
  ,years                -- 年
  ,customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,is_adj -- is_adj

-- 计算各数据源最大有数日期
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp3

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp3 as
select
 '1' flag
 ,max(ke24_month_max)  as ke24_month_max  -- ke24最大有数据月份
from ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3
where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3')

--合并Actual和fcst的数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4 as
select
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4) as years -- 年
  ,t1.channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,t1.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,t1.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,t1.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,'Act' as data_source    -- fcst数据来源
  ,t1.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,t1.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,'Act' as data_type      -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
  ,null  as pos_rsp_rate_cust  -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,sum(nvl(t1.base_pos_gmv_untax       ,0)) as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_gmv_untax            ,0)) as pos_gmv_untax          -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_normal               ,0)) as pos_normal             -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_promotional          ,0)) as pos_promotional        -- Promotional
  ,sum(nvl(t1.all_base_stock_amt_untax ,0)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)整体板块
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax,0)) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(case when t1.customer_idh='Watsons' then t3.financial_swc_inv_value else 0 end) as inv_month_wts -- Inv. Month(WTS Input)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.mini_base_stock_amt_untax,0)) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ges                  else t3.ges                  end,0)) as ges                  -- 集团外毛销售额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ngs                  else t3.ngs                  end,0)) as ngs                  -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.nes                  else t3.nes                  end,0)) as nes                  -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l6               else t3.ttl_l6               end,0)) as l6_total             -- l6_total
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6a                  else t3.l6a                  end,0)) as l6_a                 -- l6_a
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ppd                  else t3.ppd                  end,0)) as ppd                  -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.pld                  else t3.pld                  end,0)) as pld                  -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.fg                   else t3.fg                   end,0)) as fg                   -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6a_others           else t3.l6a_others           end,0)) as l6a_others           -- l6a_others
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b                  else t3.l6b                  end,0)) as l6_b                 -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ca                   else t3.ca                   end,0)) as ca                   -- 价差
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.rebate               else t3.rebate               end,0)) as rebate               -- 返利
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ka_expense           else t3.ka_expense           end,0)) as ka_expense           -- KA Expense
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.listing_fee          else t3.listing_fee          end,0)) as listing_fee          -- 进场费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.promotion_activistes else t3.promotion_activities end,0)) as promotion_activities -- Promotion Activists
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.logistics_fee        else t3.logistics_fee        end,0)) as logistics_fee        -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.oos                  else t3.oos                  end,0)) as oos                  -- OSS
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.int_agreement        else t3.int_agreement        end,0)) as int_agreement        -- Int. Agreement
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b_py_release       else t3.l6b_py_release       end,0)) as l6_py_release        -- l6_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.deduction            else t3.deduction            end,0)) as deduction            -- Returned or Refunded，退货
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ror                  else t3.ror                  end,0)) as ror                  -- 递减
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b_others           else t3.l6b_others           end,0)) as l6b_others           -- l6b_others
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l10_service_fee      else t3.l10_service_fee      end,0)) as l10_service_fee      -- L10服务商费用
  ,sum(nvl(t2.internal_sales      ,0)) as internal_sales
  ,sum(nvl(t2.nts                 ,0)) as nts
  -- Profitability NES Report的L17细项来自手工表，不用FCST补数
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel         ,0)) as l17_channel  -- L17 Channel
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_o2o             ,0)) as l17_o2o      -- L17 O2O
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_ba              ,0)) as l17_ba       -- L17 BA
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel_specific,0)) as l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_py_release      ,0)) as l17_py_release     -- l17_py_release
  ,0 as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,0 as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,0 as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,0 as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,0 as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,0 as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,0 as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,0 as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,0 as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,0 as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.ttl_l6,0)+nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) else nvl(t3.ttl_l6,0)+nvl(t3.l10_service_fee,0) end)
     + sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0))    as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp1     else t3.gp1     end,0)) as gp1           -- GP1
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp1     else t3.gp1     end,0))-sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)) as channel_gp2   -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l17 else t3.ttl_l17 end,0))-sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l17 else t3.ttl_l17 end,0)) as ttl_l17       -- TTL_L17
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp2     else t3.gp2     end,0)) as ttl_gp2       -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,null as l10_ges_rate  -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as l11_ges_rate  -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as cog_ges_rate  -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as l16_nes_rate  -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l10          else t3.l10           end,0)) as l10           -- L10
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l11           else t3.l11           end,0)) as l11           -- L11
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l14_cog       else t3.cog           end,0)) as cog           -- COG
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l16           else t3.l16           end,0)) as l16           -- L16
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.c1            else t3.c1            end,0)) as c1            -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.dbkk         ,0)) as dbkk          -- DBKK
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l30          ,0)) as l30           -- L30
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l31          ,0)) as l31           -- L31
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.gp2,0)-nvl(t4.dbkk,0)+nvl(t4.l30,0)-nvl(t4.l31,0) else t3.ebit_f_ac end,0)) as ebit_f_ac -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.drmc         ,0)) as drmc          -- drmc
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.gp2,0)-nvl(t4.dbkk,0)+nvl(t4.l30,0)-nvl(t4.l31,0)-nvl(t4.drmc,0) else t3.ebit_f_reg end,0)) as ebit_f_reg    -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l32          ,0)) as l32           -- l32
  ,sum(nvl(t2.listing_fee_py         ,0)) as listing_fee_py             -- 进场费（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.int_agreement_py       ,0)) as int_agreement_py           -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.oos_py                 ,0)) as oos_py                     -- OSS（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.promotion_activities_py,0)) as promotion_activities_py    -- Promotion Activists（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.ka_expense_py          ,0)) as ka_expense_py              -- KA Expense（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.rebate_py              ,0)) as rebate_py                  -- 返利（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.logistic_fee_py        ,0)) as logistic_fee_py            -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.ca_py                  ,0)) as ca_py                      -- 物流费（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l6b_others_py          ,0)) as l6b_others_py              -- l6b_others_py
from (                                                                                   
     select                                                                     
      a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
      ,a.months               -- 月份
      ,a.channel              -- 快照渠道
      ,a.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
      ,a.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
      ,a.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
      ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
      ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
      ,'Act' as data_source -- fcst数据来源
      ,a.is_not_py        -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
      ,b.is_adj
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_rsp_rate_cust         END AS pos_rsp_rate_cust         -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.all_base_stock_amt_untax  END AS all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax END AS mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.all_so_sales_amt_untax    END AS all_so_sales_amt_untax    -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_gmv_untax             END AS pos_gmv_untax             -- POS/GMV(未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.base_pos_gmv_untax        END AS base_pos_gmv_untax        -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax END AS sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_normal                END AS pos_normal                -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_promotional           END AS pos_promotional           -- Promotional
      ,'1' as flag
    from(
      SELECT *,'1' as flag
      FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3
      where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3')
      and data_type='ACT'
      and substr(fcst_date,1,6) > months
      ) a
    left join (
       select 'Y' as is_adj,'1' as flag union all
       select 'N' as is_adj,'1' as flag
      ) b
     on a.flag=b.flag
) t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3 t2  -- act数据
   on nvl(t1.months               ,'')=nvl(t2.months               ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh         ,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh         ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel              ,'')=nvl(t2.channel              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                 ,'')=nvl(t2.bu_1                 ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                 ,'')=nvl(t2.bu_2                 ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest      ,'')=nvl(t2.channel_lastest      ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest ,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_not_py            ,'')=nvl(t2.py_release ,'')
  and t1.is_adj='N'
  and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v3')
left join (
    select *,DENSE_RANK()over(partition by months order by fcst_date desc) as rn
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp1
    where substr(fcst_date,1,6)=months
  ) t3  -- fcst
  on nvl(t1.channel             ,'')=nvl(t3.channel             ,'')
  and nvl(t1.months              ,'')=nvl(t3.months              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh        ,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh        ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest     ,'')=nvl(t3.channel_lastest     ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh_lastest,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_1                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_2                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_adj              ,'')=nvl(t3.is_adj              ,'')
  and t3.rn=1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp1 t4  -- gr55
  on nvl(t1.fcst_date            ,'')=nvl(t4.fcst_date           ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel             ,'')=nvl(t4.channel             ,'')
  and nvl(t1.months              ,'')=nvl(t4.months              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh        ,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh        ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest     ,'')=nvl(t4.channel_lastest     ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_1                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_2                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_adj              ,'')=nvl(t4.is_adj              ,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp3 t5
on t1.flag=t5.flag
where t1.fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
group by
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4)   -- 年
  ,t1.channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,t1.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,t1.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,t1.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,t1.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,t1.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值


union  all
-- 合并fcst
select
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4) as years -- 年
  ,t1.channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,t1.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,t1.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,t1.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,'FCST' as data_source   -- fcst数据来源
  ,t1.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,t1.is_not_py as py_release -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,'FCST'       as data_type  -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
  ,max(t1.pos_rsp_rate_cust) as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,sum(nvl(t1.base_pos_gmv_untax       ,0)) as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_gmv_untax            ,0)) as pos_gmv_untax          -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_normal               ,0)) as pos_normal             -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_promotional          ,0)) as pos_promotional        -- Promotional
  ,sum(nvl(t1.all_base_stock_amt_untax ,0)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)整体板块
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax,0)) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(case when t1.customer_idh='Watsons' then t3.financial_swc_inv_value else 0 end) as inv_month_wts -- Inv. Month(WTS Input)

  ,sum(nvl(t3.ges                 ,0)) as ges                  -- 集团外毛销售额
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ngs                 ,0)) as ngs                  -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
  ,sum(nvl(t3.nes                 ,0)) as nes                  -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ttl_l6              ,0)) as l6_total             -- l6_total
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l6a                 ,0)) as l6_a                 -- l6_a
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ppd                 ,0)) as ppd                  -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(t3.pld                 ,0)) as pld                  -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(t3.fg                  ,0)) as fg                   -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l6a_others          ,0)) as l6a_others           -- l6a_others
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l6b                 ,0)) as l6_b                 -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ca                  ,0)) as ca                   -- 价差
  ,sum(nvl(t3.rebate              ,0)) as rebate               -- 返利
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ka_expense          ,0)) as ka_expense           -- KA Expense
  ,sum(nvl(t3.listing_fee         ,0)) as listing_fee          -- 进场费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.promotion_activities,0)) as promotion_activities -- Promotion Activists
  ,sum(nvl(t3.logistics_fee       ,0)) as logistics_fee        -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.oos                 ,0)) as oos                  -- OSS
  ,sum(nvl(t3.int_agreement       ,0)) as int_agreement        -- Int. Agreement
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l6b_py_release      ,0)) as l6_py_release        -- l6_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(t3.deduction           ,0)) as deduction            -- Returned or Refunded，退货
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ror                 ,0)) as ror                  -- 递减
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l6b_others          ,0)) as l6b_others           -- l6b_others
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l10_service_fee     ,0)) as l10_service_fee      -- L10服务商费用
  ,0 as internal_sales
  ,sum(nvl(t3.nes                 ,0)) as nts
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_channel         ,0)) as l17_channel          -- L17 Channel
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_o2o             ,0)) as l17_o2o              -- L17 O2O
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_ba              ,0)) as l17_ba               -- L17 BA
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_channel_specific,0)) as l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_py_release      ,0)) as l17_py_release       -- l17_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion,0)) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_live_streaming                   ,0)) as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_customer_service_fee             ,0)) as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_instore_self_broadcast           ,0)) as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_crm_operation_service_fee        ,0)) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_content_purchase_and_production  ,0)) as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_data_service_fee                 ,0)) as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_gift_items                       ,0)) as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_others                           ,0)) as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_not_allocated                    ,0)) as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ttl_l6,0)+nvl(t3.l10_service_fee,0)+ nvl(t3.l17_channel,0)) as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(nvl(t3.gp1          ,0)) as gp1           -- GP1
  ,sum(nvl(t3.channel_gp2  ,0)) as channel_gp2   -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l17_allocated,0)) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ttl_l17     ,0)) as ttl_l17       -- TTL_L17
  ,sum(nvl(t3.gp2         ,0)) as ttl_gp2       -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l10_ges_rate,0)) as l10_ges_rate  -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l11_ges_rate,0)) as l11_ges_rate  -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(t3.cog_ges_rate,0)) as cog_ges_rate  -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l16_nes_rate,0)) as l16_nes_rate  -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l10         ,0)) as l10           -- L10
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l11         ,0)) as l11           -- L11
  ,sum(nvl(t3.cog         ,0)) as cog           -- COG
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l16         ,0)) as l16           -- L16
  ,sum(nvl(t3.c1          ,0)) as c1            -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,sum(nvl(t3.dbkk        ,0)) as dbkk          -- DBKK
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l30         ,0)) as l30           -- L30
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l31         ,0)) as l31           -- L31
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ebit_f_ac   ,0)) as ebit_f_ac     -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,sum(nvl(t3.drmc        ,0)) as drmc          -- drmc
  ,sum(nvl(t3.ebit_f_reg  ,0)) as ebit_f_reg    -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,sum(nvl(t3.l32         ,0)) as l32           -- l32
  ,0 as listing_fee_py             -- 进场费（py）
  ,0 as int_agreement_py           -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,0 as oos_py                     -- OSS（py）
  ,0 as promotion_activities_py    -- Promotion Activists（py）
  ,0 as ka_expense_py              -- KA Expense（py）
  ,0 as rebate_py                  -- 返利（py）
  ,0 as logistic_fee_py            -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,0 as ca_py                      -- 物流费（py）
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.is_adj='Y' and t1.is_not_py='N' then t3.l6b_py_release else 0 end,0)) as l6b_others_py -- l6b_others_py，FCST月份只放adj的l6b_py_release 数据
from (
     select
      a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
      ,a.months               -- 月份
      ,a.channel              -- 快照渠道
      ,a.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
      ,a.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
      ,a.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
      ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
      ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
      ,'FCST' as data_source -- fcst数据来源
      ,a.is_not_py        -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
      ,b.is_adj
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_rsp_rate_cust         END AS pos_rsp_rate_cust         -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.all_base_stock_amt_untax  END AS all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax END AS mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.all_so_sales_amt_untax    END AS all_so_sales_amt_untax    -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_gmv_untax             END AS pos_gmv_untax             -- POS/GMV(未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.base_pos_gmv_untax        END AS base_pos_gmv_untax        -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax END AS sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_normal                END AS pos_normal                -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_promotional           END AS pos_promotional           -- Promotional
      ,'1' as flag
    from(
      SELECT *,'1' as flag
      FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3
      where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3')
      and data_type='FCST'
      ) a
    left join (
       select 'Y' as is_adj,'1' as flag union all
       select 'N' as is_adj,'1' as flag
      ) b
     on a.flag=b.flag
 ) t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp1 t3  -- fcst
  on IF(t1.fcst_date REGEXP 'KP' and t3.fcst_date REGEXP 'KP',1=1,nvl(t1.fcst_date,'')=nvl(t3.fcst_date,''))
  and nvl(t1.channel             ,'')=nvl(t3.channel             ,'')
  and nvl(t1.months              ,'')=nvl(t3.months              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh        ,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh        ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest     ,'')=nvl(t3.channel_lastest     ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh_lastest,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_1                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_2                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_adj              ,'')=nvl(t3.is_adj              ,'')
where (substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6) <= t1.months OR t1.is_adj='Y' or t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP')
group by
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4)   -- 年
  ,t1.channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,t1.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,t1.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,t1.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,t1.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,t1.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值

-- 计算PY值
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp5

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp5 as
select
   a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm') as months               -- 月份
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest          -- 客户idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,a.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,a.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,if(a.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N') as kp_flag
  ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax) as pos_gmv_untax_py
  ,sum(a.nes          ) as nes_py
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4 a
inner join (
 select *,row_number()over(partition by months,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N'),is_adj,is_not_py order by fcst_date desc) rn
 from(
    select distinct months,fcst_date,is_adj,is_not_py
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4
 )
) b -- 按月份取最新一份fcst_date数据
on a.months=b.months
and a.fcst_date=b.fcst_date
and a.is_adj=b.is_adj
and a.is_not_py=b.is_not_py
and b.rn=1
left join (
   select
      distinct customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,months
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
) c
 on a.customer_idh_lastest=c.customer_idh_lastest
and a.bu_2=c.bu_2
and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm')=c.months
group by
   a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm')               -- 月份
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest -- 客户idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,a.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,a.is_not_py             -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,if(a.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N')
  ,a.channel

  ,cast(t1.l17_gift_items                        as decimal(28,6)) as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,cast(t1.l17_others                            as decimal(28,6)) as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,cast(t1.l17_not_allocated                     as decimal(28,6)) as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,cast(t1.l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee as decimal(28,6)) as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,cast(t1.gp1           as decimal(28,6)) as gp1           -- GP1
  ,cast(t1.channel_gp2   as decimal(28,6)) as channel_gp2   -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,cast(t1.l17_allocated as decimal(28,6)) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
  ,cast(t1.ttl_l17       as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_l17       -- TTL_L17
  ,cast(t1.ttl_gp2       as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_gp2       -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,cast(t1.l10_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l10_ges_rate  -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l11_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l11_ges_rate  -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.cog_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as cog_ges_rate  -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l16_nes_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l16_nes_rate  -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l10           as decimal(28,6)) as l10           -- L10
  ,cast(t1.l11           as decimal(28,6)) as l11           -- L11
  ,cast(t1.cog           as decimal(28,6)) as cog           -- COG
  ,cast(t1.l16           as decimal(28,6)) as l16           -- L16
  ,cast(t1.c1            as decimal(28,6)) as c1            -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,cast(t1.dbkk          as decimal(28,6)) as dbkk          -- DBKK
  ,cast(t1.l30           as decimal(28,6)) as l30           -- L30
  ,cast(t1.l31           as decimal(28,6)) as l31           -- L31
  ,cast(t1.ebit_f_ac     as decimal(28,6)) as ebit_f_ac     -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,cast(t1.drmc          as decimal(28,6)) as drmc          -- drmc
  ,cast(t1.ebit_f_reg    as decimal(28,6)) as ebit_f_reg    -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,cast(t1.l32           as decimal(28,6)) as l32           -- l32
  ,cast(t1.listing_fee_py          as decimal(28,6)) as listing_fee_py             -- 进场费（py）
  ,cast(t1.int_agreement_py        as decimal(28,6)) as int_agreement_py           -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,cast(t1.oos_py                  as decimal(28,6)) as oos_py                     -- OSS（py）
  ,cast(t1.promotion_activities_py as decimal(28,6)) as promotion_activities_py    -- Promotion Activists（py）
  ,cast(t1.ka_expense_py           as decimal(28,6)) as ka_expense_py              -- KA Expense（py）
  ,cast(t1.rebate_py               as decimal(28,6)) as rebate_py                  -- 返利（py）
  ,cast(t1.logistic_fee_py         as decimal(28,6)) as logistic_fee_py            -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,cast(t1.ca_py                   as decimal(28,6)) as ca_py                      -- 物流费（py）
  ,cast(t1.l6b_others_py           as decimal(28,6)) as l6b_others_py              -- l6b_others_py
  ,nvl(t2.channel_customer_Permission,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,nvl(t2.region_customer_Permission,'Others_Others')  as region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4 t1
left join(
   select
      distinct customer_idh
          ,channel
          ,months
          ,sub_channel
          ,customer_name
          ,channel_lastest
          ,sub_channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,customer_name_lastest
          ,sub_channel_lastest_dis  -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
          ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
          ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
) t2
 on t1.customer_idh_lastest=t2.customer_idh_lastest
 and t1.months=t2.months
 and t1.bu_1=t2.bu_1
 and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
left join (
  select distinct fcst_date
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4 a
  inner join (
      select distinct years
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp4
      where fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
      and fcst_date>=substr('${last_month}',1,6)
      and data_type='FCST'
  ) b
  on substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=b.years
  where a.fcst_date regexp 'KP'
) t3
 on t1.fcst_date=t3.fcst_date
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3_tmp5 t4
 on t1.months = t4.months
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.channel_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.channel_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_1        ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_1        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_2        ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_2        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.is_adj      ,'')=nvl(t4.is_adj      ,'')
 and nvl(t1.is_not_py  ,'')=nvl(t4.is_not_py  ,'')
 and if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N')=t4.kp_flag
where (
    t1.fcst_date>=substr('${last_month}',1,6)   -- 取最近两个月上传的FCT数据
 or t3.fcst_date is not null   -- 取最近两个月上传的FCT年份对应的KP数据ZZ
 )
and t1.customer_idh is not null
and substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4)<=substr(t1.months,1,4)+1 --只取fcst年份前一年及之后的数据

--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
