drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_customer_btsup_new_tmp01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_customer_btsup_new_tmp01 as
select
  a.fcst_date                              -- Fcst_date（加上KP）
 ,a.months                                 -- 月份yyyyMMdd
 ,decode(substr(a.months,5,2),'01','Jan','02','Feb','03','Mar','04','Apr','05','May','06','Jun','07','Jul','08','Aug','09','Sep','10','Oct','11','Nov','12','Dec') as months_dis -- 月份展示 Jan/QTD Jan/YTD Jan/H1
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
   end as quarters                         -- 季度Qn
 ,a.years                                  -- 年度yyyy
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'H1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'H2'
   end as half_year                      -- 半年 H1/H2
 ,'Month' as time_type                   -- 时间粒度 Month/QTD/YTD/Half year
 ,case when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 'NKA'
       when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('DT') then 'Salon DT'
    else a.channel_lastest end as channel     -- 渠道
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest   as sub_channel -- 二级渠道
 ,a.customer_idh_lastest  as customer_idh  -- 客户IDH
 ,a.customer_name_lastest as customer_name -- 客户名称
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest_dis as sub_channel_dis -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
 ,a.bu_1                                   -- BU1
 ,a.bu_2                                   -- BU2
 ,a.data_type -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
 ,a.is_py_release as py_release            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
 ,a.is_adj                                 -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
 ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
 ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
 ,max(a.pos_rsp_rate_cust                     ) as pos_rate                               -- POS/RSP比例（对于QTD/YTD，置空，且NKA和Ecom的虚拟客户，需要计算对应比例）
 ,sum(a.base_pos_gmv_untax                    ) as pos_base_price                         -- POS/GMV基价销额(未税)  计算(L6+L17+服务费)%基价
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax                         ) as pos                                    -- POS/GMV(未税)
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax_py                      ) as pos_py                                 -- POS/GMV(未税) PY
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax_ytd                     ) as pos_ttl_year                           -- POS/GMV(未税) TTL Year
 ,sum(a.pos_normal                            ) as pos_normal                             -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税)- Promotional
 ,sum(a.pos_promotional                       ) as pos_promotional                        -- Promotional
 ,sum(a.all_base_stock_amt_untax              ) as inv_value                              -- 库存基价未税金额(blue table)
 ,sum(a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax              ) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax               -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax              ) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax               -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax             ) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax              -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.inv_month_wts                         ) as inv_month_wts                          -- Inv. Month(WTS Input)
 ,sum(a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax             ) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax              -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
 ,sum(a.ges                                   ) as ges                                    -- GES
 ,sum(a.ngs                                   ) as ngs                                    -- NGS
 ,sum(a.nes                                   ) as nes                                    -- NES
 ,sum(a.nes_py                                ) as nes_py                                 -- NES PY
 ,sum(a.nes_ttl_year                          ) as nes_ttl_year                           -- NES TTL Year
 ,sum(a.l6_total                              ) as l6_ttl                                 -- L6 ttl（计算，L6a+L6b）
 ,sum(a.l6_a                                  ) as l6a                                    -- L6a
 ,sum(a.ppd                                   ) as ppd                                    -- PPD
 ,sum(a.pld                                   ) as pld                                    -- PLD
 ,sum(a.fg                                    ) as fg                                     -- FG
 ,sum(a.l6a_others                            ) as l6a_others                             -- l6a_others
 ,sum(a.l6_b                                  ) as l6_b                                   -- L6b
 ,sum(a.ca                                    ) as ca                                     -- CA
 ,sum(a.rebate                                ) as rebate                                 -- Rebate
 ,sum(a.ka_expense                            ) as ka_expense                             -- KA Expense
 ,sum(a.listing_fee                           ) as listing_fee                            -- Listing Fee
 ,sum(a.promotion_activities                  ) as promotion_activities                   -- Promotion Activities
 ,sum(a.logistics_fee                         ) as logistic_fee                           -- Logistics
 ,sum(a.oos                                   ) as oos                                    -- OOS
 ,sum(a.int_agreement                         ) as int_agreement                          -- Int. Agreement
 ,sum(a.l6_py_release                         ) as l6_py_release                          -- l6_py_release
 ,sum(a.deduction                             ) as deduction                              -- Deduction
 ,sum(a.ror                                   ) as ror                                    -- ROR
 ,sum(a.l6b_others                            ) as l6b_others                             -- l6b_others
 ,sum(a.l10_service_fee                       ) as l10_service_fee                        -- L10服务商费用
 ,sum(a.l17_channel                           ) as l17_channel                            -- L17 Channel+PY_release
 ,sum(a.l17_o2o                               ) as l17_o2o                                -- O2O
 ,sum(a.l17_ba                                ) as l17_ba                                 -- BA
 ,sum(a.l17_channel_specific                  ) as l17_channel_specific                   -- l17_channel_specific
 ,sum(a.l17_py_release                        ) as l17_py_release                         -- l17_py_release
 ,sum(a.l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion ) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion  -- 平台资源包/付费推广
 ,sum(a.l17_live_streaming                    ) as l17_live_streaming                     -- 直播
 ,sum(a.l17_customer_service_fee              ) as l17_customer_service_fee               -- 客服费
 ,sum(a.l17_instore_self_broadcast            ) as l17_instore_self_broadcast             -- 站内自播
 ,sum(a.l17_crm_operation_service_fee         ) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee          -- CRM运营服务费
 ,sum(a.l17_content_purchase_and_production   ) as l17_content_purchase_and_production    -- 内容采买/内容制作
 ,sum(a.l17_data_service_fee                  ) as l17_data_service_fee                   -- 数据服务费
 ,sum(a.l17_gift_items                        ) as l17_gift_items                         -- 礼品赠品
 ,sum(a.l17_others                            ) as l17_others                             -- 其他/Others
 ,sum(a.l17_not_allocated                     ) as l17_not_allocated                      -- l17_not_allocated
 ,sum(a.l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee        ) as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee         -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
 ,sum(a.gp1                                   ) as gp1                                    -- GP1
 ,sum(a.channel_gp2                           ) as channel_gp2                            -- Channel GP2
 ,sum(a.l17_allocated                         ) as l17_allocated                          -- L17 Allocated
 ,sum(a.ttl_l17                               ) as l17_ttl                                -- TTL L17
 ,sum(a.ttl_gp2                               ) as gp2_ttl                                -- TTL GP2
 ,sum(a.l10                                   ) as l10                                    -- L10
 ,sum(a.l11                                   ) as l11                                    -- L11
 ,sum(a.cog                                   ) as cog                                    -- COG
 ,sum(a.l16                                   ) as l16                                    -- L16
 ,sum(a.c1                                    ) as c1                                     -- C1
 ,sum(a.dbkk                                  ) as dbkk                                   -- Blockcosts BU
 ,sum(a.l30                                   ) as l30                                    -- 30 Operating Income
 ,sum(a.l31                                   ) as l31                                    -- 31 Operating Charges
 ,sum(a.ebit_f_ac                             ) as ebit_f_ac                              -- EBIT-F AC（计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31）
 ,sum(a.drmc                                  ) as drmc                                   -- 35a Reg Mgmt CostsBU
 ,sum(a.ebit_f_reg                            ) as ebit_f_reg                             -- EBIT-F Reg（计算，EBIT-F AC - DRMC）
 ,sum(a.l32                                   ) as l32                                    -- 32 Restruct Charges
 ,sum(a.internal_sales                        ) as internal_sales
 ,sum(a.nts                                   ) as nts
 ,sum(a.listing_fee_py                        ) as listing_fee_py                         -- 进场费（py）
 ,sum(a.int_agreement_py                      ) as int_agreement_py                       -- Int. Agreement（py）
 ,sum(a.oos_py                                ) as oos_py                                 -- OSS（py）
 ,sum(a.promotion_activities_py               ) as promotion_activities_py                -- Promotion Activists（py）
 ,sum(a.ka_expense_py                         ) as ka_expense_py                          -- KA Expense（py）
 ,sum(a.rebate_py                             ) as rebate_py                              -- 返利（py）
 ,sum(a.logistic_fee_py                       ) as logistic_fee_py                        -- Int. Agreement（py）
 ,sum(a.ca_py                                 ) as ca_py                                  -- 物流费（py）
 ,sum(a.l6b_others_py                         ) as l6b_others_py                          -- l6b_others_py
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3 a
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v3')
group by
 a.fcst_date                              -- Fcst_date（加上KP）
 ,a.months                                 -- 月份yyyyMMdd
 ,decode(substr(a.months,5,2),'01','Jan','02','Feb','03','Mar','04','Apr','05','May','06','Jun','07','Jul','08','Aug','09','Sep','10','Oct','11','Nov','12','Dec') -- 月份展示 Jan/QTD Jan/YTD Jan/H1
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
   end                    -- 季度Qn
 ,a.years                 -- 年度yyyy
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'H1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'H2'
   end                    -- 半年 H1/H2
 ,case when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 'NKA'
       when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('DT') then 'Salon DT'
    else a.channel_lastest end -- 渠道
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest   -- 二级渠道
 ,a.customer_idh_lastest  -- 客户IDH
 ,a.customer_name_lastest -- 客户名称
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest_dis -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
 ,a.bu_1                  -- BU1
 ,a.bu_2                  -- BU2                               -- BU2
 ,a.data_type -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
 ,a.is_py_release         -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
 ,a.is_adj                -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值

 ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）

-- 判断一笔主单是组合装还是单品
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01 as
SELECT 
    dt_date,
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    bu_1,
    bu_2,
    order_no,
    henkel_item_barcode,
    product_name,
    sku,
    category_name,
    product_function,
    sub_product_function,
    brand_name,
    product_line,
    quantity,
    if(qty_all>1 or sku_num>1,'组合','单品') as prod_type,
    count(distinct order_no) over(partition by dt_date,shop_id) as order_num_all
from (
    select
        a.dt_date,
        a.shop_id,
        a.shop_name,
        a.bu_1,
        a.bu_2,
        a.order_no,
        a.henkel_item_barcode,
        nvl(b.product_name,'Others') as product_name,
        concat(nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),'-',a.henkel_item_barcode) as sku,
        nvl(b.category_name,'Others') as category_name,
        nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as product_function,
        nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function,
        nvl(b.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,
        nvl(b.product_line,'Others') as product_line,
        a.quantity,
        count(distinct a.henkel_item_barcode) over(partition by order_no) as sku_num,
        sum(distinct a.quantity) over(partition by order_no) as qty_all
    from (
        SELECT 
            ds as dt_date,
            shop_id,
            shop_name,
            bu_1,
            bu_2,
            order_no,
            henkel_item_barcode,
            sum(quantity) as quantity
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu 
        where ds>='20230101'
        -- and shop_id in ('336','444','533','30163425','30195352','30195353')
        and shop_id in ('30170766','30170767','30192080','30163425','30195352','30195353')
        and order_no is not null
        group by 
            ds,
            shop_id,
            shop_name,
            bu_1,
            bu_2,
            order_no,
            henkel_item_barcode
    ) a
    left join (
        select
            product_barcode,
            product_name,
            category_name,
            product_function,  
            sub_product_function ,
            brand_name,
            product_line
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
    ) b
    on a.henkel_item_barcode=b.product_barcode
) a

-- 若组合为洗护+洗护+洗护，可将名称更新为“洗护组合”，其他字段处理类似
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_02

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_02 as
SELECT 
    order_no,
    sku_group,
    if(category_group not like '%+%',concat(category_group,'组合'),category_group) as category_group,
    if(product_line_group not like '%+%',concat(product_line_group,'组合'),product_line_group) as product_line_group
from (
    SELECT 
        order_no,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(sku_group))) as sku_group,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(category_name))) as category_group,
        concat_ws('+',sort_array(collect_set(product_line))) as product_line_group
    from (
        select 
            order_no,
            product_name,
            quantity,
            category_name,
            product_line,
            concat_ws('*',product_name,quantity) as sku_group
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01
        where prod_type='组合'
    ) a 
    group by order_no
) a

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    substr(a.dt_date,1,4) as data_year,

    a.bu_1,

    a.order_no,
    a.henkel_item_barcode,
    a.product_name,
    a.sku,
    a.category_name,
    a.product_function,
    a.sub_product_function,
    a.brand_name,

    a.prod_type,
    b.sku_group,
    b.category_group,
    b.product_line_group,
    cast(a.order_num_all as decimal(28,6)) as order_num_all
from ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_01 a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_daily_report_order_analysis_temp_02 b
on a.order_no=b.order_no
group by

    a.prod_type,
    b.sku_group,

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ec_douyin_traffic_daily_report partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    coalesce(a.data_year,b.data_year) as data_year,
    coalesce(a.data_quarter,b.data_quarter) as data_quarter,
    coalesce(a.data_month,b.data_month) as data_month,
    coalesce(a.data_date,b.data_date) as data_date,
    coalesce(a.shop_id,b.shop_id) as shop_id,
    coalesce(a.shop_name,b.shop_name) as shop_name,
    coalesce(a.account_name,b.account_name) as account_name,
    cast(null as string) as bu_1,
    cast(null as string) as bu_2,
    cast(null as string) as category_name,
    cast(null as string) as product_function,
    cast(null as string) as sub_product_function,
    cast(null as string) as brand_name,
    cast(null as string) as product_line_name,
    cast(null as string) as sku,
    cast(null as string) as product_barcode,
    cast(null as string) as product_name,
    cast(a.sales_amount as decimal(28,6)) as sales_amount, -- gmv
    b.live_room_impressions, -- 直播间曝光人数
    b.live_room_entrances, -- 直播间进入人数
    b.product_impressions, -- 商品曝光人数
    b.product_clicks, -- 商品点击人数
    b.purchasers -- 成交人数
from (
    SELECT 
        data_year,
        data_quarter,
        data_month,
        data_date,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        account_name,
        sum(live_pay_amount) as sales_amount
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_account_traded
    where to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    and douyin_id in ('shk1898','shkxh1898','shkrfh','27506262696','64569804197')
    group by data_year,
        data_quarter,
        data_month,
        data_date,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        account_name
) a
full join (
    SELECT 
        data_year,
        data_quarter,
        data_month,
        data_date,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        account_name,
        sum(live_room_impressions) as live_room_impressions, -- 直播间曝光人数
        sum(live_room_entrances) as live_room_entrances, -- 直播间进入人数
        sum(product_impressions) as product_impressions, -- 商品曝光人数
        sum(product_clicks) as product_clicks, -- 商品点击人数
        sum(purchasers) as purchasers -- 成交人数
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ec_douyin_live_traffic_conversion
    where to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    group by data_year,
        data_quarter,
        data_month,
        data_date,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        account_name
) b 
on nvl(a.data_year,'')=nvl(b.data_year,'')
and nvl(a.data_quarter,'')=nvl(b.data_quarter,'')
and nvl(a.data_month,'')=nvl(b.data_month,'')
and nvl(a.data_date,'')=nvl(b.data_date,'')
and nvl(a.shop_id,'')=nvl(b.shop_id,'')
and nvl(a.shop_name,'')=nvl(b.shop_name,'')
and nvl(a.account_name,'')=nvl(b.account_name,'')

SELECT 
    substr(a.ds,1,4) as data_year,
    concat(substr(a.ds,1,4),'Q',quarter(to_date(a.ds,'yyyymmdd'))) as data_quarter,
    substr(a.ds,1,6) as data_month,
    a.ds as data_date,
    a.shop_id,
    a.shop_name,
    a.bu_1,
    a.bu_2,
    nvl(b.category_name,'Others') as category_name,
    nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as product_function,
    nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function,
    nvl(b.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name,
    nvl(b.product_line,'Others') as product_line_name,
    c.key_product_line_name as one_pline,
    c.sub_key_product_line_name as two_pline,
    concat(nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),'-',a.henkel_item_barcode) as sku,
    a.henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode,
    nvl(b.product_name,'Others') as product_name,
    a.order_no,
    a.refund_order_no 
from (
    select 
        ds,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        henkel_item_barcode,
        order_no,
        null as refund_order_no
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
    where to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    -- and shop_id_tp in ('336','444','533','30163425','30195352','30195353')
    and shop_id in ('30170766','30170767','30192080','30163425','30195352','30195353')
    group by ds,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        henkel_item_barcode,
        order_no
    union all
    select
        ds,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        if(trim(nvl(henkel_product_barcode,''))='','-110',henkel_product_barcode)  as henkel_item_barcode,
        null as order_no,
        return_order_id as refund_order_no
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu
    where to_date(ds,'yyyymmdd')>=to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd')
    -- and shop_id_tp in ('336','444','533','30163425','30195352','30195353')
    and shop_id in ('30170766','30170767','30192080','30163425','30195352','30195353')
    group by ds,
        shop_id,
        shop_name,
        bu_1,
        bu_2,
        henkel_product_barcode,
        refund_order_no  
) a 
left join (
    select
        product_barcode,
        product_name,
        category_name,
        product_function,  
        sub_product_function ,
        brand_name,
        brand_name_en,
        product_line,
        bu_2
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')

        bu_2,

        key_product_line_name,
        sub_key_product_line_name

) c
on b.bu_2=c.bu_2 
and b.category_name = c.category_name
and b.brand_name_en = c.brand_name_en
and b.product_line = c.product_line
and b.sub_product_function = c.sub_product_function

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp00

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp00 AS
SELECT  prod_barcode
        ,second_layer_dist_code
        ,dist_code
        ,sales_num_sales
FROM    (
            SELECT  prod_barcode
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,dist_code
                    ,SUM(sales_num_sales) AS sales_num_sales
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  a.data_date
                                ,a.prod_barcode
                                ,a.value_type
                                ,a.second_layer_dist_code
                                ,dist_code
                                ,sales_num
                                ,REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-','') AS data_date_max
                                ,SUBSTR(
                                       REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-','')
                                ,1,6) AS data_months_min
                                ,IF(SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) >= SUBSTR(
                                       REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-','')
                                ,1,6)
                                AND     data_date <= REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-',''),sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_sales
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid a
                        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
                        and  SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= '${bizmonth}'
                        union all
                        SELECT  data_date
                            ,prod_barcode
                            ,'pos' AS value_type
                            ,second_layer_dist_code
                            ,dist_code
                            ,sales_num
                            ,REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-','') AS data_date_max
                            ,SUBSTR(
                                    REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-','')
                            ,1,6) AS data_months_min
                            ,IF(SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) >= SUBSTR(
                                    REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-','')
                            ,1,6)
                            AND     data_date <= REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-',''),sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_sales
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
                        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
                        and   SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= '${bizmonth}'
            ) 
            GROUP BY prod_barcode
                     ,second_layer_dist_code
                     ,dist_code
        ) a
WHERE   sales_num_sales IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp001

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp001 AS
SELECT  a.*,
        min(a.data_date) OVER (PARTITION BY a.metric_type,a.dist_code,a.second_layer_dist_code,a.prod_barcode ) AS min_date_bill,
        d.billing_date
FROM  (
    SELECT  data_date
            ,dist_code
            ,store_category
            ,store_category_lv1
            ,second_layer_dist_code
            ,second_layer_dist_name
            ,store_code
            ,store_name
            ,bu_2
            ,prod_barcode
            ,'sellout' AS metric_type
            ,SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
            ,sum(base_amt_untax) as base_amt_untax
            ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) AS data_month
    FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid
    WHERE  ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
    and value_type = 'sellout' -- and substr(data_date,1,6)<='${bizmonth}'
    AND     SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= '${bizmonth}'
    GROUP BY data_date
                ,dist_code
                ,store_category
                ,store_category_lv1
                ,second_layer_dist_code
                ,second_layer_dist_name
                ,store_code
                ,store_name
                ,bu_2
                ,prod_barcode
                ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT  data_date
            ,dist_code
            ,store_category
            ,store_category_lv1
            ,second_layer_dist_code
            ,second_layer_dist_name
            ,store_code
            ,store_name
            ,bu_2
            ,prod_barcode
            ,'sellout_exclude_pos' AS metric_type
            ,SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
            ,sum(base_amt_untax) as base_amt_untax
            ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) AS data_month
    FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid
    WHERE   ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
    and SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= '${bizmonth}'
    GROUP BY data_date
                ,dist_code
                ,store_category
                ,store_category_lv1
                ,second_layer_dist_code
                ,second_layer_dist_name
                ,store_code
                ,store_name
                ,bu_2
                ,prod_barcode
                ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT  data_date
            ,dist_code
            ,store_category
            ,store_category_lv1
            ,second_layer_dist_code
            ,second_layer_dist_name
            ,henkel_store_code AS store_code
            ,henkel_store_name AS store_name
            ,bu_2
            ,prod_barcode
            ,'pos' AS metric_type
            ,SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
            ,sum(base_amt_untax) as base_amt_untax
            ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) AS data_month
    FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid 
    where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid ')
    and sales_num is not null
    and   SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= '${bizmonth}'
    GROUP BY data_date
                ,dist_code
                ,store_category
                ,store_category_lv1
                ,second_layer_dist_code
                ,second_layer_dist_name
                ,henkel_store_code
                ,henkel_store_name
                ,bu_2
                ,prod_barcode
                ,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6)
) a 
LEFT JOIN   (
        SELECT  product_barcode
                ,MAX(
                    CASE    WHEN billing_date RLIKE '\\.' THEN CONCAT(SPLIT(billing_date,'\\.')[0],LPAD(SPLIT(billing_date,'\\.')[1],2,'0'),LPAD(SPLIT(billing_date,'\\.')[2],2,'0'))
                            WHEN billing_date RLIKE '-' THEN SUBSTR(REPLACE(billing_date,'-',''),1,8)
                            ELSE SUBSTR(billing_date,1,8)
                    END
                ) AS billing_date
        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu')
        GROUP BY product_barcode
) d
ON a.prod_barcode = d.product_barcode

where  nvl(a.sales_num,0) <>0 or nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0) <>0
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp01 AS
SELECT  a.data_date AS data_date
        ,a.dist_code AS dist_code
        ,NVL(a.store_category,'其它') AS store_category
        ,NVL(a.store_category_lv1,'其它') AS store_category_lv1
        ,a.second_layer_dist_code
        ,a.second_layer_dist_name
        ,a.store_code
        ,a.store_name
        ,a.bu_2
        ,a.prod_barcode
        ,a.billing_date AS billing_date
        ,a.metric_type
        ,MAX(a.data_date) OVER (PARTITION BY a.metric_type,a.dist_code,a.second_layer_dist_code,a.prod_barcode ) AS data_date_max
        ,SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.min_date_bill,'yyyymmdd'),5),'-',''),1,6) AS billing_month_max
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT 
              IF(sales_num_month_bill_ttl > 0 AND data_date >= a.min_date_bill AND SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.min_date_bill,'yyyymmdd'),5),'-',''),1,6),SUBSTR(a.data_date,1,6),NULL)
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY a.metric_type,a.dist_code,a.second_layer_dist_code,a.prod_barcode,IF(data_date >= a.min_date_bill AND SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.min_date_bill,'yyyymmdd'),5),'-',''),1,6),1,0) ) AS month_nums_bill
        ,IF(data_date >= a.min_date_bill AND SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) <= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.min_date_bill,'yyyymmdd'),5),'-',''),1,6),sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_bill
        ,sales_num
        ,sales_num_month_ttl
FROM    (
            --只统计当月销量>0的
            SELECT  o.*
                    ,m.sales_num AS sales_num_month_ttl
                    ,m.sales_num_bill AS sales_num_month_bill_ttl
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp001 o
            JOIN    (
                        SELECT  metric_type
                                ,dist_code
                                ,second_layer_dist_code
                                ,prod_barcode
                                ,data_month
                                ,SUM(IF(data_date >= min_date_bill,sales_num,0)) AS sales_num_bill
                                ,SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp001
                        GROUP BY metric_type
                                 ,dist_code
                                 ,second_layer_dist_code
                                 ,prod_barcode
                                 ,data_month
                    ) m
            ON      NVL(o.dist_code,'') = NVL(m.dist_code,'')
            AND     NVL(o.second_layer_dist_code,'') = NVL(m.second_layer_dist_code,'')
            AND     NVL(o.prod_barcode,'') = NVL(m.prod_barcode,'')
            AND     NVL(o.data_month,'') = NVL(m.data_month,'')
            AND     NVL(o.metric_type,'') = NVL(m.metric_type,'')
        ) AS a
JOIN    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp00 b
ON      NVL(a.prod_barcode,'') = NVL(b.prod_barcode,'')
AND     NVL(a.second_layer_dist_code,'') = NVL(b.second_layer_dist_code,'')
AND     NVL(a.dist_code,'') = NVL(b.dist_code,'')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp02 AS
SELECT  data_date
        ,dist_code
        ,store_category
        ,store_category_lv1
        ,second_layer_dist_code
        ,second_layer_dist_name
        ,store_code
        ,store_name
        ,bu_2
        ,prod_barcode
        ,billing_date
        ,metric_type
        ,data_date_max
        ,billing_month_max
        ,month_nums_bill
        ,sales_num_bill
        ,sales_num
        ,SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_date_max,'yyyymmdd'),-5),'-',''),1,6) AS data_months_min
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT 
              IF(sales_num_month_ttl > 0 AND SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) >= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_date_max,'yyyymmdd'),-5),'-',''),1,6)
              AND     data_date <= data_date_max,SUBSTR(data_date,1,6),NULL)
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY metric_type,dist_code,second_layer_dist_code,prod_barcode,IF(SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) >= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_date_max,'yyyymmdd'),-5),'-',''),1,6)
        AND     data_date <= data_date_max,1,0) ) AS month_nums_sales
        ,IF(SUBSTR(data_date,1,6) >= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_date_max,'yyyymmdd'),-5),'-',''),1,6)
        AND     data_date <= data_date_max,sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_sales
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp01

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  NVL(b.channel_name_lastest,'Others') AS channel_name
        ,NVL(b.region_lastest,'Others') AS region_cn
        ,NVL(b.province_lastest,'Others') AS province_cn
        ,a.dist_code
        ,NVL(b.customer_name,'Others') AS dist_name_cn
        ,a.store_category AS 2nd_layer_dist_type
        ,a.store_category_lv1 AS 2nd_layer_dist_type_lv1
        ,a.second_layer_dist_code AS 2nd_layer_dist_code
        ,a.second_layer_dist_name AS 2nd_layer_dist_name
        ,a.store_code
        ,a.store_name
        ,a.bu_2 AS bu
        ,NVL(c.category_name,'Others') AS category_name_cn
        ,NVL(c.product_name,'Others') AS product_name
        ,a.prod_barcode AS product_barcode
        ,a.billing_date
        ,a.metric_type
        ,'${bizmonth}' AS end_month
        ,CAST(IF(NVL(MAX(month_nums_bill),0) = 0,NULL,SUM(sales_num_bill) / MAX(month_nums_bill)) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS first_six_months_avg_sales_num
        ,CAST(IF(NVL(MAX(month_nums_sales),0) = 0,NULL,SUM(sales_num_sales) / MAX(month_nums_sales)) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS latest_six_months_avg_sales_num
        ,FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(now())) AS extract_time
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_sku_cp_temp02 AS a
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  DISTINCT bu_2
                        ,customer_code
                        ,customer_name
                        ,channel_name_lastest
                        ,region_lastest
                        ,province_lastest
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
            ) b
ON      a.dist_code = b.customer_code

                SELECT  product_barcode

                        ,product_name
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
            ) c
ON      a.prod_barcode = c.product_barcode
WHERE   (
            sales_num_bill IS NOT NULL
            OR      sales_num_sales IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY NVL(b.channel_name_lastest,'Others')
         ,NVL(b.region_lastest,'Others')
         ,NVL(b.province_lastest,'Others')
         ,a.dist_code
         ,NVL(b.customer_name,'Others')

         ,a.second_layer_dist_name

INSERT OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_detail_cp partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT 
    channel_name,
    region_cn,
    province_cn,
    dist_code,
    dist_name AS dist_name_cn,  -- 别名匹配目标字段
    second_layer_dist_type,
    second_layer_dist_type_lv1,
    second_layer_dist_code,
    second_layer_dist_name,
    store_code,
    store_name,
    product_name,
    product_barcode,
    bu,
    category_name_cn,
    metric_code,
    metric_name,
    data_year,
    end_month,
    -- 时间维度聚合
    cast(SUM(metric_value)as decimal(28,6)) AS YTD,  -- 全年汇总
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN half_year IN ('H1') THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS H1,  -- 上半年
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN half_year IN ('H2') THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS H2,  -- 下半年
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(data_quarter,5) = 'Q1' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Q1,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(data_quarter,5) = 'Q2' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Q2,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(data_quarter,5) = 'Q3' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Q3,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(data_quarter,5) = 'Q4' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Q4,
    -- 月度数据
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '01' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Jan,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '02' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Feb,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '03' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Mar,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '04' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Apr,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '05' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS May,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '06' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Jun,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '07' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Jul,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '08' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Aug,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '09' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Sep,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '10' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Oct,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '11' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Nov,
    cast(SUM(CASE WHEN substr(month_detail,5) = '12' THEN metric_value ELSE 0 END)as decimal(28,6)) AS Dec,
    GETDATE() AS extract_time  -- 当前时间作为同步时间
FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_detail_cp_temp_01
GROUP BY 
    channel_name,
    region_cn,
    province_cn,
    dist_code,
    dist_name,  -- 原始表字段名
    second_layer_dist_type,
    second_layer_dist_type_lv1,
    second_layer_dist_code,
    second_layer_dist_name,
    store_code,
    store_name,
    product_name,
    product_barcode,
    bu,
    category_name_cn,
    metric_code,
    metric_name,
    data_year,
    end_month,
    GETDATE()

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_cp_fin_temp_01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_cp_fin_temp_01 AS
SELECT  channel_name
        ,region_cn
        ,province_cn
        ,dist_code
        ,dist_name_cn
        ,bu
        ,category_name_cn
        ,metric_code
        ,metric_name
        ,SUM(metric_value) AS metric_value
        ,SUBSTR(data_month,1,4) AS data_year
        ,data_month AS data_month
        ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(data_month,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'))) AS data_quarter
        ,CASE   WHEN MONTH(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm')) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
                ELSE 'H2'
        END AS half_year
FROM    (
            --KE24数据,到品类
            SELECT  first_channel_name_lastest AS channel_name
                    ,henkel_region_lastest AS region_cn
                    ,province_lastest AS province_cn
                    ,customer_id AS dist_code
                    ,customer_name AS dist_name_cn
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_type
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_type_lv1
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_code
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_name
                    ,NULL AS store_code
                    ,NULL AS store_name
                    ,bu_2 AS bu
                    ,henkel_category AS category_name_cn
                    ,'FIN_0001' AS metric_code
                    ,'GES' AS metric_name
                    ,ges AS metric_value
                    ,SUBSTR(ds,1,6) AS data_month
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
            WHERE  substr(ds,1,4)>=substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1
               --ds >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CONCAT(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4),'0101'),'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd')
            AND     ds <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')
            AND     first_channel_name_lastest = 'MPD'
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  channel_name
                    ,region_cn
                    ,province_cn
                    ,dist_code
                    ,dist_name_cn
                    ,second_layer_dist_type
                    ,second_layer_dist_type_lv1
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,bu
                    ,category_name_cn
                    ,metric_code
                    ,metric_name
                    ,metric_value
                    ,data_month
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  first_channel_name_lastest AS channel_name
                                ,henkel_region_lastest AS region_cn
                                ,province_lastest AS province_cn
                                ,customer_id AS dist_code
                                ,customer_name AS dist_name_cn
                                ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_type
                                ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_type_lv1
                                ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_code
                                ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_name
                                ,NULL AS store_code
                                ,NULL AS store_name
                                ,bu_2 AS bu
                                ,henkel_category AS category_name_cn
                                ,'FIN_0002' AS metric_code
                                ,'新品铺货GES' AS metric_name
                                ,ges AS metric_value
                                ,SUBSTR(ds,1,6) AS data_month
                                ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id,t.product_id ORDER BY t.ds ASC ) AS rn
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu t
                        JOIN    (
                                    SELECT  TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy') AS billing_years
                                            ,product_code
                                            ,MIN(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')) AS billing_date
                                    FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_bu
                                    WHERE   ds <> ''

SELECT  t.channel_name

        ,t1.province_lastest AS province_cn
        ,t.dist_code

        ,t.bu

        ,t2.metric_value as l6

                    ,SUBSTR(months,1,4) AS data_year
                    ,CONCAT(SUBSTR(months,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(months,'yyyymm'))) AS data_quarter

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_cp_inv_temp_02 AS
SELECT  channel_name
        ,region_cn
        ,province_cn
        ,dist_code
        ,dist_name
        ,bu
        ,category_name_cn
        ,data_year 
        ,case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then dec
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%01' then jan
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%03' then mar
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%06' then jun
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%09' then sep
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%12' then dec
        end as ytd,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then jun
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%01' then jan
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%03' then mar
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
        else jun
        end as h1,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then dec
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%09' then sep
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
        else dec
        end as h2,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then mar
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%01' then jan
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
        else mar
        end as q1,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then jun
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
        else jun
        end as q2,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then sep
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
        else sep
        end as q3,
        case when data_year<substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) then dec
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
             when '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
        else dec
        end as q4
        ,COALESCE(jan,NULL) AS jan
        ,COALESCE(feb,NULL) AS feb
        ,COALESCE(mar,NULL) AS mar
        ,COALESCE(apr,NULL) AS apr
        ,COALESCE(may,NULL) AS may
        ,COALESCE(jun,NULL) AS jun
        ,COALESCE(jul,NULL) AS jul
        ,COALESCE(aug,NULL) AS aug
        ,COALESCE(sep,NULL) AS sep
        ,COALESCE(oct,NULL) AS oct
        ,COALESCE(nov,NULL) AS nov
        ,COALESCE(dec,NULL) AS dec
FROM    (
            SELECT  channel_name
                    ,region_cn
                    ,province_cn
                    ,dist_code
                    ,dist_name
                    ,bu
                    ,category_name_cn
                    ,SUBSTR(stock_month,1,4) AS data_year -- 使用MAX和CASE WHEN进行行转列，得到每个月的值
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '01' THEN metric_value END) AS jan
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '02' THEN metric_value END) AS feb

                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '08' THEN metric_value END) AS aug
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '09' THEN metric_value END) AS sep
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '10' THEN metric_value END) AS oct
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '11' THEN metric_value END) AS nov
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '12' THEN metric_value END) AS dec
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_bb_cp_inv_temp_01
            GROUP BY channel_name
                     ,region_cn
                     ,province_cn
                     ,dist_code

                     ,category_name_cn

insert
  overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
select 
  year_id
  ,quarter_id
  ,t.mapping_time as month_id
  ,t.time_now as day_id
  ,case when t.time_now  like '%0229' then null else time_yoy end as time_yoy 
  ,case when substr(time_now,5,2) in('05','07','10','12') and substr(time_now,7,2) ='31' then null
        when ((cast(substr(time_now,1,4) as bigint) %4=0  and cast(substr(time_now,1,4) as bigint) %100 != 0) or cast(substr(time_now,1,4)as bigint)%400=0)
        and substr(time_now,5,2) in('03') and substr(time_now,7,2) in('30','31') then null
        when cast(substr(time_now,1,4) as bigint) %4 <>0 and substr(time_now,5,2) in('03') and substr(time_now,7,2) in('29','30','31') then null
  else  time_mom end as time_mom
  ,month_start                                        -- 月初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',month_end) as month_end         -- 月末时间
  ,quarter_start                                      -- 季初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',quarter_end) as quarter_end     -- 季末时间
  ,year_start                                         -- 年初时间
  ,least('${bizdate}',year_end) as year_end           -- 年末时间
   from(
 select mapping_time,time_now,time_yoy,time_mom from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time where ds =MAX_PT('dme_ads.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time')
 and  time_type='C.月' and (time_now not like '%a' or time_now is null)
 and (length (time_now) <>6 or time_now is null) and mapping_time >='202001'
) t left join(
     select distinct
   year_id
   ,quarter_id
   ,month_id
   ,concat(month_id,'01') as month_start
   ,to_char(date(last_day(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))),'yyyymmdd')  as month_end
   ,to_char(date(
     add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')))- 1)
      ,-(pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3)))
     ),'yyyymmdd') AS quarter_start
   ,to_char(date(
      last_day(add_months(date_sub(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd')), dayofmonth(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1)
      ,+  (2 - pmod(month(date(to_date(day_id,'yyyymmdd'))) - 1, 3))))
     ),'yyyymmdd')  AS quarter_end
   ,concat(year_id,'0101')  as year_start
   ,concat(year_id,'1231')  as year_end
 from dme_cdm.dim_day
 where month_id >='202001' and day_id <= '${bizdate}'
)t1 on t.mapping_time=t1.month_id

-- 月度新店标签 加工
--截至统计周期末近2个自然年的首次动销日期落在统计周期内的门店，以门店为维度判断
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT   data_year
        ,data_quarter
        ,data_month
        ,month_start -- 月初时间
        ,month_end -- 月末时间
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
        ,IF(month_start <= data_date_min,'1','0') AS new_store_flag
FROM    (
            SELECT  a.data_year
                    ,a.data_quarter
                    ,a.data_month
                    ,a.month_start -- 月初时间
                    ,a.month_end -- 月末时间
                    ,b.henkel_store_code
                    ,MIN(b.data_date_min) AS data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  DISTINCT quarter_id as data_quarter
                                ,year_id as data_year
                                ,month_id as data_month
                                ,month_start
                                ,month_end
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                    ) a
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  data_month
                                    ,henkel_store_code
                                    ,MIN(data_date) AS data_date_min
                                    ,'1' AS flag
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
                            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
                            and sales_num is not null 
                            GROUP BY data_month
                                     ,henkel_store_code
                        ) b
            ON      a.flag = b.flag
            AND     SUBSTR(b.data_month,1,4) BETWEEN SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4) - 1 AND SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4)
            AND     a.data_month >= b.data_month
            WHERE   b.henkel_store_code IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY a.data_year
                     ,a.data_quarter
                     ,a.data_month
                     ,a.month_start -- 月初时间
                     ,a.month_end -- 月末时间
                     ,b.henkel_store_code
        )

SELECT  billing_years
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_listing_date
        ,DECODE(relaunch_tag,1,'是','否') as relaunch_tag

                    ,product_barcode
                    ,MIN(to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')) AS product_listing_date

            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            WHERE   ds <>'' 
             and upper(substr(replace(npd,' ',''),4,3))='NPD'
              and nvl(trim(replace(billing_date,'-','')),'')<>''
            GROUP BY to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy')
                     ,product_barcode
        ) t

                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.25 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.30 THEN '[25%,30%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.30 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.35 THEN '[30%,35%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.35 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.40 THEN '[35%,40%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.40 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.45 THEN '[40%,45%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.45 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.50 THEN '[45%,50%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.50 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.55 THEN '[50%,55%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.55 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.60 THEN '[55%,60%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.60 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.65 THEN '[60%,65%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.65 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.70 THEN '[65%,70%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.70 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.75 THEN '[70%,75%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.75 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.80 THEN '[75%,80%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.80 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.85 THEN '[80%,85%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.85 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.90 THEN '[85%,90%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.90 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 0.95 THEN '[90%,95%)'
                WHEN t0.discount_price_rate_py >= 0.95 AND t0.discount_price_rate_py < 1 THEN '[95%,100%)'
        END AS discount_price_level2_py -- 二级价格折扣（老品老店）
        ,nvl(t1.product_listing_date,t2.product_listing_date) as product_listing_date -- 上市日期
        ,IF(t1.product_listing_date <= t0.data_date AND SUBSTR(t1.product_listing_date,1,4) = SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4),'Y','N') AS newprod_flag -- 新品
        ,if(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(t2.product_listing_date,'yyyymmdd')) BETWEEN 0 AND 364,'Y','N') AS sub_new_prod_flag-- 次新品
        ,IF(t24.product_listing_date <= to_char(dateadd(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymmdd') AND SUBSTR(t24.product_listing_date,1,4) = SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4)-1,'Y','N') AS newprod_flag_py -- 同比新品标签
        ,if(DATEDIFF(dateadd(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),TO_DATE(t25.product_listing_date,'yyyymmdd')) BETWEEN 0 AND 364 ,'Y','N')AS sub_new_prod_flag_py -- 同比次新品
        ,CASE   WHEN (NVL(t3.rate_mon,0) > 1.5 OR NVL(t3.rate_py,0) > 1.5) AND (t3.rate_mon IS NULL OR t3.rate_py IS NULL) THEN 'Y'
                WHEN (NVL(t3.rate_mon,0) > 1.5 AND NVL(t3.rate_py,0) > 1.5 )AND (t3.rate_mon IS NOT NULL AND t3.rate_py IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y'
                ELSE 'N'
        END AS block_trades_flag -- 团购/大宗
        ,nvl(t1.relaunch_tag,t2.relaunch_tag) as relaunch_tag
        ,t0.sales_num
        ,t0.sales_amount_untax as sales_amt_untax
        ,t0.sales_num * t23.product_base_price AS base_amt_untax
        ,t0.sales_num * t23.retail_price_untax AS rsp_amt_untax
        ,t0.sales_num_py
        ,t0.sales_num_py * t23.product_base_price AS base_amt_untax_py
        ,t0.sales_num_py * t23.retail_price_untax AS rsp_amt_untax_py --  ,'' as block_trades_flag
        ,t0.sales_amount_py as sales_amt_untax_py
        ,nvl(t22.region,'Others') as region
        ,nvl(t22.province,'Others') as province
        ,nvl(t22.customer_name,'Others') AS dist_name
        ,t22.channel_name_lastest as channel_name
        ,CONCAT(t22.customer_name,'-',t0.dist_code) AS dist_desc
        ,nvl(t0.store_category,'其它') AS store_category
        ,nvl(t0.store_category_lv1,'其它') AS store_category_lv1
        ,nvl(t23.category_name,'Others') as category_name
        ,nvl(t23.first_product_function,'Others') as first_product_function
        ,nvl(t23.brand_name,'Others') as brand_name
        ,nvl(t23.product_line,'Others') as product_line
        ,nvl(t23.product_name,'Others') as product_name
        ,CONCAT(NVL(t23.product_name,'Others'),'-',t0.prod_barcode) AS sku
FROM    (
            SELECT  data_year
                    ,data_quarter
                    ,data_month
                    ,month_start
                    ,month_end
                    ,quarter_start
                    ,quarter_end
                    ,year_start
                    ,year_end
                    ,data_date
                    ,dist_code
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,henkel_store_name
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,ka_first_channel_name
                    ,ka_second_channel_name
                    ,ka_third_channel_name
                    ,ka_code
                    ,ka_name
                    ,ka_type
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,sales_num
                    ,sales_num_py
                    ,sales_amount_untax
                    ,sales_amount_py
                    ,discount_price_rate
                    ,discount_price_rate_py
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
            and data_year >= YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -2, 'yyyy'))
            and (abs(nvl(sales_num,0))+abs(nvl(sales_num_py,0))
            +abs(nvl(sales_amount_untax,0))+abs(nvl(sales_amount_py,0)) <>0)
        ) t0
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t1
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t1.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t1.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t2
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t2.billing_years + 1
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t2.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t24
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4)-1 = t24.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t24.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t25
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4)-1 = t25.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t25.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN   (
SELECT  t.data_date
                        ,t.henkel_store_code
                        ,t.prod_barcode
                        ,CASE   WHEN NVL(sales_amount_mom_daily_avg,0) = 0 THEN NULL
                                ELSE (
                                    sales_amount_untax_daily_avg - sales_amount_mom_daily_avg
                        ) / abs(sales_amount_mom_daily_avg)
                        END AS rate_mon
                        ,CASE   WHEN NVL(sales_amount_py_daily_avg,0) = 0 THEN NULL
                                ELSE (
                                    sales_amount_untax_daily_avg - sales_amount_py_daily_avg
                        ) / abs(sales_amount_py_daily_avg)
                        END AS rate_py
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  data_date
                                    ,data_month
                                    ,henkel_store_code
                                    ,prod_barcode
                                    ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) as sales_amount_untax_daily_avg
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
                            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
                            and   sales_amount_untax is not null
                            GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                     ,prod_barcode
                                     ,data_date
                                     ,data_month
                        ) t
                left JOIN   ( --环比
                                SELECT  replace(substr(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),1),1,7),'-','') AS data_month 
                                        ,henkel_store_code
                                        ,prod_barcode
                                        ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) / COUNT(DISTINCT data_date) AS sales_amount_mom_daily_avg
                                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
                                where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
                                and   sales_amount_untax is not null
                                GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                         ,prod_barcode
                                         ,replace(substr(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),1),1,7),'-','') 
                            ) t1
                ON      t.data_month = t1.data_month
                AND     t.henkel_store_code = t1.henkel_store_code
                AND     t.prod_barcode = t1.prod_barcode
                left JOIN    ( --同比
                                SELECT  replace(substr(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-','') AS data_month 
                                        ,henkel_store_code
                                        ,prod_barcode
                                        ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) / COUNT(DISTINCT data_date) AS sales_amount_py_daily_avg
                                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
                                where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
                                and   sales_amount_untax is not null
                                GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                         ,prod_barcode
                                         ,replace(substr(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-','') 
                            ) t2
                ON      t.data_month = t2.data_month
                AND     t.henkel_store_code = t2.henkel_store_code
                AND     t.prod_barcode = t2.prod_barcode
            ) t3
ON      t0.data_date = t3.data_date
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t3.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t3.prod_barcode 
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  customer_code
                        ,customer_name
                        ,channel_name_lastest
                        ,region_lastest as region
                        ,province_lastest as province
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
            ) t22
ON      t0.dist_code = t22.customer_code
AND     t0.bu_1 = t22.bu_1
and     t0.bu_2 = t22.bu_2
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,retail_price_tax / 1.13 AS retail_price_untax
                        ,product_base_price
                        ,category_name
                        ,product_function_cn as first_product_function
                        ,sub_product_function_cn as sub_product_function
                        ,brand_name
                        ,product_line
                        ,product_name
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
            ) t23
ON      t0.prod_barcode = t23.product_barcode

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_year_temp_add_vs

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_year_temp_add_vs as 
select 
  o.data_month,
  o.date_type,
  concat(o.date_value,' YTD') as date_value,
  o.month_detail,
  o.date_end,
  t0.dist_code,
  t0.dist_name,
  t0.dist_desc,
  t0.region,
  t0.province,
  t0.prod_barcode,
  t0.category_name,
  t0.first_product_function,
  t0.brand_name,
  t0.product_line,
  t0.product_name,
  t0.sku,
  t0.bu_1,
  t0.bu_2,
  t0.product_listing_date,
  t0.relaunch_tag,
  t0.ka_type,
  t0.store_category,
  t0.store_category_lv1,
  t0.henkel_store_code,
  t0.henkel_store_name,
  t0.ka_first_channel_name,
  t0.ka_second_channel_name,
  t0.ka_third_channel_name,
  t0.ka_code,
  t0.ka_name,
  t0.second_layer_dist_code,
  t0.second_layer_dist_name,
  case when ((t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag ='1' and DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(t5.data_date_min,'yyyymmdd'))> 179) or nvl(t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'0') ='0') 
  and ((newprod_flag = 'Y' and DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(t0.product_listing_date,'yyyymmdd'))> 179) or newprod_flag = 'N')
  and ((nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' and DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(t1.data_date_min,'yyyymmdd'))> 179) or t1.new_store_flag ='0')
  and block_trades_flag ='Y' then 'Y'
  else 'N' end as block_trades_flag,
  case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'') <>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'') <>'1' then discount_price_level1 else null end as discount_price_level1,
  case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'') <>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'') <>'1' then discount_price_level2 else null end as discount_price_level2,
  discount_price_level1_py,
  discount_price_level2_py,
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax,
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax,  --当期老品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y'  then sales_amt_untax end) as sub_newprod_amt_untax, --当期次新品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')='Y' then sales_amt_untax_py end) as newprod_amt_untax_py,
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' then sales_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_amt_untax_py,  --当期老品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag_py,'')='Y'  then sales_amt_untax_py end) as sub_newprod_amt_untax_py, --当期次新品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t9.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax_py, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' then sales_num end) as newprod_sales_num,	 -- 当期新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then sales_num end) as oldprod_sales_num,      -- 当期老品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y'  then sales_num end) as Sub_newprod_sales_num,  -- 当期次新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num end)    as new_store_sales_num, -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as close_store_sales_num,-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as oldprod_onshelves_sales_num,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as newprod_sales_num_py,  -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_sales_num_py,  -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag_py,'')='Y'  then sales_num_py end) as sub_newprod_sales_num_py, --当期次新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num_py end)   as new_store_sales_num_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as close_store_sales_num_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_onshelves_sales_num_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t9.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num_py, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(sales_amt_untax) as sales_amt_untax,
  sum(sales_num) as sales_num,
  sum(sales_amt_untax_py) as sales_amt_untax_py,
  sum(sales_num_py) as sales_num_py,
  sum(base_amt_untax) as base_amt_untax,
  sum(base_amt_untax_py) as base_amt_untax_py,
  sum(rsp_amt_untax) as rsp_amt_untax,
  sum(rsp_amt_untax_py) as  rsp_amt_untax_py,
  t1.data_date_min as new_store_first_sales_date,
  t10.max_data_date as close_store_sales_date,
  t5.data_date_min as oldprod_onshelves_date,
  t11.max_data_date as oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date,
  t0.store_code_concat
 from (
SELECT  t.month_id AS data_month
        ,'YTD' AS date_type
        ,t.year_id AS date_value
        ,t1.month_id AS month_detail
        ,t.year_end AS date_end
FROM    (
            SELECT  month_id,year_id,year_end
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
            and   month_id in ('${bizmonth}',concat(YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizmonth}', 'yyyymm'), -1, 'yyyy')),'12'))
            GROUP BY month_id,year_id,year_end
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  month_id,year_id,year_end
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                GROUP BY month_id,year_id,year_end
            ) t1
ON      t.year_id = t1.year_id
AND     t.month_id >= t1.month_id
) o left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs t0
on o.month_detail = t0.data_month
--当月新店标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_year_temp_add_vs t1  --1代表新店 0 代表非新店
ON      o.data_month = t1.month_id
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t1.henkel_store_code 
--同比月新店标签
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_year_temp_add_vs t2
ON      SUBSTR(o.data_month,1,4) = SUBSTR(t2.month_id,1,4) + 1
AND     SUBSTR(o.data_month,5,6) = SUBSTR(t2.month_id,5,6)
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t2.henkel_store_code 
--当月闭店标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_close_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs t3 --'N' 代表非闭店
ON      o.data_month = t3.data_month
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t3.henkel_store_code 
--同比月闭店标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_close_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs t4
ON      SUBSTR(o.data_month,1,4) = SUBSTR(t4.data_month,1,4) + 1
AND     SUBSTR(o.data_month,5,6) = SUBSTR(t4.data_month,5,6)
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t4.henkel_store_code 

left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_onshelves_date_year_temp_add_vs t5 --年度新上架日期
on o.date_value = t5.data_year
and t0.henkel_store_code=t5.henkel_store_code
and t0.prod_barcode=t5.prod_barcode
--新上架标签
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_onshelves_flag_year_temp_add_vs t6 --oldprod_onshelves_flag 1 代表新上架
on  o.date_value=t6.data_year
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t6.henkel_store_code
AND t0.prod_barcode=t6.prod_barcode
--同比新上架标签
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_onshelves_flag_year_temp_add_vs t7 --oldprod_onshelves_flag 1 代表新上架
ON      o.date_value = t7.data_year + 1
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t7.henkel_store_code
AND t0.prod_barcode=t7.prod_barcode
--下架标签
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_offshelves_flag_month_temp_add_vs t8  --oldprod_offshelves_flag 1代表下架
on  o.data_month=t8.data_month
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t8.henkel_store_code
AND t0.prod_barcode=t8.prod_barcode
--同比下架标签
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_offshelves_flag_month_temp_add_vs t9  --oldprod_offshelves_flag 1代表下架
ON      SUBSTR(o.data_month,1,4) = SUBSTR(t9.data_month,1,4) + 1
AND     SUBSTR(o.data_month,5,6) = SUBSTR(t9.data_month,5,6)
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t9.henkel_store_code
AND t0.prod_barcode=t9.prod_barcode
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_close_store_recent_sales_date_temp_add_vs t10
on  o.data_month=t10.data_month
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t10.henkel_store_code
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_offshelves_oldprod_recent_sales_date_temp_add_vs t11
on  o.data_month=t11.data_month
AND t0.henkel_store_code=t11.henkel_store_code
AND t0.prod_barcode=t11.prod_barcode
group by   o.data_month,

--sellout

        ,t.ka_type

        ,t.store_category_lv1

        ,t3.sales_num AS sales_num_py
        ,t2.rsp_amt_untax as rsp_amt_untax
        ,t3.rsp_amt_untax as rsp_amt_untax_py
        ,t2.base_amt_untax  as base_amt_untax
        ,t3.base_amt_untax as base_amt_untax_py
        ,decode(t.value_type,'二分商非空pos','pos',t.value_type) as value_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  dist_code
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,ka_code
                    ,ka_name
                    ,ka_first_channel_name
                    ,ka_second_channel_name
                    ,ka_third_channel_name
                    ,ka_type
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,value_type
                    ,'1' AS flag
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid
            where  ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
            and value_type <>'pos'
            and data_date >= CONCAT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -2, 'yyyy')) AS STRING),'0101')
            GROUP BY dist_code
                     ,store_code_concat
                     ,store_code
                     ,store_name
                     ,second_layer_dist_code
                     ,second_layer_dist_name
                     ,ka_code
                     ,ka_name
                     ,ka_first_channel_name
                     ,ka_second_channel_name
                     ,ka_third_channel_name
                     ,ka_type
                     ,store_category
                     ,store_category_lv1
                     ,prod_barcode
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
                     ,value_type
        ) t
JOIN    (
            SELECT  '1' AS flag
                    ,*
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
            and year_id>=YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -2, 'yyyy'))
        ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid t2
ON      t.store_code = t2.store_code
AND     t.dist_code = t2.dist_code
AND     t.prod_barcode = t2.prod_barcode
AND     t1.day_id = t2.data_date
AND     t.second_layer_dist_code =t2.second_layer_dist_code
and     t.value_type = t2.value_type
and     nvl(t.store_code_concat,'') = nvl(t2.store_code_concat,'')
and     t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid t3
ON      t.store_code = t3.store_code
AND     t.dist_code = t3.dist_code
AND     t.prod_barcode = t3.prod_barcode
AND     t1.time_yoy = t3.data_date
and     t.value_type = t3.value_type
AND     t.second_layer_dist_code =t3.second_layer_dist_code
and     nvl(t.store_code_concat,'') = nvl(t3.store_code_concat,'')
and    t3.ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
where t2.sales_num is not null or t3.sales_num is not null
