-- 月度新客户标签（老品新客户）
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_month_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_month_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT  data_year
        ,data_quarter
        ,data_month
        ,month_start -- 月初时间
        ,month_end -- 月末时间
        ,second_layer_dist_code
        ,data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
        ,IF(month_start <= data_date_min,'1','0') AS new_store_flag
FROM    (
            SELECT  a.data_year
                    ,a.data_quarter
                    ,a.data_month
                    ,a.month_start -- 月初时间
                    ,a.month_end -- 月末时间
                    ,b.second_layer_dist_code
                    ,MIN(b.data_date_min) AS data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  DISTINCT year_id as data_year
                                ,quarter_id as data_quarter
                                ,month_id as data_month
                                ,month_start
                                ,month_end
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                    ) a
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  data_month
                                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                                    ,MIN(data_date) AS data_date_min
                                    ,'1' AS flag
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp02_add_vs
                            WHERE   sales_num IS NOT NULL
                            AND     value_type = 'sellout'
                            GROUP BY data_month
                                     ,second_layer_dist_code
                        ) b
            ON      a.flag = b.flag
            AND     SUBSTR(b.data_month,1,4) BETWEEN SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4) - 1 AND SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4)
            AND     a.data_month >= b.data_month
            WHERE   b.second_layer_dist_code IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY a.data_year
                     ,a.data_quarter
                     ,a.data_month
                     ,a.month_start -- 月初时间
                     ,a.month_end -- 月末时间
                     ,b.second_layer_dist_code
        )

--年新客户标签（老品新客户）
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_year_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_year_temp_add_vs AS
 SELECT  t.year_id
        ,t.month_id
        ,t1.second_layer_dist_code
        ,MAX(t1.new_store_flag) AS new_store_flag
        ,MIN(data_date_min) AS data_date_min
FROM    (
            SELECT  year_id
                    ,month_id
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
            GROUP BY year_id
                     ,month_id
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  data_year
                        ,data_month
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                        ,new_store_flag
                        ,data_date_min
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_month_temp_add_vs
            ) t1
ON      t.year_id = t1.data_year
AND     t.month_id >= t1.data_month
where second_layer_dist_code is not null 
group by t.year_id
        ,t.month_id
        ,t1.second_layer_dist_code

-- 月度流失客户标签加工（老品老客户）

--截至统计周期末近180天无Sell-out动销的客户，以经销商下的客户编码为维度判断，仅统计老品、老客户Sell-out
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_close_customer_flag_month_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_close_customer_flag_month_temp_add_vs AS
 select
   a.data_month
   ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,b.second_layer_dist_code
   ,max(b.data_date) as data_date
   ,MIN(IF(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.data_date,'yyyymmdd'))between 0 and 179,'N','Y')) AS close_store_flag
 from(
     select distinct
       month_id as data_month
       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
     where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
 ) a
 inner join (
     select
       data_month,max(data_date) as data_date
       ,second_layer_dist_code
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp02_add_vs
     where sales_num is not null and value_type ='sellout'
     group by data_month,second_layer_dist_code
 ) b
  on a.flag=b.flag
 group by
  a.data_month
  ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
  ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
  ,b.second_layer_dist_code

 select
   a.data_month
   ,a.month_start   -- 月初时间
   ,a.month_end     -- 月末时间
   ,b.second_layer_dist_code
   ,max(b.data_date) as max_data_date
 from(
     select distinct
       month_id as data_month
       ,month_start   -- 月初时间
       ,month_end     -- 月末时间
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
     where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
 ) a
 inner join (
     select
        data_month,max(data_date) as data_date
       ,second_layer_dist_code
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp02_add_vs
     where sales_num is not null and value_type ='sellout'
     group by data_month
       ,second_layer_dist_code
 ) b
  on a.flag=b.flag
 where DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_end,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.data_date,'yyyymmdd'))>179

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_expand_prod_flag_year_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_expand_prod_flag_year_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT  a.data_year
        ,a.year_start -- 月初时间
        ,a.year_end -- 月末时间
        ,b.second_layer_dist_code
        ,b.prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
        ,MIN(IF(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.year_start,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(b.data_date,'yyyymmdd')) >= 1,0,1)) AS expand_prod_flag
FROM    (
     select 
       year_id as data_year
       ,year_start   -- 月初时间
       ,year_end     -- 月末时间
       ,'1' AS flag
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
     where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
     group by 
       year_id
       ,year_start   -- 月初时间
       ,year_end     -- 月末时间
        ) a
INNER JOIN  (
    --扩分销需要看历史所有是否有售卖,需要用全量数据进行计算
                SELECT  substr(data_date,1,4) as data_year,max(data_date) AS data_date
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                        ,prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
                        ,'1' as flag
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid
                WHERE   ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid')
                and sales_num IS NOT NULL and value_type ='sellout'
                GROUP BY substr(data_date,1,4)
                         ,second_layer_dist_code
                         ,prod_barcode
            ) b
ON    a.flag = b.flag 
GROUP BY a.data_year
         ,a.year_start -- 月初时间
         ,a.year_end -- 月末时间
         ,b.second_layer_dist_code
         ,b.prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码

--老品下架（老品老客户）--统计周期末近180天无Sell-out动销的SKU
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_offshelves_prod_flag_month_temp_add_vs

                SELECT  max(data_date) AS data_date
                        ,data_month
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                        ,prod_barcode -- 汉高产品条码
                        ,'1' AS flag
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp02_add_vs

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT  billing_years
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_listing_date
        ,DECODE(relaunch_tag,1,'是','否') as relaunch_tag
FROM    (
            SELECT  to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy') as billing_years
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,MIN(to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')) AS product_listing_date
                    ,MAX(DECODE(relaunch,'是',1,0)) AS relaunch_tag
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            WHERE   ds <>'' 
             and upper(substr(replace(npd,' ',''),4,3))='NPD'
              and nvl(trim(replace(billing_date,'-','')),'')<>''
            GROUP BY to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy')
                     ,product_barcode
        ) t
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp03_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp03_add_vs AS
SELECT  --标签汇总
        t0.data_date
        ,t0.data_year
        ,t0.data_quarter
        ,t0.data_month
        ,t0.month_start
        ,t0.month_end
        ,t0.quarter_start
        ,t0.quarter_end
        ,t0.year_start
        ,t0.year_end
        ,t0.dist_code
        ,t0.store_code_concat
        ,t0.store_code as henkel_store_code
        ,t0.store_name as henkel_store_name
        ,t0.second_layer_dist_code
        ,t0.second_layer_dist_name
        ,t0.ka_code
        ,t0.ka_name
        ,t0.ka_first_channel_name
        ,t0.ka_second_channel_name
        ,t0.ka_third_channel_name
        ,t0.ka_type
        ,t0.prod_barcode
        ,t0.bu_1
        ,t0.bu_2
        ,nvl(t1.product_listing_date,t2.product_listing_date) as product_listing_date -- 上市日期
        ,IF(t1.product_listing_date <= t0.data_date AND SUBSTR(t1.product_listing_date,1,4) = SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4),'Y','N') AS newprod_flag -- 新品
        ,IF(DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),TO_DATE(t2.product_listing_date,'yyyymmdd')) BETWEEN 0 AND 364,'Y','N') AS sub_new_prod_flag -- 次新品
        ,IF(t3.product_listing_date <= TO_CHAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),'yyyymmdd')
        AND     SUBSTR(t3.product_listing_date,1,4) = SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) - 1,'Y','N') AS newprod_flag_py -- 同比新品标签
        ,IF(DATEDIFF(DATEADD(TO_DATE(t0.data_date,'yyyymmdd'),-1,'yyyy'),TO_DATE(t4.product_listing_date,'yyyymmdd')) BETWEEN 0 AND 364,'Y','N') AS sub_new_prod_flag_py -- 同比次新品
        ,nvl(t1.relaunch_tag,t2.relaunch_tag) as relaunch_tag
        ,t0.sales_num
        ,t0.base_amt_untax AS base_amt_untax
        ,t0.rsp_amt_untax AS rsp_amt_untax
        ,t0.sales_num_py
        ,t0.base_amt_untax_py AS base_amt_untax_py
        ,t0.rsp_amt_untax_py  AS rsp_amt_untax_py 
        ,t5.region
        ,t5.province
        ,t5.customer_name AS dist_name
        ,t5.channel_name_lastest AS channel_name
        ,CONCAT(t5.customer_name,'-',t0.dist_code) AS dist_desc
        ,NVL(t0.store_category,'其它') AS store_category
        ,NVL(t0.store_category_lv1,'其它') AS store_category_lv1
        ,NVL(t6.category_name,'Others') AS category_name
        ,nvl(t6.first_product_function,'Others') as first_product_function
        ,NVL(t6.brand_name,'Others') AS brand_name
        ,NVL(t6.product_line,'Others') AS product_line
        ,NVL(t6.product_name,'Others') AS product_name
        ,CONCAT(NVL(t6.product_name,'Others'),'-',t0.prod_barcode) AS sku
        ,value_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  data_date
                    ,data_year
                    ,data_quarter
                    ,data_month
                    ,month_start
                    ,month_end
                    ,quarter_start
                    ,quarter_end
                    ,year_start
                    ,year_end 
                    ,dist_code
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,ka_code
                    ,ka_name
                    ,ka_first_channel_name
                    ,ka_second_channel_name
                    ,ka_third_channel_name
                    ,ka_type
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,sales_num
                    ,sales_num_py
                    ,rsp_amt_untax
                    ,rsp_amt_untax_py
                    ,base_amt_untax
                    ,base_amt_untax_py
                    ,value_type
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp02_add_vs
            where   abs(nvl(sales_num,0))+abs(nvl(sales_num_py,0)) <> 0
        ) t0
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs t1
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t1.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t1.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs t2
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t2.billing_years + 1
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t2.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs t3
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) - 1 = t3.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t3.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_product_listing_date_sellout_temp_add_vs t4
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) - 1 = t4.billing_years + 1
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t4.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  customer_code
                        ,customer_name
                        ,channel_name_lastest
                        ,region_lastest AS region
                        ,province_lastest AS province
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
            ) t5
ON      t0.dist_code = t5.customer_code
AND     t0.bu_1 = t5.bu_1
AND     t0.bu_2 = t5.bu_2
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,category_name
                        ,product_function_cn as first_product_function
                        ,sub_product_function_cn as sub_product_function
                        ,brand_name
                        ,product_line
                        ,product_name
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
            ) t6
ON      t0.prod_barcode = t6.product_barcode
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_year_temp_add_vs

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_year_temp_add_vs as 
SELECT
  o.data_month,
  o.date_type,
  concat(o.date_value,' YTD') as date_value,
  o.month_detail,
  o.date_end,
  t0.dist_code,
  t0.dist_name,
  t0.dist_desc,
  t0.region,
  t0.province,
  t0.prod_barcode,
  t0.category_name,
  t0.first_product_function,
  t0.brand_name,
  t0.product_line,
  t0.product_name,
  t0.sku,
  t0.bu_1,
  t0.bu_2,
  t0.product_listing_date,
  t0.relaunch_tag,
  t0.store_category,
  t0.store_category_lv1,
  t0.store_code_concat,
  t0.henkel_store_code,
  t0.henkel_store_name,
  t0.ka_first_channel_name,
  t0.ka_second_channel_name,
  t0.ka_third_channel_name,
  t0.ka_code,
  t0.ka_name,
  t0.second_layer_dist_code,
  t0.second_layer_dist_name,
   sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' then base_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax,
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then base_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax,  --当期老品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y'  then base_amt_untax end) as sub_newprod_amt_untax, --当期次新品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then base_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then base_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.expand_prod_flag,'1')='1' then base_amt_untax end) as expand_prod_amt_untax,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1') ='1' then base_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')='Y' then base_amt_untax_py end) as newprod_amt_untax_py,
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' then base_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_amt_untax_py,  --当期老品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag_py,'')='Y'  then base_amt_untax_py end) as sub_newprod_amt_untax_py, --当期次新品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then base_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y') ='Y' then base_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.expand_prod_flag,'1') ='1' then base_amt_untax_py end) as expand_prod_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t9.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1') ='1' then base_amt_untax_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax_py, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' then sales_num end) as newprod_sales_num,	 -- 当期新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then sales_num end) as oldprod_sales_num,      -- 当期老品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y'  then sales_num end) as Sub_newprod_sales_num,  -- 当期次新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num end)    as new_store_sales_num, -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as close_store_sales_num,-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.expand_prod_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as expand_prod_sales_num,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as newprod_sales_num_py,  -- 去年同期新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_sales_num_py,  -- 去年同期老品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag_py,'')='Y'  then sales_num_py end) as sub_newprod_sales_num_py, --当期次新品POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num_py end)   as new_store_sales_num_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as close_store_sales_num_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.expand_prod_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as expand_prod_sales_num_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t9.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num_py, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(base_amt_untax) as base_amt_untax,
  sum(sales_num) as sales_num,
  sum(base_amt_untax_py) as base_amt_untax_py,
  sum(sales_num_py) as sales_num_py,
  sum(rsp_amt_untax) as rsp_amt_untax,
  sum(rsp_amt_untax_py) as  rsp_amt_untax_py,
  t1.data_date_min as new_store_first_sales_date,
  t10.max_data_date as close_store_sales_date,
  t5.data_date_min as oldprod_onshelves_date,
  t11.max_data_date as oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date,
  '所有客户' as so_customer_scope
 from (
SELECT  t.month_id AS data_month
        ,'YTD' AS date_type
        ,t.year_id AS date_value
        ,t1.month_id AS month_detail
        ,t.year_end AS date_end
FROM    (
            SELECT  month_id,year_id,year_end
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
            and   month_id in ('${bizmonth}',concat(YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizmonth}', 'yyyymm'), -1, 'yyyy')),'12'))
            GROUP BY month_id,year_id,year_end
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  month_id,year_id,year_end
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                GROUP BY month_id,year_id,year_end
            ) t1
ON      t.year_id = t1.year_id
AND     t.month_id >= t1.month_id
) o left join ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_temp03_add_vs t0
on o.month_detail = t0.data_month
--当月新客户标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_new_customer_flag_year_temp_add_vs t1  --1代表新店 0 代表非新店

  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1') ='1' then base_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额

  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag_py,'')='Y'  then base_amt_untax_py end) as sub_newprod_amt_untax_py, --当期次新品未税销额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then base_amt_untax_py end)   as new_store_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y') ='Y' then base_amt_untax_py end) as close_store_amt_untax_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.expand_prod_flag,'1') ='1' then base_amt_untax_py end) as expand_prod_amt_untax_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额

  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num end)    as new_store_sales_num, -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量额
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as close_store_sales_num,-- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.expand_prod_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as expand_prod_sales_num,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as newprod_sales_num_py,  -- 去年同期新品POS数量

  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num_py end)   as new_store_sales_num_py,   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t4.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num_py end) as close_store_sales_num_py, -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t7.expand_prod_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as expand_prod_sales_num_py,   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS数量
  sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag_py,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t2.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t9.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'1')='1' then sales_num_py end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num_py, -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS数量

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_mediabb_mapping_time_temp_01 as 
select 
mapping_time,
time_now,
time_yoy,
time_mom as time_pop,
time_type,
case when length(time_now)=4 then NULL 
else
  case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(time_now, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    when substr(time_now, 5, 2) = 01
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) > 50 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) - 1 as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    else concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_now, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
  end end as time_now_week,
case when length(time_yoy)=4 then NULL 
else
  case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(time_yoy, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    when substr(time_yoy, 5, 2) = 01
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) > 50 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) - 1 as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    else concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_yoy, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
  end end as time_yoy_week,
  case when length(time_mom)=4 then NULL 
else
  case
  --对于年底这一周大多数天（4天以上）在新一年的要处理成新一年第一周
    when substr(time_mom, 5, 2) = 12
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) = 1 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) + 1 as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    when substr(time_mom, 5, 2) = 01
    and weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) > 50 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) - 1 as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --对于小于10的周要拼接成0几的形式
    when weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) < 10 then concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-0',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
    --大于等于10的直接拼接即可
    else concat(
      cast(year(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string),
      '-',
      cast(
        weekofyear(to_date (time_mom, 'yyyymmdd')) as string
      )
    )
  end end as time_pop_week
from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_mapping_time where ds='${bizdate}' and (time_now not like '%a' or time_now is null)
and time_type <>'E.日'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mediabb_mapping_time PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.mapping_time
        ,t.time_now
        ,t.time_yoy
        ,t.time_pop
        ,t.time_type
        ,t.time_now_week
        ,t.time_yoy_week
        ,t.time_pop_week
        ,t1.ongoing_date
        ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY time_type ORDER BY mapping_time ASC ) AS mapping_time_rn
FROM    (
            SELECT  mapping_time
                    ,time_now
                    ,time_yoy
                    ,time_pop
                    ,time_type
                    ,time_now_week
                    ,time_yoy_week
                    ,time_pop_week
                    ,'1' AS flag
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mediabb_mapping_time_temp_01
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  '1' AS flag
                        ,'20240101' AS start_time
                        ,MAX(days) AS ongoing_date
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mediabb_media_social_performance
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_mediabb_media_social_performance')

            ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag
WHERE   CASE   WHEN LENGTH(time_now) = 6 AND time_now BETWEEN SUBSTR(start_time,1,6) AND SUBSTR(ongoing_date,1,6) THEN 1 = 1
        WHEN LENGTH(time_now) = 8 AND time_now BETWEEN SUBSTR(start_time,1,8) AND SUBSTR(ongoing_date,1,8) THEN 1 = 1
        when time_now is null then 1=1
        ELSE 1 = 0
END

-- ka pos maizhi接入数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_results_diff_data_source_temp_ka_pos_2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_results_diff_data_source_temp_ka_pos_2 as
select  
     'KA'      as data_system -- 数据来源系统
     ,'KA POS' as data_type	 -- 数据类型
     ,c.dist_type as idh_channel -- ka类型
     ,a.dist_code as idh_code -- ka编码 
     ,max(split_part(split_part(a.dist_name,'-',1),'—',1)) as idh_name -- ka名称  
     ,b.bu_2
     ,'s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi' as table_name
from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi a
left join (
    select 
		dist_type,
		dist_code,
		row_number() over(partition by dist_code order by ds desc,bill_date desc) rn
	from ${dme_ods}.s_ka_pos_data_sale_maizhi
   where ds<>''
) c
on a.dist_code=c.dist_code
and c.rn=1
inner join(
select 
          t.bill_date,t.dist_code,t.ds,t.source_code
         ,row_number()over(partition by t.bill_date,t.dist_code order by t.ds desc) as rn
       from (
            select  distinct
              a.ds,replace(a.dist_code,'SG-','') as dist_code
              ,to_char(to_date(a.bill_date,'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss'),'yyyymm') as bill_month

  ,a.idh_name -- ka名称

  ,a.source_table_name -- 数据源表名
  ,a.result_table_name -- 目标表名 
  ,a.is_differences  -- 是否缺失Y是，N否 
  ,case when a.is_differences='Y'  then c.reasons_differences end reasons_differences -- 差异原因
  ,case when a.is_differences='Y' and nvl(c.reasons_differences,'')='' then 'Y' else 'N' end as warning_sign -- 预警标识（Y：需要，N：不需要）

 select *,'1' as flag

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_dme_model_data_diff partition(ds)
select  
   a.data_system      -- 数据来源系统
   ,a.data_type       -- 数据类型
   ,a.ka_code         -- ka编码
   ,a.ka_name         -- ka名称
   ,a.dist_code       -- 经销商编码 
   ,a.dist_name       -- 经销商名称 
   ,a.months          -- 数据月份
   ,a.bu_1            -- 业务品牌bu_1
   ,a.bu_2            -- 业务品牌bu_2
   ,a.data_date       -- 数据日期
   ,a.data_source     -- 数据来源   
   ,cast(a.act_qty    as decimal(28,6)) as act_qty    -- 销量（PC)
   ,cast(a.act_amt_untax    as decimal(28,6)) as act_amt_untax    -- 实际销售金额(未税)
   ,cast(a.act_amt_tax      as decimal(28,6)) as act_amt_tax      -- 实际销售金额(含税)
   ,cast(a.base_amt_untax   as decimal(28,6)) as base_amt_untax   -- 基价销售金额(未税)
   ,cast(a.base_amt_tax     as decimal(28,6)) as base_amt_tax     -- 基价销售金额(含税)
   ,cast(a.BD_act_qty as decimal(28,6)) as BD_act_qty -- 前一天销量（PC)
   ,cast(a.BD_act_amt_untax  as decimal(28,6)) as BD_act_amt_untax   -- 前一天实际销售金额(未税)
   ,cast(a.BD_act_amt_tax    as decimal(28,6)) as BD_act_amt_tax     -- 前一天实际销售金额(含税)
   ,cast(a.BD_base_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)) as BD_base_amt_untax  -- 前一天基价销售金额(未税)
   ,cast(a.BD_base_amt_tax   as decimal(28,6)) as BD_base_amt_tax    -- 前一天基价销售金额(含税)
   
      -- by month+bu+经销商/ka 前一天数据销量或销额不为0，当天跑的数据0 需预警
   ,case when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_qty,0)=0 then 'Y'
       when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)=0 then 'Y' 
       when nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0)=0 then 'Y' 
      -- 当天跑的两个月之前数据销量或销额 比前一天数据大于等于1.5 或则小于等于0.5 需预警。 可能会更新近两个月的数据所以不做监控。
       when datediff(to_date(substr('${bizdate}',1,6),'yyyymm'),to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')>1 then
         case when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 and (nvl(a.act_qty,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<=0.5 or nvl(a.act_qty,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)>=1.5) then 'Y' 
              when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 and (nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<=0.5 or nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)>=1.5) then 'Y' 
              when nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)<>0 and (nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)<=0.5 or nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)>=1.5) then 'Y' 
            else 'N'
          end
      else 'N'
    end as is_differences  -- 是否缺失Y是，N否
   ,cast(case when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 then nvl(a.act_qty,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0) end as decimal(28,2)) as act_qty_rate -- 销量(当天比前一天)
   ,cast(case when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 then nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)    end as decimal(28,2)) as act_amt_rate  -- 实价金额(当天比前一天)
   ,cast(case when nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)<>0 then nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0) end as decimal(28,2)) as base_amt_rate -- 基价金额(当天比前一天)
   ,case when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_qty,0)=0 then '当天销量为0'
       when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)=0 then '当天实价金额为0' 
       when nvl(a.BD_base_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.base_amt_untax,0)=0 then '当天基价金额为0' 
      -- 当天跑的两个月之前数据销量或销额 比前一天数据大于等于1.5 或则小于等于0.5 需预警。 可能会更新近两个月的数据所以不做监控。
       when datediff(to_date(substr('${bizdate}',1,6),'yyyymm'),to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')>1 then
         case when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_qty,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<=0.9 then '销量当天小于等于前一天的0.9倍'
              when nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_qty,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_qty,0)>=1.1 then '销量当天大于等于前一天的1.1倍' 
              when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<=0.9 then '实价金额当天小于等于前一天的0.9倍'
              when nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)<>0 and nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)/nvl(a.BD_act_amt_untax,0)>=1.1 then '实价金额当天小于等于前一天的1.1倍'

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellin_maizhi_temp03 as
select distinct
     t1.posting_date            -- 入账日期(yyyymmdd)
  from (
      select
        posting_date            -- 入账日期(yyyymmdd)
        ,sum(quantity_consumer_units   ) as quantity_consumer_units    -- 产品销售数量（PC）
        ,sum(quantity_invoiced         ) as quantity_invoiced          -- 数量
        ,sum(ges                       ) as ges                        -- 集团外毛销售额
        ,sum(material_costs            ) as material_costs             -- 材料费
        ,sum(product_promotion_discount) as product_promotion_discount -- 临时促销折扣费
        ,sum(product_listing_discount  ) as product_listing_discount   -- 固定促销折扣费
        ,sum(ppd_free_goods            ) as ppd_free_goods             -- 免费品
        ,sum(ngs                       ) as ngs                        -- NGS
        ,sum(ngs                       ) as nes                        -- NES（未税金额）
        ,sum(L6                        ) as L6
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellin_maizhi_temp01
     group by posting_date
   ) t1
  left join (
     select 
        tt1.posting_date            -- 入账日期(yyyymmdd)
        ,sum(tt1.quantity_consumer_units   ) as quantity_consumer_units    -- 产品销售数量（PC）
        ,sum(tt1.quantity_invoiced         ) as quantity_invoiced          -- 数量
        ,sum(tt1.ges                       ) as ges                        -- 集团外毛销售额
        ,sum(tt1.material_costs            ) as material_costs             -- 材料费
        ,sum(tt1.product_promotion_discount) as product_promotion_discount -- 临时促销折扣费
        ,sum(tt1.product_listing_discount  ) as product_listing_discount   -- 固定促销折扣费
        ,sum(tt1.ppd_free_goods            ) as ppd_free_goods             -- 免费品
        ,sum(tt1.ngs                       ) as ngs                        -- NGS
        ,sum(tt1.ngs                       ) as nes                        -- NES（未税金额）
        ,sum(tt1.L6                        ) as L6
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellin_maizhi tt1
      inner join (
         select
             posting_date
             ,max(ds) as ds
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellin_maizhi
        where ds <'${bizdate}'
        group by posting_date
     ) tt2
     on tt1.posting_date = tt2.posting_date
     and tt1.ds = tt2.ds
      where tt1.ds <'${bizdate}'
      group by tt1.posting_date

  ) t2
   on t1.posting_date  = t2.posting_date
  left join (
     select distinct posting_date
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellin_maizhi_temp02
  ) t3
   on t1.posting_date=t3.posting_date
  where t3.posting_date  is null -- 剔除新增
  and (nvl(t1.quantity_consumer_units  ,0) <> nvl(t2.quantity_consumer_units   ,0)
   or nvl(t1.quantity_invoiced         ,0) <> nvl(t2.quantity_invoiced         ,0)

   or nvl(t1.material_costs            ,0) <> nvl(t2.material_costs            ,0)
   or nvl(t1.product_promotion_discount,0) <> nvl(t2.product_promotion_discount,0)
   or nvl(t1.product_listing_discount  ,0) <> nvl(t2.product_listing_discount  ,0)
   or nvl(t1.ppd_free_goods            ,0) <> nvl(t2.ppd_free_goods            ,0)
   or nvl(t1.ngs                       ,0) <> nvl(t2.ngs                       ,0)
   or nvl(t1.nes                       ,0) <> nvl(t2.nes                       ,0)
   or nvl(t1.L6                        ,0) <> nvl(t2.L6                        ,0)
  )

-- 月度新店标签 加工
--截至统计周期末近2个自然年的首次动销日期落在统计周期内的门店，以门店为维度判断
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT   data_year
        ,data_quarter
        ,data_month
        ,month_start -- 月初时间
        ,month_end -- 月末时间
        ,henkel_store_code
        ,dist_code
        ,data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
        ,IF(month_start <= data_date_min,'1','0') AS new_store_flag
FROM    (
            SELECT  a.data_year
                    ,a.data_quarter
                    ,a.data_month
                    ,a.month_start -- 月初时间
                    ,a.month_end -- 月末时间
                    ,b.henkel_store_code
                    ,b.dist_code
                    ,MIN(b.data_date_min) AS data_date_min -- 近两年首次动销日期
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  DISTINCT quarter_id as data_quarter
                                ,year_id as data_year
                                ,month_id as data_month
                                ,month_start
                                ,month_end
                                ,'1' AS flag
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                    ) a
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  data_month
                                    ,henkel_store_code
                                    ,dist_code
                                    ,MIN(data_date) AS data_date_min
                                    ,'1' AS flag
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs
                            GROUP BY data_month
                                     ,henkel_store_code
                                     ,dist_code
                        ) b
            ON      a.flag = b.flag
            AND     SUBSTR(b.data_month,1,4) BETWEEN SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4) - 1 AND SUBSTR(a.data_month,1,4)
            --AND     a.data_month >= b.data_month

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs AS
SELECT  billing_years
        ,product_barcode
        ,product_listing_date
        ,DECODE(relaunch_tag,1,'是','否') as relaunch_tag
FROM    (
            SELECT  to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy') as billing_years
                    ,product_barcode
                    ,MIN(to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')) AS product_listing_date
                    ,MAX(DECODE(relaunch,'是',1,0)) AS relaunch_tag
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_bu
            WHERE   ds <>'' 
             and upper(substr(replace(npd,' ',''),4,3))='NPD'
              and nvl(trim(replace(billing_date,'-','')),'')<>''
            GROUP BY to_char(to_date(billing_date,'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyy')
                     ,product_barcode
        ) t

--上市日期,新品,次新品,团购大宗逻辑加工

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_04_add_vs

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_04_add_vs AS
SELECT  t0.data_month
        ,t0.data_quarter
        ,t0.data_year
        ,t0.month_start
        ,t0.month_end
        ,t0.quarter_start
        ,t0.quarter_end
        ,t0.year_start
        ,t0.year_end
        ,t0.data_date
        ,t0.first_channel_name
        ,t0.dist_code
        ,t0.dist_name
        ,t0.prod_barcode
        ,t0.bu_1
        ,t0.bu_2
        ,t0.henkel_store_code
        ,t0.henkel_store_name
        ,NVL(t1.product_listing_date,t2.product_listing_date) AS product_listing_date -- 上市日期
        ,IF(t1.product_listing_date <= t0.data_date AND SUBSTR(t1.product_listing_date,1,4) = SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4),'Y','N') AS newprod_flag -- 新品
        ,IF(cast(substr(t2.product_listing_date,5,2) as bigint) BETWEEN 2 AND 12,'Y','N') AS sub_new_prod_flag -- 次新品(上一年度2月-12月上市的产品)
        ,CASE   WHEN (NVL(t3.rate_mon,0) > 1.5 OR NVL(t3.rate_py,0) > 1.5) AND (t3.rate_mon IS NULL OR t3.rate_py IS NULL) THEN 'Y'
                WHEN (NVL(t3.rate_mon,0) > 1.5 AND NVL(t3.rate_py,0) > 1.5) AND (t3.rate_mon IS NOT NULL AND t3.rate_py IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y' 
                ELSE 'N'
        END AS block_trades_flag -- 团购/大宗  
        ,NVL(t1.relaunch_tag,t2.relaunch_tag) AS relaunch_tag
        ,t0.sales_num
        ,t0.sales_amount_untax AS sales_amt_untax
        ,t0.sku_base_sales_amt_untax AS base_amt_untax
        ,t0.rsp_amt_untax 
        ,NVL(t23.category_name,'Others') AS category_name
        ,NVL(t23.first_product_function,'Others') AS first_product_function
        ,NVL(t23.brand_name,'Others') AS brand_name
        ,NVL(t23.product_line,'Others') AS product_line
        ,NVL(t23.product_name,'Others') AS product_name
        ,CONCAT(NVL(t23.product_name,'Others'),'-',t0.prod_barcode) AS sku
FROM    (
            SELECT  data_date
                    ,data_year
                    ,data_quarter
                    ,data_month
                    ,month_start
                    ,month_end
                    ,quarter_start
                    ,quarter_end
                    ,year_start
                    ,year_end
                    ,first_channel_name
                    ,dist_code
                    ,dist_name
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,henkel_store_name
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,sales_num
                    ,sales_amount_untax
                    ,rsp_amt_untax
                    ,sku_base_sales_amt_untax
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs
            WHERE    (
                        abs(NVL(sales_num,0)) + abs(NVL(sales_amount_untax,0))+abs(nvl(rsp_amt_untax,0)) <> 0
            ) 
        ) t0
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t1
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t1.billing_years
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t1.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_product_listing_date_pos_temp_add_vs t2
ON      SUBSTR(t0.data_date,1,4) = t2.billing_years + 1
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t2.product_barcode
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  t.data_date
                        ,t.henkel_store_code
                        ,t.dist_code
                        ,t.prod_barcode
                        ,CASE   WHEN nvl(cast(sales_amount_mom_daily_avg as decimal(28,6)),0) = 0 THEN NULL
                                ELSE (
                                    sales_amount_untax_daily_avg - sales_amount_mom_daily_avg
                        ) / abs(sales_amount_mom_daily_avg)
                        END AS rate_mon
                        ,CASE   WHEN nvl(cast(sales_amount_py_daily_avg as decimal(28,6)),0) = 0  THEN NULL
                                ELSE (
                                    sales_amount_untax_daily_avg - sales_amount_py_daily_avg
                        ) / abs(sales_amount_py_daily_avg)
                        END AS rate_py
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  data_date
                                    ,data_month
                                    ,henkel_store_code
                                    ,prod_barcode
                                    ,dist_code
                                    ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) AS sales_amount_untax_daily_avg
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs
                            WHERE   sales_amount_untax IS NOT NULL
                            GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                     ,dist_code  
                                     ,prod_barcode
                                     ,data_date
                                     ,data_month
                        ) t
                LEFT JOIN   (
                                --环比
                                SELECT  REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),1),1,7),'-','') AS data_month
                                        ,henkel_store_code
                                        ,prod_barcode
                                        ,dist_code
                                        ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) / COUNT(DISTINCT data_date) AS sales_amount_mom_daily_avg
                                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs
                                GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                         ,prod_barcode
                                         ,dist_code
                                         ,REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),1),1,7),'-','')


                            ) t1
                ON      t.data_month = t1.data_month
                AND     t.henkel_store_code = t1.henkel_store_code
                AND     t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
                AND     t.prod_barcode = t1.prod_barcode
                LEFT JOIN   (
                                --同比
                                SELECT  REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-','') AS data_month
                                        ,henkel_store_code
                                        ,prod_barcode
                                        ,dist_code
                                        ,SUM(sales_amount_untax) / COUNT(DISTINCT data_date) AS sales_amount_py_daily_avg
                                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_03_add_vs
                                WHERE   sales_amount_untax IS NOT NULL
                                GROUP BY henkel_store_code
                                         ,prod_barcode
                                         ,dist_code
                                         ,REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(data_month,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-','')
                            ) t2
                ON      t.data_month = t2.data_month
                AND     t.henkel_store_code = t2.henkel_store_code
                AND     t.dist_code = t2.dist_code
                AND     t.prod_barcode = t2.prod_barcode
            ) t3
ON      t0.data_date = t3.data_date
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t3.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t3.prod_barcode
AND     t0.dist_code = t3.dist_code
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,category_name
                        ,product_function_cn AS first_product_function
                        ,sub_product_function_cn AS sub_product_function
                        ,brand_name
                        ,product_line
                        ,product_name
                        ,bu_1
                        ,bu_2
                        ,ds
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds <>''
            ) t23
ON      t0.prod_barcode = t23.product_barcode
and     t0.data_date = t23.ds

        ,o.date_type
        ,CONCAT(o.date_value,' YTD') AS date_value
        ,o.month_detail
        ,o.date_end
        ,t0.first_channel_name
        ,t0.dist_code
        ,t0.dist_name
        ,t0.prod_barcode
        ,t0.category_name
        ,t0.first_product_function
        ,t0.brand_name
        ,t0.product_line
        ,t0.product_name
        ,t0.sku
        ,t0.bu_1
        ,t0.bu_2
        ,t0.product_listing_date
        ,t0.relaunch_tag
        ,t0.henkel_store_code
        ,t0.henkel_store_name
        ,block_trades_flag
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' or nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as newprod_amt_untax --新品次新品销额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_amt_untax  --当期老品未税销额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_amt_untax end)   as new_store_amt_untax   -- 当期新店（老品新店）POS未税金额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as close_store_amt_untax -- 当期闭店（老品老店）POS未税金额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_onshelves_amt_untax   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）POS未税金额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_amt_untax end) as oldprod_offshelves_amt_untax -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）POS未税金额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')='Y' or nvl(t0.sub_new_prod_flag,'')='Y' then sales_num end) as newprod_sales_num --新品次新品销额
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' then sales_num end) as oldprod_sales_num  --当期老品未税销量
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')='1' then sales_num end)   as new_store_sales_num   -- 当期新店（老品新店）销量
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t3.close_store_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as close_store_sales_num -- 当期闭店（老品老店）销量
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t6.oldprod_onshelves_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as oldprod_onshelves_sales_num   -- 当期老品新上架（老品老店）销量
        ,sum(case when nvl(t0.newprod_flag,'')<>'Y' and nvl(t1.new_store_flag,'')<>'1' and nvl(t8.oldprod_offshelves_flag,'Y')='Y' then sales_num end) as oldprod_offshelves_sales_num -- 当期老品下架（老品老店）销量
        ,SUM(sales_amt_untax) AS sales_amt_untax
        ,SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
        ,SUM(base_amt_untax) AS base_amt_untax
        ,SUM(rsp_amt_untax) AS rsp_amt_untax
        ,t1.data_date_min AS new_store_first_sales_date
        ,t10.max_data_date AS close_store_sales_date
        ,t5.data_date_min AS oldprod_onshelves_date
        ,t11.max_data_date AS oldprod_offshelves_recent_sales_date
FROM    (
            SELECT  t.month_id AS data_month
                    ,'YTD' AS date_type
                    ,t.year_id AS date_value
                    ,t1.month_id AS month_detail
                    ,t.year_end AS date_end
            FROM    (
                        SELECT  month_id
                                ,year_id
                                ,year_end
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                        AND     year_id >= YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -2, 'yyyy'))
                        GROUP BY month_id
                                 ,year_id
                                 ,year_end
                    ) t
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  month_id
                                    ,year_id
                                    ,year_end
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
                            GROUP BY month_id
                                     ,year_id
                                     ,year_end
                        ) t1
            ON      t.year_id = t1.year_id
            AND     t.month_id >= t1.month_id
        ) o
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_temp_04_add_vs t0
ON      o.month_detail = t0.data_month --当月新店标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_new_store_flag_year_temp_add_vs t1 --1代表新店 0 代表非新店
ON      o.data_month = t1.month_id
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t1.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.dist_code = t1.dist_code --当月闭店标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_close_store_flag_month_temp_add_vs t3 --'N' 代表非闭店
ON      o.data_month = t3.data_month
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t3.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.dist_code = t3.dist_code
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_onshelves_date_year_temp_add_vs t5 --年度新上架日期

AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t5.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.dist_code = t5.dist_code

LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_onshelves_flag_year_temp_add_vs t6 --oldprod_onshelves_flag N 代表非新上架
ON      o.date_value = t6.data_year
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t6.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t6.prod_barcode
AND     t0.dist_code = t6.dist_code --下架标签
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_offshelves_flag_month_temp_add_vs t8 --oldprod_offshelves_flag N代表非下架
ON      o.data_month = t8.data_month
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t8.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t8.prod_barcode
AND     t0.dist_code = t8.dist_code
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_close_store_recent_sales_date_temp_add_vs t10
ON      o.data_month = t10.data_month
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t10.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.dist_code = t10.dist_code
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_oldprod_offshelves_oldprod_recent_sales_date_temp_add_vs t11
ON      o.data_month = t11.data_month
AND     t0.henkel_store_code = t11.henkel_store_code
AND     t0.prod_barcode = t11.prod_barcode
AND     t0.dist_code = t11.dist_code
GROUP BY o.data_month
         ,o.date_type
         ,CONCAT(o.date_value,' YTD')
         ,o.month_detail
         ,o.date_end
         ,t0.first_channel_name
         ,t0.dist_code
         ,t0.dist_name
         ,t0.prod_barcode
         ,t0.category_name
         ,t0.first_product_function
         ,t0.brand_name
         ,t0.product_line
         ,t0.product_name
         ,t0.sku
         ,t0.bu_1
         ,t0.bu_2
         ,t0.product_listing_date
         ,t0.relaunch_tag
         ,t0.henkel_store_code
         ,t0.henkel_store_name
         ,t0.block_trades_flag
         ,t1.data_date_min
         ,t10.max_data_date
         ,t5.data_date_min

-- 剔除近24个月POS无数据部分，按照月份数的计算粒度分别卡
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp00

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp00 AS
SELECT  
    dist_code,
    prod_barcode,
    sales_num,
    sales_amount_untax
FROM (
    SELECT  
        dist_code,
        prod_barcode,
        SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num,
        sum(sales_amount_untax) as sales_amount_untax
    FROM (
        SELECT  
            data_date,
            dist_code,
            prod_barcode,
            IF(data_month >= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-',''),1,6) AND data_date <= REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-',''),sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num,
            IF(data_month >= SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),-23),'-',''),1,6) AND data_date <= REPLACE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'-',''),sales_amount_untax,NULL) AS sales_amount_untax
        FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_mid
        where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_mid')
        and data_month <= '${bizmonth}'
        ) 
    GROUP BY  dist_code,
            prod_barcode
) a
WHERE   sales_num IS NOT NULL or sales_amount_untax is not null
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp001

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp001 AS
select a.*
from (
    SELECT  a.*
        ,min(data_date) OVER (PARTITION BY a.dist_code,a.product_barcode) AS billing_date -- 开单日期
    FROM  (
            SELECT  
                data_date as data_date, --日期
                first_channel_name as channel_name, -- 渠道Channel*
                dist_code  as dist_code, -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code*
                dist_name as dist_name_cn,-- 客户名称CN*
                bu_2 as bu, -- 业务品牌
                prod_barcode as product_barcode, -- 产品条码-barcode
                henkel_store_code as store_code, -- 门店编码
                SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num,
                sum(sales_amount_untax) as sales_amount_untax,
                data_month
            FROM  ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_mid
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_mid')
            and  data_month <= '${bizmonth}'
            GROUP BY data_date,
                    first_channel_name,
                    dist_code,
                    dist_name,
                    bu_2,
                    prod_barcode,
                    henkel_store_code,
                    data_month
    ) a
    where nvl(a.sales_num,0) <>0 or nvl(a.sales_amount_untax,0) <>0
) a 
JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp00 b -- 剔除近24个月POS无数据
ON NVL(a.product_barcode,'') = NVL(b.prod_barcode,'')
AND NVL(a.dist_code,'') = NVL(b.dist_code,'')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp01 AS
SELECT  
    a.data_date,
    a.channel_name,
    a.dist_code,
    a.dist_name_cn,
    a.bu,
    a.product_barcode,
    a.store_code,
    a.billing_date,
    a.sales_num,
    a.sales_amount_untax,
    a.data_months_max,-- by pos最新日期
    a.billing_month_max, -- by开单日期前6个月
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(sales_num_month_bill_ttl > 0 AND data_date >= a.billing_date AND a.data_month <= a.billing_month_max,a.data_month,NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.dist_code,a.product_barcode,IF(data_date >= a.billing_date AND a.data_month <= a.billing_month_max,1,0) ) AS month_nums_bill, -- by开单日期月份数（销量>0），不符合条件月份数置空
    sum(a.sales_num) OVER (PARTITION BY a.dist_code,a.product_barcode,a.store_code,IF(data_date >= a.billing_date AND a.data_month <= a.billing_month_max,1,0) ) AS sales_num_store_bill_ttl, -- by开单日期门店编码_期间销量
    IF(data_date >= a.billing_date AND a.data_month <= a.billing_month_max,sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_bill, -- by开单日期销量
    concat(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4),'01') AS ytd_data_months_min, -- by YTD_pos 开始日期
    a.sales_num_month_ttl,
    SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.data_months_max,'yyyymm'),-5),'-',''),1,6) AS data_months_min, -- by pos_开始日期
    a.data_month
FROM (
    SELECT  
        a.*,
        m.sales_num AS sales_num_month_ttl,
        m.sales_num_bill AS sales_num_month_bill_ttl,
        MAX(a.data_month) OVER (PARTITION BY a.dist_code,a.product_barcode) AS data_months_max,-- by pos最新日期
        SUBSTR(REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(a.billing_date,'yyyymmdd'),5),'-',''),1,6) AS billing_month_max -- by开单日期前6个月
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp001 a
    JOIN (
        SELECT  
            dist_code,
            product_barcode,
            data_month,
            SUM(IF(data_date >= billing_date,sales_num,0)) AS sales_num_bill,
            SUM(sales_num) AS sales_num
        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp001
        GROUP BY dist_code,
            product_barcode,
            data_month
    ) m
    ON NVL(a.dist_code,'') = NVL(m.dist_code,'')
    AND NVL(a.product_barcode,'') = NVL(m.product_barcode,'')
    AND NVL(a.data_month,'') = NVL(m.data_month,'')
) AS a
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp02 AS
SELECT  
    a.data_date,
    a.channel_name,
    a.dist_code,
    a.dist_name_cn,
    a.bu,
    a.product_barcode,
    a.store_code,
    a.billing_date, -- by开单日期_开始日期
    a.sales_num,
    a.sales_amount_untax,
    a.billing_month_max, -- by开单日期_截至日期
    a.month_nums_bill, -- by开单日期_月份数
    a.store_nums_bill, -- by开单日期门店数（范围期间销量>0），不符合条件置空
    a.sales_num_bill, -- by开单日期_销量
    a.data_months_max,-- by pos_最新截至日期
    a.data_months_min, -- by pos_开始日期
    a.month_nums_sales, -- by pos_月份数（销量>0）
    a.sales_num_store_ttl, -- by pos门店编码_期间销量
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(a.sales_num_store_ttl > 0 AND a.data_month >= a.data_months_min AND a.data_month <= a.data_months_max,a.store_code,NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.dist_code,a.product_barcode,IF(a.data_month >= a.data_months_min AND a.data_month <= a.data_months_max,1,0) ) AS store_nums_sales, -- by pos_门店数（销量>0）
    a.sales_num_sales, -- by pos_销量
    a.ytd_data_months_min, -- by YTD_pos 开始日期
    cast(substr('${bizmonth}',5,2) as bigint) as ytd_month_nums_sales, -- by YTD_pos 月份数
    sum(if(a.data_month >= a.ytd_data_months_min,a.sales_num,null)) OVER (PARTITION BY a.channel_name,a.dist_code,a.store_code,a.dist_name_cn,a.bu,nvl(b.category_name,'Others'),nvl(b.product_function_cn,'Others'),nvl(b.product_name,'Others'),a.product_barcode,IF(data_month >= ytd_data_months_min,1,0) ) AS ytd_sales_num, -- by YTD_pos销量
    nvl(b.category_name,'Others') AS category_name_cn,
    nvl(b.product_function_cn,'Others') AS sub_category_name_cn,
    nvl(b.product_name,'Others') AS product_name,
    '${bizmonth}' AS end_month, -- 数据更新时间
    a.data_month
from (
    select 
        data_date,
        channel_name,
        dist_code,
        dist_name_cn,
        bu,
        product_barcode,
        store_code,
        billing_date, -- by开单日期_开始日期
        sales_num,
        sales_amount_untax,
        billing_month_max, -- by开单日期_截至日期
        month_nums_bill, -- by开单日期_月份数
        COUNT(DISTINCT IF(sales_num_store_bill_ttl > 0 AND data_date >= billing_date AND data_month <= billing_month_max,store_code,NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY dist_code,product_barcode,IF(data_date >= billing_date AND data_month <= billing_month_max,1,0) ) AS store_nums_bill, -- by开单日期门店数（范围期间销量>0），不符合条件置空
        sales_num_bill, -- by开单日期_销量
        data_months_max,-- by pos_最新截至日期
        data_months_min AS data_months_min, -- by pos_开始日期
        COUNT(DISTINCT IF(sales_num_month_ttl > 0 AND data_month >= data_months_min AND data_month <= data_months_max,data_month,NULL)) OVER (PARTITION BY dist_code,product_barcode,IF(data_month >= data_months_min AND data_month <= data_months_max,1,0) ) AS month_nums_sales, -- by pos_月份数（销量>0）
        sum(sales_num) OVER (PARTITION BY dist_code,product_barcode,store_code,IF(data_month >= data_months_min AND data_month <= data_months_max,1,0) ) AS sales_num_store_ttl, -- by pos门店编码_期间销量
        IF(data_month >= data_months_min AND data_month <= data_months_max,sales_num,NULL) AS sales_num_sales, -- by pos_销量
        ytd_data_months_min, -- by YTD_pos 开始日期
        data_month
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp01
) a 
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b
on a.product_barcode = b.product_barcode
and  b.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
select *
from (
    SELECT  
        channel_name,
        dist_code,
        -- case when dist_code='Sams' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
        --     else dist_name_cn end as dist_name_cn,
        dist_name_cn,
        bu,
        category_name_cn,
        sub_category_name_cn,
        product_name,
        product_barcode,
        billing_date, 
        end_month, -- 数据更新时间
        CAST(if(nvl(MAX(month_nums_bill),0)=0 or nvl(MAX(store_nums_bill),0)=0,null,SUM(sales_num_bill) / MAX(month_nums_bill)/MAX(store_nums_bill)) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS first_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store, -- 产品上市后的前6个月的单店月平均销量
        CAST(if(nvl(MAX(month_nums_sales),0)=0 or nvl(MAX(store_nums_sales),0)=0,null,SUM(sales_num_sales) / MAX(month_nums_sales)/MAX(store_nums_sales)) AS DECIMAL(28,6)) AS latest_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store, -- 可获取的最近6个月的单店月平均销量
        cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as avg_monthly_sales_amt_per_store_untax, -- 单店月平均销售额(未税)
        COUNT(DISTINCT IF(ytd_sales_num > 0 AND data_month >=ytd_data_months_min,store_code,NULL)) as sales_store_cnt, -- 产品售卖店数
        FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(now())) AS extract_time -- 接口同步时间
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp02 AS a
    GROUP BY channel_name,
        dist_code,
        -- case when dist_code='Sams' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
        --     else dist_name_cn end,
        dist_name_cn,
        bu,
        category_name_cn,
        sub_category_name_cn,
        product_name,
        product_barcode,
        billing_date,
        end_month -- 数据更新时间
    union all 
    SELECT  
        channel_name,
        dist_code,
        -- case when dist_code='Sams' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
        --     else dist_name_cn end as dist_name_cn,
        dist_name_cn,
        bu,
        category_name_cn,
        sub_category_name_cn,
        cast(null as string) as product_name,
        cast(null as string) as product_barcode,
        cast(null as string) as billing_date,
        end_month, -- 数据更新时间
        cast(null as decimal(28,6)) AS first_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store, -- 产品上市后的前6个月的单店月平均销量
        cast(null as decimal(28,6)) AS latest_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store, -- 可获取的最近6个月的单店月平均销量
        cast(if(nvl(ytd_month_nums_sales,0)=0 or nvl(count(distinct if(ytd_sales_amount_untax > 0,store_code,null)),0) =0,null,sum(ytd_sales_amount_untax)/ytd_month_nums_sales/count(distinct if(ytd_sales_amount_untax > 0,store_code,null))) as decimal(28,6)) as avg_monthly_sales_amt_per_store_untax, -- 单店月平均销售额(未税)
        cast(null as decimal(28,6)) as sales_store_cnt, -- 产品售卖店数
        FROM_UNIXTIME(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(now())) AS extract_time -- 接口同步时间
    from (
        select 
            channel_name,
            dist_code,
            dist_name_cn,
            bu,
            category_name_cn,
            sub_category_name_cn,
            end_month, -- 数据更新时间
            ytd_month_nums_sales,
            store_code,
            sum(sales_amount_untax) as ytd_sales_amount_untax
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_sku_cp_temp02
        where data_month >= ytd_data_months_min
        group by channel_name,
                dist_code,
                dist_name_cn,
                bu,
                category_name_cn,
                sub_category_name_cn,
                end_month, -- 数据更新时间
                ytd_month_nums_sales,
                store_code
    )
    GROUP BY channel_name,
        dist_code,
        -- case when dist_code='Sams' then '沃尔玛山姆会员'
        --     else dist_name_cn end,
        dist_name_cn,
        bu,
        category_name_cn,
        sub_category_name_cn,
        end_month,
        ytd_month_nums_sales
) a 
where first_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store is not null or latest_six_months_avg_sales_num_per_store is not null or avg_monthly_sales_amt_per_store_untax is not null or sales_store_cnt is not null

-- 关联屈臣氏日历
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_activity_pos_cp_tmp01

create table if not exists  ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_activity_pos_cp_tmp01 as
 select
   a.channel_name                           -- 渠道Channel*
   ,split(a.customer_name_code_connect,'-')[1] as dist_code    -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code*
   ,split(a.customer_name_code_connect,'-')[0] as dist_name_cn -- 客户名称CN*
   ,a.bu_2                 as bu                   -- 业务品牌
   ,nvl(c.category_name,'Other')      as category_name_cn     -- 品类
   ,nvl(c.product_function_cn,'Other') as sub_category_name_cn -- 一级子品类
   ,a.oneid                as activity_oneid       -- 促销活动编码
   ,a.oneid                as activity_name        -- 促销活动名称
   ,a.activity_start_date  as activity_start_date  -- 促销活动开始时间(YYYYMMDD)
   ,a.activity_end_date    as activity_end_date    -- 促销活动结束时间(YYYYMMDD)
   ,a.store_code           as activity_store       -- 促销活动门店
   ,a.bill_date
   ,case when split(a.customer_name_code_connect,'-')[0] = '屈臣氏' then b.mapping_time
       else substr(a.bill_date,1,6)
     end as bill_month
   ,a.retail_price_tax   -- 建议零售价（含税）
   ,a.product_base_price -- 建议零售价（未税）
   ,a.original_amt_untax -- 活动POS未税金额
   ,a.base_unit_qty      -- 活动POS销量
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_overview_pos a
 left join (
    select
        mapping_time
        ,time_now
        ,time_type
        ,time_mon
        ,year
        ,day
        ,quarter
        ,month
        ,week
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df')
    and (time_now <= concat(substr('${bizdate}',1,6),'a')
    or (substr(time_now,1,6) = concat(substr('${bizdate}',1,6),'a') and length(time_now) = 7))
    and  time_type = 'C.月'
  ) b
  on a.bill_date = substr(b.time_now,1,8)
 left join  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu c
  on a.prod_barcode = c.product_barcode
	and c.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
 where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_tpm_activity_overview_pos')
 and upper(a.channel_name) in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
 and a.activity_type_1='生意计划表'

       ,t1.activity_oneid                                  -- 促销活动编码
       ,t1.activity_name                                   -- 促销活动名称
       ,t1.activity_start_date                             -- 促销活动开始时间(YYYYMMDD)
       ,t1.activity_end_date                               -- 促销活动结束时间(YYYYMMDD)
       ,t1.data_year  -- Year
       ,t1.end_month  -- 数据更新时间
       ,sum(t1.original_amt_untax) as original_amt_untax        -- YTD活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.H1  ) as H1    -- H1活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.H2  ) as H2    -- H2活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Q1  ) as Q1    -- Q1活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Q2  ) as Q2    -- Q2活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Q3  ) as Q3    -- Q3活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Q4  ) as Q4    -- Q4活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Jan ) as Jan   -- Jan活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Feb ) as Feb   -- Feb活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Mar ) as Mar   -- Mar活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Apr ) as Apr   -- Apr活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.May ) as May   -- May活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Jun ) as Jun   -- Jun活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Jul ) as Jul   -- Jul活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Aug ) as Aug   -- Aug活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Sep ) as Sep   -- Sep活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Oct ) as Oct   -- Oct活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Nov ) as Nov   -- Nov活动POS未税金额
       ,sum(t1.Dec ) as Dec   -- Dec活动POS未税金额
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_activity_pos_cp_tmp02 t1
    group by t1.channel_name                                     -- 渠道Channel*
       ,t1.dist_code                                       -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code*
       ,t1.dist_name_cn                                    -- 客户名称CN*
       ,t1.bu                                              -- 业务品牌
       ,t1.category_name_cn                                -- 品类
       ,t1.sub_category_name_cn                            -- 一级子品类
       ,t1.activity_oneid                                  -- 促销活动编码
       ,t1.activity_name                                   -- 促销活动名称
       ,t1.activity_start_date                             -- 促销活动开始时间(YYYYMMDD)
       ,t1.activity_end_date                               -- 促销活动结束时间(YYYYMMDD)
       ,t1.data_year  -- Year
       ,t1.end_month  -- 数据更新时间
   ) t1
left join (
   select
      channel_name          -- 渠道Channel*
      ,end_month
      ,dist_code            -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code*
      ,dist_name_cn         -- 客户名称CN*
      ,bu                   -- 业务品牌
      ,category_name_cn     -- 品类
      ,sub_category_name_cn -- 一级子品类
      ,activity_oneid       -- 促销活动编码
      ,activity_name        -- 促销活动名称
      ,activity_start_date  -- 促销活动开始时间(YYYYMMDD)
      ,activity_end_date    -- 促销活动结束时间(YYYYMMDD)
      ,activity_store_num -- 促销活动门店数
      ,bill_date_num      -- 促销活动天数
      ,original_amt_untax -- 活动POS未税金额
      ,base_unit_qty      -- 活动POS销量
      ,if(nvl(activity_store_num*bill_date_num,0)<>0,original_amt_untax/activity_store_num/bill_date_num,null) as avg_daily_sales_amt_per_activity_store_untax  -- 促销活动单店日平均销售额(未税)
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_activity_pos_cp_tmp03
) t2
 on nvl(t1.channel_name        ,'')=nvl(t2.channel_name        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.end_month           ,'')=nvl(t2.end_month           ,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_code           ,'')=nvl(t2.dist_code           ,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_name_cn        ,'')=nvl(t2.dist_name_cn        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu                  ,'')=nvl(t2.bu                  ,'')
 and nvl(t1.category_name_cn    ,'')=nvl(t2.category_name_cn    ,'')
 and nvl(t1.sub_category_name_cn,'')=nvl(t2.sub_category_name_cn,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_oneid      ,'')=nvl(t2.activity_oneid      ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_name       ,'')=nvl(t2.activity_name       ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_start_date ,'')=nvl(t2.activity_start_date ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_end_date   ,'')=nvl(t2.activity_end_date   ,'')
left join (
    select 
      channel_name          -- 渠道Channel*
      ,dist_code            -- 客户代码BC-R Customer Code*
      ,dist_name_cn         -- 客户名称CN*
      ,bu                   -- 业务品牌
      ,category_name_cn     -- 品类
      ,sub_category_name_cn -- 一级子品类
      ,activity_oneid       -- 促销活动编码
      ,activity_name        -- 促销活动名称
      ,activity_start_date  -- 促销活动开始时间(YYYYMMDD)
      ,activity_end_date    -- 促销活动结束时间(YYYYMMDD)
      ,rsp_amt_untax      -- 建议零售价销售额（含税） 
      ,original_amt_untax -- 活动POS未税金额
      ,base_unit_qty      -- 活动POS销量
      ,if(nvl(rsp_amt_untax,0)<>0,original_amt_untax/rsp_amt_untax,null) as activity_discount_rate -- 促销活动折扣率
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_activity_pos_cp_tmp04
  ) t3
 on nvl(t1.channel_name        ,'')=nvl(t3.channel_name        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_code           ,'')=nvl(t3.dist_code           ,'')
 and nvl(t1.dist_name_cn        ,'')=nvl(t3.dist_name_cn        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu                  ,'')=nvl(t3.bu                  ,'')
 and nvl(t1.category_name_cn    ,'')=nvl(t3.category_name_cn    ,'')
 and nvl(t1.sub_category_name_cn,'')=nvl(t3.sub_category_name_cn,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_oneid      ,'')=nvl(t3.activity_oneid      ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_name       ,'')=nvl(t3.activity_name       ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_start_date ,'')=nvl(t3.activity_start_date ,'')
 and nvl(t1.activity_end_date   ,'')=nvl(t3.activity_end_date   ,'')

-- 历史自然增长率 Sellout

-- SAL_0006	Discount rate POS
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_bb_cp_sal_temp_02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_bb_cp_sal_temp_02 AS
SELECT 
    COALESCE(t.channel_name, t1.channel_name) AS channel_name,
    COALESCE(t.dist_code, t1.dist_code) AS dist_code,
    COALESCE(t.dist_name, t1.dist_name) AS dist_name,
    COALESCE(t.bu, t1.bu) AS bu,
    COALESCE(t.category_name_cn, t1.category_name_cn) AS category_name_cn,
    COALESCE(t.sub_category_name_cn, t1.sub_category_name_cn) AS sub_category_name_cn,
    COALESCE(t.data_year, t1.data_year) AS data_year,
    COALESCE(t.data_month, t1.data_month) AS data_month,
    COALESCE(t.data_quarter, t1.data_quarter) AS data_quarter,
    COALESCE(t.half_year, t1.half_year) AS half_year,
    COALESCE(t.sales_amt_untax, 0) AS sales_amt_untax,
    COALESCE(t1.sales_amt_untax_py, 0) AS sales_amt_untax_py,
    COALESCE(t.rsp_amt_untax, 0) AS rsp_amt_untax,
    'pos' AS data_type
FROM (
    SELECT  
        first_channel_name AS channel_name,
        dist_code,
        dist_name,
        bu_2 AS bu,
        category_name AS category_name_cn,
        first_product_function AS sub_category_name_cn,
        SUBSTR(month_detail,1,4) AS data_year,
        month_detail AS data_month,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(month_detail,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'))) AS data_quarter,
        CASE WHEN MONTH(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm')) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
             ELSE 'H2'
        END AS half_year,
        SUM(sales_amt_untax) AS sales_amt_untax,
        SUM(rsp_amt_untax) AS rsp_amt_untax
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_add_vs')
    AND date_type = 'YTD'
    -- 取当年最新月和上年最后一月
    AND (data_month ='${bizmonth}' OR data_month =CONCAT((cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) as int)-1),'12'))
    GROUP BY 
        first_channel_name,
        dist_code,
        dist_name,
        bu_2,
        category_name,
        first_product_function,
        SUBSTR(month_detail,1,4),
        month_detail,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(month_detail,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'))),
        CASE WHEN MONTH(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm')) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
             ELSE 'H2'
        END
) t
FULL JOIN (
    -- 同比数据
    SELECT  
        first_channel_name AS channel_name,
        dist_code,
        dist_name,
        bu_2 AS bu,
        category_name AS category_name_cn,
        first_product_function AS sub_category_name_cn,
        SUBSTR(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),1,4) AS data_year,
        REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-','') AS data_month,
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),'yyyymm'))) AS data_quarter,
        CASE WHEN MONTH(TO_DATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),'yyyymm')) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
             ELSE 'H2'
        END AS half_year,
        SUM(sales_amt_untax) AS sales_amt_untax_py
    FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_nka_sale_summary_pos_add_vs')
    AND date_type = 'YTD'
    -- 取当年最新月和上年最后一月
    AND (data_month = REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('${bizmonth}','yyyymm'),-12),1,7),'-','')
        OR data_month = REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(CONCAT(cast((substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) -1) as int),'12'),'yyyymm'),-12),1,7),'-','') )
    GROUP BY 
        first_channel_name,
        dist_code,
        dist_name,
        bu_2,
        category_name,
        first_product_function,
        SUBSTR(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),1,4),
        REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),
        CONCAT(SUBSTR(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),1,4),'Q',QUARTER(TO_DATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),'yyyymm'))),
        CASE WHEN MONTH(TO_DATE(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(month_detail,'yyyymm'),12),1,7),'-',''),'yyyymm')) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN 'H1'
             ELSE 'H2'
        END
) t1 ON t.channel_name = t1.channel_name
    AND t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
    AND t.bu = t1.bu
    AND t.category_name_cn = t1.category_name_cn
    AND t.sub_category_name_cn = t1.sub_category_name_cn
    AND t.data_month = t1.data_month
