              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%03' then mar
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%06' then jun
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%09' then sep
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
              when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%12' then dec
              when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int) then dec
        end as ytd,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%01' then jan
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%03' then mar
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
              when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int) then jun
        else jun
        end as h1,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%09' then sep
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
             when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int)  then dec
        else dec
        end as h2,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%01' then jan
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%02' then feb
             when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int)  then mar
        else mar
        end as q1,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%04' then apr
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%05' then may
             when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int)  then jun
        else jun
        end as q2,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%07' then jul
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%08' then aug
             when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int)  then sep
        else sep
        end as q3,
        case when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%10' then oct
             when data_year = substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) and '${bizmonth}' like '%11' then nov
             when cast(data_year as int) = cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1 as int)  then dec
        else dec
        end as q4
        ,COALESCE(jan,NULL) AS jan
        ,COALESCE(feb,NULL) AS feb
        ,COALESCE(mar,NULL) AS mar
        ,COALESCE(apr,NULL) AS apr
        ,COALESCE(may,NULL) AS may
        ,COALESCE(jun,NULL) AS jun
        ,COALESCE(jul,NULL) AS jul
        ,COALESCE(aug,NULL) AS aug
        ,COALESCE(sep,NULL) AS sep
        ,COALESCE(oct,NULL) AS oct
        ,COALESCE(nov,NULL) AS nov
        ,COALESCE(dec,NULL) AS dec
FROM    (
            SELECT  channel_name
                    ,dist_code
                    ,dist_name
                    ,bu
                    ,category_name_cn
                    ,sub_category_name_cn
                    ,SUBSTR(stock_month,1,4) AS data_year -- 使用MAX和CASE WHEN进行行转列，得到每个月的值
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '01' THEN metric_value END) AS jan
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '02' THEN metric_value END) AS feb
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '03' THEN metric_value END) AS mar
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '04' THEN metric_value END) AS apr
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '05' THEN metric_value END) AS may
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '06' THEN metric_value END) AS jun
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '07' THEN metric_value END) AS jul
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '08' THEN metric_value END) AS aug
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '09' THEN metric_value END) AS sep
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '10' THEN metric_value END) AS oct
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '11' THEN metric_value END) AS nov
                    ,MAX(CASE    WHEN SUBSTR(stock_month,5,2) = '12' THEN metric_value END) AS dec
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_nka_bb_cp_inv_temp_01
            GROUP BY channel_name
                     ,dist_code
                     ,dist_name
                     ,bu
                     ,category_name_cn
                     ,sub_category_name_cn
                     ,SUBSTR(stock_month,1,4)
        ) t

                        AND     date_type = 'YTD'
                        -- 取当年最新月和上年最后一月
                        AND     (data_month ='${bizmonth}' OR data_month =CONCAT((cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) as int)-1),'12'))
                        AND     (
                                    sales_num IS NOT NULL
                                    OR      sales_amt_untax IS NOT NULL
                        )
                        UNION
                        select o.channel_name,
                                m.customer_group_en_lv1 as dist_code,
                                m.customer_group_cn_lv1 as dist_name,
                                o.bu,
                                o.product_barcode,

                                ,customer_name AS dist_name_cn
                                ,bu_2 AS bu
                                ,product_barcode
                                ,SUBSTR(ds,1,4) AS data_year
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_sap_ke24_sale_info_bu
                        WHERE    ds >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CONCAT(cast((substr('${bizmonth}',1,4)-1) as int),'0101'),'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd')
                        AND     ds <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CONCAT('${bizmonth}','01'),'yyyymmdd')),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymmdd')
                        AND     first_channel_name_lastest in('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
                        and abs(nvl(sku_ngs_amt,0))+abs(nvl(quantity_consumer_units,0)) <> 0

                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu

                                ,SUBSTR(ds,1,4) AS data_year
                                ,category_name as category_name_cn

----------- ECOM SO,计算近12个月平均SQ----------------
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp11

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp11 as
SELECT
   a.bu_2 
  ,a.customer_code
  ,a.customer_name
  ,b.month_id  as  months
  ,a.store_code 
  ,a.store_name 
  ,a.platform 
  ,sum(c.base_price_amt_so)                                                              as   base_price_amt_so       --基价销售额(未税)
  ,count(if(nvl(c.base_price_amt_so,0) = 0,NULL, b.month_avg))                           as   month_cnt               --月份数
  ,max(d.stock_amt)                                                                      as   stock_amt               --库存金额
  ,sum(c.base_price_amt_so)/count(if(nvl(c.base_price_amt_so,0) = 0,NULL, b.month_avg))  as   base_price_amt_so_avg12       --基价销售额(未税)
from 
(  --维度去重
    select distinct  
       bu_2 
      ,customer_code
      ,customer_name
      ,store_code 
      ,store_name 
      ,platform 
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp1 
   -- where date_type = 'SO'
)a 
inner join 
(
    select distinct  
       a.month_id ,c.month_id1  as  month_avg
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day a
    left join(
        select distinct  
           month_id   as  month_id1,1  as flag
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
        where year_id >= '2023'
    )c
    on datediff(TO_DATE(a.month_id, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(c.month_id1, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') >= 0
    AND datediff(TO_DATE(a.month_id, 'yyyymm'), TO_DATE(c.month_id1, 'yyyymm'), 'mm') < 12
    and if(a.month_id is not null,1,0) = c.flag
    where a.year_id >= '2023' and a.month_id <= '${bizmonth}' 
)b
on case when a.customer_code is not null then 1 end = case when b.month_id is not null then 1 end
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp1 c
on  nvl(a.bu_2         ,'') = nvl(c.bu_2          ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_code,'') = nvl(c.customer_code ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_name,'') = nvl(c.customer_name ,'')
and nvl(a.store_code   ,'') = nvl(c.store_code    ,'')
and nvl(a.store_name   ,'') = nvl(c.store_name    ,'')
and nvl(a.platform     ,'') = nvl(c.platform      ,'')
and b.month_avg     = c.months
and c.date_type = 'SO'
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp1 d
on  nvl(a.bu_2         ,'') = nvl(d.bu_2          ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_code,'') = nvl(d.customer_code ,'')
and nvl(a.customer_name,'') = nvl(d.customer_name ,'')
and nvl(a.store_code   ,'') = nvl(d.store_code    ,'')
and nvl(a.store_name   ,'') = nvl(d.store_name    ,'')
and nvl(a.platform     ,'') = nvl(d.platform      ,'')
and b.month_id = d.months
and d.date_type = 'Inv'
where b.month_id >= '202401'
 group by   a.bu_2 
  ,a.customer_code
  ,a.customer_name
  ,b.month_id 
  ,a.store_code 
  ,a.store_name 
  ,a.platform

-- SAL_0026	Base price rate
-- 店铺 YTD该SBU该品类销售产品的未税基价单价之和/店铺 YTD该SBU该品类销售产品的未税RSP单价之和 *100%
-- 销售产品范围：GMV销售数据，不做任何过滤，只要有数字都算销售范围
-- 未税基价单价、未税RSP单价：取YTD时间段内的最新价格
-- 数据存放在YTD列，其它时间段列无数据
-- 需要改成分别取对应月份的价格
SELECT
    'Ecom'           as  channel_name
   ,a.customer_code  as  dist_code
   ,a.customer_name  as  dist_name_cn
   ,a.platform       as  platform
   ,a.store_code     as  store_code
   ,a.store_name     as  store_name
   ,a.bu_2           as  bu
   ,a.data_year
   ,a.end_month
   ,'SAL_0026'           as   metric_code
   ,'Base price rate'    as   metric_name
   ,cast(sum(t3.product_base_price)/sum(nvl(t3.retail_price_tax,0)/nvl(a.tax_rate,0))  as  Decimal(28,6))  as   metric_value          --Base price rate
   ,cast(NULL as  Decimal(28,6))   as  metric_value_base
   ,a.end_month  as  months 
from  
(
  SELECT
     distinct 
     customer_code  
    ,customer_name  
    ,platform       
    ,store_code     
    ,store_name     
    ,bu_2           
    ,substr(months,1,4)  as  data_year
    ,'${bizmonth}'              as  end_month
   -- ,months 
    ,tax_rate
    ,product_barcode
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_gtm_pl_cp_tmp0 a
where  cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) as int) <= cast(substr(months,1,4)+1 as int)
  --and order_type = '正单'  
  and  nvl(data_source_name,'') <> 'PG' 
)a
left join (
    select distinct
       product_barcode  -- 产品条形码
      ,retail_price_tax  -- 产品RSP（含税）
      ,product_base_price -- 产品基价（未税）
      ,substr(ds,1,4)  as  data_year
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu a
    join (select  month_id,max(day_id)  as  day_id
        from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day 
        where month_id = '${bizmonth}' OR  month_id =CONCAT((cast(substr('${bizmonth}',1,4) as int)-1),'12')
        group by month_id
        ) b
    on a.ds = b.day_id
 
        
) t3
  on a.product_barcode = t3.product_barcode 
 and a.data_year = t3.data_year 
group by a.customer_code 
   ,a.customer_name   
   ,a.platform        
   ,a.store_code      
   ,a.store_name      
   ,a.bu_2            
   ,a.data_year       
   ,a.end_month

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_yangshi_master_data_product_info PARTITION(ds='${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.id
        ,t.bu
        ,t.brand
        ,t.category
        ,t.product_line
        ,t.sub_category
        ,t.barcode
        ,t.product_name
        ,t.created_at
        ,t.updated_at

            SELECT  md5(product_barcode) AS id
                    ,bu_2 AS bu
                    ,brand_name_en AS brand
                    ,category_name_en AS category
                    ,product_line_en AS product_line
                    ,sub_product_function AS sub_category
                    ,product_barcode AS barcode
                    ,product_name AS product_name

                    ,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS created_at
                    ,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS updated_at

            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
        ) t

                SELECT  *
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  id
                                    ,bu
                                    ,brand
                                    ,category
                                    ,product_line
                                    ,sub_category
                                    ,barcode
                                    ,product_name
                                    ,CONCAT(bu,brand,category,product_line,sub_category,product_name) AS link
                                    ,created_at
                                    ,updated_at

                            WHERE   ds <> ''
                        ) o
                WHERE   rn = 1
            ) t1
ON      t.id = t1.id
AND     t.link = t1.link
WHERE   t1.link IS NULL

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid PARTITION(ds ='${bizdate}')
select o.*,
case when nvl(cast(rsp_amt_untax as decimal(28,6)),0) = 0 then null 
else cast(sales_amount_untax / NULLIF(rsp_amt_untax, 0) as decimal(28,6)) end AS discount_price_rate,
case when nvl(cast(rsp_amt_untax_py as decimal(28,6)),0)  = 0 then null 
else cast(sales_amount_py / NULLIF(rsp_amt_untax_py, 0) as decimal(28,6)) end AS discount_price_rate_py
 from (
--计算同环比
SELECT  t1.day_id AS data_date
        ,t1.year_id AS data_year
        ,t1.quarter_id AS data_quarter
        ,t1.month_id AS data_month
        ,t1.month_start
        ,t1.month_end
        ,t1.quarter_start
        ,t1.quarter_end
        ,t1.year_start
        ,t1.year_end
        ,t.dist_code
        ,t.prod_barcode
        ,t.bu_1
        ,t.bu_2
        ,t.henkel_store_code
        ,t.henkel_store_name
        ,t.store_code_concat
        ,t.ka_first_channel_name
        ,t.ka_second_channel_name
        ,t.ka_third_channel_name
        ,t.ka_code
        ,t.ka_name
        ,t.ka_type
        ,t.second_layer_dist_code
        ,t.second_layer_dist_name
        ,t.store_category
        ,t.store_category_lv1
        ,t.batch2code
        ,t.batch2name
        ,cast(SUM(t2.sales_num) as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_num
        ,cast(sum(t3.sales_num) as decimal(28,6)) as sales_num_py
        ,cast(SUM(t2.sales_amount_untax) as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_amount_untax
        ,cast(SUM(t3.sales_amount_untax) as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_amount_py
        ,cast(sum(t2.rsp_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) as rsp_amt_untax
        ,cast(sum(t3.rsp_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) as rsp_amt_untax_py
        ,cast(sum(t2.base_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) as base_amt_untax
        ,cast(sum(t3.base_amt_untax) as decimal(28,6)) as base_amt_untax_py
FROM    (
            SELECT  dist_code
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,henkel_store_name
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,ka_first_channel_name
                    ,ka_second_channel_name
                    ,ka_third_channel_name
                    ,ka_code
                    ,ka_name
                    ,ka_type
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,batch2code
                    ,batch2name
                    ,'1' AS flag
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid_temp_01
            where data_date >= CONCAT(CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -3, 'yyyy')) AS STRING),'0101')
            GROUP BY dist_code 
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,henkel_store_code
                    ,henkel_store_name
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,ka_first_channel_name
                    ,ka_second_channel_name
                    ,ka_third_channel_name
                    ,ka_code
                    ,ka_name
                    ,ka_type
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,store_category
                    ,store_category_lv1
                    ,batch2code
                    ,batch2name
        ) t
JOIN    (
            SELECT  '1' AS flag,* from ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_date')
            and year_id>=YEAR(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -3, 'yyyy'))
        ) t1
ON      t.flag = t1.flag
LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid_temp_01 t2
ON      t.henkel_store_code = t2.henkel_store_code
and     nvl(t.store_code_concat,'') = nvl(t2.store_code_concat,'')
AND     t.prod_barcode = t2.prod_barcode
AND     t.dist_code = t2.dist_code
and     t.ka_code = t2.ka_code
and     nvl(t.batch2code,'') = nvl(t2.batch2code,'')

LEFT JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid_temp_01 t3
ON      t.henkel_store_code = t3.henkel_store_code
and     nvl(t.store_code_concat,'') = nvl(t3.store_code_concat,'')
AND     t.prod_barcode = t3.prod_barcode
AND     t.dist_code = t3.dist_code
and     t.ka_code = t3.ka_code
and     nvl(t.batch2code,'') = nvl(t3.batch2code,'')
AND     t1.time_yoy = t3.data_date
GROUP BY t1.day_id 
        ,t1.year_id 
        ,t1.quarter_id 
        ,t1.month_id 
        ,t1.month_start
        ,t1.month_end
        ,t1.quarter_start
        ,t1.quarter_end
        ,t1.year_start
        ,t1.year_end
        ,t.dist_code
        ,t.prod_barcode
        ,t.bu_1

        ,t.henkel_store_code
        ,t.henkel_store_name
        ,t.store_code_concat
        ,t.ka_first_channel_name
        ,t.ka_second_channel_name
        ,t.ka_third_channel_name
        ,t.ka_code
        ,t.ka_name
        ,t.ka_type
        ,t.second_layer_dist_code
        ,t.second_layer_dist_name
        ,t.store_category
        ,t.store_category_lv1
        ,t.batch2code
        ,t.batch2name
 )o

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sellout_summary_mid PARTITION(ds ='${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.data_date
        ,t.dist_code
        ,CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name) as store_code_concat
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_oneid
                ELSE CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name)
        END AS store_code
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_name IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_name
                ELSE t.dist_store_name
        END AS store_name
        ,CASE   --WHEN value_type = '二分商非空pos' THEN t.second_layer_dist_code
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                    AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                    AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN ka_code
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_oneid
                ELSE CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name)
        END AS second_layer_dist_code
        ,CASE   --WHEN value_type = '二分商非空pos' THEN t.second_layer_dist_name
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                    AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                    AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN t1.chain_name
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_name
                ELSE t.dist_store_name
        END AS second_layer_dist_name
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                    AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                    AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN t1.ka_code
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                ELSE NULL
        END AS ka_code
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                    AND ka_code IS NOT NULL
                    AND upper(ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN chain_name
                WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                ELSE NULL
        END AS ka_name
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                ELSE DECODE(t1.store_definition,'Others','OT',t1.store_definition)
        END AS ka_first_channel_name
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                WHEN t1.store_definition IN ('LKA','Others') THEN t1.henkel_region
                WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NKA' AND t1.nka_customer_name = '华润' THEN '华润'
                ELSE t1.chain_name
        END AS ka_second_channel_name
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                ELSE t1.chain_name
        END AS ka_third_channel_name
        ,store_definition AS ka_type
        ,store_category
        ,store_category_lv1
        ,prod_barcode
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,cast(SUM(base_qty) as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_num
        ,cast(SUM(base_qty * t2.retail_price_untax) as decimal(28,6)) AS rsp_amt_untax
        ,cast(SUM(base_qty * t2.product_base_price) as decimal(28,6)) AS base_amt_untax
        ,t.value_type
FROM    (
            SELECT  dt_date AS data_date
                    ,dist_code
                    ,dist_store_code
                    ,dist_store_name
                    ,henkel_store_code AS store_code
                    ,product_barcode AS prod_barcode
                    ,sales_num AS base_qty
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_code
                    ,NULL AS second_layer_dist_name
                    ,'sellout' AS value_type
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid
            WHERE  ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
            AND    
             first_channel_name_new_lastest IN ('MPD')
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  data_date
                    ,dist_code
                    ,batch2code AS dist_store_code
                    ,batch2name AS dist_store_name
                    ,batch2code AS store_code
                    ,prod_barcode
                    ,SUM(0 - sales_num) AS base_qty
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_name
                    ,'二分商非空pos' AS value_type
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
            where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
            and   batch2code IS NOT NULL
            and   sales_num is not null 
            GROUP BY data_date
                     ,dist_code
                     ,batch2code
                     ,batch2name
                     ,prod_barcode
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
                     ,second_layer_dist_code
                     ,second_layer_dist_name
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  store_oneid
                        ,store_name
                        ,ka_code
                        ,CASE   WHEN ka_code = 'KA0011' THEN '屈臣氏'
                                ELSE chain_name
                        END AS chain_name
                        ,data_type_desc
                        ,store_category
                        ,store_category_lv1
                        ,store_definition
                        ,nka_customer_name
                        ,henkel_region
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
                AND     REGEXP_COUNT(lower(store_oneid),'(daipipei|daiqueren|qita)') = 0
            ) t1
ON      t.store_code = t1.store_oneid
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  product_barcode
                        ,retail_price_tax / 1.13 AS retail_price_untax
                        ,product_base_price
                        ,ds
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu
                WHERE   ds <> ''
            ) t2
ON      t.prod_barcode = t2.product_barcode
AND     t.data_date = t2.ds
GROUP BY t.data_date
         ,t.dist_code
         ,CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name)
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_oneid
                 ELSE CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name)
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_name IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_name
                 ELSE t.dist_store_name
         END
         ,CASE  -- WHEN value_type = '二分商非空pos' THEN second_layer_dist_code
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                     AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN ka_code
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                 WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_oneid
                 ELSE CONCAT(t.dist_code,'+',t.dist_store_code,'+',t.dist_store_name)
         END
         ,CASE   --WHEN value_type = '二分商非空pos' THEN second_layer_dist_name
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                     AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN t1.chain_name
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                 WHEN t1.store_oneid IS NOT NULL THEN t1.store_name
                 ELSE t.dist_store_name
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                     AND t1.ka_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND upper(t1.ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN t1.ka_code
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                 ELSE NULL
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_category = '零售'
                     AND ka_code IS NOT NULL
                     AND upper(ka_code) <> 'OTHERS' THEN chain_name
                 WHEN t1.store_category = '零售' THEN 'KA Others'
                 ELSE NULL
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                 ELSE DECODE(t1.store_definition,'Others','OT',t1.store_definition)
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                 WHEN t1.store_definition IN ('LKA','Others') THEN t1.henkel_region
                 WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NKA' AND t1.nka_customer_name = '华润' THEN '华润'
                 ELSE t1.chain_name
         END
         ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_definition = 'NC' THEN NULL
                 ELSE t1.chain_name
         END
         ,store_definition
         ,store_category
         ,store_category_lv1
         ,prod_barcode
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2
         ,value_type
UNION ALL

SELECT  data_date
        ,dist_code
        ,store_code_concat
        ,henkel_store_code AS store_code
        ,henkel_store_name AS store_name
        ,second_layer_dist_code
        ,second_layer_dist_name
        ,ka_code
        ,ka_name
        ,ka_first_channel_name
        ,ka_second_channel_name
        ,ka_third_channel_name
        ,ka_type
        ,store_category
        ,store_category_lv1
        ,prod_barcode
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,cast(SUM(0 - sales_num)as decimal(28,6)) AS sales_num
        ,cast(SUM(0 - rsp_amt_untax)as decimal(28,6)) AS rsp_amt_untax
        ,cast(SUM(0 - base_amt_untax)as decimal(28,6)) AS base_amt_untax
        ,'pos' AS value_type
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid
where ds =max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_mid')
and   batch2code IS NULL and sales_num is not null
GROUP BY data_date
         ,dist_code
         ,store_code_concat
         ,henkel_store_code
         ,henkel_store_name
         ,second_layer_dist_code
         ,second_layer_dist_name
         ,second_layer_dist_code
         ,ka_code
         ,ka_name
         ,ka_first_channel_name
         ,ka_second_channel_name
         ,ka_third_channel_name
         ,ka_type
         ,store_category
         ,store_category_lv1
         ,prod_barcode
         ,bu_1

drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp01

as
SELECT
    '' AS code,
    '' AS createtime,
    '' AS modifyTime,
    '' AS isdelete,
    '' AS isvalide,
    to_date(t.pay_time,'yyyymmdd') AS saledate,
    t1.ka_code AS kacode,
    t.customer_code AS dealercode,
    '' AS batch2code,
    '' AS datauploadtype,
    '' AS salechannel,
    t.shop_id AS kastorecode,
    --t1.store_name AS kastorename,
    t.shop_name as kastorename,
    t.commodity_sku AS kaproductcode,
    '' AS kaproductbarcode,
    t.commodity_name AS kaproductname,
    '' AS mpstoremappingcode,
    t1.store_code AS storecode,
    '' AS mpproductmappingcode,
    henkel_item_barcode AS productcode,
    CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS saleqty,
    CAST(untax_payment_actual AS DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS saleamountuntxt,
    CAST(payment_actual AS DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS saleamounttax,
    order_no AS orderno,
    sub_order_no AS suborderno,
    province_name AS provincename,
    city_name AS cityname,
    district_name AS countyname,
    '' AS streetname,
    cast(0 as DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS refundqty,

    cast(0 as DECIMAL(28, 6)) AS actualrefundamounttax
FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_mid t

    SELECT
        store_code,
        store_name,
        ka_code
    FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
    WHERE ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    --AND ec_store_code_tp IN ('446', '602')
) t1
    ON t.store_code = t1.store_code
WHERE t.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_mid')
and t.customer_code in ('2530190','1787667','1616258')  -- 炜能、鲲驰、丽人
and substr(t.pay_time,1,4)>='2020'

 on t.city_name=t2.district_name

--数据合并
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp03

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp03
as

where nvl(saleqty,0)<>0 or nvl(saleamountuntxt,0)<>0 or nvl(saleamounttax,0)<>0

select * from ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp02

--和迈志沟通只推送增量数据,且根据门店编码和事实指标发生变化则推送当天的数据.
--比对发生变化的店铺和天

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp04

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp04 AS
SELECT  t.saledate
        ,t.storecode
FROM    (
            SELECT  saledate
                    ,storecode
                    ,productcode
                    ,SUM(saleqty) AS saleqty
                    ,SUM(saleamountuntxt) AS saleamountuntxt
                    ,SUM(saleamounttax) AS saleamounttax
                    ,SUM(refundqty) AS refundqty
                    ,SUM(actualrefundamountuntxt) AS actualrefundamountuntxt
                    ,SUM(actualrefundamounttax) AS actualrefundamounttax
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp03
            GROUP BY saledate
                     ,storecode
                     ,productcode
        ) t
full JOIN   (
                SELECT  saledate
                        ,storecode
                        ,SUM(saleqty) AS saleqty
                        ,SUM(saleamountuntxt) AS saleamountuntxt
                        ,SUM(saleamounttax) AS saleamounttax
                        ,SUM(refundqty) AS refundqty
                        ,SUM(actualrefundamountuntxt) AS actualrefundamountuntxt
                        ,SUM(actualrefundamounttax) AS actualrefundamounttax
                        ,productcode
                        ,ds AS ds
                        ,DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY saledate,storecode ORDER BY ds desc) AS rn
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi
                WHERE   ds <'${bizdate}'
                GROUP BY saledate
                         ,storecode
                         ,productcode
                         ,ds
            ) t1
ON      t.saledate = t1.saledate
AND     t.storecode = t1.storecode
AND     t.productcode = t1.productcode
AND     t1.rn=1
WHERE   (
            NVL(t.saleqty,0) <> nvl(t1.saleqty,0)
            OR      NVL(t.saleamountuntxt,0) <> nvl(t1.saleamountuntxt,0)
            OR      NVL(t.saleamounttax,0) <> nvl(t1.saleamounttax,0)
            OR      NVL(t.refundqty,0) <> nvl(t1.refundqty,0)
            OR      NVL(t.actualrefundamountuntxt,0) <> nvl(t1.actualrefundamountuntxt,0)
            OR      NVL(t.actualrefundamounttax,0) <> nvl(t1.actualrefundamounttax,0)
)
GROUP BY t.saledate
         ,t.storecode

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.code
        ,t.createtime
        ,t.modifytime
        ,t.isdelete
        ,t.isvalide
        ,t.saledate
        ,t.kacode
        ,t.dealercode
        ,t.batch2code
        ,t.datauploadtype
        ,t.salechannel
        ,t.kastorecode
        ,t.kastorename
        ,t.kaproductcode
        ,t.kaproductbarcode
        ,replace(concat(t.kaproductname,'_',t.productcode),',','') as kaproductname
        ,t.mpstoremappingcode
        ,t.storecode
        ,t.mpproductmappingcode
        ,t.productcode
        ,nvl(t.saleqty,0) as saleqty
        ,nvl(t.saleamountuntxt,0) as saleamountuntxt
        ,nvl(t.saleamounttax,0) as saleamounttax
        ,t.orderno
        ,t.suborderno
        ,t.provincename
        ,t.cityname
        ,t.countyname
        ,t.streetname
        ,nvl(t.refundqty,0) as refundqty
        ,nvl(t.actualrefundamountuntxt,0) as actualrefundamountuntxt
        ,nvl(t.actualrefundamounttax,0) as actualrefundamounttax
FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp03 t --合并后的全量数据
JOIN    ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sku_ecom_pos_maizhi_temp04 t1  --变化的销售日期和店铺ID
ON      t.saledate = t1.saledate
AND     t.storecode = t1.storecode

----------- ECOM渠道 POS数据----------------
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp1 as
  select
    e.channel as first_channel_name
    ,e.channel_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest
    ,case when a.monthly<='202307' and a.customer_code='2925773' then '1967491' else a.customer_code end as customer_idh
    ,nvl(e.customer_idh_lastest,a.customer_code) as customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.monthly
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,cast(sum(a.quantity  )    as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sale_num
    ,cast(sum(a.untax_payment_actual ) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sales_amt
    ,cast(sum(a.base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_base_sales_amt
    ,cast(sum(if(d.product_barcode is not null,a.untax_payment_actual,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
    ,cast(sum(if(d.product_barcode is not null,a.base_sale_amt,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
    ,'ecom_pos' as data_source
    ,'pos' as data_type
  from(
    select 
      substr(ds,1,6) as monthly
       ,bu_1
       ,bu_2
       ,customer_code
       ,henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode
       ,sum(quantity) as quantity
       ,sum(untax_payment_actual) as untax_payment_actual
       ,sum(base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu

     group by substr(ds,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_item_barcode,customer_code
     
     union all

     SELECT  SUBSTR(ds,1,6) AS monthly
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2    
         ,customer_code  
         ,henkel_product_barcode AS product_barcode
         ,SUM(-item_num) AS quantity                     --退货数量
         ,SUM(-return_amt_untax) AS untax_payment_actual --实际退款金额未税
         ,sum(-base_sales_amt) as base_sale_amt          --基价退款金额未税

     AND nvl(a.shop_id_tp,'') <> '0'            -- 炜能的店，数据只到23年，可以过滤了
     group by substr(ds,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_product_barcode,customer_code
     
     
    union all
    -- 合并TP来源线上分销数据，目前只有沃亿转线上分销
    select 
      substr(pay_time,1,6) as monthly
       ,bu_1
       ,bu_2
       ,customer_code
       ,henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode
       ,sum(quantity) as quantity
       ,sum(untax_payment_actual) as untax_payment_actual
       ,sum(base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_mid 
     where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu_mid')
     and upper(nvl(store_category,'ECOM'))<>'ECOM'
     group by substr(pay_time,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_item_barcode,customer_code
     
    -- union all
    -- 合并TP来源线上分销数据，目前只有沃亿转线上分销，退货
    -- select 
    --   substr(refund_time,1,6) as monthly
    --    ,bu_1
    --    ,bu_2
    --    ,customer_code
    --    ,henkel_product_barcode as product_barcode
    --    ,sum(-item_num) as quantity                      --退货数量
    --    ,sum(-return_amt_untax) as untax_payment_actual  --实际退款金额未税
    --    ,sum(-base_sales_amt) as base_sale_amt           --基价退款金额未税 
    -- from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid 
    --  where ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
    --  and upper(nvl(store_category,'ECOM'))<>'ECOM'
    --  group by substr(refund_time,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_product_barcode,customer_code
  ) a
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu d
   on a.product_barcode=d.product_barcode
   and d.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
  inner join (
     select
       distinct
       customer_idh,customer_idh_lastest,channel,channel_lastest,bu_1,bu_2,months
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
     where channel='Ecom'
    ) e
   on case when a.monthly<='202307' and a.customer_code='2925773' then '1967491' else a.customer_code end=e.customer_idh
   and a.bu_2=e.bu_2
   and a.monthly=e.months
  where e.channel='Ecom'
  group by e.channel,e.channel_lastest
    ,case when a.monthly<='202307' and a.customer_code='2925773' then '1967491' else a.customer_code end
    ,a.monthly,a.bu_1,a.bu_2,nvl(e.customer_idh_lastest,a.customer_code)

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp2

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp2 as

   ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest

   ,case when upper(a.data_source) regexp 'DMS'and upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.second_channel_name_lastest else nvl(c.customer_idh_lastest,a.dist_code) end as customer_idh_lastest
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2

   ,sum(a.base_price_amt  ) as so_base_sales_amt -- so基价销售额（未税）

 left join(

 ) b
 on a.dt_month = b.months
 and a.bu_2 = b.bu_2
 and  a.third_channel_name  = b.customer_name
 and upper(a.first_channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')
 left join(
    select
       distinct customer_idh_lastest,customer_name_lastest,bu_2,months
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
 ) c
 on a.dt_month = c.months
 and a.bu_2 = c.bu_2
 and  a.third_channel_name_lastest = c.customer_name_lastest
 and upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER')

 group by dt_month,a.first_channel_name,a.first_channel_name_lastest
   ,case when upper(a.data_source) regexp 'DMS'and upper(a.first_channel_name) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.second_channel_name else nvl(b.customer_idh,a.dist_code) end  -- DMS间供来源NKA，数据处理
   ,case when upper(a.data_source) regexp 'DMS'and upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.second_channel_name_lastest else nvl(c.customer_idh_lastest,a.dist_code) end

-- 合并pos、so、stock、sellin数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp5

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp5 as
select
  coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name,t3.first_channel_name,t4.first_channel_name) as first_channel_name
  ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh,t3.customer_idh,t4.customer_idh) as customer_idh
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh_lastest,t2.customer_idh_lastest,t3.customer_idh_lastest,t4.customer_idh_lastest) as customer_idh_lastest
  ,coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly,t4.monthly) as monthly
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1,t3.bu_1,t4.bu_1) as bu_1
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2,t3.bu_2,t4.bu_2) as bu_2
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num       -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt      -- ecom pos销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt -- ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt_p   ) as ecom_sales_amt_p    -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt_p) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t2.so_sale_num       )  as so_sale_num         -- so销售数量
  ,sum(t2.so_dist_prod_amt  )  as so_dist_prod_amt    -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t2.so_base_sales_amt )  as so_base_sales_amt   -- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t2.so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的实际销售额（未税）  
  ,sum(t2.so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t3.stock_num          ) as stock_num           -- 库存数量
  ,sum(nvl(t3.base_stock_amt,0))as base_stock_amt -- 库存金额
  ,sum(t3.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt -- 小样库存基价金额
  ,sum(t4.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,sum(t4.ngs                ) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
  ,coalesce(t1.data_source,t2.data_source,t3.data_source,t4.data_source) as data_source
  ,coalesce(t1.data_type,t2.data_type,t3.data_type,t4.data_source) as data_type
from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp1 t1   -- ecom pos
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp2 t2 -- so、实际数据
 on t1.monthly=t2.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t2.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp3 t3 -- 库存数据
 on t1.monthly=t3.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t3.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp0 t4 -- sellin
 on t1.monthly=t4.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t4.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t4.bu_2
where coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly)>='202301'
and coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly)<'${bizmonth}'
group by 
  coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name,t3.first_channel_name,t4.first_channel_name)
  ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest)
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh,t3.customer_idh,t4.customer_idh)
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh_lastest,t2.customer_idh_lastest,t3.customer_idh_lastest,t4.customer_idh_lastest)
  ,coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly,t4.monthly) 
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1,t3.bu_1,t4.bu_1)
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2,t3.bu_2,t4.bu_2)
  ,coalesce(t1.data_source,t2.data_source,t3.data_source,t4.data_source)
  ,coalesce(t1.data_type,t2.data_type,t3.data_type,t4.data_source)

-- 计算pos、so、inv指标有数最大数据月份,拉平维度数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp6

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp6 as
select
  t0.channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh_lastest
  ,t0.customer_name_lastest
  ,t0.sub_channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh
  ,t0.customer_name
  ,t0.channel
  ,t0.sub_channel
  ,t0.months as monthly
  ,t0.bu_1
  ,t0.bu_2
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num       -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt      -- ecom pos销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt -- ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t1.so_sale_num        ) as so_sale_num         -- so销售数量
  ,sum(t1.so_dist_prod_amt   ) as so_dist_prod_amt    -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t1.so_base_sales_amt  ) as so_base_sales_amt   -- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t1.so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）  
  ,sum(t1.so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
  ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_untax      ) as pos_gmv_untax       -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(t1.base_pos_gmv_untax ) as base_pos_gmv_untax  -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,sum(t1.stock_num          ) as stock_num           -- 库存数量
  ,sum(t1.base_stock_amt     ) as base_stock_amt      -- 库存金额
  ,sum(t1.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt -- 小样库存基价金额
  ,sum(t1.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,sum(t1.ngs                ) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
  ,max(t1.monthly_ecompos    ) as monthly_ecompos    -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
  ,max(t1.monthly_so         ) as monthly_so         -- 有so销量的最大月份
  ,max(t1.monthly_stock      ) as monthly_stock      -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  ,min(case when nvl(t1.sell_in_qty,0)<>0 then t0.months end) as min_sellin_monthly -- 最早sellin月份
from (
    select  a.customer_idh_lastest,a.channel_lastest,a.sub_channel_lastest,customer_idh,a.channel,a.sub_channel,a.bu_1,a.bu_2,a.months
       ,max(customer_name) as customer_name,max(customer_name_lastest) as customer_name_lastest     
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3 a
    group by a.customer_idh_lastest,a.channel_lastest,a.sub_channel_lastest,customer_idh,a.channel,a.sub_channel,a.bu_1,a.bu_2,a.months
 ) t0
left join (
  select
     a1.customer_idh_lastest
     ,a1.bu_2
     ,a1.monthly
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_sales_amt_p else a1.so_dist_prod_amt_p end) as so_dist_prod_amt_p -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）  
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_base_sales_amt_p else a1.so_base_sales_amt_p end) as so_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_sales_amt else a1.so_dist_prod_amt end) as pos_gmv_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_base_sales_amt else a1.so_base_sales_amt end) as base_pos_gmv_untax -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num           -- ecom pos销售数量
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt          -- ecom pos销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt     -- ecom pos基价销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sales_amt_p   ) as ecom_sales_amt_p        -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_base_sales_amt_p) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
     ,sum(a1.so_sale_num        ) as so_sale_num          -- so销售数量
     ,sum(a1.so_dist_prod_amt   ) as so_dist_prod_amt     -- so实际销售额（未税）
     ,sum(a1.so_base_sales_amt  ) as so_base_sales_amt    -- so基价销售额（未税）
     ,sum(a1.stock_num          ) as stock_num            -- 库存数量
     ,sum(a1.base_stock_amt     ) as base_stock_amt       -- 库存金额
     ,sum(a1.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt  -- 小样库存基价金额
     ,sum(a1.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty          -- sellin数量
     ,sum(a1.ngs                ) as ngs                  -- sellin销售额（未税）
     ,max(a2.monthly_ecompos    ) as monthly_ecompos      -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
     ,max(a2.monthly_so         ) as monthly_so           -- 有so销量的最大月份
     ,max(a2.monthly_stock      ) as monthly_stock        -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp5 a1
  left join (
    select data_source,data_type
      ,case when data_source ='ecom_pos' and data_type='pos' then customer_idh_lastest else data_source end as customer_idh_lastest
      ,max(case when nvl(ecom_sales_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_ecompos -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
      ,max(case when nvl(so_base_sales_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_so   -- 有so销量的最大月份
      ,max(case when nvl(base_stock_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_stock   -- 有库存销量的最大月份
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp5
    group by data_source,data_type
      ,case when data_source ='ecom_pos' and data_type='pos' then customer_idh_lastest else data_source end
   ) a2
   on a1.data_type=a2.data_type
   and case when a1.data_type='pos' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_ecompos
           when a1.data_type='so' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_so
          when a1.data_type='stock' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_stock
        end
   and case when a1.data_source ='ecom_pos' and a1.data_type='pos' then a1.customer_idh_lastest=a2.customer_idh_lastest
       else a1.data_source=a2.data_source
      end
  group by a1.customer_idh_lastest,a1.bu_2,a1.monthly
 )t1
 on t0.customer_idh_lastest=t1.customer_idh_lastest
 and t0.bu_2=t1.bu_2
 and t0.months=t1.monthly
  -- 系统月份之前最近有pos数据月份之后的数据用fcst数据补充（ecom by tp客户看，nka by渠道看）
group by
  t0.channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh_lastest
  ,t0.customer_name_lastest
  ,t0.sub_channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh
  ,t0.customer_name
  ,t0.channel
  ,t0.sub_channel
  ,t0.months
  ,t0.bu_1
  ,t0.bu_2

-- 计算客户粒度 POS/RSP比例
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp7_cust

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp7_cust as
select
 channel_lastest
 ,monthly
 ,customer_idh_lastest
 ,bu_2
 ,so_dist_prod_amt_p_ytd  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）
 ,so_base_sales_amt_p_ytd -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
 ,case when nvl(so_base_sales_amt_p_ytd,0)=0 then null else so_dist_prod_amt_p_ytd/so_base_sales_amt_p_ytd end as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
from(
  select
   channel_lastest
   ,monthly
   ,customer_idh_lastest
   ,bu_2
   ,sum(so_dist_prod_amt_p )over(partition by channel_lastest,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,substr(monthly,1,4) order by monthly ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p_ytd  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）
   ,sum(so_base_sales_amt_p)over(partition by channel_lastest,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,substr(monthly,1,4) order by monthly ) as so_base_sales_amt_p_ytd -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
  from(
  select
    channel_lastest
    ,monthly
    ,customer_idh_lastest
    ,bu_2
    ,sum(so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）  
    ,sum(so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
  from(
      select
        channel_lastest
        ,monthly
        ,customer_idh_lastest
        ,bu_2
        ,sum(so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）   
        ,sum(so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp6
      group by channel_lastest,monthly,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
      union all
      select
        channel_lastest
        ,monthly
        ,case when channel_lastest regexp 'DT' then 'v_dt'
             end as customer_idh_lastest
        ,bu_2
        ,sum(so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）   
        ,sum(so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp6
      --where nvl(pos_sales_amt,0)<>0
      where channel_lastest in ('DT')
      group by channel_lastest,monthly,bu_2
       ,case when channel_lastest regexp 'DT' then 'v_dt'
          end
    )
    group by
    channel_lastest
    ,monthly
    ,customer_idh_lastest
    ,bu_2
  )
)

-- 拉平所有维度数据：pos数据拉平fcst_date，并判断是否用fcst数据补充。每个fcst_date 放近两年的act数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp8

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp8 as
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,c.channel
  ,c.customer_idh
  ,c.channel_lastest
  ,c.customer_idh_lastest
  ,c.bu_1
  ,c.bu_2
  ,case when a.months<=b.monthly_ecompos or a.months<=b.monthly_so or a.months<=b.monthly_stock then 'ACT' else 'FCST' end as data_source
  ,max(b.monthly_ecompos)as monthly_ecompos -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
  ,max(b.monthly_so   )  as monthly_so    -- 有so销量的最大月份
  ,max(b.monthly_stock)  as monthly_stock -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  ,min(b.min_sellin_monthly) as min_sellin_monthly -- 最早sellin月份
  ,sum(b.ecom_sale_num)  as ecom_sale_num -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(b.so_sale_num)    as so_sale_num  -- so销售数量
  ,sum(b.stock_num)      as stock_num    -- 库存数量
  -- pos
  ,cast(sum(b.ecom_sales_amt     ) as decimal) as ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.ecom_base_sales_amt) as decimal) as ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,cast(sum(b.so_dist_prod_amt  ) as decimal) as so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.so_base_sales_amt ) as decimal) as so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.pos_gmv_untax     ) as decimal) as pos_gmv_untax          -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,cast(sum(b.base_pos_gmv_untax) as decimal) as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  -- stock
  ,cast(sum(b.base_stock_amt) as decimal) as base_stock_amt_untax -- 库存金额 （未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.mini_base_stock_amt) as decimal) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  -- sellin
  ,cast(sum(b.sell_in_qty        ) as decimal) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,cast(sum(b.ngs                ) as decimal) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
 from  (
    select distinct t1.fcst_date,t2.months
    from(
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,a.months
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
       union all
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),-12)),'yyyymm')
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
       union all
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),-24)),'yyyymm')
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
     ) t1
     left join (
        select
          distinct substr(day_id,1,6) as months
        from dme_cdm.dim_day
     )t2
     on substr(t1.months,1,4)=substr(t2.months,1,4)
   ) a
 left join (
  select
      distinct customer_idh,channel,channel_lastest,bu_1,bu_2,customer_idh_lastest,months
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
 ) c
  on a.months=c.months
 left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp6 b
  on a.months=b.monthly
  and c.channel_lastest=b.channel_lastest
  and c.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
  and c.bu_2=b.bu_2
  and a.fcst_date not regexp 'KP' 
 group by
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,c.channel
  ,c.customer_idh
  ,c.channel_lastest
  ,c.customer_idh_lastest
  ,c.bu_1
  ,c.bu_2
  ,case when a.months<=b.monthly_ecompos or a.months<=b.monthly_so or a.months<=b.monthly_stock then 'ACT' else 'FCST' end

-- 计算fcst_date当月库存，（上月末实际库存+当月ges+pos_gmv未税）
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp10

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp10 as
 select
   a.months
   ,a.channel
   ,a.customer_idh
   ,a.channel_lastest
   ,a.customer_idh_lastest
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2
   ,case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then 'ACT_stock' else 'FCST'END as data_source
   ,sum(a.ges_fcst) as ges_fcst
   ,sum(a.pos_gmv_pre_untax_fcst) as pos_gmv_pre_untax_fcst
   ,sum(case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then b.base_stock_amt else d.base_stock_amt end) as base_stock_amt   -- 当月月实际库存
  -- ,sum(case when c.first_channel_name is null then nvl(a.ges_fcst,0)-nvl(a.pos_gmv_pre_untax_fcst,0) end)
  --       over(partition by a.channel,a.customer_idh,a.channel_lastest,a.customer_idh_lastest,a.bu_2,a.platform,a.store_cn_bts,a.store_en_bts,a.brand_name
  --          order by a.months) as ges_vs_pos_fcst -- 当月YTD ges-TTLPOS
 from (
    select
        a.months
        ,a.channel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.channel_lastest
        ,a.customer_idh_lastest
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,sum(b.ges) as ges_fcst
        ,sum(b.pos_gmv_pre_untax) as pos_gmv_pre_untax_fcst
    from (
        select distinct          
          months
          ,channel
          ,customer_idh
          ,channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp8
        ) a
    left join (
        select
           fcst_date
           ,months               
           ,channel              
           ,customer_idh         
           ,channel_lastest      
           ,customer_idh_lastest 
           ,bu_2
           ,sum(ges) as ges
           ,sum(pos_gmv_pre_untax) as pos_gmv_pre_untax
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
        and is_adj='N'
        and fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
        group by  fcst_date ,months ,channel ,customer_idh ,channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest ,bu_2
      ) b
     on nvl(a.months               ,'')= nvl(b.months               ,'')
    and nvl(a.channel              ,'')= nvl(b.channel              ,'')
    and nvl(a.customer_idh         ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh         ,'')
    and nvl(a.channel_lastest      ,'')= nvl(b.channel_lastest      ,'')
    and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
    and nvl(a.bu_2                 ,'')= nvl(b.bu_2                 ,'')
    and substr(b.fcst_date,1,6)=b.months
    group by a.months
        ,a.channel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.channel_lastest
        ,a.customer_idh_lastest
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
   ) a
 left join (
     select monthly
      ,channel_lastest
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
      ,sum(base_stock_amt) as base_stock_amt
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp9
     group by monthly,channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
     ) b
  on a.months=b.monthly
  and a.channel_lastest=b.channel_lastest
  and a.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 left join (
     select monthly
      ,channel_lastest
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
      ,sum(base_stock_amt) as base_stock_amt
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp9
     group by monthly,channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
     ) d -- 取最近一个月份库存
  on a.channel_lastest=d.channel_lastest
  and a.customer_idh_lastest=d.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_2=d.bu_2
  and nvl(d.base_stock_amt,0)<>0
  and nvl(d.monthly  ,'')=nvl(d.monthly_stock  ,'') 
 left join (
     select channel_lastest
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp9
     group by  channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
     ) e -- 取库存最近一个月份
  on a.channel_lastest=e.channel_lastest
  and a.customer_idh_lastest=e.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_2=e.bu_2
 group by  a.months ,a.channel ,a.customer_idh ,a.channel_lastest ,a.customer_idh_lastest ,a.bu_1 ,a.bu_2
   ,case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then 'ACT_stock' else 'FCST'END

--取FCST数据，同时计算每个版本大于等于版本月份的各月份度ytd 指标
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp11

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp11 as
select
 fcst_date
 ,months
 ,channel
 ,customer_idh
 ,channel_lastest
 ,customer_idh_lastest
 ,bu_1
 ,bu_2
 ,pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
 ,final_inv_value   -- 期末库存
 ,ges
 ,pos_normal -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
 ,pos_promotional -- Promotional
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,pos_rsp_rate_cust ) as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
 ,data_source  -- 库存数据来源
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,stock_amt_act_last) as stock_amt_act_last -- 上月末实际库存数据
 ,ges_ytd
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,pos_gmv_pre_untax_ytd) as pos_gmv_pre_untax_ytd
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,
    case when customer_idh='Watsons' then final_inv_value
    else nvl(stock_amt_act_last,0)+nvl(ges_ytd,0)-nvl(pos_gmv_pre_untax_ytd/pos_rsp_rate_cust,0)
   end) as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
 ,mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
from(
  select
    a.fcst_date
    ,a.months
    ,a.channel
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,a.channel_lastest
    ,a.customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,a.pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
    ,a.final_inv_value   -- 期末库存
    ,a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
    ,a.ges
    ,a.pos_normal -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
    ,a.pos_promotional -- Promotional
    ,coalesce(d.pos_rsp_rate_cust,e.pos_rsp_rate_cust) as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
    ,b.data_source -- 库存数据来源
    ,b.base_stock_amt as stock_amt_act_last -- 上月末实际库存数据
    ,sum(case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then a.ges end)over(partition by a.fcst_date,a.customer_idh,a.bu_2,substr(a.months,1,4)
         order by a.months ) as ges_ytd -- ges(未税)YTD
    ,sum(case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then a.pos_gmv_pre_untax end)over(partition by a.fcst_date,a.customer_idh,a.bu_2,substr(a.months,1,4)
         order by a.months ) as pos_gmv_pre_untax_ytd  -- POS/GMV(未税)YTD
  from (
       select
         a.fcst_date
         ,a.months
         ,a.channel
         ,a.customer_idh
         ,a.channel_lastest
         ,a.customer_idh_lastest
         ,a.bu_1
         ,a.bu_2
         ,sum(b.pos_gmv_pre_untax) as pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
         ,sum(b.final_inv_value  ) as final_inv_value   -- 期末库存
         ,0 as mini_base_stock_amt_untax   -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
         ,sum(b.ges              ) as ges
         ,sum(nvl(b.pos_gmv_pre_untax,0)-nvl(b.pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax,0)) as pos_normal -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
         ,sum(nvl(b.pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax,0)) as pos_promotional -- Promotional
       from (
        select distinct          
          fcst_date
          ,months
          ,channel
          ,customer_idh
          ,channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp8
        ) a
       left join(
          select
            fcst_date           
            ,months              
            ,channel             
            ,customer_idh        
            ,channel_lastest     
            ,customer_idh_lastest
            ,bu_2
            ,sum(pos_gmv_pre_untax) as pos_gmv_pre_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
            ,sum(final_inv_value  ) as final_inv_value   -- 期末库存
            ,0 as mini_base_stock_amt_untax   -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
            ,sum(ges              ) as ges
            ,sum(pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax) as pos_gmv_promotional_pre_untax
          from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3
           where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
            and is_adj='N'
            group by fcst_date ,months ,channel ,customer_idh ,channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
       )  b
        on nvl(a.fcst_date             ,'')= nvl(b.fcst_date            ,'')
        and nvl(a.months               ,'')= nvl(b.months               ,'')
        and nvl(a.channel              ,'')= nvl(b.channel              ,'')
        and nvl(a.customer_idh         ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh         ,'')
        and nvl(a.channel_lastest      ,'')= nvl(b.channel_lastest      ,'')
        and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
        and nvl(a.bu_2                 ,'')= nvl(b.bu_2                 ,'')
        --and b.fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
       group by
         a.fcst_date
         ,a.months
         ,a.channel
         ,a.customer_idh
         ,a.channel_lastest
         ,a.customer_idh_lastest
         ,a.bu_1
         ,a.bu_2
   ) a
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp10 b -- 取前一个月库存
   on a.channel=b.channel
   and a.customer_idh=b.customer_idh
   and a.channel_lastest=b.channel_lastest
   and a.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
   and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
   and case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then datediff(to_date(substr(a.fcst_date,1,6),'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=1
      else datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=1 end
   and nvl(b.base_stock_amt,0)<>0
 left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp7_cust d -- 当年ytd POS/RSP比例
  on substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)=d.monthly

  on substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(e.monthly,1,4)+1

-- 合并act、fcst数据
-- 如果act数据缺失 取上个月份最后一版fcst对应月份数据。（ecom by tp客户看，nka by渠道看）
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp12

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp12 as
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,null as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,null as ges
  -- pos
  ,a.ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,a.ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,a.so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,a.so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  -- stock
  ,if(a.data_source='FCST' and a.months>a.monthly_stock,cast(b.all_base_stock_amt_untax as decimal),cast(a.base_stock_amt_untax as decimal)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
  ,if(a.data_source='FCST' and a.months>a.monthly_stock,cast(0 as decimal),cast(a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax as decimal)) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  -- 计算12个月平均销额
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_pre_untax_cust
        else a.so_base_sales_amt_untax
     end as all_so_sales_amt_untax  -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度 计算12个月平均销额     
          
  -- 计算整体模块"pos/gmv"
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_pre_untax
        else a.pos_gmv_untax
     end as pos_gmv_untax      -- POS/GMV(未税)&TTL GMV
  
  -- 计算"(L6+L17+服务费)%基价"指标使用
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_pre_untax_cust
        else a.base_pos_gmv_untax
     end as base_pos_gmv_untax  -- POS/GMV基价销额(未税)客户粒度（有产品数据）  
  -- 计算 Normal、Promotional       
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_normal
        else a.pos_gmv_untax
     end as pos_normal      -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_promotional
        else 0
     end as pos_promotional -- Promotional
  ,a.data_source
  ,'ACT' as data_type -- 数�类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp8  a
 left join (
    select
       t1.months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,t1.channel
       ,t1.bu_2
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_pre_untax        ) as pos_gmv_pre_untax         -- POS/GMV(未税)&TTL GMV
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_pre_untax/nvl(t1.pos_rsp_rate_cust ,1)) as pos_gmv_pre_untax_cust     -- POS/GMV(未税)客户粒度
       ,sum(t1.all_base_stock_amt_untax ) as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
       ,sum(t1.pos_normal               ) as pos_normal      -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
       ,sum(t1.pos_promotional          ) as pos_promotional -- Promotional
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp11 t1
    inner join(
       select substr(fcst_date,1,6) as fcst_month,max(fcst_date) as fcst_date_last
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp11
       group by substr(fcst_date,1,6)
     ) t2
      on t1.fcst_date=t2.fcst_date_last
     where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)=t1.months   -- 取每月最后一版本数据
     group by
       t1.months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,t1.channel
       ,t1.bu_2
  ) b
 on a.months=b.months
 and a.channel=b.channel
 and a.customer_idh=b.customer_idh
 and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 and a.data_source='FCST'
 where substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)>a.months and fcst_date not regexp 'KP' -- 预测版本月份及之后的数据用fcst
union all
 -- 取预测版本月份及之后用fcst的数据
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.pos_rsp_rate_cust  -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,a.ges
  -- pos
  ,null as ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,null as ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,null as so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,null as so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,a.all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
  ,a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  ,a.pos_gmv_pre_untax/nvl(a.pos_rsp_rate_cust,1)  as all_so_sales_amt_untax  -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度 计算12个月平均销额
  ,a.pos_gmv_pre_untax as pos_gmv_untax      -- POS/GMV(未税)&TTL GMV
  -- 计算(L6+L17+服务费)%基价指标
  ,a.pos_gmv_pre_untax/a.pos_rsp_rate_cust as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,a.pos_normal      -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税) - Promotional
  ,a.pos_promotional -- Promotional
  ,a.data_source       -- 库存数据来源
  ,'FCST' as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp11 a
 where substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months OR fcst_date  regexp 'KP' -- 预测版本月份及之后用fcst的数据

-- 平均12月平均基价销售额
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp13

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp13 as
select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.months
  ,c.monthly as sellin_monthly
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,max(a.all_so_sales_amt_untax) as all_so_sales_amt_untax
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 2 
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_3_amt_untax -- 近3个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 2 
       then b.months end) as sell_out_3_months -- 近3个月月数
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 5
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_6_amt_untax -- 近6个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 5
       then b.months end) as sell_out_6_months -- 近6个月月数
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_12_amt_untax -- 近12个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 
       then b.months end) as sell_out_12_months -- 近12个月月数
  ,a.data_source
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp12 a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp12 b  -- 取当前版近12月度汇总数据
 on nvl(a.fcst_date   ,'')=nvl(b.fcst_date,'')
 and nvl(a.channel    ,'')=nvl(b.channel  ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh ,'')
 and nvl(a.channel_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.channel_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_1         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_1         ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_2         ,'')
 and datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11
left join (
  select customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,min(monthly) as monthly
  from  ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v3_tmp0 
  where nvl(sell_in_qty,0)<>0
  group by customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
 ) c   -- 最早sellin 月份
 on nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')=nvl(c.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2        ,'')=nvl(c.bu_2         ,'')
group by
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.months
  ,c.monthly
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.data_source
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
