insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_controller_index_bts_v3 partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  distinct
 a.fcst_date      -- 最新预测版本
 ,case when upper(c.channel_lastest)in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 'NKA'
       when upper(c.channel_lastest)in ('DT') then 'Salon DT'
      else c.channel_lastest
  end as channel       
 ,a.customer_idh
 ,c.customer_name_lastest as customer_name
 ,a.bu_2
 ,cast(a.l10_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l10_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.l11_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l11_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.cog_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as cog_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.l16_nes_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l16_nes_rate
 ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
 ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3 a
inner join (
 select max(fcst_date) as fcst_date
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3
 where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3')
 and is_adj='N'
) b  -- 最新预测版本
 on a.fcst_date=b.fcst_date
inner join (
  SELECT  
    channel_lastest
    ,customer_idh_lastest
    ,customer_name_lastest
    ,bu_2
    ,months
  FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v3
) c  -- 最新预测版本
 on substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)=c.months
 and a.customer_idh_lastest=c.customer_idh_lastest
 and a.bu_2=c.bu_2
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v3') 
and (a.l10_ges_rate is not null or a.l11_ges_rate is not null or a.cog_ges_rate is not null or a.l16_nes_rate is not null)

--获取两次推数版本有变化的2nd编码
CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp01 AS
SELECT  t.dist_code
        ,t.second_layer_dist_code AS second_layer_dist_code_old
        ,t1.second_layer_dist_code AS second_layer_dist_code_new
FROM    (
            --获取比对版本
            SELECT  dist_code
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
            WHERE   ds = (
                        SELECT  compare_date
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp')
                        AND     push_date = '${bizdate}'
                        AND channel_name ='MPD'
                    ) 
            AND     NVL(sales_amt_untax,0) <> 0
            UNION
            SELECT  dist_code
                    ,store_code_concat
                    ,second_layer_dist_code
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_add_vs
            WHERE   ds = (
                        SELECT  compare_date
                        FROM    ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp
                        WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp')
                        AND     push_date = '${bizdate}'
                        AND channel_name ='MPD'
                    ) 
            AND     NVL(base_amt_untax,0) <> 0
        ) t --本次推送
FULL JOIN   (
                SELECT  dist_code
                        ,store_code_concat
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
                WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                AND     NVL(sales_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                UNION
                SELECT  dist_code
                        ,store_code_concat
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_add_vs
                WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                AND     NVL(base_amt_untax,0) <> 0
            ) t1
ON      t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
AND     t.store_code_concat = t1.store_code_concat
WHERE   t.second_layer_dist_code <> t1.second_layer_dist_code
AND     t1.second_layer_dist_code IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp02

--发生变化的2nd编码仍然存在于本次推送的文件中,也要保留,防止被全部替换
CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp02 AS
SELECT  t.dist_code
        ,t.second_layer_dist_code_old
        ,t.second_layer_dist_code_old AS second_layer_dist_code_new
FROM    (
            SELECT  dist_code
                    ,second_layer_dist_code_old
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp01
            GROUP BY dist_code
                     ,second_layer_dist_code_old
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                --本次
                SELECT  dist_code
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
                WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                AND     NVL(sales_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                UNION
                SELECT  dist_code
                        ,second_layer_dist_code
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_add_vs
                WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                AND     NVL(base_amt_untax,0) <> 0
            ) t1
ON      t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
AND     t.second_layer_dist_code_old = t1.second_layer_dist_code
WHERE   t1.second_layer_dist_code IS NOT NULL

--获取2nd被删除的清单,且不在变更清单中
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp03

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp03 AS
SELECT  t.*
FROM    (
            SELECT  t.dist_code
                    ,t.second_layer_dist_code AS second_layer_dist_code_old
                    ,t1.second_layer_dist_code AS second_layer_dist_code_new
            FROM    (
                        --上一次推送
                        SELECT  dist_code
                                ,store_code_concat
                                ,second_layer_dist_code
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
                        WHERE   ds = (
                                    SELECT  compare_date
                                    FROM    ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp
                                    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp')
                                    AND     push_date = '${bizdate}'
                                    AND channel_name ='MPD'
                                ) 
                        AND     NVL(sales_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                        UNION
                        SELECT  dist_code
                                ,store_code_concat
                                ,second_layer_dist_code
                        FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_add_vs
                        WHERE   ds = (
                                    SELECT  compare_date
                                    FROM    ${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp
                                    WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm_dev}.dwd_delivery_schedule_control_cp')
                                    AND     push_date = '${bizdate}'
                                    AND channel_name ='MPD'
                                ) 
                        AND     NVL(base_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                    ) t --本次推送
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  dist_code
                                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_pos_add_vs
                            WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                            AND     NVL(sales_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                            UNION
                            SELECT  dist_code
                                    ,second_layer_dist_code
                            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_dashboard_mpd_sale_summary_sellout_add_vs
                            WHERE   ds = '${bizdate}'
                            AND     NVL(base_amt_untax,0) <> 0
                        ) t1
            ON      t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
            AND     t.second_layer_dist_code = t1.second_layer_dist_code
            WHERE   t1.second_layer_dist_code IS NULL
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  dist_code
                        ,second_layer_dist_code_old
                        ,second_layer_dist_code_new
                FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp01
            ) t1
ON      t.dist_code = t1.dist_code
AND     t.second_layer_dist_code_old = t1.second_layer_dist_code_old
WHERE   t1.second_layer_dist_code_old IS NULL

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads_dev}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  dist_code
        ,second_layer_dist_code_old
        ,second_layer_dist_code_new
        ,GETDATE() AS extract_time
FROM    (

            UNION ALL
            SELECT  *
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp02
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  *
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_mpd_store_mapping_cp_temp03
        ) t
GROUP BY dist_code
         ,second_layer_dist_code_old
         ,second_layer_dist_code_new

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_data_source partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    if(coalesce(c.store_effective,b.store_effective)='1','活跃','关闭') as store_effective, -- 	状态
    coalesce(c.bu_2,a.bu_2)  as bu_2	, -- 	BU
    coalesce(c.shop_id_tp,a.shop_id_tp)  as shop_id_tp	, -- 	客户方门店编码
    coalesce(c.shop_id,a.shop_id)	 as shop_id, -- 	标准门店编码
    coalesce(c.shop_name,a.shop_name)	 as shop_name, -- 	标准门店名称
    coalesce(c.ka_code,b.ka_code)	 as ka_code, -- 	KA编码
    coalesce(c.ka_name,b.chain_name)	 as ka_name, -- 	KA名称
    coalesce(c.store_definition,b.store_definition)  as store_definition	, -- 	客户类型
    coalesce(c.store_category,b.store_category)	 as store_category, -- 	门店分类
    coalesce(c.business_model_name,b.business_model_name)	 as business_model_name, -- 	业务模式
    coalesce(c.customer_code,a.customer_code)	 as customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
    coalesce(c.customer_name,a.customer_name)	 as customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
    coalesce(c.start_date,a.start_date) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
    coalesce(c.latest_date,a.latest_date)	 as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
    case when c.data_provider is not null then c.data_provider 
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '丽人'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' then '鲲驰'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '沃亿'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '迈志' end as  data_provider, -- 	数据提供方
    case when c.connection_method is not null then c.connection_method
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'OSS'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('30192078') then 'Quick BI'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then 'API'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'Quick BI'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then 'OSS' end  as connection_method	, -- 	对接方式
    case when c.update_frequency is not null then c.update_frequency
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076','30170773') then 'by month'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'by day'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' then 'by day'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'by month'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then 'by day' end as update_frequency, -- 	更新频率
    case when c.business_push_time is not null then c.business_push_time
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076','30170773') then 'M-1'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'T-1'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('30192078') then 'T-1'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then 'T-2~10'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'M-1'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then 'T-2' end	 as business_push_time, -- 	推数的业务数据时间(T指系统时间)
    case when c.source_push_time is not null then c.source_push_time
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076') then '每月第5个工作日'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30170773') then '每月不定期'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '每日凌晨2点'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('30192078') then '每个工作日'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '每日23:40'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '每月15日之前'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '每天下午5点前' end as source_push_time, -- 	源头推数时间
    case when c.display_time is not null then c.display_time
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076','30170773') then '推数次日'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '推数当天凌晨3点'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('30192078') then '推数次日'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '推数次日凌晨3点半'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '推数次日'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '推数次日凌晨3点半' end as display_time, -- 	DME展示时间
    case when c.whether_city is not null then c.whether_city
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076','30170773') then '否'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('SHN00019','30170776') then '是'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '否'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '否' end	 as whether_city, -- 	DME是否到城市
    case when c.whether_order is not null then c.whether_order
        when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.shop_id in ('30192076','30170773') then '否'
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
        when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.shop_id in ('SHN00019','30170776') then '是'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '是'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '否' end	 as whether_order, -- 	DME是否有订单信息
    case when c.whether_refund is not null then c.whether_refund
        when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
        when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
        when a.customer_code='2925773' then '是'
        when a.data_source_code='1' then '是' end	 as whether_refund, -- 	DME是否有退货信息
    c.remark  as remark -- 	备注
from (
    select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        shop_id_tp	, -- 	客户方门店编码
        shop_id, -- 	标准门店编码
        shop_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        data_source_code,
        min(ds) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        max(ds)	 as latest_date -- 	数据最晚日期
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
    where ds>0
    and (nvl(quantity,0) <>0 or nvl(untax_payment_actual,0) <>0)
    group by bu_2	, -- 	BU
        shop_id_tp	, -- 	客户方门店编码
        shop_id, -- 	标准门店编码
        shop_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        data_source_code
) a
left join(
    select  *
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu 
    where ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
    and ec_store_code_tp is not null 
)b on  a.shop_id_tp =b.ec_store_code_tp
left join (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY shop_id_tp ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id desc) AS rn 
    from ${dme_ods}.s_ecom_pos_data_source
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_ecom_pos_data_source')
) c
on a.shop_id_tp=c.shop_id_tp
and c.rn=1

        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,first_class_code

            SELECT  CASE    WHEN t2.day_id IS NOT NULL THEN t2.day_id
                            ELSE REPLACE(dt_date,'a','')
                    END AS data_date

                    ,second_channel_name
                    ,third_channel_name
                    ,fourth_channel_name

                    ,sku_price * sku_sale_num / 1.13 as rsp_amt_untax
                    ,sku_base_sales_amt
                    ,time_type
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu t
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  month_id
                                    ,MAX(day_id) AS day_id
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
                            GROUP BY month_id
                        ) t2
            ON      REPLACE(t.dt_date,'a','') = t2.month_id
            WHERE   t.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu')
            AND     t.first_channel_name IN ('SELECTIVE RETAILER','NKA')
            AND     t.supply_type_name = '直供'

                -- AND     customer_group_cn_lv2 <> 'Others'

                --          ,CASE   WHEN customer_group_cn_lv2 LIKE '大润发%' THEN '大润发'

                --                  WHEN customer_group_cn_lv2 = '山姆士' THEN '沃尔玛山姆会员'
                --                  ELSE customer_group_cn_lv2
                --          END
    SELECT  
            ka_name_cn_lv1 AS customer_group_cn_lv1,
            ka_name_en_lv1 as customer_group_en_lv1
    FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka

    group by ka_name_cn_lv1,
             ka_name_en_lv1
             
            ) t1

LEFT JOIN   (

                        END AS chain_name

--********************************************************************--
--所属主题: BTS
--功能描述: fcst及actual融合的明细表
--创建者: mass
--创建日期: 2026-04-28 15:06:58
--修改日期	修改人	修改内容
--yyyymmdd	name	comment
--20260515 xueyang 增加字段EKA服务费

-- fcst数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp1 as
select
  fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,months               -- 月份
  ,years                -- 年
  ,customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,sum(nvl(pos_gmv_so_act_untax ,0)) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax         -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
  ,sum(nvl(pos_gmv_so_base_untax,0)) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax        -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
  ,sum(nvl(mini_inv_value            ,0)) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax
  ,sum(nvl(final_inv_value           ,0)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax     -- 期末库存
  ,sum(nvl(sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  ,0)) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax     -- 近3个月月均SO
  ,sum(nvl(sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  ,0)) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax     -- 近6个月月均SO
  ,sum(nvl(sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax    -- 近12个月月均SO
  ,sum(nvl(ges                                  ,0)) as ges                                   -- 集团外毛销售额
  ,sum(nvl(ngs                                  ,0)) as ngs                                   -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
  ,sum(nvl(nes                                  ,0)) as nes                                   -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
  ,sum(nvl(ttl_l6                               ,0)) as	ttl_l6                                -- l6_total
  ,sum(nvl(l6a                                  ,0)) as l6a                                   -- l6_a
  ,sum(nvl(ppd                                  ,0)) as ppd                                   -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(pld                                  ,0)) as pld                                   -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(fg                                   ,0)) as fg                                    -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
  ,sum(nvl(l6a_others                           ,0)) as l6a_others                            -- l6a_others
  ,sum(nvl(l6b                                  ,0)) as l6b                                   -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
  ,sum(nvl(ca                                   ,0)) as ca                                    -- 价差
  ,sum(nvl(rebate                               ,0)) as rebate                                -- 返利
  ,sum(nvl(ka_expense                           ,0)) as ka_expense                            -- KA Expense
  ,sum(nvl(listing_fee                          ,0)) as listing_fee                           -- 进场费
  ,sum(nvl(promotion_activities                 ,0)) as promotion_activities                  -- Promotion Activists
  ,sum(nvl(logistics_fee                        ,0)) as logistics_fee                         -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(oos                                  ,0)) as oos                                   -- OSS
  ,sum(nvl(int_agreement                        ,0)) as int_agreement                         -- Int. Agreement
  ,sum(nvl(l6b_py_release                       ,0)) as l6b_py_release                        -- l6_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(deduction                            ,0)) as deduction                             -- Returned or Refunded，退货
  ,sum(nvl(ror                                  ,0)) as ror                                   -- 递减
  ,sum(nvl(l6b_others                           ,0)) as l6b_others                            -- l6b_others
  ,sum(nvl(l10_service_fee                      ,0)) as l10_service_fee                       -- L10服务商费用
  ,sum(nvl(l17_channel                          ,0)) as l17_channel                           -- L17 Channel
  ,sum(nvl(l17_o2o                              ,0)) as l17_o2o                               -- L17 O2O
  ,sum(nvl(l17_ba                               ,0)) as l17_ba                                -- L17 BA
  ,sum(nvl(l17_channel_specific                 ,0)) as l17_channel_specific                  -- l17_channel_specific
  ,sum(nvl(l17_py_release                       ,0)) as l17_py_release                        -- l17_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion,0)) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,sum(nvl(l17_live_streaming                   ,0)) as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,sum(nvl(l17_customer_service_fee             ,0)) as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_instore_self_broadcast           ,0)) as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,sum(nvl(l17_crm_operation_service_fee        ,0)) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_content_purchase_and_production  ,0)) as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,sum(nvl(l17_data_service_fee                 ,0)) as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,sum(nvl(l17_gift_items                       ,0)) as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,sum(nvl(l17_others                           ,0)) as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,sum(nvl(l17_not_allocated                    ,0)) as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  ,sum(nvl(gp1                                  ,0)) as gp1                                   -- GP1
  ,sum(nvl(channel_gp2                          ,0)) as channel_gp2                           -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,sum(nvl(l17_allocated                        ,0)) as l17_allocated                         -- L17 Allocated
  ,sum(nvl(ttl_l17                              ,0)) as ttl_l17                               -- TTL_L17
  ,sum(nvl(gp2                                  ,0)) as gp2                                   -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,sum(nvl(l10_ges_rate                         ,0)) as l10_ges_rate                          -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l11_ges_rate                         ,0)) as l11_ges_rate                          -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(cog_ges_rate                         ,0)) as cog_ges_rate                          -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l16_nes_rate                         ,0)) as l16_nes_rate                          -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(l10                                  ,0)) as l10                                   -- L10
  ,sum(nvl(l11                                  ,0)) as l11                                   -- L11
  ,sum(nvl(cog                                  ,0)) as cog                                   -- COG
  ,sum(nvl(l16                                  ,0)) as l16                                   -- L16
  ,sum(nvl(c1                                   ,0)) as c1                                    -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,sum(nvl(dbkk                                 ,0)) as dbkk                                  -- DBKK
  ,sum(nvl(l30                                  ,0)) as l30                                   -- L30
  ,sum(nvl(l31                                  ,0)) as l31                                   -- L31
  ,sum(nvl(ebit_f_ac                            ,0)) as ebit_f_ac                             -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,sum(nvl(drmc                                 ,0)) as drmc                                  -- drmc
  ,sum(nvl(ebit_f_reg                           ,0)) as ebit_f_reg                            -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,sum(nvl(l32                                  ,0)) as l32                                   -- l32
  ,is_adj -- is_adj
  ,'FCST' AS  is_fcst
  ,sum(nvl(l17_ec_eka_service_fee               ,0)) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee                -- l17 EKA服务费
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4
where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
 group by
  fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,months               -- 月份
  ,years                -- 年
  ,customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,is_adj -- is_adj

-- 计算各数据源最大有数日期
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp3

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp3 as
select
 '1' flag
 ,max(ke24_month_max)  as ke24_month_max  -- ke24最大有数据月份
from ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4
where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4')

--合并Actual和fcst的数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4 as
select
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4) as years -- 年
  ,t1.channel              -- 快照渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
  ,t1.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
  ,t1.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
  ,t1.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,t1.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,'Act' as data_source    -- fcst数据来源
  ,t1.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,t1.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,'Act' as data_type      -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
  ,null  as pos_rsp_rate_cust  -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,sum(nvl(t1.base_pos_gmv_untax       ,0)) as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.pos_gmv_untax            ,0)) as pos_gmv_untax          -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(nvl(t1.all_base_stock_amt_untax ,0)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)整体板块
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax ,0)) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax,0)) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,sum(nvl(t1.mini_base_stock_amt_untax,0)) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ges                  else t3.ges                  end,0)) as ges                  -- 集团外毛销售额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ngs                  else t3.ngs                  end,0)) as ngs                  -- Net_Gross_Sales，净销售总额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.nes                  else t3.nes                  end,0)) as nes                  -- 全称Net_External_Sales，即外部净销售额；
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l6               else t3.ttl_l6               end,0)) as l6_total             -- l6_total
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6a                  else t3.l6a                  end,0)) as l6_a                 -- l6_a
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ppd                  else t3.ppd                  end,0)) as ppd                  -- Price_Promotion_Discount，促销价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.pld                  else t3.pld                  end,0)) as pld                  -- Price_Listing_Discount，固定价格折扣
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.fg                   else t3.fg                   end,0)) as fg                   -- Free_Goods，赠品金额
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6a_others           else t3.l6a_others           end,0)) as l6a_others           -- l6a_others
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b                  else t3.l6b                  end,0)) as l6_b                 -- 用于Controlling调整FCST的L6B费用
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ca                   else t3.ca                   end,0)) as ca                   -- 价差
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.rebate               else t3.rebate               end,0)) as rebate               -- 返利
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ka_expense           else t3.ka_expense           end,0)) as ka_expense           -- KA Expense
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.listing_fee          else t3.listing_fee          end,0)) as listing_fee          -- 进场费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.promotion_activistes else t3.promotion_activities end,0)) as promotion_activities -- Promotion Activists
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.logistics_fee        else t3.logistics_fee        end,0)) as logistics_fee        -- 物流费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.oos                  else t3.oos                  end,0)) as oos                  -- OSS
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.int_agreement        else t3.int_agreement        end,0)) as int_agreement        -- Int. Agreement
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b_py_release       else t3.l6b_py_release       end,0)) as l6_py_release        -- l6_py_release
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.deduction            else t3.deduction            end,0)) as deduction            -- Returned or Refunded，退货
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ror                  else t3.ror                  end,0)) as ror                  -- 递减
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l6b_others           else t3.l6b_others           end,0)) as l6b_others           -- l6b_others
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l10_service_fee      else t3.l10_service_fee      end,0)) as l10_service_fee      -- L10服务商费用
  ,sum(nvl(t2.internal_sales      ,0)) as internal_sales
  ,sum(nvl(t2.nts                 ,0)) as nts
  -- Profitability NES Report的L17细项来自手工表，不用FCST补数
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel         ,0)) as l17_channel  -- L17 Channel
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_o2o             ,0)) as l17_o2o      -- L17 O2O
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_ba              ,0)) as l17_ba       -- L17 BA
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel_specific,0)) as l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l17_py_release      ,0)) as l17_py_release     -- l17_py_release
  ,0 as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,0 as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,0 as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,0 as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,0 as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,0 as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,0 as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,0 as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,0 as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,0 as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.ttl_l6,0)+nvl(t2.l10_service_fee,0) else nvl(t3.ttl_l6,0)+nvl(t3.l10_service_fee,0) end)
     + sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0))    as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp1     else t3.gp1     end,0)) as gp1           -- GP1
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp1     else t3.gp1     end,0))-sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)) as channel_gp2   -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l17 else t3.ttl_l17 end,0))-sum(nvl(t2.l17_channel,0)) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.ttl_l17 else t3.ttl_l17 end,0)) as ttl_l17       -- TTL_L17
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.gp2     else t3.gp2     end,0)) as ttl_gp2       -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,null as l10_ges_rate  -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as l11_ges_rate  -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as cog_ges_rate  -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,null as l16_nes_rate  -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l10          else t3.l10           end,0)) as l10           -- L10
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l11           else t3.l11           end,0)) as l11           -- L11
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l14_cog       else t3.cog           end,0)) as cog           -- COG
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.l16           else t3.l16           end,0)) as l16           -- L16
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then t2.c1            else t3.c1            end,0)) as c1            -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.dbkk         ,0)) as dbkk          -- DBKK
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l30          ,0)) as l30           -- L30
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l31          ,0)) as l31           -- L31
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.gp2,0)-nvl(t4.dbkk,0)+nvl(t4.l30,0)-nvl(t4.l31,0) else t4.ebit_f_ac end,0)) as ebit_f_ac -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.drmc         ,0)) as drmc          -- drmc
  ,sum(nvl(case when t1.months<=t5.ke24_month_max then nvl(t2.gp2,0)-nvl(t4.dbkk,0)+nvl(t4.l30,0)-nvl(t4.l31,0)-nvl(t4.drmc,0) else t4.ebit_f_reg end,0)) as ebit_f_reg    -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,sum(nvl(t4.l32          ,0)) as l32           -- l32
  ,sum(nvl(t2.listing_fee_py         ,0)) as listing_fee_py             -- 进场费（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.int_agreement_py       ,0)) as int_agreement_py           -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.oos_py                 ,0)) as oos_py                     -- OSS（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.promotion_activities_py,0)) as promotion_activities_py    -- Promotion Activists（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.ka_expense_py          ,0)) as ka_expense_py              -- KA Expense（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.rebate_py              ,0)) as rebate_py                  -- 返利（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.logistic_fee_py        ,0)) as logistic_fee_py            -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.ca_py                  ,0)) as ca_py                      -- 物流费（py）
  ,sum(nvl(t2.l6b_others_py          ,0)) as l6b_others_py              -- l6b_others_py
  ,0 as l17_ec_eka_service_fee                -- l17 EKA服务费
from (                                                                                   
     select                                                                     
      a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
      ,a.months               -- 月份
      ,a.channel              -- 快照渠道
      ,a.customer_idh         -- 客户idh
      ,a.channel_lastest      -- 最新渠道
      ,a.customer_idh_lastest -- customer_idh最新值
      ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
      ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
      ,'Act' as data_source -- fcst数据来源
      ,a.is_not_py        -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
      ,b.is_adj
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_rsp_rate_cust         END AS pos_rsp_rate_cust         -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.all_base_stock_amt_untax  END AS all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax END AS mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.pos_gmv_untax             END AS pos_gmv_untax             -- POS/GMV(未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.base_pos_gmv_untax        END AS base_pos_gmv_untax        -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  END AS sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,case when b.is_adj='N' THEN a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax END AS sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
      ,'1' as flag
      
    from(
      SELECT *,'1' as flag
      FROM ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4
      where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4')
      and data_type='ACT'
      and(
        (substr(fcst_date,1,6)>months and fcst_date not regexp 'KP')  -- 预测版本月份及之后的数据用fcst
       or (substr(fcst_date,1,4)>substr(months,1,4) and fcst_date regexp 'KP') -- KP取之前年份数据
       )
      --and substr(fcst_date,1,6) > months
      ) a
    left join (
       select 'Y' as is_adj,'1' as flag union all
       select 'N' as is_adj,'1' as flag
      ) b
     on a.flag=b.flag
) t1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4 t2  -- act数据
   on nvl(t1.months               ,'')=nvl(t2.months               ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh         ,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh         ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel              ,'')=nvl(t2.channel              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                 ,'')=nvl(t2.bu_1                 ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                 ,'')=nvl(t2.bu_2                 ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest      ,'')=nvl(t2.channel_lastest      ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest ,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_not_py            ,'')=nvl(t2.py_release ,'')
  and t1.is_adj='N'
  and t2.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4')
left join (
    select *,DENSE_RANK()over(partition by months order by fcst_date desc) as rn
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp1
    where substr(fcst_date,1,6)=months
  ) t3  -- fcst
  on nvl(t1.channel             ,'')=nvl(t3.channel             ,'')
  and nvl(t1.months              ,'')=nvl(t3.months              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh        ,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh        ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest     ,'')=nvl(t3.channel_lastest     ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh_lastest,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_1                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                ,'')=nvl(t3.bu_2                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_adj              ,'')=nvl(t3.is_adj              ,'')
  and t3.rn=1
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp1 t4  -- gr55
  on nvl(t1.fcst_date            ,'')=nvl(t4.fcst_date           ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel             ,'')=nvl(t4.channel             ,'')
  and nvl(t1.months              ,'')=nvl(t4.months              ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh        ,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh        ,'')
  and nvl(t1.channel_lastest     ,'')=nvl(t4.channel_lastest     ,'')
  and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_1                ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_1                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.bu_2                ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_2                ,'')
  and nvl(t1.is_adj              ,'')=nvl(t4.is_adj              ,'')
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp3 t5
on t1.flag=t5.flag
--where t1.fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
group by
  t1.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,t1.months               -- 月份
  ,substr(t1.months,1,4)   -- 年

 ) t1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp5 as
select
   a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm') as months               -- 月份
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest          -- 客户idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,a.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,a.is_not_py            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,if(a.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N') as kp_flag
  ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax) as pos_gmv_untax_py
  ,sum(a.nes          ) as nes_py
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4 a
inner join (
 select *,row_number()over(partition by months,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N'),is_adj,is_not_py order by fcst_date desc) rn
 from(
    select distinct months,fcst_date,is_adj,is_not_py
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4
 )
) b -- 按月份取最新一份fcst_date数据
on a.months=b.months
and a.fcst_date=b.fcst_date
and a.is_adj=b.is_adj
and a.is_not_py=b.is_not_py
and b.rn=1
left join (
   select
      distinct customer_idh_lastest,bu_1,bu_2,months
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
) c
 on a.customer_idh_lastest=c.customer_idh_lastest
and a.bu_1=c.bu_1
and a.bu_2=c.bu_2
and to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm')=c.months
group by
   a.fcst_date             -- 预测日期
  ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),12)),'yyyymm')               -- 月份
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest -- 客户idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.bu_1                 -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2                 -- bu_2
  ,a.is_adj               -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
  ,a.is_not_py             -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
  ,if(a.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N')

  ,cast(t1.l17_ba               as decimal(28,6)) as l17_ba               -- L17 BA
  ,cast(t1.l17_channel_specific as decimal(28,6)) as l17_channel_specific -- l17_channel_specific
  ,cast(t1.l17_py_release       as decimal(28,6)) as l17_py_release       -- l17_py_release
  ,cast(t1.l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion as decimal(28,6)) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion -- L17平台资源包/付费推广
  ,cast(t1.l17_live_streaming                    as decimal(28,6)) as l17_live_streaming                    -- L17直播
  ,cast(t1.l17_customer_service_fee              as decimal(28,6)) as l17_customer_service_fee              -- L17客服费
  ,cast(t1.l17_instore_self_broadcast            as decimal(28,6)) as l17_instore_self_broadcast            -- L17站内自播
  ,cast(t1.l17_crm_operation_service_fee         as decimal(28,6)) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee         -- L17CRM运营服务费
  ,cast(t1.l17_content_purchase_and_production   as decimal(28,6)) as l17_content_purchase_and_production   -- L17内容采买/内容制作
  ,cast(t1.l17_data_service_fee                  as decimal(28,6)) as l17_data_service_fee                  -- L17数据服务费
  ,cast(t1.l17_gift_items                        as decimal(28,6)) as l17_gift_items                        -- L17礼品赠品
  ,cast(t1.l17_others                            as decimal(28,6)) as l17_others                            -- l17_others
  ,cast(t1.l17_not_allocated                     as decimal(28,6)) as l17_not_allocated                     -- l17_not_allocated
  -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,cast(t1.l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee as decimal(28,6)) as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
  ,cast(t1.gp1           as decimal(28,6)) as gp1           -- GP1
  ,cast(t1.channel_gp2   as decimal(28,6)) as channel_gp2   -- Channel_GP2(计算GP1 - L17 Channel)
  ,cast(t1.l17_allocated as decimal(28,6)) as l17_allocated -- L17 Allocated
  ,cast(t1.ttl_l17       as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_l17       -- TTL_L17
  ,cast(t1.ttl_gp2       as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_gp2       -- TTL_GP2(计算GP1 - TTL L17)
  ,cast(t1.l10_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l10_ges_rate  -- l10的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l11_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l11_ges_rate  -- l11的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.cog_ges_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as cog_ges_rate  -- cog的ges比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l16_nes_rate  as decimal(28,6)) as l16_nes_rate  -- l16的nes比例（业务上传）
  ,cast(t1.l10           as decimal(28,6)) as l10           -- L10
  ,cast(t1.l11           as decimal(28,6)) as l11           -- L11
  ,cast(t1.cog           as decimal(28,6)) as cog           -- COG
  ,cast(t1.l16           as decimal(28,6)) as l16           -- L16
  ,cast(t1.c1            as decimal(28,6)) as c1            -- C1(计算NES - L10 - L11 - COG)
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.dbkk      )  as decimal(28,6)) as dbkk          -- DBKK
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.l30       )  as decimal(28,6)) as l30           -- L30
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.l31       )  as decimal(28,6)) as l31           -- L31
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.ebit_f_ac )  as decimal(28,6)) as ebit_f_ac     -- ebit_f_ac(计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31)
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.drmc      )  as decimal(28,6)) as drmc          -- drmc
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.ebit_f_reg)  as decimal(28,6)) as ebit_f_reg    -- ebit_f_reg(计算EBIT-F AC - DRMC)
  ,cast(if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,t1.l32       )  as decimal(28,6)) as l32           -- l32
  ,cast(t1.listing_fee_py          as decimal(28,6)) as listing_fee_py             -- 进场费（py）
  ,cast(t1.int_agreement_py        as decimal(28,6)) as int_agreement_py           -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,cast(t1.oos_py                  as decimal(28,6)) as oos_py                     -- OSS（py）
  ,cast(t1.promotion_activities_py as decimal(28,6)) as promotion_activities_py    -- Promotion Activists（py）
  ,cast(t1.ka_expense_py           as decimal(28,6)) as ka_expense_py              -- KA Expense（py）
  ,cast(t1.rebate_py               as decimal(28,6)) as rebate_py                  -- 返利（py）
  ,cast(t1.logistic_fee_py         as decimal(28,6)) as logistic_fee_py            -- Int. Agreement（py）
  ,cast(t1.ca_py                   as decimal(28,6)) as ca_py                      -- 物流费（py）
  ,cast(t1.l6b_others_py           as decimal(28,6)) as l6b_others_py              -- l6b_others_py
  ,nvl(t2.channel_customer_Permission,'Others') as channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,nvl(t2.region_customer_Permission,'Others_Others')  as region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,cast(t1.l17_ec_eka_service_fee            as decimal(28,6)) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee            -- l17 EKA服务费
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4 t1
left join(
   select
      distinct customer_idh
          ,channel
          ,months
          ,sub_channel
          ,customer_name
          ,channel_lastest
          ,sub_channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,customer_name_lastest
          ,sub_channel_lastest_dis  -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
          ,channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
          ,region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
) t2
 on t1.customer_idh_lastest=t2.customer_idh_lastest
 and t1.months=t2.months
 and t1.bu_1=t2.bu_1
 and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
left join (
  select distinct a.fcst_date
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4 a
  inner join (
      select max(substr(fcst_date,1,4)) as years
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp4
      where fcst_date regexp 'KP'
  ) b
  on substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)>=b.years-1
  where a.fcst_date regexp 'KP'
) t3
 on t1.fcst_date=t3.fcst_date
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4_tmp5 t4
 on t1.months = t4.months
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.channel_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.channel_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_1        ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_1        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.bu_2        ,'')=nvl(t4.bu_2        ,'')
 and nvl(t1.is_adj      ,'')=nvl(t4.is_adj      ,'')
 and nvl(t1.is_not_py  ,'')=nvl(t4.is_not_py  ,'')
 and if(t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP','Y','N')=t4.kp_flag
where (
   substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)>=substr('${last_month}',1,6)   -- 取最近两个月上传的FCST数据
 or t3.fcst_date is not null   -- 取最近两个FCST年份对应的KP数据
 )
and t1.customer_idh is not null
and substr(t1.fcst_date,1,4)<=substr(t1.months,1,4)+1 --只取fcst年份前一年及之后的数据

drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_customer_bts_v4_tmp01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_customer_bts_v4_tmp01 as
select
  a.fcst_date                              -- Fcst_date（加上KP）
 ,a.months                                 -- 月份yyyyMMdd
 ,decode(substr(a.months,5,2),'01','Jan','02','Feb','03','Mar','04','Apr','05','May','06','Jun','07','Jul','08','Aug','09','Sep','10','Oct','11','Nov','12','Dec') as months_dis -- 月份展示 Jan/QTD Jan/YTD Jan/H1
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
   end as quarters                         -- 季度Qn
 ,a.years                                  -- 年度yyyy
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'H1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'H2'
   end as half_year                      -- 半年 H1/H2
 ,'Month' as time_type                   -- 时间粒度 Month/QTD/YTD/Half year
 ,case when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 'NKA'
       when upper(a.channel_lastest)in ('DT') then 'Salon DT'
    else a.channel_lastest end as channel     -- 渠道
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest   as sub_channel -- 二级渠道
 ,a.customer_idh_lastest  as customer_idh  -- 客户IDH
 ,a.customer_name_lastest as customer_name -- 客户名称
 ,a.sub_channel_lastest_dis as sub_channel_dis -- sub_channel最新值(BTS展示字段)
 ,a.bu_1                                   -- BU1
 ,a.bu_2                                   -- BU2
 ,a.data_type -- 数据类型 Act PY/Act CY/Fcst（对于QTD/YTD/H 存在Fcst，就给Fcst）
 ,a.is_py_release as py_release            -- Act PY Y-不包含PY值 N-包含PY值
 ,a.is_adj                                 -- IS Adj N-不含ADJ值 Y-仅ADJ值
 ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
 ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
 ,max(a.pos_rsp_rate_cust                     ) as pos_rate                               -- POS/RSP比例（对于QTD/YTD，置空，且NKA和Ecom的虚拟客户，需要计算对应比例）
 ,sum(a.base_pos_gmv_untax                    ) as pos_base_price                         -- POS/GMV基价销额(未税)  计算(L6+L17+服务费)%基价
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax                         ) as pos                                    -- POS/GMV(未税)
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax_py                      ) as pos_py                                 -- POS/GMV(未税) PY
 ,sum(a.pos_gmv_untax_ytd                     ) as pos_ttl_year                           -- POS/GMV(未税) TTL Year
 ,sum(a.pos_normal                            ) as pos_normal                             -- Normal，计算，POS/GMV(未税)- Promotional
 ,sum(a.pos_promotional                       ) as pos_promotional                        -- Promotional
 ,sum(a.all_base_stock_amt_untax              ) as inv_value                              -- 库存基价未税金额(blue table)
 ,sum(a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax              ) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax               -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax              ) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax               -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax             ) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax              -- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
 ,sum(a.inv_month_wts                         ) as inv_month_wts                          -- Inv. Month(WTS Input)
 ,sum(a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax             ) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax              -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
 ,sum(a.ges                                   ) as ges                                    -- GES
 ,sum(a.ngs                                   ) as ngs                                    -- NGS
 ,sum(a.nes                                   ) as nes                                    -- NES
 ,sum(a.nes_py                                ) as nes_py                                 -- NES PY
 ,sum(a.nes_ttl_year                          ) as nes_ttl_year                           -- NES TTL Year
 ,sum(a.l6_total                              ) as l6_ttl                                 -- L6 ttl（计算，L6a+L6b）
 ,sum(a.l6_a                                  ) as l6a                                    -- L6a
 ,sum(a.ppd                                   ) as ppd                                    -- PPD
 ,sum(a.pld                                   ) as pld                                    -- PLD
 ,sum(a.fg                                    ) as fg                                     -- FG
 ,sum(a.l6a_others                            ) as l6a_others                             -- l6a_others
 ,sum(a.l6_b                                  ) as l6_b                                   -- L6b
 ,sum(a.ca                                    ) as ca                                     -- CA
 ,sum(a.rebate                                ) as rebate                                 -- Rebate
 ,sum(a.ka_expense                            ) as ka_expense                             -- KA Expense
 ,sum(a.listing_fee                           ) as listing_fee                            -- Listing Fee
 ,sum(a.promotion_activities                  ) as promotion_activities                   -- Promotion Activities
 ,sum(a.logistics_fee                         ) as logistic_fee                           -- Logistics
 ,sum(a.oos                                   ) as oos                                    -- OOS
 ,sum(a.int_agreement                         ) as int_agreement                          -- Int. Agreement
 ,sum(a.l6_py_release                         ) as l6_py_release                          -- l6_py_release
 ,sum(a.deduction                             ) as deduction                              -- Deduction
 ,sum(a.ror                                   ) as ror                                    -- ROR
 ,sum(a.l6b_others                            ) as l6b_others                             -- l6b_others
 ,sum(a.l10_service_fee                       ) as l10_service_fee                        -- L10服务商费用
 ,sum(a.l17_channel                           ) as l17_channel                            -- L17 Channel+PY_release
 ,sum(a.l17_o2o                               ) as l17_o2o                                -- O2O
 ,sum(a.l17_ba                                ) as l17_ba                                 -- BA
 ,sum(a.l17_channel_specific                  ) as l17_channel_specific                   -- l17_channel_specific
 ,sum(a.l17_py_release                        ) as l17_py_release                         -- l17_py_release
 ,sum(a.l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion ) as l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion  -- 平台资源包/付费推广
 ,sum(a.l17_live_streaming                    ) as l17_live_streaming                     -- 直播
 ,sum(a.l17_customer_service_fee              ) as l17_customer_service_fee               -- 客服费
 ,sum(a.l17_instore_self_broadcast            ) as l17_instore_self_broadcast             -- 站内自播
 ,sum(a.l17_crm_operation_service_fee         ) as l17_crm_operation_service_fee          -- CRM运营服务费
 ,sum(a.l17_content_purchase_and_production   ) as l17_content_purchase_and_production    -- 内容采买/内容制作
 ,sum(a.l17_data_service_fee                  ) as l17_data_service_fee                   -- 数据服务费
 ,sum(a.l17_gift_items                        ) as l17_gift_items                         -- 礼品赠品
 ,sum(a.l17_others                            ) as l17_others                             -- 其他/Others
 ,sum(a.l17_not_allocated                     ) as l17_not_allocated                      -- l17_not_allocated
 ,sum(a.l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee        ) as l6_l17_channel_l10_service_fee         -- L6+L17 Channel+L10服务费
 ,sum(a.gp1                                   ) as gp1                                    -- GP1
 ,sum(a.channel_gp2                           ) as channel_gp2                            -- Channel GP2
 ,sum(a.l17_allocated                         ) as l17_allocated                          -- L17 Allocated
 ,sum(a.ttl_l17                               ) as l17_ttl                                -- TTL L17
 ,sum(a.ttl_gp2                               ) as gp2_ttl                                -- TTL GP2
 ,sum(a.l10                                   ) as l10                                    -- L10
 ,sum(a.l11                                   ) as l11                                    -- L11
 ,sum(a.cog                                   ) as cog                                    -- COG
 ,sum(a.l16                                   ) as l16                                    -- L16
 ,sum(a.c1                                    ) as c1                                     -- C1
 ,sum(a.dbkk                                  ) as dbkk                                   -- Blockcosts BU
 ,sum(a.l30                                   ) as l30                                    -- 30 Operating Income
 ,sum(a.l31                                   ) as l31                                    -- 31 Operating Charges
 ,sum(a.ebit_f_ac                             ) as ebit_f_ac                              -- EBIT-F AC（计算，GP2-DBKK+L30-L31）
 ,sum(a.drmc                                  ) as drmc                                   -- 35a Reg Mgmt CostsBU
 ,sum(a.ebit_f_reg                            ) as ebit_f_reg                             -- EBIT-F Reg（计算，EBIT-F AC - DRMC）
 ,sum(a.l32                                   ) as l32                                    -- 32 Restruct Charges
 ,sum(a.internal_sales                        ) as internal_sales
 ,sum(a.nts                                   ) as nts
 ,sum(a.listing_fee_py                        ) as listing_fee_py                         -- 进场费（py）
 ,sum(a.int_agreement_py                      ) as int_agreement_py                       -- Int. Agreement（py）
 ,sum(a.oos_py                                ) as oos_py                                 -- OSS（py）
 ,sum(a.promotion_activities_py               ) as promotion_activities_py                -- Promotion Activists（py）
 ,sum(a.ka_expense_py                         ) as ka_expense_py                          -- KA Expense（py）
 ,sum(a.rebate_py                             ) as rebate_py                              -- 返利（py）
 ,sum(a.logistic_fee_py                       ) as logistic_fee_py                        -- Int. Agreement（py）
 ,sum(a.ca_py                                 ) as ca_py                                  -- 物流费（py）
 ,sum(a.l6b_others_py                         ) as l6b_others_py                          -- l6b_others_py
 ,sum(a.l17_ec_eka_service_fee                ) as l17_ec_eka_service_fee                 -- l17 EKA服务费
from ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4 a
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_actual_bts_detail_v4')
group by
 a.fcst_date                              -- Fcst_date（加上KP）
 ,a.months                                 -- 月份yyyyMMdd
 ,decode(substr(a.months,5,2),'01','Jan','02','Feb','03','Mar','04','Apr','05','May','06','Jun','07','Jul','08','Aug','09','Sep','10','Oct','11','Nov','12','Dec') -- 月份展示 Jan/QTD Jan/YTD Jan/H1
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'

 ,a.bu_1                  -- BU1

  ,sum(a.nes_py                               ) as nes_py                                 -- NES PY

  ,sum(a.l6_ttl                               ) as l6_ttl                                 -- L6 ttl（计算，L6a+L6b）
  ,sum(a.l6a                                  ) as l6a                                    -- L6a

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_fcst_controller_index_bts_v4 partition(ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  distinct
 a.fcst_date      -- 最新预测版本
 ,case when upper(c.channel_lastest)in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then 'NKA'
       when upper(c.channel_lastest)in ('DT') then 'Salon DT'
      else c.channel_lastest
  end as channel       
 ,a.customer_idh
 ,c.customer_name_lastest as customer_name
 ,a.bu_2
 ,cast(a.l10_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l10_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.l11_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l11_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.cog_ges_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as cog_ges_rate
 ,cast(a.l16_nes_rate as DECIMAL(28,6)) as l16_nes_rate
 ,a.channel_customer_Permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
 ,a.region_customer_Permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 a
inner join (
 select max(fcst_date) as fcst_date
 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4
 where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
 and is_adj='N'
 and fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
) b  -- 最新预测版本
 on a.fcst_date=b.fcst_date
inner join (
  SELECT  
    channel_lastest
    ,customer_idh_lastest
    ,customer_name_lastest
    ,bu_2
    ,months
  FROM ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
) c  -- 最新预测版本
 on substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)=c.months
 and a.customer_idh_lastest=c.customer_idh_lastest
 and a.bu_2=c.bu_2
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4') 
and (a.l10_ges_rate is not null or a.l11_ges_rate is not null or a.cog_ges_rate is not null or a.l16_nes_rate is not null)

  group by  a.first_channel_name
    ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
    ,case when upper(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.customer_group_en_lv1 else a.customer_id end

----------- ECOM渠道 POS数据----------------
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp1

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp1 as
  select
    e.channel as first_channel_name
    ,e.channel_lastest as first_channel_name_lastest
    ,case when a.monthly<='202307' and a.customer_code='2925773' then '1967491' else a.customer_code end as customer_idh
    ,nvl(e.customer_idh_lastest,a.customer_code) as customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.monthly
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,cast(sum(a.quantity  )    as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sale_num
    ,cast(sum(a.untax_payment_actual ) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sales_amt
    ,cast(sum(a.base_sale_amt) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_base_sales_amt
    --,cast(sum(if(d.product_barcode is not null,a.untax_payment_actual,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
    --,cast(sum(if(d.product_barcode is not null,a.base_sale_amt,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
    ,'ecom_pos' as data_source
    ,'pos' as data_type
  from(
    select 
      substr(ds,1,6) as monthly
       ,bu_1
       ,bu_2
       ,customer_code
       ,henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode
       ,sum(quantity) as quantity
       ,sum(untax_payment_actual) as untax_payment_actual
       ,sum(base_sale_amt) as base_sale_amt
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
     where ds >='20210101'
     and nvl(data_source_name,'')<>'PG' -- 老PG过来的ecom数据没有TP，需过滤
     AND nvl(shop_id_tp,'') <> '0'    -- 炜能的店，数据只到23年，可以过滤了 
     and nvl(shop_id,'')<>'30192076'  -- 剔除 天猫施华蔻海外旗舰店
     group by substr(ds,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_item_barcode,customer_code
     
     union all 
     
     -- 取退款
     SELECT  SUBSTR(ds,1,6) AS monthly
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2    
         ,customer_code  
         ,henkel_product_barcode AS product_barcode
         ,SUM(-item_num) AS quantity                     --退货数量
         ,SUM(-return_amt_untax) AS untax_payment_actual --实际退款金额未税
         ,sum(-base_sales_amt) as base_sale_amt          --基价退款金额未税 
     FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu a  
     WHERE   a.ds >= '20210101'
     and nvl(data_source_name,'')<>'PG' -- 老PG过来的ecom数据没有TP，需过滤
     AND nvl(a.shop_id_tp,'') <> '0'  -- 炜能的店，数据只到23年，可以过滤了
     and nvl(shop_id,'')<>'30192076'  -- 剔除 天猫施华蔻海外旗舰店
     group by substr(ds,1,6),bu_1,bu_2,henkel_product_barcode,customer_code
     
     
    union all
    -- 合并TP来源线上分销数据，目前只有沃亿转线上分销
    select 
      substr(pay_time,1,6) as monthly
       ,bu_1
       ,bu_2
       ,customer_code
       ,henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode
       ,sum(quantity) as quantity

-- 合并pos、so、stock、sellin数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp5

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp5 as
select
  coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name,t3.first_channel_name,t4.first_channel_name) as first_channel_name
  ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest) as first_channel_name_lastest
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh,t3.customer_idh,t4.customer_idh) as customer_idh
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh_lastest,t2.customer_idh_lastest,t3.customer_idh_lastest,t4.customer_idh_lastest) as customer_idh_lastest
  ,coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly,t4.monthly) as monthly
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1,t3.bu_1,t4.bu_1) as bu_1
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2,t3.bu_2,t4.bu_2) as bu_2
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num       -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt      -- ecom pos销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt -- ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt   ) as ecom_sales_amt_p    -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t2.so_sale_num       )  as so_sale_num         -- so销售数量
  ,sum(t2.so_dist_prod_amt  )  as so_dist_prod_amt    -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t2.so_base_sales_amt )  as so_base_sales_amt   -- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t2.so_dist_prod_amt  ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的实际销售额（未税）  
  ,sum(t2.so_base_sales_amt ) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t3.stock_num          ) as stock_num           -- 库存数量
  ,sum(nvl(t3.base_stock_amt,0))as base_stock_amt -- 库存金额
  ,sum(t3.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt -- 小样库存基价金额
  ,sum(t4.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,sum(t4.ngs                ) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
  ,coalesce(t1.data_source,t2.data_source,t3.data_source,t4.data_source) as data_source
  ,coalesce(t1.data_type,t2.data_type,t3.data_type,t4.data_source) as data_type
from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp1 t1   -- ecom pos
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp2 t2 -- so、实际数据
 on t1.monthly=t2.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t2.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t2.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp3 t3 -- 库存数据
 on t1.monthly=t3.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t3.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t3.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
full join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp0 t4 -- sellin
 on t1.monthly=t4.monthly
 and t1.first_channel_name=t4.first_channel_name
 and nvl(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.first_channel_name_lastest,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh,'')
 and nvl(t1.customer_idh_lastest,'')=nvl(t4.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and t1.bu_2=t4.bu_2
where coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly)>='202301'
and coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly)<='${bizmonth}'
group by 
  coalesce(t1.first_channel_name,t2.first_channel_name,t3.first_channel_name,t4.first_channel_name)
  ,coalesce(t1.first_channel_name_lastest,t2.first_channel_name_lastest,t3.first_channel_name_lastest,t4.first_channel_name_lastest)
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh,t2.customer_idh,t3.customer_idh,t4.customer_idh)
  ,coalesce(t1.customer_idh_lastest,t2.customer_idh_lastest,t3.customer_idh_lastest,t4.customer_idh_lastest)
  ,coalesce(t1.monthly,t2.monthly,t3.monthly,t4.monthly) 
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_1,t2.bu_1,t3.bu_1,t4.bu_1)
  ,coalesce(t1.bu_2,t2.bu_2,t3.bu_2,t4.bu_2)
  ,coalesce(t1.data_source,t2.data_source,t3.data_source,t4.data_source)
  ,coalesce(t1.data_type,t2.data_type,t3.data_type,t4.data_source)

-- 计算pos、so、inv指标有数最大数据月份,拉平维度数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp6

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp6 as
select
  t0.channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh_lastest
  ,t0.customer_name_lastest
  ,t0.sub_channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh
  ,t0.customer_name
  ,t0.channel
  ,t0.sub_channel
  ,t0.months as monthly
  ,t0.bu_1
  ,t0.bu_2
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num       -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(t1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt      -- ecom pos销售额
  ,sum(t1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt -- ecom pos基价销售额
  ,sum(t1.so_sale_num        ) as so_sale_num         -- so销售数量
  ,sum(t1.so_dist_prod_amt   ) as so_dist_prod_amt    -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t1.so_base_sales_amt  ) as so_base_sales_amt   -- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,sum(t1.so_dist_prod_amt_p ) as so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）  
  ,sum(t1.so_base_sales_amt_p) as so_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
  ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_untax      ) as pos_gmv_untax       -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,sum(t1.base_pos_gmv_untax ) as base_pos_gmv_untax  -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,sum(t1.stock_num          ) as stock_num           -- 库存数量
  ,sum(t1.base_stock_amt     ) as base_stock_amt      -- 库存金额
  ,sum(t1.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt -- 小样库存基价金额
  ,sum(t1.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,sum(t1.ngs                ) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
  ,max(t1.monthly_ecompos    ) as monthly_ecompos    -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
  ,max(t1.monthly_so         ) as monthly_so         -- 有so销量的最大月份
  ,max(t1.monthly_stock      ) as monthly_stock      -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  ,min(case when nvl(t1.sell_in_qty,0)<>0 then t0.months end) as min_sellin_monthly -- 最早sellin月份
from (
    select  a.customer_idh_lastest,a.channel_lastest,a.sub_channel_lastest,customer_idh,a.channel,a.sub_channel,a.bu_1,a.bu_2,a.months
       ,max(customer_name) as customer_name,max(customer_name_lastest) as customer_name_lastest     
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4 a
    group by a.customer_idh_lastest,a.channel_lastest,a.sub_channel_lastest,customer_idh,a.channel,a.sub_channel,a.bu_1,a.bu_2,a.months
 ) t0
left join (
  select
     a1.customer_idh_lastest
     ,a1.bu_2
     ,a1.monthly
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_sales_amt_p else a1.so_dist_prod_amt_p end) as so_dist_prod_amt_p -- 有产品的so实际销售额（未税）  
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_base_sales_amt_p else a1.so_base_sales_amt_p end) as so_base_sales_amt_p  -- 有产品的so基价销售额（未税） 
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_sales_amt else a1.so_dist_prod_amt end) as pos_gmv_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
     ,sum(case when upper(a1.first_channel_name)='ECOM' then a1.ecom_base_sales_amt else a1.so_base_sales_amt end) as base_pos_gmv_untax -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sale_num      ) as ecom_sale_num           -- ecom pos销售数量
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sales_amt     ) as ecom_sales_amt          -- ecom pos销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_base_sales_amt) as ecom_base_sales_amt     -- ecom pos基价销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_sales_amt_p   ) as ecom_sales_amt_p        -- 有产品的ecom pos实际销售额
     ,sum(a1.ecom_base_sales_amt_p) as ecom_base_sales_amt_p -- 有产品的ecom pos基价销售额
     ,sum(a1.so_sale_num        ) as so_sale_num          -- so销售数量
     ,sum(a1.so_dist_prod_amt   ) as so_dist_prod_amt     -- so实际销售额（未税）
     ,sum(a1.so_base_sales_amt  ) as so_base_sales_amt    -- so基价销售额（未税）
     ,sum(a1.stock_num          ) as stock_num            -- 库存数量
     ,sum(a1.base_stock_amt     ) as base_stock_amt       -- 库存金额
     ,sum(a1.mini_base_stock_amt) as mini_base_stock_amt  -- 小样库存基价金额
     ,sum(a1.sell_in_qty        ) as sell_in_qty          -- sellin数量
     ,sum(a1.ngs                ) as ngs                  -- sellin销售额（未税）
     ,max(a2.monthly_ecompos    ) as monthly_ecompos      -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
     ,max(a2.monthly_so         ) as monthly_so           -- 有so销量的最大月份
     ,max(a2.monthly_stock      ) as monthly_stock        -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp5 a1
  left join (
    select data_source,data_type
      ,case when data_source ='ecom_pos' and data_type='pos' then customer_idh_lastest else data_source end as customer_idh_lastest
      ,max(case when nvl(ecom_sales_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_ecompos -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
      ,max(case when nvl(so_base_sales_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_so   -- 有so销量的最大月份
      ,max(case when nvl(base_stock_amt,0)<>0 then monthly end) as monthly_stock   -- 有库存销量的最大月份
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp5
    group by data_source,data_type
      ,case when data_source ='ecom_pos' and data_type='pos' then customer_idh_lastest else data_source end
   ) a2
   on a1.data_type=a2.data_type
   and case when a1.data_type='pos' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_ecompos
           when a1.data_type='so' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_so
          when a1.data_type='stock' then a1.monthly<=a2.monthly_stock
        end
   and case when a1.data_source ='ecom_pos' and a1.data_type='pos' then a1.customer_idh_lastest=a2.customer_idh_lastest
       else a1.data_source=a2.data_source
      end
  group by a1.customer_idh_lastest,a1.bu_2,a1.monthly
 )t1
 on t0.customer_idh_lastest=t1.customer_idh_lastest
 and t0.bu_2=t1.bu_2
 and t0.months=t1.monthly
  -- 系统月份之前最近有pos数据月份之后的数据用fcst数据补充（ecom by tp客户看，nka by渠道看）
group by
  t0.channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh_lastest
  ,t0.customer_name_lastest
  ,t0.sub_channel_lastest
  ,t0.customer_idh
  ,t0.customer_name
  ,t0.channel
  ,t0.sub_channel
  ,t0.months
  ,t0.bu_1
  ,t0.bu_2

-- 计算客户粒度 POS/RSP比例中间值 近12月数据（含当月）
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_cust

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_cust as
select
 channel_lastest
 ,monthly
 ,customer_idh_lastest
 ,bu_1
 ,bu_2
 ,so_dist_prod_amt_p  -- 近12个月有产品的so实际销售额（未税）
 ,so_base_sales_amt_p -- 近12个月有产品的so基价销售额（未税）
 ,case when nvl(so_base_sales_amt_p,0)=0 then null else so_dist_prod_amt_p/so_base_sales_amt_p end as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
from(
  select
    b.channel_lastest
    ,a.months as monthly
    ,b.customer_idh_lastest
    ,b.bu_1

-- 拉平所有维度数据：pos数据拉平fcst_date，并判断是否用fcst数据补充。每个fcst_date 放近两年的act数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp8

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp8 as
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,c.channel
  ,c.customer_idh
  ,c.channel_lastest
  ,c.customer_idh_lastest
  ,c.bu_1
  ,c.bu_2
  ,case when a.months<=b.monthly_ecompos or a.months<=b.monthly_so or a.months<=b.monthly_stock then 'ACT' else 'FCST' end as data_source
  ,max(b.monthly_ecompos)as monthly_ecompos -- ecom有pos销量的最大月份
  ,max(b.monthly_so   )  as monthly_so    -- 有so销量的最大月份
  ,max(b.monthly_stock)  as monthly_stock -- 有库存销量的最大月份
  ,min(b.min_sellin_monthly) as min_sellin_monthly -- 最早sellin月份
  ,sum(b.ecom_sale_num)  as ecom_sale_num -- ecom pos销售数量
  ,sum(b.so_sale_num)    as so_sale_num  -- so销售数量
  ,sum(b.stock_num)      as stock_num    -- 库存数量
  -- pos
  ,cast(sum(b.ecom_sales_amt     ) as decimal) as ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.ecom_base_sales_amt) as decimal) as ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,cast(sum(b.so_dist_prod_amt  ) as decimal) as so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.so_base_sales_amt ) as decimal) as so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.pos_gmv_untax     ) as decimal) as pos_gmv_untax          -- POS/GMV(未税)
  ,cast(sum(b.base_pos_gmv_untax) as decimal) as base_pos_gmv_untax     -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  -- stock
  ,cast(sum(b.base_stock_amt) as decimal) as base_stock_amt_untax -- 库存金额 （未税）
  ,cast(sum(b.mini_base_stock_amt) as decimal) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  -- sellin
  ,cast(sum(b.sell_in_qty        ) as decimal) as sell_in_qty         -- sellin数量
  ,cast(sum(b.ngs                ) as decimal) as ngs                 -- sellin销售额（未税）
 from  (
    select distinct t1.fcst_date,t2.months
    from(
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,a.months
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
       union all
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),-12)),'yyyymm')
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
       union all
       select distinct
           a.fcst_date
           ,to_char(date(add_months(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),-24)),'yyyymm')
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 a
       where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
       --and substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)=substr(a.months,1,4)
     ) t1
     left join (
        select
          distinct substr(day_id,1,6) as months
        from dme_cdm.dim_day
     )t2
     on substr(t1.months,1,4)=substr(t2.months,1,4)
   ) a
 left join (
  select
      distinct customer_idh,channel,channel_lastest,bu_1,bu_2,customer_idh_lastest,months
   from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_mapping_bts_v4
 ) c
  on a.months=c.months
 left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp6 b
  on a.months=b.monthly
  and c.channel_lastest=b.channel_lastest
  and c.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
  and c.bu_1=b.bu_1
  and c.bu_2=b.bu_2
  and b.monthly<'${bizmonth}' -- 过滤当月数据
  --and a.fcst_date not regexp 'KP' 
 group by
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,c.channel
  ,c.customer_idh
  ,c.channel_lastest
  ,c.customer_idh_lastest
  ,c.bu_1
  ,c.bu_2
  ,case when a.months<=b.monthly_ecompos or a.months<=b.monthly_so or a.months<=b.monthly_stock then 'ACT' else 'FCST' end
