-- 计算fcst_date当月库存，（上月末实际库存+当月ges+pos_gmv未税）
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp10

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp10 as
 select
   a.months
   ,a.channel
   ,a.customer_idh
   ,a.channel_lastest
   ,a.customer_idh_lastest
   ,a.bu_1
   ,a.bu_2
   ,case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then 'ACT_stock' else 'FCST'END as data_source
   ,sum(a.ges_fcst) as ges_fcst
   ,sum(a.pos_gmv_so_act_untax_fcst ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax_fcst   -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
   ,sum(a.pos_gmv_so_base_untax_fcst) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax_fcst  -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
   ,sum(case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then b.base_stock_amt else d.base_stock_amt end) as base_stock_amt   -- 当月月实际库存
 from (
    select
        a.months
        ,a.channel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.channel_lastest
        ,a.customer_idh_lastest
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
        ,sum(b.ges) as ges_fcst
        ,sum(b.pos_gmv_so_act_untax ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax_fcst   -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
        ,sum(b.pos_gmv_so_base_untax) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax_fcst  -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
    from (
        select distinct          
          months
          ,channel
          ,customer_idh
          ,channel_lastest
          ,customer_idh_lastest
          ,bu_1
          ,bu_2
        from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp8
        ) a
    left join (
        select
           fcst_date
           ,months               
           ,channel              
           ,customer_idh         
           ,channel_lastest      
           ,customer_idh_lastest 
           ,bu_1
           ,bu_2
           ,sum(ges) as ges
           ,sum(pos_gmv_so_act_untax ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax   -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
           ,sum(pos_gmv_so_base_untax) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax  -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
        and is_adj='N'
        and fcst_date not regexp 'KP'
        and channel_orig='DT' -- 手工上传DT渠道
        group by  fcst_date ,months ,channel ,customer_idh ,channel_lastest ,customer_idh_lastest,bu_1,bu_2
      ) b
     on nvl(a.months               ,'')= nvl(b.months               ,'')
    and nvl(a.channel              ,'')= nvl(b.channel              ,'')
    and nvl(a.customer_idh         ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh         ,'')
    and nvl(a.channel_lastest      ,'')= nvl(b.channel_lastest      ,'')
    and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')= nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
    and nvl(a.bu_1                 ,'')= nvl(b.bu_1                 ,'')
    and nvl(a.bu_2                 ,'')= nvl(b.bu_2                 ,'')
    and substr(b.fcst_date,1,6)=b.months
    group by a.months
        ,a.channel
        ,a.customer_idh
        ,a.channel_lastest
        ,a.customer_idh_lastest
        ,a.bu_1
        ,a.bu_2
   ) a
 left join (
     select monthly
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_1
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
      ,sum(base_stock_amt) as base_stock_amt
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp9
     group by monthly,customer_idh_lastest,bu_1,bu_2
     ) b
  on a.months=b.monthly
  and a.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_1=b.bu_1
  and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 left join (
     select monthly
      ,customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_1
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
      ,sum(base_stock_amt) as base_stock_amt
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp9
     group by monthly,customer_idh_lastest,bu_1,bu_2
     ) d -- 取最近一个月份库存
  on a.customer_idh_lastest=d.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_1=d.bu_1
  and a.bu_2=d.bu_2
  and nvl(d.base_stock_amt,0)<>0
  and nvl(d.monthly  ,'')=nvl(d.monthly_stock  ,'') 
 left join (
     select customer_idh_lastest
      ,bu_1
      ,bu_2
      ,max(monthly_stock) as monthly_stock
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp9
     group by  customer_idh_lastest,bu_1,bu_2
     ) e -- 取库存最近一个月份
  on a.customer_idh_lastest=e.customer_idh_lastest
  and a.bu_1=e.bu_1
  and a.bu_2=e.bu_2
 group by  a.months ,a.channel ,a.customer_idh ,a.channel_lastest ,a.customer_idh_lastest ,a.bu_1 ,a.bu_2
   ,case when a.months<=e.monthly_stock then 'ACT_stock' else 'FCST'END

-- 计算CP系统过来的FCST数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11_01

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11_01 as
select
 fcst_date
 ,months
 ,channel
 ,customer_idh
 ,channel_lastest
 ,customer_idh_lastest
 ,bu_1
 ,bu_2
 ,ges
 ,pos_gmv_so_act_untax      -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
 ,pos_gmv_so_base_untax     -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
 ,final_inv_value           -- 期末库存
 ,mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
 ,sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO
 ,sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO
 ,sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO 
 ,if(pos_gmv_so_base_untax=0,null,pos_gmv_so_act_untax/pos_gmv_so_base_untax ) as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
 ,act_pos_rsp_rate_cust_mp 
 ,act_pos_rsp_rate_channel_mp
 ,act_pos_rsp_rate_cust_kp
 ,act_pos_rsp_rate_channel_kp
from(
  select
    t1.fcst_date           
    ,t1.months              
    ,t1.channel             
    ,t1.customer_idh        
    ,t1.channel_lastest
    ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
    ,t1.bu_1
    ,t1.bu_2
    ,max(t2.pos_rsp_rate_cust)    as act_pos_rsp_rate_cust_mp
    ,max(t3.pos_rsp_rate_channel) as act_pos_rsp_rate_channel_mp
    ,max(t4.pos_rsp_rate_cust )   as act_pos_rsp_rate_cust_kp
    ,max(t5.pos_rsp_rate_channel) as act_pos_rsp_rate_channel_kp
    ,sum(t1.ges                      ) as ges
    ,sum(case when t1.channel_orig='MPD' and t1.fcst_date not regexp 'KP' then t1.pos_gmv_so_base_untax*nvl(t2.pos_rsp_rate_cust,t3.pos_rsp_rate_channel)
              when t1.channel_orig='MPD' and t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP' then t1.pos_gmv_so_base_untax*nvl(t4.pos_rsp_rate_cust,t5.pos_rsp_rate_channel)
       else pos_gmv_so_act_untax end) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax      -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
    ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_so_base_untax    ) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax    -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
    ,sum(t1.final_inv_value          ) as final_inv_value          -- 期末库存
    ,sum(t1.mini_inv_value           ) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax-- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
    ,sum(t1.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax ) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax -- 近3个月月均SO
    ,sum(t1.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax ) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax -- 近6个月月均SO
    ,sum(t1.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax-- 近12个月月均SO
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 t1
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_cust t2 -- 客户粒度近12个月 POS/RSP比例
   on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)=t2.monthly
   and t1.channel_lastest=t2.channel_lastest

  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_channel t3 -- 渠道粒度近12个月 POS/RSP比例

   and t1.bu_1=t3.bu_1
   and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2

  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_kp_cust t4 -- 客户粒度KP POS/RSP比例

  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_kp_channel t5 -- 渠道粒度KP POS/RSP比例

   and t1.channel_lastest=t5.channel_lastest
   and t1.bu_1=t5.bu_1
   and t1.bu_2=t5.bu_2
   and t1.fcst_date regexp 'KP'
  where t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')

--取手工来源的DT渠道MP数据
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11_02

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11_02 as
select
 fcst_date
 ,months
 ,channel
 ,customer_idh
 ,channel_lastest
 ,customer_idh_lastest
 ,bu_1
 ,bu_2
 ,pos_gmv_so_act_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
 ,pos_gmv_so_base_untax-- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
 ,mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
 ,ges
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,pos_rsp_rate_cust ) as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,stock_amt_act_last) as stock_amt_act_last -- 上月末实际库存数据
 ,ges_ytd
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,pos_gmv_so_base_untax_ytd) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax_ytd
 ,if(fcst_date regexp 'KP',null,nvl(stock_amt_act_last,0)+nvl(ges_ytd,0)-nvl(pos_gmv_so_base_untax_ytd,0)
   ) as final_inv_value   -- 期末库存
from(
  select
    a.fcst_date
    ,a.months
    ,a.channel
    ,a.customer_idh
    ,a.channel_lastest
    ,a.customer_idh_lastest
    ,a.bu_1
    ,a.bu_2
    ,a.pos_gmv_so_act_untax -- POS/GMV(未税)
    ,a.pos_gmv_so_base_untax-- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
    ,a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
    ,a.ges
    ,a.pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
    ,b.base_stock_amt as stock_amt_act_last -- 上月末实际库存数据
    ,sum(case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then a.ges end)over(partition by a.fcst_date,a.customer_idh,a.bu_2,substr(a.months,1,4)
         order by a.months ) as ges_ytd -- ges(未税)YTD
    ,sum(case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then a.pos_gmv_so_base_untax end)over(partition by a.fcst_date,a.customer_idh,a.bu_2,substr(a.months,1,4)
         order by a.months ) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax_ytd  -- POS/GMV(未税)YTD
  from (
     select
       t1.fcst_date           
       ,t1.months              
       ,t1.channel             
       ,t1.customer_idh        
       ,t1.channel_lastest
       ,t1.customer_idh_lastest
       ,t1.bu_1
       ,t1.bu_2
       ,nvl(t2.pos_rsp_rate_cust,t3.pos_rsp_rate_channel) as pos_rsp_rate_cust 
       ,sum(t1.mini_inv_value           ) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
       ,sum(t1.ges                      ) as ges
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_so_act_untax     ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax  -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_so_act_untax/nvl(t2.pos_rsp_rate_cust,t3.pos_rsp_rate_channel)) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax        -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4 t1
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_cust t2 -- 客户粒度近12个月 POS/RSP比例
      on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)=t2.monthly
      and t1.channel_lastest=t2.channel_lastest
      and t1.customer_idh_lastest=t2.customer_idh_lastest
      and t1.bu_1=t2.bu_1
      and t1.bu_2=t2.bu_2
     left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp7_channel t3 -- 渠道粒度近12个月 POS/RSP比例
      on substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)=t3.monthly
      and t1.channel_lastest=t3.channel_lastest
      and t1.bu_1=t3.bu_1
      and t1.bu_2=t3.bu_2
      where t1.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_fcst_data_bts_v4')
       and t1.is_adj='N'
       and (nvl(t1.data_source,'')='dt_fcst'
        or nvl(t1.channel_orig,'')='DT'
        )
       group by t1.fcst_date ,t1.months ,t1.channel ,t1.customer_idh ,t1.channel_lastest,t1.customer_idh_lastest
       ,t1.bu_1,t1.bu_2,nvl(t2.pos_rsp_rate_cust,t3.pos_rsp_rate_channel)
       
   ) a
  left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp10 b -- 取前一个月库存
   on a.channel=b.channel
   and a.customer_idh=b.customer_idh
   and a.channel_lastest=b.channel_lastest
   and a.customer_idh_lastest=b.customer_idh_lastest
   and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
   and case when substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months then datediff(to_date(substr(a.fcst_date,1,6),'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=1
      else datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm')=1 end
   and nvl(b.base_stock_amt,0)<>0
)

-- 合并act、fcst数据
-- 如果act数据缺失 取上个月份最后一版fcst对应月份数据。（ecom by tp客户看，nka by渠道看）
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp12

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp12 as
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,null as pos_rsp_rate_cust -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,null as ges
  -- pos
  ,a.ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,a.ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,a.so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,a.so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  -- stock
  ,if(a.data_source='FCST' and a.months>a.monthly_stock,cast(b.final_inv_value as decimal),cast(a.base_stock_amt_untax as decimal)) as all_base_stock_amt_untax -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
  ,if(a.data_source='FCST' and a.months>a.monthly_stock,cast(0 as decimal),cast(a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax as decimal)) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  -- 计算12个月平均销额
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_so_base_untax
        else a.so_base_sales_amt_untax
     end as all_so_sales_amt_untax  -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度 计算12个月平均销额     
          
  -- 计算整体模块"pos/gmv"
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_so_act_untax
        else a.pos_gmv_untax
     end as pos_gmv_untax      -- POS/GMV(未税)&TTL GMV
  
  -- 计算"(L6+L17+服务费)%基价"指标使用
  ,case when a.data_source='FCST' and (a.months>a.monthly_ecompos or a.months>a.monthly_so) then b.pos_gmv_so_base_untax
        else a.base_pos_gmv_untax
     end as base_pos_gmv_untax  -- POS/GMV基价销额(未税)客户粒度（有产品数据） 
  ,null as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO
  ,null as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO
  ,null as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO 
  ,a.data_source
  ,'ACT' as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp8  a
 left join (
    select
       t1.months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,t1.channel
       ,t1.bu_2
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_so_act_untax     ) as pos_gmv_so_act_untax      -- POS_GMV_SO_实价未税
       ,sum(t1.pos_gmv_so_base_untax    ) as pos_gmv_so_base_untax     -- POS_GMV_SO_基价未税
       ,sum(t1.final_inv_value          ) as final_inv_value           -- 期末库存
       ,sum(t1.mini_base_stock_amt_untax) as mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11 t1
    inner join(
       select substr(fcst_date,1,6) as fcst_month,max(fcst_date) as fcst_date_last
       from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11
       group by substr(fcst_date,1,6)
     ) t2
      on t1.fcst_date=t2.fcst_date_last
     where substr(t1.fcst_date,1,6)=t1.months   -- 取每月最后一版本数据
     group by
       t1.months
       ,t1.customer_idh
       ,t1.channel
       ,t1.bu_2
  ) b
 on a.months=b.months
 and a.channel=b.channel
 and a.customer_idh=b.customer_idh
 and a.bu_2=b.bu_2
 and a.data_source='FCST'
 where (substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)>a.months and fcst_date not regexp 'KP')  -- 预测版本月份之前的数据用act
   or (substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)>substr(a.months,1,4) and fcst_date regexp 'KP') -- KP取版本年份及之后的数据
union all
 -- 取预测版本月份及之后用fcst的数据
 select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.months
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.pos_rsp_rate_cust  -- POS/RSP比例（客户粒度）
  ,a.ges
  -- pos
  ,null as ecom_sales_amt_untax     -- ecom pos累计销售额（未税）
  ,null as ecom_base_sales_amt_untax-- ecom pos累计基价销售额（未税）
  -- so
  ,null as so_dist_prod_amt_untax -- so实际销售额（未税）
  ,null as so_base_sales_amt_untax-- so基价销售额（未税）
  ,a.final_inv_value as all_base_stock_amt_untax  -- 库存(未税)客户粒度
  ,a.mini_base_stock_amt_untax -- 小样库存基价金额 （未税）
  ,a.pos_gmv_so_base_untax as all_so_sales_amt_untax  -- so基价销售额(未税)客户粒度 计算12个月平均销额
  ,a.pos_gmv_so_act_untax  as pos_gmv_untax           -- POS/GMV(未税)&TTL GMV
  -- 计算(L6+L17+服务费)%基价指标
  ,a.pos_gmv_so_base_untax as base_pos_gmv_untax -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax  -- 近3个月月均SO
  ,a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax  -- 近6个月月均SO
  ,a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax -- 近12个月月均SO 
  ,a.data_source       -- 库存数据来源
  ,'FCST' as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp11 a
 where (substr(a.fcst_date,1,6)<=a.months and fcst_date not regexp 'KP')  -- 预测版本月份及之后的数据用fcst
   or (substr(a.fcst_date,1,4)<=substr(a.months,1,4) and fcst_date regexp 'KP') -- KP取版本年份及之后的数据

-- 平均12月平均基价销售额
drop table if EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp13

create table ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp13 as
select
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.months
  ,c.monthly as sellin_monthly
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,max(a.all_so_sales_amt_untax) as all_so_sales_amt_untax
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 2 
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_3_amt_untax -- 近3个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 2 
       then b.months end) as sell_out_3_months -- 近3个月月数
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 5
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_6_amt_untax -- 近6个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 5
       then b.months end) as sell_out_6_months -- 近6个月月数
  ,sum(case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 
       then nvl(b.all_so_sales_amt_untax,0) end) as sell_out_12_amt_untax -- 近12个月基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,count(distinct case when datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),if(b.months<nvl(c.monthly,'299912'),null,to_date(b.months,'yyyymm')),'mm') between 0 and 11 
       then b.months end) as sell_out_12_months -- 近12个月月数
  ,a.data_source
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp12 a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp12 b  -- 取当前版近12月度汇总数据
 on nvl(a.fcst_date   ,'')=nvl(b.fcst_date,'')
 and nvl(a.channel    ,'')=nvl(b.channel  ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh ,'')
 and nvl(a.channel_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.channel_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_1         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_1         ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_2         ,'')
 and datediff(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'),to_date(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm') between 0 and 11
left join (
  select customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,min(monthly) as monthly
  from  ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp0 
  where nvl(sell_in_qty,0)<>0
  group by customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
 ) c   -- 最早sellin 月份
 on nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')=nvl(c.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2        ,'')=nvl(c.bu_2         ,'')   
 where a.data_type='ACT' or a.data_source='QuickBI' 
group by
  a.fcst_date
  ,a.channel
  ,a.customer_idh
  ,a.channel_lastest
  ,a.customer_idh_lastest
  ,a.months
  ,c.monthly
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.data_source
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型

 select

  ,cast(a.base_pos_gmv_untax        as decimal(28,6)) as base_pos_gmv_untax       -- POS/GMV(基价未税)
  ,cast(case when a.data_type='FCST' and a.data_source='CP' then a.sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax
         else b.sell_out_3_amt_untax/if(b.sell_out_3_months=0,null,b.sell_out_3_months) 
        end as decimal(28,6)) as sell_out_3_mon_avg_untax -- 平均3月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,cast(case when a.data_type='FCST' and a.data_source='CP' then a.sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax
         else b.sell_out_6_amt_untax/if(b.sell_out_6_months=0,null,b.sell_out_6_months) 
        end as decimal(28,6)) as sell_out_6_mon_avg_untax -- 平均6月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,cast(case when a.data_type='FCST' and a.data_source='CP' then a.sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax
         else b.sell_out_12_amt_untax/if(b.sell_out_12_months=0,null,b.sell_out_12_months)
        end as decimal(28,6)) as sell_out_12_mon_avg_untax-- 平均12月平均基价销售额(未税)客户粒度
  ,a.data_source
  ,a.data_type   -- 数据类型
  ,c.is_not_py
from (select *,'1' as flag from ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp12) a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp13 b
 on nvl(a.fcst_date   ,'')=nvl(b.fcst_date,'')
 and nvl(a.channel    ,'')=nvl(b.channel   ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh    ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh ,'')
 and nvl(a.channel_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.channel_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.customer_idh_lastest ,'')=nvl(b.customer_idh_lastest,'')
 and nvl(a.months       ,'')=nvl(b.months      ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_1         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_1         ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2         ,'')=nvl(b.bu_2         ,'')
 and nvl(a.data_source  ,'')=nvl(b.data_source  ,'')
 and nvl(a.data_type    ,'')=nvl(b.data_type    ,'')
left join  (
    select  'Y' as is_not_py,'1' as  flag union all
    select  'N' as is_not_py,'1' as  flag
  ) c
on a.flag= c.flag
left join (
  select customer_idh_lastest,bu_2,min(monthly) as monthly
  from  ${dme_ads}.tb_so_pos_data_bts_v4_tmp0 
  where nvl(sell_in_qty,0)<>0
  group by customer_idh_lastest,bu_2
 ) d   -- 最早sellin 月份
 on nvl(a.customer_idh ,'')=nvl(d.customer_idh_lastest ,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2        ,'')=nvl(d.bu_2         ,'')

--初始化
drop table if exists ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4_temp01

create table if not exists ${dme_ads}.tb_actual_data_bts_v4_temp01 as 
SELECT  month
        ,customer_idh_snapshot
        ,is_not_py
        ,customer_type
        ,bu_1
        ,bu_2
        ,SUM(ges) AS ges
        ,SUM(ngs) AS ngs
        ,SUM(nes) AS nes
        ,SUM(ttl_l6) AS ttl_l6
        ,SUM(l6a) AS l6a
        ,SUM(ppd) AS ppd
        ,SUM(pld) AS pld
        ,SUM(fg) AS fg
        ,SUM(l6a_others) AS l6a_others
        ,SUM(l6_b_w_ror) AS l6b
        ,SUM(ca) AS ca
        ,SUM(rebate) AS rebate
        ,SUM(ka_expense) AS ka_expense
        ,SUM(listing_fee) AS listing_fee
        ,SUM(promotion_activistes) AS promotion_activistes
        ,SUM(logistics_fee) AS logistics_fee
        ,SUM(oos) AS oos
        ,SUM(int_agreement) AS int_agreement
        ,SUM(l6b_py_release) AS l6b_py_release
        ,SUM(deduction) AS deduction
        ,SUM(ror) AS ror
        ,SUM(l6b_others) AS l6b_others
        ,SUM(l10_service_fee) AS l10_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release) AS l17_channel
        ,sum(l17_o2o) as l17_o2o
        ,sum(l17_ba) as l17_ba
        ,sum(l17_channel_specific) as l17_channel_specific
        ,SUM(l17_py_release) AS l17_py_release
        ,SUM(l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion) AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion
        ,SUM(l17_live_streaming) AS l17_live_streaming
        ,SUM(l17_customer_service_fee) AS l17_customer_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_instore_self_broadcast) AS l17_instore_self_broadcast
        ,SUM(l17_crm_operation_service_fee) AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_content_purchase_and_production) AS l17_content_purchase_and_production
        ,SUM(l17_data_service_fee) AS l17_data_service_fee
        ,SUM(l17_gift_items) AS l17_gift_items
        ,SUM(l17_others) AS l17_others
        ,SUM(l17_not_allocated) AS l17_not_allocated
        ,SUM(gp1) AS gp1
        ,SUM(gp1 - (l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release)) AS channel_gp2 --GP1 - L17 Channel
        ,SUM(ttl_l17 - (l17_o2o + l17_ba + l17_channel_specific + l17_py_release)) AS l17_allocated
        ,SUM(ttl_l17) AS ttl_l17
        ,SUM(gp2) AS gp2
        ,SUM(l10) AS l10
        ,SUM(l11) AS l11
        ,SUM(l14_cog) AS l14_cog
        ,SUM(l16) AS l16
        ,SUM(c1) AS c1
        ,sum(internal_sales) as internal_sales
        ,sum(nts) as nts
        ,'Profitability' as data_source
FROM    (
            SELECT   month
                    ,nvl(t2.customer_group_en_lv1,t1.customer_idh_snapshot)  AS  customer_idh_snapshot
                    ,customer_type
                    ,is_not_py
                    ,bu_1
                    ,bu_2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ges' THEN index_value END) AS ges
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ngs' THEN index_value END) AS ngs
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'nes' THEN index_value END) AS nes
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_total' THEN index_value END) AS ttl_l6
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_a' THEN index_value END) AS l6a
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ppd' THEN index_value END) AS ppd
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'pld' THEN index_value END) AS pld
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'fg' THEN index_value END) AS fg
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6a_others' THEN index_value END) AS l6a_others --SUM(CASE WHEN value_type = '' THEN index_value END) AS  l6b,
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ca' THEN index_value END) AS ca
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'rebate' THEN index_value END) AS rebate
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'ka_expense' THEN index_value END) AS ka_expense
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'listing_fee' THEN index_value END) AS listing_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'promotion_activists' THEN index_value END) AS promotion_activistes
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'logistic_fee' THEN index_value END) AS logistics_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'oos' THEN index_value END) AS oos
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'agreement' THEN index_value END) AS int_agreement
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6b_py_release' THEN index_value END) AS l6b_py_release
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'deduction' THEN index_value END) AS deduction
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6_b_w_ror' THEN index_value END) AS l6_b_w_ror
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'return_provision_ror' THEN index_value END) AS ror
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l6b_others' THEN index_value END) AS l6b_others
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'merchandising_l10' THEN index_value END) AS l10_service_fee
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_nka_tm_o2o' THEN index_value END) AS l17_o2o
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_ba' THEN index_value END) AS l17_ba
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_nka' THEN index_value END) AS l17_channel_specific
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'py_release' THEN index_value END) AS l17_py_release
                    ,0 AS l17_platform_resources_paid_promotion --L17平台资源包/付费推广
                    ,0 AS l17_live_streaming --L17直播
                    ,0 AS l17_customer_service_fee --L17客服费
                    ,0 AS l17_instore_self_broadcast --L17站内自播
                    ,0 AS l17_crm_operation_service_fee --L17CRM运营服务费
                    ,0 AS l17_content_purchase_and_production --L17内容采买/内容制作
                    ,0 AS l17_data_service_fee --L17数据服务费
                    ,0 AS l17_gift_items --L17礼品赠品
                    ,0 AS l17_others --L17其他
                    ,0 AS l17_not_allocated --L17未分配
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'gp1' THEN index_value END) AS gp1 --,MAX() AS channel_gp2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l17_total' THEN index_value END) AS ttl_l17
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'gp2' THEN index_value END) AS gp2
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l10_commission' THEN index_value END) AS l10
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l11_t_w' THEN index_value END) AS l11
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l14_cog' THEN index_value END) AS l14_cog
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'l16_umc' THEN index_value END) AS l16
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'c1' THEN index_value END) AS c1
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'internal_sales' THEN index_value END) AS internal_sales
                    ,SUM(CASE    WHEN value_type = 'nts' THEN index_value END) AS nts
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2 t1
            left join 
            (
                 select  distinct
                    customer_group_en_lv1
                   ,customer_group_en_lv2
                 from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
                 where nvl(ds,'') like '%01'
                 and (channel_hierarchy_1_lastest in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') or channel_hierarchy_1 in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER'))
                 and customer_group_en_lv1 not in ('CLH','DIA','Jiami','Lushang','NGS','Others','Parkn shop','Sanjiu') -- 过滤一些无效的KA，需要注意如果这些KA生效了需要释放
            )t2
            on t1.customer_idh_snapshot = t2.customer_group_en_lv2
            WHERE   t1.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_controlling_reports_database_by_customer_mf_v2')
            AND     t1.slow_moving = 'All'
            GROUP BY month
                     ,nvl(t2.customer_group_en_lv1,t1.customer_idh_snapshot)
                     ,customer_type
                     ,is_not_py
                     ,bu_1
                     ,bu_2
        ) t
GROUP BY month
         ,customer_idh_snapshot
         ,is_not_py
         ,customer_type
         ,bu_1
         ,bu_2

    nvl(e.customer_name,'Others')	 as customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
    a.start_date as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
    a.latest_date	 as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
    case when c.data_provider is not null then c.data_provider
        when a.data_type='POS' then case  
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then '丽人'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' then '鲲驰'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then '沃亿'
                                    else  '迈志' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then  '迈志' end as  data_provider, -- 	数据提供方
    case 
        when c.connection_method is not null then c.connection_method
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'OSS'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192078') then 'Quick BI'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667'  then 'API'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'Quick BI'
                                    else 'OSS' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then  'OSS' end  as connection_method	, -- 	对接方式
    case when c.update_frequency is not null then c.update_frequency
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076','30170773') then 'by month'
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'by day'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' then 'by day'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'by month'
                                    else 'by day'  end

    case when c.business_push_time is not null then c.business_push_time
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076','30170773') then 'M-1'
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then 'T-1'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192078') then 'T-1'

                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then 'M-1'
                                    else 'T-2' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then 'T-2' end	 as business_push_time, -- 	推数的业务数据时间(T指系统时间)  
    case 
        when c.source_push_time is not null then c.source_push_time

                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076') then '每月第5个工作日'

                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then '每月15日之前'

                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076','30170773') then '推数次日'

    case 
        when c.whether_city is not null then c.whether_city
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076','30170773') then '否'
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.henkel_store_code in ('SHN00019','30170776') then '是'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then '否'
                                    else '否' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then '否' end	 as whether_city, -- 	DME是否到城市
    case 
        when c.whether_order is not null then c.whether_order
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' and a.henkel_store_code in ('30192076','30170773') then '否'
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667' and a.henkel_store_code in ('SHN00019','30170776') then '是'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then '是'
                                    else '否' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then '否' end	 as whether_order, -- 	DME是否有订单信息
    case 
        when c.whether_refund is not null then c.whether_refund
        when a.data_type='POS' then case
                                    when a.customer_code='1616258' then '是'
                                    when a.customer_code='1787667'  then '否'
                                    when a.customer_code='2925773' then '是'
                                    else '是' end
        when a.data_type='Inventory' then '否' end	 as whether_refund, -- 	DME是否有退货信息
    c.remark  as remark -- 	备注
from (
    ---- pos-------
    select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        min(ds) over(PARTITION BY bu_2,henkel_store_code) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        max(ds)	over(PARTITION BY bu_2,henkel_store_code) as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
        data_type,
        store_category,
        null as ka_code, -- ecom渠道ka编码放的是店铺，需要重新关联ka主数据
        null as ka_name
    from (
        select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        DealerCode as customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        'POS' as data_type,
        store_category,
        dt_date as ds
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ka_pos_sku_store_sales_summary_bu')
    and (nvl(sku_sale_num,0) <>0 or nvl(sku_sales_amt,0) <>0)
    group by 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        DealerCode, -- 	经销商编码
        -- customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        store_category,
        dt_date
    union all 
    -- ecom pos需要从ecompos报表中取，posvoerview表里面ecom pos 20220101之前日期放的时月份，不到天粒度
    select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        store_code as henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        store_name as henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
         customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        'POS' as data_type,
        henkel_store_category as store_category,
        dt_date as ds
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu')
    and (nvl(sku_sale_num,0) <>0 or nvl(sku_sales_amt,0) <>0)
    group by 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        henkel_store_category,
        dt_date
        
    )a
    union all   
     ---- pos 库存------- 
    select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- dealername as customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        min(ds) over(PARTITION BY bu_2,ka_code) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        max(ds)	over(PARTITION BY bu_2,ka_code) as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
        data_type,
        store_category,
        ka_code, -- KA编码
        ka_name -- KA名称  
    from (
        select 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        null as henkel_store_code, -- 	标准门店编码
        null as henkel_store_name, -- 	标准门店名称
        dealercode as customer_code, -- 	经销商编码
        -- dealername as customer_name, -- 	经销商名称
        'Inventory' as data_type,
        null as store_category,
        ka_code, -- KA编码
        ka_name, -- KA名称  
        ds  
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu
    where ds>0
    and nvl(stock_num,0) <>0
    group by 
        bu_2	, -- 	BU
        dealercode, -- 	经销商编码
        -- dealername , -- 	经销商名称
        ka_code, -- KA编码
        ka_name ,
        ds
    ) a
) a
left join(
    select  *
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu 
    where ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
)b on  a.henkel_store_code =b.store_code
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka d
 on coalesce(a.ka_code,b.ka_code) = d.KA_Code
 and d.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
left join (
    select *
    from (
        SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY data_type,bu_2,shop_id,ka_code ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id desc) AS rn 
    from ${dme_ods}.s_dme_pos_inventory_data_source
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_dme_pos_inventory_data_source')
    ) a where rn=1
) c
on case when c.bu_2 is not null and c.shop_id is not null then a.henkel_store_code=c.shop_id and a.bu_2=c.bu_2 and a.data_type=c.data_type
        when c.bu_2 is  null and c.shop_id is not null then a.henkel_store_code=c.shop_id  and a.data_type=c.data_type
        when  c.shop_id is  null and c.ka_code is not null then coalesce(a.ka_code,b.ka_code)=c.ka_code and a.data_type=c.data_type
        end

left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu e
on a.bu_2 = e.bu_2
and a.customer_code = e.customer_code
and e.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_dme_sellout_inventory_data_source partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select 
    a.data_type, -- 数据类型
    a.first_channel_name as first_channel_name, -- 	经销商渠道
    a.region_name  as region_name	, -- 	经销商大区
    a.dist_code	 as dist_code, -- 	经销商编码
    coalesce(e.customer_name,'Others')	 as dist_name, -- 	经销商名称
    a.start_date as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
    a.latest_date	 as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
    case when c.data_provider is not null then c.data_provider
        else '迈志' end as  data_provider, -- 	数据提供方
    case when c.update_frequency is not null then c.update_frequency
        else 'by day' end as update_frequency, -- 	更新频率    
    case when c.business_push_time is not null then c.business_push_time
        else 'T-2' end	 as business_push_time, -- 	推数的业务数据时间(T指系统时间) 
    case when c.source_push_time is not null then c.source_push_time
        else '每天下午5点前' end as source_push_time, -- 	源头推数时间
    case when c.display_time is not null then c.display_time
        else '推数次日凌晨3点半' end as display_time, -- 	DME展示时间              
    c.remark  as remark, -- 	备注
    a.bu_2
from (
    ---- sellout-------
    SELECT
        first_channel_name, -- 经销商渠道 
        region_name, -- 经销商大区
        dist_code, -- 经销商编码 
        -- dist_name, -- 	经销商名称
        min(dt_date) over(PARTITION BY dist_code) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        max(dt_date)	over(PARTITION BY dist_code) as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
        data_type,
        bu_2
    from (
        select 
        first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name, -- 经销商渠道 
        case when upper(first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','MPD') then region_name 
            else null end as region_name, -- 经销商大区
        dist_code, -- 经销商编码 
        -- dist_name, -- 	经销商名称
        -- min(dt_date) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        -- max(dt_date)	 as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
        'SO' as data_type,
        bu_2,
        dt_date
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid 
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
    and (nvl(sales_num,0) <>0 or nvl(actual_sales_amt,0) <>0)
    group by 
        first_channel_name_lastest, -- 经销商渠道 
        case when upper(first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','MPD') then region_name 
            else null end, -- 经销商大区
        dist_code, -- 经销商编码 
        -- dist_name, -- 	经销商名称
        bu_2,
        dt_date
    union all   
     ---- sellout 库存------- 
    select 
        first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name, -- 经销商渠道 
        case when upper(first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','MPD') then henkel_region_name_lastest 
            else null end as region_name, -- 经销商大区
        dist_code, -- 经销商编码 
        -- dist_name, -- 	经销商名称
        -- min(dt_date) as start_date	, -- 	数据开始日期
        -- max(dt_date)	 as latest_date, -- 	数据最晚日期
        'Inventory' as data_type,
        bu_2,
        dt_date
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid 
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_stock_allchannel_mid')
    and nvl(stock_num,0) <>0
    and date_type='日'
    group by 
        first_channel_name_lastest, -- 经销商渠道 
        case when upper(first_channel_name_lastest) in ('DT','MPD') then henkel_region_name_lastest 
            else null end, -- 经销商大区
        dist_code, -- 经销商编码 
        -- dist_name,
        bu_2,
        dt_date
    ) a
) a
left join (
    select *
    from (
        SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY data_type,dist_code ORDER BY qbi_system_upload_id desc) AS rn 
    from ${dme_ods}.s_dme_sellout_inventory_data_source
    where ds=max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_dme_sellout_inventory_data_source')
    ) a where rn=1
) c
on a.dist_code=c.dist_code 
and a.data_type=c.data_type
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu e
on a.bu_2 = e.bu_2
and a.dist_code = e.customer_code
and e.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss PARTITION (ds ='${bizdate}')
SELECT  t.is_ecom --是否Ecom店铺
        ,nvl(t2.store_status,'待补充') AS store_status --待补充状态
        ,t.ka_type --KA类型
        ,t.ka_code --KA编码
        ,t.ka_name --KA名称
        ,t.henkel_store_code AS store_code --门店名称
        ,t.dist_store_name --经销商处门店名称
        ,t.dist_code --经销商编码
        ,t.dist_name --经销商名称
        ,t.bu_2 --BU
        ,t.min_sales_day
        ,t.max_sales_day
        ,t.sellout_sales_amt_untax --SO实价销额未税
        ,t.sellout_base_sales_amt_untax --SO_基价销额未税
        ,t.pos_sales_amt_untax --POS_实价销额未税
        ,t.pos_base_sales_amt_untax --POS_基价销额未税
        ,t.stock_num --KA库存数量
        ,GETDATE() AS update_time
FROM    (
            SELECT  *
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss_ecom_temp_01 --EC
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  COALESCE(o.is_ecom,m.is_ecom) AS is_ecom
                    ,COALESCE(o.ka_type,m.ka_type) AS ka_type
                    ,COALESCE(o.ka_code,m.ka_code) AS ka_code
                    ,COALESCE(o.ka_name,m.ka_name) AS ka_name
                    ,COALESCE(o.dist_store_code,m.dist_store_code) AS dist_store_code
                    ,COALESCE(o.dist_store_name,m.dist_store_name) AS dist_store_name
                    ,COALESCE(o.dist_code,m.dist_code) as dist_code
                    ,COALESCE(o.dist_name,m.dist_name) AS dist_name
                    ,COALESCE(o.bu_2,m.bu_2) AS bu_2
                    ,LEAST(nvl(o.min_sales_day,999999),nvl(m.min_sales_day,999999)) AS min_sales_day
                    ,GREATEST(nvl(o.max_sales_day,0),nvl(m.max_sales_day,0)) AS max_sales_day
                    ,o.sellout_sales_amt_untax AS sellout_sales_amt_untax
                    ,o.sellout_base_sales_amt_untax AS sellout_base_sales_amt_untax
                    ,m.pos_sales_amt_untax AS pos_sales_amt_untax
                    ,m.pos_base_sales_amt_untax AS pos_base_sales_amt_untax
                    ,m.stock_num AS stock_num
                    ,COALESCE(o.henkel_store_code,m.henkel_store_code) as henkel_store_code
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss_dms_temp_02 o     --DMS SO
            FULL JOIN ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss_ka_temp_03 m    --KA POS & INV
            ON      o.dist_code = m.dist_code
            AND     o.henkel_store_code = m.henkel_store_code
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  store_oneid
                FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu
                WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
            ) t1
ON      t.henkel_store_code = t1.store_oneid
left join(
    select store_code,dist_code,store_status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_code,dist_code order by modify_time desc) as rn
     from ${dme_ods}.s_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss_remark
    where ds =MAX_PT('${dme_ods}.s_monitor_master_data_store_bu_loss_remark')
)t2 on t.henkel_store_code = t2.store_code
and t.dist_code=t2.dist_code
and t2.rn=1
WHERE   t1.store_oneid IS NULL
AND     REGEXP_REPLACE(t.henkel_store_code,'[\\x00\\s\\r\\n]','') != ''
AND     t.henkel_store_code <> '-110'
AND     t.henkel_store_code NOT LIKE 'dai%' --含待匹配,待确认
and nvl(sellout_sales_amt_untax,0)+nvl(sellout_base_sales_amt_untax,0)+
nvl(pos_sales_amt_untax,0)+nvl(pos_base_sales_amt_untax,0) <>0

                     ,store_code
                     ,dist_store_name
                     ,dist_code
                     ,dist_name

                        ,create_time
                        ,modify_time

            ) t2

AND     t1.dist_code = t2.dist_code
and     t2.rn=1

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_ecom_store_pos_update PARTITION (ds='${bizdate}')
--非抖音平台优惠数据
SELECT  'POS' as data_type
        ,t.customer_name
        ,t.store_code
        ,t.store_name
        ,t.bill_type
        ,CASE   
        WHEN t1.store_code IS NULL THEN '不涉及'
                WHEN t.data_type = '常规' THEN '否'
                WHEN t.data_type = '回流' THEN '是'
                ELSE '其它'
        END AS is_backflow
        ,t2.date_min
        ,t2.date_max
        ,CASE   WHEN t.data_type = '回流' THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) < '08' THEN '待上传'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '08' THEN '已延期'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') < 1 THEN '未延期'
                        ELSE '未延期'
                END
                ELSE CASE   WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) < '05' THEN '待上传'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '05' THEN '已延期'
                ELSE '未延期'
        END
        END AS data_status
        ,CASE   WHEN t.data_type = '回流'
                    AND DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2
                    AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '08' 
                    THEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GETDATE(),1,7),'-',''),'01'),'yyyymmdd'),'dd') -7
                WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '05' THEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GETDATE(),1,7),'-',''),'01'),'yyyymmdd'),'dd') -4
                ELSE NULL
        END AS delay_date
        ,t3.loss_date_last_month  --上月数据缺失日期
        ,t4.loss_date_curr_month  --当月数据缺失日期
        ,t6.amount_zero_date      --上月至当月金额为0日期
        ,t.data_source
        ,t.platform
        ,GETDATE() AS etl_time
FROM    (
            SELECT  customer_name
                    ,shop_id AS store_code
                    ,shop_name AS store_name
                    ,'正单' AS bill_type
                    ,data_type
                    ,data_source_name AS data_source
                    ,platform
            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-6),'-','')
            AND     shop_name NOT LIKE '%已关闭%'
            AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
            GROUP BY customer_name
                     ,shop_id
                     ,shop_name
                     ,data_type
                     ,data_source_name
                     ,platform
        ) t
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id AS store_code
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-6),'-','')
                and     data_type ='回流'
                AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                GROUP BY shop_id
            ) t1
ON      t.store_code = t1.store_code
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id AS store_code
                        ,data_type
                        ,MAX(ds) AS date_max
                        ,MIN(ds) AS date_min
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                WHERE   ds >='20200101'
                AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                GROUP BY shop_id
                         ,data_type
            ) t2
ON      t.store_code = t2.store_code
AND     t.data_type = t2.data_type
LEFT JOIN   (
                --获取店铺最新日期
                SELECT  shop_id AS store_code
                        ,MAX(ds) AS date_max
                        ,MIN(ds) AS date_min
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                WHERE   ds >='20200101'
                AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                GROUP BY shop_id
            ) t5
ON      t.store_code = t5.store_code --获取上月缺失天数,以下代码AI生成
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id AS store_code
                        ,WM_CONCAT(',',day_id) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY day_id) AS loss_date_last_month
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  /*+ MAPJOIN(shop_list) */
                                    day_list.day_id AS day_id
                                    ,shop_list.shop_id AS shop_id
                            FROM    (
                                        SELECT  day_id
                                        FROM    dme_cdm.dim_day
                                        WHERE   day_id >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
                                        AND     day_id <= REPLACE(SUBSTR(LASTDAY(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm')),1,10),'-','')
                                    ) day_list
                            CROSS JOIN  (
                                            SELECT  DISTINCT shop_id
                                            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                                            WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
                                            AND     ds <= REPLACE(SUBSTR(LASTDAY(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm')),1,10),'-','')
                                            AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                                        ) shop_list
                            WHERE   NOT 
EXISTS(
                                        SELECT  1
                                        FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu m
                                        WHERE   m.ds = day_list.day_id
                                        AND     m.shop_id = shop_list.shop_id
                                        AND     m.henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                                    ) 
                        ) p
                GROUP BY shop_id
            ) t3
ON      t.store_code = t3.store_code
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  shop_id AS store_code
                        ,WM_CONCAT(',',day_id) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY day_id) AS loss_date_curr_month
                FROM    (
                            SELECT  /*+ MAPJOIN(shop_list) */
                                    date_list.day_id
                                    ,shop_list.shop_id
                            FROM    (
                                        -- 生成从本月1号到 bizdate 的所有日期
                                        SELECT  day_id
                                        FROM    dme_cdm.dim_day
                                        WHERE   day_id >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
                                        AND     day_id <= '${bizdate}'
                                    ) date_list
                            CROSS JOIN  (
                                            -- 获取本月有数据的店铺及其最新日期
                                            SELECT  shop_id
                                                    ,MAX(ds) AS max_ds
                                            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
                                            WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
                                            AND     ds <= '${bizdate}'
                                            AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                                            GROUP BY shop_id
                                        ) shop_list
                            WHERE   date_list.day_id <= shop_list.max_ds -- 只到每个店铺的最新日期
                            AND     NOT 
EXISTS(
                                        SELECT  1
                                        FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu m
                                        WHERE   m.ds = date_list.day_id
                                        AND     m.shop_id = shop_list.shop_id
                                        AND     m.ds >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
                                        AND     m.ds <= '${bizdate}'
                                        AND     m.henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                                    ) 
                        ) q
                GROUP BY shop_id
            ) t4
ON      t.store_code = t4.store_code
left join(

select shop_id,WM_CONCAT(',',ds) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ds) as amount_zero_date from (
    select 
            shop_id,ds
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
            AND     shop_name NOT LIKE '%已关闭%'
            AND     henkel_item_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
            group by shop_id,ds having sum(untax_payment_actual) = 0
) o group by shop_id

) t6 on t.store_code = t6.shop_id

union all 

SELECT  'POS' as data_type
        ,t.customer_name
        ,t.store_code
        ,t.store_name
        ,t.bill_type
        ,CASE   WHEN t1.store_code IS NULL THEN '不涉及'
                WHEN nvl(t.data_type,'常规') = '常规' THEN '否'
                WHEN t.data_type = '回流' THEN '是'
                ELSE '其它'
        END AS is_backflow
        ,t2.date_min
        ,t2.date_max
        ,CASE   WHEN t.data_type = '回流' THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) < '08' THEN '待上传'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '08' THEN '已延期'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') < 1 THEN '未延期'
                        ELSE '未延期'
                END
                ELSE CASE   WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) < '05' THEN '待上传'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '05' THEN '已延期'
                ELSE '未延期'
        END
        END AS data_status
        ,CASE   WHEN t.data_type = '回流'
                    AND DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t2.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2
                    AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '08' 
                    THEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GETDATE(),1,7),'-',''),'01'),'yyyymmdd'),'dd') -7
                WHEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(t5.date_max,'yyyymmdd'),'mm') >= 2 AND SUBSTR(CAST(GETDATE() AS STRING),9,2) >= '05' THEN DATEDIFF(GETDATE(),TO_DATE(CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTR(GETDATE(),1,7),'-',''),'01'),'yyyymmdd'),'dd') -4
                ELSE NULL
        END AS delay_date
        ,t3.loss_date_last_month
        ,t4.loss_date_curr_month
        ,t6.amount_zero_date
        ,t.data_source
        ,t7.chain_name as platform
        ,GETDATE() AS etl_time
FROM    (
            SELECT  customer_name
                    ,store_code
                    ,store_name
                    ,'退单' AS bill_type
                    ,nvl(data_type,'常规') as data_type
                    ,'TP POS' AS data_source
                    --,platform
            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
            WHERE  ds =MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
            and refund_time >= REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-6),'-','')
            and    upper(store_category) in ('ECOM')
            and     henkel_product_barcode <>'platform subsidy'
            and     shop_name not like '%已关闭%'
            group by customer_name,store_code,store_name,nvl(data_type,'常规')
        ) t
left join(
                    SELECT  store_code 
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
                WHERE   ds >= REPLACE(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-6),'-','')
                and     data_type ='回流'
                AND     henkel_product_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                GROUP BY store_code
) t1 on t.store_code = t1.store_code
LEFT JOIN   (
                SELECT  store_code
                        ,nvl(data_type,'常规') as data_type
                        ,MAX(refund_time) AS date_max
                        ,MIN(refund_time) AS date_min
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
                WHERE  ds =MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
                and refund_time >='20200101'
                and     henkel_product_barcode <>'platform subsidy'
                and     upper(store_category) in ('ECOM')
                GROUP BY store_code
                       ,nvl(data_type,'常规')
            ) t2
ON      t.store_code = t2.store_code
AND     t.data_type = t2.data_type
LEFT JOIN   (
                --获取店铺最新日期
                SELECT  store_code AS store_code
                        ,MAX(refund_time) AS date_max
                        ,MIN(refund_time) AS date_min
                FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
                WHERE  ds =MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
                AND     henkel_product_barcode <> 'platform subsidy'
                and     upper(store_category) in ('ECOM')
                GROUP BY store_code
            ) t5
ON      t.store_code = t5.store_code --获取上月缺失天数,以下代码AI生成
--获取缺失天数,以下代码AI生成
left join(
 select store_code,WM_CONCAT(',',day_id) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY day_id) as loss_date_last_month 
from
(
SELECT  /*+ MAPJOIN(shop_list) */
        day_list.day_id as day_id
        ,shop_list.store_code
FROM    (
            SELECT  day_id
            FROM    dme_cdm.dim_day
            WHERE   day_id >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
            AND     day_id <= REPLACE(SUBSTR(LASTDAY(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm')),1,10),'-','')
        ) day_list
CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT  DISTINCT store_code
            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
            WHERE  ds =max_pt('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
            and  refund_time >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
            AND     refund_time <= REPLACE(SUBSTR(LASTDAY(DATEADD(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),-1,'mm')),1,10),'-','')
            and     henkel_product_barcode <>'platform subsidy'
            and     upper(store_category) in ('ECOM')
        ) shop_list
WHERE   NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT  1
            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid m
            WHERE   m.ds =MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
            AND     m.refund_time = day_list.day_id
            AND     m.store_code = shop_list.store_code
            and     m.henkel_product_barcode <>'platform subsidy'
            and     upper(m.store_category) in ('ECOM')
        )
)p group by store_code
)t3
 on t.store_code = t3.store_code
 left join(

select store_code,WM_CONCAT(',',day_id) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY day_id) as loss_date_curr_month 
from (
SELECT  /*+ MAPJOIN(shop_list) */
        date_list.day_id
        ,shop_list.store_code
FROM    (
            -- 生成从本月1号到 bizdate 的所有日期
            SELECT  day_id
            FROM    dme_cdm.dim_day
            WHERE   day_id >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
            AND     day_id <= '${bizdate}'
        ) date_list
CROSS JOIN (
            -- 获取本月有数据的店铺及其最新日期
            SELECT  store_code
                    ,MAX(refund_time) AS max_ds
            FROM    dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid
            WHERE   ds =MAX_PT('dme_cdm.dwd_ecom_order_return_info_bu_mid')
            AND     refund_time >= REPLACE(SUBSTR(DATETRUNC(TO_DATE('${bizdate}','yyyymmdd'),'mm'),1,10),'-','')
            AND     refund_time <= '${bizdate}'
            and     henkel_product_barcode <>'platform subsidy'
            and     upper(store_category) in ('ECOM')
            GROUP BY store_code

--店铺Others占比
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_monitor_ecom_store_product_others_ratio PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
 select 
  t.ec_name
 ,t.shop_id
 ,t.shop_id_tp as ec_store_code_tp
 ,t.platform
 ,t.shop_name
 ,t.untax_payment_actual as others_amt_untax
 ,t1.untax_payment_actual as ttl_amt_untax
 ,cast(t.untax_payment_actual/t1.untax_payment_actual as decimal(28,2)) as others_zb
 ,t.month
 ,CURRENT_DATE() AS etl_time
 from (
            select 
                    shop_id
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,shop_name
                    ,platform
                    ,MAX(ec_name) AS ec_name
                    ,CAST(SUM(untax_payment_actual) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS untax_payment_actual
                    ,substr(ds,1,6) as month
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= '20250101'
            AND     ec_name IN ('丽人丽妆','鲲驰')
            and     nvl(henkel_category,'Others') ='Others'
            and     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'shopping voucher'
            and     nvl(henkel_item_barcode,'') <> 'platform subsidy'
            group by shop_id
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,shop_name
                    ,platform
                    ,substr(ds,1,6)
 ) t left join(
                 select 
                    shop_id
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,shop_name
                    ,MAX(ec_name) AS ec_name
                    ,CAST(SUM(untax_payment_actual) AS DECIMAL(19,2)) AS untax_payment_actual
                    ,substr(ds,1,6) as month
            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ecom_order_detail_info_bu
            WHERE   ds >= '20230101'
            AND     ec_name IN ('丽人丽妆','鲲驰')
            group by shop_id
                    ,shop_id_tp
                    ,shop_name
                    ,substr(ds,1,6)
 ) t1 on t.shop_id=t1.shop_id
 and t.month=t1.month
 --只监控Others占比超过五或者金额超过一万的店铺
 where  nvl(t1.untax_payment_actual,0)<>0
 and (cast(t.untax_payment_actual/t1.untax_payment_actual*100 as decimal(28,2)) >=5
 or t.untax_payment_actual >=100000
 )

-- 新增排序键
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp10

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp10 as
select distinct
   Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
   ,Channel --Channel一级
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,Lineup         -- 一级子品类英文
   ,Variant
   ,Size
   ,1 as Channel_rn --Channel一级排序
   ,case when Channel_2 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 20
       when Channel_2='NKA' then 30
       when Channel_2='MPD' then 40
     end as Channel_2_rn --Channel二级排序
   ,case when Channel_3 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='TO B' then 20
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='TO C'   then 30
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Others' then 40
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Hyper'  then 30
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Mini'   then 20
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Others' then 40
       when Channel_2='MPD' then 
         case when Channel_3='Offline retail' then 20
             when Channel_3='Online retail'   then 30
             when Channel_3='WS'              then 40
             when Channel_3='Group buy'       then 50
             when Channel_3='Others'   then 99
           else 90
          end
     end as Channel_3_rn --Channel三级排序
   ,case when Channel_4 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 
          case when Channel_4='Tmall'   then 20
               when Channel_4='JDPS'    then 30
               when Channel_4='TMS'     then 40
               when Channel_4='DY'      then 50
               when Channel_4='VIP'     then 60
               when Channel_4='WeStore' then 70
               when Channel_4='KS'      then 80
              when Channel_4='Others'   then 99
           else 90
          end
       when Channel_2='NKA' then
         case when Channel_4='Watsons' then 20
             when Channel_4='WAL'      then 30
             when Channel_4='CRV'      then 40
             when Channel_4='RT'       then 50
             when Channel_4='Mannings' then 60
             when Channel_4='Metro'    then 70
             when Channel_4='YH'       then 80
             when Channel_4='Others'   then 99
           else 90
          end
     end as Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
   ,case when Lineup is null then 10
         when Lineup='Base'      then 20
         when Lineup='Genesis'   then 30
         when Lineup='Treatment' then 40
         when Lineup='Styling'   then 50
         when Lineup='Others'    then 99
        else 90
    end as Lineup_rn --一级子品类英文排序
   ,case when Variant is null then 10
         when Lineup='Base' and Variant='Volume' then 20
         when Lineup='Base' and Variant='MAD'    then 30
         when Lineup='Base' and Variant='Repair' then 40
         when Lineup='Genesis' and Variant='Green'  then 20  
         when Lineup='Genesis' and Variant='Blue'   then 30  
         when Lineup='Genesis' and Variant='Gold'   then 40  
         when Lineup='Genesis' and Variant='Purple' then 50
         when Lineup='Treatment' and Variant='Pixies oil' then 20 
         when Lineup='Treatment' and Variant='ROT'        then 30 
         when Lineup='Treatment' and Variant='JAR'        then 40
         when Lineup='Styling' then 20
         when Variant='Others'    then 99
      else 90
    end as Variant_rn  -- 版本排序
   ,case when Size is null then 10
         when Size='750'        then 20
         when Size='500'        then 30
         when Size='400'        then 50
         when Size='310'        then 60
         when Size='200'        then 70
         when Size='500*2+50*2' then 80
         when Size='500*2'      then 90
         when Size='400+200'    then 91
         when Size='Others'     then 99
      else 92 
    end as Size_rn     -- 规格排序
   --,dense_rank()over(partition by Channel,Channel_2 order by if(Channel_4='Others','ZZZZZZZZZZZZ',Channel_4)) as Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
   --,dense_rank()over(partition by 1 order by if(Lineup='Others','ZZZZZZZZZZZZ',Lineup)) as Lineup_rn --一级子品类英文排序
from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp09
where rn=1

-- 最终排序
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp10_1

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp10_1 as
  select
     Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
     ,Channel --Channel一级
     ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
     ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
     ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
     ,Lineup    -- 一级子品类英文
     ,Variant   -- 版本排序
     ,Size      -- 规格排序
     ,Channel_rn --Channel一级排序
     ,Channel_2_rn --Channel二级排序
     ,Channel_3_rn --Channel三级排序
     ,Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
     ,Lineup_rn --一级子品类英文排序
     ,Variant_rn  -- 版本排序
     ,Size_rn     -- 规格排序
     ,Channel_2_rn*10000000+Channel_3_rn*1000000+Channel_4_rn*100000+Lineup_rn*10000+Variant_rn*1000+Size_rn*100+b.num as rn
     ,row_number()over(partition by Channel order by Channel_2_rn*10000000+Channel_3_rn*1000000+Channel_4_rn*100000+Lineup_rn*10000+Variant_rn*1000+Size_rn*100+b.num) as Seq_No -- 排序
     ,b.data_type
     ,b.num
  from (
      select '1' as flag,*
      from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp10 
  ) a
  left join (
      select 'iya' as data_type,'1' as flag,1 as num union all 
      select 'act' as data_type,'1' as flag,0 as num
  )b
  on a.flag=b.flag

-- 计算IYA
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp11

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_temp11 as
select
    a.Channel_type     -- Channel的组合类型
   ,a.Channel          -- Channel一级
   ,a.Channel_2        -- Channel二级
   ,a.Channel_3        -- Channel三级
   ,a.Channel_4        -- Channel四级
   ,a.Lineup           -- 业务报告产品线，同DME产品主数据一级子品类
   ,a.Variant          -- 版本
   ,a.Size             -- 规格
   ,a.data_type        -- 指标类型：含批发/去批发
   ,a.sample_product -- FG标签
   ,sum(case when a.months regexp '2023' then a.sell_out_untax end) as CY23 -- CY23指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months regexp '2024' then a.sell_out_untax end) as CY24 -- CY24指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months regexp '2025' then a.sell_out_untax end) as CY25 -- CY25指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months regexp '2026' then a.sell_out_untax end) as CY26 -- CY26指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202307' and '202406' then a.sell_out_untax end) as FY2324  -- FY2324指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202407' and '202506' then a.sell_out_untax end) as FY2425  -- FY2425指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202507' and '202606' then a.sell_out_untax end) as FY2526  -- FY2526指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202607' and '202706' then a.sell_out_untax end) as FY2627  -- FY2526指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202301' and '202306' then a.sell_out_untax end) as _23H1   -- 23H1指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202307' and '202312' then a.sell_out_untax end) as _23H2   -- 23H2指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202401' and '202406' then a.sell_out_untax end) as _24H1   -- 24H1指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202407' and '202412' then a.sell_out_untax end) as _24H2   -- 24H2指标值
   ,sum(case when a.months between '202501' and '202506' then a.sell_out_untax end) as _25H1   -- 25H1指标值

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp1 AS

select yearmonth  as  months
 ,substr(yearmonth,1,4)  as   years
 ,case when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
       when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
       when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
   end as quarters  
 ,case when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2023' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2223'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2023' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2324'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2024' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2324'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2024' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2425'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2025' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2425'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2025' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2526'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2026' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2526'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2026' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2627'
       when substr(yearmonth,1,4) = '2027' and substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2627'
    end as FY 
   ,case when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06')   then 'H1'
         when substr(yearmonth,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12')   then 'H2'   end       as  HY
   ,'TTL VS'  as   Channel    
   ,nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others')  as  Channel_2 
   ,case when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('Ecom') and banner_group in ('DY JD','DY 263','TMS','TMFS','JD') then 'Beijing Yishang Yijie Co.Ltd.'
         when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('Ecom') and banner_group in ('VIP') then 'Wuhan Liyang Co.Ltd.'
         when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('NKA') and Banner_group in ('RTM','METRO','WMSC','CRV')  then  'Hyper'          
         when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('NKA') and Banner_group in ('MANNINGS','WATSONS')  then  'Mini' 
         else 'Others' end   as   `Channel_3`   
    ,case when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('MPD') then null
          when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('Ecom') and banner_group in ('DY JD','DY 263') then 'DY'
          when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('Ecom') and banner_group not in ('DY JD','DY 263') then banner_group
          when nvl(decode(trim(main_channel), '','Others','MPD-indirect','MPD',trim(main_channel)),'Others') in ('NKA') and Banner_group in ('RTM'     )  then  'RT'

-- 不同时间和渠道类型笛卡尔积，并关联计算iya
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp5

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp5 AS
select
     a.date_value   
    ,a.date_value_cy
    ,t1.date_value_py 
    ,a.channel_type 
    ,a.channel      
    ,a.channel_2    
    ,a.channel_3    
    ,a.channel_4    
    ,a.lineup       
    ,a.data_type    
    ,sum(t.data_value)  as  data_value_cy
    ,sum(t1.data_value)  as  data_value_py
    ,sum(nvl(t.data_value,0))/(case when sum(nvl(t1.data_value,0)) = 0 then NULL else sum(nvl(t1.data_value,0)) end)  * 100  as  iya_value
from 
(
    select  distinct 
        a.date_value
       ,a.date_value_cy
       ,b.channel_type
       ,b.channel
       ,b.channel_2
       ,b.channel_3
       ,b.channel_4
       ,b.lineup
       ,b.data_type
     from  
    (select  distinct
        date_value
       ,date_value_cy
       ,1  as  flag
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp4
   -- where date_value_cy <> '不保留'
    )a
    left join (
    select channel_type
          ,channel
          ,channel_2
          ,channel_3
          ,channel_4
          ,lineup
          ,data_type
           ,1  as  flag
    from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp4
    )b
    on a.flag = b.flag
)a
left join ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp4 t
 on  nvl(a.date_value_cy ,'') = nvl(t.date_value_cy ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_type  ,'') = nvl(t.channel_type  ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel       ,'') = nvl(t.channel       ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_2     ,'') = nvl(t.channel_2     ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_3     ,'') = nvl(t.channel_3     ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_4     ,'') = nvl(t.channel_4     ,'')
and  nvl(a.lineup        ,'') = nvl(t.lineup        ,'')
and  nvl(a.data_type     ,'') = nvl(t.data_type     ,'')
 left join ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp4 t1
 on  nvl(a.date_value_cy ,'') = nvl(t1.date_value_py ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_type  ,'') = nvl(t1.channel_type  ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel       ,'') = nvl(t1.channel       ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_2     ,'') = nvl(t1.channel_2     ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_3     ,'') = nvl(t1.channel_3     ,'')
and  nvl(a.channel_4     ,'') = nvl(t1.channel_4     ,'')
and  nvl(a.lineup        ,'') = nvl(t1.lineup        ,'')
and  nvl(a.data_type     ,'') = nvl(t1.data_type     ,'')
group by   a.date_value   
    ,a.date_value_cy
    ,t1.date_value_py

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp6

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp6 as
select distinct
    Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
   ,Channel --Channel一级
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,Lineup 
   ,data_type   -- 一级子品类英文
   ,1 as Channel_rn --Channel一级排序
   ,case when Channel_2 is null then 1
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 2
       when Channel_2='NKA' then 3
       when Channel_2='MPD' then 4
       when Channel_2='Others' then 9
       else 5 end as Channel_2_rn --Channel二级排序
   ,case when Channel_3 is null then 1
   
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Beijing Yishang Yijie Co.Ltd.' then 2
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Wuhan Liyang Co.Ltd.'   then 3
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Shanghai Enxi E-commerce Co.， LTD'   then 4
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Others' then 9
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Hyper'  then 3
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Mini'   then 2
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Others' then 9
       when Channel_2='MPD'  and Channel_3='MPD Online' then 2
       when Channel_2='MPD'  and Channel_3='MPD Offline' then 3
       when Channel_2='MPD'  and Channel_3='MPD Wholesale' then 4
       when Channel_2='MPD'  and Channel_3='Others' then 9
     else 5 end as Channel_3_rn --Channel三级排序
   ,case when Channel_4 is null then 1
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 
          case when Channel_4='Tmall'   then 2
               when Channel_4='JDPS'    then 3
               when Channel_4='TMS'     then 4
               when Channel_4='DY'      then 5
               when Channel_4='VIP'     then 6
               when Channel_4='WeStore' then 7
               when Channel_4='KS'      then 8
              when Channel_4='Others'   then 10
           else 9
          end
       when Channel_2='NKA' then
         case when Channel_4='Watsons' then 2
             when Channel_4='WAL'      then 3
             when Channel_4='CRV'      then 4
             when Channel_4='RT'       then 5
             when Channel_4='Mannings' then 6
             when Channel_4='Metro'    then 7
             when Channel_4='YH'       then 8
             when Channel_4='Others'   then 10
           else 9
          end
        else 10 end as Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
   ,case when Lineup is null then 1
         when Lineup='Base'      then 2
         when Lineup='Genesis'   then 3
         when Lineup='Treatment' then 4
         when Lineup='Styling'   then 5
         when Lineup='Others'    then 7
        else 6 end as Lineup_rn --一级子品类英文排序
   ,case when data_type='GES' then   1
       when data_type='GIV'   then   2
       when data_type='FG'    then   3  end as data_type_rn
from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_si_drs_tmp5

  ,a.store_name    -- 门店名称
  ,a.bu_1          -- bu_1
  ,a.bu_2          -- bu_2
