  ,a.product_line  -- 品线
  ,cast(sum(a.cost_amt         )  as decimal(28,6)) as cost_amt          -- 投放费用
  ,cast(sum(a.impression_cnt   )  as decimal(28,6)) as impression_cnt    -- 展现量
  ,cast(sum(a.click_cnt        )  as decimal(28,6)) as click_cnt         -- 点击量
  ,cast(sum(a.cart_cnt         )  as decimal(28,6)) as cart_cnt          -- 总购物车数
  ,cast(sum(a.favorite_cnt     )  as decimal(28,6)) as favorite_cnt      -- 总收藏数
  ,cast(sum(a.presale_order_cnt)  as decimal(28,6)) as presale_order_cnt -- 总预售成交笔数
  ,cast(sum(a.presale_order_amt)  as decimal(28,6)) as presale_order_amt -- 总预售成交金额
  ,cast(sum(a.direct_order_cnt )  as decimal(28,6)) as direct_order_cnt  -- 直接成交笔数
  ,cast(sum(a.direct_order_amt )  as decimal(28,6)) as direct_order_amt  -- 直接成交金额
  ,cast(sum(a.total_order_cnt  )  as decimal(28,6)) as total_order_cnt   -- 总成交笔数
  ,cast(sum(a.total_order_amt  )  as decimal(28,6)) as total_order_amt   -- 总成交金额
  ,cast(sum(a.gsv_post_refund  )  as decimal(28,6)) as gsv_post_refund   -- 退后成交金额（投放口径）
from(
  select
    months        -- 月份
    ,store_name    -- 门店名称
    ,bu_1          -- bu_1
    ,bu_2          -- bu_2
    ,store_code    -- 门店编码
    ,category_name -- 品类
    ,product_line  -- 品线
    ,sum(cost_amt          ) as cost_amt          -- 投放费用
    ,sum(impression_cnt    ) as impression_cnt    -- 展现量
    ,sum(click_cnt         ) as click_cnt         -- 点击量
    ,sum(cart_cnt          ) as cart_cnt          -- 总购物车数

    ,sum(direct_order_cnt  ) as direct_order_cnt  -- 直接成交笔数
    ,sum(direct_order_amt  ) as direct_order_amt  -- 直接成交金额
    ,sum(total_order_cnt   ) as total_order_cnt   -- 总成交笔数
    ,sum(total_order_amt   ) as total_order_amt   -- 总成交金额

insert OVERWRITE table ${dme_ads}.tb_professtional_si_data_hsa_tmkt partition(data_date ='${bizdate}')
SELECT  t1.ds
        ,SUBSTR(t1.ds,1,6) month
        ,'汉高' AS org_name
        ,t1.henkel_region_lastest
        ,CASE   WHEN t2.channel_name_lastest = 'DT' THEN t2.channel_name2_lastest
                ELSE t2.channel_name_lastest
        END AS first_channel_name
        ,t1.customer_id
        ,t1.customer_name
        ,t1.bu_2
        ,t1.henkel_brand
        ,t1.henkel_category
        ,t1.product_line_name
        ,t1.product_id
        ,t1.sku_name
        ,t1.product_base_price
        ,SUM(t1.quantity_consumer_units) quantity
        ,SUM(t1.gross_sales_price) ges
        ,SUM(t1.sku_ngs_amt) ngs
        ,SUM(t1.sku_ngs_amt * 1.13) AS sellin_ngs_with_tax -- ngs(含税）
        ,NVL(SUM(t1.quantity_consumer_units * t1.product_base_price * 1.13),CAST(SUM(t1.gross_sales_price * 1.13) AS DECIMAL(38,12))) AS sellin_base_amt_with_tax -- sellin基价金额（含税）

ON      t1.customer_id = t2.customer_code
AND     t1.bu_2 = t2.bu_2
WHERE   SUBSTR(t1.ds,1,6) >= '202301'

INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_professtional_so_data_hsa_tmkt PARTITION (ds = '${bizdate}')
SELECT  *
FROM    (
            SELECT  dt_date
                    ,SUBSTR(dt_date,1,6) month
                    ,distributor_type
                    ,t1.dist_code
                    ,t1.dist_name
                    ,first_channel_name_lastest AS first_channel_name
                    ,second_channel_name_lastest AS second_channel_name
                    ,third_channel_name_lastest AS third_channel_name
                    ,category_name
                    ,brand_name
                    ,bu_2
                    ,t1.product_code
                    ,t1.product_name
                    ,product_line
                    ,product_line_en
                    ,region_name
                    ,t2.chain_code
                    ,t2.chain_name
                    ,dist_store_nums
                    ,NVL(SUM(sales_num),0) sales_num
                    ,NVL(CAST(SUM(actual_sales_amt_untax) AS DECIMAL(38,2)),0) actual_sales_amt
                    ,NVL(SUM(actual_sales_amt),0) actual_sales_amt_with_tax
                    ,NVL(SUM(base_price_amt),0) base_price_amt
                    ,NVL(SUM(base_price_amt),0) * 1.13 AS base_price_amt_with_tax
                    ,TO_CHAR(GETDATE(),'yyyymmdd') AS update_date
            FROM    ${dme_ads}.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid t1
            LEFT JOIN   (
                            SELECT  store_oneid AS henkel_store_code -- 汉高门店编码
                                    ,ka_code AS chain_code
                                    ,chain_name
                                    ,SUBSTR(ds,1,6) AS months
                                    ,SUM(dist_store_nums) dist_store_nums
                            FROM    ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t2
                            LEFT JOIN   (
                                            SELECT  store_code
                                                    ,dist_store_nums
                                            FROM    dme_ods.s_salon_dist_store_nums_maizhi
                                            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_ods.s_salon_dist_store_nums_maizhi')
                                        ) t3
                            ON      t2.store_oneid = t3.store_code
                            WHERE   ds LIKE '%01'
                            GROUP BY store_oneid
                                     ,ka_code
                                     ,chain_name
                                     ,SUBSTR(ds,1,6)
                        ) t2
            ON      t1.henkel_store_code = t2.henkel_store_code
            AND     SUBSTR(t1.dt_date,1,6) = t2.months
            WHERE   ds = MAX_PT('dme_ads.tb_inventory_sku_sale_allchannel_mid')
            AND     bu_1 = 'Professional'
            AND     SUBSTR(dt_date,1,6) >= '202301'
            GROUP BY dt_date
                     ,month
                     ,distributor_type
                     ,t1.dist_code
                     ,t1.dist_name
                     ,first_channel_name_lastest
                     ,category_name
                     ,brand_name
                     ,bu_2
                     ,t1.product_code
                     ,t1.product_name
                     ,product_line
                     ,region_name
                     ,t2.chain_code
                     ,t2.chain_name
                     ,dist_store_nums
                     ,product_line_en
                     ,second_channel_name_lastest
                     ,third_channel_name_lastest
        ) t1
WHERE   (
            actual_sales_amt != 0
            OR      base_price_amt != 0
            OR      sales_num != 0
)

-- DMS库存数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp01

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp01 as
SELECT
  substr(a.ds,1,6) as months            -- 年月 
  ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
  ,case when a.first_channel_name_lastest='Ecom' then 
         case when a.dist_code='3030725' then 'YSYJ'
              when a.dist_code='4006756' then 'WHLY'
          else a.dist_code end
    end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
  ,cast(null  as string) as Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,a.prod_barcode as product_barcode  -- Henkel产品条码
  ,a.dist_code     -- 经销商编码
  ,a.dist_name     -- 经销商名称
  ,sum(a.base_qty              ) as stock_num -- 库存数量
  ,sum(a.base_qty*a.base_price ) as stock_amt  -- 基价库存金额
  ,a.data_source
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu a
inner join(
  select 
     substr(ds,1,6) as months
     ,bu_2
     ,dist_code
     ,max(ds) as ds
  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_dms_data_stock_bu
  where ds<>''
  and bu_2='VS'
  group by substr(ds,1,6),bu_2,dist_code
) b
 on nvl(a.dist_code,'')=nvl(b.dist_code,'')
 and nvl(a.bu_2,'')=nvl(b.bu_2,'')
 and nvl(a.ds,'')=nvl(b.ds,'')
where a.ds between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
 and a.bu_2='VS'
 and a.first_channel_name_lastest in ('Ecom','MPD')
 and if(a.first_channel_name_lastest='Ecom',a.ds>='20250701',1=1) -- Ecom经销商库存只取202507及之后的数据)
 and if(a.dist_code='4006756',a.ds<'20251201',1=1) -- 滤武汉利阳的经销商库存只取202507-202511的数据)
group by substr(a.ds,1,6) -- 年月 
  ,a.first_channel_name_lastest
  ,case when a.first_channel_name_lastest='Ecom' then 
         case when a.dist_code='3030725' then 'YSYJ'
              when a.dist_code='4006756' then 'WHLY'
          else a.dist_code end
    end --Channel三级 
  ,a.prod_barcode  -- Henkel产品条码
  ,a.dist_code     -- 经销商编码
  ,a.dist_name     -- 经销商名称
  ,a.data_source

-- KA库存数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp02

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp02 as
SELECT
  t1.months            -- 年月 
  ,t1.first_channel_name as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name='NKA' then nvl(t2.nka_group,'Others')
        when t1.first_channel_name='Ecom' and t1.months>'202506' then 
         case when t1.dist_code in ('3030725','3006839') then 'YSYJ'
              when t1.dist_code='4006756' then 'WHLY'
              when t1.dist_code='100006' and t1.ka_code='EKA0003' then 'WHLY'
              when t1.dist_code='100006' and nvl(t1.ka_code,'')<>'EKA0003' then 'YSYJ'
          else t1.dist_code end
    end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
  ,case when t1.first_channel_name='NKA' then nvl(t1.KA_Name_En_lv1,'Others')
        when t1.first_channel_name='Ecom' and t1.months<='202506' then nvl(t1.ka_name_en,'Others')
    end as Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,t1.ka_code
  ,t1.ka_name
  ,t1.ka_name_en    -- ka英文名称
  ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1
  ,t1.dist_code     -- 经销商编码   
  ,t1.dist_name     -- 经销商名称   
  ,t1.product_barcode  -- Henkel产品条码
  ,t1.stock_num     -- 库存数量
  ,t1.stock_amt     -- 基价库存金额
  ,t1.data_source
from(
    select
      substr(a.ds,1,6) as months            -- 年月 
      ,case when a.ka_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136')
             then 'MPD'
            when a.ka_code ='KA0008' and c.dist_region_name is null then 'MPD'
         else a.first_channel_name
        end as first_channel_name
      ,a.ka_code
      ,a.ka_name
      ,a.ka_name_en      -- ka英文名称
      ,a.KA_Name_En_lv1
      ,a.dealercode as dist_code  -- 经销商编码   
      ,a.dealername as dist_name  -- 经销商名称   
      ,a.henkel_item_barcode as product_barcode  -- Henkel产品条码
      ,sum(a.stock_num     ) as stock_num -- 库存数量
      ,sum(a.base_stock_amt) as stock_amt -- 基价库存金额
      ,a.data_source
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu a
    inner join(
      select 
         substr(ds,1,6) as months
         ,ka_code
         ,ka_name
         ,dealercode
         ,bu_2
         ,max(ds) as ds
      from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_stock_data_info_bu
      where ds<>''
      and bu_2='VS'
      group by substr(ds,1,6),ka_code,ka_name,dealercode,bu_2
    ) b
     on nvl(a.ka_code,'')=nvl(b.ka_code,'')
     and nvl(a.ka_name,'')=nvl(b.ka_name,'')
     and nvl(a.dealercode,'')=nvl(b.dealercode,'')
     and nvl(a.bu_2,'')=nvl(b.bu_2,'')
     and nvl(a.ds,'')=nvl(b.ds,'')
    left join (
       select distinct customer_group_cn_lv2,replace(customer_group_cn_lv2,'华润万家','') as dist_region_name
       from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
       where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
       and customer_group_cn_lv2 regexp '华润万家'
    ) c
    on a.dist_region_name=c.dist_region_name
    where a.ds between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
     and a.bu_2 ='VS'
     and ((a.first_channel_name ='Ecom' and if(a.ka_code in ('EKA0005','EKA0002','EKA0003'),a.ds>='20230101',a.ds<'20250701')) -- 'JD','TMS','VIP'
          or (a.first_channel_name ='NKA'and a.supply_type_name ='直供' and a.ds>='20250701' and if(a.ka_code='KA0008',1=1,a.dealercode='100000')) -- 202507开始迈志接口数据除华润万家外其他的只取公司直供
          or(a.first_channel_name ='NKA' and a.supply_type_name ='直供' and a.ds<'20250701')
          or(a.ds<'20250701' and a.supply_type_name ='直供' and a.ka_code in (
            'KA0008' -- 华润万家 
           ,'KA0003' -- 永辉
           ,'KA0046' -- 重百新世纪
           ,'KA0063' -- 红旗
           ,'KA0023' -- 家家悦
           ,'KA0024' -- 利群
           ,'KA0020' -- 世纪联华
           ,'KA0034' -- 天虹
           ,'KA0030' -- 物美
           ,'KA0013' -- 中百仓储
           ,'KA0136' -- 中百便民超市
           ))
        )
    group by substr(a.ds,1,6)            -- 年月 
      ,case when a.ka_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136')
             then 'MPD'
            when a.ka_code ='KA0008' and c.dist_region_name is null then 'MPD'
         else a.first_channel_name
        end
      ,a.ka_code
      ,a.ka_name
      ,a.ka_name_en      -- ka英文名称
      ,a.KA_Name_En_lv1
      ,a.dealercode   -- 经销商编码
      ,a.dealername   -- 经销商名称

      ,a.data_source

 and t2.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp03

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp03 as
select
 substr(t1.months,1,4) years
 ,t1.months     -- 年月
 ,t1.Channel_2 --Channel二级
 ,t1.Channel_3 --Channel三级
 ,t1.Channel_4 --Channel四级
 ,t1.product_barcode -- Henkel产品条码
 ,t2.product_name -- Henkel产品条码
 ,t1.dist_code       -- 经销商编码
 ,nvl(t3.customer_name,t1.dist_name) as dist_name -- 经销商名称
 ,case when t1.sample_product is not null then t1.sample_product
    when upper(t2.product_class)='FG' then 'FG'
    else 'UN_FG'
  end as sample_product -- FG标签
 ,t1.data_type
 ,t1.data_value  -- 基价库存金额
 ,t1.data_source
from(
   select 
     months     -- 年月
     ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
     ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
     ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
     ,product_barcode -- Henkel产品条码
     ,dist_code       -- 经销商编码
     ,dist_name       -- 经销商名称
     ,null sample_product -- FG标签
     ,'Inventory Value' as data_type
     ,stock_amt as data_value  -- 基价库存金额
     ,'dms_stock' as data_source
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp01
    union all
   select 
     months     -- 年月
     ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
     ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
     ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
     ,product_barcode -- Henkel产品条码
     ,dist_code       -- 经销商编码
     ,dist_name       -- 经销商名称
     ,null sample_product -- FG标签
     ,'Inventory Value' as data_type
     ,stock_amt as data_value  -- 基价库存金额
     ,'ka_stock' as data_source
   from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp02
    union all
   select 
     a.month_id as months     -- 年月
     ,b.Channel_2 --Channel二级          
     ,case when b.Channel_2='NKA' then b.Channel_3
        when b.Channel_2='Ecom' and a.month_id>'202506'  then 
          case when b.customer_code in ('3030725','3006839') then 'YSYJ'
              when b.customer_code='4006756'  then 'WHLY'
              when b.customer_code='100006' and b.Channel_4='VIP'  then 'WHLY'
              when b.customer_code='100006' and nvl(b.Channel_4,'')<>'VIP' then 'YSYJ'
          else b.customer_code end
      end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
     ,case when b.Channel_2='NKA' then b.Channel_4
        when b.Channel_2='Ecom' and a.month_id<='202506' then b.Channel_4
      end as Channel_4 --Channel四级
     ,b.product_barcode
     ,b.customer_code as dist_code       -- 经销商编码 
     ,b.customer_name as dist_name       -- 经销商名称 
     ,b.sample_product   -- FG标签
     ,'P6M Sellout' as data_type
     ,sum(b.sell_out_untax) as data_value  -- SO折算
     ,'so' as data_source
   from (
    select distinct '1' as falg,month_id,quarter_id,year_id
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
    where day_id between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
   ) a
   inner join (
     select '1' as falg,*
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid
     where ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid')    
      and data_type='含批发'
   ) b
    on a.falg=b.falg
    and a.DATEDIFF(TO_DATE(a.month_id,'yyyymm'),TO_DATE(b.months,'yyyymm'),'mm') BETWEEN 0 AND 5
   group by
     a.month_id     -- 年月
     ,b.Channel_2 --Channel二级
     ,case when b.Channel_2='NKA' then b.Channel_3
        when b.Channel_2='Ecom' and a.month_id>'202506'  then 
          case when b.customer_code in ('3030725','3006839') then 'YSYJ'
              when b.customer_code='4006756'  then 'WHLY'
              when b.customer_code='100006' and b.Channel_4='VIP'  then 'WHLY'
              when b.customer_code='100006' and nvl(b.Channel_4,'')<>'VIP' then 'YSYJ'
          else b.customer_code end
      end  --Channel三级 
     ,case when b.Channel_2='NKA' then b.Channel_4
        when b.Channel_2='Ecom' and a.month_id<='202506' then b.Channel_4
      end  --Channel四级
     ,b.product_barcode
     ,b.customer_code
     ,b.customer_name
     ,b.sample_product   -- FG标签
) t1
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu t2
 on t1.product_barcode=t2.product_barcode
 and t2.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu t3
 on t1.dist_code=t3.customer_code
 and t3.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
 and t3.bu_2='VS'

-- 计算各维度汇总值
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp05

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp05 as
select
 a.years
 ,a.months     -- 年月
 ,b.quarter_id -- 季度
 ,a.Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
 ,a.Channel --Channel一级  
 ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
 ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
 ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
 ,a.sample_product -- FG标签
 ,a.data_type      -- 数据类型
 ,a.data_value    -- SO折算
 ,row_number()over(partition by a.years,a.months,a.Channel,a.Channel_2,a.Channel_3,a.Channel_4,a.sample_product,a.data_type order by a.Channel_type) as rn
from(
  select
    years
    ,months     -- 年月
    ,'1'  as Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
    ,'TTL VS' as Channel --Channel一级  
    ,null as Channel_2 --Channel二级
    ,null as Channel_3 --Channel三级
    ,null as Channel_4 --Channel四级
    ,sample_product -- FG标签
    ,data_type      -- 数据类型
    ,case when data_type='DOH Level' then sum(data_value)/sum(data_value_2) 
       else sum(data_value) 
      end as data_value    -- SO折算
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp04
  group by years,months,sample_product,data_type
  
  union all
  select
    years
    ,months     -- 年月
    ,'2'  as Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
    ,'TTL VS' as Channel --Channel一级  
    ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
    ,null as Channel_3 --Channel三级
    ,null as Channel_4 --Channel四级
    ,sample_product -- FG标签
    ,data_type      -- 数据类型
    ,case when data_type='DOH Level' then sum(data_value)/sum(data_value_2) 
       else sum(data_value) 
      end as data_value    -- SO折算
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp04
  group by years,months,Channel_2,sample_product,data_type
  
  union all
  select
    years
    ,months     -- 年月
    ,'3'  as Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
    ,'TTL VS' as Channel --Channel一级  
    ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
    ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
    ,null as Channel_4 --Channel四级
    ,sample_product -- FG标签
    ,data_type      -- 数据类型
    ,case when data_type='DOH Level' then sum(data_value)/sum(data_value_2) 
       else sum(data_value) 
      end as data_value    -- SO折算
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp04
  group by years,months,Channel_2,Channel_3,sample_product,data_type
  
  union all
  select
    years
    ,months     -- 年月
    ,'4'  as Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
    ,'TTL VS' as Channel --Channel一级  
    ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
    ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
    ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
    ,sample_product -- FG标签
    ,data_type      -- 数据类型
    ,case when data_type='DOH Level' then sum(data_value)/sum(data_value_2) 
       else sum(data_value) 
      end as data_value    -- SO折算
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp04
  group by years,months,Channel_2,Channel_3,Channel_4,sample_product,data_type
) a
left join(
    select distinct month_id,quarter_id,year_id
    from ${dme_cdm}.dim_day
    where day_id between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
   )  b
on a.months=b.month_id

-- 新增排序键
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp06

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp06 as
select distinct
   Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型
   ,Channel --Channel一级
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,data_type
   ,1 as Channel_rn --Channel一级排序
   ,case when Channel_2 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 20
       when Channel_2='NKA' then 30
       when Channel_2='MPD' then 40
     end as Channel_2_rn --Channel二级排序
   ,case when Channel_3 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='YSYJ' then 20
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='WHLY'   then 30
       when Channel_2='Ecom' and Channel_3='Others' then 40
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Hyper'  then 30
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Mini'   then 20
       when Channel_2='NKA'  and Channel_3='Others' then 40
     end as Channel_3_rn --Channel三级排序
   ,case when Channel_4 is null then 10
       when Channel_2='Ecom' then 
          case when Channel_4='Tmall'   then 20
               when Channel_4='JDPS'    then 30
               when Channel_4='TMS'     then 40
               when Channel_4='DY'      then 50
               when Channel_4='VIP'     then 60
               when Channel_4='WeStore' then 70
               when Channel_4='KS'      then 80
              when Channel_4='Others'   then 99
           else 90
          end
       when Channel_2='NKA' then
         case when Channel_4='Watsons' then 20
             when Channel_4='WAL'      then 30
             when Channel_4='CRV'      then 40
             when Channel_4='RT'       then 50
             when Channel_4='Mannings' then 60
             when Channel_4='Metro'    then 70
             when Channel_4='YH'       then 80
             when Channel_4='Others'   then 99
           else 90
          end
     end as Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
   ,case when data_type='Inventory Value' then 20
       when data_type='P6M Sellout'   then 30
       when data_type='DOH Level'     then 40
     end as data_type_rn
   --,dense_rank()over(partition by Channel,Channel_2 order by if(Channel_4='Others','ZZZZZZZZZZZZ',Channel_4)) as Channel_4_rn --Channel四级排序
   --,dense_rank()over(partition by 1 order by if(Lineup='Others','ZZZZZZZZZZZZ',Lineup)) as Lineup_rn --一级子品类英文排序
from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp05
where rn=1

  select
     Channel_type -- Channel的组合类型

 and nvl(a.data_type   ,'')= nvl(b.data_type   ,'')
 left join(
  select quarter_id,max(months) as months
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_stock_drs_temp05
  where months>='202401'
  and months<='${last_month}'
  group by quarter_id
 ) c
 on a.quarter_id=c.quarter_id
 where a.months>='202401'
 and a.months<='${last_month}'
 and nvl(a.data_value,0)<>0
 and a.rn=1

-- 系统ecom数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp03

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp03 as
 select
   substr(a.dt_date,1,6) as months -- 年月
   ,'Ecom'  as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
   ,case when upper(nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others'))='TMALL' then 'TO C' 
     else nvl(b.business_model_name,'Others')
     end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
   ,nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others') as Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,a.store_code
   ,a.store_name
   ,a.henkel_store_category     as store_category    
   ,a.henkel_store_category_lv1 as store_category_lv1
   ,a.henkel_store_category_lv2 as store_category_lv2
   ,nvl(b.ka_code,'Others')     as ka_code
   ,nvl(b.chain_name,'Others')  as ka_name     --ka名称中文  
   ,a.customer_code
   ,a.customer_name
   ,a.sku_id   as product_barcode   -- 商品条码
   ,a.sku_name as product_name      -- 商品名称
   ,a.product_function as Lineup   -- 一级子品类英文
   ,sum(case when c.KA_Name_En='JDPS' and sku_id in('daipipei-vs')then a.post_return_amt_tax/1.13/(1-0.24)
      when c.KA_Name_En ='TMS' and sku_id in('daipipei-vs') then a.post_return_amt_tax/1.13/(1-0.21)
     else a.base_price_post_return_amt 
    end) as sell_out_untax -- SO折算
   ,'ecom_pos' as data_source  -- 数据源   
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu a
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
  on a.store_code = b.store_code
  and b.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka c
  on c.ka_code = b.ka_code
  and c.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
 WHERE a.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu')
 and a.bu_2 ='VS' 
 and substr(a.dt_date,1,6) between '202301' and '${last_month}'
 group by substr(a.dt_date,1,6)  -- 年月
   ,nvl(b.business_model_name,'Others')  --Channel三级 
   ,nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others')  --Channel四级
   ,a.store_code
   ,a.store_name
   ,a.henkel_store_category
   ,a.henkel_store_category_lv1
   ,a.henkel_store_category_lv2
   ,nvl(b.ka_code,'Others')     
   ,nvl(b.chain_name,'Others')  --ka名称中文  
   ,a.customer_code
   ,a.customer_name
   ,a.sku_id      -- 商品条码
   ,a.sku_name    -- 商品名称
   ,a.product_function

-- 系统NKA数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp04

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp04 as
 select
   a.ds -- 日期
   ,a.months -- 年月
   ,a.first_channel_name as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
   ,case when a.first_channel_name ='MPD' then 'Offline retail'
      else nvl(c.nka_group,'Others')
     end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
   ,case when a.first_channel_name ='MPD' then null
      else a.KA_Name_En_lv1
     end                  as Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,a.delivery_store_code as store_code -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
   ,a.delivery_store_name as store_name
   ,nvl(d.store_category    ,'Others') as store_category
   ,nvl(d.store_category_lv1,'Others') as store_category_lv1 --汉高门店一级分类
   ,nvl(d.store_category_lv2,'Others') as store_category_lv2 --汉高门店二级分类
   ,a.dist_system_code    as ka_code
   ,a.dist_system_name    as ka_name         -- ka名称中文  
   ,a.dealercode as customer_code
   ,a.dealername as customer_name
   ,a.henkel_prod_barcode as product_barcode -- 商品条码
   ,a.henkel_prod_name    as product_name    -- 商品名称
   
   ,nvl(b.product_pack,'Others') as product_pack -- 产品规格 
   ,nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as Lineup   -- 一级子品类英文
   ,case --when a.dist_system_code='KA0011' and a.months in ('202604','202605','202606') then 'UN_FG' -- 屈臣氏2604、2605两个月份的FG用手工数据
         when upper(b.product_class)='FG' then 'FG'
         when a.first_channel_name ='NKA' and nvl(a.act_amt_untax,0)=0 then 'FG'
     else 'UN_FG'
    end as sample_product -- FG标签
   ,a.delivery_store_code -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
   ,a.sales_channel
   ,a.act_amt_untax  -- 实价金额(未税)
   ,a.base_unit_qty  -- 基本单位数量
   ,a.sell_out_untax -- SO折算(未税)
   ,case when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name='麦德龙' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') in('PCR','B2B-小B','B2C-POS大单') then '批发'
         when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name='大润发' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') in('B2B','大宗卡结账') then  '批发'
         when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name regexp '华润' and substr(a.ds,1,6) <'202601' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') regexp '批发' then  '批发'
       else '去批发'
     end as data_type
   --,a.data_source as data_source_org
   ,'nka_pos' as data_source  -- 数据源   
  from (
     select t1.ds  
            ,case when t1.dist_system_code='KA0011' then t2.mapping_time -- 屈臣氏日历
               else substr(t1.ds,1,6) end as months
            ,case when t1.dist_system_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136')
                 then 'MPD'
                when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and t2.dist_region_name is null then 'MPD'
             else t1.first_channel_name
            end as first_channel_name
           ,t1.dist_region_name
           ,t1.dist_system_code    
           ,t1.dist_system_name    -- ka名称中文  
           ,t1.dealercode
           ,t1.dealername
           ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1
           ,t1.henkel_prod_barcode -- 商品条码
           ,t1.henkel_prod_name    -- 商品名称
           ,t1.delivery_store_code --	汉高线下配送门店编码
           ,t1.delivery_store_name
           ,t1.sales_channel
           ,t1.original_amt_untax as act_amt_untax -- 实价金额(未税)
           ,t1.base_unit_qty  as base_unit_qty  -- 基本单位数量
           ,t1.base_sales_amt as sell_out_untax -- SO折算
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily t1
     left join (
        select distinct customer_group_cn_lv2,replace(customer_group_cn_lv2,'华润万家','') as dist_region_name
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
        and customer_group_cn_lv2 regexp '华润万家'
     ) t2
     on t1.dist_region_name=t2.dist_region_name
     left join  (
        select distinct
            mapping_time
            ,time_now
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
        and (
         time_now <= concat('${bizdate}','a') 
          or (substr(time_now,1,6) = substr(concat('${bizdate}','a'),1,6) and length(time_now) = 7)
          )
        and  time_type = 'C.月'
     )t2
     on t1.ds = substr(t2.time_now,1,8)
     where t1.ds between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
      and t1.supply_type_name ='直供'
      and t1.bu_2 ='VS'
      and ((t1.first_channel_name ='NKA' and t1.ds>='20250701' and if(t1.dist_system_code='KA0008',1=1,t1.dealercode='100000')) -- 202507开始迈志接口数据除华润万家外其他的只取公司直供
           or(t1.first_channel_name ='NKA' and t1.ds<'20250701')
           or(t1.data_source_name='PG' 
            and t1.dist_system_code in (
             'KA0008' -- 华润万家 
            ,'KA0003' -- 永辉
            ,'KA0046' -- 重百新世纪
            ,'KA0063' -- 红旗
            ,'KA0023' -- 家家悦
            ,'KA0024' -- 利群
            ,'KA0020' -- 世纪联华
            ,'KA0034' -- 天虹
            ,'KA0030' -- 物美
            ,'KA0013' -- 中百仓储
            ,'KA0136' -- 中百便民超市
            ))
         )
   ) a
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b
    on a.henkel_prod_barcode=b.product_barcode
    and b.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
  left join  ${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping  c
    on a.dist_system_code=c.ka_code
    and c.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping')
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu d
    on a.delivery_store_code = d.store_code
    and d.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')

-- 合并个渠道数据，手工+系统
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp06

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_so_drs_mid_temp06 as
select
  a.months     -- 年月
  ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
  ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
  ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,a.customer_code
  ,a.customer_name
  ,a.store_code
  ,a.store_name
  ,a.store_category    
  ,a.store_category_lv1
  ,a.store_category_lv2
  ,a.ka_code      -- ka编码
  ,a.ka_name      -- ka名称
  ,b.product_code	  -- 产品IDH
  ,a.product_barcode  -- 商品条码
  ,nvl(b.product_name,a.product_name) as product_name     -- 商品名称
  ,case when a.sample_product is not null then a.sample_product
     when upper(b.product_class)='FG' then 'FG'
     else 'UN_FG'
   end as sample_product -- FG标签
  ,b.product_class       -- 产品分类
  ,case when a.data_source='ecom_ws' then a.Lineup
      else nvl(b.product_function ,'Others')
    end as Lineup              -- 一级子品类英文
  ,nvl(b.sub_category_name_en,'Others') as sub_category_name_en-- 子品类英文 
  ,nvl(b.sub_product_function,'Others') as sub_product_function-- 二级子品类英文 
  ,nvl(b.product_line_en     ,'Others') as product_line_en     -- 产品线英文
  ,nvl(b.product_pack        ,'Others') as product_pack        -- 产品规格
  ,nvl(b.product_group       ,'Others') as product_group	     -- 产品组
  ,case when b.product_function='Base' then
          case when b.product_line_en in('Volume','MAD','Repair') then b.product_line_en 
            else 'Others' end
       when b.product_function='Genesis' then 
          case when product_line_en in('Green','Blue','Gold','Purple') and b.sub_category_name_en='SHP' then b.product_line_en
            else 'Others' end
       when b.product_function='Treatment' then 
          case when b.product_line_en in('Pixies oil','ROT')  then b.product_line_en 
               when nvl(b.product_line_en,'') not in('Pixies oil','ROT') and b.sub_product_function='JAR' then 'JAR'
            else 'Others' end
       when b.product_function='Styling' then 'Styling'
     else 'Others'
    end as Variant -- 版本
  ,case when b.product_function='Base' and b.product_pack in('750','500','400','200','500*2','500+500','400+200') then b.product_pack
      when b.product_function='Genesis' and b.product_pack in('500','310','500*2+50*2') then b.product_pack
     else 'Others'
    end as Size -- 规格
  ,SUM(a.act_amt_untax) AS act_amt_untax    -- 实价金额(未税）
  ,SUM(a.sell_out_untax) AS sell_out_untax   -- SO折算
  ,a.data_source      -- 数据源
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
from(
 -- ecom渠道批发数据 手工数据
 select 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,null as customer_code
   ,null as customer_name
   ,null as store_code
   ,null as store_name
   ,null as store_category    
   ,null as store_category_lv1

       when b.product_function='Genesis' then 
          case when product_line_en in('Green','Blue','Gold','Purple') and b.sub_category_name_en='SHP' then b.product_line_en
            else 'Others' end
       when b.product_function='Treatment' then 
          case when b.product_line_en in('Pixies oil','ROT')  then b.product_line_en 
               when nvl(b.product_line_en,'') not in('Pixies oil','ROT') and b.sub_product_function='JAR' then 'JAR'
            else 'Others' end
       when b.product_function='Styling' then 'Styling'
     else 'Others'
    end  -- 版本
  ,case when b.product_function='Base' and b.product_pack in('750','500','400','200','500*2','500+500','400+200') then b.product_pack
      when b.product_function='Genesis' and b.product_pack in('500','310','500*2+50*2') then b.product_pack
     else 'Others'
    end  -- 规格
  ,a.data_source -- 数据源
  ,a.data_type   -- 数据类型

-- crv批发

  ,'NKA'   as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
  ,'Hyper' as Channel_3 --Channel三级

select

  ,'Hyper' as Channel_3 --Channel三级

  ,cast(sum(a.act_pos_amt_tax) as decimal(28,6)) as pos_act_amt -- POS实价含税

  from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka

 ) c
 on a.ka_name = c.KA_Name

  ,nvl(c.KA_Name_En_lv1,'Others') -- ka名称英文

  ,a.product_name      -- 商品名称

-- 系统ecom数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp03

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp03 as
 select
   substr(a.dt_date,1,6) as months -- 年月
   ,'Ecom'  as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
   ,case when upper(nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others'))='TMALL' then 'TO C' 
     else nvl(b.business_model_name,'Others')
     end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
   ,nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others') as Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,b.ka_code
   ,b.chain_name as ka_name     --ka名称中文  
   ,a.sku_id   as product_barcode   -- 商品条码
   ,a.sku_name as product_name      -- 商品名称
   ,a.product_function as Lineup   -- 一级子品类英文
   ,sum(post_return_amt_tax) as pos_act_amt -- POS实价含税
   ,'ecom_pos' as data_source  -- 数据源   
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu a
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
  on a.store_code = b.store_code
  and b.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
 left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka c
  on c.ka_code = b.ka_code
  and c.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_ka')
 WHERE a.ds = MAX_PT('${dme_ads}.tb_ecom_pos_sku_sales_summary_bu')
 and a.bu_2 ='VS' 
 and substr(a.dt_date,1,6) between '202301' and '${last_month}'
 group by substr(a.dt_date,1,6)  -- 年月
   ,nvl(b.business_model_name,'Others')  --Channel三级 
   ,nvl(c.KA_Name_En,'Others')  --Channel四级
   ,b.ka_code
   ,b.chain_name  -- ka名称中文  
   ,a.sku_id      -- 商品条码
   ,a.sku_name    -- 商品名称
   ,a.product_function

-- 系统NKA+MPD数据
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp04

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp04 as
 select
    a.ds -- 日期
   ,a.months -- 年月
   ,a.first_channel_name as Channel_2 --Channel二级  
   ,case when a.first_channel_name ='MPD' then nvl(a.Channel_3,'Others') 
      else nvl(c.nka_group,'Others')
     end as Channel_3 --Channel三级 
   ,case when a.first_channel_name ='MPD' then nvl(a.Channel_4,'Others') 
      else a.KA_Name_En_lv1
     end  as Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,case when a.first_channel_name ='MPD' and a.Channel_3 = 'TOP KA Banners' then               
         case when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0008')                   then 'CRV '
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0003')                   then 'YH'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0046')                   then 'CQXSJ'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0063')                   then 'Hongqi'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0023')                   then 'JJY'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0024')                   then 'LQ'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0020')                   then 'SJLH'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0034')                   then 'Tianhong'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0030')                   then 'Wumart'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0013','KA0136')          then 'WHZB'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0025'           )        then 'Yinzuo'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0135','KA0033'  )        then 'Aeon'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0071'           )        then '1+1'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0022'           )        then 'WFZB'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0053'           )        then 'BeiGuo'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0069','KA2537'  )        then 'Hema'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0043'           )        then 'GZHL(贵州合力）'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0029'           )        then 'NBSJ（宁波三江）'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA1665'           )        then 'SuBo'
              when a.dist_system_code in ('KA0072','KA0152','KA2247') then 'OUYA'
              else 'Others' end
         else NULL end  as Channel_5 --Channel五级，仅MPD
   ,a.dist_system_code    as ka_code
   ,a.dist_system_name    as ka_name         -- ka名称中文  
   ,a.henkel_prod_barcode as product_barcode -- 商品条码
   ,a.henkel_prod_name    as product_name    -- 商品名称
   ,nvl(b.product_pack,'Others') as product_pack -- 产品规格 
   ,nvl(b.product_function,'Others') as Lineup   -- 一级子品类英文
   ,a.delivery_store_code -- 汉高线下配送门店编码
   ,a.sales_channel
   ,a.act_amt as pos_act_amt -- 实价金额(含税)
   ,a.base_unit_qty  -- 基本单位数量
   ,case when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name='麦德龙' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') in('PCR','B2B-小B','B2C-POS大单') then '批发'
         when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name='大润发' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') in('B2B','大宗卡结账') then  '批发'
         when a.first_channel_name='NKA' and a.dist_system_name regexp '华润' and substr(a.ds,1,6) <'202601' and nvl(upper(a.sales_channel),'') regexp '批发' then  '批发'
       else '去批发'
     end as data_type
   --,a.data_source as data_source_org
   ,'nka_pos' as data_source  -- 数据源   
  from (
     select t1.ds  
            ,case when t1.dist_system_code='KA0011' then t2.mapping_time -- 屈臣氏日历
               else substr(t1.ds,1,6) end as months
            ,case when t1.dist_system_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136','KA0025','KA0135','KA0033','KA0071','KA0022','KA0053','KA0069','KA2537','KA0043','KA0029','KA1665','KA0072','KA0152','KA2247') 
                    OR t1.henkel_store_category = '线上分销' then 'MPD'
                when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and (t1.DealerCode = '100006') and t2.dist_region_name is null then 'MPD'
                when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and nvl(t1.DealerCode,'') not in ('100006','100000') then 'MPD'
             else t1.first_channel_name
            end as first_channel_name
           ,case when t1.dist_system_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136','KA0025','KA0135','KA0033','KA0071','KA0022','KA0053','KA0069','KA2537','KA0043','KA0029','KA1665','KA0072','KA0152','KA2247') 
                 then 'TOP KA Banners'
                 when t1.henkel_store_category = '线上分销' then 'MPD Online'
                 when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and (t1.DealerCode = '100006') and t2.dist_region_name is null then 'TOP KA Banners'
                 when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and nvl(t1.DealerCode,'') not in ('100006','100000') then 'TOP KA Banners'
             else NULL 
            end  as  Channel_3
           ,case when t1.dist_system_code in('KA0003','KA0046','KA0063','KA0023','KA0024','KA0020','KA0034','KA0030','KA0013','KA0136')
                 then 'P&G indirect'
                 when t1.dist_system_code in('KA0025','KA0135','KA0033','KA0071','KA0022','KA0053','KA0069','KA2537','KA0043','KA0029','KA1665','KA0072','KA0152','KA2247') 
                 then 'Legacy LKA'
                 when t1.henkel_store_category = '线上分销' then (case when nvl(t3.store_group_name,'') = '超星星'  then nvl(t3.store_group_name,'') else 'Others' end)
                 when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and (t1.DealerCode = '100006') and t2.dist_region_name is null then 'P&G indirect'
                 when t1.dist_system_code ='KA0008' and nvl(t1.DealerCode,'') not in ('100006','100000') then 'P&G indirect'
             else NULL 
            end  as  Channel_4
           ,t1.dist_region_name
           ,t1.dist_system_code    
           ,t1.dist_system_name    -- ka名称中文  
           ,t1.KA_Name_En_lv1
           ,t1.henkel_prod_barcode -- 商品条码
           ,t1.henkel_prod_name    -- 商品名称
           ,t1.delivery_store_code --	汉高线下配送门店编码
           ,t1.sales_channel
           ,t1.original_amt_tax as act_amt -- 实价金额(含税)
           ,t1.base_unit_qty  as base_unit_qty  -- 基本单位数量
     from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_ka_pos_data_sales_daily t1
     left join (
        select distinct customer_group_cn_lv2,replace(customer_group_cn_lv2,'华润万家','') as dist_region_name
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu
        where ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
        and customer_group_cn_lv2 regexp '华润万家'
     ) t2
     on t1.dist_region_name=t2.dist_region_name
     left join  (
        select distinct
            mapping_time
            ,time_now
        from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df 
        where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
        and (
         time_now <= concat('${bizdate}','a') 
          or (substr(time_now,1,6) = substr(concat('${bizdate}','a'),1,6) and length(time_now) = 7)
          )
        and  time_type = 'C.月'
     )t2
     on t1.ds = substr(t2.time_now,1,8)
    left join  ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu t3  -- 取汉高门店分组
    on t1.henkel_store_code=t3.store_code
    and t3.ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
     where t1.ds between '20230101' and '${bizdate}'
      and t1.bu_2 ='VS'
      and ( (t1.first_channel_name ='NKA' and t1.supply_type_name ='直供'  )
           or (t1.dist_system_code in (
             'KA0008' -- 华润万家 
            ,'KA0003' -- 永辉
            ,'KA0046' -- 重百新世纪
            ,'KA0063' -- 红旗
            ,'KA0023' -- 家家悦
            ,'KA0024' -- 利群
            ,'KA0020' -- 世纪联华
            ,'KA0034' -- 天虹
            ,'KA0030' -- 物美
            ,'KA0013' -- 中百仓储
            ,'KA0136' -- 中百便民超市
            ))
            or(t1.dist_system_code in 
                ('KA0025'                      -- 银座
                ,'KA0135','KA0033'             -- 永旺
                ,'KA0071'                      -- 壹加壹
                ,'KA0022'                      -- 潍坊中百
                ,'KA0053'                      -- 北国
                ,'KA0069','KA2537'             -- 盒马
                ,'KA0043'                      -- 贵州合力
                ,'KA0029'                      -- 宁波三江
                ,'KA1665'                      -- 苏铂
                ,'KA0072','KA0152','KA2247') )   -- 欧亚连锁、欧亚超市、欧亚长青生活超市)
           or (t1.henkel_store_category = '线上分销' )
         )
   ) a
  left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b
    on a.henkel_prod_barcode=b.product_barcode
    and b.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
  left join  ${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping  c
    on a.dist_system_code=c.ka_code
    and c.ds = max_pt('${dme_ods}.s_nka_group_mapping')

-- 合并个渠道数据，手工+系统
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp06

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp06 as
select
  a.months     -- 年月
 ,substr(a.months,1,4)  as   years
 ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03') then 'Q1'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('04','05','06') then 'Q2'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09') then 'Q3'
       when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('10','11','12') then 'Q4'
   end as quarters  
 ,case when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2023' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2324'
       when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2024' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2324'
       when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2024' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2425'
       when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2025' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2425'
       when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2025' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12') then 'FY2526'
       when substr(a.months,1,4) = '2026' and substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06') then 'FY2526'
    end as FY 
   ,case when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('01','02','03','04','05','06')   then 'H1'
         when substr(a.months,5,2) in ('07','08','09','10','11','12')   then 'H2'   end       as  HY
  ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
  ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
  ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,a.Channel_5 --Channel五级
  ,a.product_barcode  -- 商品条码
  ,nvl(b.product_name,a.product_name) as product_name     -- 商品名称

  ,case when a.data_source='ecom_ws' then a.Lineup
      else nvl(b.product_function ,'Others')
    end as Lineup              -- 一级子品类英文
  ,SUM(a.pos_act_amt) AS pos_act_amt   -- POS实价含税
  ,a.data_source      -- 数据源
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
from(
 -- ecom渠道批发数据 手工数据
 select 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,cast(NULL as string)  as  Channel_5 --Channel五级
   ,product_barcode  -- 商品条码
   ,product_name     -- 商品名称
   ,Lineup           -- 一级子品类英文
   ,pos_act_amt   -- POS实价含税
   ,data_source      -- 数据源
   ,'批发' as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp01 
 
 -- nka渠道批发 手工数据
 union all
 select 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,cast(NULL as string)  as  Channel_5 --Channel五级
   ,product_barcode  -- 商品条码
   ,product_name     -- 商品名称
   ,Lineup           -- 一级子品类英文
   ,pos_act_amt   -- POS实价含税
   ,data_source      -- 数据源
   ,'批发'   as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp02
    
 -- 系统ecom数据
 union all
 select 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,cast(NULL as string)  as  Channel_5 --Channel五级
   ,product_barcode  -- 商品条码
   ,product_name     -- 商品名称
   ,Lineup           -- 一级子品类英文
   ,pos_act_amt   -- POS实价含税
   ,data_source      -- 数据源
   ,'含批发' as data_type -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp03
 
 -- 系统nka&MPD数据
 union all
 
 select 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,Channel_5  as  Channel_5 --Channel五级
   ,product_barcode  -- 商品条码
   ,product_name     -- 商品名称
   ,Lineup           -- 一级子品类英文
   ,sum(pos_act_amt) as pos_act_amt -- POS实价含税
   ,data_source -- 数据源
   ,data_type   -- 数据类型
 from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp04
 group by 
   months     -- 年月
   ,Channel_2 --Channel二级
   ,Channel_3 --Channel三级
   ,Channel_4 --Channel四级
   ,Channel_5
   ,product_barcode  -- 商品条码
   ,product_name     -- 商品名称
   ,Lineup           -- 一级子品类英文
   ,data_source -- 数据源
   ,data_type   -- 数据类型
 
 
) a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu b
 on a.product_barcode=b.product_barcode
 and b.ds =max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
group by 
  a.months     -- 年月
  ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
  ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
  ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,a.Channel_5 --Channel五级
  ,a.product_barcode  -- 商品条码
  ,nvl(b.product_name,a.product_name)     -- 商品名称
  ,case when a.data_source='ecom_ws' then a.Lineup
      else nvl(b.product_function ,'Others')
    end -- 一级子品类英文
  
  ,a.data_source      -- 数据源
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型

-- 区分是否去批发，加工好的rawdata，可用于明细导出
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp07

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp07 as
select
   a.months     -- 年月
  ,a.years
  ,a.quarters  
  ,a.FY 
  ,a.HY
  ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
  ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
  ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
  ,a.Channel_5 --Channel五级
  ,a.product_barcode
  ,a.product_name     -- 商品名称
  ,a.Lineup         -- 一级子品类英文
  ,sum(a.pos_act_amt) as pos_act_amt  -- POS实价含税
  ,a.data_source    -- 数据源
  ,a.data_type -- 数据类型
from (
     select
        a.months     -- 年月
       ,a.years
       ,a.quarters  
       ,a.FY 
       ,a.HY
       ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
       ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
       ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
       ,a.Channel_5 --Channel五级
       ,a.product_barcode
       ,a.product_name     -- 商品名称
       ,a.Lineup         -- 一级子品类英文
       ,sum(a.pos_act_amt) as pos_act_amt  -- POS实价含税
       ,a.data_source    -- 数据源
       ,'含批发' as data_type -- 数据类型
     from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp06 a   
     where nvl(pos_act_amt,0)<>0 and ((data_type = '含批发' and a.data_source <> 'nka_pos') OR a.data_source = 'nka_pos')
     group by a.months -- 年月
       ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
       ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级
       ,a.Channel_4 --Channel四级
       ,a.Channel_5 --Channel五级
       ,a.product_barcode
       ,a.product_name     -- 商品名称
       ,a.Lineup         -- 一级子品类英文
       ,a.data_source    -- 数据源
       ,a.years
       ,a.quarters  
       ,a.FY 
       ,a.HY
       
     union all
     --批发
     select
       a.months     -- 年月
       ,a.years
       ,a.quarters  
       ,a.FY 
       ,a.HY

CREATE TABLE ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp08 as
select
   b.year_id     as years
  ,b.quarter_id as quarters
  ,a.months     -- 年月
  ,a.Channel_2 --Channel二级
  ,a.Channel_3 --Channel三级

    months     -- 年月

    ,Channel_5 --Channel五级

    ,data_source    -- 数据源

  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp07
   where months >= '202301' and months<='${last_month}'
  union all
  select
    to_char(to_date(add_months(to_date(months,'yyyymm'),12),'yyyy-mm-dd'),'yyyymm') as months     -- 年月

    ,Channel_3 --Channel三级

    ,data_type      -- 数据类型
  from ${dme_ads}.tb_mtk_pos_drs_temp07
   where months >= '202301' and months<='${last_month}'

) a

       when Channel_2='MPD' then 
         (case when Channel_3='MPD Online' then 20
             when Channel_3='TOP KA Banners'   then 30
             when Channel_3='Others'   then 99
           else 90 end)
       else 40 end as Channel_3_rn --Channel三级排序

    ,case when Channel_5 is null then 10

          when Channel_5 in ('CQXSJ'           )   then  23

          when Channel_5 in ('Wumart'          )   then  29
          when Channel_5 in ('WHZB'            )   then  30

          when Channel_5 in ('BeiGuo'          )   then  35
          when Channel_5 in ('Hema'            )   then  36
          when Channel_5 in ('GZHL(贵州合力）' )   then  37
          when Channel_5 in ('NBSJ（宁波三江）')   then  38
          when Channel_5 in ('SuBo'            )   then  39
          when Channel_5 in ('OUYA'            )   then  40

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_detail partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select *
from(
select
  case when a.ka_code='KA0011' and e.mapping_time is not null then substr(e.mapping_time,1,4)
       else substr(a.dt_date,1,4) end as years -- 年
  ,case when a.ka_code='KA0011' and e.mapping_time is not null then concat(substr(e.mapping_time,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(to_date(e.mapping_time,'yyyymm')))
       else concat(substr(a.dt_date,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(to_date(substr(a.dt_date,1,6),'yyyymm'))) end as quarters -- 季
  ,case when a.ka_code='KA0011' then e.mapping_time -- 屈臣氏日历
       else substr(a.dt_date,1,6) end as months -- 月
  ,if(length(a.dt_date)<=7,to_char(LASTDAY(TO_DATE(substr(a.dt_date,1,6),'yyyymm')),'yyyymmdd'),substr(a.dt_date,1,8)) as dt_date -- 日期
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.sku_id           -- 产品编码
  ,a.sku_barcode      -- 产品条码
  ,a.sku_name         -- 产品名称
  ,nvl(d.brand_name             ,'Others') as brand_name              -- 品牌
  ,nvl(d.brand_name_en          ,'Others') as brand_name_en           -- 品牌英文
  ,nvl(d.product_line           ,'Others') as product_line            -- 产品线
  ,nvl(d.product_line_en        ,'Others') as product_line_en         -- 产品线英文
  ,nvl(d.category_name          ,'Others') as category_name           -- 品类
  ,nvl(d.category_name_en       ,'Others') as category_name_en        -- 品类英文
  ,nvl(d.product_function_cn    ,'Others') as product_function_cn     -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(d.product_function       ,'Others') as product_function_en     -- 一级子品类英文
  ,nvl(d.sub_product_function_cn,'Others') as sub_product_function_cn -- 二级子品类
  ,nvl(d.sub_product_function   ,'Others') as sub_product_function_en -- 二级子品类英文
  ,nvl(d.product_pack_type      ,'Others') as product_pack_type       -- 产品包装分类
  ,nvl(d.product_pack           ,'Others') as product_pack            -- 产品规格
  ,nvl(case when length(concat(d.colour_chroma, '.', d.main_colour_hue))<=1 then 'Others'
       else concat(d.colour_chroma, '.', d.main_colour_hue)
       end,'Others') as colour_hue-- 色调
  ,a.first_channel_name_cust_lastest  as channel_1_cust  --一级经销商渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name_cust_lastest as channel_2_cust  -- 二级经销商渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name_cust_lastest  as channel_3_cust  -- 三级经销商渠道
  ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest as channel_4_cust  -- 四级经销商渠道
  ,c.is_expired_customer as cooperation_status --  经销商合作状态
  ,a.region_cust_lastest     as region_cust       -- 经销商区域
  ,nvl(c.province ,'Others') as province_name_cust-- 经销商省份
  ,nvl(c.city_name,'Others') as city_name_cust    -- 经销商城市
  ,a.customer_code -- 经销商编码
  ,a.customer_name -- 经销商名称
  ,a.first_channel_name  as channel_1_ka  -- 一级KA渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name as channel_2_ka  -- 二级KA渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name  as channel_3_ka  -- 三级KA渠道
  ,a.fourth_channel_name as channel_4_ka  -- 四级KA渠道
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then b.ka_code    else a.ka_code end as ka_code -- KA编码
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then b.chain_name else a.ka_name end as ka_name -- KA名称 
  ,nvl(b.distributor_region_name,'Others') as dist_region_name -- 零售商区域
  ,a.store_category     -- 门店分类
  ,a.store_category_lv1 -- 门店一级分类
  ,a.store_category_lv2 -- 门店二级分类
  ,nvl(b.henkel_region,'Others') as region_name_store   -- 门店区域
  ,nvl(b.province_name,'Others') as province_name_store -- 门店省份
  ,nvl(b.city_name    ,'Others') as city_name_store     -- 门店城市
  ,a.store_code as ka_store_code -- KA处门店编码
  ,a.henkel_store_code   -- 门店标准编码
  ,a.henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
  ,a.delivery_store_code -- 送达门店编码
  ,a.delivery_store_name -- 送达门店名称
  ,a.sales_channel       -- 销售渠道
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then nvl(a.province_name,'Others') end as ecom_province_name -- Ecom收货方省份
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then nvl(a.city_name,'Others')     end as ecom_city_name     -- Ecom收货方城市
  ,a.tax_rate -- 税率
  ,sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.sku_sale_num             end) as pre_sale_num   -- POS退前销量
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.sku_sales_amt            end)as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pre_sales_amt  -- POS退前销额
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.sku_base_sales_amt       end)as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pre_base_amt   -- POS退前基价销额
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.sku_sale_num*a.sku_price/nvl(a.tax_rate,1.13) end)as DECIMAL(28,6)) as pre_rsp_amt    -- POS退前RSP销额
  ,sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.return_num             end) as return_sale_num  -- POS退货销量    
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.return_amt             end)as DECIMAL(28,6)) as return_sales_amt -- POS退货销额    
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then nvl(a.sku_base_sales_amt,0)-nvl(a.base_price_post_return_amt,0) end)as DECIMAL(28,6)) as return_base_amt  -- POS退货基价金额  
  ,cast(sum(case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then a.return_num*a.sku_price/nvl(a.tax_rate,1.13) end) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as return_rsp_amt   -- POS退货RSP金额
  ,sum(a.post_return_num) as post_return_num -- POS退后销量
  ,cast(sum(a.post_return_amt) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as post_return_amt -- POS退后销额
  ,cast(sum(a.base_price_post_return_amt) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as post_return_base_amt -- POS退后基价销额
  ,cast(sum((nvl(a.sku_sale_num,0)-nvl(a.return_num,0))*a.sku_price/nvl(a.tax_rate,1.13)) as DECIMAL(28,6)) as post_return_rsp_amt -- POS退后RSP销额
  ,a.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,a.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,a.channel_ka_permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）


from ${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu a
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu b
 on a.henkel_store_code=b.store_code
 and b.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_store_bu')
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu c
 on a.customer_code=c.customer_code
 and a.bu_2=c.bu_2
 and c.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_customer_bu')
left join ${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu d
 on a.sku_barcode=d.product_barcode
 and d.ds=max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_master_data_product_pos_bu')
left join  (
    select distinct
        mapping_time
        ,time_now
    from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df 
    where ds = max_pt('${dme_cdm}.dwd_watsons_mapping_time_df') 
    and  time_type = 'C.月'
    and ( time_now <= concat('${bizdate}','a') 
      or (substr(time_now,1,6) = substr(concat('${bizdate}','a'),1,6) and length(time_now) = 7)
      )
 ) e
 on substr(a.dt_date,1,8) = substr(e.time_now,1,8)
where a.ds=max_pt('${dme_ads}.tb_pos_sku_sales_summary_v2_bu')
group by 
  case when a.ka_code='KA0011' and e.mapping_time is not null then substr(e.mapping_time,1,4)
       else substr(a.dt_date,1,4) end -- 年
  ,case when a.ka_code='KA0011' and e.mapping_time is not null then concat(substr(e.mapping_time,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(to_date(e.mapping_time,'yyyymm')))
       else concat(substr(a.dt_date,1,4),'Q',QUARTER(to_date(substr(a.dt_date,1,6),'yyyymm'))) end -- 季
  ,case when a.ka_code='KA0011' then e.mapping_time -- 屈臣氏日历
       else substr(a.dt_date,1,6) end -- 月
  ,if(length(a.dt_date)<=7,to_char(LASTDAY(TO_DATE(substr(a.dt_date,1,6),'yyyymm')),'yyyymmdd'),substr(a.dt_date,1,8))  -- 日期
  ,a.bu_1
  ,a.bu_2
  ,a.sku_id           -- 产品编码
  ,a.sku_barcode      -- 产品条码
  ,a.sku_name         -- 产品名称
  ,nvl(d.brand_name             ,'Others') -- 品牌
  ,nvl(d.brand_name_en          ,'Others') -- 品牌英文
  ,nvl(d.product_line           ,'Others') -- 产品线
  ,nvl(d.product_line_en        ,'Others') -- 产品线英文
  ,nvl(d.category_name          ,'Others') -- 品类
  ,nvl(d.category_name_en       ,'Others') -- 品类英文
  ,nvl(d.product_function_cn    ,'Others') -- 一级子品类
  ,nvl(d.product_function       ,'Others') -- 一级子品类英文
  ,nvl(d.sub_product_function_cn,'Others') -- 二级子品类
  ,nvl(d.sub_product_function   ,'Others') -- 二级子品类英文
  ,nvl(d.product_pack_type      ,'Others') -- 产品包装分类
  ,nvl(d.product_pack           ,'Others') -- 产品规格
  ,nvl(case when length(concat(d.colour_chroma, '.', d.main_colour_hue))<=1 then 'Others'
       else concat(d.colour_chroma, '.', d.main_colour_hue)
       end,'Others')-- 色调
  ,a.first_channel_name_cust_lastest   --一级经销商渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 二级经销商渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name_cust_lastest   -- 三级经销商渠道
  ,a.fourth_channel_name_cust_lastest  -- 四级经销商渠道
  ,c.is_expired_customer --  经销商合作状态
  ,a.region_cust_lastest     -- 经销商区域
  ,nvl(c.province ,'Others') -- 经销商省份
  ,nvl(c.city_name,'Others') -- 经销商城市
  ,a.customer_code -- 经销商编码
  ,a.customer_name -- 经销商名称
  ,a.first_channel_name   -- 一级KA渠道
  ,a.second_channel_name  -- 二级KA渠道
  ,a.third_channel_name   -- 三级KA渠道
  ,a.fourth_channel_name  -- 四级KA渠道
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then b.ka_code    else a.ka_code end  -- KA编码
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then b.chain_name else a.ka_name end  -- KA名称 
  ,nvl(b.distributor_region_name,'Others') -- 零售商区域
  ,a.store_category     -- 门店分类
  ,a.store_category_lv1 -- 门店一级分类
  ,a.store_category_lv2 -- 门店二级分类
  ,nvl(b.henkel_region,'Others')  -- 门店区域
  ,nvl(b.province_name,'Others')  -- 门店省份
  ,nvl(b.city_name    ,'Others')  -- 门店城市
  ,a.store_code  -- KA处门店编码
  ,a.henkel_store_code   -- 门店标准编码
  ,a.henkel_store_name   -- 汉高门店名称
  ,a.delivery_store_code -- 送达门店编码
  ,a.delivery_store_name -- 送达门店名称
  ,a.sales_channel       -- 销售渠道
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then nvl(a.province_name,'Others')          end  -- Ecom收货方省份
  ,case when a.first_channel_name='Ecom' then nvl(a.city_name,'Others')              end  -- Ecom收货方城市
  ,a.tax_rate -- 税率
  ,a.channel_customer_permission -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,a.region_customer_permission  -- 客户区域（权限字段）
  ,a.channel_ka_permission       -- KA渠道（权限字段）
)
where nvl(pre_sale_num        ,0)<>0
or nvl(pre_sales_amt       ,0)<>0
or nvl(pre_base_amt        ,0)<>0
or nvl(pre_rsp_amt         ,0)<>0
or nvl(return_sale_num     ,0)<>0
or nvl(return_sales_amt    ,0)<>0
or nvl(return_base_amt     ,0)<>0
or nvl(return_rsp_amt      ,0)<>0
or nvl(post_return_num     ,0)<>0
or nvl(post_return_amt     ,0)<>0
or nvl(post_return_base_amt,0)<>0
or nvl(post_return_rsp_amt ,0)<>0

insert overwrite table ${dme_ads}.tb_customer_product_pl_m_bu partition(ds='${bizdate}')
select
  substr(a.months,1,4) as years       -- 年
  ,concat('Q',QUARTER(to_date(a.months,'yyyymm'))) as quarters    -- 季
  ,a.months                       -- 月
  ,a.bu_2                         -- bu_2
  ,a.bu_1                         -- bu_1
  ,a.category_name_cn             -- 品类
  ,a.category_name_en             -- 品类英文
  ,a.product_function_cn          -- 一级子品类
  ,a.product_function_en          -- 一级子品类英文
  ,a.sub_product_function_cn      -- 二级子品类
  ,a.sub_product_function_en      -- 二级子品类英文
  ,a.brand_name_cn                -- 品牌
  ,a.brand_name_en                -- 品牌英文
  ,a.product_line_name_cn         -- 产品线
  ,a.product_ph5_code             -- 产品PH5编码
  ,nvl(a.product_ph5_name_en,'Others') as product_ph5_name_en -- 产品PH5名称
  ,a.product_id                   -- 产品编码
  ,a.product_barcode              -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name_cn              -- SKU
  ,nvl(b.product_pack_type,'Others') as product_pack_type  -- 产品规格类型
  ,nvl(b.product_pack,'Others') as product_pack  -- 产品规格
  ,a.first_channel_name_lastest as first_channel_name  -- 一级渠道
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.region
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('ECOM') then a.customer_name_cn
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(a.customer_group_cn_lv1 regexp'屈臣氏|万宁','WTS','Non-WTS')
       else null
     end as second_channel_name --渠道层级第二级
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.province
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.customer_group_cn_lv1
       else null
     end as third_channel_name --渠道层级第三级
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.customer_name_cn
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then  a.customer_group_cn_lv2
       else  null
     end as fourth_channel_name --渠道层级第四级
  ,c.is_expired_customer          -- 经销商合作状态
  ,a.customer_id                  -- 经销商编码
  ,a.customer_name_cn             -- 经销商名称
  ,a.customer_name_en             -- 经销商名称英文
  ,cast(sum(a.ges                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as ges                  -- GES
  ,cast(sum(a.ppd                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as ppd                  -- PPD
  ,cast(sum(a.pld                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as pld                  -- PLD
  ,cast(sum(a.fg                     ) as decimal(28,6)) as fg                   -- FG
  ,cast(sum(a.l6a_others             ) as decimal(28,6)) as l6a_others           -- L6 A others
  ,cast(sum(a.ngs                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as ngs                  -- NGS
  ,cast(sum(a.rebate_cy              ) as decimal(28,6)) as rebate               -- Rebate
  ,cast(sum(a.ca_cy                  ) as decimal(28,6)) as ca                   -- CA
  ,cast(sum(a.listing_fee_cy         ) as decimal(28,6)) as listing_fee          -- Listing Fee
  ,cast(sum(a.int_agreement_cy       ) as decimal(28,6)) as int_agreement        -- Int. Agreement
  ,cast(sum(a.oos_penalty_cy         ) as decimal(28,6)) as oos_penalty          -- OOS Penalty
  ,cast(sum(a.promotion_activities_cy) as decimal(28,6)) as promotion_activities -- Promotion Activities
  ,cast(sum(a.ka_expense_cy          ) as decimal(28,6)) as ka_expense           -- KA Expense
  ,cast(sum(a.logistics_cy           ) as decimal(28,6)) as logistics            -- LOGSTIC
  ,cast(sum(a.l6b_others_cy          ) as decimal(28,6)) as l6b_others           -- L6 B others
  ,cast(sum(a.py_release             ) as decimal(28,6)) as py_release           -- PY Release
  ,cast(sum(a.ror_cy                 ) as decimal(28,6)) as ror                  -- ROR
  ,cast(sum(a.deduction_cy           ) as decimal(28,6)) as deduction            -- Deduction
  ,cast(sum(nvl(a.L6a,0)+nvl(a.L6b,0)) as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_16               -- L6 Total       
  ,cast(sum(a.nes                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as nes                  -- NES
  ,cast(sum(a.l10_bdp                ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10_bdp              -- L10 BDP
  ,cast(sum(a.l10_dsr                ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10_dsr              -- L10 DSR
  ,cast(sum(a.l10_service_fee        ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10_service_fee      -- L10 服务商费用
  ,cast(sum(a.l10_mark_up_ii         ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10_mark_up_ii       -- L10 Mark Up II
  ,cast(sum(a.l10_sur_tax_others     ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10_sur_tax_others   -- L10 Sur Tax/Others
  ,cast(sum(a.l10                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l10                  -- TTL L10
  ,cast(sum(a.l11                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l11                  -- L11
  ,cast(sum(a.l12_goods_sold         ) as decimal(28,6)) as l12_goods_sold       -- L12 Goods Sold
  ,cast(sum(a.l12_provision_cog      ) as decimal(28,6)) as l12_provision_cog    -- L12 Provision COG
  ,cast(sum(a.l12_tp_price_others    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l12_tp_price_others  -- L12 TP price/Others
  ,cast(sum(a.l12                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l12                  -- TTL L12
  ,cast(sum(a.l13                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l13                  -- L13 Processing cost
  ,cast(sum(a.l14_cog                ) as decimal(28,6)) as l14_cog              -- L14 Total manufactur
  ,cast(sum(a.c1                     ) as decimal(28,6)) as c1                   -- C1
  ,cast(sum(a.l16                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as l16                  -- L16
  ,cast(sum(a.gp1                    ) as decimal(28,6)) as gp1                  -- GP1
  ,cast(sum(a.ttl_l17                ) as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_l17              -- TTL L17
  ,cast(sum(a.ttl_gp2                ) as decimal(28,6)) as ttl_gp2              -- GP2
  ,a.channel_customer_Permission  -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,a.region_customer_Permission   -- 客户区域（权限字段）
from ${dme_cdm}.dwd_customer_product_pl_m_bu a

 on a.product_id=b.product_code

  ,nvl(a.product_ph5_name_en,'Others') -- 产品PH5名称
  ,a.product_id                   -- 产品编码
  ,a.product_barcode              -- 产品条码
  ,a.product_name_cn              -- SKU
  ,nvl(b.product_pack_type,'Others')   -- 产品规格类型
  ,nvl(b.product_pack,'Others')   -- 产品规格
  ,a.first_channel_name_lastest   -- 一级渠道
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.region

       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then if(a.customer_group_cn_lv1 regexp'屈臣氏|万宁','WTS','Non-WTS')
       else null
     end  --渠道层级第二级
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.province
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then a.customer_group_cn_lv1
       else null
     end  --渠道层级第三级
  ,case when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in('DT','MPD') then a.customer_name_cn
       when UPPER(a.first_channel_name_lastest) in ('NKA','SELECTIVE RETAILER') then  a.customer_group_cn_lv2
       else  null
     end  --渠道层级第四级
  ,c.is_expired_customer          -- 经销商合作状态
  ,a.customer_id                  -- 经销商编码
  ,a.customer_name_cn             -- 经销商名称
  ,a.customer_name_en             -- 经销商名称英文
  ,a.channel_customer_Permission  -- 客户渠道（权限字段）
  ,a.region_customer_Permission   -- 客户区域（权限字段）
